`host/locks.ps1`:

```ps1
# Dot-source: . host\locks.ps1   (needs $root = project root, set by the caller or derived below)
# Lock files hold "<owner> pid=<pid> <MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss> <what>"; created atomically (CreateNew). Stale = pid dead or older than 20 min.
#   build lock : build\heavy.lock              one build (host\build_snap.py, snap_build) at a time. Take-BuildLock / Release-Lock
#   run slots  : build\slots\run0..run3.lock   up to 4 hidden test runs at once (host\run_boot.ps1 does this itself)
#   priority   : while build\heavy.priority exists, run slot 0 is reserved for the run whose $env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER equals its content
#   exclusive  : -Bench / perf runs: build\slots\exclusive.lock (one exclusive at a time), then all 4 slots; new normal runs yield meanwhile
if (-not $script:LockRoot) { $script:LockRoot = if ($root) { "$root" } else { (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path } }
$script:LockMax = 4   # owner 2026-11-12: 4 hidden runs at once (was 6: CPU at 100%, runs crawled; was 3 before that)
# owner 2026-11-12: "while i use the pc you can only have 1 instance". build\slots\max.txt (1..4) lowers the cap; delete it to go back to 4.
$capFile = Join-Path $script:LockRoot 'build\slots\max.txt'
if (Test-Path $capFile) { $cap = 0; if ([int]::TryParse(((Get-Content $capFile -TotalCount 1) -as [string]).Trim(), [ref]$cap) -and $cap -ge 1 -and $cap -lt $script:LockMax) { $script:LockMax = $cap } }

function Get-LockText([string]$Path) { try { (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop) -join ' ' } catch { $null } }

function Test-LockStale([string]$Path) {
    $t = Get-LockText $Path
    if ($null -eq $t) { return $false }                       # vanished or unreadable: not ours to remove
    $age = ((Get-Date) - (Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LastWriteTime).TotalMinutes
    if ($age -gt 20) { return $true }
    if ($t -match 'pid=(\d+)') { return -not [bool](Get-Process -Id ([int]$Matches[1]) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
    return ($age -gt 0.2)                                      # no pid: a half-written file older than ~10 s
}

# Atomic create. Returns $true if we now own the lock. A machine-wide named mutex covers the stale check + removal + create, so two takers cannot both
# judge a lock stale and delete each other's fresh lock.
function Try-TakeLock([string]$Path, [string]$What) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $Path) | Out-Null
    $mx = New-Object System.Threading.Mutex($false, 'Global\SnapRecompLocks')
    try { try { [void]$mx.WaitOne(10000) } catch [System.Threading.AbandonedMutexException] {}
        if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) -and (Test-LockStale $Path)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
        try {
            $owner = if ($env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER) { $env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER } else { 'run_boot' }
            $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Write, [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite)
            $b = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$owner pid=$PID $(Get-Date -Format 'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss') $What")
            $fs.Write($b, 0, $b.Length); $fs.Close()
            return $true
        } catch { return $false }
    } finally { try { $mx.ReleaseMutex() } catch {}; $mx.Dispose() }
}
function Release-Lock([string]$Path) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

# Build lock: poll until taken (default 30 min). Returns $true/$false. Release with Release-Lock (Join-Path $LockRoot 'build\heavy.lock').
function Take-BuildLock([string]$What = 'build', [int]$WaitSec = 1800) {
    $p = Join-Path $script:LockRoot 'build\heavy.lock'
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $WaitSec; $i++) { if (Try-TakeLock $p $What) { return $true }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
    return $false
}

function Get-SlotOwners {
    (0..($script:LockMax - 1) | ForEach-Object { $f = Join-Path $script:LockRoot "build\slots\run$_.lock"; "run$_=" + $(if (Test-Path $f) { Get-LockText $f } else { 'free' }) }) -join ' | '
}

# Take one run slot (returns slot index) or, with -Exclusive, all slots (returns 0..2). $null on timeout. Release with Exit-RunSlots.
function Enter-RunSlots([string]$What, [switch]$Exclusive, [int]$WaitSec = 3600) {
    $dir = Join-Path $script:LockRoot 'build\slots'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
    $xl = Join-Path $dir 'exclusive.lock'; $prio = Join-Path $script:LockRoot 'build\heavy.priority'
    $got = @(); $haveX = $false; $lastMsg = Get-Date '2000-01-01'
    try {
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt ($WaitSec * 2); $i++) {
            if ($Exclusive) {
                if ($haveX -and -not (Test-Path $xl)) { $haveX = $false }   # lost to a stale clean-up: take it again
                if (-not $haveX) { $haveX = Try-TakeLock $xl "$What (exclusive)" }
                if ($haveX) { foreach ($n in 0..($script:LockMax - 1)) { if ($got -notcontains $n -and (Try-TakeLock (Join-Path $dir "run$n.lock") "$What (exclusive)")) { $got += $n } } }
                if ($got.Count -eq $script:LockMax) { $script:SlotsHeld = $got; return $got }
            } elseif (-not (Test-Path $xl) -or (Test-LockStale $xl)) {   # a waiting exclusive run goes first
                $reserved = $null
                if (Test-Path $prio) { $reserved = ((Get-Content $prio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join '').Trim() }
                $isOwner = $reserved -and $env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER -and ($env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER.Trim() -eq $reserved)
                foreach ($n in 0..($script:LockMax - 1)) {
                    if ($n -eq 0 -and $reserved -and -not $isOwner) { continue }
                    if (Try-TakeLock (Join-Path $dir "run$n.lock") $What) { $script:SlotsHeld = @($n); return @($n) }
                }
            }
            if (((Get-Date) - $lastMsg).TotalSeconds -ge 30) { $lastMsg = Get-Date; Write-Host "waiting for run slot$(if ($Exclusive) { 's (exclusive)' }): $(Get-SlotOwners)" }
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
        }
        return $null
    } finally {
        if ($Exclusive -and -not ($script:SlotsHeld -and $script:SlotsHeld.Count -eq $script:LockMax)) { foreach ($n in $got) { Release-Lock (Join-Path $dir "run$n.lock") }; if ($haveX) { Release-Lock $xl } }
    }
}
function Exit-RunSlots {
    $dir = Join-Path $script:LockRoot 'build\slots'
    foreach ($n in @($script:SlotsHeld)) { Release-Lock (Join-Path $dir "run$n.lock") }
    if (@($script:SlotsHeld).Count -gt 1) { $xl = Join-Path $dir 'exclusive.lock'; if ((Get-LockText $xl) -match "pid=$PID ") { Release-Lock $xl } }   # only our own exclusive.lock
    $script:SlotsHeld = @()
}

```

`host/make_icon.py`:

```py
"""Build-time icon generator: writes build/snap_icon.ico (+ build/snap_icon.rc) for the exe resource.

  python -I host/make_icon.py [--out build]

Sizes up to SMALL_MAX use a Pikachu head with a camera badge from the game's own Photodex portrait (host/icon_pikachu.py,
decoded at build time, cached in build/icon_src/); without game data they use the original lens tile below.
Source: the game's own icon from the local extracted control data (JPEG, converted with PowerShell System.Drawing),
or, when missing, an original camera-lens icon drawn here (same design as host/icon_fallback.svg).
Env SNAP_ICON_STYLE=r1|r2|r3 (renders of the game's Research Camera model from build/icon_src/camera_r*.png, made by host/render_camera_icon.py; r1 teal lens, r2 red lens cap, r3 front view; also used at 48+ px) or a|b|c|d|d1-d4|e1-e4|f1-f6|g1-g5|h1-h4 picks (h: detailed Research Camera; h1/h2 also supply the 48-256 px sizes, or set SNAP_ICON_LARGE=h1|h2|h3|h4|box to choose them separately; e: head stickers; f: whole-body Pikachu; g: Research Camera) the small-icon design (default a: Pikachu + camera badge; b: peeking over a camera;
c: in viewfinder brackets; d: inside a lens). Env SNAP_ICON_SRC overrides the source path; SNAP_ICON_SRC=none forces the fallback (tests the public-repo path).
Outputs are generated, never committed.
"""
import argparse, math, os, struct, subprocess, sys, zlib
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SIZES = [16, 20, 24, 30, 32, 36, 40, 48, 60, 64, 72, 80, 96, 128, 256]   # in-between sizes are for 125-250% display scaling
SMALL_MAX = 40  # sizes up to this use the simple lens design (title bar, taskbar, small Explorer views)


def png_bytes(w, h, rgba):
    raw = b''.join(b'\0' + bytes(rgba[y * w * 4:(y + 1) * w * 4]) for y in range(h))
    def chunk(t, d):
        c = struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d
        return c + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
    return b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)) + chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw, 9)) + chunk(b'IEND', b'')


def shade(x, y):
    """Design in 256-unit space; returns (r,g,b,a) 0-255 for the point."""
    def inrr(px, py, lo, hi, r):
        qx, qy = abs(px - 128) - (128 - lo - r), abs(py - 128) - (128 - lo - r)
        return math.hypot(max(qx, 0), max(qy, 0)) + min(max(qx, qy), 0) <= r
    if not inrr(x, y, 8, 248, 48):
        return (0, 0, 0, 0)
    # Bold shapes only, so it stays readable at 16-32 px: warm orange tile, cream lens ring, dark lens.
    t = y / 256.0
    col = (int(0xF7 * (1 - t) + 0xE0 * t), int(0x8A * (1 - t) + 0x4A * t), int(0x2E * (1 - t) + 0x1E * t))
    d = math.hypot(x - 128, y - 128)
    if d <= 92: col = (0xFF, 0xF4, 0xE0)
    if d <= 70: col = (0x1E, 0x2A, 0x3A)
    for k in range(6):  # six thick shutter blades, 60 degrees apart, from r=26 to r=70
        a = -math.pi / 2 + k * math.pi / 3
        along = (x - 128) * math.cos(a) + (y - 128) * math.sin(a)
        perp = abs(-(x - 128) * math.sin(a) + (y - 128) * math.cos(a))
        if 26 <= along <= 70 and perp <= 6 and d <= 70: col = (0x3A, 0x4E, 0x68)
    if d <= 26: col = (0x0B, 0x12, 0x1C)
    if math.hypot(x - 104, y - 104) <= 14:
        col = (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
    return col + (255,)


def draw_fallback(n):
    ss = 4 if n <= 64 else 2
    out = bytearray()
    for py in range(n):
        for px in range(n):
            acc = [0, 0, 0, 0]
            for sy in range(ss):
                for sx in range(ss):
                    r, g, b, a = shade((px + (sx + .5) / ss) * 256 / n, (py + (sy + .5) / ss) * 256 / n)
                    acc[0] += r * a; acc[1] += g * a; acc[2] += b * a; acc[3] += a
            cnt = ss * ss
            a = acc[3]
            out += bytes((acc[0] // a, acc[1] // a, acc[2] // a, a // cnt)) if a else b'\0\0\0\0'
    return png_bytes(n, n, out)


def convert_jpeg(src, tmp):
    tmp.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ps = ("Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $src=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($args[0]); foreach($n in %s){"
          "$b=New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $n,$n,([System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format32bppArgb);"
          "$g=[System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($b);$g.InterpolationMode='HighQualityBicubic';$g.PixelOffsetMode='HighQuality';"
          "$g.DrawImage($src,0,0,$n,$n);$g.Dispose();$b.Save((Join-Path $args[1] ('i'+$n+'.png')),[System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png);$b.Dispose()};$src.Dispose()"
          % ','.join(map(str, SIZES)))
    sc = tmp / 'conv.ps1'
    sc.write_text(ps)
    r = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', str(sc), str(src), str(tmp)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(r.stderr[-500:])
    return {n: (tmp / f'i{n}.png').read_bytes() for n in SIZES}


def find_source():
    ov = os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_SRC')
    if ov:
        return None if ov.lower() == 'none' else Path(ov)
    for v in ('v262144', 'v0'):
        p = ROOT / 'extracted' / v / 'control' / 'part0' / 'icon_AmericanEnglish.dat'
        if p.exists():
            return p
    return None


STYLES = ('a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'd1', 'd2', 'd3', 'd4', 'e1', 'e2', 'e3', 'e4', 'f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4', 'f5', 'f6', 'g1', 'g2', 'g3', 'g4', 'g5', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4')
RENDER_STYLES = ('r1p', 'r1', 'r2', 'r3')   # renders of the game's own Research Camera model (host/render_camera_icon.py -> build/icon_src/camera_r*.png)
DEFAULT_STYLE = 'r1p'   # the Research Camera render (best angle, native render per size); falls back to Pikachu when the render is missing
DETAILED = ('h1', 'h2') + RENDER_STYLES   # styles whose detailed master also replaces the box art at 48+ px


def pikachu_small(out, style=None, sizes=None):
    """Small-size icons from host/icon_pikachu.py (needs the extracted game data and numpy/Pillow); {} when unavailable."""
    if os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_SRC', '').lower() == 'none':
        return {}
    small = sizes or [n for n in SIZES if n <= SMALL_MAX]
    style = (style or os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_STYLE', DEFAULT_STYLE)).lower()
    have = (out / 'icon_src' / (f'camera_{style}.png' if style != 'r1p' else 'camera_r1p/render_256.png')).exists()
    if style in RENDER_STYLES and not have:
        if sizes:
            return {}   # large sizes: keep the box art
        style = 'a'     # no local render: the existing Pikachu + camera design
    if style in RENDER_STYLES:
        try:
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-E', '-P', str(Path(__file__).with_name('render_camera_icon.py')), 'size', str(out), style] + list(map(str, small)),
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
            return {} if r.returncode else {n: (out / 'icon_src' / f'small_{style}_{n}.png').read_bytes() for n in small}
        except Exception:
            return {}
    if style not in STYLES:
        style = 'a'
    try:
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-E', '-P', str(Path(__file__).with_name('icon_pikachu.py')), str(out), style] + list(map(str, small)),
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
        if r.returncode:
            return {}
        return {n: (out / 'icon_src' / f'small_{style}_{n}.png').read_bytes() for n in small}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--out', default=str(ROOT / 'build'))
    out = Path(ap.parse_args().out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = find_source()
    pngs = None
    if src and src.exists():
        try:
            pngs = convert_jpeg(src, out / 'icon_tmp')
            print(f'icon: game icon {src.name}')
        except Exception as e:
            print('icon: conversion failed, using fallback:', e)
    if pngs is None:
        pngs = {n: draw_fallback(n) for n in SIZES}
        print('icon: original fallback')
    else:
        # The game's box-art icon is unreadable at title-bar and taskbar sizes; use Pikachu (or the lens) there.
        small = pikachu_small(out)
        for n in SIZES:
            if n <= SMALL_MAX:
                pngs[n] = small.get(n) or draw_fallback(n)
        print('icon: small sizes', 'Pikachu + camera / render' if small else 'original lens')
    # Opt-in large sizes: SNAP_ICON_LARGE=<style>, or the selected style when it is a detailed one (default: the game's box art).
    sel = os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_STYLE', DEFAULT_STYLE).lower()
    large = os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_LARGE', '').lower() or (sel if sel in DETAILED else '')
    if (large in STYLES or large in RENDER_STYLES) and os.environ.get('SNAP_ICON_SRC', '').lower() != 'none':
        big = pikachu_small(out, large, [n for n in SIZES if n > SMALL_MAX])
        for n, data in big.items():
            pngs[n] = data
        print('icon: large sizes', large if big else 'box art (style unavailable)')
    head = struct.pack('<HHH', 0, 1, len(SIZES))
    off = 6 + 16 * len(SIZES)
    ents, data = b'', b''
    for n in SIZES:
        p = pngs[n]
        ents += struct.pack('<BBBBHHII', n % 256, n % 256, 0, 0, 1, 32, len(p), off + len(data))
        data += p
    (out / 'snap_icon.ico').write_bytes(head + ents + data)
    (out / 'snap_icon.rc').write_text('1 ICON "snap_icon.ico"\n')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`host/mods/gamemods.cpp`:

```cpp
// Game-side mods #16 (higher-quality SSAO) and #7 (per-pass toggles) (project code, ours).
//
// Everything here is driven by MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS in recomp/snap_gen.py: the generated code calls the rt_gm_* functions below just before
// the named instruction. Registers x19..x28 are always in the Cpu at that point; caller-saved ones may not be, so each hook reads
// only callee-saved registers. Every hook returns after one static flag check when its feature is off.
//
//   SNAP_SSAO_QUALITY=default|high|ultra   SimpleAO kernel size 32 / 96 / 256 (the pass already generates a 512-entry kernel), HBAO
//                                          8 directions x 32 samples (game default) / 12 x 48 / 16 x 64.
//   SNAP_SSAO_SAMPLES=n                    SimpleAO / Alchemy / Hemisphere sample count (1..512), overrides the preset.
//   SNAP_SSAO_HBAO=dirs,samples            HBAO directions and samples per direction, overrides the preset.
//   SNAP_SSAO_RADIUS=f                     SimpleAO kernel radius (game default 0.2; world-space units of the AO hemisphere).
//   SNAP_SSAO_STRENGTH=f                   SimpleAO strength (game default 1.0).
//   SNAP_LIGHTING=high                     preset: SNAP_SSAO_QUALITY=high plus SNAP_SHADOW_RES=2048 (the latter read by runtime/nvn
//                                          ApplyHostEnvPolicy); every explicit switch above still wins.
//   SNAP_UI_FONT_SCALE=auto|1|2..4         UI glyphs are rasterized at k times the size into a k times larger atlas (#29, sharper fonts); the
//                                          layout fields of every glyph entry keep the 1x values, so text size and position do not change.
//                                          Unset or auto: k = 2 when the game window's client height is 1440 or more, else 1 (off). 1 = off.
//   SNAP_GM_TRACE=1                        logs the values the game had before the override (first 8 hits of each hook).
//   SNAP_PASS_DUMP=1                       logs each distinct render pass object once (vtable, flags, strings) for pass identification.
//   SNAP_PASS_OFF=name,name,...            switches render passes off by name (case-insensitive, names as SNAP_PASS_DUMP prints them; the pass
//                                          object keeps its enable byte at +0xf0 at zero, so the game never records it). Bloom: BloomCreate,BloomDraw;
//                                          DOF: DOFBlurX,DOFBlurY,DOF; FilmGrain; ChromaticAberration; also SSAOCreate/BlurX/BlurY/Composite.
//                                          Photo and evaluation passes are refused (see pass_class below); names not verified safe are refused too
//                                          unless SNAP_PASS_FORCE=1 (test aid, never for the photo passes). A pass is NOT skipped when the game
//                                          itself wants it off: only the byte is forced to 0, the game's own writes are not touched.
//   SNAP_PASS_AB=<P>                       test aid: the passes named in SNAP_PASS_OFF are off only in even blocks of P presents (same-view A/B).
//
// Addresses (module offsets, build id DDB900FF...): analysis/mods/ and docs/mod-ideas.md rows 7 and 16.
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"
#include "hle/visual_defaults.h"   // default font scale (SNAP_PROFILE)

using namespace loader;

namespace {

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;

bool g_init_done;
int g_simple_n;                 // 0 = leave the game's value
int g_hbao_dirs, g_hbao_samples;  // 0 = leave
bool g_trace, g_pass_dump;
int g_font_k;                   // 0 = off
bool g_font_decided;
float g_ao_radius, g_ao_strength;  // 0 = leave the game's value
std::vector<std::string> g_pass_off;
int g_pass_ab;
bool g_pass_force;

void init() {
    if (g_init_done) return;
    g_init_done = true;
    const char* q = getenv("SNAP_SSAO_QUALITY");
    if (q) {
        if (!strcmp(q, "high")) { g_simple_n = 96; g_hbao_dirs = 12; g_hbao_samples = 48; }
        else if (!strcmp(q, "ultra")) { g_simple_n = 256; g_hbao_dirs = 16; g_hbao_samples = 64; }
    }
    if (const char* s = getenv("SNAP_SSAO_SAMPLES")) { int n = atoi(s); if (n >= 1 && n <= 512) g_simple_n = n; }
    if (const char* h = getenv("SNAP_SSAO_HBAO")) {
        int d = 0, s = 0;
        if (sscanf(h, "%d,%d", &d, &s) == 2 && d >= 1 && d <= 64 && s >= 1 && s <= 128) { g_hbao_dirs = d; g_hbao_samples = s; }
    }
    if (const char* r = getenv("SNAP_SSAO_RADIUS")) { float v = (float)atof(r); if (v > 0.0f && v <= 4.0f) g_ao_radius = v; }
    if (const char* r = getenv("SNAP_SSAO_STRENGTH")) { float v = (float)atof(r); if (v > 0.0f && v <= 8.0f) g_ao_strength = v; }
    g_trace = getenv("SNAP_GM_TRACE") && getenv("SNAP_GM_TRACE")[0] != '0';
    g_pass_dump = getenv("SNAP_PASS_DUMP") && getenv("SNAP_PASS_DUMP")[0] != '0';
    g_pass_ab = getenv("SNAP_PASS_AB") ? atoi(getenv("SNAP_PASS_AB")) : 0;
    g_pass_force = getenv("SNAP_PASS_FORCE") && getenv("SNAP_PASS_FORCE")[0] == '1';
    if (const char* o = getenv("SNAP_PASS_OFF")) {
        std::string s = o, cur;
        for (char ch : s + ",") {
            if (ch == ',') { if (!cur.empty()) g_pass_off.push_back(cur); cur.clear(); }
            else cur.push_back((char)tolower((unsigned char)ch));
        }
    }
    if (g_simple_n || g_hbao_dirs || g_ao_radius > 0.0f || g_ao_strength > 0.0f || g_trace || g_pass_dump || !g_pass_off.empty())
        fprintf(stderr, "gamemods: SimpleAO samples %d, HBAO %dx%d, trace %d, pass dump %d, %zu pass(es) off\n", g_simple_n, g_hbao_dirs,
                g_hbao_samples, (int)g_trace, (int)g_pass_dump, g_pass_off.size());
}

bool readable(const void* p, size_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    if (!VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) return false;
    if (mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT || (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD))) return false;
    return (uintptr_t)p + n <= (uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
}

}  // namespace

// Inside the SimpleAO / Hemisphere / Alchemy pass execute (main+0x5a5970), after `mov x21, x9` at main+0x5a6c90: x21 = the pass object.
// +0x17c is kernelSize (u32), +0x180 kernelRadius, +0x184 strength; the cbuffer is built from them just after. Hooked before 0x5a6c94.
extern "C" void rt_gm_ao_simple(Cpu* c) {
    init();
    uint8_t* self = (uint8_t*)c->x[21];
    if (!self || !readable(self + 0x174, 0x14)) return;
    static int hits;
    if (g_trace && hits < 8) {
        hits++;
        float r, s;
        memcpy(&r, self + 0x180, 4);
        memcpy(&s, self + 0x184, 4);
        trace("gamemods: SimpleAO pass %p kernelSize %u radius %g strength %g (hemisphere flag %u)", (void*)self, *(uint32_t*)(self + 0x17c), r, s,
              (unsigned)self[0x188]);
    }
    if (g_simple_n) *(uint32_t*)(self + 0x17c) = (uint32_t)g_simple_n;
}

// Inside the HBAO pass execute (main+0x5a7880), before `ldr w8, [x21, #0x174]` at main+0x5a7bac: x21 = the pass object, +0x174 numDirections,
// +0x178 numSamples (ints, copied from the preset tables at main+0xb15c40 / 0xb15ca0 earlier in the same function).
extern "C" void rt_gm_ao_hbao(Cpu* c) {
    init();
    uint8_t* self = (uint8_t*)c->x[21];
    if (!self || !readable(self + 0x174, 8)) return;
    static int hits;
    if (g_trace && hits < 8) {
        hits++;
        trace("gamemods: HBAO pass %p numDirections %d numSamples %d", (void*)self, *(int*)(self + 0x174), *(int*)(self + 0x178));
    }
    if (g_hbao_dirs) {
        *(int*)(self + 0x174) = g_hbao_dirs;
        *(int*)(self + 0x178) = g_hbao_samples;
    }
}

namespace {
extern "C" uint64_t snap_present_count();   // host/boot.cpp
struct PassState { uint8_t* pass; int orig_on; int refused; int zeroed; int seen; int game_on; uint64_t uuid[2]; };   // uuid = pass+0x30: unique per pass object, so a freed and reused address starts fresh
std::vector<PassState> g_pass_state;

// Pass objects (class at vtable main+0xcc4058, 0xf8 bytes) hold their name as a libc++ std::string at +0x40 (short form: byte0 = len << 1, text at +1;
// long form: size at +8, pointer at +16).
std::string pass_name(const uint8_t* pass) {
    const uint8_t* s = pass + 0x40;
    const char* p;
    size_t n;
    if ((s[0] & 1) == 0) { n = s[0] >> 1; p = (const char*)s + 1; }
    else {
        n = *(const uint64_t*)(s + 8);
        p = *(const char* const*)(s + 16);
        if (n > 64 || !p || !readable(p, n)) return "";
    }
    if (n > 40) return "";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (p[i] < 0x20 || p[i] > 0x7e) return "";
    return std::string(p, n);
}
// 0 = never (photo, evaluation, capture, UI path), 1 = verified safe, 2 = unverified. Input is the lower-case name.
int pass_class(const std::string& n) {
    static const char* never[] = {"eval", "photo", "capture", "thumb", "report", "resize", "final", "ui", "fade", "downsizetarget", "compositeblendbuffer"};
    for (auto k : never) if (n.find(k) != std::string::npos) return 0;
    static const char* safe[] = {"bloomcreate", "bloomdraw", "dofblurx", "dofblury", "dof", "filmgrain", "chromaticaberration"};
    for (auto k : safe) if (n == k) return 1;
    return 2;
}
const char* pass_class_text(const std::string& name) {
    std::string low;
    for (char ch : name) low.push_back((char)tolower((unsigned char)ch));
    int c = pass_class(low);
    return c == 0 ? "protected" : c == 1 ? "toggle" : "unverified";
}
}  // namespace

// Pass loop (main+0x988fe0, entries of 32 bytes at [ctx+0x1b8, ctx+0x1c0)): at main+0x989048 x20 = the entry, [x20+8] = the pass object, whose
// byte at +0xf0 is the enable flag the loop copies to +0xf1 and tests. Names: pass_name (libc++ string at +0x40).
extern "C" void rt_gm_pass(Cpu* c) {
    init();
    if (!g_pass_dump && g_pass_off.empty()) return;
    uint8_t* ent = (uint8_t*)c->x[20];
    if (!ent || !readable(ent, 16)) return;
    uint8_t* pass = *(uint8_t**)(ent + 8);
    if (!pass || !readable(pass, 0x100)) return;
    std::string name = pass_name(pass);
    if (g_pass_dump) {
        static std::vector<uint8_t*> seen;
        bool known = false;
        for (auto p : seen) if (p == pass) known = true;
        if (!known && seen.size() < 256) {
            seen.push_back(pass);
            uint64_t vt = *(uint64_t*)pass;
            trace("gamemods: pass %p name \"%s\" order[+0x5c]=%u on[+0xf0]=%u vtable main+%#llx class %s", (void*)pass, name.c_str(), *(uint32_t*)(pass + 0x5c),
                  pass[0xf0], (unsigned long long)(vt - kMainBase), pass_class_text(name));
        }
    }
    if (g_pass_off.empty() || name.empty()) return;
    std::string low;
    for (char ch : name) low.push_back((char)tolower((unsigned char)ch));
    bool listed = false;
    for (auto& n : g_pass_off) if (n == low) listed = true;
    if (!listed) return;
    int cls = pass_class(low);
    PassState* st = nullptr;
    uint64_t uu[2];
    memcpy(uu, pass + 0x30, 16);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pass_state.size(); i++) {
        PassState& s = g_pass_state[i];
        if (s.pass != pass) continue;
        if (s.uuid[0] == uu[0] && s.uuid[1] == uu[1]) st = &s;
        else { g_pass_state.erase(g_pass_state.begin() + i); i--; }   // the address was freed and reused by another pass object
    }
    if (!st) {
        if (g_pass_state.size() >= 128) return;
        g_pass_state.push_back({pass, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, {uu[0], uu[1]}});
        st = &g_pass_state.back();
        if (cls == 0) { trace("gamemods: pass \"%s\" is a photo/evaluation pass: SNAP_PASS_OFF refused", name.c_str()); st->refused = 1; }
        else if (cls == 2 && !g_pass_force) { trace("gamemods: pass \"%s\" is not verified safe to switch off: refused (SNAP_PASS_FORCE=1 overrides)", name.c_str()); st->refused = 1; }
        else trace("gamemods: pass \"%s\" switched off%s", name.c_str(), g_pass_ab ? " (A/B)" : "");
    }
    if (st->refused) return;
    bool off = !g_pass_ab || ((snap_present_count() / (uint64_t)g_pass_ab) & 1) == 0;
    // The game may rewrite the byte (a scene turns the pass on or off): remember its last value unless we wrote the zero ourselves.
    if (!st->zeroed || pass[0xf0]) st->orig_on = pass[0xf0];
    st->seen++;
    if (pass[0xf0]) st->game_on++;
    if (g_trace && (st->seen == 1 || st->seen % 1800 == 0)) trace("gamemods: pass \"%s\" seen %d times, game had it on %d times", name.c_str(), st->seen, st->game_on);
    if (off) { pass[0xf0] = 0; st->zeroed = 1; }
    else { if (st->zeroed) pass[0xf0] = (uint8_t)st->orig_on; st->zeroed = 0; }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ sharper UI fonts (#29)
// The glyph cache (main+0x435560) asks nn::fontll for a glyph bitmap (PLT 0xa37dc0 after SetScale 0xa37d90), packs it into an R8 atlas
// (dims at cache+0x2188/+0x218c, created in 0x63fdc0) and fills the glyph entry: +0x1a/+0x1c bitmap size in the atlas and the UV source, +0x1e/+0x20
// layout size, +0x22 advance, +0x24.. bearings (the quad builder 0x438960 uses +0x1a/+0x1c for UV and the rest for the screen quad).
// With SNAP_UI_FONT_SCALE=k: the atlas texture is k times larger in both axes; right after each GetGlyph the hook renders the same glyph again at
// k times the scale and hands the cache a composite (the k-times bitmap and size, but the 1x bearings and advance of the first call); a third hook
// writes the 1x bitmap size back into the entry's layout size, so text layout is exactly the original and only the UV rect covers more texels.
const uint64_t kMagic = 0x32544e4650414e53ull;   // "SNAPFNT2"
thread_local uint32_t t_font_scale;               // 16.16 scale of the current glyph request (w24 at the SetScale call)
thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> t_font_ring[8];
thread_local int t_font_ring_i;

void font_composite(Cpu* c, bool first) {
    uint8_t* r1 = (uint8_t*)c->x[0];
    if (!r1 || !readable(r1, 0x30)) return;
    uint16_t w1 = *(uint16_t*)(r1 + 0x1c), h1 = *(uint16_t*)(r1 + 0x1e);
    if (!w1 || !h1 || !readable(r1, 0x28 + (size_t)w1 * h1)) return;
    uint8_t hdr1[0x28];
    memcpy(hdr1, r1, 0x28);
    uint64_t engine = *(uint64_t*)(c->x[29] - 0x68);
    uint32_t cp = *(uint32_t*)(c->sp + 0x3c);
    if (first) t_font_scale = (uint32_t)c->x[24];
    uint32_t s = t_font_scale;
    if (!engine || !s || (uint64_t)s * g_font_k > 0x7fffffffull) return;
    uint64_t saved[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) saved[i] = c->x[i];
    uint32_t sk = s * (uint32_t)g_font_k;
    call_guest_nested(c, kMainBase + 0xa37d90, {engine, sk, 0, 0, sk});
    uint8_t* r2 = (uint8_t*)call_guest_nested(c, kMainBase + 0xa37dc0, {engine, cp, 8});
    call_guest_nested(c, kMainBase + 0xa37d90, {engine, s, 0, 0, s});
    for (int i = 1; i < 8; i++) c->x[i] = saved[i];
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)r1;
    if (!r2 || !readable(r2, 0x30)) return;
    uint16_t w2 = *(uint16_t*)(r2 + 0x1c), h2 = *(uint16_t*)(r2 + 0x1e);
    if (w2 < w1 || h2 < h1 || !readable(r2, 0x28 + (size_t)w2 * h2)) return;
    std::vector<uint8_t>& b = t_font_ring[t_font_ring_i++ & 7];
    b.assign(16 + 0x28 + (size_t)w2 * h2, 0);
    memcpy(b.data(), &kMagic, 8);
    memcpy(b.data() + 8, &w1, 2);
    memcpy(b.data() + 10, &h1, 2);
    memcpy(b.data() + 16, r2, 0x28 + (size_t)w2 * h2);
    memcpy(b.data() + 16 + 0xc, hdr1 + 0xc, 6);   // bearing x, bearing y, advance: the 1x values
    c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(b.data() + 16);
    static int n, n2, total[2];
    total[first ? 0 : 1]++;
    if (g_trace && first && n < 6) { n++; trace("gamemods: font glyph %#x 1x %ux%u -> %ux%u (scale %#x)", cp, w1, h1, w2, h2, s); }
    if (g_trace && !first && n2 < 6) { n2++; trace("gamemods: font glyph2 %#x 1x %ux%u -> %ux%u (scale %#x)", cp, w1, h1, w2, h2, s); }
    if (g_trace && (total[0] + total[1]) % 500 == 0) trace("gamemods: font glyph calls %d first-site, %d second-site", total[0], total[1]);
}

// Client height of this process's largest visible top-level window (the real output: borderless fullscreen gives the monitor height); 0 if none.
BOOL CALLBACK font_enum_win(HWND h, LPARAM lp) {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, &pid);
    if (pid != GetCurrentProcessId() || !IsWindowVisible(h)) return TRUE;
    RECT r;
    if (GetClientRect(h, &r) && r.bottom > *(int*)lp) *(int*)lp = r.bottom;
    return TRUE;
}

// Decides g_font_k once, at the first atlas creation (the window exists by then). SNAP_UI_FONT_SCALE: 1 or off = off, 2..4 = that scale,
// auto / default = 2 when the output is 1440 lines or taller. Unset = the shared defaults table (hle/visual_defaults.h: off in the
// original profile, auto in the enhanced one); the F1 menu stores "default" as unset.
void decide_font_scale() {
    g_font_decided = true;
    const char* f = snapdef::get("SNAP_UI_FONT_SCALE");
    if (f && *f && strcmp(f, "auto") && strcmp(f, "default")) {
        int k = !strcmp(f, "off") ? 1 : atoi(f);
        if (k >= 2 && k <= 4) g_font_k = k;
        fprintf(stderr, "gamemods: UI font scale %d (SNAP_UI_FONT_SCALE=%s)\n", g_font_k ? g_font_k : 1, f);
        return;
    }
    int h = 0;
    EnumWindows(font_enum_win, (LPARAM)&h);
    if (h <= 0) { if (const char* e = getenv("SNAP_WINDOW_H")) h = atoi(e); }
    if (h >= 1440) g_font_k = 2;
    fprintf(stderr, "gamemods: UI font scale %d (auto, output height %d)\n", g_font_k ? g_font_k : 1, h);
}

// ----- the five hook sites (recomp/snap_gen.py MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS)
// Before main+0x6410bc (the call that creates the atlas texture, texture info at sp+0xe0, width/height as two u32 at +0x18): enlarge it.
extern "C" void rt_gm_font_atlas_info(Cpu* c) {
    init();
    if (!g_font_decided) decide_font_scale();
    if (!g_font_k) return;
    uint32_t* wh = (uint32_t*)(c->sp + 0xf8);
    if (wh[0] == 512 && wh[1] == 2048) { wh[0] *= g_font_k; wh[1] *= g_font_k; }
}
// Before main+0x641288 (just after `str x20, [x25, #0x2188]`): the cache's own atlas size, used for the pitch and the UV divide.
extern "C" void rt_gm_font_atlas_dims(Cpu* c) {
    if (!g_font_k) return;
    uint32_t* wh = (uint32_t*)(c->x[25] + 0x2188);
    if (wh[0] == 512 && wh[1] == 2048) { wh[0] *= g_font_k; wh[1] *= g_font_k; }
}
// Before main+0x4358c0 and main+0x435eb0 (just after the GetGlyph calls): x0 = the glyph result.
extern "C" void rt_gm_font_glyph1(Cpu* c) { if (g_font_k) font_composite(c, true); }
extern "C" void rt_gm_font_glyph2(Cpu* c) { if (g_font_k) font_composite(c, false); }
// Before main+0x435cf0 (copies the bitmap size to the entry's +0x1a/+0x1c): x1 = the glyph result, x21 = the entry.
extern "C" void rt_gm_font_fix(Cpu* c) {
    if (!g_font_k) return;
    uint8_t* r = (uint8_t*)c->x[1];
    uint8_t* e = (uint8_t*)c->x[21];
    if (!r || !e || !readable(r - 16, 16) || memcmp(r - 16, &kMagic, 8)) return;
    memcpy(e + 0x1e, r - 8, 2);
    memcpy(e + 0x20, r - 6, 2);
}

```

`host/mods/lodanim.cpp`:

```cpp
// Draw-distance mods #26 (full-rate distant animation) and #27 (LOD bias, draw distance): dynamic tracer and knobs (project code, ours).
//
// Tracer (env SNAP_TRACE_LOD=1): the lifted code calls fnprof_hit on every function entry when g_fnprof is set (runtime/cpu.h FN_ENTER),
// and host/loader.cpp forwards it to snap_fn_observe below. Three tools, all off unless asked:
//   * parity profile: counts every main function's entries on even and odd rendered frames. A function that runs every frame for
//     near objects but every other frame for far ones shows an even/odd imbalance (the 30 Hz distant-animation signature).
//     SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMEFN (default main+0x988fe0, the per-frame pass loop), SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FROM (first frame, default 300),
//     SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMES (window, default 600), SNAP_TRACE_LOD_OUT (default analysis/mods/fn_parity.tsv).
//   * watch list: SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FN=0xaddr[,..] (module offset or absolute) logs the first hits of each function with x0-x7, the low
//     float of v0-v3 and (SNAP_TRACE_LOD_MEM=bytes) a float/hex dump of the memory x0 points at.
//   * SNAP_TRACE_LOD_CALLERS=0xaddr[,..] counts the callers (lr) of those functions over the window.
#include <windows.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"

using namespace loader;

extern "C" volatile int g_fnprof;

namespace {

struct Watch { uint64_t addr; int hits; };

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;
const uint64_t kMainSpan = 0xa40000ull;   // lifted .text is 0xa38e40 bytes
bool g_on;
uint64_t g_frame_fn, g_frame;
uint64_t g_from = 300, g_win = 600;
bool g_dumped;
std::vector<uint32_t> g_even, g_odd;
Watch g_watch[16];
int g_nwatch;
Watch g_callers[8];
int g_ncallers;
struct CallerKey { uint64_t fn, lr; uint32_t n; };
std::vector<CallerKey> g_caller_counts;
int g_memdump;
Watch g_seq[12];
int g_nseq;
uint8_t g_seq_cnt[12][160];
void fov_mark(bool end);
std::string g_out = "analysis/mods/fn_parity.tsv";
double g_t_from, g_t_to;

double now_s() {
    LARGE_INTEGER f, n;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&n);
    return (double)n.QuadPart / (double)f.QuadPart;
}

uint64_t norm(uint64_t a) { return a < 0x1000000000ull ? kMainBase + a : a; }

void parse_list(const char *e, Watch *w, int *n, int max) {
    while (e && *e && *n < max) {
        char *end;
        w[(*n)++] = Watch{norm(strtoull(e, &end, 0)), 0};
        e = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : nullptr;
    }
}

bool readable(const void *p, size_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    if (!VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) return false;
    if (mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT || (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD))) return false;
    return (uintptr_t)p + n <= (uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
}

void dump_parity() {
    FILE *f = fopen(g_out.c_str(), "wb");
    if (!f) { trace("lodanim: cannot write %s", g_out.c_str()); return; }
    double secs = g_t_to - g_t_from;
    fprintf(f, "# frames %llu..%llu, %.2f s (%.1f frames/s); columns: module offset, even-frame entries, odd-frame entries, entries per frame\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_from, (unsigned long long)(g_from + g_win), secs, secs > 0 ? g_win / secs : 0.0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_even.size(); i++) {
        uint32_t e = g_even[i], o = g_odd[i];
        if (e + o < 20) continue;
        fprintf(f, "%#llx\t%u\t%u\t%.2f\n", (unsigned long long)(i * 4), e, o, (double)(e + o) / (double)g_win);
    }
    fclose(f);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nseq; i++) {
        char line[900];
        int n = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 160 && n < 850; k++) n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, "%d,", (int)g_seq_cnt[i][k]);
        trace("lodanim: seq %#llx per frame from %llu: %s", (unsigned long long)(g_seq[i].addr - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)g_from, line);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ncallers; i++)
        for (auto &c : g_caller_counts)
            if (c.fn == g_callers[i].addr) trace("lodanim: caller of %#llx: %#llx x%u", (unsigned long long)(c.fn - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)(c.lr - kMainBase), c.n);
    trace("lodanim: parity profile written to %s (%.1f frames/s over the window)", g_out.c_str(), secs > 0 ? g_win / secs : 0.0);
}

void log_watch(Watch &w, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    Cpu *c = g_tls_cpu;
    if (!c) { trace("lodanim: fn %#llx hit (frame %llu) lr=%#llx x0=%#llx (no cpu)", (unsigned long long)(w.addr - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)g_frame, (unsigned long long)(lr - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)x0); return; }
    float s[4];
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { uint32_t b = (uint32_t)c->v[k]; memcpy(&s[k], &b, 4); }
    trace("lodanim: fn %#llx frame %llu lr=%#llx x0-3=%#llx %#llx %#llx %#llx x4-7=%#llx %#llx %#llx %#llx s0-3=%g %g %g %g",
          (unsigned long long)(w.addr - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)g_frame, (unsigned long long)(lr - kMainBase),
          (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[3],
          (unsigned long long)c->x[4], (unsigned long long)c->x[5], (unsigned long long)c->x[6], (unsigned long long)c->x[7],
          s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]);
    if (g_memdump && x0 > 0x10000 && readable((void *)x0, (size_t)g_memdump)) {
        char line[1024];
        int n = 0;
        const uint32_t *p = (const uint32_t *)x0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_memdump / 4 && n < 1000; i++) {
            float fv;
            memcpy(&fv, &p[i], 4);
            n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, "%s+%x:%08x(%g)", i % 8 ? " " : "\n   ", i * 4, p[i], fv);
        }
        trace("lodanim:   [x0]%s", line);
    }
}

struct Init {
    Init() {
        const char *e = getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD");
        if (!e || e[0] == '0') return;
        g_on = true;
        g_frame_fn = norm(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMEFN") ? strtoull(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMEFN"), nullptr, 0) : 0x988fe0);
        if (getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FROM")) g_from = strtoull(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FROM"), nullptr, 0);
        if (getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMES")) g_win = strtoull(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FRAMES"), nullptr, 0);
        if (getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_OUT")) g_out = getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_OUT");
        if (getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_MEM")) g_memdump = atoi(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_MEM"));
        parse_list(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_FN"), g_watch, &g_nwatch, 16);
        parse_list(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_SEQ"), g_seq, &g_nseq, 12);
        parse_list(getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LOD_CALLERS"), g_callers, &g_ncallers, 8);
        g_even.assign(kMainSpan / 4, 0);
        g_odd.assign(kMainSpan / 4, 0);
        g_caller_counts.reserve(4000);
        g_fnprof = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "lodanim: SNAP_TRACE_LOD on, frame marker main+%#llx, window frames %llu..%llu, %d watched, %d callers\n",
                (unsigned long long)(g_frame_fn - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)g_from, (unsigned long long)(g_from + g_win), g_nwatch, g_ncallers);
    }
} g_init;

}  // namespace

extern "C" void snap_fn_observe(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    if (!g_on) return;
    if (a == g_frame_fn) {
        g_frame++;
        if (g_frame == g_from) { g_t_from = now_s(); fov_mark(false); }
        if (g_frame == g_from + g_win && !g_dumped) { g_dumped = true; g_t_to = now_s(); fov_mark(true); dump_parity(); }
    }
    uint64_t off = a - kMainBase;
    bool in_win = g_frame >= g_from && g_frame < g_from + g_win;
    if (in_win && off < kMainSpan) {
        if (g_frame & 1) g_odd[off >> 2]++; else g_even[off >> 2]++;
    }
    if (g_nseq && g_frame >= g_from && g_frame < g_from + 160)
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nseq; i++)
            if (g_seq[i].addr == a && g_seq_cnt[i][g_frame - g_from] < 255) g_seq_cnt[i][g_frame - g_from]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nwatch; i++)
        if (g_watch[i].addr == a && g_frame >= g_from && g_watch[i].hits < 400) { g_watch[i].hits++; log_watch(g_watch[i], lr, x0); }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ncallers; i++)
        if (g_callers[i].addr == a && in_win) {
            bool found = false;
            for (auto &c : g_caller_counts)
                if (c.fn == a && c.lr == lr) { c.n++; found = true; break; }
            if (!found && g_caller_counts.size() < 4000) g_caller_counts.push_back({a, lr, 1});
        }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- field of view (SNAP_FOV)
// The perspective builders in main compute 1/tanf(fov/2) through the libc import tanf (PLT main+0xa36be0, 42 call sites, 24 of
// them camera code). The host override below sees the caller (lr). SNAP_FOV scales the vertical field-of-view angle for the call
// sites in g_fov_sites only (filled from the trace); every other tanf call is exact. SNAP_TRACE_FOV=1 logs the distinct callers.
namespace {

double g_fov_scale = 1.0;      // multiplier of the angle
double g_fov_target_deg = 0;   // >0: absolute vertical FOV in degrees
bool g_fov_trace;
struct FovSite { uint64_t lr; uint64_t n; float last; };
FovSite g_fov_sites_seen[96];
int g_fov_nseen;
std::vector<uint64_t> g_fov_allow;   // module offsets of return addresses that get the FOV scale
uint64_t g_fov_ab;                   // SNAP_FOV_AB=<P> (test aid): the FOV change applies only while (present count / P) is odd
extern "C" uint64_t snap_present_count();   // host/boot.cpp

uint64_t g_fov_snap[96];

void h_tanf(Cpu *c);
}  // namespace
namespace {
void fov_mark_impl(bool end) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_fov_nseen; i++) {
        if (!end) g_fov_snap[i] = g_fov_sites_seen[i].n;
        else if (g_fov_sites_seen[i].n > g_fov_snap[i])
            trace("fov: window caller main+%#llx hits=%llu last fov %.1f deg", (unsigned long long)(g_fov_sites_seen[i].lr - kMainBase),
                  (unsigned long long)(g_fov_sites_seen[i].n - g_fov_snap[i]), g_fov_sites_seen[i].last * 114.5916);
    }
}
}  // namespace
namespace {
void h_tanf(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t b = (uint32_t)c->v[0];
    float x;
    memcpy(&x, &b, 4);
    uint64_t lr = c->x[30];
    float xr = x;
    if ((g_fov_scale != 1.0 || g_fov_target_deg > 0) && (!g_fov_ab || ((snap_present_count() / g_fov_ab) & 1))) {
        uint64_t off = lr - kMainBase;
        bool ok = false;
        for (uint64_t a : g_fov_allow) if (a == off) { ok = true; break; }
        if (ok && x > 0.02f && x < 1.55f) {   // half-angle in radians
            xr = g_fov_target_deg > 0 ? (float)(g_fov_target_deg * 3.14159265358979 / 360.0) : (float)(x * g_fov_scale);
            if (xr > 1.5f) xr = 1.5f;
            static int applied;
            if (++applied == 1 || applied == 1000) trace("fov: SNAP_FOV applied at main+%#llx: half-angle %.2f -> %.2f deg (%d)", (unsigned long long)off, x * 57.29578, xr * 57.29578, applied);
        }
    }
    if (g_fov_trace) {
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < g_fov_nseen; i++) if (g_fov_sites_seen[i].lr == lr) break;
        if (i == g_fov_nseen && i < 96) { g_fov_sites_seen[i] = {lr, 0, x}; g_fov_nseen++; }
        if (i < 96) {
            FovSite &s = g_fov_sites_seen[i];
            s.n++;
            s.last = x;
            if (s.n == 1 || s.n == 60 || s.n == 600 || s.n == 3000 || s.n == 12000)
                trace("fov: tanf caller main+%#llx x=%g rad (half-angle %.2f deg) hits=%llu", (unsigned long long)(lr - kMainBase), x, x * 57.29578, (unsigned long long)s.n);
        }
    }
    float r = tanf(xr);
    uint32_t rb;
    memcpy(&rb, &r, 4);
    c->v[0] = (__uint128_t)rb;
}

}  // namespace

namespace { void fov_mark(bool end) { fov_mark_impl(end); } }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- model LOD (#27) and distant animation rate (#26)
// Found by static RE (2026-11-12). The character/model instance class (vtable main+0xc7c5e8, ctor 0x32dc90) picks its LOD in its update
// (vtable slot 2, main+0x334db0) at 0x337c2c..0x337d38 (and a copy at 0x337a3c..0x337b4c for attached sub-models):
//   d = |instance pos - camera pos| (camera globals main+0xcfb480, fov main+0xcfb4c8, aspect +0x4cc);  s = 2 d tan(fov/2)
//   ratio = pi (radius * scale[+0x3ef0])^2 / (s^2 * aspect)      (the share of the screen the bounding sphere covers)
//   table t[3] per LOD group ([mgr+0x270] + group*0xc, group = [model data+0x54], group 0 = always LOD0):
//   ratio >= t0 -> LOD0, >= t1 -> LOD1, >= t2 -> LOD2, else 3 = not drawn (visible byte [+0x104] cleared) unless flag +0x12a keeps LOD2.
// The result goes to instance+0x4174 (current LOD) and +0x417c (ratio). Because ratio ~ 1/d^2, multiplying it by m^2 moves every switch
// distance and the cull distance out by m. SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE=<m> does that in rt_gm_lod_ratio, hooked (MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS) right after the
// fdiv that produces the ratio: main+0x337ca8 (main path) and main+0x337ab8 (sub-model path); s0 holds the ratio there.
//
// Distant animation: the pre-draw method (vtable slot 3, main+0x338170) rebuilds the instance's render job [+0x158] (main+0x971170, queued
// by main+0x98d3b0 in slot 4 main+0x33aac0 and cleared after) only every 2*LOD frames while the LOD is unchanged: counter [+0x4170],
// last LOD [+0x4178]; LOD0 every frame, LOD1 every 2nd, LOD2 every 4th (main+0x33a744..0x33a770, x20 = instance+0x4000). The skipped
// frames reuse the previous job, so far models update at 30 or 15 Hz. SNAP_FULL_RATE_ANIM=1 sets the counter to a large value before
// the compare (rt_gm_anim_rate, hook main+0x33a744), so the job is rebuilt every frame like LOD0. SNAP_TRACE_LODSEL=1 logs LOD histograms.
namespace {
float g_dd_ratio_mul = 1.0f;   // legacy SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE squared (moves LOD switches and the cull together)
float g_lod_mul2 = 1.0f;       // SNAP_LOD_DIST squared: LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 switch distances
float g_cull_mul2 = 1.0f;      // SNAP_DRAW_DIST squared: the distance where a model stops being drawn
bool g_lod_force0, g_lod_split;   // SNAP_LOD_FORCE0; any of the new switches set
bool g_full_rate, g_lodsel_trace, g_lodmods_init;
uint64_t g_dd_ab;              // SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE_AB=<P> (test aid): the multiplier applies only while (present count / P) is odd
uint64_t g_lod_hist[2][4], g_lod_calls, g_anim_seen, g_anim_forced;

void lodmods_init() {
    if (g_lodmods_init) return;
    g_lodmods_init = true;
    if (const char *e = getenv("SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE")) {
        double m = atof(e);
        if (m > 0.01 && m <= 1000.0 && m != 1.0) g_dd_ratio_mul = (float)(m * m);
    }
    auto mul2 = [](const char *name, float *out) {
        if (const char *e = getenv(name)) {
            double m = atof(e);
            if (m < 1.0) m = 1.0;
            if (m > 8.0) m = 8.0;
            *out = (float)(m * m);
        }
    };
    mul2("SNAP_LOD_DIST", &g_lod_mul2);
    mul2("SNAP_DRAW_DIST", &g_cull_mul2);
    { const char *f0 = getenv("SNAP_LOD_FORCE0"); g_lod_force0 = f0 && f0[0] && f0[0] != '0'; }
    g_lod_split = g_lod_mul2 != 1.0f || g_cull_mul2 != 1.0f || g_lod_force0;
    if (const char *e = getenv("SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE_AB")) g_dd_ab = strtoull(e, nullptr, 0);
    const char *f = getenv("SNAP_FULL_RATE_ANIM");
    g_full_rate = f && f[0] && f[0] != '0';
    const char *t = getenv("SNAP_TRACE_LODSEL");
    g_lodsel_trace = t && t[0] && t[0] != '0';
    if (g_dd_ratio_mul != 1.0f || g_lod_split || g_full_rate || g_lodsel_trace)
        trace("lodanim: SNAP_DRAW_DISTANCE ratio x%g, SNAP_LOD_DIST ratio x%g, SNAP_DRAW_DIST ratio x%g, SNAP_LOD_FORCE0 %d (A/B period %llu presents), SNAP_FULL_RATE_ANIM %d, SNAP_TRACE_LODSEL %d",
              g_dd_ratio_mul, g_lod_mul2, g_cull_mul2, (int)g_lod_force0, (unsigned long long)g_dd_ab, (int)g_full_rate, (int)g_lodsel_trace);
}

extern "C" uint64_t snap_present_count();   // host/boot.cpp
bool mod_active() { return !(g_dd_ab && ((snap_present_count() / g_dd_ab) & 1) == 0); }   // false on the "original" blocks of the A/B aid
float ratio_mul() { return mod_active() ? g_dd_ratio_mul : 1.0f; }

float get_s0(Cpu *c) { uint32_t b = (uint32_t)c->v[0]; float f; memcpy(&f, &b, 4); return f; }
void set_s0(Cpu *c, float f) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &f, 4); c->v[0] = (__uint128_t)b; }

void lod_trace(Cpu *c, float ratio, int path) {
    // threshold table pointer at [sp+0x28]; group index in w22 (main path) or w25 (sub-model path)
    uint64_t sp = c->sp;
    int grp = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)c->x[path ? 25 : 22];
    int lod = 0;
    if (grp != 0 && readable((void *)(sp + 0x28), 8)) {
        const float *t = *(const float **)(sp + 0x28);
        if (t && grp > 0 && grp < 4096 && readable(t + grp * 3, 12)) {
            t += grp * 3;
            lod = ratio >= t[0] ? 0 : ratio >= t[1] ? 1 : ratio >= t[2] ? 2 : 3;
            static int shown;
            if (shown < 6) { shown++; trace("lodanim: LOD group %d thresholds %g %g %g (ratio %g)", grp, t[0], t[1], t[2], ratio); }
        }
    }
    g_lod_hist[path][lod]++;
    if (++g_lod_calls % 20000 == 0)
        trace("lodanim: LOD picks (x%g) main lod0-3 %llu %llu %llu %llu, sub %llu %llu %llu %llu; anim rebuilds forced %llu of %llu", g_dd_ratio_mul,
              (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[0][0], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[0][1], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[0][2], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[0][3],
              (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[1][0], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[1][1], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[1][2], (unsigned long long)g_lod_hist[1][3],
              (unsigned long long)g_anim_forced, (unsigned long long)g_anim_seen);
}
}  // namespace

// Before main+0x337ca8 (main path, group in w22) and main+0x337ab8 (sub-model path, group in w25): s0 = screen-coverage ratio.
// SNAP_LOD_DIST / SNAP_DRAW_DIST / SNAP_LOD_FORCE0: the chain is re-evaluated here with separate multipliers (ratios are 1/d^2, so a distance
// multiplier m scales the ratio by m^2): LOD0/LOD1 use the LOD multiplier, the cull (LOD3) uses max(LOD, draw) so it never comes before a
// LOD switch. FORCE0 makes every not-culled model LOD0. The result is handed back to the original compare chain by writing s0: unchanged
// when the original LOD already matches, else the exact threshold of the wanted LOD (0 for culled).
static void lod_apply(Cpu *c, int path) {
    lodmods_init();
    const bool legacy = g_dd_ratio_mul != 1.0f;
    if (!legacy && !g_lod_split && !g_lodsel_trace) return;
    const bool act = mod_active();
    float r0 = get_s0(c);
    float r = r0;
    if (act && (legacy || g_lod_split)) {
        const uint64_t sp = c->sp;
        const int grp = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)c->x[path ? 25 : 22];
        const float *t = nullptr;
        if (g_lod_split && grp > 0 && grp < 4096 && readable((void *)(sp + 0x28), 8)) {
            t = *(const float **)(sp + 0x28);
            if (t) t += grp * 3;
            if (t && !readable(t, 12)) t = nullptr;
        }
        const float lm = g_lod_mul2 * g_dd_ratio_mul;
        if (t) {
            const float cm = (g_cull_mul2 > g_lod_mul2 ? g_cull_mul2 : g_lod_mul2) * g_dd_ratio_mul;
            const float rl = r0 * lm, rc = r0 * cm;
            const int orig = r0 >= t[0] ? 0 : r0 >= t[1] ? 1 : r0 >= t[2] ? 2 : 3;
            int want = rl >= t[0] ? 0 : rl >= t[1] ? 1 : rc >= t[2] ? 2 : 3;
            if (g_lod_force0 && want != 3) want = 0;
            if (want == orig) r = r0;
            else if (want == 3) r = 0.0f;
            else r = t[want] > r0 || orig == 3 || orig > want ? t[want] : r0;
            if (r != r0) set_s0(c, r);
        } else if (lm != 1.0f) {   // no table (group 0 or unreadable): plain scaling, as the legacy switch did
            r = r0 * lm;
            set_s0(c, r);
        }
    }
    if (g_lodsel_trace) lod_trace(c, r, path);
}
extern "C" void rt_gm_lod_ratio(Cpu *c) { lod_apply(c, 0); }
extern "C" void rt_gm_lod_ratio_sub(Cpu *c) { lod_apply(c, 1); }

// Before main+0x33a744 `ldr w9, [x20, #0x170]` (x20 = instance+0x4000): counter +0x170, current LOD +0x174, last LOD +0x178.
extern "C" void rt_gm_anim_rate(Cpu *c) {
    lodmods_init();
    if (!g_full_rate && !g_lodsel_trace) return;
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)c->x[20];
    if (!p || !readable(p + 0x170, 12)) return;
    int32_t cnt = *(int32_t *)(p + 0x170), cur = *(int32_t *)(p + 0x174), last = *(int32_t *)(p + 0x178);
    g_anim_seen++;
    if (cnt + 1 < last * 2 && cur == last) g_anim_forced++;   // the original code would skip the rebuild this frame
    if (g_full_rate) *(int32_t *)(p + 0x170) = 0x3fffffff;    // cnt+1 >= 2*last always: rebuild every frame, counter resets to 0
}
namespace loader {
void snap_lodanim_install() {
    const char *e = getenv("SNAP_FOV");
    if (e && *e) {
        double v = atof(e);
        if (v >= 10.0) g_fov_target_deg = v; else if (v > 0.1) g_fov_scale = v;
    }
    if (const char *ab = getenv("SNAP_FOV_AB")) g_fov_ab = strtoull(ab, nullptr, 0);
    g_fov_trace = getenv("SNAP_TRACE_FOV") && getenv("SNAP_TRACE_FOV")[0] != '0';
    if (const char *s = getenv("SNAP_FOV_SITES")) {   // override the allow list: comma separated module offsets
        g_fov_allow.clear();
        while (s && *s) { char *end; g_fov_allow.push_back(strtoull(s, &end, 0)); s = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : nullptr; }
    }
    if (g_fov_trace || g_fov_scale != 1.0 || g_fov_target_deg > 0) add_override("tanf", h_tanf);
}
}  // namespace loader

```

`host/mods/look.cpp`:

```cpp
// Color looks (mod #7 part 2) (project code, ours): a host-side tone/tint pass on the final output image, never on a game render target.
//
//   SNAP_LOOK=<preset>[:<intensity>]   preset neutral | vivid | warm | cool, intensity 0..1.5 (default 1; 0 or neutral = off)
//
// snap_look_present() is called by the NVN present path once per present, after the scene has been blitted to the swapchain image and before
// the overlay (analysis/mods/nvn_hook_requests.md has the diff). The image is in TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL and must be left there. The pass copies it
// to a scratch image and redraws it through a fragment shader (GLSL in shaders/, SPIR-V in look_spv.h). The photo capture and the Evaluation
// pass read the game's own render targets, which this never touches, so scoring and saved photos are unchanged.
#include <windows.h>

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <string>

#include "../../runtime/ui/ui_present.h"
#include "look_spv.h"

namespace {

struct Look { float gain[3], sat, contrast; };
bool g_parsed, g_on;
float g_gain[3] = {1, 1, 1}, g_sat = 1, g_con = 1, g_t = 1;

void parse() {
  g_parsed = true;
  const char* e = getenv("SNAP_LOOK");
  if (!e || !*e) return;
  std::string s = e, name = s;
  float t = 1.0f;
  size_t c = s.find(':');
  if (c != std::string::npos) { name = s.substr(0, c); t = (float)atof(s.c_str() + c + 1); }
  for (auto& ch : name) ch = (char)tolower((unsigned char)ch);
  if (t < 0) t = 0;
  if (t > 1.5f) t = 1.5f;
  if (name == "vivid") { g_sat = 1.35f; g_con = 1.10f; }
  else if (name == "warm") { g_gain[0] = 1.07f; g_gain[1] = 1.0f; g_gain[2] = 0.88f; g_sat = 1.06f; g_con = 1.03f; }
  else if (name == "cool") { g_gain[0] = 0.90f; g_gain[1] = 1.0f; g_gain[2] = 1.09f; g_sat = 1.04f; g_con = 1.03f; }
  else return;   // neutral or unknown: off
  g_t = t;
  g_on = t > 0.001f;
  fprintf(stderr, "look: SNAP_LOOK=%s intensity %.2f\n", name.c_str(), t);
}

struct State {
  VkDevice dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  VkExtent2D ext{};
  VkSwapchainKHR sc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkRenderPass rp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkPipelineLayout pl = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkPipeline pipe = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDescriptorPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDescriptorSet set = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkSampler samp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  struct Fb { VkImageView v; VkFramebuffer f; };
  std::map<VkImage, Fb> fbs;
  bool failed = false;
} S;

uint32_t findMem(VkPhysicalDevice pd, uint32_t bits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags want) {
  VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount; i++)
    if ((bits & (1u << i)) && (mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want) return i;
  return 0xffffffffu;
}

void dropSized() {
  for (auto& kv : S.fbs) { vkDestroyFramebuffer(S.dev, kv.second.f, nullptr); vkDestroyImageView(S.dev, kv.second.v, nullptr); }
  S.fbs.clear();
  if (S.view) vkDestroyImageView(S.dev, S.view, nullptr);
  if (S.img) vkDestroyImage(S.dev, S.img, nullptr);
  if (S.mem) vkFreeMemory(S.dev, S.mem, nullptr);
  S.view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; S.img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; S.mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

bool build(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  // called with the device idle for our resources only: the previous frames' command buffers may still use the old scratch image, so wait.
  if (S.dev) vkDeviceWaitIdle(S.dev);
  if (S.dev && (S.dev != f->device || S.fmt != f->format)) {
    dropSized();
    if (S.pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(S.dev, S.pipe, nullptr);
    if (S.rp) vkDestroyRenderPass(S.dev, S.rp, nullptr);
    S.pipe = VK_NULL_HANDLE; S.rp = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }
  S.dev = f->device;
  VkDevice d = S.dev;
  if (!S.rp) {
    VkAttachmentDescription a{};
    a.format = f->format; a.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    a.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD; a.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    a.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE; a.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    a.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL; a.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentReference r{0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL};
    VkSubpassDescription sp{}; sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS; sp.colorAttachmentCount = 1; sp.pColorAttachments = &r;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO};
    ci.attachmentCount = 1; ci.pAttachments = &a; ci.subpassCount = 1; ci.pSubpasses = &sp;
    if (vkCreateRenderPass(d, &ci, nullptr, &S.rp) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    S.fmt = f->format;
  }
  if (!S.samp) {
    VkSamplerCreateInfo si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO};
    si.magFilter = si.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    si.addressModeU = si.addressModeV = si.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
    if (vkCreateSampler(d, &si, nullptr, &S.samp) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b{0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, nullptr};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dl{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    dl.bindingCount = 1; dl.pBindings = &b;
    if (vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(d, &dl, nullptr, &S.dsl) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkPushConstantRange pcr{VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, 32};
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    pli.setLayoutCount = 1; pli.pSetLayouts = &S.dsl; pli.pushConstantRangeCount = 1; pli.pPushConstantRanges = &pcr;
    if (vkCreatePipelineLayout(d, &pli, nullptr, &S.pl) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkDescriptorPoolSize ps{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1};
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
    dp.maxSets = 1; dp.poolSizeCount = 1; dp.pPoolSizes = &ps;
    if (vkCreateDescriptorPool(d, &dp, nullptr, &S.pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo da{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    da.descriptorPool = S.pool; da.descriptorSetCount = 1; da.pSetLayouts = &S.dsl;
    if (vkAllocateDescriptorSets(d, &da, &S.set) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  }
  if (!S.pipe) {
    VkShaderModule vs, fs;
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo sm{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
    sm.codeSize = sizeof kLook_vert; sm.pCode = kLook_vert;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(d, &sm, nullptr, &vs) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    sm.codeSize = sizeof kLook_frag; sm.pCode = kLook_frag;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(d, &sm, nullptr, &fs) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo st[2]{};
    st[0].sType = st[1].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    st[0].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT; st[0].module = vs; st[0].pName = "main";
    st[1].stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT; st[1].module = fs; st[1].pName = "main";
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo ia{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    ia.topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    vp.viewportCount = 1; vp.scissorCount = 1;
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rs{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    rs.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL; rs.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE; rs.frontFace = VK_FRONT_FACE_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE; rs.lineWidth = 1.0f;
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    ms.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState cba{}; cba.colorWriteMask = 0xF;
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo cb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    cb.attachmentCount = 1; cb.pAttachments = &cba;
    VkDynamicState dyn[2] = {VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR};
    VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo ds{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
    ds.dynamicStateCount = 2; ds.pDynamicStates = dyn;
    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo gp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO};
    gp.stageCount = 2; gp.pStages = st; gp.pVertexInputState = &vi; gp.pInputAssemblyState = &ia; gp.pViewportState = &vp;
    gp.pRasterizationState = &rs; gp.pMultisampleState = &ms; gp.pColorBlendState = &cb; gp.pDynamicState = &ds;
    gp.layout = S.pl; gp.renderPass = S.rp; gp.subpass = 0;
    VkResult r = vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(d, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &gp, nullptr, &S.pipe);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(d, vs, nullptr);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(d, fs, nullptr);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  }
  if (!S.img || S.ext.width != f->extent.width || S.ext.height != f->extent.height || S.sc != f->swapchain) {
    dropSized();
    S.ext = f->extent; S.sc = f->swapchain;
    VkImageCreateInfo ic{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
    ic.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ic.format = f->format; ic.extent = {f->extent.width, f->extent.height, 1};
    ic.mipLevels = 1; ic.arrayLayers = 1; ic.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT; ic.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ic.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT; ic.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    if (vkCreateImage(d, &ic, nullptr, &S.img) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkMemoryRequirements mr;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(d, S.img, &mr);
    uint32_t mt = findMem(f->phys, mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    if (mt == 0xffffffffu) return false;
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    ai.allocationSize = mr.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = mt;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(d, &ai, nullptr, &S.mem) != VK_SUCCESS || vkBindImageMemory(d, S.img, S.mem, 0) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
    vc.image = S.img; vc.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vc.format = f->format;
    vc.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    if (vkCreateImageView(d, &vc, nullptr, &S.view) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkDescriptorImageInfo di{S.samp, S.view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET};
    w.dstSet = S.set; w.descriptorCount = 1; w.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER; w.pImageInfo = &di;
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(d, 1, &w, 0, nullptr);
  }
  return true;
}

void barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage im, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to, VkAccessFlags sa, VkAccessFlags da) {
  VkImageMemoryBarrier b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
  b.srcAccessMask = sa; b.dstAccessMask = da; b.oldLayout = from; b.newLayout = to;
  b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
  b.image = im; b.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &b);
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" void snap_look_present(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  if (!g_parsed) parse();
  if (!g_on || S.failed || !f) return;
  static bool needBuild = true;
  if (needBuild || S.dev != f->device || S.fmt != f->format || S.ext.width != f->extent.width || S.ext.height != f->extent.height || S.sc != f->swapchain) {
    if (!build(f)) { S.failed = true; fprintf(stderr, "look: setup failed, look disabled\n"); return; }
    needBuild = false;
  }
  VkCommandBuffer cb = f->cb;
  // framebuffer for this swapchain image (created on first use)
  auto it = S.fbs.find(f->image);
  if (it == S.fbs.end()) {
    State::Fb fb{};
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
    vc.image = f->image; vc.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vc.format = f->format;
    vc.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    if (vkCreateImageView(S.dev, &vc, nullptr, &fb.v) != VK_SUCCESS) { S.failed = true; return; }
    VkFramebufferCreateInfo fi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
    fi.renderPass = S.rp; fi.attachmentCount = 1; fi.pAttachments = &fb.v; fi.width = f->extent.width; fi.height = f->extent.height; fi.layers = 1;
    if (vkCreateFramebuffer(S.dev, &fi, nullptr, &fb.f) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyImageView(S.dev, fb.v, nullptr); S.failed = true; return; }
    it = S.fbs.emplace(f->image, fb).first;
  }
  // 1. swapchain image TRANSFER_DST -> TRANSFER_SRC, scratch -> TRANSFER_DST, copy
  barrier(cb, f->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT);
  barrier(cb, S.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 0, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
  VkImageCopy cp{};
  cp.srcSubresource = cp.dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
  cp.extent = {f->extent.width, f->extent.height, 1};
  vkCmdCopyImage(cb, f->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, S.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &cp);
  barrier(cb, S.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT);
  barrier(cb, f->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT);
  // 2. redraw through the look shader; the render pass leaves the image in TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL
  VkRenderPassBeginInfo rb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO};
  rb.renderPass = S.rp; rb.framebuffer = it->second.f; rb.renderArea = {{0, 0}, f->extent};
  vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cb, &rb, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
  vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, S.pipe);
  vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, S.pl, 0, 1, &S.set, 0, nullptr);
  VkViewport vp{0, 0, (float)f->extent.width, (float)f->extent.height, 0, 1};
  VkRect2D sc{{0, 0}, f->extent};
  vkCmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp);
  vkCmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &sc);
  const bool srgb = f->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB || f->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
  float pc[8] = {g_gain[0], g_gain[1], g_gain[2], 1.0f, g_sat, g_con, g_t, srgb ? 1.0f : 0.0f};
  vkCmdPushConstants(cb, S.pl, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, sizeof pc, pc);
  vkCmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
  vkCmdEndRenderPass(cb);
}
```
