`host/mods/nativeopt.cpp`:

```cpp
// Native PC options inside the game's own Settings screen (owner 2026-11-13: "native, in game menu for options, not an F1
// menu"). The screens themselves are data: scripts/ui/make_native_options.py patches the screen's behavior file option.lmb
// (a local mod pack, built on the user's PC from their own files) with ten PC tabs (states PcTab0..9) that follow the game's
// "Other" tab, plus one popup state per pulldown row (PcPull<tab>_<slot>). It also writes rows.txt (the row table) next to
// the pack. This file drives those states from two inline hooks (MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS in recomp/snap_gen.py):
//
//   main+0x728e10  rt_ui_opt_event  entry of the option screen's event handler (a std::function body; x0 = handler object,
//                                   w1 = event, x2 = the Lumen player, x3 = std::string* state, x4 = element name for event 8
//                                   (focus moved) and 10 (decide); 11/19 = cancel (B), 22 = a per-frame update sent all game
//                                   long). In a PC state the game's handler would not know the state, so the hook handles the
//                                   event itself and turns w1 into 7 (a no-op case), except cancel and the per-frame update,
//                                   which it passes on as if the state were "Others" (B closes the screen as on any tab).
//   SetState calls rt_ui_opt_state  the `blr` of the handler's 8 calls to player->vtable[0x140](player, desc): x1 = the state
//                                   descriptor. Used to keep a template element entry (see below) and for the route anchor.
//
// Changing state is the Lumen player's own work, driven by option.lmb: an element whose f2 names a state (and f6 = 1) goes
// there on decide (tab elements, the pulldown rows), f6 = 4 returns to the previous state (popup items), and L/R open the
// state named at +0x30 of the page's Prev/Next element entries (BuildPage: the neighbor game tabs; the hook points them at
// the PC tabs: R on "Other" to PC tab 1, L on "Game" to the last, and along the PC tabs). The player then sends event 5 with the new state, and the game's handler answers
// with BuildPage + SetState (the page data: variables and the element list). For a PC state the hook does that part:
// it builds a descriptor with the game's own BuildPage (main+0x737360: state name of a game tab, the
// tab-bar variables TabNum/Tab%dLabel/..., all in a 0xf8-byte object), renames the state, adds the PC variables (current
// choices, pulldown texts, slider dots) to its std::map<string,string> at +0xa8 and lists the focusable elements in its
// element vector at +0x90 (0x130-byte entries, name at +0 and +0x18; the cursor only reaches listed elements), then calls
// SetState (calling SetState at any other time does not switch states). Values are read and written where the F1 overlay keeps them: settings keys through the F1 option table
// (snap::ui::options_test_get/set: same defaults, custom stores, presets), the controls mapping (hle::input::hub()), the
// master volume (audio layer). Restore Default Settings (Minus) on a PC tab resets that tab's rows only.
//
// Without the pack (rows.txt missing, or the pack is not active) every hook returns at once and the game is unchanged.
// SNAP_NATIVE_OPT_TRACE=1 logs events, states and element lists. SNAP_NATIVE_OPT_SETTINGS=<file>: test aid for runs that
// skip settings::load() (SNAP_SAVE_DIR set): use this settings.cfg.
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"
#include "hle/settings.h"
#include "hle/input_core.h"
#include "audio/audio_out.h"
#include "mods/mods_core.h"

namespace hle::input { void script_event(const char* name); }   // runtime/hle/input_core.cpp
namespace snap::ui {                                              // runtime/ui/ui_options.cpp (the F1 option table)
bool options_test_set(const std::string& key, const std::string& value);
std::string options_test_get(const std::string& key);
}

using namespace loader;

namespace {

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;
const uint64_t kMapEmplace = kMainBase + 0x6d7df0;   // map<string,string>::__emplace_unique_key_args(map, key, key&&, const value&)
const uint64_t kElemCopy = kMainBase + 0x656170;     // element entry copy constructor (dst, const src&)
const uint64_t kVecPushSlow = kMainBase + 0x6565c0;  // vector<element entry>::__push_back_slow_path(vec, const value&)
const uint64_t kBuildPage = kMainBase + 0x737360;    // BuildPage(desc, handler, tab id): a fresh descriptor for a game tab
const uint64_t kTabTable = kMainBase + 0x12ffc18;    // per tab id: std::string state name (+0), label (+0x18); 0x30 apart
const uint64_t kElemSize = 0x130;
const uint64_t kDescSize = 0xf8;
const char* const kGameTabs[5] = {"Game", "Camera", "Button", "Sound", "Others"};

bool trace_on() {
    static int t = -1;
    if (t < 0) { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_NATIVE_OPT_TRACE"); t = (e && *e && *e != '0') ? 1 : 0; }
    return t == 1;
}

// ---- guest libc++ strings (24 bytes): short if bit 0 of byte 0 is clear (size = byte0 >> 1, chars at +1), long otherwise
// (capacity word with bit 0 set, size at +8, data pointer at +16). Guest memory is identity mapped, so the guest reads ours.
std::string read_str(uint64_t p) {
    if (!p) return {};
    const uint8_t* s = (const uint8_t*)p;
    if (!(s[0] & 1)) return std::string((const char*)s + 1, s[0] >> 1);
    uint64_t n = *(const uint64_t*)(s + 8), d = *(const uint64_t*)(s + 16);
    if (!d || n > 4096) return {};
    return std::string((const char*)d, (size_t)n);
}
struct GStr {
    alignas(8) uint8_t b[24] = {};
    std::string keep;   // backing chars of a long string
    explicit GStr(const std::string& s) : keep(s) {
        if (s.size() <= 22) { b[0] = (uint8_t)(s.size() << 1); memcpy(b + 1, s.data(), s.size()); return; }
        uint64_t cap = (keep.size() + 16) | 1, n = keep.size(), d = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)keep.c_str();
        memcpy(b, &cap, 8); memcpy(b + 8, &n, 8); memcpy(b + 16, &d, 8);
    }
    GStr(const GStr&) = delete;
    uint64_t p() const { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)b; }
};
bool put_short(uint64_t at, const std::string& s) {   // overwrite a short guest string in place
    if (s.size() > 22 || (*(const uint8_t*)at & 1)) return false;
    memset((void*)at, 0, 24);
    *(uint8_t*)at = (uint8_t)(s.size() << 1);
    memcpy((void*)(at + 1), s.data(), s.size());
    return true;
}

// ---- the row table (rows.txt from the generator)
struct Row { int tab = 0, slot = 0; char widget = 'c'; std::string store, key, def; std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> ch; };
struct Tab { std::string state, name; std::vector<Row> rows; };
std::vector<Tab> g_tabs;

std::vector<std::string> split(const std::string& s, char sep) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    size_t a = 0;
    for (;;) { size_t b = s.find(sep, a); out.push_back(s.substr(a, b == std::string::npos ? b : b - a)); if (b == std::string::npos) break; a = b + 1; }
    return out;
}

// The pack is active when the mods index (same root and enable rules as the loader) has its option.lmb override.
bool pack_active(const std::string& root) {
    mods::Index idx;
    std::vector<std::string> warn;
    mods::load(root, idx, warn);
    for (const auto& kv : idx.map)
        if (idx.packs[kv.second.pack].id == "native-options" && kv.second.label.find("option.drp") != std::string::npos) return true;
    return false;
}

bool rows_ready() {
    static int ok = -1;
    if (ok >= 0) return ok == 1;
    ok = 0;
    std::string root = mods::default_root();
    std::ifstream f(root + "\\native-options\\rows.txt");
    if (!f) return false;
    if (!pack_active(root)) { trace("nativeopt: native-options pack not active: PC tabs off"); return false; }
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(f, line)) {
        if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#') continue;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        auto v = split(line, '\t');
        if (v[0] == "T" && v.size() >= 4) {
            int t = atoi(v[1].c_str());
            if (t != (int)g_tabs.size()) return false;
            g_tabs.push_back(Tab{v[2], v[3], {}});
        } else if (v[0] == "R" && v.size() >= 8) {
            Row r;
            r.tab = atoi(v[1].c_str()); r.slot = atoi(v[2].c_str()); r.widget = v[3].empty() ? 'c' : v[3][0];
            r.store = v[4]; r.key = v[5]; r.def = v[6];
            if (!v[7].empty())
                for (const std::string& c : split(v[7], '|')) { size_t e = c.find('='); if (e != std::string::npos) r.ch.push_back({c.substr(0, e), c.substr(e + 1)}); }
            if (r.tab < 0 || r.tab >= (int)g_tabs.size()) return false;
            g_tabs[r.tab].rows.push_back(r);
        }
    }
    ok = g_tabs.empty() ? 0 : 1;
    if (ok) trace("nativeopt: %zu PC tabs from %s\\native-options\\rows.txt", g_tabs.size(), root.c_str());
    return ok == 1;
}

void ensure_settings() {
    static bool done = false;
    if (done) return;
    done = true;
    const char* f = getenv("SNAP_NATIVE_OPT_SETTINGS");
    if (f && *f && hle::settings::file_path().empty()) {
        hle::settings::use_path_for_test(f);
        trace("nativeopt: settings file %s (SNAP_NATIVE_OPT_SETTINGS)", f);
    }
}

// ---- values: the same stores as the F1 overlay
bool* map_bool(hle::input::Mapping& m, const std::string& k) {
    if (k == "swap_sticks") return &m.swap_sticks;
    if (k == "left_invert_y") return &m.left.invert_y;
    if (k == "right_invert_y") return &m.right.invert_y;
    if (k == "toggle_zl") return &m.toggle_zl;
    if (k == "toggle_zr") return &m.toggle_zr;
    if (k == "mouse_look") return &m.mouse_look;
    if (k == "mouse_invert_x") return &m.mouse_invert_x;
    if (k == "mouse_invert_y") return &m.mouse_invert_y;
    if (k == "mouse_touch") return &m.mouse_touch;
    if (k == "lock_cursor") return &m.lock_cursor;
    return nullptr;
}

std::string get_value(const Row& r) {
    ensure_settings();
    if (r.store == "opt") return snap::ui::options_test_get(r.key);
    if (r.store == "vol") { char b[8]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%d", (int)std::lround(snap_audio_get_volume(SNAP_VOL_MASTER) * 10.0f)); return b; }
    hle::input::Mapping m = hle::input::hub().mapping();
    if (r.key == "face_layout") return std::to_string(m.face_layout);
    if (r.key == "mouse_sensitivity") { char b[16]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.2f", m.mouse_sensitivity); return b; }
    bool* p = map_bool(m, r.key);
    return p ? (*p ? "1" : "0") : r.def;
}

void set_value(const Row& r, const std::string& v) {
    ensure_settings();
    if (r.store == "opt") {
        std::string sv = v;
        if (r.widget == 'n') { char b[16]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.2f", atoi(v.c_str()) / 10.0); sv = b; }
        bool ok = snap::ui::options_test_set(r.key, sv);
        trace("nativeopt: %s = %s%s", r.key.c_str(), sv.c_str(), ok ? "" : " (refused)");
        return;
    }
    if (r.store == "vol") { snap_audio_set_volume(SNAP_VOL_MASTER, atoi(v.c_str()) / 10.0f); trace("nativeopt: master volume = %s/10", v.c_str()); return; }
    hle::input::Hub& h = hle::input::hub();
    hle::input::Mapping m = h.mapping();
    if (r.key == "face_layout") { int l = atoi(v.c_str()); if (l != m.face_layout) hle::input::set_face_layout(m, l); }
    else if (r.key == "mouse_sensitivity") m.mouse_sensitivity = (float)atof(v.c_str());
    else if (bool* p = map_bool(m, r.key)) *p = v == "1";
    h.set_mapping(m);
    h.save();
    trace("nativeopt: controls %s = %s", r.key.c_str(), v.c_str());
}

void reset_row(const Row& r) {
    if (r.store == "map") {
        hle::input::Mapping d;
        hle::input::Mapping m = d;
        std::string v = r.key == "face_layout" ? std::to_string(d.face_layout)
                      : r.key == "mouse_sensitivity" ? std::to_string(d.mouse_sensitivity)
                      : (map_bool(m, r.key) && *map_bool(m, r.key)) ? "1" : "0";
        set_value(r, v);
        return;
    }
    if (r.store == "opt" && r.widget == 'n') { set_value(r, std::to_string((int)std::lround(atof(r.def.c_str()) * 10))); return; }
    set_value(r, r.def);
}

// Index of the stored value among the row's choices (numbers compare as numbers: "2" == "2.00"); -1 when none matches.
int choice_of(const Row& r, const std::string& v) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < r.ch.size(); i++) if (r.ch[i].first == v) return (int)i;
    char* e1 = nullptr;
    double a = strtod(v.c_str(), &e1);
    if (v.empty() || *e1) return -1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < r.ch.size(); i++) {
        char* e2 = nullptr;
        double b = strtod(r.ch[i].first.c_str(), &e2);
        if (!r.ch[i].first.empty() && !*e2 && std::fabs(a - b) < 1e-4) return (int)i;
    }
    return -1;
}
int slider_of(const Row& r) {
    std::string v = get_value(r);
    int n = r.store == "opt" ? (int)std::lround(atof(v.c_str()) * 10.0) : atoi(v.c_str());
    return n < 0 ? 0 : n > 10 ? 10 : n;
}

// ---- guest calls
struct Saved { uint64_t x[31]; };
uint64_t vfn(uint64_t obj, uint64_t off) { return *(const uint64_t*)(*(const uint64_t*)obj + off); }

std::string g_slider_landed;   // the slider the cursor is on: its first focus event only reports the knob it shows
alignas(16) uint8_t g_tmpl[kElemSize];   // a copy of one of the game's own element entries (all fields but the names zero)
bool g_have_tmpl = false;
int g_tab_id[5] = {-1, -1, -1, -1, -1};  // BuildPage tab id of each game tab position

bool find_tab_ids() {
    if (g_tab_id[0] >= 0) return true;
    for (int id = 0; id < 24; id++) {
        std::string n = read_str(kTabTable + (uint64_t)id * 0x30);
        for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) if (n == kGameTabs[k] && g_tab_id[k] < 0) g_tab_id[k] = id;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) if (g_tab_id[k] < 0) { trace("nativeopt: tab id of %s not found", kGameTabs[k]); return false; }
    trace("nativeopt: tab ids %d %d %d %d %d", g_tab_id[0], g_tab_id[1], g_tab_id[2], g_tab_id[3], g_tab_id[4]);
    return true;
}

void add_var(Cpu* c, uint64_t desc, const std::string& k, const std::string& v) {
    GStr k1(k), k2(k), val(v);
    call_guest_nested(c, kMapEmplace, {desc + 0xa8, k1.p(), k2.p(), val.p()});
}

// Element entries (0x130 bytes): name at +0 and +0x18, a target state at +0x30 (Prev/Next: the tab L/R open), the
// entry's variables (std::map) at +0x60.
uint64_t find_entry(uint64_t desc, const char* name) {
    const uint64_t* vec = (const uint64_t*)(desc + 0x90);
    for (uint64_t p = vec[0]; p && p < vec[1]; p += kElemSize) if (read_str(p) == name) return p;
    return 0;
}
void set_target(uint64_t desc, const char* name, const std::string& target) {
    uint64_t p = find_entry(desc, name);
    if (!p || !put_short(p + 0x30, target)) trace("nativeopt: could not point %s at %s", name, target.c_str());
}

void add_entry(Cpu* c, uint64_t desc, const std::string& name) {
    uint64_t* vec = (uint64_t*)(desc + 0x90);
    if (vec[1] != vec[2]) { call_guest_nested(c, kElemCopy, {vec[1], (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_tmpl}); vec[1] += kElemSize; }
    else call_guest_nested(c, kVecPushSlow, {desc + 0x90, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_tmpl});
    uint64_t e = vec[1] - kElemSize;
    put_short(e, name);
    put_short(e + 0x18, name);
}

uint64_t new_desc(Cpu* c, uint64_t handler, int pos, const std::string& state) {
    uint64_t desc = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)calloc(1, 0x100);   // not freed: SetState copies it, a few hundred bytes per switch
    call_guest_nested(c, kBuildPage, {desc, handler, (uint64_t)g_tab_id[pos]});
    if (!put_short(desc, state)) trace("nativeopt: could not rename state to %s", state.c_str());
    return desc;
}

// player->vtable[0x158](player, &state, &element, bool): the game's slider drawing calls it for every dot sub-element
// ("<slider>_NN") with true on the current value; used here for our sliders and for the popup's current item.
void mark(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, const std::string& state, const std::string& element, bool on) {
    GStr s(state), e(element);
    call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0x158), {player, s.p(), e.p(), on ? 1ull : 0ull});
}

void set_state(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, uint64_t desc) {
    trace("nativeopt: SetState '%s' (host)", read_str(desc).c_str());
    call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0x140), {player, desc});
}

void row_vars(Cpu* c, uint64_t desc, int t, const Row& r) {
    char p[32];
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "PcT%dS%d", t, r.slot);
    std::string pre = p;
    if (r.widget == 'n') {
        int n = slider_of(r);
        for (int d = 1; d <= 10; d++) { char k[8]; snprintf(k, sizeof k, "D%02d", d); add_var(c, desc, pre + k, d <= n ? "lb_on" : "lb_off"); }
        add_var(c, desc, pre + "Num", std::to_string(n));
        return;
    }
    std::string v = get_value(r);
    int cur = choice_of(r, v);
    if (r.widget == 'c') {
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) add_var(c, desc, pre + "C" + std::to_string(k + 1), k == cur ? "lb_decide" : "lb_unselect");
        return;
    }
    add_var(c, desc, pre + "V", cur >= 0 ? r.ch[(size_t)cur].second : v);
    for (size_t k = 0; k < r.ch.size(); k++) add_var(c, desc, pre + "I" + std::to_string(k + 1), (int)k == cur ? "lb_active" : "lb_unselect");
}

void redraw_row(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, const Row& r);

void go_tab(Cpu* c, uint64_t handler, uint64_t player, int t) {
    if (!g_have_tmpl || !find_tab_ids()) { trace("nativeopt: no element template yet"); return; }
    const Tab& tab = g_tabs[(size_t)t];
    uint64_t desc = new_desc(c, handler, t % 5, tab.state);
    // BuildPage listed the five game tabs: they become this set's PC tabs; L/R go where Prev/Next name at +0x30
    const int base = (t / 5) * 5, n = (int)g_tabs.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < 5 && base + i < n; i++)
        if (uint64_t p = find_entry(desc, kGameTabs[i])) { put_short(p, g_tabs[(size_t)base + i].state); put_short(p + 0x18, g_tabs[(size_t)base + i].state); }
    set_target(desc, "Prev", t == 0 ? "Others" : g_tabs[(size_t)t - 1].state);
    set_target(desc, "Next", t + 1 < n ? g_tabs[(size_t)t + 1].state : "Game");
    for (const Row& r : tab.rows) {
        row_vars(c, desc, t, r);
        char n[32];
        if (r.widget == 'c') for (int k = 1; k <= 2; k++) { snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PcT%dS%dC%d", t, r.slot, k); add_entry(c, desc, n); }
        else if (r.widget == 'p') { snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PcT%dS%dP", t, r.slot); add_entry(c, desc, n); }
        else { snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PcT%dS%dN", t, r.slot); add_entry(c, desc, n); snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PcT%dS%dM", t, r.slot); add_entry(c, desc, n); }
    }
    set_state(c, player, desc);
    for (const Row& r : tab.rows) {
        if (r.widget == 'p') redraw_row(c, player, r);   // back from a popup the player keeps the old pulldown texts
        if (r.widget != 'n') continue;
        int v = slider_of(r);   // the cursor lands on the knob of the value (on 0: dot 1, so Right/Left still work)
        for (int d = 1; d <= 10; d++) { char n[40]; snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PcT%dS%dN_%02d", t, r.slot, d); mark(c, player, tab.state, n, d == (v < 1 ? 1 : v)); }
    }
    g_slider_landed.clear();
}

void open_pull(Cpu* c, uint64_t handler, uint64_t player, int t, const Row& r) {
    if (!g_have_tmpl || !find_tab_ids()) return;
    char st[32];
    snprintf(st, sizeof st, "PcPull%d_%d", t, r.slot);
    uint64_t desc = new_desc(c, handler, t % 5, st);
    row_vars(c, desc, t, r);
    add_entry(c, desc, "PulldownMenu");   // the game's own list widget (type 6): Up/Down inside it, items report PulldownMenuItemNN
    set_state(c, player, desc);
}

// Decide on a pulldown row, before the player switches to the popup state: as the game's list helper does at the same
// point (main+0x776c80), register the items with player->vtable[0x148](player, &popup state, &"PulldownMenuItemNN", true).
// (The game then calls player->vtable[0x1f0](player, &"PulldownMenuItemNN") for the current value (0x776bb0); here the
// player focuses the list header a frame after SetState anyway, so the cursor starts above item 1; the current value is
// marked lb_active.)
void prepare_pull(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, int t, const Row& r) {
    char st[32];
    snprintf(st, sizeof st, "PcPull%d_%d", t, r.slot);
    GStr sname{std::string(st)};
    for (size_t k = 1; k <= r.ch.size(); k++) {
        char n[32];
        snprintf(n, sizeof n, "PulldownMenuItem%02zu", k);
        GStr item{std::string(n)};
        call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0x148), {player, sname.p(), item.p(), 1ull});
    }
}

// A slider moved: draw its dots and number at once (the game's own sliders do the same through these two player calls).
void draw_slider(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, const Row& r, int n) {
    for (int d = 1; d <= 10; d++) {
        char path[96];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "selector_parent_mc/selector_%02d_mc/selector_number_mc/number_dot_mc/dot_%02d_mc", r.slot, d);
        GStr p(path), l(d <= n ? "lb_on" : "lb_off");
        call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0x90), {player, p.p(), l.p()});
    }
    char path[112];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "selector_parent_mc/selector_%02d_mc/selector_number_mc/dt_select_number_mc/dt_select_number", r.slot);
    GStr p(path), txt(std::to_string(n));
    alignas(8) uint64_t args[3] = {0, 0, 0};   // empty std::vector of format arguments
    call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0xa8), {player, p.p(), txt.p(), (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)args});
}

const Row* find_row(int t, int slot) {
    if (t < 0 || t >= (int)g_tabs.size()) return nullptr;
    for (const Row& r : g_tabs[(size_t)t].rows) if (r.slot == slot) return &r;
    return nullptr;
}

// Draw a row's current value again (after Restore Default Settings), with the same player calls the game's own handler uses.
void redraw_row(Cpu* c, uint64_t player, const Row& r) {
    char sel[48];
    snprintf(sel, sizeof sel, "selector_parent_mc/selector_%02d_mc", r.slot);
    if (r.widget == 'n') { draw_slider(c, player, r, slider_of(r)); return; }
    std::string v = get_value(r);
    int cur = choice_of(r, v);
    if (r.widget == 'c') {
        for (int k = 1; k <= 2; k++) {
            char path[96];
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/selector_common_%02d_mc", sel, k);
            GStr p(path), l(k - 1 == cur ? "lb_decide" : "lb_unselect");
            call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0x90), {player, p.p(), l.p()});
        }
        return;
    }
    std::string path = std::string(sel) + "/selector_pulldown_mc/dt_select_pulldown_mc/dt_select_pulldown";
    GStr p(path), txt(cur >= 0 ? r.ch[(size_t)cur].second : v);
    alignas(8) uint64_t args[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    call_guest_nested(c, vfn(player, 0xa8), {player, p.p(), txt.p(), (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)args});
}

alignas(8) uint8_t g_others[24];   // "Others": the state name handed to the game handler for B and the per-frame update
void init_names() { put_short((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_others, "Others"); }

}  // namespace

// The player switches states itself (option.lmb: tab elements and the pulldown row name their target state, popup items
// return to the previous one) and then sends event 5 with the new state; the game's handler answers with BuildPage and
// SetState. For a PC state the hook does that part.
extern "C" void rt_ui_opt_event(Cpu* c) {
    unsigned ev = (unsigned)c->x[1];
    if (!rows_ready()) return;
    std::string st = read_str(c->x[3]);
    bool tab = st.compare(0, 5, "PcTab") == 0, pull = st.compare(0, 6, "PcPull") == 0;
    if (!tab && !pull) {
        if (trace_on() && (ev == 5 || ev == 10)) trace("nativeopt: event %u state '%s' element '%s'", ev, st.c_str(), ev == 10 ? read_str(c->x[4]).c_str() : "");
        return;
    }
    static bool names = false;
    if (!names) { init_names(); names = true; }
    const uint64_t handler = c->x[0], player = c->x[2];
    std::string e = (ev == 8 || ev == 10) ? read_str(c->x[4]) : std::string();
    if (trace_on() && ev != 22) trace("nativeopt: event %u state '%s' element '%s'", ev, st.c_str(), e.c_str());
    if (ev == 22 || (tab && (ev == 11 || ev == 19))) { c->x[3] = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_others; return; }   // B closes the screen as on "Other"
    int t = atoi(st.c_str() + (tab ? 5 : 6));
    if (t < 0 || t >= (int)g_tabs.size()) { c->x[1] = 7; return; }
    Saved s; memcpy(s.x, c->x, sizeof s.x);
    if (ev == 5) {   // entering a PC state: its page data
        if (tab) go_tab(c, handler, player, t);
        else if (const Row* r = find_row(t, atoi(st.c_str() + st.find('_') + 1))) open_pull(c, handler, player, t, *r);
    } else if (pull) {
        const Row* r = find_row(t, atoi(st.c_str() + st.find('_') + 1));
        if (r && ev == 10 && e.compare(0, 16, "PulldownMenuItem") == 0) {   // an item: set it; the list returns to the tab
            size_t k = (size_t)atoi(e.c_str() + 16);
            if (k >= 1 && k <= r->ch.size()) set_value(*r, r->ch[k - 1].first);
        }
    } else if (ev == 8 && e.compare(0, 3, "PcT") == 0) {   // a slider's knob or mute button got the focus
        int tt = 0, slot = 0, n = -1;
        char kind = 0;
        if (sscanf(e.c_str(), "PcT%dS%d%c_%d", &tt, &slot, &kind, &n) >= 3 && (kind == 'N' || kind == 'M')) {
            const Row* r = find_row(tt, slot);
            char key[24];
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "%d_%d", tt, slot);
            bool landing = g_slider_landed != key;   // the cursor just arrived: not a change (never store what the widget starts at)
            g_slider_landed = key;
            if (r && r->widget == 'n' && !landing) {
                if (kind == 'M') n = 0;
                if (n >= 0 && n <= 10 && n != slider_of(*r)) { set_value(*r, std::to_string(n)); draw_slider(c, player, *r, n); }
            }
        } else {
            g_slider_landed.clear();
        }
    } else if (ev == 8) {
        g_slider_landed.clear();
    } else if (ev == 10) {
        int tt = 0, slot = 0, k = 0;
        char kind = 0;
        if (e == "Reset") {   // Restore Default Settings on a PC tab: this tab's rows only
            for (const Row& r : g_tabs[(size_t)t].rows) { reset_row(r); redraw_row(c, player, r); }
        } else if (sscanf(e.c_str(), "PcT%dS%d%c%d", &tt, &slot, &kind, &k) == 4 && kind == 'C') {
            const Row* r = find_row(tt, slot);
            if (r && k >= 1 && k <= (int)r->ch.size()) set_value(*r, r->ch[(size_t)k - 1].first);
        } else if (sscanf(e.c_str(), "PcT%dS%d%c", &tt, &slot, &kind) == 3 && kind == 'P') {   // a pulldown row: its popup opens next
            if (const Row* r = find_row(tt, slot)) prepare_pull(c, player, tt, *r);
        }
    }
    memcpy(c->x, s.x, sizeof s.x);
    c->x[1] = 7;   // the game's handler skips the event
}

extern "C" void rt_ui_opt_state(Cpu* c) {
    uint64_t desc = c->x[1];
    if (!desc || !rows_ready()) return;
    std::string state = read_str(desc);
    hle::input::script_event("options");   // scripted-input anchor: the Settings screen opened (host/routes/native_options_*.txt)
    const uint64_t* vec = (const uint64_t*)(desc + 0x90);
    if (trace_on()) {
        std::string names;
        for (uint64_t p = vec[0]; p && p < vec[1]; p += kElemSize) {
            names += " " + read_str(p);
            for (uint64_t o = 0x30; o < kElemSize; o += 8) if (*(const uint64_t*)(p + o)) { char b[40]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[+%llx=%llx]", (unsigned long long)o, (unsigned long long)*(const uint64_t*)(p + o)); names += b; }
        }
        trace("nativeopt: SetState '%s' elements:%s", state.c_str(), names.c_str());
    }
    bool game_tab = false;
    for (const char* n : kGameTabs) game_tab = game_tab || state == n;
    if (!game_tab) return;
    Saved s; memcpy(s.x, c->x, sizeof s.x);
    if (!g_have_tmpl) {
        for (uint64_t p = vec[0]; p && p < vec[1]; p += kElemSize) {   // keep an entry with short names (a tab's) as the template
            if ((*(const uint8_t*)p & 1) || (*(const uint8_t*)(p + 0x18) & 1)) continue;
            call_guest_nested(c, kElemCopy, {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_tmpl, p});
            g_have_tmpl = true;
            trace("nativeopt: element template from '%s'", read_str(p).c_str());
            break;
        }
    }
    // R on "Other" opens the first PC tab, L on "Game" the last one
    if (!g_tabs.empty()) {
        if (state == "Others") set_target(desc, "Next", g_tabs.front().state);
        else if (state == "Game") set_target(desc, "Prev", g_tabs.back().state);
    }
    memcpy(c->x, s.x, sizeof s.x);
}

```

`host/mods/neofilm.cpp`:

```cpp
// Gameplay mods #14 (NEO-ONE speed control, SNAP_NEO_SPEED) and #22 (more photos per run, SNAP_FILM) (project code, ours),
// plus a small dev tracer (SNAP_NEO_DUMP, SNAP_NEO_WATCH) used to find the rail code. Everything is off unless its env var is set.
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"

using namespace loader;

extern "C" volatile int g_fnprof;
extern "C" uint64_t snap_present_count();   // host/boot.cpp

namespace {

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- dev tracer
// SNAP_NEO_DUMP=<module offset>,<bytes>[;..]   logs the floats at main+off once a second.
// SNAP_NEO_WATCH=<module offset>[,..]          hardware write watchpoints (DR0..3, 4 bytes) on every thread; a VEH counts the rip of each write
//                                              (rip - exe base, resolve with the linker map) and prints the table every 2 s.
struct Dump { uint64_t addr; int bytes; bool deref; };
std::vector<Dump> g_dumps;
std::vector<uint64_t> g_watch;
std::mutex g_mu;
std::map<uint64_t, uint64_t> g_hits;   // rip rva -> count
uint64_t g_modbase;
uint64_t g_camfn;                    // SNAP_NEO_CAMFN=<module offset>: function whose x0 is the object to inspect
volatile uint64_t g_camobj;
int g_camdump = 0x200;               // SNAP_NEO_CAMDUMP=<bytes>
std::vector<int> g_camoffs;          // SNAP_NEO_WATCH_OBJ=<off>[,..]: hardware-watch obj+off (else auto: offsets that change, first 4)
std::vector<float> g_prev;
bool g_autodone;
uint64_t g_watchbase;
int g_auto_t = 110;                  // SNAP_NEO_AUTO_T: second at which the auto watch picks

LONG CALLBACK veh(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep) {
    if (ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    DWORD64 dr6 = ep->ContextRecord->Dr6;
    if (!(dr6 & 0xf)) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint64_t rip = ep->ContextRecord->Rip;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
        g_hits[((uint64_t)(dr6 & 0xf) << 56) | (rip - g_modbase)]++;
    }
    ep->ContextRecord->Dr6 = 0;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
}

void arm_threads() {
    DWORD me = GetCurrentThreadId(), pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    THREADENTRY32 te{sizeof te};
    for (BOOL ok = Thread32First(snap, &te); ok; ok = Thread32Next(snap, &te)) {
        if (te.th32OwnerProcessID != pid || te.th32ThreadID == me) continue;
        HANDLE h = OpenThread(THREAD_ALL_ACCESS, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
        if (!h) continue;
        if (SuspendThread(h) != (DWORD)-1) {
            CONTEXT cx{};
            cx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS;
            if (GetThreadContext(h, &cx)) {
                DWORD64 dr7 = 0;
                DWORD64 *dr[4] = {&cx.Dr0, &cx.Dr1, &cx.Dr2, &cx.Dr3};
                for (size_t i = 0; i < g_watch.size() && i < 4; i++) {
                    *dr[i] = g_watch[i];
                    dr7 |= (1ull << (i * 2)) | (1ull << (16 + i * 4)) | (3ull << (18 + i * 4));   // enable, write, 4 bytes
                }
                cx.Dr7 = dr7;
                SetThreadContext(h, &cx);
            }
            ResumeThread(h);
        }
        CloseHandle(h);
    }
    CloseHandle(snap);
}

void tracer_thread() {
    g_modbase = (uint64_t)GetModuleHandleA(nullptr);
    if (!g_watch.empty()) AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, veh);
    for (int sec = 0;; sec++) {
        Sleep(1000);
        if (!g_watch.empty() && (sec % 3) == 0) arm_threads();
        for (const Dump &d : g_dumps) {
            uint64_t base = d.addr;
            if (d.deref) { if (IsBadReadPtr((void *)d.addr, 8)) continue; base = *(const uint64_t *)d.addr; }
            const float *f = (const float *)base;
            if (IsBadReadPtr(f, d.bytes)) continue;
            char line[1100];
            int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[neo-dump] t=%d main+%#llx base=%#llx:", sec, (unsigned long long)(d.addr - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)base);
            for (int i = 0; i < d.bytes / 4 && n < 1000; i++) n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %g", f[i]);
            fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line);
        }
        if (g_camfn && g_camobj && !IsBadReadPtr((void *)g_camobj, g_camdump)) {
            const float *f = (const float *)g_camobj;
            int nf = g_camdump / 4;
            char line[2400];
            int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[neo-cam] t=%d obj=%#llx:", sec, (unsigned long long)g_camobj);
            for (int i = 0; i < nf && n < 2300; i++) n += snprintf(line + n, sizeof line - n, " %g", f[i]);
            fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line);
            if (!g_camoffs.empty() && sec >= g_auto_t && g_watchbase != g_camobj) {   // explicit offsets: follow the object when it changes
                static bool veh_added;
                g_watchbase = g_camobj;
                g_watch.clear();
                for (int o : g_camoffs) { fprintf(stderr, "[neo-cam] watch obj+%#x (obj %#llx)\n", o, (unsigned long long)g_camobj); g_watch.push_back(g_camobj + o); }
                if (!veh_added) { veh_added = true; AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, veh); }
                arm_threads();
            }
            if (!g_autodone && g_camoffs.empty() && g_watch.empty() && !g_prev.empty() && sec >= g_auto_t) {
                // auto: floats that changed since the last second and stayed finite and small; keep the first four, one per 3-float group
                std::vector<int> pick;
                for (int i = 0; i + 2 < nf && pick.size() < 4; i++) {
                    bool all = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                        float a = f[i + k], b = g_prev[i + k];
                        if (!(a != b && fabsf(a) < 1e6f && fabsf(a) > 1e-3f && fabsf(a - b) < 1e3f)) all = false;
                    }
                    if (all) { pick.push_back(i * 4); i += 2; }
                }
                if (!pick.empty()) {
                    g_autodone = true;
                    for (int o : pick) { fprintf(stderr, "[neo-cam] auto watch obj+%#x\n", o); g_watch.push_back(g_camobj + o); }
                    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, veh);
                    arm_threads();
                }
            }
            g_prev.assign(f, f + nf);
        }
        if (!g_watch.empty() && (sec % 2) == 1) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
            for (auto &kv : g_hits) fprintf(stderr, "[neo-watch] dr=%llx exe+%#llx hits=%llu\n", (unsigned long long)(kv.first >> 56), (unsigned long long)(kv.first & 0xffffffffffffffull), (unsigned long long)kv.second);
        }
        fflush(stderr);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- #22 SNAP_FILM
// The play HUD object keeps the photo counter at [this+0x2b8] (int, 72 on most courses). Its live per-frame update is main+0x393c90, which
// decrements it per shot (`ldr w8,[x26,#0x2b8]; subs w10,w8,#1; ... str w10,[x26,#0x2b8]`, main+0x393d98..0x393f84) and ends the expedition at
// 0. (Module offsets are real vaddrs; scripts/elf_xref.py `func` prints addresses shifted by 0x1000, use knobs_lib.dis.) The initial value is
// written elsewhere (main+0x37fa48 and 0x3807fc looked right but never ran), so rt_gm_film_c, hooked at main+0x393d98 (before the load), overwrites the counter
// with SNAP_FILM once per HUD object, the first time it still reads 72.
int g_film;           // 0 = off
bool g_film_log;

void film_apply(uint64_t this_, const char *site, bool only72) {
    static bool inited;
    if (!inited) {
        inited = true;
        if (const char *e = getenv("SNAP_FILM")) { int v = atoi(e); if (v >= 1) g_film = v > 999 ? 999 : v; }
        g_film_log = getenv("SNAP_FILM_LOG") && getenv("SNAP_FILM_LOG")[0] != '0';
    }
    if (!this_ || IsBadReadPtr((void *)(this_ + 0x2b8), 4)) return;
    int *p = (int *)(this_ + 0x2b8);
    if (g_film_log) fprintf(stderr, "[film] %s hud=%#llx counter %d -> %d\n", site, (unsigned long long)this_, *p, g_film ? g_film : *p);
    if (g_film && (!only72 || *p == 72)) *p = g_film;
}

}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- #14 SNAP_NEO_SPEED
// Found 2026-11-12 (dev tracer, florio_photos): the render camera (builder 0x295170, eye at obj+0xd0) is placed by the camera controller
// update 0x38b710, which samples the NEO-ONE rail object R = *(controller+0x68) through 0x4bf670: R+0x30 = the rail curve (its length is
// curve+0x3c), R+0x70 = progress along it (a float, about 0.9 per second on Florio), the position is curve(R+0x70 / length). The progress
// is advanced once per frame by the rail update 0x4c0090: `R+0x70 += dt * speed * slope factor` at main+0x4c2de8..0x4c2df0
// (`ldr s1,[x19,#0x70]; fadd s1,s12,s1; str s1,[x19,#0x70]`, x19 = R). MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS runs rt_gm_neo_speed right after that store. It
// remembers the progress it left last time per rail object, takes this frame's increment (new - last) and stores last + increment * speed.
// Nothing else is touched: the animation clock, Pokemon scripts and the camera's own timers keep real time, so only the ride covers
// ground faster or slower (events keyed to rail position fire earlier or later in real time; photo scoring reads positions, not time).
namespace {
double g_neo = 1.0;
bool g_neo_log;
struct RailState { uint64_t obj; float last; bool have; };
RailState g_rails[8];
int g_nrails;
bool g_neo_inited;

void neo_init() {
    g_neo_inited = true;
    if (const char *e = getenv("SNAP_NEO_SPEED")) { double v = atof(e); if (v >= 0.5 && v <= 3.0 && v != 1.0) g_neo = v; else if (v > 3.0) g_neo = 3.0; else if (v > 0.0 && v < 0.5) g_neo = 0.5; }
    g_neo_log = getenv("SNAP_NEO_LOG") && getenv("SNAP_NEO_LOG")[0] != '0';
    if (g_neo != 1.0) fprintf(stderr, "[neo] SNAP_NEO_SPEED=%g: rail progress increments scaled\n", g_neo);
}

}  // namespace

namespace hle::input { bool route_on(); void route_rail(uint64_t obj, float prog); void route_film(int count); }   // runtime/hle/input_core.cpp (route "wait" signals)

extern "C" void rt_gm_neo_speed(Cpu *c) {
    if (hle::input::route_on() && c->x[19] && !IsBadReadPtr((void *)(c->x[19] + 0x70), 4)) hle::input::route_rail(c->x[19], *(float *)(c->x[19] + 0x70));
    if (!g_neo_inited) neo_init();
    if (g_neo == 1.0 && !g_neo_log) return;
    uint64_t obj = c->x[19];
    if (!obj || IsBadReadPtr((void *)(obj + 0x70), 4)) return;
    float *pp = (float *)(obj + 0x70);
    RailState *rs = nullptr;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nrails; i++) if (g_rails[i].obj == obj) { rs = &g_rails[i]; break; }
    if (!rs) {
        if (g_nrails >= 8) return;
        rs = &g_rails[g_nrails++];
        rs->obj = obj; rs->have = false;
        if (g_neo_log) fprintf(stderr, "[neo] rail object %#llx (progress %g)\n", (unsigned long long)obj, *pp);
    }
    float cur = *pp;
    if (rs->have && cur > rs->last && cur - rs->last < 5.0f && g_neo != 1.0) {
        float scaled = rs->last + (cur - rs->last) * (float)g_neo;
        *pp = scaled;
        cur = scaled;
    }
    if (g_neo_log) {
        static int n;
        if ((++n % 120) == 1) fprintf(stderr, "[neo] present=%llu rail %#llx progress %g\n", (unsigned long long)snap_present_count(), (unsigned long long)obj, cur);
    }
    rs->last = cur;
    rs->have = true;
}

namespace {
}  // namespace

extern "C" void snap_neo_observe(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    (void)lr;
    if (g_camfn && a == g_camfn) g_camobj = x0;
}
// Live HUD update main+0x393c90, hooked before `ldr w8, [x26, #0x2b8]` at main+0x393d98 (x26 = HUD), so this frame's
// `subs w10, w8, #1` already sees a rewritten counter (hooked one instruction later, a shot in that frame stored 71).
extern "C" void rt_gm_film_c(Cpu *c) {
    static uint64_t addr[8];
    static int last[8];
    static int nd;
    uint64_t hud = c->x[26];
    if (!hud || IsBadReadPtr((void *)(hud + 0x2b8), 4)) return;
    hle::input::route_film(*(int *)(hud + 0x2b8));
    int i = 0;
    while (i < nd && addr[i] != hud) i++;
    if (i == nd) { if (nd == 8) i = 7; else { addr[nd] = hud; last[nd] = -1; nd++; } }
    // A new expedition reads 72 after any value but 73 (a normal shot 73 -> 72 is not a refill), so the boost works again on every
    // expedition even when the allocator reuses the HUD address.
    if (*(int *)(hud + 0x2b8) == 72 && last[i] != 73 && last[i] != 72) film_apply(hud, "hud", true);
    last[i] = *(int *)(hud + 0x2b8);
}

namespace loader {
void snap_neofilm_install() {
    if (const char *d = getenv("SNAP_NEO_DUMP")) {
        std::string s = d;
        size_t p = 0;
        while (p < s.size()) {
            size_t e = s.find(';', p);
            if (e == std::string::npos) e = s.size();
            std::string item = s.substr(p, e - p);
            size_t c = item.find(',');
            if (c != std::string::npos) g_dumps.push_back({kMainBase + strtoull(item.c_str(), nullptr, 0), atoi(item.c_str() + c + 1), item.find(",d", c + 1) != std::string::npos});
            p = e + 1;
        }
    }
    if (const char *w = getenv("SNAP_NEO_WATCH")) {
        const char *s = w;
        while (s && *s) { char *end; g_watch.push_back(kMainBase + strtoull(s, &end, 0)); s = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : nullptr; }
    }
    if (const char *cf = getenv("SNAP_NEO_CAMFN")) { g_camfn = kMainBase + strtoull(cf, nullptr, 0);  }
    if (const char *cd = getenv("SNAP_NEO_CAMDUMP")) g_camdump = atoi(cd) & ~3;
    if (const char *wo = getenv("SNAP_NEO_WATCH_OBJ")) {
        const char *s = wo;
        while (s && *s) { char *end; g_camoffs.push_back((int)strtoul(s, &end, 0)); s = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : nullptr; }
    }
    if (const char *at = getenv("SNAP_NEO_AUTO_T")) g_auto_t = atoi(at);
    if (g_camfn) g_fnprof = 1;
    if (!g_dumps.empty() || !g_watch.empty() || g_camfn) std::thread(tracer_thread).detach();
}
}  // namespace loader

```

`host/mods/photoexport.cpp`:

```cpp
// Full-resolution photo export (mod: every photo the game saves to the album is also written as a PNG; project code, ours).
//
// The game encodes each album photo (and its thumbnail) through nn::image::JpegEncoder, which is lifted sdk code. Two host
// overrides wrap it: SetPixelData records the pixel buffer, format and size per encoder object; Encode runs the original, and
// when the pixels are photo-sized (width >= SNAP_PHOTO_MIN_W, default 640) the pixels are copied and a worker thread writes
// <photos>\photo_<date>_<time>_<n>.png (Windows Imaging Component, lossless) plus a .json sidecar with the size, the game's
// JPEG byte size and its CRC32 (the gallery links an export to its album entry through that CRC).
//
//   SNAP_PHOTO_EXPORT=1|0   enables / disables the export (default per hle/visual_defaults.h: off, on with SNAP_PROFILE=enhanced; when off the overrides are not registered at all).
//   SNAP_PHOTO_DIR=<dir>    output folder (default %APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\photos; test runs should set it).
//   SNAP_PHOTO_MIN_W=<n>    smallest width that counts as a photo (default 640; thumbnails are smaller).
//   SNAP_PHOTO_LOG=1        logs every encoder call (format, size, stride) to stderr.
#include <windows.h>
#include <wincodec.h>

#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"
#include "hle/visual_defaults.h"   // default on/off (SNAP_PROFILE)

#pragma comment(lib, "windowscodecs")

using namespace loader;

namespace {

const char *kSetPixel = "_ZN2nn5image11JpegEncoder12SetPixelDataEPKvNS0_11PixelFormatERKNS0_9DimensionEi";
const char *kEncode = "_ZN2nn5image11JpegEncoder6EncodeEPmPvmS3_mPNS0_11ExifBuilderE";

struct PixInfo { uint64_t data; int fmt, w, h, align; };
struct Job { std::vector<uint8_t> bgra; int w, h; std::string base; uint32_t jpg_size, jpg_crc; int fmt, align; };

std::mutex g_mu;
std::condition_variable g_cv;
std::unordered_map<uint64_t, PixInfo> g_pix;
std::unordered_set<uint32_t> g_seen;
std::deque<Job> g_q;
bool g_log, g_started;
int g_min_w = 640;
long g_count;
std::string g_dir;

uint32_t crc32(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    static uint32_t t[256];
    static bool init;
    if (!init) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) { uint32_t c = i; for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1) : c >> 1; t[i] = c; }
        init = true;
    }
    uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = t[(c ^ p[i]) & 255] ^ (c >> 8);
    return ~c;
}

std::wstring widen(const std::string &s) {
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring w(n > 0 ? n - 1 : 0, L'\0');
    if (n > 1) MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, &w[0], n);
    return w;
}

bool write_png(const Job &j, const std::string &path) {
    IWICImagingFactory *f = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&f)))) return false;
    IWICStream *st = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapEncoder *enc = nullptr;
    IWICBitmapFrameEncode *fr = nullptr;
    IPropertyBag2 *pb = nullptr;
    bool ok = false;
    std::wstring tmp = widen(path + ".tmp");
    if (SUCCEEDED(f->CreateStream(&st)) && SUCCEEDED(st->InitializeFromFilename(tmp.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(f->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng, nullptr, &enc)) && SUCCEEDED(enc->Initialize(st, WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)) &&
        SUCCEEDED(enc->CreateNewFrame(&fr, &pb)) && SUCCEEDED(fr->Initialize(pb)) && SUCCEEDED(fr->SetSize(j.w, j.h))) {
        WICPixelFormatGUID pf = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
        fr->SetPixelFormat(&pf);
        if (SUCCEEDED(fr->WritePixels(j.h, j.w * 4, (UINT)j.bgra.size(), (BYTE *)j.bgra.data())) && SUCCEEDED(fr->Commit()) && SUCCEEDED(enc->Commit())) ok = true;
    }
    if (pb) pb->Release();
    if (fr) fr->Release();
    if (enc) enc->Release();
    if (st) st->Release();
    f->Release();
    if (ok) {
        std::wstring fin = widen(path);
        ok = MoveFileExW(tmp.c_str(), fin.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
    }
    if (!ok) DeleteFileW(tmp.c_str());
    return ok;
}

void worker() {
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
    CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    for (;;) {
        Job j;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
            g_cv.wait(lk, [] { return !g_q.empty(); });
            j = std::move(g_q.front());
            g_q.pop_front();
        }
        std::string png = g_dir + "\\" + j.base + ".png";
        bool ok = write_png(j, png);
        if (ok) {
            char js[512];
            snprintf(js, sizeof js, "{\"png\": \"%s.png\", \"width\": %d, \"height\": %d, \"jpeg_bytes\": %u, \"jpeg_crc32\": \"%08x\", \"pixel_format\": %d, \"source\": \"nn::image::JpegEncoder\"}\n",
                     j.base.c_str(), j.w, j.h, j.jpg_size, j.jpg_crc, j.fmt);
            FILE *fp = fopen((g_dir + "\\" + j.base + ".json").c_str(), "wb");
            if (fp) { fputs(js, fp); fclose(fp); }
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "[photo-export] %s %s (%dx%d)\n", ok ? "wrote" : "FAILED", png.c_str(), j.w, j.h);
    }
}

void ensure_started() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
    if (g_started) return;
    g_started = true;
    CreateDirectoryA(g_dir.c_str(), nullptr);
    std::thread(worker).detach();
}

// Source pixel format: the game passes 14 (R,G,B,A bytes); that is the only one converted. Photos are 1080x720, thumbnails 240x200 and 204x136.
void h_setpixel(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t self = c->x[0];
    PixInfo p{c->x[1], (int)c->x[2], 0, 0, (int)c->x[4]};
    const int *dim = (const int *)c->x[3];
    if (dim) { p.w = dim[0]; p.h = dim[1]; }
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu); g_pix[self] = p; }
    if (g_log) fprintf(stderr, "[photo-export] SetPixelData enc=%#llx data=%#llx fmt=%d %dx%d align=%d\n", (unsigned long long)self, (unsigned long long)p.data, p.fmt, p.w, p.h, p.align);
    uint64_t orig = lookup(kSetPixel);
    if (orig) c->x[0] = call_guest_nested(c, orig, {c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[2], c->x[3], c->x[4]});
}

void h_encode(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t self = c->x[0], psize = c->x[1], out = c->x[2];
    uint64_t args[7] = {c->x[0], c->x[1], c->x[2], c->x[3], c->x[4], c->x[5], c->x[6]};
    uint64_t orig = lookup(kEncode);
    uint64_t res = orig ? call_guest_nested(c, orig, {args[0], args[1], args[2], args[3], args[4], args[5], args[6]}) : 0;
    PixInfo p{};
    bool have = false;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu); auto it = g_pix.find(self); if (it != g_pix.end()) { p = it->second; have = true; } }
    uint64_t jsz = psize ? *(const uint64_t *)psize : 0;
    if (g_log) fprintf(stderr, "[photo-export] Encode enc=%#llx result=%#llx jpeg=%llu have=%d\n", (unsigned long long)self, (unsigned long long)res, (unsigned long long)jsz, have);
    c->x[0] = res;
    if (!have || (uint32_t)res != 0) return;   // failed encode
    if (p.w < g_min_w || p.h < 1 || p.w > 16384 || p.h > 16384 || !p.data) return;
    int bpp = 4;
    if (p.fmt != 14) { fprintf(stderr, "[photo-export] pixel format %d not handled, photo skipped\n", p.fmt); return; }
    size_t stride = (size_t)p.w * bpp;
    if (p.align > 1) stride = (stride + p.align - 1) / p.align * p.align;
    Job j;
    j.w = p.w; j.h = p.h; j.fmt = p.fmt; j.align = p.align;
    j.bgra.resize((size_t)p.w * p.h * 4);
    const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)p.data;
    for (int y = 0; y < p.h; y++) {
        const uint8_t *s = src + y * stride;
        uint8_t *d = &j.bgra[(size_t)y * p.w * 4];
        for (int x = 0; x < p.w; x++) {
            d[4 * x + 0] = s[bpp * x + 2];
            d[4 * x + 1] = s[bpp * x + 1];
            d[4 * x + 2] = s[bpp * x + 0];
            d[4 * x + 3] = 255;   // photos are opaque; the game's alpha is not meaningful in a JPEG
        }
    }
    j.jpg_size = (uint32_t)jsz;
    j.jpg_crc = (out && jsz && jsz < (1u << 26)) ? crc32((const uint8_t *)out, (size_t)jsz) : 0;
    if (j.jpg_crc) {   // the game encodes some photos twice; write each distinct JPEG once per session
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
        if (!g_seen.insert(j.jpg_crc).second) return;
    }
    SYSTEMTIME t;
    GetLocalTime(&t);
    char nm[96];
    long n;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu); n = ++g_count; }
    snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "photo_%04d%02d%02d_%02d%02d%02d_%03ld", t.wYear, t.wMonth, t.wDay, t.wHour, t.wMinute, t.wSecond, n);
    j.base = nm;
    ensure_started();
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu); g_q.push_back(std::move(j)); }
    g_cv.notify_one();
}

}  // namespace

namespace loader {
void snap_photoexport_install() {
    const char *e = snapdef::get("SNAP_PHOTO_EXPORT");   // unset = the shared defaults table (off in the original profile)
    if (e && (e[0] == '0' || e[0] == 'n' || e[0] == 'N' || e[0] == 'f' || e[0] == 'F')) return;
    g_log = getenv("SNAP_PHOTO_LOG") && getenv("SNAP_PHOTO_LOG")[0] != '0';
    if (const char *m = getenv("SNAP_PHOTO_MIN_W")) { int v = atoi(m); if (v > 0) g_min_w = v; }
    if (const char *d = getenv("SNAP_PHOTO_DIR")) g_dir = d;
    else if (getenv("SNAP_SAVE_DIR")) return;   // test runs (they set SNAP_SAVE_DIR) never write into the player's photo folder
    else {
        const char *a = getenv("APPDATA");
        g_dir = std::string(a ? a : ".") + "\\SnapRecomp\\photos";
    }
    add_override(kSetPixel, h_setpixel);
    add_override(kEncode, h_encode);
}
}  // namespace loader
```

`host/mods/routes.cpp`:

```cpp
// Game-state signals for scripted routes (SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT "wait" lines, runtime/hle/input_core.cpp). Project code, ours.
//
// Two inline hooks (recomp/snap_gen.py MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS) read the Lumen UI layer; the course rail, the film counter and the
// dialogue window come from hooks that already exist (host/mods/neofilm.cpp, host/mods/skips.cpp) and call the same sink.
//
//   main+0x6c1d90  rt_gm_route_ui_event     entry of the std::function operator() of the UI scene base class (ctor 0x6c1a30), which
//                                        forwards each Lumen player event to scene->vtable[2]. The player dispatch (lr main+0x782008)
//                                        reaches it for every scene seen so far (title, main_menu, map_select, photo_submit, myphoto,
//                                        option, pause_menu, ...). x1 = int* event, x2 = Player**, x3 = std::string* state,
//                                        x4 = std::string* element. Events seen (run 2-20261113_144339): 1 scene built (hidden),
//                                        2 opened (first state), 3 closed, 5 state entered, 6 state ready, 7 input on, 16 focus,
//                                        18 + 10 decide (A), 21 + 12 decide done, 22 per-frame (carries a new state the frame the
//                                        layout moves to it). The player (vtable main+0xc92020, built by 0x77cc40) holds its scene
//                                        name, the .lm/.drp base name, at +0x10.
//   main+0x79a6d0  rt_gm_route_ui_setstate  entry of Player::SetState (player vtable +0x140): x0 = player, x1 = page descriptor,
//                                        state name std::string at desc+0x18. Covers scenes outside the base class too.
//
// All hooks return at once unless a route uses "wait" lines or SNAP_ROUTE_LOG=1 (then every scene, state and event is logged).
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include "loader.h"

namespace hle::input {   // runtime/hle/input_core.cpp
bool route_on();
void route_ui(uint64_t player, const char* scene, const char* state, int event, const char* elem, uint64_t lr);
}

namespace {

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;
const uint64_t kPlayerVt = kMainBase + 0xc92020;

// libc++ std::string (short: byte 0 = size * 2, text at +1; long: byte 0 bit 0 set, size at +8, data at +0x10)
bool read_str(uint64_t s, char* out, size_t cap) {
    out[0] = 0;
    if (!s || IsBadReadPtr((void*)s, 24)) return false;
    uint8_t b0 = *(const uint8_t*)s;
    const char* p;
    size_t n;
    if (b0 & 1) {
        n = *(const uint64_t*)(s + 8);
        p = *(const char* const*)(s + 16);
        if (n > 4096 || !p || IsBadReadPtr(p, n ? n : 1)) return false;
    } else {
        n = b0 >> 1;
        p = (const char*)(s + 1);
    }
    if (n >= cap) n = cap - 1;
    memcpy(out, p, n);
    out[n] = 0;
    return true;
}

// scene name of a player, read on every call: players are freed with their scene and the allocator reuses the address for the next
// scene (a pointer-keyed cache named photo select "online_report" in run 2-20261113_144339)
void player_name(uint64_t player, char* nm, size_t cap) {
    nm[0] = 0;
    if (player && !IsBadReadPtr((void*)player, 0x30) && *(const uint64_t*)player == kPlayerVt) read_str(player + 0x10, nm, cap);
    if (!nm[0]) snprintf(nm, cap, "?");
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" void rt_gm_route_ui_event(Cpu* c) {
    if (!hle::input::route_on()) return;
    uint64_t pe = c->x[1], pp = c->x[2];
    if (!pe || !pp || IsBadReadPtr((void*)pe, 4) || IsBadReadPtr((void*)pp, 8)) return;
    int ev = *(const int*)pe;
    uint64_t player = *(const uint64_t*)pp;
    char st[64], el[64];
    read_str(c->x[3], st, sizeof st);
    el[0] = 0;
    if (ev != 22) read_str(c->x[4], el, sizeof el);
    char nm[40];
    player_name(player, nm, sizeof nm);
    hle::input::route_ui(player, nm, st, ev, el, c->x[30]);
}

extern "C" void rt_gm_route_ui_setstate(Cpu* c) {
    if (!hle::input::route_on()) return;
    uint64_t player = c->x[0], desc = c->x[1];
    char st[64];
    if (!read_str(desc + 0x18, st, sizeof st)) return;
    char nm[40];
    player_name(player, nm, sizeof nm);
    hle::input::route_ui(player, nm, st, -1, "", c->x[30]);
}
```

```ps1
# Rebuilds runtime/nvn/nvn_aa_spv.h from smaa_aa.hlsl and cas.hlsl (dxc from the Vulkan SDK in tools\vulkan_sdk) and the SMAA area/search textures
# from the reference scripts (Scripts/AreaTex.py, Scripts/SearchTex.py of github.com/iryoku/smaa, MIT). Reference files go to build\smaa_ref.
$root = Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot))
$ref = Join-Path $root 'build\smaa_ref'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $ref | Out-Null
foreach ($f in 'Scripts/AreaTex.py','Scripts/SearchTex.py','SMAA.hlsl','LICENSE.txt') {
  $leaf = Split-Path $f -Leaf
  if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $ref $leaf))) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iryoku/smaa/master/$f" -OutFile (Join-Path $ref $leaf) }
}
$py = Join-Path $root 'tools\venv-recomp\Scripts\python.exe'
Push-Location $ref
if (-not (Test-Path area_out.txt)) { & $py -I AreaTex.py | Out-File -Encoding ascii area_out.txt }
if (-not (Test-Path search_out.txt)) { & $py -I SearchTex.py | Out-File -Encoding ascii search_out.txt }
Pop-Location
& $py -I (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'gen_aa_header.py') $root
```

`host/mods/shaders/cas.hlsl`:

```hlsl
// Contrast adaptive sharpening after the AA pass. Follows the published AMD FidelityFX CAS algorithm (MIT, Copyright (c) 2019 Advanced Micro
// Devices, Inc.; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): per-pixel sharpening weight from the local min/max, 5-tap cross filter.
// Set 0 binding 0 = input color, binding 4 = point sampler. Push constants: x = 1/w, y = 1/h, z = sharpness 0..1.
[[vk::push_constant]] struct { float4 p; } g_pc;
[[vk::binding(0, 0)]] Texture2D colorTex;
[[vk::binding(4, 0)]] SamplerState PointSampler;
struct VOut { float4 pos : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };
VOut vs_cas(uint id : SV_VertexID) { VOut o; o.uv = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2); o.pos = float4(o.uv * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); return o; }
float3 ld(float2 uv, float2 d) { return colorTex.SampleLevel(PointSampler, uv + d * g_pc.p.xy, 0).rgb; }
float4 ps_cas(VOut i) : SV_Target {
  float3 a = ld(i.uv, float2(-1, -1)), b = ld(i.uv, float2(0, -1)), c = ld(i.uv, float2(1, -1));
  float3 d = ld(i.uv, float2(-1, 0)), e = ld(i.uv, float2(0, 0)), f = ld(i.uv, float2(1, 0));
  float3 g = ld(i.uv, float2(-1, 1)), h = ld(i.uv, float2(0, 1)), k = ld(i.uv, float2(1, 1));
  float3 mn = min(min(min(d, e), min(f, b)), h);
  float3 mn2 = min(min(min(mn, a), min(c, g)), k);
  mn += mn2;
  float3 mx = max(max(max(d, e), max(f, b)), h);
  float3 mx2 = max(max(max(mx, a), max(c, g)), k);
  mx += mx2;
  float3 amp = saturate(min(mn, 2.0 - mx) * rcp(max(mx, 1e-5)));
  amp = sqrt(amp);
  float peak = -rcp(lerp(8.0, 5.0, saturate(g_pc.p.z)));
  float3 w = amp * peak;
  float3 rcpW = rcp(1.0 + 4.0 * w);
  float3 outc = saturate((b * w + d * w + f * w + h * w + e) * rcpW);
  return float4(outc, 1.0);
}

```

`host/mods/shaders/gen_aa_header.py`:

```py
# Generates runtime/nvn/nvn_aa_spv.h (SPIR-V of the SMAA/CAS shaders and the SMAA lookup textures). Run via build_aa_shaders.ps1.
import os, re, subprocess, struct, sys
root = sys.argv[1]
here = os.path.join(root, 'host', 'mods', 'shaders')
ref = os.path.join(root, 'build', 'smaa_ref')
dxc = os.path.join(root, 'tools', 'vulkan_sdk', 'Bin', 'dxc.exe')
tmp = os.path.join(root, 'build', 'smaa_ref', 'spv'); os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
jobs = [('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'vs_edge', 'vs', 'smaa_vs_edge'), ('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'ps_edge', 'ps', 'smaa_ps_edge'),
        ('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'vs_weights', 'vs', 'smaa_vs_weights'), ('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'ps_weights', 'ps', 'smaa_ps_weights'),
        ('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'vs_blend', 'vs', 'smaa_vs_blend'), ('smaa_aa.hlsl', 'ps_blend', 'ps', 'smaa_ps_blend'),
        ('cas.hlsl', 'vs_cas', 'vs', 'cas_vs'), ('cas.hlsl', 'ps_cas', 'ps', 'cas_ps')]
out = ['// Generated by host/mods/shaders/gen_aa_header.py. SMAA code: Copyright (C) 2013 Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro,',
       '// Diego Gutierrez (MIT, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). CAS: AMD FidelityFX algorithm (MIT). Do not edit.', '#pragma once', '#include <cstdint>', '']
for f, entry, st, name in jobs:
    spv = os.path.join(tmp, name + '.spv')
    r = subprocess.run([dxc, '-spirv', '-fspv-target-env=vulkan1.1', '-fspv-entrypoint-name=main', '-T', st + '_6_0', '-E', entry, '-I', ref, '-Fo', spv, os.path.join(here, f)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode: print(r.stdout, r.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    b = open(spv, 'rb').read()
    w = struct.unpack('<%dI' % (len(b) // 4), b)
    out.append('static const uint32_t k_%s[%d] = {%s};' % (name, len(w), ','.join('0x%x' % x for x in w)))
def arr(path, label):
    t = open(path).read()
    t = t[t.index('{') + 1:t.rindex('}')]
    v = [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}', t)]
    return v
area = arr(os.path.join(ref, 'area_out.txt'), 'area'); search = arr(os.path.join(ref, 'search_out.txt'), 'search')
assert len(area) == 160 * 560 * 2, len(area)
assert len(search) == 64 * 16, len(search)
out.append('static const uint8_t k_smaa_area[%d] = {%s};' % (len(area), ','.join(str(x) for x in area)))
out.append('static const uint8_t k_smaa_search[%d] = {%s};' % (len(search), ','.join(str(x) for x in search)))
open(os.path.join(root, 'runtime', 'nvn', 'nvn_aa_spv.h'), 'w').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
print('wrote nvn_aa_spv.h', len(area), len(search))
```

`host/mods/shaders/look.frag`:

```frag
#version 450
layout(set=0,binding=0) uniform sampler2D tex;
layout(push_constant) uniform P { vec4 gain; vec4 p; } pc;   // gain.rgb; p = saturation, contrast, intensity, srgb flag
layout(location=0) in vec2 uv;
layout(location=0) out vec4 o;
void main(){
  vec3 c = texture(tex, uv).rgb;
  vec3 g = (pc.p.w > 0.5) ? pow(c, vec3(1.0/2.2)) : c;
  g *= pc.gain.rgb;
  float l = dot(g, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
  g = mix(vec3(l), g, pc.p.x);
  g = (g - 0.5) * pc.p.y + 0.5;
  g = clamp(g, 0.0, 1.0);
  if (pc.p.w > 0.5) g = pow(g, vec3(2.2));
  o = vec4(mix(c, g, pc.p.z), 1.0);
}
```
