`host/mods/shaders/smaa_aa.hlsl`:

```hlsl
// SMAA 1x passes for runtime/nvn/nvn_aa.cpp. Wrapper around the reference SMAA.hlsl (Jimenez et al., MIT; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md),
// which this build reads from build/smaa_ref/SMAA.hlsl (fetched by host/mods/shaders/build_aa_shaders.ps1; not stored in the repo).
// Descriptor set 0: 0 colorTex, 1 second input (edges or blend weights), 2 areaTex, 3 searchTex, 4 linear sampler, 5 point sampler.
// Push constants: rt = (1/w, 1/h, w, h).
#define SMAA_CUSTOM_SL
#define SMAA_PRESET_HIGH
[[vk::push_constant]] struct { float4 rt; } g_pc;
#define SMAA_RT_METRICS g_pc.rt
[[vk::binding(4, 0)]] SamplerState LinearSampler;
[[vk::binding(5, 0)]] SamplerState PointSampler;
#define SMAATexture2D(tex) Texture2D tex
#define SMAATexturePass2D(tex) tex
#define SMAASampleLevelZero(tex, coord) tex.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, coord, 0)
#define SMAASampleLevelZeroPoint(tex, coord) tex.SampleLevel(PointSampler, coord, 0)
#define SMAASampleLevelZeroOffset(tex, coord, offset) tex.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, coord, 0, offset)
#define SMAASample(tex, coord) tex.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, coord, 0)
#define SMAASamplePoint(tex, coord) tex.SampleLevel(PointSampler, coord, 0)
#define SMAASampleOffset(tex, coord, offset) tex.SampleLevel(LinearSampler, coord, 0, offset)
#define SMAA_FLATTEN [flatten]
#define SMAA_BRANCH [branch]
#include "SMAA.hlsl"

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]] Texture2D colorTex;
[[vk::binding(1, 0)]] Texture2D secondTex;
[[vk::binding(2, 0)]] Texture2D areaTex;
[[vk::binding(3, 0)]] Texture2D searchTex;

struct VOut { float4 pos : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; float4 o0 : TEXCOORD1; float4 o1 : TEXCOORD2; float4 o2 : TEXCOORD3; float2 pix : TEXCOORD4; };

VOut vs_common(uint id) {
  VOut o;
  o.uv = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2);
  o.pos = float4(o.uv * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  o.o0 = o.o1 = o.o2 = 0; o.pix = 0;
  return o;
}
VOut vs_edge(uint id : SV_VertexID) { VOut o = vs_common(id); float4 off[3]; SMAAEdgeDetectionVS(o.uv, off); o.o0 = off[0]; o.o1 = off[1]; o.o2 = off[2]; return o; }
VOut vs_weights(uint id : SV_VertexID) { VOut o = vs_common(id); float4 off[3]; SMAABlendingWeightCalculationVS(o.uv, o.pix, off); o.o0 = off[0]; o.o1 = off[1]; o.o2 = off[2]; return o; }
VOut vs_blend(uint id : SV_VertexID) { VOut o = vs_common(id); float4 off; SMAANeighborhoodBlendingVS(o.uv, off); o.o0 = off; return o; }

float2 ps_edge(VOut i) : SV_Target { float4 off[3] = { i.o0, i.o1, i.o2 }; return SMAALumaEdgeDetectionPS(i.uv, off, colorTex); }
float4 ps_weights(VOut i) : SV_Target { float4 off[3] = { i.o0, i.o1, i.o2 }; return SMAABlendingWeightCalculationPS(i.uv, i.pix, off, secondTex, areaTex, searchTex, float4(0, 0, 0, 0)); }
float4 ps_blend(VOut i) : SV_Target { return SMAANeighborhoodBlendingPS(i.uv, i.o0, colorTex, secondTex); }

```

`host/mods/skips.cpp`:

```cpp
// Skip cutscenes / dialogue (#18) and fast evaluation (#17): discovery recorder (project code, ours).
//
// SNAP_SKIPS_REC=<from>,<len>,<out>  records, for presents [from, from+len), every main function that is entered in few distinct
// presents (at most 40), with the presents it was entered in and x0 of the first entry. Used to find the code that handles one
// button press or one state (a function entered only on the presents around a scripted press). Off unless set.
#include <windows.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "loader.h"

using namespace loader;

extern "C" volatile int g_fnprof;
extern "C" uint64_t snap_present_count();   // host/boot.cpp
namespace hle::input { extern std::atomic<uint64_t> g_inject_buttons; extern std::atomic<int64_t> g_inject_until_ns; }   // runtime/hle/input_core.cpp

namespace {

const uint64_t kMainBase = 0x7100000000ull;
const uint64_t kMainSpan = 0xa40000ull;

bool g_rec;
// #18 dialogue fast-forward: main+0x676630 is a per-present UI predicate that the cutscene / skit dialogue window runs once per present while it
// waits for the A press (about once per 3 presents while the text is still typing). A streak of consecutive presents with a call = waiting.
const uint64_t kWaitFn = kMainBase + 0x676630;
bool g_skip_dlg, g_skip_log;
int g_skip_delay = 6;            // presents the window must have been active before the host presses A
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_last_fr{~0ull};
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_next_fire{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_fired{0};
uint64_t g_from, g_len, g_bucket = 50;
std::string g_out;
bool g_dumped;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::vector<uint16_t>> g_hist;   // function index -> entries per bucket of presents

void dump() {
    FILE* f = fopen(g_out.c_str(), "w");
    if (!f) return;
    size_t nb = (size_t)((g_len + g_bucket - 1) / g_bucket);
    for (auto& kv : g_hist) {
        uint64_t tot = 0;
        for (uint16_t v : kv.second) tot += v;
        if (tot > 20000) continue;
        fprintf(f, "0x%x", kv.first << 2);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < nb; i++) fprintf(f, "\t%u", (unsigned)kv.second[i]);
        fprintf(f, "\n");
    }
    fclose(f);
    trace("skips: recorder wrote %s (%zu functions seen, bucket %llu presents)", g_out.c_str(), g_hist.size(), (unsigned long long)g_bucket);
}

}  // namespace

static void skip_wait(uint64_t x0) {
    {        uint64_t fr = snap_present_count();
        uint64_t last = g_last_fr.exchange(fr);
        if (fr != last) {
            // the window is active while the predicate runs at least every ~8 presents (every present while waiting, every 3rd while the text types)
            if (last == ~0ull || fr - last > 8) g_next_fire = fr + (uint64_t)g_skip_delay;
            if (fr >= g_next_fire) {   // press A for about 3 presents: finishes the typing, or moves to the next line; again every 12 presents
                using namespace hle::input;
                g_next_fire = fr + 12;
                g_inject_buttons = 1ull << 0;
                g_inject_until_ns = std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count() + 100000000ll;
                uint64_t n = ++g_fired;
                if (g_skip_log && n <= 400) {
                    uint64_t v0 = 0, o1 = 0, v1 = 0;
                    if (x0 && !IsBadReadPtr((void*)x0, 16)) { v0 = *(uint64_t*)x0; o1 = *(uint64_t*)(x0 + 8); if (o1 && !IsBadReadPtr((void*)o1, 8)) v1 = *(uint64_t*)o1; }
                    trace("skips: dialogue window active at present %llu (object %#llx vtable main+%#llx, [+8] %#llx vtable main+%#llx): A", (unsigned long long)fr,
                          (unsigned long long)x0, (unsigned long long)(v0 - kMainBase), (unsigned long long)o1, (unsigned long long)(v1 - kMainBase));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Inline hook (recomp/snap_gen.py MAIN_INLINE_HOOKS, before the first instruction of main+0x676630): x0 = the dialogue window object.
namespace hle::input { void route_dialog(); }   // runtime/hle/input_core.cpp (route "wait dialog")

extern "C" void rt_gm_skip_wait(Cpu* c) {
    hle::input::route_dialog();
    if (g_skip_dlg) skip_wait(c->x[0]);
}

extern "C" void snap_skips_observe(uint64_t a, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) {
    (void)lr;
    (void)x0;
    if (!g_rec) return;
    uint64_t fr = snap_present_count();
    if (fr < g_from) return;
    static std::mutex mu;   // lifted code runs on several guest threads
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mu);
    if (fr >= g_from + g_len) {
        if (!g_dumped) { g_dumped = true; dump(); }
        return;
    }
    uint64_t off = a - kMainBase;
    if (off >= kMainSpan) return;
    auto& v = g_hist[(uint32_t)(off >> 2)];
    size_t nb = (size_t)((g_len + g_bucket - 1) / g_bucket);
    if (v.empty()) v.assign(nb, 0);
    uint16_t& c = v[(size_t)((fr - g_from) / g_bucket)];
    if (c < 0xffff) c++;
}

namespace loader {
void snap_skips_install() {
    const char* sc = getenv("SNAP_SKIP_CUTSCENES");
    if (sc && *sc && *sc != '0') {
        g_skip_dlg = true;   // needs no function profile: the inline hook rt_gm_skip_wait does the watching
        g_skip_log = getenv("SNAP_SKIPS_LOG") && *getenv("SNAP_SKIPS_LOG") != '0';
        if (const char* d = getenv("SNAP_SKIP_DELAY")) { int v = atoi(d); if (v >= 2 && v <= 600) g_skip_delay = v; }
    }
    const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SKIPS_REC");
    if (e && *e) {
        char out[260] = "analysis/mods/skips_rec.tsv";
        unsigned long long from = 0, len = 0;
        const char* c1 = strchr(e, ',');
        if (c1) {
            from = strtoull(e, nullptr, 0);
            len = strtoull(c1 + 1, nullptr, 0);
            const char* c2 = strchr(c1 + 1, ',');
            if (c2) { snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s", c2 + 1); if (char* c3 = strchr(out, ',')) *c3 = 0; }
        }
        if (len) {
            g_from = from;
            g_len = len;
            g_out = out;
            if (const char* c2 = strchr(strchr(e, ',') + 1, ',')) {
                const char* c3 = strchr(c2 + 1, ',');
                if (c3) g_bucket = strtoull(c3 + 1, nullptr, 0);
                if (g_bucket < 1) g_bucket = 50;
            }
            g_rec = true;
            g_fnprof = 1;
        }
    }
}
}  // namespace loader

```

`host/pgo.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// PGO training support (host/build_snap.py --pgo-gen). Only built into instrumented exes (SNAP_PGO_GEN); empty otherwise.
// A run killed by PID never reaches the profile runtime's exit-time write, so this thread writes the counters every
// SNAP_PGO_DUMP_S seconds (default 15) to LLVM_PROFILE_FILE (default "default.profraw" in the working directory). On Windows
// each write APPENDS a profile to the file (found 2026-11-13: llvm-profdata merge summed about 20 cumulative copies, so boot
// counted 20 times and the end of the run once), so the counters are reset after each write: the appended pieces are then
// disjoint time slices and their merge is the true total. See host/README.md "PGO and ThinLTO".
#ifdef SNAP_PGO_GEN
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

extern "C" int __llvm_profile_write_file(void);
extern "C" void __llvm_profile_reset_counters(void);

static DWORD WINAPI pgo_dump_thread(void *) {
    const char *e = getenv("SNAP_PGO_DUMP_S");
    int s = e ? atoi(e) : 15;
    if (s < 1) s = 15;
    for (;;) {
        Sleep((DWORD)s * 1000);
        int rc = __llvm_profile_write_file();
        if (rc) { fprintf(stderr, "pgo: profile write failed (%d)\n", rc); fflush(stderr); }
        else __llvm_profile_reset_counters();
    }
    return 0;
}

static int g_pgo_started = [] {
    HANDLE h = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, pgo_dump_thread, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    if (h) CloseHandle(h);
    return 1;
}();
#endif

```

`host/play.ps1`:

```ps1
# Plays the game from a private copy of the build, so workers can keep building and test-booting meanwhile.
#   powershell -File host\play.ps1              play
#   powershell -File host\play.ps1 -SkipIntro   also feed scripted input through loading, name entry and the lab intro (host\skip_intro.txt);
#                                               real input stays active, so you can take over at any time
#   powershell -File host\play.ps1 -Profile "Photo run"   start with that save profile (created if new); -PickProfile always shows the profile picker
#   powershell -File host\play.ps1 -ListPads    print every game controller the game sees and show live pad input for 15 s, then exit
#   powershell -File host\play.ps1 -NoNativeOptions   do not (re)build the native-options pack (PC tabs in the game's Settings screen)
# Steps: take build\heavy.lock only while build\snap\snap_boot.exe (and SDL3.dll, the PDB and nvn_cache) are copied to build\play\, release it,
# create build\play.lock (PID; workers must not start boot runs while it exists), run the copy at normal priority with no timeout and
# Vulkan validation off, and delete play.lock on exit, crash or Ctrl+C. The save is %APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\save (SNAP_SAVE_DIR overrides);
# test runs (host\run_boot.ps1) use build\testsave instead. Logs: analysis\boot\play_stderr.log, play_stdout.log (device list), play_trace.log.
[CmdletBinding(PositionalBinding=$false)]
param([switch]$SkipIntro, [switch]$ListPads, [int]$PadSeconds = 15, [string]$Name = 'player', [int]$LockWaitMinutes = 60,
       [string]$Profile, [switch]$PickProfile, [switch]$NoNativeOptions)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
Set-Location $root
$src = 'build\snap'
if (-not (Test-Path "$src\snap_boot.exe")) { throw "$src\snap_boot.exe not found: run tools\venv-recomp\Scripts\python -I host\build_snap.py first" }

if ($ListPads) {
    $exe = if (Test-Path 'build\play\snap_boot.exe') { 'build\play\snap_boot.exe' } else { "$src\snap_boot.exe" }
    & $exe pads $PadSeconds
    return
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'build', 'build\play', 'analysis\boot' | Out-Null
$heavy = 'build\heavy.lock'
$playLock = 'build\play.lock'

function Take-Lock([string]$path, [string]$text, [int]$waitMinutes, [int]$staleMinutes) {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($waitMinutes)
    while ($true) {
        try {
            New-Item -ItemType File $path -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
            $text | Set-Content $path
            return
        } catch {
            if ((Test-Path $path) -and ((Get-Date) - (Get-Item $path).LastWriteTime).TotalMinutes -gt $staleMinutes) { Remove-Item $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; continue }
            if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw "gave up waiting for $path" }
            Write-Host "waiting for $path ($((Get-Content $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join ' '))..."
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
        }
    }
}

# one game at a time; a play.lock whose PID is gone is stale
if (Test-Path $playLock) {
    $old = ((Get-Content $playLock -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join ' ')
    $oldPid = if ($old -match 'pid=(\d+)') { [int]$Matches[1] } else { 0 }
    if ($oldPid -and (Get-Process -Id $oldPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "the game is already running ($old)" }
    Remove-Item $playLock -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

# 1. copy under heavy.lock (no build or test boot can run, and snap_boot.exe cannot change under us)
Take-Lock $heavy "$Name pid=$PID $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') (play.ps1 copy)" $LockWaitMinutes 20
try {
    foreach ($f in 'snap_boot.exe', 'SDL3.dll', 'snap_boot.pdb') { if (Test-Path "$src\$f") { Copy-Item "$src\$f" "build\play\$f" -Force } }
    if (Test-Path "$src\nvn_cache") { robocopy "$src\nvn_cache" 'build\play\nvn_cache' /E /MT:8 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null }   # exit codes below 8 are success
} finally {
    Remove-Item $heavy -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

# 1b. the "native-options" mod pack (PC tabs in the game's own Settings screen) is built from the user's own extracted
# option.lmb into the mods folder (%APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\mods, or SNAP_MODS_DIR) when missing or older than its generator;
# nothing game-derived is in the repo. A failure only means no PC tabs: the game and the F1 menu still work.
if (-not $NoNativeOptions) {
    $py = 'tools\venv-recomp\Scripts\python.exe'
    $lmb = 'extracted\drp-v262144\common\UI\master\Scenes\option.drp\option.lmb'
    if ((Test-Path $py) -and (Test-Path $lmb)) {
        $genArgs = @('-I', 'scripts\ui\make_native_options.py', '--if-stale')
        if ($env:SNAP_MODS_DIR) { $genArgs += @('--out', $env:SNAP_MODS_DIR) }
        & $py @genArgs
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host "native-options pack not built (exit $LASTEXITCODE): PC tabs off, the F1 menu still works" }
    } else { Write-Host "native-options pack skipped: $lmb or $py missing" }
}

# 2. run the copy under play.lock
Take-Lock $playLock "$Name pid=$PID $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') (play.ps1)" 1 1000000
$p = $null
try {
    Remove-Item Env:NVN_VK_VALIDATION -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item Env:SNAP_PLAY_ROOT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item Env:SNAP_PLAY_ROOT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item Env:SNAP_INPUT_BACKGROUND -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($Profile) { $env:SNAP_PROFILE = $Profile } else { Remove-Item Env:SNAP_PROFILE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    if ($PickProfile) { $env:SNAP_PROFILE_PICKER = '1' } else { Remove-Item Env:SNAP_PROFILE_PICKER -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    if ($SkipIntro) { $env:SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT = (Resolve-Path 'host\skip_intro.txt').Path } else { Remove-Item Env:SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'build\play\snap_boot.exe' -ArgumentList @('run', '--trace', 'analysis\boot\play_trace.log') -NoNewWindow -PassThru `
        -RedirectStandardError 'analysis\boot\play_stderr.log' -RedirectStandardOutput 'analysis\boot\play_stdout.log'
    try { $p.PriorityClass = 'Normal' } catch {}
    Write-Host "game started (pid $($p.Id)); close its window to quit. Click the window once so it has focus."
    if ($SkipIntro) { Write-Host "-SkipIntro: scripted input runs through the lab cutscene (about 3 to 4 minutes), then presses nothing: you take over at the tutorial panels and photo selection. Real input works at any time." }
    $env:SNAP_PLAY_ROOT = "$root"   # tells the game it was started here: "Restart now" / "Switch profile" in the F1 menu relaunch it (same exe, arguments, working directory, environment) and write the new pid to build\play.restart
    $restartFile = Join-Path $root 'build\play.restart'
    Remove-Item $restartFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    while ($true) {
        $p.WaitForExit()
        Write-Host "game exited with code $($p.ExitCode)"
        $np = 0
        if (Test-Path $restartFile) {
            try { $np = [int](Get-Content $restartFile -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1) } catch {}
            Remove-Item $restartFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        if ($np -le 0) { break }
        $p = Get-Process -Id $np -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (-not $p) { break }
        Write-Host "game restarted (pid $np)"
    }
} finally {
    if ($p -and -not $p.HasExited) { taskkill /PID $p.Id /T /F | Out-Null }
    Remove-Item $playLock -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

```

`host/render_camera_icon.py`:

```py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Renders the owner's local copy of the game's Research Camera model into icon source PNGs, then copies them to build/icon_src/.
# Code only: no game data lives in this file. Inputs are read from ignored local folders.
#   python -I host/render_camera_icon.py render   # needs Blender; reads analysis/ui/camera_render/ (mesh dump + decoded textures)
#   python -E -P host/render_camera_icon.py size <out_dir> <r1|r2|r3> <px> [<px> ...]  # used by make_icon.py (needs Pillow)
#   python -I host/render_camera_icon.py install  # copies camera_r1/r2/r3.png into build/icon_src/ for SNAP_ICON_STYLE=r1|r2|r3
import sys, shutil, subprocess, os
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'analysis' / 'ui' / 'camera_render'
DST = ROOT / 'build' / 'icon_src'
BLENDER = [Path(p) for p in (os.environ.get('BLENDER_EXE', ''), r'C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 5.2\blender.exe',
                             r'C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender 5.1\blender.exe') if p]
SCENE = Path(__file__).with_name('camera_scene_blender.py')


def install():
    DST.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    if (OUT / 'r1p').is_dir():
        shutil.copytree(OUT / 'r1p', DST / 'camera_r1p', dirs_exist_ok=True); n += 1
    for k in ('r1', 'r2', 'r3'):
        s = OUT / f'camera_{k}.png'
        if s.exists():
            shutil.copyfile(s, DST / f'camera_{k}.png'); n += 1
    print('installed', n, 'render(s) into', DST)
    return 0 if n else 3


def render():
    exe = next((b for b in BLENDER if b.exists()), None)
    if not exe:
        print('Blender not found'); return 3
    cmd = ['cmd', '/c', 'start', '/wait', '/belownormal', '/b', str(exe), '--background', '--python', str(SCENE), '--', str(OUT)]
    return subprocess.call(cmd)


def size_r1p(out, sizes):
    """r1p: each size was rendered natively at 4-8x supersampling (camera_scene_blender.py, CAM_SIZES); box-reduce, sharpen per size,
    add a soft anti-aliased shadow plus faint light halo (reads on light and dark taskbars)."""
    from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageChops
    import io
    d = out / 'icon_src' / 'camera_r1p'
    (out / 'icon_src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for n in sizes:
        src = Image.open(d / f'render_{n}.png').convert('RGBA')
        ss = src.width // n
        im = src.convert('RGBa').reduce(ss).convert('RGBA')
        pct = 90 if n <= 24 else 70 if n <= 40 else 50 if n <= 72 else 35
        rad = 0.55 if n <= 40 else 0.7 if n <= 72 else 1.0
        rgb = im.convert('RGB').filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=rad, percent=pct, threshold=0))
        im = Image.merge('RGBA', (*rgb.split(), im.getchannel('A')))
        a = im.getchannel('A')
        sg = 0.5 + n / 70.0
        off = max(0.6, n / 56.0)
        sh = ImageChops.offset(a, 0, round(off)).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(sg)).point(lambda v: int(v * 0.55))
        halo = a.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(sg * 1.5)).point(lambda v: int(v * 0.3))
        out_im = Image.new('RGBA', (n, n), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        hl = Image.new('RGBA', (n, n), (255, 255, 255, 255)); hl.putalpha(halo); out_im.alpha_composite(hl)
        sd = Image.new('RGBA', (n, n), (10, 14, 26, 255)); sd.putalpha(sh); out_im.alpha_composite(sd)
        out_im.alpha_composite(im)
        b = io.BytesIO(); out_im.save(b, 'PNG')
        (out / 'icon_src' / f'small_r1p_{n}.png').write_bytes(b.getvalue())
    return 0


def size_icons(out, style, sizes):
    """Downscale build/icon_src/camera_<style>.png to each size: tight crop, Lanczos reduction, 1 px dark keyline at 32 px and below."""
    from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageChops
    import io
    src = Image.open(out / 'icon_src' / f'camera_{style}.png').convert('RGBA')
    box = src.getchannel('A').point(lambda v: 255 if v > 8 else 0).getbbox()
    src = src.crop(box)
    for n in sizes:
        small = n <= 32
        pad = 0.04 if small else 0.07
        w, h = src.size
        side = max(w, h) * (1 + 2 * pad)
        sq = Image.new('RGBA', (round(side), round(side)), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        sq.alpha_composite(src, ((sq.width - w) // 2, (sq.height - h) // 2))
        im = sq.convert('RGBa').resize((n, n), Image.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA')   # premultiplied reduce: no dark fringes
        if small:
            a = im.getchannel('A')
            grow = a.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3))
            line = Image.new('RGBA', (n, n), (0x12, 0x16, 0x20, 255)); line.putalpha(ImageChops.subtract(grow, a).point(lambda v: min(255, v * 2)))
            ring = Image.new('RGBA', (n, n), (0, 0, 0, 0)); ring.alpha_composite(line); ring.alpha_composite(im); im = ring
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, 'PNG')
        (out / 'icon_src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (out / 'icon_src' / f'small_{style}_{n}.png').write_bytes(b.getvalue())
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) > 4 and sys.argv[1] == 'size' and sys.argv[3] == 'r1p':
        sys.exit(size_r1p(Path(sys.argv[2]), [int(x) for x in sys.argv[4:]]))
    if len(sys.argv) > 4 and sys.argv[1] == 'size':
        sys.exit(size_icons(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], [int(x) for x in sys.argv[4:]]))
    a = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'install'
    sys.exit(render() if a == 'render' else install())

```

```txt
# Core sweep route (generated by analysis/core/mk_routes.py): Florio Nature Park entry 1 (Day).
```

`host/routes/core_template.txt`:

```txt
# fixture: unlock_all
# Template for the course sweep (core_<course>.txt), driven by game state (host\README.md "Waiting on game state").
# Copy it, then fill in the two marked blocks: the Lental Map D-pad path to the course marker and the Down taps for the entry
# (Day / Night / ...); see analysis\core\mk_routes.py for each course's path and entry.
# Run: $env:SNAP_NEO_SPEED=3; powershell -File host\run_boot.ps1 -Route core_<course> -Timeout 590 -ShotAt 110 -ShotEvery 6 -ShotMax 80
# 1) Title, lab hub, reward cards: A taps until the map shows its course markers.
wait ui=title timeout=150
repeat @f60 @f30000 40 4 A
wait ui=map_select:StageSelect timeout=200
# 2) >>> D-pad path to the course marker, one press per 180 presents (none for Florio, where the cursor starts), e.g.:
# @f90 6 Right
# @f270 6 Down
# then A opens the course panel; the @f of this A is 90 after the last path press.
@f90 6 A
wait ui=map_select:CourseSelect timeout=30
# 3) >>> one Down per extra entry (entry 0 = none), 90 presents apart, then A starts the course; e.g. entry 1:
# @f90 6 Down
@f180 6 A
wait ride timeout=240
# 4) The ride: shutter taps with a slow yaw wobble. The same A taps then advance the course-end and professor lines.
repeat @f0 @f60000 24 4 A
repeat @f0 @f60000 400 60 rx=0.25
repeat @f200 @f60000 400 60 rx=-0.25
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=420
# 5) Photo select (as florio_eval): Right, A opens the folder, A picks the shown photo; twice. Then Plus, Up (Yes), A.
@f150 8 Right
@f230 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
# (run 1-20261113_160836 timed out on a refused Pichu photo).
repeat @f60 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f180 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f240 @f1440 240 8 Right
@f1500 8 B
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=90
@f60 8 Right
@f140 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
# (run 1-20261113_160836 timed out on a refused Pichu photo).
repeat @f60 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f180 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f240 @f1440 240 8 Right
@f1500 8 B
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=90
@f60 8 Plus
@f140 8 Up
@f220 8 A
wait ui=evaluation timeout=60
# 6) Evaluation: A taps through the comments and the score; the run ends after the evaluation closes.
repeat @f240 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=evaluation:Score timeout=120
repeat @f60 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=evaluation:End timeout=240
end @f300

```

`host/routes/florio_eval.txt`:

```txt
# fixture: post_tutorial
# Florio photo run to the professor's score, driven by game state ("wait" lines, host\README.md "Waiting on game state";
# 2026-11-13, replaces the present-timed version that missed photo select in 3 of 4 runs).
# Run: powershell -File host\run_boot.ps1 -Route florio_eval -Timeout 590 -ShotAt 280 -ShotEvery 6 -ShotMax 60
# Pass: boot_stderr.log has "wait 'ui=evaluation:Score' met" (a photo was scored) and "end of route reached" (exit code 0).
# 1) Slow A taps: title, lab hub "Research", Lental Map (Florio is the only open course), course start.
repeat @f300 @f30000 120 8 A
wait ui=map_select timeout=240
repeat @f60 @f30000 120 8 A
wait ride timeout=240
# 2) Riding: fast shutter taps with a slow right-stick yaw wobble and a ZL zoom now and then, until the 72 shots are used up
#    (the ride itself goes on to the end of the rail, progress about 116).
repeat @f0 @f30000 24 4 A
repeat @f0 @f6000 600 200 ZL
repeat @f0 @f30000 400 60 rx=0.25
repeat @f200 @f30000 400 60 rx=-0.25
wait film<=0 timeout=300
# 3) Rest of the ride, course end and the professor's lines: slow A taps until photo select shows its subject folders.
repeat @f120 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=400
# 4) Photo select. Folder 1 (Wurmple) is refused as not clearly visible, so: Right to the next folder, A opens it, A picks the
#    shown photo (the screen goes back to the folders by itself); then the same for the next folder.
@f150 8 Right
@f230 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
# (run 1-20261113_160836 timed out on a refused Pichu photo).
repeat @f60 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f180 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f240 @f1440 240 8 Right
@f1500 8 B
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=90
@f60 8 Right
@f140 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
```

`host/routes/s2_beach.txt`:

```txt
# fixture: unlock_all
# sweep2 route beach nav=R R entry=0 level=0 mode=analysis/core/aim_beach.txt (mk_routes2.py)
wait ui=title timeout=200
repeat @f60 @f30000 40 4 A
wait ui=map_select:StageSelect timeout=300
@f120 6 Right
@f300 6 Right
@f540 6 A
wait ui=map_select:CourseSelect timeout=60
@f180 6 A
wait ride timeout=300
wait ride>=42 timeout=200
@f0 50 rx=-0.5
repeat @f60 @f500 30 4 A
repeat @f500 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=500
@f150 8 Right
@f230 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
# (run 1-20261113_160836 timed out on a refused Pichu photo).
repeat @f60 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f180 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f240 @f1440 240 8 Right
@f1500 8 B
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=90
@f60 8 Right
@f140 8 A
wait ui=photo_submit:PhotoSubmit timeout=30
# A picks the shown photo (back to the folders within ~15 presents). A refused photo ("not clearly visible") keeps the folder
# open with a notice: then A again and Right to the next photo, every 240 presents, six photos; then B back to the folders
# (run 1-20261113_160836 timed out on a refused Pichu photo).
repeat @f60 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f180 @f1440 240 8 A
repeat @f240 @f1440 240 8 Right
@f1500 8 B
wait ui=photo_submit:FolderSelect timeout=90
@f60 8 Plus
@f140 8 Up
@f220 8 A
wait ui=evaluation timeout=60
# 6) Evaluation: A taps through the comments and the score; the run ends after the evaluation closes.
repeat @f240 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=evaluation:Score timeout=120
repeat @f60 @f60000 90 8 A
wait ui=evaluation:End timeout=240
end @f300
```

`host/routes/tutorial_pass.txt`:

```txt
# fixture: post_tutorial
# Capture route (frame timed, load independent): mash A through title, intro cutscene and camera tutorial (a mashed A also skips photo
# select and the evaluation) until the autosave after the tutorial. Run with -Exclusive (~9 min), then check the save with snap_save.py dump.
# Observed: tutorial starts ~present 8000. Either stick turns the camera (the pointer stays centered); the tutorial wants the pointer on Pikachu + A.
# So: a slow constant yaw drift and a fast A tap (period 8 presents), before that a slower A for the dialogue.
repeat @f1500 @f8000 50 12 A
repeat @f8000 @f60000 8 3 A
@f8100 100000 lx=-0.22
@f8100 100000 rx=-0.22
# pitch: positive ly looks DOWN, ~0.18 deg per present at 0.07. Pikachu sits ~12 degrees below the pointer, so a +-16 degree sawtooth
# (90 presents down, 90 up) sweeps the pointer across it while the yaw drift sweeps sideways; A is tapped every 8 presents.
repeat @f8100 @f60000 180 90 ly=0.07 ry=0.07
repeat @f8190 @f60000 180 90 ly=-0.07 ry=-0.07
```

`host/run_boot.ps1`:

```ps1
# Test runs are HIDDEN by default: snap_boot.exe goes through the ghost launcher (a never-shown "EmberGhost" desktop in a job object), so no
# window reaches the owner's screen. -Visible = old behavior (normal window, to watch). Launcher: $env:SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER or the default below.
# -SaveFixture <name> seeds the run's save dir from build\fixtures\saves\<name> (e.g. post_tutorial) instead of an empty save.
# -Route <name>: feeds host\routes\<name>.txt as SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT, defaults the save fixture to the route's first-line
#   '# fixture: <name>' (else <name>), and saves checkpoint screenshots (first at -ShotAt s, then every -ShotEvery s, at most -ShotMax; NVN_FRAME_DUMP).
#   -ShotAt without -Route also dumps frames, to analysis\boot\run_<id>_NN.png.
# PARALLEL RUNS (owner exception to the one-heavy-process rule): takes one of 4 run slots (build\slots\run0..3.lock, host\locks.ps1) instead of
# build\heavy.lock (that stays the BUILD lock). -Bench / -Exclusive (or SNAP_PERF set) take all 4 slots and wait for them. While build\heavy.priority
# exists, slot 0 is reserved for the run whose $env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER equals its content. -NoLock = the caller already holds a slot (scratch dir slotnl<pid>).
# Each run works in build\runs\slot<N>\ (copy of build\snap exe + DLLs + nvn_cache, own save dir, own copy of the shared shader cache), so a
# concurrent build can relink. Output carries a run id <slot>-<stamp>: analysis\boot\runs\<id>\boot_{trace,stderr,stdout}.log and
# route_<name>_<id>_NN.png / run_<id>_NN.png; the legacy names (boot_trace.log, route_<name>_NN.png) get a copy of the latest finished run.
# An explicit -Log keeps the old behavior (that path, stderr/stdout beside it). Runs the exe copy at BelowNormal priority with a hard timeout; kills it by PID if it hangs.
#   powershell -File host\run_boot.ps1 [-Route florio_photos] [-Timeout 300] [-Log analysis\boot\boot_trace.log] <snap_boot args...>   (default args: run)
[CmdletBinding(PositionalBinding=$false)]
param([int]$Timeout = 300, [switch]$KeepSave, [string]$SaveFixture, [switch]$Visible, [string]$Route, [string]$Bench, [int]$ShotAt = 20, [int]$ShotEvery = 30, [int]$ShotMax = 8, [switch]$NoLock, [switch]$Exclusive, [string]$BuildDir, [string]$Log ='analysis\boot\boot_trace.log', [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments = $true)][string[]]$Rest)
$root = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
Set-Location $root
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'locks.ps1')
$logGiven = $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Log')
# a game is being played from build\play (host\play.ps1): do not start a test boot meanwhile
if (Test-Path 'build\play.lock') {
    $pl = (Get-Content 'build\play.lock' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join ' '
    if ($pl -match 'pid=(\d+)' -and (Get-Process -Id ([int]$Matches[1]) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host "play.lock held ($pl): not starting a boot run"; exit 3 }
}
# -Bench <route>: the same route with no screenshots or frame dumps and SNAP_PERF on; afterwards writes analysis\perf\bench_<route>_<stamp>.md
# and .csv (avg fps, 1% / 0.1% low, max, percentiles, per-scene split from '# scene: <name> <start_s> <end_s>' lines in the route file,
# git hash + dirty flag, shader cache cold/warm). Run it twice for a repeatability figure. Always exclusive.
$benchStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $benchPrefix = $null
if ($Bench) { $Route = $Bench; $benchPrefix = Join-Path $root "analysis\perf\bench_${Bench}_$benchStamp" }
if ($Route) {
    $rf = Join-Path $root "host\routes\$Route.txt"
    if (-not (Test-Path $rf)) { Write-Host "no route file $rf"; exit 5 }
    $env:SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT = $rf
    if (-not $SaveFixture) {
        $m = Select-String -Path $rf -Pattern '^#\s*fixture:\s*(\S+)' | Select-Object -First 1
        $SaveFixture = if ($m) { $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { $Route }
    }
}
$dumpOn = (-not $Bench) -and ($Route -or $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('ShotAt'))

# ---- slot: one of 6 concurrent run slots (all 6 for -Bench / -Exclusive / perf)
$excl = [bool]($Bench -or $Exclusive -or $env:SNAP_PERF)
$what = "run_boot $(if ($Route) { "route=$Route" } else { 'run' })$(if ($Bench) { ' bench' })"
$slots = @()
if ($NoLock) { $slotName = "slotnl$PID"; $sid = 'nl' }
else {
    $slots = Enter-RunSlots $what -Exclusive:$excl
    if ($null -eq $slots) { Write-Host 'could not get a run slot'; exit 6 }
    $slotName = "slot$($slots[0])"; $sid = "$($slots[0])"
}
$runId = "$sid-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"
Write-Host "run $runId on $slotName$(if ($excl) { ' (exclusive)' })"
$p = $null; $cacheBefore = $null
$bootDir = Join-Path $root 'analysis\boot'; $shotBase = $null; $err = $null; $so = $null
try {
    $runDir = Join-Path $root "build\runs\$slotName"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $runDir | Out-Null
    # output locations
    if ($logGiven) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $Log) | Out-Null }
    else { $runOut = Join-Path $bootDir "runs\$runId"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $runOut | Out-Null; $Log = Join-Path $runOut 'boot_trace.log' }
    $err = Join-Path (Split-Path $Log) 'boot_stderr.log'; $so = Join-Path (Split-Path $Log) 'boot_stdout.log'
    $shotBase = if ($Route) { Join-Path $bootDir "route_${Route}_$runId" } else { Join-Path $bootDir "run_$runId" }
    if ($Bench) { $env:SNAP_PERF = $benchPrefix }
    elseif ($dumpOn) {
        # NVN_FRAME_DUMP works on the hidden desktop (the desktop capture SNAP_SHOT only sees black there); half-size BMPs
        $rawDir = "${shotBase}_raw"
        if (Test-Path $rawDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $rawDir }
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $rawDir | Out-Null
        $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP = $rawDir; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM = [string]$ShotAt; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY = [string]$ShotEvery; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_MAX = [string]$ShotMax
    }
    # isolated copy of the exe + DLLs + nvn shader cache (a build may relink build\snap meanwhile); retry if the source changes mid-copy
    # -BuildDir <dir> (or $env:SNAP_BUILD_DIR): run a worker's own build (host\build_snap.py --out <dir>) instead of build\snap
    $bd = if ($BuildDir) { $BuildDir } elseif ($env:SNAP_BUILD_DIR) { $env:SNAP_BUILD_DIR } else { 'build\snap' }
    $src = if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($bd)) { $bd } else { Join-Path $root $bd }; $ok = $false
    for ($try = 0; $try -lt 15 -and -not $ok; $try++) {
        $ok = $true
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem $src -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'snap_boot.exe', 'snap_boot.pdb' -or $_.Extension -eq '.dll' })) {
            try { Copy-Item $f.FullName (Join-Path $runDir $f.Name) -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $ok = $false; break }
            if ((Get-Item (Join-Path $runDir $f.Name)).Length -ne (Get-Item $f.FullName).Length) { $ok = $false; break }
        }
        if (-not $ok) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
    }
    if (-not $ok) { Write-Host 'could not copy a stable build\snap exe'; exit 7 }
    $warm = Join-Path $root 'build\snap\nvn_cache'   # own build dir without a warm translated-shader cache: use the main one
    if (-not (Test-Path "$src\nvn_cache") -and (Test-Path $warm)) { robocopy $warm "$runDir\nvn_cache" /MIR /MT:16 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null }
    if (Test-Path "$src\nvn_cache") { robocopy "$src\nvn_cache" "$runDir\nvn_cache" /MIR /MT:16 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null }
    # SNAP_XLATE_REV=<n> (translator revision, runtime\nvn\nvn_shader.cpp): the run reads nvn_cache_r<n>, seeded from build\xlate\r<n>\out (scripts\xlate_run.ps1)
    if ($env:SNAP_XLATE_REV -and $env:SNAP_XLATE_REV -ne '0') {
        $xr = Join-Path $root "build\xlate\r$($env:SNAP_XLATE_REV)\out"
        if (Test-Path $xr) { robocopy $xr "$runDir\nvn_cache_r$($env:SNAP_XLATE_REV)" /MIR /XF *.tsv /MT:16 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null }
    }
    # per-slot pipeline cache seeded from the shared one (no concurrent writes to %APPDATA%); SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR in the caller's env is the seed if set
    $seed = if ($env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR) { $env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR } elseif ($env:SNAP_CONFIG_DIR) { Join-Path $env:SNAP_CONFIG_DIR 'shadercache' } else { Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'SnapRecomp\shadercache' }
    $scd = Join-Path $runDir 'shadercache'
    if ($Bench) {
        $cf = Get-ChildItem $seed -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        $cacheBefore = if ($cf) { "warm ($(@($cf).Count) files, $([math]::Round((($cf | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB, 1)) MB in $seed)" } else { "cold (empty or missing $seed)" }
    }
    if (Test-Path $seed) { robocopy $seed $scd /MIR /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $scd | Out-Null }
    $env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR = $scd
    # Test runs never touch the player's save (%APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\save): per-slot build\runs\slot<N>\save, wiped per run unless -KeepSave.
    $testSave = Join-Path $runDir 'save'
    if (-not $KeepSave -and (Test-Path $testSave)) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $testSave -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $testSave | Out-Null
    if ($SaveFixture) {
        $fx = Join-Path $root "build\fixtures\saves\$SaveFixture"
        if (-not (Test-Path $fx)) { Write-Host "no save fixture $fx"; exit 4 }
        if ($KeepSave) { Write-Host "-SaveFixture with -KeepSave: not re-seeding $testSave" } else { Copy-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $fx '*') $testSave }
    }
    if (-not $env:SNAP_SAVE_DIR) { $env:SNAP_SAVE_DIR = $testSave }
    # test runs load no mods unless asked (2026-11-12: the owner's HD packs in %APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\mods made hidden-run loading ~15x slower);
    # to test a pack set SNAP_MODS_DIR to its folder (or to "$env:APPDATA\SnapRecomp\mods" for the owner's set)
    if (-not $env:SNAP_MODS_DIR) { $noMods = Join-Path $runDir 'mods_none'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $noMods | Out-Null; $env:SNAP_MODS_DIR = $noMods }
    if (-not $Rest) { $Rest = @('run') }
    $argl = @($Rest) + @('--trace', $Log, '--timeout', [string]($Timeout - 5))
    $exe = Join-Path $runDir 'snap_boot.exe'
    # the exe maps a fixed address (0x7300000000); on a busy PC that sometimes collides at start-up ('cannot map the thunk range'): retry, up to 3 starts
    $t0 = Get-Date
    for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) {
        if ($Visible) {
            $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $argl -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $err -RedirectStandardOutput $so
        } else {
            $gl = if ($env:SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER) { $env:SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.claude\skills\ghost-godot\ghost_launch.py' }
            if (-not (Test-Path $gl)) { Write-Host "ghost launcher not found ($gl); set SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER or use -Visible"; exit 97 }
            # the hidden desktop has no foreground window: the game must not gate (scripted) input on focus
            # ...and must not pause itself on focus loss (a hidden run once paused at 241 s)
            $env:SNAP_INPUT_BACKGROUND = '1'; $env:SNAP_HEADLESS = '1'; $env:SNAP_WINDOW_PAUSE = '0'
            # muted by default (owner, 2026-11-12): the timer-paced null audio backend keeps the game's audio timing and SNAP_AUDIO_CAPTURE, but nothing reaches the speakers; set SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND=wasapi to hear it
            if (-not $env:SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND) { $env:SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND = 'null' }
            $gargs = @('-I', $gl, $exe) + @($argl)
            $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'python' -ArgumentList $gargs -NoNewWindow -PassThru -RedirectStandardError $err -RedirectStandardOutput $so
        }
        try { $p.PriorityClass = 'BelowNormal' } catch {}
        $left = [int]($Timeout - ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds)
        if (-not $p.WaitForExit([math]::Max(1, $left) * 1000)) { taskkill /PID $p.Id /T /F | Out-Null; Write-Host "killed pid $($p.Id) after $Timeout s"; break }
        if (((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds -lt 30 -and (Select-String -Path $err -Pattern 'cannot map the thunk range' -Quiet)) { Write-Host "start-up address clash, retrying ($attempt)"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; continue }
        break
    }
    Write-Host "exit code $($p.ExitCode); run $runId; stderr in $err, trace in $Log"
    # keep the run's save before the slot is released (2026-11-12: the next run in this slot wiped it before a worker could copy it)
    if ((Test-Path $testSave) -and (Get-ChildItem $testSave -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1)) {
        $keep = Join-Path $root "build\runs\saves\$runId"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $keep | Out-Null
        Copy-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $testSave '*') $keep -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "save kept in $keep"
        # owner 2026-11-12: these copies filled F: (195 runs x ~3.7 GB = 721 GB). Keep only the generation CURRENT names, and only the newest 20 runs.
        Get-ChildItem $keep -Recurse -Filter CURRENT -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
            $lines = @(Get-Content $_.FullName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)   # "SNAPSAVE1", current generation, checksum
            $gen = if ($lines.Count -ge 2 -and $lines[0] -eq 'SNAPSAVE1') { $lines[1].Trim() } else { '' }
            $gens = Join-Path $_.DirectoryName 'gens'
            if ($gen -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $gens $gen))) {
                Get-ChildItem $gens -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne $gen } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            }
        }
        Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'build\runs\saves') -Directory | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -Skip 20 |
            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    # owner 2026-11-12 "keep my drive a little clean": route screenshots in analysis\boot older than 24 h are deleted unless a doc names them
    # (AGENTS.md, host\README.md, docs\*.md, analysis\**\*.md); *_raw dump folders older than 24 h go too. Copy a shot you want to keep
    # into analysis\mods\compare\ or name it in a doc.
    try {
        $bootDir = Join-Path $root 'analysis\boot'; $cut = (Get-Date).AddHours(-24)
        $old = @(Get-ChildItem $bootDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cut -and $_.Extension -in '.png','.bmp','.jpg' })
        if ($old.Count) {
            $docs = @((Join-Path $root 'AGENTS.md'), (Join-Path $root 'host\README.md')) + @(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'docs'), (Join-Path $root 'analysis') -Recurse -Filter *.md -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object FullName)
            $refs = @{}; Select-String -Path $docs -Pattern '[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.(png|bmp|jpg)' -AllMatches -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches | ForEach-Object { $refs[$_.Value] = 1 } }
            $old | Where-Object { -not $refs.ContainsKey($_.Name) } | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
        Get-ChildItem $bootDir -Directory -Filter '*_raw' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cut } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    } catch { Write-Host "screenshot cleanup skipped: $_" }
} finally {
    if ($p -and -not $p.HasExited) { taskkill /PID $p.Id /T /F | Out-Null }
    if (-not $NoLock) { Exit-RunSlots }
}
if (-not $logGiven -and $err -and (Test-Path $Log)) {   # legacy names = latest finished run
    Copy-Item $Log (Join-Path $bootDir 'boot_trace.log') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Copy-Item $err (Join-Path $bootDir 'boot_stderr.log') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Copy-Item $so (Join-Path $bootDir 'boot_stdout.log') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
if ($NoLock) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $runDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
if ($Bench) {
    $cacheState = if ($cacheBefore) { $cacheBefore } else { 'unknown' }
    $dirty = [bool](git status --porcelain 2>$null)
    $meta = @{ run = "bench_${Bench}_$benchStamp"; route = $Bench; stamp = $benchStamp; timeout = $Timeout; git = ((git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>$null) -join ''); dirty = $dirty; cache = $cacheState } | ConvertTo-Json
    $mf = "$benchPrefix.meta.json"; $meta | Set-Content $mf -Encoding utf8
    if (Test-Path "${benchPrefix}_frames.csv") {
        python -I (Join-Path $root 'analysis\perf\bench_report.py') $benchPrefix (Join-Path $root "host\routes\$Bench.txt") "$benchPrefix.md" "$benchPrefix.csv" $mf
    } else { Write-Host "no frames log at ${benchPrefix}_frames.csv (run too short or SNAP_PERF unsupported by this exe)" }
} elseif ($dumpOn -and $shotBase) {   # raw BMPs -> <shotBase>_NN.png (route runs also refresh the legacy route_<name>_NN.png)
    $conv = "import sys,glob,shutil`nfrom PIL import Image`nd=sys.argv[1]`nfor n,f in enumerate(sorted(glob.glob(d+'_raw/*.bmp'))): Image.open(f).convert('RGB').save('%s_%02d.png'%(d,n))`nshutil.rmtree(d+'_raw',ignore_errors=True)"
    Get-ChildItem "${shotBase}_raw" -Filter *.bmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object Name | Set-Content "${shotBase}_dumps.txt"   # names carry present count and time: fps = delta p / delta t
    & python -c $conv $shotBase
    $shots = Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $shotBase) -Filter "$(Split-Path $shotBase -Leaf)_??.png" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($Route) {
        Get-ChildItem $bootDir -Filter "route_${Route}_??.png" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
        foreach ($f in $shots) { Copy-Item $f.FullName (Join-Path $bootDir ("route_${Route}_" + $f.Name.Substring($f.Name.Length - 6))) -Force }
    }
    Write-Host ("checkpoints: " + (($shots | ForEach-Object Name) -join ' '))
}
```

`host/run_boot_mods.ps1`:

```ps1
# Test runs are HIDDEN by default: snap_boot.exe goes through the ghost launcher (a never-shown "EmberGhost" desktop in a job object), so no
# window reaches the owner's screen. -Visible = old behavior (normal window, to watch). Launcher: $env:SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER or the default below.
# -SaveFixture <name> seeds the run's save dir from build\fixtures\saves\<name> (e.g. post_tutorial) instead of an empty save.
# -Route <name>: feeds host\routes\<name>.txt as SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT, defaults the save fixture to the route's first-line
#   '# fixture: <name>' (else <name>), and saves checkpoint screenshots (first at -ShotAt s, then every -ShotEvery s, at most -ShotMax; NVN_FRAME_DUMP).
#   -ShotAt without -Route also dumps frames, to analysis\boot\run_<id>_NN.png.

# build\heavy.lock (that stays the BUILD lock). -Bench / -Exclusive (or SNAP_PERF set) take all 6 slots and wait for them. While build\heavy.priority
# exists, slot 0 is reserved for the run whose $env:SNAP_LOCK_OWNER equals its content. -NoLock = the caller already holds a slot (scratch dir slotnl<pid>).

# concurrent build can relink. Output carries a run id <slot>-<stamp>: analysis\boot\runs\<id>\boot_{trace,stderr,stdout}.log and

# and .csv (avg fps, 1% / 0.1% low, max, percentiles, per-scene split from '# scene: <name> <start_s> <end_s>' lines in the route file,

$benchStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $benchPrefix = $null
if ($Bench) { $Route = $Bench; $benchPrefix = Join-Path $root "analysis\perf\bench_${Bench}_$benchStamp" }
if ($Route) {
    $rf = Join-Path $root "host\routes\$Route.txt"
    if (-not (Test-Path $rf)) { Write-Host "no route file $rf"; exit 5 }

    if (-not $SaveFixture) {
        $m = Select-String -Path $rf -Pattern '^#\s*fixture:\s*(\S+)' | Select-Object -First 1
        $SaveFixture = if ($m) { $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } else { $Route }
    }

$dumpOn = (-not $Bench) -and ($Route -or $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('ShotAt'))

# ---- slot: one of 6 concurrent run slots (all 6 for -Bench / -Exclusive / perf)
$excl = [bool]($Bench -or $Exclusive -or $env:SNAP_PERF)

$slots = @()
if ($NoLock) { $slotName = "slotnl$PID"; $sid = 'nl' }
else {
    $slots = Enter-RunSlots $what -Exclusive:$excl
    if ($null -eq $slots) { Write-Host 'could not get a run slot'; exit 6 }
    $slotName = "slot$($slots[0])"; $sid = "$($slots[0])"

try {
    $runDir = Join-Path $root "build\runs\$slotName"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $runDir | Out-Null
    # output locations
    if ($logGiven) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $Log) | Out-Null }
    else { $runOut = Join-Path $bootDir "runs\$runId"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $runOut | Out-Null; $Log = Join-Path $runOut 'boot_trace.log' }
    $err = Join-Path (Split-Path $Log) 'boot_stderr.log'; $so = Join-Path (Split-Path $Log) 'boot_stdout.log'
    $shotBase = if ($Route) { Join-Path $bootDir "route_${Route}_$runId" } else { Join-Path $bootDir "run_$runId" }
    if ($Bench) { $env:SNAP_PERF = $benchPrefix }
    elseif ($dumpOn) {
        # NVN_FRAME_DUMP works on the hidden desktop (the desktop capture SNAP_SHOT only sees black there); half-size BMPs
        $rawDir = "${shotBase}_raw"
        if (Test-Path $rawDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $rawDir }
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $rawDir | Out-Null
        $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP = $rawDir; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM = [string]$ShotAt; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY = [string]$ShotEvery; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_MAX = [string]$ShotMax
    }
    # isolated copy of the exe + DLLs + nvn shader cache (a build may relink build\snap meanwhile); retry if the source changes mid-copy
    $src = Join-Path $root 'build\snap_mods'; $ok = $false
    for ($try = 0; $try -lt 15 -and -not $ok; $try++) {
        $ok = $true
        foreach ($f in (Get-ChildItem $src -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'snap_boot.exe', 'snap_boot.pdb' -or $_.Extension -eq '.dll' })) {

            if ((Get-Item (Join-Path $runDir $f.Name)).Length -ne (Get-Item $f.FullName).Length) { $ok = $false; break }
        }
        if (-not $ok) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }

    $seed = if ($env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR) { $env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR } elseif ($env:SNAP_CONFIG_DIR) { Join-Path $env:SNAP_CONFIG_DIR 'shadercache' } else { Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'SnapRecomp\shadercache' }
    $scd = Join-Path $runDir 'shadercache'
    if ($Bench) {

        $cacheBefore = if ($cf) { "warm ($(@($cf).Count) files, $([math]::Round((($cf | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB, 1)) MB in $seed)" } else { "cold (empty or missing $seed)" }
    }

    $env:SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR = $scd
    # Test runs never touch the player's save (%APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\save): per-slot build\runs\slot<N>\save, wiped per run unless -KeepSave.
    $testSave = Join-Path $runDir 'save'
    if (-not $KeepSave -and (Test-Path $testSave)) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $testSave -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $testSave | Out-Null
    if ($SaveFixture) {
        $fx = Join-Path $root "build\fixtures\saves\$SaveFixture"
        if (-not (Test-Path $fx)) { Write-Host "no save fixture $fx"; exit 4 }
        if ($KeepSave) { Write-Host "-SaveFixture with -KeepSave: not re-seeding $testSave" } else { Copy-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $fx '*') $testSave }

        } else {

            if (-not (Test-Path $gl)) { Write-Host "ghost launcher not found ($gl); set SNAP_GHOST_LAUNCHER or use -Visible"; exit 97 }
            # the hidden desktop has no foreground window: the game must not gate (scripted) input on focus

            # muted by default (owner, 2026-11-12): the timer-paced null audio backend keeps the game's audio timing and SNAP_AUDIO_CAPTURE, but nothing reaches the speakers; set SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND=wasapi to hear it
            if (-not $env:SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND) { $env:SNAP_AUDIO_BACKEND = 'null' }
```

`host/skip_intro.txt`:

```txt
# Scripted input for play.ps1 -SkipIntro (SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT): loading, language/voice/appearance select, name entry and the lab intro
# cutscene. It hands control back to the player at the tutorial's "Tutorials are based on default button layouts" panel and presses
# nothing after that: the tutorial's camera, the photo-select screen and everything later need live input (a held A skips the photo
# selection and the professor's evaluation). Real input stays active and is OR-ed in. See runtime/hle/input_core.cpp for the format.
# Segment 0: A every 2.5 s until the name prompt opens (the game calls nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard).
repeat 12 200 2.5 0.3 A
anchor swkbd
# Segment 1 (seconds after the name prompt): the "Are you ready to start?" dialog defaults to No: move up to Yes, confirm, then
# advance the cutscene dialogue. The A presses stop at t=135 at the latest (fallback if the next event never comes).
2.5 0.2 Up
3.5 0.2 Up
4.5 0.2 Up
5.5 0.3 A
repeat 9 135 1.2 0.25 A
anchor vibration
# Segment 2 (seconds after the first controller rumble, which is the lab cutscene handing the camera to the player; it comes 120 to
# 126 s after the name prompt in test runs): the last cutscene lines. The "Tutorials are based on default button layouts" panel
# appeared 21 to 30 s after the rumble and the first camera prompt 31 to 36 s after it, so A stops at 18 s, before both.
repeat 0 18 1.2 0.25 A
```

```manifest
</assembly>
```
