`runtime/mods/mods_core.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "mods_core.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

#include "../hle/json_lite.h"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace mods {

uint32_t crc32(const void* data, size_t n) {
  static uint32_t table[256];
  static bool init = false;
  if (!init) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      uint32_t c = i;
      for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? 0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1) : c >> 1;
      table[i] = c;
    }
    init = true;
  }
  uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
  const uint8_t* p = (const uint8_t*)data;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = table[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (c >> 8);
  return c ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu;
}

static std::string lower(std::string s) {
  for (auto& ch : s) ch = (char)std::tolower((unsigned char)ch);
  return s;
}

uint32_t ext_crc(const std::string& ext) {
  if (ext.size() == 8 && std::all_of(ext.begin(), ext.end(), [](unsigned char ch) { return std::isxdigit(ch); }))
    return (uint32_t)std::strtoul(ext.c_str(), nullptr, 16);
  std::string l = lower(ext);
  return crc32(l.data(), l.size());
}

std::string norm_archive(const std::string& a) {
  std::string s = a;
  for (auto& ch : s) if (ch == '\\') ch = '/';
  size_t colon = s.find(":/");
  if (colon != std::string::npos && colon < 12) s = s.substr(colon + 2);
  while (!s.empty() && s[0] == '/') s.erase(0, 1);
  return lower(s);
}

static bool ends_with_ci(const std::string& s, const std::string& suf) {
  return s.size() >= suf.size() && lower(s.substr(s.size() - suf.size())) == lower(suf);
}

bool parse_pack_path(const std::string& rel_in, std::string* archive, std::string* stem, uint32_t* extcrc) {
  std::string rel = rel_in;
  for (auto& ch : rel) if (ch == '\\') ch = '/';
  std::vector<std::string> parts;
  size_t i = 0;
  while (i <= rel.size()) {
    size_t j = rel.find('/', i);
    if (j == std::string::npos) j = rel.size();
    if (j > i) parts.push_back(rel.substr(i, j - i));
    i = j + 1;
  }
  size_t da = parts.size();
  for (size_t k = 0; k + 1 < parts.size(); k++)
    if (ends_with_ci(parts[k], ".drp")) { da = k; break; }
  if (da >= parts.size() || da + 2 != parts.size()) return false;
  const std::string& fn = parts.back();
  size_t dot = fn.rfind('.');
  if (dot == std::string::npos || dot == 0 || dot + 1 >= fn.size()) return false;
  std::string ext = fn.substr(dot + 1);
  std::string st = fn.substr(0, dot);
  if (ends_with_ci(st, "." + ext)) st.resize(st.size() - ext.size() - 1);
  std::string arch;
  for (size_t k = 0; k <= da; k++) { if (k) arch += '/'; arch += parts[k]; }
  *archive = norm_archive(arch);
  *stem = lower(st);
  *extcrc = ext_crc(ext);
  return true;
}

std::string make_key(const std::string& archive_norm, const std::string& stem_lower, uint32_t extcrc) {
  char buf[16];
  snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "|%08x|", extcrc);
  return archive_norm + buf + stem_lower;
}

void Index::add(int pack, const std::string& archive, const std::string& stem, uint32_t extcrc, const std::string& file) {
  std::string key = make_key(archive, stem, extcrc);
  auto it = map.find(key);
  if (it != map.end()) {   // a higher-priority pack was added first
    conflicts.push_back(key + ": " + packs[it->second.pack].id + " beats " + packs[pack].id);
    return;
  }
  Override o;
  o.file = file;
  o.pack = pack;
  o.label = archive + "/" + stem;
  map.emplace(std::move(key), std::move(o));
}

const Override* Index::find(const std::string& archive_norm, const std::string& name, uint32_t extcrc) const {
  std::string l = lower(name);
  auto it = map.find(make_key(archive_norm, l, extcrc));
  if (it != map.end()) return &it->second;
  size_t dot = l.rfind('.');
  if (dot != std::string::npos && ext_crc(l.substr(dot + 1)) == extcrc) {
    it = map.find(make_key(archive_norm, l.substr(0, dot), extcrc));
    if (it != map.end()) return &it->second;
  }
  return nullptr;
}

std::string default_root() {
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_MODS_DIR")) if (*e) return e;
  const char* ap = std::getenv("APPDATA");
  return std::string(ap ? ap : ".") + "\\SnapRecomp\\mods";
}

static bool read_text(const fs::path& p, std::string* out) {
  std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  if (!f) return false;
  std::ostringstream ss;
  ss << f.rdbuf();
  *out = ss.str();
  return true;
}

static void read_pack_json(Pack& p, std::vector<std::string>& warn) {
  std::string txt;
  if (!read_text(fs::path(p.dir) / "pack.json", &txt)) { warn.push_back(p.id + ": no pack.json (name and version unknown)"); p.name = p.id; return; }
  hle::Json j;
  std::string err;
  if (!hle::json_parse(txt, j, err)) { warn.push_back(p.id + ": pack.json: " + err); p.name = p.id; return; }
  if (auto* v = j.get("name")) p.name = v->str();
  if (auto* v = j.get("version")) p.version = v->str();
  if (auto* v = j.get("author")) p.author = v->str();
  if (auto* v = j.get("description")) p.description = v->str();
  if (p.name.empty()) p.name = p.id;
}

void load(const std::string& root, Index& out, std::vector<std::string>& warn) {
  std::error_code ec;
  if (!fs::is_directory(root, ec)) return;
  std::vector<std::pair<std::string, bool>> order;   // (folder, enabled)
  std::string txt;
  if (read_text(fs::path(root) / "mods.json", &txt)) {
    hle::Json j;
    std::string err;
    if (!hle::json_parse(txt, j, err)) warn.push_back("mods.json: " + err);
    else if (auto* arr = j.get("packs")) {
      for (auto& e : arr->a) {
        if (e.type == hle::Json::Str) order.push_back({e.s, true});
        else if (e.type == hle::Json::Obj) {
          std::string id = e.get("id") ? e.get("id")->str() : e.get("folder") ? e.get("folder")->str() : "";
          if (!id.empty()) order.push_back({id, e.get("enabled") ? e.get("enabled")->boolean(true) : true});
        }
      }
    }
  }
  // Without a mods.json nothing is enabled (the owner parked texture and mod packs; before 2026-11-13 every folder with a pack.json was).
  // Packs the game itself needs are the exception and are on unless mods.json lists them as disabled: "native-options" is the PC tabs of the
  // game's Settings screen that host/play.ps1 builds (host/mods/nativeopt.cpp reads its rows.txt only while that pack is active).
  for (const char* req : {"native-options"}) {
    bool listed = false;
    for (auto& o : order) if (o.first == req) listed = true;
    if (!listed && fs::exists(fs::path(root) / req / "pack.json", ec)) order.push_back({req, true});
  }
  for (auto& [id, en] : order) {
    Pack p;
    p.id = id;
    p.dir = (fs::path(root) / id).string();
    p.enabled = en;
    if (!fs::is_directory(p.dir, ec)) { warn.push_back(id + ": listed in mods.json but the folder does not exist"); continue; }
    read_pack_json(p, warn);
    out.packs.push_back(p);
    if (!en) continue;
    int idx = (int)out.packs.size() - 1;
    for (auto it = fs::recursive_directory_iterator(p.dir, fs::directory_options::skip_permission_denied, ec); it != fs::recursive_directory_iterator(); it.increment(ec)) {
      if (ec) break;
      if (!it->is_regular_file(ec)) continue;
      std::string rel = fs::relative(it->path(), p.dir, ec).generic_string();
      if (rel == "pack.json" || lower(rel).find(".drp/") == std::string::npos) continue;   // only paths below an archive folder
      std::string a, s;
      uint32_t x;
      if (!parse_pack_path(rel, &a, &s, &x)) { warn.push_back(p.id + ": ignored " + rel + " (expected <archive>.drp/<entry>.<ext>)"); continue; }
      out.add(idx, a, s, x, it->path().string());
    }
  }
}

size_t chunk_header_len(size_t name_len) { return 0x18 + ((name_len + 4) & ~(size_t)3); }

std::vector<uint8_t> build_chunk(const uint8_t* orig, size_t hdr_len, const uint8_t* data, size_t n) {
  std::vector<uint8_t> v(hdr_len + n);
  std::memcpy(v.data(), orig, hdr_len);
  if (n) std::memcpy(v.data() + hdr_len, data, n);
  uint32_t crc = crc32(data, n), total = (uint32_t)(hdr_len + n), sz = (uint32_t)n;
  std::memcpy(v.data() + 0x00, &crc, 4);
  std::memcpy(v.data() + 0x08, &total, 4);
  std::memcpy(v.data() + 0x10, &sz, 4);
  std::memcpy(v.data() + 0x14, &sz, 4);
  return v;
}

}  // namespace mods
```

`runtime/mods/mods_core.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Loose-file DRP entry mods (project code, ours): pack discovery, the (archive, entry) index, path mapping and the
// replacement-chunk builder. Host-only, no dependency on the lifted game; tests/mods/mods_tests.cpp covers it.
// Design and user guide: docs/mods.md.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace mods {

struct Pack {
  std::string id;            // folder name under the mods root
  std::string dir;           // absolute path
  std::string name, version, author, description;
  bool enabled = true;
};

struct Override {
  std::string file;          // absolute path of the replacement
  int pack = 0;              // index into Index::packs
  std::string label;         // "archive/entry" for logs
};

uint32_t crc32(const void* data, size_t n);
// DRP entry extension id: crc32 of the lowercase extension (verified: "nutexb" -> 0x5c156dbc). An 8-digit hex extension
// (the unpacker's name for ids it does not know) is taken as the id itself.
uint32_t ext_crc(const std::string& ext);
// "Common/UI\\x.drp" or "rom:/common/UI/x.drp" -> "common/ui/x.drp"
std::string norm_archive(const std::string& a);
// A path inside a pack ("common/UI/master/Foo.drp/icon.nutexb", forward slashes) -> archive, entry stem and ext id. The
// first path component that ends in ".drp" ends the archive path; exactly one file name must follow it. A trailing
// ".<ext>" is dropped from the stem when it repeats the extension (the game stores some names with their extension).
bool parse_pack_path(const std::string& rel, std::string* archive, std::string* stem, uint32_t* extcrc);
std::string make_key(const std::string& archive_norm, const std::string& stem_lower, uint32_t extcrc);

class Index {
 public:
  std::vector<Pack> packs;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, Override> map;
  std::vector<std::string> conflicts;   // "key: pack A beats pack B"
  bool empty() const { return map.empty(); }
  void add(int pack, const std::string& archive, const std::string& stem, uint32_t extcrc, const std::string& file);
  // `name` is the entry name as stored in the chunk; the plain name and the name minus a ".<ext>" suffix whose crc is
  // the chunk's ext id are both tried.
  const Override* find(const std::string& archive_norm, const std::string& name, uint32_t extcrc) const;
};

// Mods root: SNAP_MODS_DIR, else %APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\mods.
std::string default_root();
// Reads <root>/mods.json (priority order, "enabled" flags; without the file nothing is enabled except the packs the game needs (native-options),
// in name order), each pack.json, and indexes the files of enabled packs. Problems go to `warnings`.
void load(const std::string& root, Index& out, std::vector<std::string>& warnings);

// Replacement chunk for the DRP entry worker: the original chunk's header (words, name and padding, `hdr_len` bytes)
// followed by the raw data, stored the way the game stores uncompressed entries (csize == dsize) with the data's CRC32.
// The size fields are rewritten, so the data may be any length.
std::vector<uint8_t> build_chunk(const uint8_t* orig, size_t hdr_len, const uint8_t* data, size_t n);
// Header length of a chunk with a NUL-terminated name of `name_len` bytes at +0x18: 0x18 + ((len + 4) & ~3)
size_t chunk_header_len(size_t name_len);

}  // namespace mods
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_aa.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// SMAA 1x and contrast adaptive sharpening, run on the game's tonemap output (project code, ours).
//
// The game's last scene pass (`Final`, shaders TonemappingPS / TonemappingFXAAPS / TonemappingLut* / FXAAOnlyPS) writes the tonemapped, FXAA'd picture
// into the window texture, and the `UI` pass draws text and HUD over it afterwards. The pass objects pick the FXAA variant themselves, so instead of
// changing what the game selects:
//   * SNAP_AA=off|smaa: the four FXAA shaders (and FXAAOnlyPS) are patched in SPIR-V (AaPatchFragment): their first early-exit test, "luma range >= threshold",
//     is made always false, which is the shader's own no-edge path (the plain tonemapped center pixel).
//   * SNAP_AA=smaa: right after any of those programs draws (AaAfterDraw, called from DoDraw), the render target is copied to a scratch image and SMAA 1x
//     (edge detection, blend weights, neighborhood blend; reference SMAA.hlsl compiled with dxc, area/search textures from the reference scripts) writes
//     the result back in place. UI draws later, so text is untouched.
//   * SNAP_SHARPEN=s: CAS (FidelityFX algorithm) after the AA step, also before the UI.
// Everything runs in the replaying command buffer; no other guest-visible state changes. Photos and the Evaluation pass read their own targets.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <tuple>

#include "nvn_aa.h"
#include "nvn_aa_spv.h"
#include "nvn_internal.h"
#include "hle/visual_defaults.h"   // the one table of visual defaults

namespace nvn {
int g_aaMode = AA_FXAA;
float g_aaSharpen = 0.0f;
// Window client height in pixels: SNAP_WINDOW_H, else window.json "height", else 720 (host/window_opts.cpp's default windowed size).
// Shared with the upscaler (upscale.cpp used its own copy that fell back to 1080).
int HostWindowHeight() {
  if (const char* e = getenv("SNAP_WINDOW_H")) if (atoi(e) > 0) return atoi(e);
  std::string dir;
  if (const char* c = getenv("SNAP_CONFIG_DIR")) dir = c; else if (const char* a = getenv("APPDATA")) dir = std::string(a) + "\\SnapRecomp";
  if (!dir.empty()) {
    if (FILE* f = fopen((dir + "\\window.json").c_str(), "rb")) {
      char buf[4096]; size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f); fclose(f); buf[n] = 0;
      if (const char* p = strstr(buf, "\"height\"")) { p = strchr(p, ':'); if (p && atoi(p + 1) > 0) return atoi(p + 1); }
    }
  }
  return 720;
}
namespace {
bool g_parsed;
float g_ssaaScale = 0.f;   // the scale AaParseEnv handed to g_scale; reset to 1 if the AA step fails (AaFail)
bool g_log;
bool g_split;   // SNAP_AA_SPLIT=1: the left half of the frame keeps the game's own picture (same-frame A/B shots)

// first 12 hex digits of the translation cache keys (computed from the game's nushdb data, see AGENTS.md "Anti-aliasing")
const char* kFxaaKeys[] = {"3df861d79c36" /*TonemappingFXAAPS*/, "874c3a9bc04b" /*TonemappingLutFXAAPS*/, "49a9f4c5b6d7" /*TonemappingLutFXAADistortionPS*/,
                           "e85954edec1f" /*FXAAOnlyPS*/};
const char* kPlainKeys[] = {"981bcb0e4161" /*TonemappingPS*/, "5729ba114d4b" /*TonemappingLutPS*/, "067ec8d5c8f9" /*TonemappingLutDistortionPS*/};
bool In(const char* const* l, size_t n, const char* k) { for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strncmp(l[i], k, 12)) return true; return false; }
bool IsFxaa(const char* k) { return In(kFxaaKeys, 4, k); }
bool IsTonemap(const char* k) { return IsFxaa(k) || In(kPlainKeys, 3, k); }

// ---- Vulkan objects ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Pipes { VkPipeline edge = VK_NULL_HANDLE, weights = VK_NULL_HANDLE, blend = VK_NULL_HANDLE, cas = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED; };
struct Img { VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; };
struct Sized {
  uint32_t w = 0, h = 0; VkFormat fmt = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  Img c, e, wt, b;                                   // scene copy, edges, weights, blended (CAS input)
  VkDescriptorSet setEdge = VK_NULL_HANDLE, setW = VK_NULL_HANDLE, setBlend = VK_NULL_HANDLE, setCas = VK_NULL_HANDLE, setCasC = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
};
struct G {
  Host* h = nullptr; bool failed = false, ready = false, texUploaded = false;
  VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkPipelineLayout pl = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkShaderModule mod[8] = {};
  VkSampler lin = VK_NULL_HANDLE, pt = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDescriptorPool pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  Img area, search; VkBuffer stage = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory stageMem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  Pipes pipes[4]; int npipes = 0;
  Sized sz;
  std::map<std::tuple<VkImage, uint32_t, uint32_t>, VkImageView> unormViews;   // sRGB targets: UNORM view of (image, level, layer); guarded by unormMu
  std::mutex unormMu;   // AaAfterDraw (replay thread) vs AaForgetTexture (graveyard reaper)
} g;

// SNAP_AA_DUMP=<dir> SNAP_AA_DUMP_AT=<p1,p2,...> (test aid): at the first tonemap draw at or after each present count, write the scene before the
// AA step (<dir>/aa_p<N>_before.bmp) and after it (aa_p<N>_after.bmp) from the SAME frame (no UI), so before/after pairs share one pose.
struct Dump {
  bool init = false, on = false; std::string dir; std::vector<int> at; size_t idx = 0;
  VkBuffer buf[3] = {}; VkDeviceMemory mem[3] = {}; void* map[3] = {}; uint64_t bytes = 0;
  int pendingAt = -1, pendingFrame = 0; uint32_t w = 0, h = 0; bool hasSmaa = false;
} dmp;

void WriteBmp(const std::string& path, const uint8_t* rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
  FILE* f = fopen(path.c_str(), "wb"); if (!f) return;
  uint8_t hdr[54] = {'B', 'M'};
  const uint32_t sz = 54 + w * h * 4, off = 54, dib = 40; const int32_t nh = -(int32_t)h; const uint16_t pl = 1, bpp = 32;
  memcpy(hdr + 2, &sz, 4); memcpy(hdr + 10, &off, 4); memcpy(hdr + 14, &dib, 4); memcpy(hdr + 18, &w, 4); memcpy(hdr + 22, &nh, 4);
  memcpy(hdr + 26, &pl, 2); memcpy(hdr + 28, &bpp, 2);
  fwrite(hdr, 1, 54, f);
  std::vector<uint8_t> row(w * 4);
  for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) {
    const uint8_t* s = rgba + (uint64_t)y * w * 4;
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) { row[x * 4] = s[x * 4 + 2]; row[x * 4 + 1] = s[x * 4 + 1]; row[x * 4 + 2] = s[x * 4]; row[x * 4 + 3] = 255; }
    fwrite(row.data(), 1, row.size(), f);
  }
  fclose(f);
}

VkFormat Unorm(VkFormat f) {
  switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32: return f;
    default: return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  }
}

void ImgBar(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage im, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to) {
  VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
  b.srcStageMask = b.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
  b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
  b.oldLayout = from; b.newLayout = to; b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
  b.image = im; b.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; di.imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pImageMemoryBarriers = &b;
  vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

bool MakeImg(Host* h, Img& o, uint32_t w, uint32_t hh, VkFormat fmt, VkImageUsageFlags usage) {
  VkImageCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ci.format = fmt; ci.extent = {w, hh, 1}; ci.mipLevels = 1; ci.arrayLayers = 1; ci.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
  ci.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL; ci.usage = usage; ci.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
  if (vkCreateImage(h->device, &ci, nullptr, &o.img) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(h->device, o.img, &mr);
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  ai.allocationSize = mr.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
  if (vkAllocateMemory(h->device, &ai, nullptr, &o.mem) != VK_SUCCESS || vkBindImageMemory(h->device, o.img, o.mem, 0) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkImageViewCreateInfo vc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
  vc.image = o.img; vc.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vc.format = fmt; vc.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  return vkCreateImageView(h->device, &vc, nullptr, &o.view) == VK_SUCCESS;
}
void FreeImg(Host* h, Img& o) {
  if (o.view) vkDestroyImageView(h->device, o.view, nullptr);
  if (o.img) vkDestroyImage(h->device, o.img, nullptr);
  if (o.mem) vkFreeMemory(h->device, o.mem, nullptr);
  o = Img{};
}

bool Setup(Host* h) {
  g.h = h; VkDevice d = h->device;
  static const uint32_t* const code[8] = {k_smaa_vs_edge, k_smaa_ps_edge, k_smaa_vs_weights, k_smaa_ps_weights, k_smaa_vs_blend, k_smaa_ps_blend, k_cas_vs, k_cas_ps};
  static const size_t size[8] = {sizeof k_smaa_vs_edge, sizeof k_smaa_ps_edge, sizeof k_smaa_vs_weights, sizeof k_smaa_ps_weights, sizeof k_smaa_vs_blend, sizeof k_smaa_ps_blend, sizeof k_cas_vs, sizeof k_cas_ps};
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO}; mi.codeSize = size[i]; mi.pCode = code[i];
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(d, &mi, nullptr, &g.mod[i]) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  }
  VkSamplerCreateInfo si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO};
  si.addressModeU = si.addressModeV = si.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
  si.magFilter = si.minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
  if (vkCreateSampler(d, &si, nullptr, &g.lin) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  si.magFilter = si.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
  if (vkCreateSampler(d, &si, nullptr, &g.pt) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding bn[6];
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) bn[i] = {(uint32_t)i, i < 4 ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE : VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, nullptr};
  VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dl{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO}; dl.bindingCount = 6; dl.pBindings = bn;
  if (vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(d, &dl, nullptr, &g.dsl) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkPushConstantRange pr{VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, 16};
  VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pli{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
  pli.setLayoutCount = 1; pli.pSetLayouts = &g.dsl; pli.pushConstantRangeCount = 1; pli.pPushConstantRanges = &pr;
  if (vkCreatePipelineLayout(d, &pli, nullptr, &g.pl) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkDescriptorPoolSize ps[2] = {{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE, 4 * 16}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER, 2 * 16}};
  VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO}; dp.maxSets = 16; dp.poolSizeCount = 2; dp.pPoolSizes = ps;
  if (vkCreateDescriptorPool(d, &dp, nullptr, &g.pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  if (!MakeImg(h, g.area, 160, 560, VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT)) return false;
  if (!MakeImg(h, g.search, 64, 16, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT)) return false;
  void* mp = nullptr;
  const uint64_t asz = sizeof k_smaa_area, ssz = sizeof k_smaa_search;
  if (!CreateHostBuffer(h, asz + ssz, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, &g.stage, &g.stageMem, &mp)) return false;
  memcpy(mp, k_smaa_area, asz); memcpy((uint8_t*)mp + asz, k_smaa_search, ssz);
  return true;
}

VkPipeline MakePipe(VkShaderModule vs, VkShaderModule fs, VkFormat fmt) {
  VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo st[2] = {{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, nullptr, 0, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, vs, "main", nullptr},
                                           {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, nullptr, 0, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, fs, "main", nullptr}};
  VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
  VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo ia{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO}; ia.topology = VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST;
  VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo vp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO}; vp.viewportCount = 1; vp.scissorCount = 1;
  VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rs{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO};
  rs.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL; rs.cullMode = VK_CULL_MODE_NONE; rs.lineWidth = 1.0f;
  VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo ms{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO}; ms.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
  VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState cba{}; cba.colorWriteMask = 0xF;
  VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo cb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO}; cb.attachmentCount = 1; cb.pAttachments = &cba;
  const VkDynamicState dyn[] = {VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT, VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR};
  VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo ds{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO}; ds.dynamicStateCount = 2; ds.pDynamicStates = dyn;
  VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo ri{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO}; ri.colorAttachmentCount = 1; ri.pColorAttachmentFormats = &fmt;
  VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo gi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO};
  gi.pNext = &ri; gi.stageCount = 2; gi.pStages = st; gi.pVertexInputState = &vi; gi.pInputAssemblyState = &ia; gi.pViewportState = &vp;
  gi.pRasterizationState = &rs; gi.pMultisampleState = &ms; gi.pColorBlendState = &cb; gi.pDynamicState = &ds; gi.layout = g.pl;
  VkPipeline p = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  const VkResult r = vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(g.h->device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &gi, nullptr, &p);
  if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { fprintf(stderr, "aa: vkCreateGraphicsPipelines failed (%d)\n", (int)r); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
  return p;
}

Pipes* GetPipes(VkFormat fmt) {
  for (int i = 0; i < g.npipes; i++) if (g.pipes[i].fmt == fmt) return &g.pipes[i];
  if (g.npipes >= 4) return nullptr;
  Pipes& p = g.pipes[g.npipes];
  p.fmt = fmt;
  p.edge = MakePipe(g.mod[0], g.mod[1], VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM);
  p.weights = MakePipe(g.mod[2], g.mod[3], VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);
  p.blend = MakePipe(g.mod[4], g.mod[5], fmt);
  p.cas = MakePipe(g.mod[6], g.mod[7], fmt);
  if (!p.edge || !p.weights || !p.blend || !p.cas) return nullptr;
  g.npipes++;
  return &p;
}

VkDescriptorSet MakeSet(VkImageView v0, VkImageView v1, VkImageView v2, VkImageView v3) {
  VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO}; ai.descriptorPool = g.pool; ai.descriptorSetCount = 1; ai.pSetLayouts = &g.dsl;
  VkDescriptorSet s = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkAllocateDescriptorSets(g.h->device, &ai, &s) != VK_SUCCESS) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDescriptorImageInfo ii[6] = {{VK_NULL_HANDLE, v0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL}, {VK_NULL_HANDLE, v1, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL},
                                 {VK_NULL_HANDLE, v2, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL}, {VK_NULL_HANDLE, v3, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL},
                                 {g.lin, VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED}, {g.pt, VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED}};
  VkWriteDescriptorSet w[6];
  for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    w[i] = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET}; w[i].dstSet = s; w[i].dstBinding = (uint32_t)i; w[i].descriptorCount = 1;
    w[i].descriptorType = i < 4 ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE : VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER; w[i].pImageInfo = &ii[i];
  }
  vkUpdateDescriptorSets(g.h->device, 6, w, 0, nullptr);
  return s;
}

bool Resize(uint32_t w, uint32_t hh, VkFormat fmt) {
  Host* h = g.h;
  if (g.sz.w == w && g.sz.h == hh && g.sz.fmt == fmt && g.sz.c.img) return true;
  if (g.sz.c.img) {
    // [nvnfix] review_nvn.md 8: commands recorded earlier in this submit (not on the GPU yet, so vkDeviceWaitIdle never covered them) may
    // still use the old images and sets. They get a fresh descriptor pool, and the old images and pool go to the graveyard (nvn_life.cpp).
    LifeCount(LS_AA_RESIZE);
    VkDescriptorPoolSize ps[2] = {{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE, 4 * 16}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER, 2 * 16}};   // as in Init
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO}; dp.maxSets = 16; dp.poolSizeCount = 2; dp.pPoolSizes = ps;
    VkDescriptorPool fresh = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateDescriptorPool(h->device, &dp, nullptr, &fresh) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    Sized old = g.sz; const VkDescriptorPool oldPool = g.pool;
    g.pool = fresh;
    RetireFn([h, old, oldPool]() mutable {
      FreeImg(h, old.c); FreeImg(h, old.e); FreeImg(h, old.wt); FreeImg(h, old.b);
      vkDestroyDescriptorPool(h->device, oldPool, nullptr);
    });
  }
  g.sz = Sized{};
  g.sz.w = w; g.sz.h = hh; g.sz.fmt = fmt;
  const VkImageUsageFlags rt = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
  if (!MakeImg(h, g.sz.c, w, hh, fmt, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT) || !MakeImg(h, g.sz.e, w, hh, VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, rt) ||
      !MakeImg(h, g.sz.wt, w, hh, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, rt) || !MakeImg(h, g.sz.b, w, hh, fmt, rt | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT)) return false;
  g.sz.setEdge = MakeSet(g.sz.c.view, g.sz.c.view, g.area.view, g.search.view);
  g.sz.setW = MakeSet(g.sz.c.view, g.sz.e.view, g.area.view, g.search.view);
  g.sz.setBlend = MakeSet(g.sz.c.view, g.sz.wt.view, g.area.view, g.search.view);
  g.sz.setCas = MakeSet(g.sz.b.view, g.sz.b.view, g.area.view, g.search.view);
  g.sz.setCasC = MakeSet(g.sz.c.view, g.sz.c.view, g.area.view, g.search.view);
  return g.sz.setEdge && g.sz.setW && g.sz.setBlend && g.sz.setCas && g.sz.setCasC;
}

void FullPass(ReplayCtx& cx, VkImageView target, uint32_t w, uint32_t hh, VkAttachmentLoadOp load, VkPipeline pipe, VkDescriptorSet set, const float pc[4], uint32_t x0 = 0) {
  VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO};
  ca.imageView = target; ca.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL; ca.loadOp = load; ca.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
  VkRenderingInfo ri{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO};
  ri.renderArea = {{0, 0}, {w, hh}}; ri.layerCount = 1; ri.colorAttachmentCount = 1; ri.pColorAttachments = &ca;
  vkCmdBeginRendering(cx.cb, &ri);
  VkViewport vp{0, 0, (float)w, (float)hh, 0, 1}; VkRect2D sc{{(int32_t)x0, 0}, {w - x0, hh}};
  vkCmdSetViewport(cx.cb, 0, 1, &vp); vkCmdSetScissor(cx.cb, 0, 1, &sc);
  vkCmdBindPipeline(cx.cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipe);
  vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cx.cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, g.pl, 0, 1, &set, 0, nullptr);
  vkCmdPushConstants(cx.cb, g.pl, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, 16, pc);
  vkCmdDraw(cx.cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
  vkCmdEndRendering(cx.cb);
}
}  // namespace

// ssaa2 asks for 2x the window height, then is capped: 2x the window per side is the formula's own ceiling, and on top of that
//   * scale <= kSsaaMaxScale (3.0 = 5760x3240): a 2160p window used to render at 7680x4320 (4.0), 4x the pixels of 4K for no visible gain
//   * no render side over 8192 px (the largest 2D image size every desktop GPU guarantees) = scale <= 8192/1920
// Raise kSsaaMaxScale (or set SNAP_RENDER_SCALE explicitly) to opt into more.
constexpr float kSsaaMaxScale = 3.0f;
static float SsaaScale(int windowH) {
  const float want = 2.0f * (float)windowH / 1080.0f;
  const float cap = std::min(kSsaaMaxScale, 8192.0f / 1920.0f);
  const float v = std::clamp(want, 1.0f, cap);
  if (v < want) fprintf(stderr, "aa: ssaa2 scale capped %.3f -> %.3f (window height %d, max %.2f = %.0fx%.0f)\n", want, v, windowH, cap, 1920 * v, 1080 * v);
  return v;
}
// Called when the AA step gives up (setup, pipeline or scratch-image failure): drop the supersampling scale it raised, which has no benefit
// without the AA step. Only new textures see it (existing targets keep their size); an explicit SNAP_RENDER_SCALE is left alone.
static void AaFail() {
  if (g_ssaaScale > 0.f && g_scale.scale == g_ssaaScale) { fprintf(stderr, "aa: render scale %.3f reset to 1 (AA disabled)\n", g_ssaaScale); g_scale.scale = 1.0f; g_ssaaScale = 0.f; }
}

float AaParseEnv() {
  if (g_parsed) return 0.f;
  g_parsed = true;
  g_split = getenv("SNAP_AA_SPLIT") && getenv("SNAP_AA_SPLIT")[0] != '0';
  g_log = getenv("SNAP_AA_LOG") && getenv("SNAP_AA_LOG")[0] != '0';
  float scale = 0.f;
  {
    // Default (SNAP_AA unset) comes from hle/visual_defaults.h: the game's own FXAA ("original") or ssaa2+smaa+CAS ("enhanced", SNAP_PROFILE).
    // SNAP_AA=off is the original FXAA path. An explicit SNAP_RENDER_SCALE wins over the enhanced default's ssaa2.
    const char* e = getenv("SNAP_AA"); if (e && !*e) e = nullptr;
    std::string s = e ? e : snapdef::get("SNAP_AA");
    if (!e && getenv("SNAP_RENDER_SCALE") && s.find("ssaa2") != std::string::npos) s = "smaa";
    g_aaSharpen = std::clamp((float)atof(snapdef::get("SNAP_SHARPEN")), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    for (auto& ch : s) { ch = (char)tolower((unsigned char)ch); if (ch == '+') ch = ','; }
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos <= s.size()) {
      size_t c = s.find(',', pos); if (c == std::string::npos) c = s.size();
      const std::string t = s.substr(pos, c - pos); pos = c + 1;
      if (t == "smaa") g_aaMode = AA_SMAA;
      else if (t == "none") g_aaMode = AA_OFF;   // the game's FXAA removed, nothing in its place
      else if (t == "off" || t == "original" || t == "fxaa" || t.empty()) g_aaMode = AA_FXAA;   // the game's own FXAA, untouched
      else if (t == "ssaa2") scale = SsaaScale(HostWindowHeight());
      else fprintf(stderr, "aa: unknown SNAP_AA token '%s' (fxaa, off, smaa, ssaa2)\n", t.c_str());
    }
  }
  fprintf(stderr, "aa: mode %s, sharpen %.2f, ssaa render scale %.3f\n", g_aaMode == AA_SMAA ? "smaa" : g_aaMode == AA_OFF ? "off" : "fxaa", g_aaSharpen, scale);
  g_ssaaScale = scale;
  return scale;
}

void AaPatchFragment(std::vector<uint32_t>& w, const char* key) {
  if (!g_parsed) AaParseEnv();
  if (g_aaMode == AA_FXAA || !IsFxaa(key)) return;
  // first OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual (190) after the first OpImageGather (96): the luma-range early-exit test. Make it OpFOrdLessThan (184) of the same
  // operand twice, which is always false, so the shader takes its no-edge path.
  size_t i = 5; bool seenGather = false;
  while (i < w.size()) {
    const uint32_t op = w[i] & 0xffff, n = w[i] >> 16;
    if (!n) break;
    if (op == 96) seenGather = true;
    if (op == 190 && seenGather && n == 5) { w[i] = (5u << 16) | 184u; w[i + 4] = w[i + 3]; fprintf(stderr, "aa: patched FXAA edge test in %.12s\n", key); return; }
    i += n;
  }
  fprintf(stderr, "aa: FXAA edge test not found in %.12s, left unchanged\n", key);
}

// DestroyTexture runs from the graveyard (nvn_life.cpp) only after the GPU has finished with the texture, so the views can go now.
// Without this the cache kept views of destroyed images, and a recycled VkImage handle could hand back a stale view.
void AaForgetTexture(const TextureImpl* t) {
  if (!t || !t->image || !g.h || !g.h->device) return;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g.unormMu);
  for (auto it = g.unormViews.lower_bound(std::make_tuple(t->image, 0u, 0u)); it != g.unormViews.end() && std::get<0>(it->first) == t->image;) {
    vkDestroyImageView(g.h->device, it->second, nullptr);
    it = g.unormViews.erase(it);
  }
}

void AaAfterDraw(ReplayCtx& cx, const char* key) {
  if (g_aaMode != AA_SMAA && g_aaSharpen <= 0.0f) return;
  if (g.failed || !IsTonemap(key)) return;
  // SNAP_AA_AB=<P> (test aid): SMAA/CAS run only while (present count / P) is odd, for same-frame before/after shots in one run
  static const unsigned long long abP = getenv("SNAP_AA_AB") ? strtoull(getenv("SNAP_AA_AB"), nullptr, 0) : 0;
  if (abP && (((unsigned long long)g_presentCount / abP) & 1) == 0) return;
  TextureImpl* t = cx.rt[0];
  if (!t || !t->image || !t->fi) return;
  const VkFormat fmt = Unorm(t->fi->vk);
  if (fmt == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) { static bool w; if (!w) { w = true; fprintf(stderr, "aa: tonemap target format %d not supported, AA step skipped\n", (int)t->fi->vk); } return; }
  Host* h = cx.h;
  if (!g.ready) { if (!Setup(h)) { g.failed = true; fprintf(stderr, "aa: setup failed, disabled\n"); AaFail(); return; } g.ready = true; }
  const bool smaa = g_aaMode == AA_SMAA, cas = g_aaSharpen > 0.0f;
  EndRendering(cx);
  SubRange rr;
  VkImageView rtv = t->RenderView(cx.rtHasView[0] ? &cx.rtView[0] : nullptr, &rr);
  const uint32_t w = t->LevelW(rr.lb), hh = t->LevelH(rr.lb);
  if (rr.yn != 1 || w < 64 || hh < 64) return;
  if (g_log) { static int n; if (n++ < 12) fprintf(stderr, "aa: p%d key %.12s target %ux%u fmt %d level %u layer %u fxaa=%d\n", g_presentCount, key, w, hh, (int)t->fi->vk, rr.lb, rr.yb, (int)IsFxaa(key)); }
  Pipes* pp = GetPipes(fmt);
  if (!pp) { g.failed = true; fprintf(stderr, "aa: pipeline creation failed (format %d), disabled\n", (int)fmt); AaFail(); return; }
  if (!Resize(w, hh, fmt)) { g.failed = true; fprintf(stderr, "aa: scratch image or descriptor setup failed (%ux%u), disabled\n", w, hh); AaFail(); return; }
  // write view: a UNORM view when the target is sRGB, so SMAA and CAS read and write the stored (gamma) values unchanged
  if (t->fi->vk != fmt) {
    const auto k = std::make_tuple(t->image, (uint32_t)rr.lb, (uint32_t)rr.yb);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> ulk(g.unormMu);
    auto it = g.unormViews.find(k);
    if (it == g.unormViews.end()) {
      VkImageViewCreateInfo vc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
      vc.image = t->image; vc.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vc.format = fmt; vc.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, rr.lb, 1, rr.yb, 1};
      VkImageView v = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      if (vkCreateImageView(h->device, &vc, nullptr, &v) != VK_SUCCESS) { g.failed = true; AaFail(); return; }
      it = g.unormViews.emplace(k, v).first;
    }
    rtv = it->second;
  }
  VkCommandBuffer cb = cx.cb;
  if (!g.texUploaded) {
    g.texUploaded = true;
    ImgBar(cb, g.area.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    ImgBar(cb, g.search.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy a{}; a.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; a.imageExtent = {160, 560, 1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g.stage, g.area.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &a);
    VkBufferImageCopy s{}; s.bufferOffset = sizeof k_smaa_area; s.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; s.imageExtent = {64, 16, 1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g.stage, g.search.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &s);
    ImgBar(cb, g.area.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    ImgBar(cb, g.search.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
  }
  if (!dmp.init) {
    dmp.init = true;
    const char* d = getenv("SNAP_AA_DUMP"); const char* a = getenv("SNAP_AA_DUMP_AT");
    if (d && *d && a) { dmp.on = true; dmp.dir = d; for (const char* c = a; *c;) { dmp.at.push_back(atoi(c)); while (*c && *c != ',') c++; if (*c == ',') c++; } }
  }
  if (dmp.pendingAt >= 0 && g_presentCount >= dmp.pendingFrame + 3) {   // the copies recorded a few frames ago are done: write them
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(h->device);
    char nm[64];
    snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "/aa_p%d_before.bmp", dmp.pendingAt); WriteBmp(dmp.dir + nm, (const uint8_t*)dmp.map[0], dmp.w, dmp.h);
    snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "/aa_p%d_after.bmp", dmp.pendingAt); WriteBmp(dmp.dir + nm, (const uint8_t*)dmp.map[1], dmp.w, dmp.h);
    if (dmp.hasSmaa) { snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "/aa_p%d_smaaonly.bmp", dmp.pendingAt); WriteBmp(dmp.dir + nm, (const uint8_t*)dmp.map[2], dmp.w, dmp.h); }
    fprintf(stderr, "aa: dumped before/after pair for present %d (%ux%u)\n", dmp.pendingAt, dmp.w, dmp.h);
    dmp.pendingAt = -1;
  }
  bool dumpNow = dmp.on && dmp.pendingAt < 0 && dmp.idx < dmp.at.size() && g_presentCount >= dmp.at[dmp.idx] && t->fi->bytes == 4;
  if (dumpNow && (dmp.bytes != (uint64_t)w * hh * 4)) {
    dmp.bytes = (uint64_t)w * hh * 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (!CreateHostBuffer(h, dmp.bytes, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, &dmp.buf[i], &dmp.mem[i], &dmp.map[i])) { dmp.on = false; dumpNow = false; }
  }
  // 1. copy the target into the scratch image C
  TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, rr);
  ImgBar(cb, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
  VkImageCopy cp{}; cp.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, rr.lb, rr.yb, 1}; cp.dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; cp.extent = {w, hh, 1};
  vkCmdCopyImage(cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &cp);
  ImgBar(cb, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
  TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, rr);
  const float rtm[4] = {1.0f / w, 1.0f / hh, (float)w, (float)hh};
  VkImageView first = rtv;   // where the blend pass writes
  if (smaa) {
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.e.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
    FullPass(cx, g.sz.e.view, w, hh, VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, pp->edge, g.sz.setEdge, rtm);
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.e.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.wt.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
    FullPass(cx, g.sz.wt.view, w, hh, VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, pp->weights, g.sz.setW, rtm);
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.wt.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    if (cas) { ImgBar(cb, g.sz.b.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL); first = g.sz.b.view; }
    FullPass(cx, first, w, hh, cas ? VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE : (g_split ? VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD : VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE), pp->blend, g.sz.setBlend, rtm, cas ? 0 : (g_split ? w / 2 : 0));
    if (cas) ImgBar(cb, g.sz.b.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
  }
  if (cas) {
    const float cpc[4] = {1.0f / w, 1.0f / hh, g_aaSharpen, 0};
    FullPass(cx, rtv, w, hh, g_split ? VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD : VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE, pp->cas, smaa ? g.sz.setCas : g.sz.setCasC, cpc, g_split ? w / 2 : 0);
  }
  if (dumpNow) {   // before: the scratch copy of the untouched frame; after: the target as it is now
    VkBufferImageCopy bc{}; bc.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; bc.imageExtent = {w, hh, 1};
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, dmp.buf[0], 1, &bc);
    ImgBar(cb, g.sz.c.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, rr);
    bc.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, rr.lb, rr.yb, 1};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, dmp.buf[1], 1, &bc);
    TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, rr);
    dmp.hasSmaa = smaa && cas;   // SMAA alone (before CAS) is the scratch image B
    if (dmp.hasSmaa) {
      VkBufferImageCopy b2{}; b2.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; b2.imageExtent = {w, hh, 1};
      ImgBar(cb, g.sz.b.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
      vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, g.sz.b.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, dmp.buf[2], 1, &b2);
      ImgBar(cb, g.sz.b.img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    }
    dmp.pendingAt =dmp.at[dmp.idx++]; dmp.pendingFrame = g_presentCount; dmp.w = w; dmp.h = hh;
  }
  t->uploaded = true;
  // order everything above before later draws; put back the viewport and scissor the game had set
  VkMemoryBarrier2 mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
  mb.srcStageMask = mb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
  mb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT; mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
  VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; di.memoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb;
  vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
  if (cx.vpHave & 1) { const float* v = cx.vpGuest[0]; VkViewport vp = MakeNvnViewport(h->originMode, v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], t->scale); vkCmdSetViewport(cb, 0, 1, &vp); }
  else cx.vpSet = false;
  if (cx.scHave & 1) {
    int x = cx.scGuest[0][0], y = cx.scGuest[0][1], sw = cx.scGuest[0][2], sh = cx.scGuest[0][3];
    if (x < 0) { sw += x; x = 0; }
    if (y < 0) { sh += y; y = 0; }
    sw = std::max(sw, 0); sh = std::max(sh, 0);
    const float sc = t->scale;
    if (sc != 1.0f) { x = (int)std::floor(x * sc); y = (int)std::floor(y * sc); sw = (int)std::ceil(sw * sc); sh = (int)std::ceil(sh * sc); }
    VkRect2D r{{x, y}, {(uint32_t)sw, (uint32_t)sh}}; vkCmdSetScissor(cb, 0, 1, &r);
  } else cx.scSet = false;
}
}  // namespace nvn
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Anti-aliasing and sharpening for the game's tonemap pass (project code, ours). See nvn_aa.cpp.
//   SNAP_AA=fxaa|off|smaa|ssaa2 (combine with + or ,  e.g. ssaa2+smaa)   SNAP_SHARPEN=0..1
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace nvn {
struct ReplayCtx;
struct TextureImpl;
enum { AA_FXAA = 0, AA_OFF = 1, AA_SMAA = 2 };
extern int g_aaMode;        // what replaces the game's FXAA
extern float g_aaSharpen;   // contrast adaptive sharpening strength, 0 = off
// Parses SNAP_AA / SNAP_SHARPEN once. Returns the render scale SNAP_AA=ssaa2 asks for (2x the window height / 1080, capped at 3.0 and 8192 px), or 0.
float AaParseEnv();
// Window client height in pixels (SNAP_WINDOW_H, window.json, else 720). Used by ssaa2 and by the upscaler.
int HostWindowHeight();
// Called from DestroyTexture (nvn_vk.cpp): drops the cached UNORM views of this texture image.
void AaForgetTexture(const struct TextureImpl* t);
// Fragment shader fixups, called on a translated fragment module (key = first 12 hex digits of its cache key): turns the game's FXAA off by
// forcing its edge test to fail, so the tonemap shaders write the plain tonemapped color. No-op for other shaders and for SNAP_AA=fxaa.
void AaPatchFragment(std::vector<uint32_t>& words, const char* key12);
// Called after every draw; runs SMAA and/or CAS in place on render target 0 when the draw used one of the game's tonemap programs.
void AaAfterDraw(ReplayCtx& cx, const char* fragKey12);
}  // namespace nvn
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_alpha.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Alpha test emulation (NVN has a fixed-function alpha test, Vulkan does not): a fragment SPIR-V module is wrapped so
// that a new entry point calls the original, reads output location 0 .w and discards the fragment when
// `a <func> ref` is false. The reference value is specialization constant 0 so one patched module serves every ref.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <set>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>
#include "nvn_internal.h"

namespace nvn {
namespace {
enum : uint32_t {
  OpEntryPoint = 15, OpExecutionMode = 16, OpTypeVoid = 19, OpTypeBool = 20, OpTypeInt = 21, OpTypeFloat = 22, OpTypeVector = 23,
  OpTypePointer = 32, OpVariable = 59, OpFunction = 54, OpFunctionCall = 57, OpLoad = 61, OpLabel = 248, OpBranchConditional = 250,
  OpReturn = 253, OpKill = 252, OpFunctionEnd = 56, OpSelectionMerge = 247, OpDecorate = 71, OpMemberDecorate = 72,
  OpDecorationGroup = 73, OpGroupDecorate = 74, OpGroupMemberDecorate = 75, OpSpecConstant = 50, OpCompositeExtract = 81,
  OpFOrdEqual = 180, OpFUnordNotEqual = 183, OpFOrdLessThan = 184, OpFOrdGreaterThan = 186, OpFOrdLessThanEqual = 188,
  OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual = 190, OpConstantFalse = 42,
};
void Emit(std::vector<uint32_t>& v, uint32_t op, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> w) {
  v.push_back(((uint32_t)(w.size() + 1) << 16) | op);
  v.insert(v.end(), w.begin(), w.end());
}
}  // namespace

// func: NVN compare enum 1..8 (NEVER LESS EQUAL LEQUAL GREATER NOTEQUAL GEQUAL ALWAYS). Returns false when the module has
// no float vec4 output at location 0 (the module is then left alone).
bool PatchAlphaTest(const std::vector<uint32_t>& in, int func, std::vector<uint32_t>& out) {
  if (in.size() < 6 || in[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  const uint32_t bound = in[3];
  uint32_t entry = 0, var0 = 0, voidT = 0, fnT = 0, boolT = 0, annotEnd = 0, firstFn = 0, oldMainIdx = 0;
  uint32_t varType = 0;                                  // OpVariable result type for var0 (pointer type)
  std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> ptrs;       // pointer type id -> pointee
  struct Vec { uint32_t id, comp, n; };
  std::vector<Vec> vecs;
  std::vector<uint32_t> floats;                          // 32-bit float type ids
  std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> varSc;      // variable id -> pointer type
  size_t i = 5;
  while (i < in.size()) {
    uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > in.size()) return false;
    switch (op) {
      case OpEntryPoint: if (in[i + 1] == 4 && !entry) { entry = in[i + 2]; oldMainIdx = (uint32_t)i; } break;
      case OpDecorate: if (wc >= 4 && in[i + 2] == 30 && in[i + 3] == 0) var0 = in[i + 1]; annotEnd = (uint32_t)(i + wc); break;
      case OpMemberDecorate: case OpDecorationGroup: case OpGroupDecorate: case OpGroupMemberDecorate: annotEnd = (uint32_t)(i + wc); break;
      case OpTypeVoid: voidT = in[i + 1]; break;
      case OpTypeBool: boolT = in[i + 1]; break;
      case OpTypeFloat: if (in[i + 2] == 32) floats.push_back(in[i + 1]); break;
      case OpTypeVector: vecs.push_back({in[i + 1], in[i + 2], in[i + 3]}); break;
      case OpTypePointer: ptrs.push_back({in[i + 1], in[i + 3]}); break;
      case OpVariable: varSc.push_back({in[i + 2], in[i + 1]}); break;
      case OpFunction: if (!firstFn) firstFn = (uint32_t)i; if (in[i + 2] == entry) { fnT = in[i + 4]; voidT = in[i + 1]; } break;
      default: break;
    }
    i += wc;
  }
  (void)oldMainIdx;
  if (!entry || !var0 || !fnT || !firstFn || !annotEnd) return false;
  for (auto& v : varSc) if (v.first == var0) varType = v.second;
  uint32_t vecT = 0, floatT = 0;
  for (auto& p : ptrs) if (p.first == varType) vecT = p.second;
  for (auto& v : vecs) if (v.id == vecT && v.n == 4) for (uint32_t f : floats) if (f == v.comp) floatT = f;
  if (!floatT) return false;

  uint32_t next = bound;
  const uint32_t refId = next++, newMain = next++, lbl = next++, callId = next++, loadId = next++, aId = next++, condId = next++, killLbl = next++, mergeLbl = next++;
  const bool addBool = !boolT;
  if (addBool) boolT = next++;

  out.assign(in.begin(), in.begin() + 5);
  out[3] = 0;  // patched below
  // copy up to the end of annotations, retargeting OpEntryPoint / OpExecutionMode at the new entry function
  size_t k = 5;
  while (k < in.size()) {
    uint32_t wc = in[k] >> 16, op = in[k] & 0xFFFF;
    if (k == annotEnd) break;
    size_t base = out.size();
    out.insert(out.end(), in.begin() + k, in.begin() + k + wc);
    if (op == OpEntryPoint && in[k + 2] == entry) out[base + 2] = newMain;
    if (op == OpExecutionMode && in[k + 1] == entry) out[base + 1] = newMain;
    k += wc;
  }
  Emit(out, OpDecorate, {refId, 1, 0});   // SpecId 0
  // copy the rest up to the first function, retargeting remaining entry-related instructions (none live there)
  while (k < firstFn) { uint32_t wc = in[k] >> 16; out.insert(out.end(), in.begin() + k, in.begin() + k + wc); k += wc; }
  if (addBool) Emit(out, OpTypeBool, {boolT});
  Emit(out, OpSpecConstant, {floatT, refId, 0});
  // original functions
  out.insert(out.end(), in.begin() + k, in.end());
  // wrapper
  Emit(out, OpFunction, {voidT, newMain, 0, fnT});
  Emit(out, OpLabel, {lbl});
  Emit(out, OpFunctionCall, {voidT, callId, entry});
  if (func != 1) {
    Emit(out, OpLoad, {vecT, loadId, var0});
    Emit(out, OpCompositeExtract, {floatT, aId, loadId, 3});
    uint32_t cmp = 0;
    switch (func) {
      case 2: cmp = OpFOrdLessThan; break; case 3: cmp = OpFOrdEqual; break; case 4: cmp = OpFOrdLessThanEqual; break;
      case 5: cmp = OpFOrdGreaterThan; break; case 6: cmp = OpFUnordNotEqual; break; case 7: cmp = OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual; break;
      default: break;
    }
    if (cmp) {
      Emit(out, cmp, {boolT, condId, aId, refId});
      Emit(out, OpSelectionMerge, {mergeLbl, 0});
      Emit(out, OpBranchConditional, {condId, mergeLbl, killLbl});
      Emit(out, OpLabel, {killLbl});
      Emit(out, OpKill, {});
      Emit(out, OpLabel, {mergeLbl});
      Emit(out, OpReturn, {});
    } else Emit(out, OpReturn, {});
  } else {   // NEVER
    Emit(out, OpKill, {});
  }
  Emit(out, OpFunctionEnd, {});
  out[3] = next;
  (void)callId;
  return true;
}


// ---- SPIR-V patches for the translated modules -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The translator's output is used as is except for the fixes below (each one a Vulkan validity rule the translator does not know).
namespace {
enum : uint32_t { OpCapability = 17, OpTypeImage = 25, OpTypeArray = 28, OpTypeMatrix = 24, OpConstant = 43, OpAccessChain = 65, OpInBoundsAccessChain = 66,
                  OpImageRead = 98, OpImageWrite = 99 };
constexpr uint32_t kDecLocation = 30, kDecComponent = 31, kDecIndex = 32, kDecBuiltIn = 11;
constexpr uint32_t kScInput = 1, kScOutput = 3, kScPrivate = 6;
}  // namespace

// A storage image declared with an unknown format needs StorageImageRead/WriteWithoutFormat; the translator omits the capability.
bool SpvAddStorageImageCaps(std::vector<uint32_t>& spv) {
  if (spv.size() < 6 || spv[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  bool unknownFmt = false, rd = false, wr = false, hasRd = false, hasWr = false;
  size_t firstNonCap = 0;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < spv.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > spv.size()) return false;
    if (op == OpCapability) { if (spv[i + 1] == 55) hasRd = true; if (spv[i + 1] == 56) hasWr = true; }
    else if (!firstNonCap) firstNonCap = i;
    if (op == OpTypeImage && wc >= 9 && spv[i + 7] == 2 && spv[i + 8] == 0) unknownFmt = true;
    if (op == OpImageRead) rd = true;
    if (op == OpImageWrite) wr = true;
    i += wc;
  }
  if (!unknownFmt || !firstNonCap) return false;
  std::vector<uint32_t> add;
  if (rd && !hasRd) Emit(add, OpCapability, {55});
  if (wr && !hasWr) Emit(add, OpCapability, {56});
  if (add.empty()) return false;
  spv.insert(spv.begin() + firstNonCap, add.begin(), add.end());
  return true;
}

// Bit n set = the vertex shader reads input location n (arrays and matrices cover several locations).
uint32_t SpvVertexInputMask(const std::vector<uint32_t>& in) {
  if (in.size() < 6 || in[0] != 0x07230203) return 0xFFFFFFFFu;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> loc, builtin, ptrPointee, varType, constVal, arrElem, arrLen, matCols;
  std::vector<uint32_t> inputVars;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > in.size()) return 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    switch (op) {
      case OpDecorate:
        if (wc >= 4 && in[i + 2] == kDecLocation) loc[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3];
        if (wc >= 3 && in[i + 2] == kDecBuiltIn) builtin[in[i + 1]] = 1;
        break;
      case OpTypePointer: ptrPointee[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3]; break;
      case OpVariable: varType[in[i + 2]] = in[i + 1]; if (in[i + 3] == kScInput) inputVars.push_back(in[i + 2]); break;
      case OpConstant: if (wc >= 4) constVal[in[i + 2]] = in[i + 3]; break;
      case OpTypeArray: arrElem[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 2]; arrLen[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3]; break;
      case OpTypeMatrix: matCols[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3]; break;
      default: break;
    }
    i += wc;
  }
  uint32_t mask = 0;
  for (uint32_t v : inputVars) {
    if (builtin.count(v) || !loc.count(v)) continue;
    uint32_t t = ptrPointee[varType[v]], n = 1;
    while (arrElem.count(t)) { n *= std::max(1u, constVal.count(arrLen[t]) ? constVal[arrLen[t]] : 1u); t = arrElem[t]; }
    if (matCols.count(t)) n *= matCols[t];
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n && loc[v] + k < 32; k++) mask |= 1u << (loc[v] + k);
  }
  return mask;
}

// Locations of the fragment color outputs (OpVariable Output with a Location decoration), ascending.
std::vector<int> SpvFragmentOutputs(const std::vector<uint32_t>& in) {
  std::vector<int> r;
  if (in.size() < 6 || in[0] != 0x07230203) return r;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> loc;
  std::vector<uint32_t> outs;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > in.size()) return r;
    if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 4 && in[i + 2] == kDecLocation) loc[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3];
    if (op == OpVariable && in[i + 3] == kScOutput) outs.push_back(in[i + 2]);
    i += wc;
  }
  for (uint32_t v : outs) if (loc.count(v)) r.push_back((int)loc[v]);
  std::sort(r.begin(), r.end());
  return r;
}

// Rewrites the fragment outputs for one pipeline:
//  - outputs at a location >= nColor (no such attachment) become Private variables, so the write is dropped inside the shader
//    instead of tripping the "write is unused" validation warning;
//  - dual = true: the two lowest outputs become source 0 and source 1 of one location (Location L Index 0 / 1) and every
//    other output is dropped (Vulkan allows dual-source output only at location 0 when maxFragmentDualSrcAttachments is 1).
// Returns false when the module needs no change.
bool PatchFragmentOutputs(const std::vector<uint32_t>& in, int nColor, bool dual, std::vector<uint32_t>& out) {
  if (in.size() < 6 || in[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  const bool legacyIface = in[1] < 0x10400;   // before SPIR-V 1.4 the entry point interface lists only Input/Output variables
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> loc, varType;
  std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> outs;   // (location, var id)
  std::vector<uint32_t> outVars;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > in.size()) return false;
    if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 4 && in[i + 2] == kDecLocation) loc[in[i + 1]] = in[i + 3];
    if (op == OpVariable) { varType[in[i + 2]] = in[i + 1]; if (in[i + 3] == kScOutput) outVars.push_back(in[i + 2]); }
    i += wc;
  }
  for (uint32_t v : outVars) if (loc.count(v)) outs.push_back({loc[v], v});
  std::sort(outs.begin(), outs.end());
  std::set<uint32_t> strip;
  uint32_t second = 0, firstLoc = 0;
  if (dual && outs.size() >= 2) {
    firstLoc = outs[0].first; second = outs[1].second;
    for (size_t k = 2; k < outs.size(); k++) strip.insert(outs[k].second);
  } else {
    for (auto& o : outs) if ((int)o.first >= nColor) strip.insert(o.second);
  }
  if (strip.empty() && !second) return false;
  // access chains rooted at a stripped variable change pointer storage class too
  std::set<uint32_t> chain = strip;
  std::set<uint32_t> needPtr;   // Output pointer type ids that need a Private twin
  for (uint32_t v : strip) needPtr.insert(varType[v]);
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if ((op == OpAccessChain || op == OpInBoundsAccessChain) && wc >= 4 && chain.count(in[i + 3])) { chain.insert(in[i + 2]); needPtr.insert(in[i + 1]); }
    i += wc;
  }
  uint32_t next = in[3];
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> priv;   // Output pointer type -> Private pointer type
  for (uint32_t t : needPtr) priv[t] = next++;
  out.assign(in.begin(), in.begin() + 5);
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    const uint32_t* w = &in[i];
    if (op == OpEntryPoint && legacyIface) {
      // OpEntryPoint model id "name" interface...: the name is a NUL-terminated string packed in words, find its last word
      size_t k = 3;
      while (k < wc) {
        const bool hasNul = ((w[k] & 0xFF000000u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0x00FF0000u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0x0000FF00u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0xFFu) == 0);
        k++;
        if (hasNul) break;
      }
      std::vector<uint32_t> ins(w, w + std::min<size_t>(k, wc));
      for (size_t j = k; j < wc; j++) if (!strip.count(w[j])) ins.push_back(w[j]);
      ins[0] = ((uint32_t)ins.size() << 16) | OpEntryPoint;
      out.insert(out.end(), ins.begin(), ins.end());
    } else if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 3 && strip.count(w[1]) && (w[2] == kDecLocation || w[2] == kDecComponent || w[2] == kDecIndex)) {
      // dropped
    } else if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 4 && second && w[1] == second && w[2] == kDecLocation) {
      Emit(out, OpDecorate, {second, kDecLocation, firstLoc});
      Emit(out, OpDecorate, {second, kDecIndex, 1});
    } else if (op == OpTypePointer && priv.count(w[1])) {
      out.insert(out.end(), w, w + wc);
      Emit(out, OpTypePointer, {priv[w[1]], kScPrivate, w[3]});
    } else if (op == OpVariable && strip.count(w[2])) {
      std::vector<uint32_t> v(w, w + wc);
      v[1] = priv[v[1]]; v[3] = kScPrivate;
      out.insert(out.end(), v.begin(), v.end());
    } else if ((op == OpAccessChain || op == OpInBoundsAccessChain) && wc >= 4 && chain.count(w[3])) {
      std::vector<uint32_t> v(w, w + wc);
      v[1] = priv[v[1]];
      out.insert(out.end(), v.begin(), v.end());
    } else {
      out.insert(out.end(), w, w + wc);
    }
    i += wc;
  }
  out[3] = next;
  return true;
}

// A fragment color output the translator declares as float, drawn into an integer attachment (the BC1 thumbnail encoder writes raw
// block bits into an RGBA16_UINT stand-in, `RedirectCompressedTargets`), is undefined by the spec (validation: "numeric type of FLOAT
// but ... UINT"; other GPUs may convert the value instead of keeping the bits). kinds[L] = 1 uint / 2 sint for attachment L, else 0.
// Each such output becomes a Private float variable (all writes go there) plus a new Output variable of the integer type at the
// same Location; before every OpReturn of the entry function the Private value is loaded, OpBitcast to the integer type and stored.
// The bits written are exactly what the float output carried before. Returns false when the module needs no change.
bool PatchIntOutputs(const std::vector<uint32_t>& in, const int kinds[8], std::vector<uint32_t>& out) {
  constexpr uint32_t OpStoreC = 62, OpBitcastC = 124;
  if (in.size() < 6 || in[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  const bool legacyIface = in[1] < 0x10400;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> loc, varType, varSc, ptrTo, ptrSc;
  std::unordered_set<uint32_t> hasIndex, f32;
  std::map<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>, uint32_t> intT;                 // (width, signed) -> id
  std::map<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>, uint32_t> vecT;                 // (component type, count) -> id
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> vecOf;      // vec id -> (component, count)
  std::map<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>, uint32_t> ptrT;                 // (storage class, pointee) -> id
  std::vector<uint32_t> outVars;
  uint32_t entryFn = 0, firstFunc = 0, firstType = 0;
  size_t firstFuncAt = 0, firstTypeAt = 0;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > in.size()) return false;
    const uint32_t* w = &in[i];
    if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 4 && w[2] == kDecLocation) loc[w[1]] = w[3];
    if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 4 && w[2] == kDecIndex) hasIndex.insert(w[1]);
    if (op == OpEntryPoint && !entryFn) entryFn = w[2];
    if (op >= OpTypeVoid && op <= 39 && !firstTypeAt) firstTypeAt = i;
    if (op == OpTypeInt && wc >= 4) intT[{w[2], w[3]}] = w[1];
    if (op == OpTypeFloat && wc >= 3 && w[2] == 32) f32.insert(w[1]);
    if (op == OpTypeVector && wc >= 4) { vecT[{w[2], w[3]}] = w[1]; vecOf[w[1]] = {w[2], w[3]}; }
    if (op == OpTypePointer && wc >= 4) { ptrT[{w[2], w[3]}] = w[1]; ptrTo[w[1]] = w[3]; ptrSc[w[1]] = w[2]; }
    if (op == OpVariable) { varType[w[2]] = w[1]; varSc[w[2]] = w[3]; if (w[3] == kScOutput) outVars.push_back(w[2]); }
    if (op == OpFunction && !firstFuncAt) firstFuncAt = i;
    i += wc;
  }
  (void)firstFunc; (void)firstType;
  if (!entryFn || !firstFuncAt || !firstTypeAt) return false;
  struct T { uint32_t var, nv, ptrOld, pointee, comp, count, ity, ivec, optr; int kind; };
  std::vector<T> tg;
  std::set<uint32_t> pinned;
  uint32_t next = in[3];
  std::vector<uint32_t> newTypes;   // declarations placed before the first function
  auto pushType = [&](uint32_t op, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> w) { Emit(newTypes, op, w); };
  for (uint32_t v : outVars) {
    if (!loc.count(v) || hasIndex.count(v) || loc[v] >= 8 || kinds[loc[v]] == 0) continue;
    T t{}; t.var = v; t.kind = kinds[loc[v]]; t.ptrOld = varType[v]; t.pointee = ptrTo[t.ptrOld];
    uint32_t comp = t.pointee, count = 1;
    if (vecOf.count(t.pointee)) { comp = vecOf[t.pointee].first; count = vecOf[t.pointee].second; }
    if (!f32.count(comp)) continue;   // only float32 outputs
    t.comp = comp; t.count = count;
    const uint32_t sg = t.kind == 2 ? 1 : 0;
    if (!intT.count({32, sg})) { intT[{32, sg}] = next++; pushType(OpTypeInt, {intT[{32, sg}], 32, sg}); }
    t.ity = intT[{32, sg}];
    t.ivec = t.ity;
    if (count > 1) {
      if (!vecT.count({t.ity, count})) { vecT[{t.ity, count}] = next++; pushType(OpTypeVector, {vecT[{t.ity, count}], t.ity, count}); }
      t.ivec = vecT[{t.ity, count}];
    }
    if (!ptrT.count({kScOutput, t.ivec})) { ptrT[{kScOutput, t.ivec}] = next++; pushType(OpTypePointer, {ptrT[{kScOutput, t.ivec}], kScOutput, t.ivec}); }
    t.optr = ptrT[{kScOutput, t.ivec}];
    t.nv = next++;
    tg.push_back(t);
  }
  if (tg.empty()) return false;
  std::set<uint32_t> chain, needPtr;
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> byVar;
  for (size_t k = 0; k < tg.size(); k++) { chain.insert(tg[k].var); needPtr.insert(tg[k].ptrOld); byVar[tg[k].var] = (uint32_t)k; }
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if ((op == OpAccessChain || op == OpInBoundsAccessChain) && wc >= 4 && chain.count(in[i + 3])) { chain.insert(in[i + 2]); needPtr.insert(in[i + 1]); }
    i += wc;
  }
  std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> priv;
  for (uint32_t t : needPtr) priv[t] = next++;
  std::set<uint32_t> oldVars; for (auto& t : tg) oldVars.insert(t.var);
  out.assign(in.begin(), in.begin() + 5);
  uint32_t curFn = 0;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < in.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = in[i] >> 16, op = in[i] & 0xFFFF;
    const uint32_t* w = &in[i];
    if (i == firstTypeAt) for (auto& t : tg) { Emit(out, OpDecorate, {t.nv, kDecLocation, loc[t.var]}); }
    if (i == firstFuncAt) {
      out.insert(out.end(), newTypes.begin(), newTypes.end());
      for (auto& t : tg) Emit(out, OpVariable, {t.optr, t.nv, kScOutput});
    }
    if (op == OpEntryPoint) {
      size_t k = 3;
      while (k < wc) {
        const bool hasNul = ((w[k] & 0xFF000000u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0x00FF0000u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0x0000FF00u) == 0) || ((w[k] & 0xFFu) == 0);
        k++;
        if (hasNul) break;
      }
      std::vector<uint32_t> ins(w, w + std::min<size_t>(k, wc));
      for (size_t j = k; j < wc; j++) if (!(legacyIface && oldVars.count(w[j]))) ins.push_back(w[j]);
      for (auto& t : tg) ins.push_back(t.nv);
      ins[0] = ((uint32_t)ins.size() << 16) | OpEntryPoint;
      out.insert(out.end(), ins.begin(), ins.end());
    } else if (op == OpDecorate && wc >= 3 && oldVars.count(w[1]) && (w[2] == kDecLocation || w[2] == kDecComponent)) {
      // dropped: the Private variable carries no interface decoration
    } else if (op == OpTypePointer && priv.count(w[1])) {
      out.insert(out.end(), w, w + wc);
      Emit(out, OpTypePointer, {priv[w[1]], kScPrivate, w[3]});
    } else if (op == OpVariable && oldVars.count(w[2])) {
      std::vector<uint32_t> v(w, w + wc);
      v[1] = priv[v[1]]; v[3] = kScPrivate;
      out.insert(out.end(), v.begin(), v.end());
    } else if ((op == OpAccessChain || op == OpInBoundsAccessChain) && wc >= 4 && chain.count(w[3])) {
      std::vector<uint32_t> v(w, w + wc);
      v[1] = priv[v[1]];
      out.insert(out.end(), v.begin(), v.end());
    } else if (op == OpReturn && curFn == entryFn) {
      for (auto& t : tg) {
        const uint32_t l = next++, b = next++;
        Emit(out, OpLoad, {t.pointee, l, t.var});
        Emit(out, OpBitcastC, {t.ivec, b, l});
        Emit(out, OpStoreC, {t.nv, b});
      }
      out.insert(out.end(), w, w + wc);
    } else {
      if (op == OpFunction) curFn = w[2];
      out.insert(out.end(), w, w + wc);
    }
    i += wc;
  }
  out[3] = next;
  return true;
}

// The translator cannot know a compute shader's workgroup size (it lives in the NVN control section), so the module is
// emitted with LocalSize 1 1 1; the shader indexes everything through the invocation / workgroup ids, so setting the real
// size here is all it takes. Returns false when the module has no LocalSize execution mode.
bool SpvSetLocalSize(std::vector<uint32_t>& spv, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) {
  if (spv.size() < 6 || spv[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  for (size_t i = 5; i < spv.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > spv.size()) return false;
    if (op == 16 && wc >= 6 && spv[i + 2] == 17) { spv[i + 3] = x; spv[i + 4] = y; spv[i + 5] = z; return true; }   // OpExecutionMode ... LocalSize
    i += wc;
  }
  return false;
}

// GLSL layout(early_fragment_tests) is not visible in the SASS: on Maxwell the driver sets the EarlyZForce register from the program's
// control section (+0x718 bit 0; of the 3,149 fragment programs only EvaluationAggregatePS sets it). Without the execution mode Vulkan runs
// the depth/stencil test after a shader with side effects, so the photo-evaluation atomics would count hidden pixels too.
bool SpvAddEarlyFragmentTests(std::vector<uint32_t>& spv) {
  if (spv.size() < 6 || spv[0] != 0x07230203) return false;
  uint32_t entry = 0;
  size_t insertAt = 0;   // after the last OpEntryPoint / OpExecutionMode (the logical layout keeps them together)
  for (size_t i = 5; i < spv.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = spv[i] >> 16, op = spv[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > spv.size()) return false;
    if (op == OpEntryPoint && wc >= 3) { if (spv[i + 1] == 4 /*Fragment*/) entry = spv[i + 2]; insertAt = i + wc; }
    else if (op == OpExecutionMode || op == 331 /*OpExecutionModeId*/) {
      if (op == OpExecutionMode && wc >= 3 && spv[i + 1] == entry && spv[i + 2] == 9 /*EarlyFragmentTests*/) return true;
      insertAt = i + wc;
    } else if (insertAt) break;
    i += wc;
  }
  if (!entry || !insertAt) return false;
  const uint32_t ins[3] = {(3u << 16) | OpExecutionMode, entry, 9};
  spv.insert(spv.begin() + insertAt, ins, ins + 3);
  return true;
}

}  // namespace nvn

```
