`runtime/nvn/nvn_pace.cpp`:

```cpp
// Frame pacing: one frame clock for the host limiter and the guest vsync event. See nvn_pace.h and analysis/perf/pacing.md.
#define NOMINMAX
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <mmsystem.h>

#include "nvn_pace.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>

namespace snap_pace {
namespace {

int64_t NowNs() { return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count(); }
bool EnvZero(const char* n) { const char* e = getenv(n); return e && e[0] == '0'; }
const bool kLegacy = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_PACE"); return e && !_stricmp(e, "legacy"); }();
const char* const kLogPath = getenv("SNAP_PACE_LOG");
const int64_t kT0 = NowNs();   // free-grid anchor (shared by the limiter and the guest vsync)

// Sleep until t on the steady clock: high-resolution waitable timer, then at most spinNs of spinning. Without that timer
// (pre-1803 Windows) Sleep(1) with a 1 ms system timer period.
void WaitUntil(int64_t t, int64_t spinNs) {
  thread_local HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
  static std::once_flag period;
  const int64_t margin = std::max<int64_t>(spinNs, 100000);
  for (;;) {
    const int64_t left = t - NowNs();
    if (left <= margin) break;
    if (timer) {
      LARGE_INTEGER due; due.QuadPart = -(left - margin) / 100;
      SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE);
      WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    } else {
      std::call_once(period, [] { timeBeginPeriod(1); });
      if (left < 1500000 + margin) break;
      Sleep(1);
    }
  }
  if (spinNs > 0) while (NowNs() < t) YieldProcessor();
}

// ---- display: monitor of the window and its exact refresh rate
double QueryHz(const wchar_t* gdiName) {
  UINT32 np = 0, nm = 0;
  if (GetDisplayConfigBufferSizes(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, &nm) == ERROR_SUCCESS && np) {
    std::vector<DISPLAYCONFIG_PATH_INFO> p(np);
    std::vector<DISPLAYCONFIG_MODE_INFO> m(nm);
    if (QueryDisplayConfig(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, p.data(), &nm, m.data(), nullptr) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
      for (UINT32 i = 0; i < np; i++) {
        DISPLAYCONFIG_SOURCE_DEVICE_NAME sn{};
        sn.header.type = DISPLAYCONFIG_DEVICE_INFO_GET_SOURCE_NAME; sn.header.size = sizeof sn;
        sn.header.adapterId = p[i].sourceInfo.adapterId; sn.header.id = p[i].sourceInfo.id;
        if (DisplayConfigGetDeviceInfo(&sn.header) != ERROR_SUCCESS || wcscmp(sn.viewGdiDeviceName, gdiName)) continue;
        const UINT32 mi = p[i].targetInfo.modeInfoIdx;
        if (mi != DISPLAYCONFIG_PATH_MODE_IDX_INVALID && mi < nm && m[mi].infoType == DISPLAYCONFIG_MODE_INFO_TYPE_TARGET) {
          const auto& v = m[mi].targetMode.targetVideoSignalInfo.vSyncFreq;
          if (v.Denominator && v.Numerator) return (double)v.Numerator / v.Denominator;
        }
        const auto& r = p[i].targetInfo.refreshRate;
        if (r.Denominator && r.Numerator) return (double)r.Numerator / r.Denominator;
      }
    }
  }
  DEVMODEW dm{}; dm.dmSize = sizeof dm;
  if (EnumDisplaySettingsW(gdiName, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) && dm.dmDisplayFrequency > 1) {
    double f = dm.dmDisplayFrequency;
    if (dm.dmDisplayFrequency % 60 == 59) f = (f + 1) * 1000.0 / 1001.0;   // 59 / 119 Hz are NTSC rates
    return f;
  }
  return 0;
}

// ---- vblank clock: a thread blocked in D3DKMTWaitForVerticalBlankEvent on the window's monitor
struct KmtOpen { WCHAR DeviceName[32]; UINT hAdapter; LUID AdapterLuid; UINT VidPnSourceId; };
struct KmtWait { UINT hAdapter; UINT hDevice; UINT VidPnSourceId; };
struct KmtClose { UINT hAdapter; };
struct VBlank {
  std::mutex m;
  std::condition_variable cv;
  wchar_t want[32] = {};        // monitor (GDI name) to follow
  std::atomic<int64_t> tvRef{0};  // exact vblank period from QueryDisplayConfig (0 = measure)
  int64_t lastV = 0;            // phase estimate of the latest vblank (steady ns, tracks the earliest wake-ups)
  uint64_t seq = 0;             // vblank counter
  int64_t tvMeas = 0;           // measured period (filtered)
  bool ok = false;
};
VBlank g_vb;
std::once_flag g_vbOnce;
std::atomic<bool> g_vbDead{false};

void VBlankMain() {
  HMODULE g = LoadLibraryW(L"gdi32.dll");
  auto open = g ? (LONG(APIENTRY*)(KmtOpen*))GetProcAddress(g, "D3DKMTOpenAdapterFromGdiDisplayName") : nullptr;
  auto wait = g ? (LONG(APIENTRY*)(const KmtWait*))GetProcAddress(g, "D3DKMTWaitForVerticalBlankEvent") : nullptr;
  auto close = g ? (LONG(APIENTRY*)(const KmtClose*))GetProcAddress(g, "D3DKMTCloseAdapter") : nullptr;
  if (!open || !wait || !close) { fprintf(stderr, "[pace] D3DKMT vblank wait unavailable: steady-clock pacing\n"); g_vbDead = true; return; }
  SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST);
  KmtOpen o{};
  wchar_t cur[32] = {};
  bool isOpen = false;
  int fails = 0;
  for (;;) {
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m);
      if (wcscmp(cur, g_vb.want)) {
        if (isOpen) { KmtClose c{o.hAdapter}; close(&c); isOpen = false; }
        wcscpy_s(cur, g_vb.want);
        o = KmtOpen{}; wcscpy_s(o.DeviceName, cur);
        isOpen = cur[0] && open(&o) == 0;
        g_vb.lastV = 0; g_vb.tvMeas = 0; g_vb.ok = false;
        fprintf(stderr, "[pace] vblank clock on %ls: %s\n", cur, isOpen ? "open" : "D3DKMTOpenAdapterFromGdiDisplayName failed");
      }
    }
    if (!isOpen) { Sleep(50); continue; }
    KmtWait w{o.hAdapter, 0, o.VidPnSourceId};
    const LONG st = wait(&w);
    const int64_t t = NowNs();
    if (st != 0) {
      if (++fails == 20) fprintf(stderr, "[pace] vblank wait failing (0x%lx)\n", (unsigned long)st);
      { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m); g_vb.ok = false; }
      Sleep(fails > 20 ? 100 : 5);
      continue;
    }
    fails = 0;
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m);
      VBlank& v = g_vb;
      const int64_t ref = v.tvRef.load();
      if (v.lastV == 0) { v.lastV = t; v.seq++; }
      else {
        const int64_t d = t - v.lastV;
        const int64_t tv = ref > 0 ? ref : (v.tvMeas > 0 ? v.tvMeas : d);
        const int64_t n = std::max<int64_t>(1, (d + tv / 2) / tv);
        const int64_t per = d / n;
        if (n <= 8 && std::llabs(per - tv) < tv / 10) {
          v.tvMeas = v.tvMeas ? v.tvMeas + (per - v.tvMeas) / 32 : per;
          const int64_t pred = v.lastV + n * (ref > 0 ? ref : v.tvMeas);
          const int64_t e = t - pred;   // wake-ups are never early, so an early sample is the better phase estimate
          v.lastV = e < 0 ? t : pred + e / 16;
        } else v.lastV = t;   // display mode change or a long stall: re-anchor
        v.seq += (uint64_t)n;
      }
      v.ok = true;
    }
    g_vb.cv.notify_all();
  }
}
void StartVBlank() {
  if (kLegacy || EnvZero("SNAP_PACE_VBLANK")) { g_vbDead = true; return; }
  std::call_once(g_vbOnce, [] { std::thread(VBlankMain).detach(); });
}
struct VbSnap { bool ok; int64_t lastV, tv; uint64_t seq; };
VbSnap Snapshot(int64_t now) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m);
  const int64_t ref = g_vb.tvRef.load();
  VbSnap s{g_vb.ok, g_vb.lastV, ref > 0 ? ref : g_vb.tvMeas, g_vb.seq};
  if (s.tv <= 0 || now - s.lastV > 250000000) s.ok = false;   // no vblank for 250 ms (display off, wait failing)
  return s;
}

// ---- clock shared with the guest vsync thread
struct Clock {
  std::atomic<int64_t> U{16666667};   // guest vsync period on the free grid
  std::atomic<int> kv{0};             // vblanks per guest vsync when locked to the display (0 = free grid)
  std::atomic<uint64_t> parity{0};    // locked: vsync on vblank seqs == parity (mod kv)
} g_clk;
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_vsTicks{0};
std::atomic<int64_t> g_vsLast{0};

// ---- present wait (VK_KHR_present_id + VK_KHR_present_wait)
VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR g_fId{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR};
VkPhysicalDevicePresentWaitFeaturesKHR g_fWait{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_WAIT_FEATURES_KHR};
bool g_pwOn = false;
VkDevice g_dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR g_waitPresent = nullptr;
VkSwapchainKHR g_sc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
uint64_t g_nextId = 1, g_pendingId = 0, g_last1 = 0, g_last2 = 0;   // ids of the last two presents on g_sc
VkPresentIdKHR g_pid{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_ID_KHR};
int g_pwTimeouts = 0;
bool g_pwSuspended = false;
bool g_chained = false;

// ---- limiter state (present thread)
struct Rel {
  HMONITOR mon = nullptr;
  wchar_t name[32] = {};
  double hz = 0;
  int64_t hzAt = 0;
  int mode = 0;          // 0 none, 1 free grid, 2 locked to vblanks
  int kf = 0;            // vblanks per frame when locked
  int64_t lastIdx = 0;   // free grid index of the last release
  uint64_t lastSeq = 0;  // locked: vblank seq whose mid-point released the last frame
  int64_t lastP = 0;
  int lastLogMode = -1, lastLogK = -1;
  double lastLogHz = -1;
} g_rel;

// ---- SNAP_PACE_LOG
struct Log {
  FILE* f = nullptr;
  int64_t mk[6] = {};
  int64_t prevRelease = 0, prevEnd = 0, pwNs = 0, lateNs = 0;
  int pwTo = 0, mode = 0, kf = 0;
  double hz = 0;
  uint64_t n = 0, vsPrev = 0;
  bool open = false;
} g_log;
enum { K_PACE_BEGIN = 4, K_PACE_END = 5 };

void LogRow() {
  Log& L = g_log;
  if (!L.f) return;
  const int64_t rel = L.mk[K_PACE_END], beg = L.mk[K_PACE_BEGIN];
  auto ms = [](int64_t a, int64_t b) { return (a && b && b >= a) ? (double)(b - a) / 1e6 : 0.0; };
  const uint64_t vs = g_vsTicks.load();
  const int64_t vl = g_vsLast.load();
  fprintf(L.f, "%llu,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%d,%.3f,%.3f,%llu,%.3f,%c,%d,%.3f,%.3f\n", (unsigned long long)L.n, (double)(rel - kT0) / 1e6,
          ms(L.prevRelease, rel), ms(L.prevEnd, beg), ms(beg, rel), (double)L.pwNs / 1e6, L.pwTo, ms(L.mk[M_ACQ_BEGIN], L.mk[M_ACQ_END]),
          ms(L.mk[M_QP_BEGIN], L.mk[M_QP_END]), (unsigned long long)(vs - L.vsPrev), vl && rel ? (double)(rel - vl) / 1e6 : 0.0,
          kLegacy ? 'L' : L.mode == 2 ? 'K' : L.mode == 1 ? 'F' : 'N', L.kf, L.hz, (double)L.lateNs / 1e6);
  if ((++L.n & 127) == 0) fflush(L.f);
  L.vsPrev = vs;
  L.prevRelease = rel;
  L.prevEnd = L.mk[M_QP_END] ? L.mk[M_QP_END] : rel;
  L.pwNs = 0; L.pwTo = 0; L.lateNs = 0;
  memset(L.mk, 0, sizeof L.mk);
}

void UpdateDisplay(void* hwnd, int64_t now) {
  Rel& R = g_rel;
  static const char* monEnv = getenv("SNAP_PACE_MONITOR");   // test override: monitor number (\\.\DISPLAY<n>)
  static const double hzEnv = getenv("SNAP_PACE_REFRESH") ? atof(getenv("SNAP_PACE_REFRESH")) : 0.0;
  HMONITOR m = MonitorFromWindow((HWND)hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
  if (m == R.mon && now - R.hzAt < 30000000000LL) return;
  R.mon = m;
  R.hzAt = now;
  wchar_t name[32] = {};
  if (monEnv && *monEnv) swprintf(name, 32, L"\\\\.\\DISPLAY%d", atoi(monEnv));
  else { MONITORINFOEXW mi{}; mi.cbSize = sizeof mi; if (GetMonitorInfoW(m, &mi)) wcscpy_s(name, mi.szDevice); }
  const double hz = hzEnv > 0 ? hzEnv : (name[0] ? QueryHz(name) : 0.0);
  const bool changed = wcscmp(name, R.name) != 0 || std::fabs(hz - R.hz) > 0.001;
  wcscpy_s(R.name, name);
  R.hz = hz;
  g_vb.tvRef = hz > 1 ? (int64_t)std::llround(1e9 / hz) : 0;
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m); wcscpy_s(g_vb.want, name); }
  if (changed) { R.mode = 0; fprintf(stderr, "[pace] display %ls %.3f Hz\n", name, hz); }
}

// Waits for the present two frames back (queue depth cap). Never past `deadline`; after 3 timeouts in a row (minimized, hidden
// desktop, a driver that never signals) it only polls until a present completes again.
void QueueCap(VkSwapchainKHR sc, int64_t deadline) {
  if (!g_pwOn || !g_waitPresent || sc != g_sc || !g_last2) return;
  const int64_t t0 = NowNs();
  const uint64_t timeout = g_pwSuspended ? 0 : (uint64_t)std::max<int64_t>(0, deadline - t0);
  const VkResult r = g_waitPresent(g_dev, sc, g_last2, timeout);
  g_log.pwNs = NowNs() - t0;
  if (r == VK_SUCCESS) { g_pwTimeouts = 0; if (g_pwSuspended) { g_pwSuspended = false; fprintf(stderr, "[pace] present wait resumed\n"); } return; }
  if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) {
    if (!g_pwSuspended) { g_log.pwTo = 1; if (++g_pwTimeouts >= 3) { g_pwSuspended = true; fprintf(stderr, "[pace] present wait timing out: queue cap paused\n"); } }
    return;
  }
  g_pwSuspended = true;   // out of date / surface lost: the next swapchain resets this
}

}  // namespace

bool Legacy() { return kLegacy; }
bool LogOn() { return kLogPath && *kLogPath; }

void AppendDeviceExt(VkPhysicalDevice phys, std::vector<const char*>& dext, VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features* f11) {
  if (kLegacy || EnvZero("SNAP_PACE_WAIT")) return;
  uint32_t n = 0;
  vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(phys, nullptr, &n, nullptr);
  std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> ep(n);
  vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(phys, nullptr, &n, ep.data());
  auto has = [&](const char* s) { for (auto& e : ep) if (!strcmp(e.extensionName, s)) return true; return false; };
  if (!has(VK_KHR_PRESENT_ID_EXTENSION_NAME) || !has(VK_KHR_PRESENT_WAIT_EXTENSION_NAME)) { fprintf(stderr, "[pace] present wait not offered\n"); return; }
  VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR qi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR};
  VkPhysicalDevicePresentWaitFeaturesKHR qw{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_WAIT_FEATURES_KHR};
  qi.pNext = &qw;
  VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 q2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, &qi};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(phys, &q2);
  if (!qi.presentId || !qw.presentWait) { fprintf(stderr, "[pace] present wait feature off\n"); return; }
  for (auto& d : dext) if (!strcmp(d, VK_KHR_PRESENT_ID_EXTENSION_NAME) || !strcmp(d, VK_KHR_PRESENT_WAIT_EXTENSION_NAME)) return;   // already added
  dext.push_back(VK_KHR_PRESENT_ID_EXTENSION_NAME);
  dext.push_back(VK_KHR_PRESENT_WAIT_EXTENSION_NAME);
  g_fId.presentId = VK_TRUE; g_fWait.presentWait = VK_TRUE;
  g_fId.pNext = &g_fWait; g_fWait.pNext = f11->pNext; f11->pNext = &g_fId;
  g_pwOn = true;
}

void DeviceCreated(VkDevice dev) {
  g_dev = dev;
  if (g_pwOn) g_waitPresent = (PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, "vkWaitForPresentKHR");
  if (!g_waitPresent) g_pwOn = false;
  if (!kLegacy) fprintf(stderr, "[pace] model display (SNAP_PACE=legacy for the old limiter), present wait %s\n", g_pwOn ? "on" : "off");
}

void SwapchainCreated(VkSwapchainKHR sc, void*) {
  g_sc = sc;
  g_last1 = g_last2 = 0;
  g_pwTimeouts = 0;
  g_pwSuspended = false;
}

const void* PresentChain(VkSwapchainKHR sc) {
  g_chained = false;
  if (!g_pwOn || sc != g_sc) return nullptr;
  g_pendingId = g_nextId++;
  g_pid.pNext = nullptr; g_pid.swapchainCount = 1; g_pid.pPresentIds = &g_pendingId;
  g_chained = true;
  return &g_pid;
}

void Presented(VkSwapchainKHR sc, VkResult r) {
  if (!g_chained || sc != g_sc) return;
  g_chained = false;
  if (r == VK_SUCCESS || r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) { g_last2 = g_last1; g_last1 = g_pendingId; }
}

void Stamp(Mark m) {
  if (!LogOn()) return;
  g_log.mk[m] = NowNs();
}

void Release(void* hwnd, VkSwapchainKHR sc, int64_t base, int64_t vsyncNs) {
  if (kLegacy) return;
  StartVBlank();
  Rel& R = g_rel;
  int64_t now = NowNs();
  UpdateDisplay(hwnd, now);
  const double tvD = R.hz > 1 ? 1e9 / R.hz : 0.0;
  const VbSnap vb = Snapshot(now);
  // Lock to the display when its refresh is a whole multiple of the guest vsync rate (60, 59.94, 120 Hz...).
  auto multiple = [](double x) { const int k = (int)std::llround(x); return (k >= 1 && std::fabs(x - k) <= 0.006 * k) ? k : 0; };
  // Guest vsync period: whole display vblanks when the refresh allows it (59.94 Hz -> 16.683 ms), so the free grid of the
  // vsync thread and of the limiter below stay on one clock even without the vblank thread.
  const int kvD = (tvD > 0 && vsyncNs > 0) ? multiple(vsyncNs / tvD) : 0;
  g_clk.U = kvD ? (int64_t)std::llround(kvD * tvD) : (vsyncNs > 0 ? vsyncNs : 16666667);
  const int kv = vb.ok ? kvD : 0;
  const int kf = (kv && base > 0) ? multiple(base / tvD) : 0;
  g_clk.kv = kv;
  if (base <= 0) { R.mode = 0; if (LogOn()) g_log.mode = 0; return; }
  int64_t T;
  if (kf) {
    const int64_t tv = vb.tv;
    const uint64_t sNow = vb.seq + (uint64_t)(std::max<int64_t>(0, now - vb.lastV) / tv);
    uint64_t next = R.lastSeq + (uint64_t)kf;
    // Release half a vblank after vblank `next`: the frame shows on vblank next+1 whichever side of the mid-point jitter puts it.
    T = vb.lastV + ((int64_t)next - (int64_t)vb.seq) * tv + tv / 2;
    if (R.mode != 2 || R.kf != kf || R.lastSeq == 0 || next + (uint64_t)kf <= sNow || next > sNow + 2 * (uint64_t)kf) {
      next = sNow;   // (re)start, or more than a frame behind: release now (waiting for a mid-point would only slow a late game)
      T = now;
    }
    R.lastSeq = next;
    R.mode = 2; R.kf = kf;
    g_clk.parity = next % (uint64_t)kv;   // guest vsync on vblank `next`, half a vblank before the release (legacy: ~1.3 ms before)
  } else {
    // Free grid on the steady clock. With a known whole-multiple refresh but no vblank clock, use the display's exact period.
    int64_t P = base;
    if (kvD) if (const int k = multiple(base / tvD)) P = (int64_t)std::llround(k * tvD);
    if (R.mode != 1 || R.lastP != P) R.lastIdx = (now - kT0) / P - 1;
    int64_t idx = R.lastIdx + 1;
    T = kT0 + idx * P;
    if (now - T > P) { idx = (now - kT0) / P; T = kT0 + idx * P; }   // more than a period behind: drop the schedule
    R.lastIdx = idx; R.lastP = P;
    R.mode = 1; R.kf = 0;
  }
  if (R.mode != R.lastLogMode || R.kf != R.lastLogK || R.hz != R.lastLogHz) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[pace] %s, %ls %.3f Hz, vblank clock %s, frame %.3f ms\n", R.mode == 2 ? "locked to vblank" : "steady-clock grid", R.name, R.hz,
            vb.ok ? "ok" : (g_vbDead ? "unavailable" : "not ready"), R.mode == 2 ? kf * vb.tv / 1e6 : R.lastP / 1e6);
    R.lastLogMode = R.mode; R.lastLogK = R.kf; R.lastLogHz = R.hz;
  }
  QueueCap(sc, T + (R.mode == 2 ? vb.tv / 2 : base / 2));
  now = NowNs();
  if (T > now) WaitUntil(T, 300000);
  if (LogOn()) { g_log.mode = R.mode; g_log.kf = R.kf; g_log.hz = R.hz; g_log.lateNs = std::max<int64_t>(0, now - T); }
}

}  // namespace snap_pace

// Called from nvn_vk.cpp Pace() around the limiter (both models) so SNAP_PACE_LOG has the release time.
namespace snap_pace {
void PaceMark(bool end) {
  if (!LogOn()) return;
  Log& L = g_log;
  if (!L.open) {
    L.open = true;
    L.f = fopen(kLogPath, "w");
    if (L.f) fprintf(L.f, "n,t_ms,dt_ms,work_ms,pace_ms,pw_ms,pw_to,acq_ms,qp_ms,vs_n,vs_ph_ms,mode,kf,hz,late_ms\n");
  }
  if (!end) { if (L.mk[K_PACE_END]) LogRow(); L.mk[K_PACE_BEGIN] = NowNs(); }
  else L.mk[K_PACE_END] = NowNs();
}
}  // namespace snap_pace

// ---- guest vsync (runtime/hle/services_sys.cpp, nn::vi::GetDisplayVsyncEvent)
// snap_pace_vsync_wait blocks until the next guest vsync of the shared frame clock and returns 1; returns 0 under SNAP_PACE=legacy
// (the caller keeps its own 60 Hz sleep loop). snap_pace_vsync_note counts a tick for SNAP_PACE_LOG (legacy loop).
extern "C" void snap_pace_vsync_note() {
  snap_pace::g_vsTicks.fetch_add(1);
  snap_pace::g_vsLast = snap_pace::NowNs();
}

extern "C" int snap_pace_vsync_wait(int64_t* last) {
  using namespace snap_pace;
  if (kLegacy) return 0;
  StartVBlank();
  static uint64_t lastSeq = 0;
  const int kv = g_clk.kv.load();
  bool ticked = false;
  if (kv > 0 && !g_vbDead) {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_vb.m);
    const uint64_t k = (uint64_t)kv, par = g_clk.parity.load() % k;
    const uint64_t s0 = g_vb.seq;
    // Next vblank with the limiter's parity after the last tick; the current one only if the last tick was right before it.
    const uint64_t lo = (lastSeq && s0 >= lastSeq && s0 - lastSeq <= k) ? std::max(lastSeq + 1, s0) : s0 + 1;
    const uint64_t want = lo + (par + k - lo % k) % k;
    ticked = g_vb.cv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::milliseconds(100), [&] { return g_vb.seq >= want; });
    if (ticked) lastSeq = g_vb.seq - ((g_vb.seq - want) % k);
  }
  if (!ticked) {   // free grid shared with the limiter (also the fallback when the vblank clock stops)
    const int64_t U = g_clk.U.load(), now = NowNs();
    // 1 ms before each limiter tick (the old free-running thread happened to sit ~1.3 ms before the release; ticking exactly on
    // the release made the order of the two a coin flip).
    const int64_t a = kT0 - std::min<int64_t>(1000000, U / 8);
    int64_t next = a + ((now - a) / U + 1) * U;
    if (*last && next < *last + U / 2) next += U;
    WaitUntil(next, 0);
    lastSeq = 0;
  }
  *last = NowNs();
  snap_pace_vsync_note();
  return 1;
}
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_pace.h`:

```h
// Frame pacing (2026-11-13, pace worker; analysis/perf/pacing.md). One frame clock drives both the host frame limiter and the
// guest nn::vi vsync event, so the two can no longer drift apart. SNAP_PACE=legacy restores the old limiter (steady 60 Hz
// schedule, 1.5 ms spin) and the free-running 16667 us vsync thread.
//
// Model (default "display"):
//  - Refresh R of the monitor the window is on (QueryDisplayConfig, exact rational; SNAP_PACE_REFRESH=<hz> overrides).
//  - If R is within 0.6% of a whole multiple k of the target rate (60, 59.94, 120, 119.88, 240 Hz for 60 fps), the clock is
//    "locked": frame period = k vblanks, phase-locked to the real vblank through VK_KHR_present_wait. Each frame is released
//    half a vblank after the vblank before the one it should show on, so jitter on either side never moves it to another
//    vblank, and the FIFO queue never holds more than one frame (no queue build-up at 59.94 Hz, no 1-3 vblank judder at 120).
//  - Otherwise (144, 165, 75 Hz...) the clock is "free": the period is the target on the steady clock (VRR shows it as is;
//    a fixed-refresh display shows the unavoidable 2/3-vblank cadence). present_wait still caps the queue at one frame.
//  - No present_wait (unsupported, minimized, hidden desktop, timeouts): the same grid on the steady clock.
//  - Waits: high-resolution waitable timer, 0.3 ms final spin (Sleep(1) + timeBeginPeriod when the timer is missing).
//  - SNAP_PACE_LOG=<file.csv>: one row per present (release interval, waits, acquire/present times, display interval, vsync ticks).
#pragma once
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace snap_pace {

bool Legacy();   // SNAP_PACE=legacy
bool LogOn();    // SNAP_PACE_LOG set

// Device setup: adds VK_KHR_present_id + VK_KHR_present_wait (when offered and not legacy) and chains their feature structs after f11.
void AppendDeviceExt(VkPhysicalDevice phys, std::vector<const char*>& dext, VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features* f11);
void DeviceCreated(VkDevice dev);
void SwapchainCreated(VkSwapchainKHR sc, void* hwnd);

// Frame limiter, called before the present. basePeriodNs = presentInterval / paceHz (and the frame cap), 0 = unlimited;
// vsyncNs = 1 / paceHz (the guest vsync period before it is fitted to the display).
void Release(void* hwnd, VkSwapchainKHR sc, int64_t basePeriodNs, int64_t vsyncNs);
void PaceMark(bool end);   // SNAP_PACE_LOG: around the limiter in nvn_vk.cpp Pace() (both models)

// Present: chain the returned struct (or nullptr) into VkPresentInfoKHR::pNext, then report the result.
const void* PresentChain(VkSwapchainKHR sc);
void Presented(VkSwapchainKHR sc, VkResult r);

// SNAP_PACE_LOG timestamps inside the present (no-ops when the log is off).
enum Mark { M_ACQ_BEGIN = 0, M_ACQ_END, M_QP_BEGIN, M_QP_END, M_COUNT };
void Stamp(Mark m);

}  // namespace snap_pace
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_perf.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// GPU-side half of the SNAP_PERF instrumentation (runtime/os/perf.h): a ring of timestamp pairs around every command buffer the
// layer submits. Slots are collected at the next present once the queue's timeline has passed them. Only active with SNAP_PERF set.
// All entry points except PerfFrameMark are called with Host::queueMutex held (SubmitLists / PresentWindow); it takes the lock itself.
#include <algorithm>

#include "nvn_internal.h"
#include "os/perf.h"

namespace nvn {

namespace {
constexpr uint32_t kSlots = 2048;
struct Slot { uint64_t value = 0; bool submitted = false; bool used = false; };
VkQueryPool g_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
Slot g_slots[kSlots];
uint32_t g_next = 0;
bool g_failed = false;
}  // namespace

bool PerfGpuReady(Host* h) {
  if (!snap_perf::on || g_failed) return false;
  if (g_pool) return true;
  if (!h->hostQueryReset) { g_failed = true; return false; }
  VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
  qi.queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP; qi.queryCount = kSlots * 2;
  if (vkCreateQueryPool(h->device, &qi, nullptr, &g_pool) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_failed = true; g_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return false; }
  return true;
}

int PerfGpuBegin(Host* h, VkCommandBuffer cb) {
  if (!PerfGpuReady(h)) return -1;
  const uint32_t s = g_next++ % kSlots;
  if (g_slots[s].used) return -1;   // ring full of uncollected slots: skip this one
  g_slots[s] = {0, false, true};
  vkResetQueryPool(h->device, g_pool, s * 2, 2);
  vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, g_pool, s * 2);
  return (int)s;
}

void PerfGpuEnd(Host*, VkCommandBuffer cb, int slot) {
  if (slot < 0) return;
  vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, g_pool, (uint32_t)slot * 2 + 1);
}

void PerfGpuSubmitted(int slot, uint64_t value) {
  if (slot < 0) return;
  g_slots[slot].value = value; g_slots[slot].submitted = true;
}

void PerfFrameMark(QueueImpl* q, uint64_t presentNo) {
  if (!snap_perf::on) return;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(q->host->queueMutex);
  double busy = -1, span = -1; int cbs = 0;
  if (g_pool) {
    uint64_t done = 0;
    vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(q->host->device, q->timeline, &done);
    const double period = q->host->props.limits.timestampPeriod;
    uint64_t lo = UINT64_MAX, hi = 0, sum = 0;
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < kSlots; s++) {
      Slot& sl = g_slots[s];
      if (!sl.used || !sl.submitted || sl.value > done) continue;
      uint64_t t[2] = {0, 0};
      if (vkGetQueryPoolResults(q->host->device, g_pool, s * 2, 2, sizeof t, t, 8, VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT) == VK_SUCCESS && t[1] >= t[0]) {
        sum += t[1] - t[0]; lo = std::min(lo, t[0]); hi = std::max(hi, t[1]); cbs++;
      }
      sl.used = false; sl.submitted = false;
    }
    busy = (double)sum * period / 1e6;
    span = hi > lo ? (double)(hi - lo) * period / 1e6 : 0;
  }
  snap_perf::frame_mark(presentNo, busy, span, cbs);
}

}  // namespace nvn

```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_pipeline.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Persistent + asynchronous graphics-pipeline compilation for the NVN layer.
//
//  * Every pipeline the game creates is identified by a PipeDesc (stage cache keys + state) and recorded in an append-only key list
//    (<shadercache>\pipeline_keys.bin). The VkPipelineCache is saved next to it every 30 s while new pipelines appear, so killing the
//    process loses at most 30 s (it used to be written only on a clean device teardown, which never happens when the window closes).
//  * At startup the recorded keys are compiled on a worker pool (shaderprecompile_begin / mode NOW or PLAYING) and stored in the ready map,
//    so the first draw that needs them finds a finished VkPipeline.
//  * A pipeline the game needs that is not ready compiles on the pool (hot queue first); the draw is skipped until it is ready
//    (SNAP_PIPELINE_ASYNC=0 compiles inline on the replay thread instead, the old behaviour).
//  * Files are versioned by game build, translator version, descriptor layout and (cache blob only) driver identity; a mismatch discards them.
#define NOMINMAX
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "nvn_pipeline.h"
#include "os/perf.h"
#include "shaderprecompile.h"

namespace nvn {

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kFormatVersion = 1;
constexpr uint32_t kMagicKeys = 0x4B504E53;    // 'SNPK'
constexpr uint32_t kMagicCache = 0x43504E53;   // 'SNPC'

struct FileHdr {
  uint32_t magic, version, descSize, pad;
  uint64_t translator, gameBuild;
  uint32_t vendor, device, driver, pad2;
  uint8_t uuid[16];
};

uint64_t Fnv(const void* p, size_t n, uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull) {
  const uint8_t* b = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { h ^= b[i]; h *= 0x100000001b3ull; }
  return h;
}
// In-memory map key only (never written to a file; entries compare the whole desc). Word-wise (opt 2026-11-13): the byte-wise
// FNV over 464 bytes ran once per draw in PipelineAcquire, the hottest loop of the replay thread in a PGO profile.
uint64_t HashDesc(const PipeDesc& pd) {
  static_assert(sizeof(PipeDesc) % 8 == 0, "word hash");
  const uint8_t* b = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&pd);
  uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof pd; i += 8) { uint64_t w; memcpy(&w, b + i, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull; h ^= h >> 31; }
  return h;
}

enum EntState { ES_PENDING = 0, ES_READY = 1, ES_FAILED = 2, ES_NEEDS_INLINE = 3 };
struct Ent {
  PipeDesc pd;
  std::atomic<VkPipeline> pipe{VK_NULL_HANDLE};   // atomic: a stale rebuild on the replay thread can race a worker's StoreResult for the same entry
  std::atomic<int> state{ES_PENDING};
  Ent* next = nullptr;   // hash chain
  std::atomic<bool> hot{false};   // a hot-queue job exists (set when the replay thread first asks for an entry that BeginRun queued cold)
  std::atomic<bool> stale{false};  // built from a fragment template that lacked early fragment tests: rebuilt inline on the next acquire
};

struct Tmpl {
  std::once_flag once;
  StageProg sp;      // as loaded from the translation cache; never modified after the load
  // What readers (background compiles, GetLayoutFor) use. PatchTmplEft publishes a patched COPY here instead of editing \sp\ in place: a worker
  // reading mod / spv / fragMods through the old pointer keeps a valid, unchanging object (the old one is never freed while the service runs).
  std::atomic<StageProg*> cur{nullptr};
  bool ok = false;
  std::mutex em;     // guards eft and the module swap in PatchTmplEft
  bool eft = false;  // the module carries layout(early_fragment_tests)
};

struct Job { PipeDesc pd; bool hot; };

struct Svc {
  Host* h = nullptr;
  bool up = false;
  std::string dir;
  uint64_t translatorHash = 0, buildHash = 0;
  bool async = true;
  std::atomic<int> mode{SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_UNSET};

  // ready map
  std::mutex pm;
  std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Ent*> map;
  // stage templates, layouts
  std::mutex tm;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, Tmpl*> tmpls;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> fullKeys;   // key prefix -> full translation cache key
  std::unordered_set<std::string> eftKeys;                 // key prefixes whose program asks for early fragment tests (guarded by tm)
  std::mutex lm;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, ProgramImpl*> layouts;
  // job queues and workers
  std::mutex qm;
  std::condition_variable qcv;
  std::deque<Job> hot, cold;
  std::vector<std::thread> workers;
  std::atomic<int> activeLimit{2};
  int running = 0;
  bool stop = false;
  // key list
  std::mutex km;
  FILE* keysFile = nullptr;
  std::vector<PipeDesc> known;
  // progress of the current precompile run
  std::atomic<int> state{SHADERPRECOMPILE_IDLE};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> total{0}, done{0}, failed{0};
  std::atomic<uint64_t> runStartNs{0}, busyNs{0};
  std::atomic<bool> cancel{false};
  std::atomic<uint32_t> bgPending{0};
  // cache persistence
  std::atomic<bool> dirty{false};
  std::atomic<uint64_t> lastSaveNs{0};
  std::thread housekeeper;
  double avgMs = 25.0;   // measured average compile time of a precompile run (persisted in stats.txt)
};
Svc* S = nullptr;
std::mutex g_early;                // guards the early requests below
bool g_wantBegin = false;
int g_earlyMode = -1;
std::string g_buildId = "DDB900FF04A912ED42430508389853CFAF1ACCCE";

std::string Dir() {
  const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR");
  std::string d;
  if (e && *e) d = e;
  else if ((e = getenv("SNAP_CONFIG_DIR")) && *e) d = std::string(e) + "\\shadercache";
  else {
    char buf[MAX_PATH] = {};
    DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableA("APPDATA", buf, MAX_PATH);
    d = (n ? std::string(buf) : std::string(".")) + "\\SnapRecomp\\shadercache";
  }
  if (const char* r = getenv("SNAP_XLATE_REV"); r && *r && strcmp(r, "0")) d += std::string("_r") + r;   // translator revision: its own pipeline keys and VkPipelineCache
  for (size_t i = 3; i < d.size(); i++)
    if (d[i] == '\\' || d[i] == '/') CreateDirectoryA(d.substr(0, i).c_str(), nullptr);
  CreateDirectoryA(d.c_str(), nullptr);
  return d;
}

FileHdr MakeHdr(Host* h, uint32_t magic, bool withDriver) {
  FileHdr x{};
  x.magic = magic; x.version = kFormatVersion; x.descSize = (uint32_t)sizeof(PipeDesc);
  x.translator = S->translatorHash; x.gameBuild = S->buildHash;
  if (withDriver) {
    x.vendor = h->props.vendorID; x.device = h->props.deviceID; x.driver = h->props.driverVersion;
    memcpy(x.uuid, h->props.pipelineCacheUUID, 16);
  }
  return x;
}
bool HdrMatches(const FileHdr& a, const FileHdr& b) { return memcmp(&a, &b, sizeof a) == 0; }

double NowMs() { return (double)snap_perf::now_ns() / 1e6; }

// ---- templates and layouts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Early fragment tests on background templates. BuildStage adds layout(early_fragment_tests) when the program's control section asks for
// it (EvaluationAggregatePS) and leaves a <key>.efz marker so cache loads can do the same. Test runs mirror the shader cache from
// build\snap\nvn_cache, which has no markers, so the startup precompile could load the Aggregate template before the game rebuilt the
// marker: its pipeline then ran the stencil test after the shader's atomics and every visibility counter read 518400 (all of 1920x1080 / 4),
// so no photo passed. Now BuildStage also tells the service directly (eftKeys); a template loaded too early is patched and the pipelines
// built from it are rebuilt inline. NVN_NO_EFT_FIX=1 restores the old marker-only behavior.
bool EftFixOn() { static const bool on = getenv("NVN_NO_EFT_FIX") == nullptr; return on; }

void PatchTmplEft(Tmpl* t, const char* key12) {
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(t->em);
    StageProg* base = t->cur.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (t->eft || !t->ok || !base || base->stage != 1 || base->spv.empty()) return;
    std::vector<uint32_t> words = base->spv;
    if (!SpvAddEarlyFragmentTests(words)) return;
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
    ci.codeSize = words.size() * 4; ci.pCode = words.data();
    VkShaderModule mod = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(S->h->device, &ci, nullptr, &mod) != VK_SUCCESS) return;
    // Copy field by field (not "*np = *base": copying base->fragMods would race a worker inserting a variant). fragMods starts empty: the old
    // variants were built from the module without early fragment tests. A field added to StageProg must be added here.
    StageProg* np = new StageProg;
    np->valid = base->valid; memcpy(np->key, base->key, sizeof np->key); memcpy(np->fkey, base->fkey, sizeof np->fkey); np->stage = base->stage;
    np->cb = base->cb; np->sb = base->sb; np->tex = base->tex; np->img = base->img; np->fragOutputMap = base->fragOutputMap;
    np->inputMask = base->inputMask; np->outLocs = base->outLocs; np->constBuf = base->constBuf; np->constMem = base->constMem; np->constSize = base->constSize;
    np->mod = mod;   // the old module is left alive on purpose: a worker may be compiling with it right now (one module per patched stage)
    np->spv = std::move(words);
    t->cur.store(np, std::memory_order_release);
    t->eft = true;
  }
  int n = 0;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->pm);
    for (auto& kv : S->map)
      for (Ent* e = kv.second; e; e = e->next)
        if (!strncmp(e->pd.stage[1], key12, 12)) { e->stale = true; n++; }
  }
  Log("pipeline service: fragment template %.12s patched with early fragment tests, %d pipelines rebuilt on next use", key12, n);
}

Tmpl* GetTmpl(const char* key12) {
  Tmpl* t;
  std::string full;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->tm);
    auto& slot = S->tmpls[key12];
    if (!slot) slot = new Tmpl;
    t = slot;
    auto it = S->fullKeys.find(key12);
    if (it != S->fullKeys.end()) full = it->second;
  }
  if (full.empty() && S->h) {   // startup precompile: the game has not built this stage yet, find its translation in the shader cache by the 12-hex prefix
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE hf = FindFirstFileA((S->h->cacheDir + "\\" + key12 + "*.spv").c_str(), &fd);
    if (hf != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
      std::string n = fd.cFileName;
      if (n.size() > 4) full = n.substr(0, n.size() - 4);
      FindClose(hf);
    }
  }
  std::call_once(t->once, [&] {
    if (full.empty()) return;
    bool want, applied = false;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->tm); want = EftFixOn() && S->eftKeys.count(key12) != 0; }
    t->ok = LoadStageFromCache(S->h, full, &t->sp, want, &applied);
    t->cur.store(&t->sp, std::memory_order_release);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(t->em); t->eft = applied; }
    bool late;   // the game registered the program as early-fragment-tests while this load ran
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->tm); late = t->ok && EftFixOn() && S->eftKeys.count(key12) != 0; }
    if (late) PatchTmplEft(t, key12);
  });
  return t->ok ? t : nullptr;
}

ProgramImpl* GetLayoutFor(const PipeDesc& pd, StageProg* out[6]) {
  std::string key;
  Tmpl* ts[5] = {};
  for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) {
    out[s] = nullptr;
    if (!pd.stage[s][0]) continue;
    ts[s] = GetTmpl(pd.stage[s]);
    if (!ts[s]) return nullptr;
    out[s] = ts[s]->cur.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    key += pd.stage[s]; key += '|';
  }
  out[5] = nullptr;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->lm);
  auto it = S->layouts.find(key);
  if (it != S->layouts.end()) return it->second;
  auto* p = new ProgramImpl;
  p->host = S->h; p->composite = true;
  for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) if (ts[s]) p->st[s] = *ts[s]->cur.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
  if (!ProgramBuildLayout(p)) { delete p; S->layouts[key] = nullptr; return nullptr; }
  S->layouts[key] = p;
  return p;
}

// ---- key list --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void LoadKeys() {
  const std::string path = S->dir + "\\pipeline_keys.bin";
  const FileHdr want = MakeHdr(S->h, kMagicKeys, false);
  bool good = false;
  {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    FileHdr got{};
    if (f && f.read((char*)&got, sizeof got) && HdrMatches(got, want)) {
      good = true;
      PipeDesc pd;
      std::unordered_set<uint64_t> seen;
      uint64_t nGood = 0;
      // Records are fixed size, so a torn tail (the process was killed mid-write) would shift every record appended after it. Stop at the first
      // short or implausible record and cut the file there before anything is appended.
      while (f.read((char*)&pd, sizeof pd)) {
        bool ok = pd.nattr >= 0 && pd.nattr <= 16 && pd.nstream >= 0 && pd.nstream <= 16 && pd.nColor >= 0 && pd.nColor <= 8;
        for (int s = 0; s < 5 && ok; s++) ok = pd.stage[s][15] == 0;
        if (!ok) break;
        nGood++;
        // [vkval] keys recorded before the compressed-render-target stand-in existed carry a block-compressed colour format (BC1 photo
        // thumbnails): Vulkan cannot render to those (VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-renderPass-06582 at startup), and the live draw
        // now uses the stand-in format, so the old key is never hit. Do not precompile it.
        bool compressedRt = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < pd.nColor; i++) if (pd.colorFmt[i] >= 131 && pd.colorFmt[i] <= 184) compressedRt = true;   // VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB..ASTC_12x12
        if (compressedRt) continue;
        if (seen.insert(HashDesc(pd)).second) S->known.push_back(pd);
      }
      f.close();
      const uint64_t goodLen = sizeof(FileHdr) + nGood * sizeof(PipeDesc);
      std::error_code ec;
      const uint64_t have = std::filesystem::file_size(path, ec);
      if (!ec && have != goodLen) {
        std::filesystem::resize_file(path, goodLen, ec);
        Log("pipeline keys: cut %llu stray byte(s) after record %llu%s", (unsigned long long)(have - goodLen), (unsigned long long)nGood, ec ? " (resize failed)" : "");
        if (ec) good = false;   // cannot repair: start a fresh list rather than append after a torn record
      }
    }
  }
  if (!good) {   // missing or from another build / translator / descriptor layout: start a fresh list
    S->known.clear();
    S->keysFile = fopen(path.c_str(), "wb");
    if (S->keysFile) { fwrite(&want, sizeof want, 1, S->keysFile); fflush(S->keysFile); }
  } else {
    S->keysFile = fopen(path.c_str(), "ab");
  }
}
void RecordKey(const PipeDesc& pd) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->km);
  if (!S->keysFile) return;
  fwrite(&pd, sizeof pd, 1, S->keysFile);
  fflush(S->keysFile);
}

// ---- pipeline cache persistence ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void LoadCache(Host* h) {
  std::ifstream f(S->dir + "\\pipeline_cache.bin", std::ios::binary);
  FileHdr got{};
  const FileHdr want = MakeHdr(h, kMagicCache, true);
  if (!f || !f.read((char*)&got, sizeof got) || !HdrMatches(got, want)) return;   // other driver / build / translator: the blob is useless
  std::vector<char> data((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
  if (data.empty()) return;
  VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_CACHE_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.initialDataSize = data.size(); ci.pInitialData = data.data();
  VkPipelineCache pc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreatePipelineCache(h->device, &ci, nullptr, &pc) == VK_SUCCESS) {
    if (h->pipelineCache) vkDestroyPipelineCache(h->device, h->pipelineCache, nullptr);
    h->pipelineCache = pc;
    Log("pipeline cache loaded (%zu bytes)", data.size());
  }
}
void SaveCache(bool force) {
  Host* h = S->h;
  if (!h->pipelineCache || (!force && !S->dirty.exchange(false))) return;
  size_t n = 0;
  if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(h->device, h->pipelineCache, &n, nullptr) != VK_SUCCESS || !n) return;
  std::vector<char> data(n);
  if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(h->device, h->pipelineCache, &n, data.data()) != VK_SUCCESS) return;
  // The housekeeper and the thread finishing a precompile run can both get here: each writes its own tmp file, then renames it into place
  // (MoveFileEx replace is atomic), so the cache file is always one writer's complete blob.
  static std::atomic<unsigned> saveSeq{0};
  const std::string path = S->dir + "\\pipeline_cache.bin",
                    tmp = path + "." + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()) + "." + std::to_string(saveSeq.fetch_add(1)) + ".tmp";
  {
    std::ofstream f(tmp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    const FileHdr hdr = MakeHdr(h, kMagicCache, true);
    f.write((const char*)&hdr, sizeof hdr);
    f.write(data.data(), (std::streamsize)n);
    f.flush();
    if (!f.good()) { f.close(); DeleteFileA(tmp.c_str()); return; }
  }
  if (!MoveFileExA(tmp.c_str(), path.c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)) { DeleteFileA(tmp.c_str()); return; }
  S->lastSaveNs = snap_perf::now_ns();
  Log("pipeline cache saved (%zu bytes)", n);
}

// ---- compile jobs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void StoreResult(Ent* e, VkPipeline pipe, int failState) {
  e->pipe = pipe;
  e->state.store(pipe ? ES_READY : failState, std::memory_order_release);
}

Ent* FindOrNull(const PipeDesc& pd, uint64_t hsh) {   // caller holds pm
  auto it = S->map.find(hsh);
  for (Ent* e = it == S->map.end() ? nullptr : it->second; e; e = e->next)
    if (memcmp(&e->pd, &pd, sizeof pd) == 0) return e;
  return nullptr;
}

void RunJob(const Job& j) {
  const uint64_t hsh = HashDesc(j.pd);
  Ent* e;
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->pm); e = FindOrNull(j.pd, hsh); }
  if (!e || e->state.load() == ES_READY) return;
  StageProg* st[6];
  ProgramImpl* lay = GetLayoutFor(j.pd, st);
  VkPipeline pipe = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (lay) pipe = CreateGraphicsPipeline(S->h, j.pd, st, lay->layout);
  StoreResult(e, pipe, ES_NEEDS_INLINE);   // a failed background build is retried inline by the replay thread (it has the real program)
  if (pipe) S->dirty = true;
}

void Worker() {
  for (;;) {
    Job j;
    bool isHot;
    {
      std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(S->qm);
      for (;;) {
        if (S->stop) return;
        const bool canRun = S->running < S->activeLimit.load() || !S->hot.empty();
        if (canRun && (!S->hot.empty() || (!S->cold.empty() && !S->cancel.load()))) break;
        if (S->cancel.load() && !S->cold.empty()) { S->cold.clear(); }
        S->qcv.wait_for(lk, std::chrono::milliseconds(200));
      }
      isHot = !S->hot.empty();
      if (isHot) { j = S->hot.front(); S->hot.pop_front(); }
      else { j = S->cold.front(); S->cold.pop_front(); }
      S->running++;
    }
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), isHot ? THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL
                                                : (S->mode.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW ? THREAD_PRIORITY_NORMAL : THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL));
    const uint64_t t0 = snap_perf::now_ns();
    RunJob(j);
    const uint64_t dt = snap_perf::now_ns() - t0;
    if (isHot) { if (S->bgPending.load()) S->bgPending--; }
    else {
      S->busyNs += dt;
      const uint32_t d = ++S->done;
      if (d >= S->total.load() && S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING) {
        S->state = SHADERPRECOMPILE_DONE;
        const double wallMs = (double)(snap_perf::now_ns() - S->runStartNs.load()) / 1e6;
        char det[96]; snprintf(det, sizeof det, "%u pipelines", d);
        snap_perf::event("precompile_done", wallMs, det);
        if (d) S->avgMs = (double)S->busyNs.load() / 1e6 / d;
        SaveCache(true);
        std::ofstream st(S->dir + "\\stats.txt", std::ios::trunc);
        st << S->avgMs << "\n";
      }
    }
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm); S->running--; }
    S->qcv.notify_all();
  }
}

int WorkerCountFor(int mode) {
  if (const char* e = getenv("SNAP_PIPELINE_THREADS")) { int n = atoi(e); if (n > 0) return std::min(n, 32); }
  const int hw = (int)std::max(2u, std::thread::hardware_concurrency());
  if (mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW) return std::clamp(hw / 2, 2, 16);
  return std::clamp(hw / 8, 2, 4);
}
void EnsureWorkers(int want) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm);
  S->activeLimit = want;
  while ((int)S->workers.size() < want) S->workers.emplace_back(Worker);
}

void Housekeeping() {
  while (true) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      Sleep(100);
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm);
      if (S->stop) return;
    }
    if (S->dirty.load() && (snap_perf::now_ns() - S->lastSaveNs.load()) > 30ull * 1000000000ull) SaveCache(false);
  }
}

int BeginRun() {
  if (!S || !S->up) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_early); g_wantBegin = true; return 0; }
  std::vector<PipeDesc> todo, knownCopy;
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->km); knownCopy = S->known; }
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->pm);
    for (const PipeDesc& pd : knownCopy) {
      const uint64_t hsh = HashDesc(pd);
      if (FindOrNull(pd, hsh)) continue;
      Ent* e = new Ent; memcpy(&e->pd, &pd, sizeof pd);
      e->next = S->map.count(hsh) ? S->map[hsh] : nullptr;
      S->map[hsh] = e;
      todo.push_back(pd);
    }
  }
  S->cancel = false;
  S->done = 0; S->failed = 0; S->busyNs = 0;
  S->total = (uint32_t)todo.size();
  S->runStartNs = snap_perf::now_ns();
  if (todo.empty()) { S->state = SHADERPRECOMPILE_DONE; return 0; }
  S->state = SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING;
  EnsureWorkers(WorkerCountFor(S->mode.load()));
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm);
    for (auto& pd : todo) S->cold.push_back({pd, false});
  }
  S->qcv.notify_all();
  return (int)todo.size();
}

}  // namespace

// ---- public service API -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void PipelineRegisterStageKey(const char* key12, const char* fullKey, bool eft) {
  if (!S) return;
  Tmpl* t = nullptr;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->tm);
    S->fullKeys.emplace(key12, fullKey);
    if (eft && EftFixOn()) {
      S->eftKeys.insert(key12);
      auto it = S->tmpls.find(key12);
      if (it != S->tmpls.end()) t = it->second;
    }
  }
  if (t && t->ok) PatchTmplEft(t, key12);   // loaded before the game built the program (a load still running re-checks eftKeys itself)
}

void PipelineServiceInit(Host* h) {
  if (S) return;
  S = new Svc;
  S->h = h;
  S->dir = Dir();
  S->translatorHash = Fnv(TranslatorVersion(), strlen(TranslatorVersion()));
  const char* b = getenv("SNAP_GAME_BUILD_ID");
  S->buildHash = Fnv(b && *b ? b : g_buildId.c_str(), strlen(b && *b ? b : g_buildId.c_str()));
  const char* as = getenv("SNAP_PIPELINE_ASYNC");
  S->async = !(as && *as == '0');
  // mode: env override, else <dir>\mode.txt
  int mode = SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_UNSET;
  if (const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SHADER_PRECOMPILE")) mode = !strcmp(e, "now") ? SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW : !strcmp(e, "playing") ? SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING : mode;
  else {
    std::ifstream f(S->dir + "\\mode.txt");
    std::string w;
    if (f >> w) mode = w == "now" ? SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW : w == "playing" ? SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING : mode;
  }
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_early); if (g_earlyMode >= 0) mode = g_earlyMode; }
  S->mode = mode;
  { std::ifstream f(S->dir + "\\stats.txt"); double v; if (f >> v && v > 0.1 && v < 5000) S->avgMs = v; }
  // enumerate the translation cache so background jobs can load any stage by its key prefix
  {
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE hf = FindFirstFileA((h->cacheDir + "\\*.json").c_str(), &fd);
    if (hf != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
      do {
        std::string n = fd.cFileName;
        if (n.size() == 64 + 5) S->fullKeys.emplace(n.substr(0, 12), n.substr(0, 64));
      } while (FindNextFileA(hf, &fd));
      FindClose(hf);
    }
  }
  LoadCache(h);
  LoadKeys();
  S->lastSaveNs = snap_perf::now_ns();
  S->housekeeper = std::thread(Housekeeping);
  S->up = true;
  Log("pipeline service: %zu recorded pipelines, mode %d, async %d, dir %s", S->known.size(), mode, (int)S->async, S->dir.c_str());
  bool begin;
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_early); begin = g_wantBegin; g_wantBegin = false; }
  // NOW and PLAYING both start the run at boot; only NOW holds the game. UNSET waits for the UI's choice (or an explicit begin()).
  if (begin || mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW || mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING) BeginRun();
}

void PipelineServiceShutdown(Host* h) {
  if (!S) return;
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm); S->stop = true; S->cancel = true; }
  S->qcv.notify_all();
  for (auto& t : S->workers) if (t.joinable()) t.join();
  if (S->housekeeper.joinable()) S->housekeeper.join();
  SaveCache(true);
  for (auto& kv : S->map)
    for (Ent* e = kv.second; e;) { Ent* n = e->next; if (e->pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(h->device, e->pipe, nullptr); delete e; e = n; }
  S->map.clear();
  for (auto& kv : S->layouts) if (kv.second) { ProgramDestroy(kv.second); delete kv.second; }
  for (auto& kv : S->tmpls) {
    Tmpl* t = kv.second;
    StageProg* c = t->cur.load();
    if (t->ok && t->sp.mod) vkDestroyShaderModule(h->device, t->sp.mod, nullptr);
    if (c && c != &t->sp) { if (c->mod) vkDestroyShaderModule(h->device, c->mod, nullptr); delete c; }   // the PatchTmplEft copy
    delete t;
  }
  if (S->keysFile) fclose(S->keysFile);
  S->up = false;
}

VkPipeline PipelineAcquire(Host* h, const PipeDesc& pd, ProgramImpl* p, bool* pending, bool mustHave) {
  if (!S || !S->up) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  const uint64_t hsh = HashDesc(pd);
  Ent* e;
  bool isNew = false;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->pm);
    e = FindOrNull(pd, hsh);
    if (!e) {
      e = new Ent; memcpy(&e->pd, &pd, sizeof pd);
      auto it = S->map.find(hsh);
      e->next = it == S->map.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
      S->map[hsh] = e;
      isNew = true;
    }
  }
  if (!isNew) {
    int st = e->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (st == ES_PENDING && mustHave && S->async) {   // wait for the background compile (hot jobs run first); give up after 10 s
      if (!e->hot.exchange(true)) {
        S->bgPending++;
        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm); S->hot.push_back({pd, true}); }
        S->qcv.notify_one();
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < 10000 && (st = e->state.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) == ES_PENDING; i++) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }
    if (st == ES_READY && e->stale.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && p) {   // see PatchTmplEft: rebuild with the game's own (patched) stages
      StageProg* sts[6] = {};
      for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) sts[s] = p->st[s].valid ? &p->st[s] : nullptr;
      if (VkPipeline pipe = CreateGraphicsPipeline(h, pd, sts, p->layout)) { e->stale = false; e->pipe = pipe; S->dirty = true; }   // old pipeline leaked: may be in flight
      return e->pipe;
    }
    if (st == ES_READY) return e->pipe;
    if (st == ES_PENDING) {
      if (S->async && !e->hot.exchange(true)) {   // queued cold by the precompile run, but the game needs it now: add a hot job
        S->bgPending++;
        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm); S->hot.push_back({pd, true}); }
        S->qcv.notify_one();
      }
      *pending = true;
      return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (st == ES_FAILED) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    // ES_NEEDS_INLINE: the background build failed (e.g. a stage missing from the translation cache): build on this thread with the real program
    StageProg* sts[6] = {};
    for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) sts[s] = p->st[s].valid ? &p->st[s] : nullptr;
    VkPipeline pipe = CreateGraphicsPipeline(h, pd, sts, p->layout);
    StoreResult(e, pipe, ES_FAILED);
    if (pipe) S->dirty = true;
    return pipe;
  }
  // first request of this pipeline in this run
  bool known = false;
  {
    // recorded earlier (a previous run) pipelines are already in the map from BeginRun; reaching here means it is genuinely new
    (void)known;
    RecordKey(pd);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->km);
    S->known.push_back(pd);
  }
  if (S->async && !mustHave) {
    EnsureWorkers(std::max(S->activeLimit.load(), WorkerCountFor(S->mode.load())));
    e->hot = true;
    S->bgPending++;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(S->qm); S->hot.push_back({pd, true}); }
    S->qcv.notify_one();
    *pending = true;
    return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  }
  StageProg* sts[6] = {};
  for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) sts[s] = p->st[s].valid ? &p->st[s] : nullptr;
  VkPipeline pipe = CreateGraphicsPipeline(h, pd, sts, p->layout);
  StoreResult(e, pipe, ES_FAILED);
  if (pipe) S->dirty = true;
  return pipe;
}

bool PipelineHoldGame() {
  return S && S->up && S->mode.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW && S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING && !S->cancel.load();
}

}  // namespace nvn

// ---- C API ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using namespace nvn;
extern "C" {

int shaderprecompile_begin(void) { return BeginRun(); }
int shaderprecompile_state(void) { return S ? S->state.load() : SHADERPRECOMPILE_IDLE; }
void shaderprecompile_progress(uint32_t* done, uint32_t* total, double* eta) {
  const uint32_t d = S ? S->done.load() : 0, t = S ? S->total.load() : 0;
  if (done) *done = d;
  if (total) *total = t;
  if (eta) {
    *eta = -1;
    if (S && d > 0 && S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING) {
      const double el = (double)(snap_perf::now_ns() - S->runStartNs.load()) / 1e9;
      *eta = el / d * (t - d);
    } else if (S && S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_DONE) *eta = 0;
  }
}
void shaderprecompile_cancel(void) {
  if (!S) return;
  S->cancel = true;
  if (S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING) S->state = SHADERPRECOMPILE_CANCELLED;
  S->qcv.notify_all();
}
int shaderprecompile_get_mode(void) { return S ? S->mode.load() : SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_UNSET; }
void shaderprecompile_set_mode(int mode) {
  if (mode < 0 || mode > 2) return;
  if (!S || !S->up) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_early); g_earlyMode = mode; return; }
  S->mode = mode;
  std::ofstream f(S->dir + "\\mode.txt", std::ios::trunc);
  f << (mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW ? "now" : mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING ? "playing" : "unset") << "\n";
  if (mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW && S->state.load() != SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING) BeginRun();
}
double shaderprecompile_estimate_seconds(void) {
  if (!S) return -1;
  const int thr = WorkerCountFor(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW);
  size_t todo = S->total.load() ? (S->state.load() == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING ? S->total.load() - S->done.load() : S->total.load()) : S->known.size();
  return (double)todo * S->avgMs / 1000.0 / std::max(thr, 1);
}
int shaderprecompile_is_holding_game(void) { return PipelineHoldGame() ? 1 : 0; }
uint32_t shaderprecompile_background_pending(void) { return S ? S->bgPending.load() : 0; }

}  // extern "C"
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_pipeline.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Persistent, asynchronous pipeline compilation (nvn_pipeline.cpp). A graphics pipeline is identified by a PipeDesc: the stable
// translation-cache keys of its shader stages plus every piece of state the pipeline depends on. The descriptor is plain data,
// so it can be recorded to disk and replayed at startup on a worker pool; runtime misses compile on the same pool while the draw
// is skipped (or the replay thread compiles inline when SNAP_PIPELINE_ASYNC=0).
#pragma once
#include <type_traits>

#include "nvn_internal.h"
#include "nvn_state.h"

namespace nvn {

struct PipeDesc {                 // zero-initialised, then filled: memcmp / hash equality is identity
  char stage[5][16];              // translation cache key prefix of the VS, FS, GS, TCS, TES (index = NVN stage); empty = none
  int32_t topo, nattr, nstream, nColor, alphaFunc, patchSize, samples, depthFmt, stencilFmt;
  int32_t colorFmt[8];
  uint32_t blendEn, chmask;
  float alphaRef;
  uint32_t pad0, pad1;
  uint64_t dsBits;
  MsSt ms;
  PolySt poly;
  BlendSt blend[8];
  VaSt attr[16];
  VsSt stream[16];
  uint32_t pad2;
};
static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<PipeDesc> && sizeof(PipeDesc) == 464, "PipeDesc must have no padding (it is hashed and compared bytewise)");

// ---- implemented in nvn_draw.cpp (needs the replay helpers) -------------------------------------------------------------
// Builds the Vulkan pipeline for `pd` from the stage objects in `st[0..4]` (nullptr = absent) and `layout`. Thread-safe.
VkPipeline CreateGraphicsPipeline(Host* h, const PipeDesc& pd, StageProg* const st[6], VkPipelineLayout layout);

// ---- implemented in nvn_shader.cpp --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// module + reflection from the translation cache; `eft`: add layout(early_fragment_tests) even without the .efz marker (*eftApplied: it has it)
bool LoadStageFromCache(Host* h, const std::string& fullKey, StageProg* out, bool eft = false, bool* eftApplied = nullptr);
const char* TranslatorVersion();

// ---- implemented in nvn_pipeline.cpp ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Returns the compiled pipeline for `pd`, or VK_NULL_HANDLE while it is still compiling (*pending = true) or when it cannot be built.
// `p` supplies the stage objects/layout for an inline (synchronous) compile and the full cache keys of the stages for background jobs.
// `mustHave`: the draw cannot be dropped (one-shot passes such as the photo thumbnail, evaluation and capture targets): wait for a pending
// background compile, or compile inline, instead of returning VK_NULL_HANDLE.
VkPipeline PipelineAcquire(Host* h, const PipeDesc& pd, ProgramImpl* p, bool* pending, bool mustHave = false);
void PipelineServiceInit(Host* h);       // after the device and cacheDir exist: loads the key list, starts the workers
void PipelineServiceShutdown(Host* h);   // joins workers, saves the cache
bool PipelineHoldGame();                 // true while "compile now" is running and the game must stay on its present loop
// BuildStage: prefix -> cache file key for background loads. `eft`: the program's control section asks for early fragment tests, so the
// background template of this stage must carry the execution mode too (see PipelineRegisterStageKey in nvn_pipeline.cpp).
void PipelineRegisterStageKey(const char* key12, const char* fullKey, bool eft = false);

}  // namespace nvn
```
