`runtime/nvn/nvn_shader.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// NVN program objects: GLSLC program binaries -> SPIR-V -> VkShaderModule + descriptor layouts.
//
// Translation path (docs/nvn-vulkan-design.md, "Shader pipeline"): the game's shaders are Maxwell SASS inside the
// GLSLC binary (the NVN driver never sees GLSL at run time). The SASS is translated by the Ryujinx shader
// translator (MIT), driven by scripts/shader_harness (dotnet) in --nvn mode, and the result is cached on disk keyed
// by SHA-256 of the program's data section. Nothing of the game is stored in the repository: the cache lives under
// the layer's cache directory (NVN_CACHE_DIR, default <exe dir>\nvn_cache).
//
// Control/data section facts used here come from analysis/shaders/nushdb_layout.md (derived from the game's own
// files): control+0x6F8 program size, +0x700 constant-data offset, +0x704 data size, +0x708 header size (0x30);
// the data section starts with 0x12345678 and, for graphics stages, the Maxwell SPH at +0x30. Compute programs
// have neither.
#define NOMINMAX
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "nvn_aa.h"
#include "nvn_internal.h"
#include "nvn_pipeline.h"
#include "os/perf.h"   // SNAP_PERF instrumentation

namespace nvn {
namespace {

// SNAP_XLATE_REV=<n> switches to translator revision n (patched Ryujinx translator, scripts/xlate_patch.sh): the revision joins the cache salt, so
// old and new outputs never share a key, and the nvn_cache and shadercache folders get a _r<n> suffix (nvn_vk.cpp, nvn_pipeline.cpp).
// Unset or 0 = the original translation, unchanged.
const std::string& TranslatorSaltStr() {
  static const std::string s = [] {
    std::string b = "nvn-xlate-v2|binding-model-1|interlock-off|clip7";
    const char* r = getenv("SNAP_XLATE_REV");
    if (r && *r && strcmp(r, "0")) b += std::string("|xlate-r") + r;
    return b;
  }();
  return s;
}

// Shader modules whose SPIR-V uses subgroup operations (GroupNonUniform*, SubgroupLocalInvocationId and the lane masks): their lane math
// assumes 32 lanes, so the pipeline builders pin them to a required subgroup size of 32 (nvn_draw.cpp, g_sgPinStages).
std::mutex g_sgMu;
std::unordered_set<uint64_t> g_sgMods;
bool SpvUsesSubgroup(const std::vector<uint32_t>& w) {
  for (size_t i = 5; i < w.size();) {
    const uint32_t wc = w[i] >> 16, op = w[i] & 0xFFFF;
    if (!wc || i + wc > w.size()) return false;
    if (op >= 333 && op <= 366) return true;   // OpGroupNonUniform*
    if (op == 71 && wc >= 4 && w[i + 2] == 11 && (w[i + 3] == 41 || (w[i + 3] >= 4416 && w[i + 3] <= 4420))) return true;   // BuiltIn SubgroupLocalInvocationId, SubgroupEq/Ge/Gt/Le/LtMask
    i += wc;
  }
  return false;
}
void NoteSubgroup(VkShaderModule m, const std::vector<uint32_t>& w) {
  if (!SpvUsesSubgroup(w)) return;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_sgMu);
  g_sgMods.insert((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m);
}

// ---- SHA-256 (BCrypt) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Load pass (2026-11-13): the provider is opened once (BCrypt algorithm handles are shareable between threads); opening it per
// shader cost about as much as the hash. SNAP_SHADER_FASTIO=0 restores one open per call.
bool ShaderFastIo() {
  static const bool on = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SHADER_FASTIO"); return !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); }();
  return on;
}
std::string Sha256Hex(const uint8_t* d, size_t n, const std::string& extra) {
  static BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE shared = [] {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE a = nullptr;
    return BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&a, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0) < 0 ? nullptr : a;
  }();
  const bool keep = ShaderFastIo() && shared;
  BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE alg = keep ? shared : nullptr;
  BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE h = nullptr;
  std::string out;
  if (!keep && BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&alg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0) < 0) return out;
  if (BCryptCreateHash(alg, &h, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, 0) >= 0) {
    BCryptHashData(h, const_cast<PUCHAR>(d), (ULONG)n, 0);
    BCryptHashData(h, (PUCHAR)extra.data(), (ULONG)extra.size(), 0);
    uint8_t dig[32] = {};
    BCryptFinishHash(h, dig, 32, 0);
    char hx[65];
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) snprintf(hx + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", dig[i]);
    out.assign(hx, 64);
    BCryptDestroyHash(h);
  }
  if (!keep) BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(alg, 0);
  return out;
}

// ---- tiny JSON reader (the manifest is machine-written, numbers only) ---------------------------------------------
struct J {
  char type = 0;  // 'n' number, 'a' array, 'o' object
  double num = 0;
  std::vector<J> arr;
  std::vector<std::pair<std::string, J>> obj;
  const J* get(const char* k) const {
    for (auto& kv : obj) if (kv.first == k) return &kv.second;
    return nullptr;
  }
  int i(const char* k, int def = 0) const { auto* v = get(k); return v ? (int)v->num : def; }
};
struct JP {
  const char* p; const char* e;
  void ws() { while (p < e && (*p == ' ' || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r' || *p == '\t')) p++; }
  bool parse(J& out) {
    ws();
    if (p >= e) return false;
    if (*p == '{') {
      p++; out.type = 'o';
      for (;;) {
        ws();
        if (p < e && *p == '}') { p++; return true; }
        if (p < e && *p == ',') { p++; continue; }
        if (p >= e || *p != '"') return false;
        const char* s = ++p;
        while (p < e && *p != '"') p++;
        std::string k(s, p); p++;
        ws();
        if (p >= e || *p != ':') return false;
        p++;
        J v;
        if (!parse(v)) return false;
        out.obj.emplace_back(k, std::move(v));
      }
    }
    if (*p == '[') {
      p++; out.type = 'a';
      for (;;) {
        ws();
        if (p < e && *p == ']') { p++; return true; }
        if (p < e && *p == ',') { p++; continue; }
        J v;
        if (!parse(v)) return false;
        out.arr.push_back(std::move(v));
      }
    }
    char* end = nullptr;
    out.type = 'n';
    out.num = strtod(p, &end);
    if (end == p) return false;
    p = end;
    return true;
  }
};

bool ReadFile(const std::string& path, std::vector<uint8_t>* out) {
  if (ShaderFastIo()) {   // load pass: one sized Win32 read instead of a byte-wise istreambuf_iterator copy (same bytes)
    HANDLE fh = CreateFileA(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING,
                            FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr);
    if (fh == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    LARGE_INTEGER sz{};
    bool ok = GetFileSizeEx(fh, &sz) && sz.QuadPart >= 0 && sz.QuadPart < (1ll << 31);
    if (ok) {
      out->resize((size_t)sz.QuadPart);
      DWORD got = 0;
      ok = sz.QuadPart == 0 || (::ReadFile(fh, out->data(), (DWORD)sz.QuadPart, &got, nullptr) && got == (DWORD)sz.QuadPart);
    }
    CloseHandle(fh);
    if (!ok) out->clear();
    return ok;
  }
  std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
  if (!f) return false;
  out->assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
  return true;
}
bool WriteFile(const std::string& path, const void* d, size_t n) {
  std::ofstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
  if (!f) return false;
  f.write(static_cast<const char*>(d), (std::streamsize)n);
  return f.good();
}

// Run the dotnet shader harness (BelowNormal priority, 10 minute cap). Returns true when the manifest exists.
bool RunHarness(const std::string& bin, const std::string& spv, const std::string& json, int stage, uint32_t constOff,
                uint32_t codeOff) {
  std::string dll;
#ifdef NVN_HARNESS_DLL
  dll = NVN_HARNESS_DLL;
#endif
  if (const char* e = getenv("SNAP_XLATE_REV"); e && *e && strcmp(e, "0")) {   // revision n: build\xlate\r<n>\h (scripts/xlate_build.ps1), under the same project root as the default harness
    size_t k = dll.find("tools\\shader_harness");
    if (k == std::string::npos) k = dll.find("tools/shader_harness");
    if (k != std::string::npos) dll = dll.substr(0, k) + "build\\xlate\\r" + e + "\\h\\bin\\Release\\net10.0\\ShaderHarness.dll";
  }
  if (const char* e = getenv("NVN_SHADER_HARNESS")) dll = e;
  if (dll.empty()) { LogError("shader translation needs the harness: set NVN_SHADER_HARNESS=<ShaderHarness.dll>"); return false; }
  std::ostringstream cl;
  cl << "dotnet \"" << dll << "\" --nvn \"" << bin << "\" \"" << spv << "\" \"" << json << "\" " << stage << " " << constOff << " "
     << codeOff;
  std::string cmd = cl.str();
  STARTUPINFOA si{sizeof si};
  PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
  if (!CreateProcessA(nullptr, cmd.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi)) {
    LogError("cannot start dotnet (%lu)", GetLastError());
    return false;
  }
  DWORD w = WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, 600000);
  DWORD code = 1;
  if (w == WAIT_OBJECT_0) GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code);
  else TerminateProcess(pi.hProcess, 1);   // our own child only
  CloseHandle(pi.hProcess); CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
  if (code != 0) { LogError("shader harness failed (exit %lu)", code); return false; }
  return GetFileAttributesA(json.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES;
}

VkShaderStageFlagBits StageBit(int nvnStage) {
  static const VkShaderStageFlagBits t[6] = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT,
                                             VK_SHADER_STAGE_TESSELLATION_CONTROL_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_TESSELLATION_EVALUATION_BIT,
                                             VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT};
  return t[nvnStage];
}

uint32_t Rd32(const void* p, size_t o) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p) + o, 4); return v; }

void FreeStage(Host* h, StageProg& s) {
  if (s.mod) vkDestroyShaderModule(h->device, s.mod, nullptr);
  // fragMods variants are owned by the host (Host::variantMods): composite programs hold copies of this map
  if (s.constBuf) vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, s.constBuf, nullptr);
  if (s.constMem) vkFreeMemory(h->device, s.constMem, nullptr);
  s = StageProg{};
}

bool BuildStage(Host* h, const ShaderData& sd, StageProg* out) {
  PoolImpl* pool = nullptr; uint64_t off = 0;
  if (!h->ResolveAddress(sd.data, &pool, &off) || !pool->storage) {
    LogError("ProgramSetShaders: shader address 0x%llx is not in a pool", (unsigned long long)sd.data);
    return false;
  }
  if (!sd.control) { LogError("ProgramSetShaders: null control section"); return false; }
  const uint8_t* data = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(pool->storage) + off;
  const uint32_t progSize = Rd32(sd.control, 0x6F8), constOff = Rd32(sd.control, 0x700), dataSize = Rd32(sd.control, 0x704),
                 hdrSize = Rd32(sd.control, 0x708);
  if (dataSize == 0 || dataSize > (16u << 20) || constOff > dataSize || progSize > dataSize) {
    LogError("ProgramSetShaders: bad control section (size 0x%x const 0x%x)", dataSize, constOff);
    return false;
  }
  bool compute = Rd32(data, 0) != 0x12345678u;
  int stage = 5;
  uint32_t codeOff = 0;
  if (!compute) {
    codeOff = hdrSize;
    const uint32_t w0 = Rd32(data, codeOff);
    switch ((w0 >> 10) & 15) {   // SPH stage field [analysis/shaders/nushdb_layout.md]
      case 1: stage = 0; break;
      case 2: stage = 3; break;
      case 3: stage = 4; break;
      case 4: stage = 2; break;
      case 5: stage = 1; break;
      default: LogError("ProgramSetShaders: unknown SPH stage %u", (w0 >> 10) & 15); return false;
    }
  }
  std::string key = Sha256Hex(data, dataSize, TranslatorSaltStr() + "|" + std::to_string(stage) + "|" + std::to_string(codeOff));
  if (key.empty()) return false;
  const std::string base = h->cacheDir + "\\" + key;
  const std::string spvPath = base + ".spv", jsonPath = base + ".json";
  std::vector<uint8_t> spv, js;
  if (!ReadFile(spvPath, &spv) || !ReadFile(jsonPath, &js)) {
    const std::string binPath = base + ".bin";
    WriteFile(binPath, data, dataSize);
    Log("translating shader %s (stage %d)", key.c_str(), stage);
    bool ok = RunHarness(binPath, spvPath, jsonPath, stage, constOff, codeOff);
    DeleteFileA(binPath.c_str());
    if (!ok || !ReadFile(spvPath, &spv) || !ReadFile(jsonPath, &js)) return false;
  }
  J m;
  JP jp{reinterpret_cast<const char*>(js.data()), reinterpret_cast<const char*>(js.data()) + js.size()};
  if (!jp.parse(m)) { LogError("bad shader manifest %s", jsonPath.c_str()); return false; }
  StageProg sp;
  sp.valid = true; sp.stage = stage; snprintf(sp.key, sizeof sp.key, "%.12s", key.c_str()); sp.fragOutputMap = m.i("fragmentOutputMap");
  snprintf(sp.fkey, sizeof sp.fkey, "%s", key.c_str());
  PipelineRegisterStageKey(sp.key, sp.fkey, stage == 1 && (Rd32(sd.control, 0x718) & 1));
  if (auto* a = m.get("cbuffers")) for (auto& c : a->arr) sp.cb.push_back({c.i("slot"), c.i("set"), c.i("binding")});
  if (auto* a = m.get("sbuffers"))
    for (auto& c : a->arr) sp.sb.push_back({c.i("slot"), c.i("set"), c.i("binding"), c.i("sbCbSlot"), c.i("sbCbOffset"), c.i("write")});
  auto readTex = [](const J* a, std::vector<MTex>& v) {
    if (!a) return;
    for (auto& c : a->arr)
      v.push_back({c.i("set"), c.i("binding"), c.i("handleIndex"), c.i("cbufSlot", -1), c.i("type"), std::max(c.i("array", 1), 1), c.i("separate")});
  };
  readTex(m.get("textures"), sp.tex);
  readTex(m.get("images"), sp.img);
  std::vector<uint32_t> words(spv.size() / 4);
  memcpy(words.data(), spv.data(), words.size() * 4);
  if (stage == 5) {   // workgroup size: u32 x, y, z at control+0x748 (checked on the three resource.drp compute programs: 1x1x1, 16x16x1, 16x16x1)
    const uint32_t lx = Rd32(sd.control, 0x748), ly = Rd32(sd.control, 0x74C), lz = Rd32(sd.control, 0x750);
    if (lx && ly && lz && lx <= 1024 && ly <= 1024 && lz <= 64 && lx * ly * lz <= 1024) { SpvSetLocalSize(words, lx, ly, lz); Log("compute shader %s: local size %ux%ux%u", key.c_str(), lx, ly, lz); }
    else LogError("compute shader %s: implausible local size %u %u %u in the control section", key.c_str(), lx, ly, lz);
  }
  if (stage == 1 && (Rd32(sd.control, 0x718) & 1)) {   // layout(early_fragment_tests): see SpvAddEarlyFragmentTests
    if (SpvAddEarlyFragmentTests(words)) Log("fragment shader %s: early fragment tests", key.c_str());
    std::vector<uint8_t> mark;
    if (!ReadFile(base + ".efz", &mark)) WriteFile(base + ".efz", "1", 1);   // the cache key hashes only the data section, so the pipeline service needs this marker
  }
  SpvAddStorageImageCaps(words);   // the translator omits StorageImageRead/WriteWithoutFormat for storage images of unknown format
  if (stage == 1) AaPatchFragment(words, key.c_str());   // SNAP_AA=off/smaa: FXAA tonemap shaders lose their edge test (nvn_aa.cpp)
  VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.codeSize = words.size() * 4; ci.pCode = words.data();
  if (vkCreateShaderModule(h->device, &ci, nullptr, &sp.mod) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateShaderModule failed for %s", key.c_str()); return false; }
  NoteSubgroup(sp.mod, words);
  if (stage == 0) sp.inputMask = SpvVertexInputMask(words);
  if (stage == 1) { sp.spv = words; sp.outLocs = SpvFragmentOutputs(words); }
  // c[1]: the constant-data blob that follows the code (data section tail)
  sp.constSize = dataSize - constOff;
  bool needC1 = false;
  for (auto& c : sp.cb) if (c.slot == 1) needC1 = true;
  if (needC1 && sp.constSize) {
    void* mp = nullptr;
    if (CreateHostBuffer(h, (sp.constSize + 15) & ~15ull, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT, &sp.constBuf, &sp.constMem, &mp))
      memcpy(mp, data + constOff, sp.constSize);
  }
  *out = std::move(sp);
  return true;
}

// Rebuilds a stage object (module, reflection, no constant buffer) from the translation cache by its full key. Used by the pipeline
// service to compile pipelines without the game having created the program. Compute stages are not supported.
bool LoadStageFromCacheImpl(Host* h, const std::string& key, StageProg* out, bool eft, bool* eftApplied) {
  std::vector<uint8_t> spv, js;
  const std::string base = h->cacheDir + "\\" + key;
  if (!ReadFile(base + ".spv", &spv) || !ReadFile(base + ".json", &js)) return false;
  J m;
  JP jp{reinterpret_cast<const char*>(js.data()), reinterpret_cast<const char*>(js.data()) + js.size()};
  if (!jp.parse(m)) return false;
  StageProg sp;
  sp.stage = m.i("stage", -1);
  if (sp.stage < 0 || sp.stage > 4) return false;
  sp.valid = true; snprintf(sp.key, sizeof sp.key, "%.12s", key.c_str()); snprintf(sp.fkey, sizeof sp.fkey, "%s", key.c_str());
  sp.fragOutputMap = m.i("fragmentOutputMap");
  if (auto* a = m.get("cbuffers")) for (auto& c : a->arr) sp.cb.push_back({c.i("slot"), c.i("set"), c.i("binding")});
  if (auto* a = m.get("sbuffers"))
    for (auto& c : a->arr) sp.sb.push_back({c.i("slot"), c.i("set"), c.i("binding"), c.i("sbCbSlot"), c.i("sbCbOffset"), c.i("write")});
  auto readTex = [](const J* a, std::vector<MTex>& v) {
    if (!a) return;
    for (auto& c : a->arr)
      v.push_back({c.i("set"), c.i("binding"), c.i("handleIndex"), c.i("cbufSlot", -1), c.i("type"), std::max(c.i("array", 1), 1), c.i("separate")});
  };
  readTex(m.get("textures"), sp.tex);
  readTex(m.get("images"), sp.img);
  std::vector<uint32_t> words(spv.size() / 4);
  memcpy(words.data(), spv.data(), words.size() * 4);
  { std::vector<uint8_t> mark; if (sp.stage == 1 && (eft || ReadFile(base + ".efz", &mark)) && SpvAddEarlyFragmentTests(words) && eftApplied) *eftApplied = true; }
  SpvAddStorageImageCaps(words);
  if (sp.stage == 1) AaPatchFragment(words, key.c_str());   // same patch for pipelines built by the pipeline service
  VkShaderModuleCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.codeSize = words.size() * 4; ci.pCode = words.data();
  if (vkCreateShaderModule(h->device, &ci, nullptr, &sp.mod) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  NoteSubgroup(sp.mod, words);
  if (sp.stage == 0) sp.inputMask = SpvVertexInputMask(words);
  if (sp.stage == 1) { sp.spv = words; sp.outLocs = SpvFragmentOutputs(words); }
  *out = std::move(sp);
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool LoadStageFromCache(Host* h, const std::string& fullKey, StageProg* out, bool eft, bool* eftApplied) { return LoadStageFromCacheImpl(h, fullKey, out, eft, eftApplied); }
const char* TranslatorVersion() { return TranslatorSaltStr().c_str(); }
bool ModuleUsesSubgroup(VkShaderModule m) { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(g_sgMu); return g_sgMods.count((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m) != 0; }

bool CreateHostBuffer(Host* h, uint64_t size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage, VkBuffer* buf, VkDeviceMemory* mem, void** mapped) {
  VkBufferCreateInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
  bi.size = size; bi.usage = usage;
  if (vkCreateBuffer(h->device, &bi, nullptr, buf) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(h->device, *buf, &mr);
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  mai.allocationSize = mr.size;
  mai.memoryTypeIndex = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
  if (mai.memoryTypeIndex == UINT32_MAX || vkAllocateMemory(h->device, &mai, nullptr, mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
    vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, *buf, nullptr);
    *buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; *mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return false;
  }
  vkBindBufferMemory(h->device, *buf, *mem, 0);
  vkMapMemory(h->device, *mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, mapped);
  return true;
}

void ProgramDestroy(ProgramImpl* p) {
  if (!p) return;
  Host* h = p->host;
  if (h && h->device) {
    // pipelines built from this program stay in the host map (keyed by program id, ids are never reused) and are
    // destroyed at shutdown
    if (!p->composite && p->id) {   // composites built from this program hold copies of its stage objects
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(h->compMutex);
      for (auto it = h->composites.begin(); it != h->composites.end();) {
        bool uses = false;
        for (uint64_t k : it->first) uses |= k == p->id;
        if (uses) { ProgramDestroy(it->second); delete it->second; it = h->composites.erase(it); } else ++it;
      }
    }
    if (!p->composite) for (auto& s : p->st) FreeStage(h, s);
    for (auto l : p->setLayout) if (l) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(h->device, l, nullptr);
    if (p->layout) vkDestroyPipelineLayout(h->device, p->layout, nullptr);
  }
  p->layout = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  for (auto& l : p->setLayout) l = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  for (auto& u : p->setUsed) u = false;
}

// Binding model (see the harness): set 0 = support buffer (0) + c[s] of stage at 1 + stage*16 + s; set 1 = storage
// buffers stage*16 + n; set 2 = combined image samplers stage*32 + n; set 3 = storage images stage*8 + n.
bool ProgramSetShadersImpl(ProgramImpl* p, int n, const ShaderData* sd) {
  Host* h = p->host;
  snap_perf::Scope perfShader(snap_perf::C_SHADER); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_SHADERS);
  ProgramDestroy(p);
  if (n < 1 || n > 6 || !sd) return false;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    StageProg sp;
    if (!BuildStage(h, sd[i], &sp)) { ProgramDestroy(p); return false; }
    if (p->st[sp.stage].valid) {
      LogError("ProgramSetShaders: two shaders for stage %d", sp.stage);
      FreeStage(h, sp); ProgramDestroy(p);
      return false;
    }
    p->st[sp.stage] = std::move(sp);
  }
  return ProgramBuildLayout(p);
}

bool ProgramBuildLayout(ProgramImpl* p) {
  Host* h = p->host;
  struct B { VkDescriptorType type = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER; uint32_t count = 0; VkShaderStageFlags stages = 0; };
  std::map<std::pair<int, int>, B> binds;
  VkShaderStageFlags all = 0;
  for (auto& s : p->st) if (s.valid) all |= StageBit(s.stage);
  binds[{0, 0}] = {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 1, all};
  auto add = [&](int set, int binding, VkDescriptorType t, uint32_t cnt, VkShaderStageFlags st) {
    auto& b = binds[{set, binding}];
    b.type = t; b.count = std::max(b.count, cnt); b.stages |= st;
  };
  for (auto& s : p->st) {
    if (!s.valid) continue;
    VkShaderStageFlags sb = StageBit(s.stage);
    for (auto& c : s.cb) add(c.set, c.binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 1, sb);
    for (auto& c : s.sb) add(c.set, c.binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, sb);
    for (auto& t : s.tex) {
      if (t.separate) { LogError("separate texture/sampler bindings are not implemented yet"); continue; }
      add(t.set, t.binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, (uint32_t)t.array, sb);
    }
    for (auto& t : s.img) add(t.set, t.binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE, (uint32_t)t.array, sb);
  }
  for (int set = 0; set < 4; set++) {
    std::vector<VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding> v;
    for (auto& kv : binds)
      if (kv.first.first == set) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b{};
        b.binding = (uint32_t)kv.first.second; b.descriptorType = kv.second.type; b.descriptorCount = kv.second.count;
        b.stageFlags = kv.second.stages;
        v.push_back(b);
      }
    p->setUsed[set] = !v.empty();
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    lci.bindingCount = (uint32_t)v.size(); lci.pBindings = v.data();
    if (vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(h->device, &lci, nullptr, &p->setLayout[set]) != VK_SUCCESS) { ProgramDestroy(p); return false; }
  }
  VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pl{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
  pl.setLayoutCount = 4; pl.pSetLayouts = p->setLayout;
  if (vkCreatePipelineLayout(h->device, &pl, nullptr, &p->layout) != VK_SUCCESS) { ProgramDestroy(p); return false; }
  {
    static std::mutex mu;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mu);
    p->id = h->nextProgramId++;
  }
  return true;
}

ProgramImpl* ProgramResolve(Host* h, ProgramImpl* const src[6]) {
  ProgramImpl* first = nullptr;
  int bound = 0;
  std::array<uint64_t, 6> key{};
  for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) {
    if (!src[s]) continue;
    if (!first) first = src[s];
    if (!src[s]->st[s].valid) continue;
    bound |= 1 << s;
    key[s] = src[s]->id;
  }
  if (!bound) return first;   // nothing usable: hand back any bound program so the draw reports it
  ProgramImpl* one = nullptr;
  bool single = true;
  for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) if (bound & (1 << s)) { if (!one) one = src[s]; else if (one != src[s]) single = false; }
  if (single) for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) if (one->st[s].valid && !(bound & (1 << s))) single = false;
  if (single) return one;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(h->compMutex);
  auto it = h->composites.find(key);
  if (it != h->composites.end()) return it->second;
  auto* c = new ProgramImpl;
  c->host = h; c->composite = true;
  for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) if (bound & (1 << s)) c->st[s] = src[s]->st[s];
  if (!ProgramBuildLayout(c)) { ProgramDestroy(c); delete c; return one; }
  h->composites[key] = c;
  return c;
}

}  // namespace nvn
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_soak.cpp`:

```cpp
// SNAP_SOAK_LOG=<seconds>: one "[soak]" line to stderr every <seconds> (default off). For long-session leak hunts: process
// working set / commit / handles / GDI / USER objects / threads, Vulkan object counts (made-freed, from nvn_vkcount.h), guest VAMM
// and memory-heap totals, shader cache folder size and presents per second. Cost when off: nothing (no thread).
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#define PSAPI_VERSION 2
#include <psapi.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include "nvn_internal.h"

extern "C" void snap_os_mem_stats(uint64_t* out);

namespace {

std::string CacheDir() {
  const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR");
  std::string d;
  if (e && *e) d = e;
  else if ((e = getenv("SNAP_CONFIG_DIR")) && *e) d = std::string(e) + "\\shadercache";
  else {
    char buf[MAX_PATH] = {};
    DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableA("APPDATA", buf, MAX_PATH);
    d = (n ? std::string(buf) : std::string(".")) + "\\SnapRecomp\\shadercache";
  }
  if (const char* r = getenv("SNAP_XLATE_REV"); r && *r && strcmp(r, "0")) d += std::string("_r") + r;
  return d;
}

uint64_t DirBytes(const std::string& d, int depth = 0) {
  uint64_t sum = 0;
  WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
  HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA((d + "\\*").c_str(), &fd);
  if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
  do {
    if (fd.cFileName[0] == '.' && (!fd.cFileName[1] || (fd.cFileName[1] == '.' && !fd.cFileName[2]))) continue;
    if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) { if (depth < 3) sum += DirBytes(d + "\\" + fd.cFileName, depth + 1); }
    else sum += ((uint64_t)fd.nFileSizeHigh << 32) | fd.nFileSizeLow;
  } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
  FindClose(h);
  return sum;
}

int ThreadCount() {
  int n = 0;
  HANDLE s = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
  if (s == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return -1;
  THREADENTRY32 te{}; te.dwSize = sizeof te;
  const DWORD pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
  if (Thread32First(s, &te)) do { if (te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid) n++; } while (Thread32Next(s, &te));
  CloseHandle(s);
  return n;
}

void Loop(int secs) {
  const std::string cache = CacheDir();
  const double mb = 1.0 / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
  DWORD64 t0 = GetTickCount64(), tPrev = t0;
  int prevPresent = nvn::g_presentCount;
  int idx = 0;
  for (;;) {
    Sleep((DWORD)secs * 1000);
    HANDLE p = GetCurrentProcess();
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX pm{}; pm.cb = sizeof pm;
    K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(p, (PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS*)&pm, sizeof pm);
    DWORD handles = 0; GetProcessHandleCount(p, &handles);
    const DWORD gdi = GetGuiResources(p, GR_GDIOBJECTS), usr = GetGuiResources(p, GR_USEROBJECTS);
    uint64_t m[6] = {}; snap_os_mem_stats(m);
    const DWORD64 now = GetTickCount64();
    const int pc = nvn::g_presentCount;
    const double dt = (double)(now - tPrev) / 1000.0;
    auto& c = snapvk::C();
    auto live = [&](int k) { return (long long)(c.made[k].load() - c.freed[k].load()); };
    fprintf(stderr,
            "[soak] #%d t=%.0fs ws=%.0fMB commit=%.0fMB peakws=%.0fMB handles=%lu gdi=%lu user=%lu threads=%d | vk live img=%lld buf=%lld mem=%lld(made %lld, %.0fMB total) "
            "dpool=%lld pipe=%lld view=%lld samp=%lld shmod=%lld | guest vamm res=%.0fMB com=%.0fMB regions=%llu heap=%.0fMB blocks=%llu(%.0fMB) | shadercache=%.1fMB | present=%d %.1f/s\n",
            ++idx, (double)(now - t0) / 1000.0, pm.WorkingSetSize * mb, pm.PrivateUsage * mb, pm.PeakWorkingSetSize * mb, (unsigned long)handles, (unsigned long)gdi,
            (unsigned long)usr, ThreadCount(), live(snapvk::kImage), live(snapvk::kBuffer), live(snapvk::kMemory), (long long)c.made[snapvk::kMemory].load(),
            (double)c.memBytesMade.load() * mb, live(snapvk::kDescPool), live(snapvk::kPipeline), live(snapvk::kImageView), live(snapvk::kSampler),
            live(snapvk::kShaderModule), m[0] * mb, m[1] * mb, (unsigned long long)m[2], m[3] * mb, (unsigned long long)m[4], m[5] * mb,
            (double)DirBytes(cache) * mb, pc, dt > 0 ? (pc - prevPresent) / dt : 0.0);
    fflush(stderr);
    prevPresent = pc; tPrev = now;
  }
}

struct Starter {
  Starter() {
    const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SOAK_LOG");
    int s = e ? atoi(e) : 0;
    if (s > 0) std::thread(Loop, s).detach();
  }
} g_starter;
```

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Guest-visible NVN state objects, packed in place by the Set* entry points and copied by value into the recorded
// command stream. The layouts are ours (the game never looks inside); sizes fit the real objects
// ([TOTK-NVN] sizes: blendState 8, colorState 4, channelMaskState 4, polygonState 4, depthStencilState 8,
// multisampleState 0x18, vertexAttribState 4, vertexStreamState 8).
// Enum values are NVN's (printed from tools/ref/totk/runtime/nvn.h, MIT reference); the mapping to Vulkan is in
// nvn_draw.cpp.
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace nvn {

enum : int {  // NVNblendFunc
  BF_ZERO = 1, BF_ONE = 2, BF_SRC_COLOR = 3, BF_ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR = 4, BF_SRC_ALPHA = 5, BF_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA = 6,
  BF_DST_ALPHA = 7, BF_ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA = 8, BF_DST_COLOR = 9, BF_ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR = 0xA, BF_SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE = 0xB,
  BF_SRC1_COLOR = 0x10, BF_ONE_MINUS_SRC1_COLOR = 0x11, BF_SRC1_ALPHA = 0x12, BF_ONE_MINUS_SRC1_ALPHA = 0x13,
  BF_CONSTANT_COLOR = 0x61, BF_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_COLOR = 0x62, BF_CONSTANT_ALPHA = 0x63, BF_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_ALPHA = 0x64,
};
enum : int { BE_ADD = 1, BE_SUB = 2, BE_REVSUB = 3, BE_MIN = 4, BE_MAX = 5 };                    // NVNblendEquation
enum : int { FACE_NONE = 0, FACE_FRONT = 1, FACE_BACK = 2, FACE_FRONT_AND_BACK = 3 };            // NVNface
enum : int { FRONT_CW = 0, FRONT_CCW = 1 };                                                     // NVNfrontFace
enum : int { POLY_POINT = 0, POLY_LINE = 1, POLY_FILL = 2 };                                    // NVNpolygonMode
enum : int { CMP_NEVER = 1, CMP_LESS = 2, CMP_EQUAL = 3, CMP_LEQUAL = 4, CMP_GREATER = 5, CMP_NOTEQUAL = 6, CMP_GEQUAL = 7, CMP_ALWAYS = 8 };
enum : int { SOP_KEEP = 1 };                                                                    // NVNstencilOp (1..8)
enum : int { IDX_U8 = 0, IDX_U16 = 1, IDX_U32 = 2 };                                            // NVNindexType
enum : int { LOGIC_COPY = 3 };                                                                  // placeholder default (unused by replay)

struct BlendSt { uint8_t srcRgb, dstRgb, srcA, dstA, eqRgb, eqA, target, pad; };
struct ColorSt { uint8_t blendEn, logicOp, alphaFunc, pad; };            // blendEn: bit per render target
struct ChMaskSt { uint32_t mask; };                                       // 4 bits (r,g,b,a) per render target
struct MsSt { uint8_t enable, samples, a2c, a2cDither, covMod, covToColor, covToColorOut, slEn, slGrid, pad[15]; };
struct PolySt { uint8_t cull, front, mode, offsetEn; };                   // offsetEn: 1 point, 2 line, 4 fill
struct DsSt { uint64_t bits; };
struct VaSt { uint32_t v; };                                              // fmt:9 | stream:4 << 9 | offset:19 << 13
struct VsSt { uint32_t stride, divisor; };
static_assert(sizeof(BlendSt) == 8 && sizeof(ColorSt) == 4 && sizeof(ChMaskSt) == 4 && sizeof(MsSt) == 0x18 &&
              sizeof(PolySt) == 4 && sizeof(DsSt) == 8 && sizeof(VaSt) == 4 && sizeof(VsSt) == 8);

// DepthStencil bit layout
enum : int { DS_DT = 0, DS_DW = 1, DS_ST = 2, DS_DF = 3, DS_SF_F = 7, DS_SF_B = 11, DS_FAIL_F = 15, DS_ZFAIL_F = 19, DS_ZPASS_F = 23,
             DS_FAIL_B = 27, DS_ZFAIL_B = 31, DS_ZPASS_B = 35 };
inline uint32_t DsGet(const DsSt& s, int sh, int bits) { return (uint32_t)((s.bits >> sh) & ((1u << bits) - 1)); }
inline void DsSet(DsSt& s, int sh, int bits, uint32_t v) {
  uint64_t m = (uint64_t)((1u << bits) - 1) << sh;
  s.bits = (s.bits & ~m) | ((uint64_t)v << sh & m);
}

inline uint32_t VaFmt(const VaSt& s) { return s.v & 0x1FF; }
inline uint32_t VaStream(const VaSt& s) { return (s.v >> 9) & 0xF; }
inline uint32_t VaOffset(const VaSt& s) { return s.v >> 13; }

}  // namespace nvn
```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_tex.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Maxwell block-linear layout, see nvn_tex.h for provenance.
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace nvn {

uint32_t DefaultBlockHeightLog2(uint32_t hb) {
  uint32_t hh = hb + hb / 2;
  return hh >= 128 ? 4 : hh >= 64 ? 3 : hh >= 32 ? 2 : hh >= 16 ? 1 : 0;
}
uint32_t DefaultBlockDepthLog2(uint32_t d) {
  uint32_t l = 0;
  while ((1u << l) < d && l < 4) l++;
  return l;
}
static uint32_t CeilDiv(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (uint32_t)((a + b - 1) / b); }

SurfaceLayout ComputeSurfaceLayout(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t depth, uint32_t layers, uint32_t levels,
                                   uint32_t bpb, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh) {
  SurfaceLayout s;
  s.bpb = bpb; s.bw = bw; s.bh = bh; s.layers = layers ? layers : 1;
  uint32_t bh0 = DefaultBlockHeightLog2(CeilDiv(h, bh)), bd0 = 0;
  if (depth > 1) {
    bd0 = DefaultBlockDepthLog2(depth);
    bh0 = std::min(bh0, 4 - bd0);
  }
  uint64_t off = 0;
  for (uint32_t m = 0; m < std::max(levels, 1u); m++) {
    LevelLayout l;
    l.w = std::max(w >> m, 1u); l.h = std::max(h >> m, 1u); l.d = std::max(depth >> m, 1u);
    l.wb = CeilDiv(l.w, bw); l.hb = CeilDiv(l.h, bh);
    uint32_t lbh = bh0, lbd = bd0;
    while (lbh > 0 && (8u << (lbh - 1)) >= l.hb) lbh--;
    while (lbd > 0 && (1u << (lbd - 1)) >= l.d) lbd--;
    l.bhLog2 = lbh; l.bdLog2 = lbd; l.offset = off;
    l.size = (uint64_t)CeilDiv((uint64_t)l.wb * bpb, 64) * 512 * (1u << lbh) * (1u << lbd) *
             CeilDiv(l.hb, 8u << lbh) * CeilDiv(l.d, 1u << lbd);
    off += l.size;
    s.levels.push_back(l);
  }
  if (s.layers > 1) { uint64_t al = 512ull << bh0; off = (off + al - 1) / al * al; }
  s.layerSize = off;
  s.total = off * s.layers;
  return s;
}

// Address of byte (x, y, z) inside a level (x in bytes). Same arithmetic as tests/nvn/nutexb_ref.py.
static inline uint64_t GobAddr(const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint64_t widthGobs,
                               uint64_t blocksY) {
  uint32_t bh = 1u << l.bhLog2, bd = 1u << l.bdLog2, gobRows = 8 * bh;
  uint64_t blockSize = 512ull * bh * bd;
  uint64_t a = ((z / bd) * blocksY + (y / gobRows)) * widthGobs * blockSize;
  a += (uint64_t)(x / 64) * blockSize;
  a += (uint64_t)(((z % bd) * bh) + ((y % gobRows) / 8)) * 512;
  a += ((x % 64) / 32) * 256 + ((y % 8) / 2) * 64 + ((x % 32) / 16) * 32 + (y % 2) * 16 + (x % 16);
  return a;
}

template <bool Swz>
static void Walk(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t bpb) {
  uint32_t rowb = l.wb * bpb;
  uint64_t widthGobs = CeilDiv(rowb, 64), blocksY = CeilDiv(l.hb, 8u << l.bhLog2);
  for (uint32_t z = 0; z < l.d; z++)
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < l.hb; y++) {
      uint8_t* lin = Swz ? nullptr : dst + ((uint64_t)z * l.hb + y) * rowb;
      const uint8_t* linS = Swz ? src + ((uint64_t)z * l.hb + y) * rowb : nullptr;
      for (uint32_t x = 0; x < rowb; x += 16) {  // 16-byte sectors never straddle, rows are multiples of bpb>=1 though
        uint32_t n = std::min(16u, rowb - x);
        uint64_t a = GobAddr(l, x, y, z, widthGobs, blocksY);
        if (Swz) std::memcpy(dst + l.offset * 0 + a, linS + x, n);
        else std::memcpy(lin + x, src + a, n);
      }
    }
}
void DeswizzleLevel(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t bpb) { Walk<false>(src, dst, l, bpb); }
void SwizzleLevel(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t bpb) { Walk<true>(src, dst, l, bpb); }

}  // namespace nvn

```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_tex.h`:

```h
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Texture helpers that do not depend on Vulkan: Maxwell (Tegra X1) block-linear layout, deswizzle/swizzle, ASTC LDR
// decode and a BC7 (mode 6) encoder used to transcode ASTC when the GPU cannot sample it.
//
// Layout provenance (no Nintendo header or driver code was used):
//   * GOB = 64 bytes x 8 rows (512 B), laid out as 16-byte sectors; blocks stack GOBs in y (block height) and z (block
//     depth). Reference: tools/ref/las/runtime/nvn/tegra.c (MIT) and the public tegra_swizzle layout description.
//   * Default block height: the tegra_swizzle rule (height_in_blocks + height_in_blocks / 2 against 16/32/64/128), which
//     reproduced the footer sizes of 239 distinct geometries and decoded smoother than the "next power of two" rule on
//     six textures where the two differ (survey in docs/nvn-vulkan-design.md).
//   * Per-level block height shrinks while the level is shorter than half a block; arrays/cubes align the layer size to
//     512 << blockHeightLog2 (verified against the 108 cubemaps in the game's NUTEXB set).
//   * 3D textures: block depth from the depth (same thresholds, up to 16), block height limited so that
//     blockHeight * blockDepth <= 16 GOBs. Verified on the 33^3 and 65^3 RGBA16F colour LUTs (decoded volume is smooth
//     only for height 1 / depth 16); the 1024x1024x8 BC1 3D texture has no checkable content.
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace nvn {

struct LevelLayout {
  uint64_t offset = 0;                  // from the start of the layer
  uint32_t w = 0, h = 0, d = 0;         // texels
  uint32_t wb = 0, hb = 0;              // blocks
  uint32_t bhLog2 = 0, bdLog2 = 0;      // GOBs per block (log2) in y / z for this level
  uint64_t size = 0;                    // bytes of this level in the swizzled layout
};
struct SurfaceLayout {
  uint32_t bpb = 4, bw = 1, bh = 1;     // bytes per block, block size in texels
  uint32_t layers = 1;
  std::vector<LevelLayout> levels;
  uint64_t layerSize = 0, total = 0;
};

uint32_t DefaultBlockHeightLog2(uint32_t heightInBlocks);
uint32_t DefaultBlockDepthLog2(uint32_t depth);
// width/height in texels; depth > 1 only for 3D textures (layers is the array/cube layer count, 1 otherwise).
SurfaceLayout ComputeSurfaceLayout(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t depth, uint32_t layers, uint32_t levels,
                                   uint32_t bpb, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh);
// One level (all depth slices) between block-linear memory and tightly packed rows (pitch = wb * bpb, then hb rows,
// then d slices).
void DeswizzleLevel(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t bpb);
void SwizzleLevel(const uint8_t* src, uint8_t* dst, const LevelLayout& l, uint32_t bpb);

// ASTC LDR (2D) -> RGBA8, nvn_astc.cpp.
bool AstcDecodeBlock(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t* rgbaOut);
void AstcDecodeLdr(const uint8_t* blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                   uint8_t* rgbaOut);

// RGBA8 (w*h*4, tightly packed) -> BC7 blocks (ceil(w/4)*ceil(h/4)*16 bytes), nvn_bc7.cpp. Mode 6 only.
void EncodeBc7(const uint8_t* rgba, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint8_t* out);

}  // namespace nvn

```

`runtime/nvn/nvn_tex_vk.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Static texture upload: Maxwell block-linear deswizzle, ASTC CPU decode / BC7 transcode (with a disk cache).
#include <windows.h>   // [perf] SetThreadPriority for the upload prefetch workers
#include <immintrin.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include "nvn_internal.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "os/perf.h"   // SNAP_PERF instrumentation

namespace nvn {
namespace {

// Guest-side layout parameters of a texture (what the packaged data uses), which differ from the Vulkan format's when
// ASTC is transcoded.
struct GuestFmt { uint32_t bpb, bw, bh; };
GuestFmt GuestFormat(const FormatInfo* fi) {
  if (fi->astcW) return {16, fi->astcW, fi->astcH};
  return {fi->bytes, fi->bw, fi->bh};
}
uint32_t Levels(const TextureBuilder& b) {
  uint32_t m = 1, d = (uint32_t)std::max(b.width, std::max(b.height, b.target == TT_3D ? b.depth : 1));
  while (d >>= 1) m++;
  return std::min<uint32_t>((uint32_t)std::max(b.levels, 1), m);
}
void Fnv(const uint8_t* p, size_t n, uint64_t& h1, uint64_t& h2) {
  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { h1 = (h1 ^ p[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull; h2 = (h2 + p[i] + 1) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull; h2 ^= h2 >> 29; }
}
}  // namespace

int g_presentCount = 0;
uint64_t g_replaySeq = 1;
static uint64_t HashBytes(const void* p, uint64_t n) {   // 64-bit word mix; cheap enough to run per replay on 1 MB
  const uint8_t* b = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p);
  uint64_t h = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ n, i = 0;
  for (; i + 8 <= n; i += 8) { uint64_t w; memcpy(&w, b + i, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0x100000001b3ull; h ^= h >> 29; }
  for (; i < n; i++) h = (h ^ b[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
  return h;
}
// Guest source bytes of a pool-resident texture the CPU may rewrite after creation (nullptr otherwise).
static const uint8_t* DynamicSource(const TextureImpl* t, uint64_t* bytes) {
  const TextureBuilder& b = t->b;
  if (b.packaged || !b.pool || !(b.flags & TF_LINEAR) || (b.flags & (TF_COMPRESSIBLE | TF_DISPLAY | TF_LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET))) return nullptr;
  auto* p = Impl<PoolImpl>(b.pool, MAGIC_POOL);
  if (!p || !p->storage || !t->fi || b.samples > 1) return nullptr;
  const uint64_t wb = ((uint64_t)b.width + t->fi->bw - 1) / t->fi->bw, hb = ((uint64_t)b.height + t->fi->bh - 1) / t->fi->bh;
  const uint64_t stride = std::max<uint64_t>((uint64_t)std::max(b.stride, 0), wb * t->fi->bytes);
  if (b.poolOffset < 0 || (uint64_t)b.poolOffset + stride * hb > p->size) return nullptr;
  *bytes = stride * hb;
  return static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p->storage) + b.poolOffset;
}
void DebugDumpTexture(const TextureImpl* t, const char* tag, const void* data, uint64_t bytes, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
  static const char* dir = getenv("NVN_TEX_DUMP");
  static int seq = 0;
  if (!dir || !*dir || !data || bytes > (8u << 20)) return;
  char name[512];
  snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s/%04d_%s_t%p_f%x_%dx%d_%ux%u.raw", dir, seq++, tag, (const void*)t, t->b.format, t->b.width, t->b.height, w, h);
  if (FILE* f = fopen(name, "wb")) { fwrite(data, 1, (size_t)bytes, f); fclose(f); }
}
static FILE* DrawLogFile() {
  static FILE* f = [] { const char* p = getenv("NVN_DRAW_LOG"); return (p && *p) ? fopen(p, "w") : (FILE*)nullptr; }();
  return f;
}
bool DebugDrawLogActive() {
  if (!DrawLogFile()) return false;
  static int a = -1, b = -1;
  static double sa = -1, sb = -1;
  static const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  if (a < 0) {
    a = 0; b = 1 << 30;
    if (const char* e = getenv("NVN_DRAW_LOG_FRAMES")) sscanf(e, "%d-%d", &a, &b);
    if (const char* e = getenv("NVN_DRAW_LOG_SEC")) sscanf(e, "%lf-%lf", &sa, &sb);   // wall-clock window since the first draw log query
  }
  if (sa >= 0) {
    const double t = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
    return t >= sa && t < sb;
  }
  return g_presentCount >= a && g_presentCount < b;
}
void DebugDrawLog(const char* fmt, ...) {
  FILE* f = DrawLogFile();
  if (!f) return;
  va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vfprintf(f, fmt, ap); va_end(ap); fflush(f);
}

uint64_t TextureStorageSize(const TextureBuilder& b) {
  const FormatInfo* fi = LookupFormat(b.format);
  GuestFmt g = fi ? GuestFormat(fi) : GuestFmt{4, 1, 1};
  uint32_t depth = b.target == TT_3D ? (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1) : 1;
  if ((b.flags & TF_LINEAR) && fi && !fi->astcW && b.target != TT_3D && b.target != TT_CUBEMAP) {   // pitch-linear: stride * rows
    const uint64_t wb = ((uint64_t)std::max(b.width, 1) + fi->bw - 1) / fi->bw, hb = ((uint64_t)std::max(b.height, 1) + fi->bh - 1) / fi->bh;
    const uint64_t stride = std::max<uint64_t>((uint64_t)std::max(b.stride, 0), wb * fi->bytes);
    return (stride * hb + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
  }
  SurfaceLayout l = ComputeSurfaceLayout((uint32_t)std::max(b.width, 1), (uint32_t)std::max(b.height, 1), depth,
                                         TextureLayerCount(b), (uint32_t)std::max(b.levels, 1), g.bpb, g.bw, g.bh);
  uint64_t total = l.total * (uint64_t)std::max(b.samples, 1);
  return (total + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull;
}

// ---- [perf] upload prefetch (perf pass 4, pass2_design.md item 1 step 2) -----------------------------------------------------
// Scene changes upload hundreds of static textures in one replay (bursts of 100 to 400 ms on the presenting thread). Most of
// that is the block-linear deswizzle, which needs no Vulkan and no shared state. TexPrefetch (called from TextureInitialize)
// queues it on a few below-normal workers that deswizzle into host memory; UploadStaticTexture then only checks that the guest
// bytes are unchanged (FastHash of the source, taken before and after the job's deswizzle and again at upload) and copies the
// result into the staging buffer. Anything else (queued but not started, hash mismatch, ASTC, linear, multisample, over budget)
// takes the old synchronous path, so the first sample still sees the final bytes. Staged data is capped at
// SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_MB (default 384, oldest ready entries dropped first); SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_MB=0 restores the old path.
namespace {
uint64_t FastHash(const uint8_t* p, uint64_t n) {   // change detection only (xxh3-style accumulate, position-mixed)
  __m256i a0 = _mm256_set_epi64x(1, 2, 3, 4), a1 = _mm256_set_epi64x(5, 6, 7, 8);
  const __m256i k0 = _mm256_set_epi64x((long long)0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull, (long long)0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4Full, 0x165667B19E3779F9ll, (long long)0x85EBCA77C2B2AE63ull);
  const __m256i k1 = _mm256_set_epi64x(0x27D4EB2F165667C5ll, (long long)0xFF51AFD7ED558CCDull, (long long)0xC4CEB9FE1A85EC53ull, 0x4CF5AD432745937Fll);
  uint64_t i = 0;
  for (; i + 64 <= n; i += 64) {
    const __m256i vi = _mm256_set1_epi64x((long long)i);
    const __m256i d0 = _mm256_loadu_si256((const __m256i*)(p + i)), d1 = _mm256_loadu_si256((const __m256i*)(p + i + 32));
    const __m256i x0 = _mm256_xor_si256(d0, _mm256_add_epi64(k0, vi)), x1 = _mm256_xor_si256(d1, _mm256_add_epi64(k1, vi));
    a0 = _mm256_add_epi64(_mm256_add_epi64(a0, _mm256_mul_epu32(x0, _mm256_srli_epi64(x0, 32))), _mm256_shuffle_epi32(d0, 0x4E));
    a1 = _mm256_add_epi64(_mm256_add_epi64(a1, _mm256_mul_epu32(x1, _mm256_srli_epi64(x1, 32))), _mm256_shuffle_epi32(d1, 0x4E));
  }
  alignas(32) uint64_t lanes[8];
  _mm256_store_si256((__m256i*)lanes, a0); _mm256_store_si256((__m256i*)(lanes + 4), a1);
  uint64_t h = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ n;
  for (uint64_t v : lanes) { h = (h ^ v) * 0x100000001b3ull; h ^= h >> 29; }
  for (; i < n; i++) { h = (h ^ p[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull; h ^= h >> 29; }
  return h;
}
struct Prep {
  std::atomic<int> state{0};          // 0 queued, 1 running, 2 ready, 3 failed
  std::atomic<bool> cancel{false};
  TextureBuilder b{}; const FormatInfo* fi = nullptr;
  const uint8_t* src = nullptr; uint64_t srcBytes = 0, hash = 0;
  const void* pool = nullptr;         // PoolImpl* the source lives in (nullptr for packaged data outside pools)
  std::vector<uint8_t> data;          // Vulkan-side layout, same offsets as UploadStaticTexture
  uint64_t seq = 0;
  Host* host = nullptr; uint32_t hw = 0, hh = 0;   // host image size at TexPrefetch
  TexImage img;                       // created by the worker (SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_IMAGE); handed to the texture or destroyed here
  ~Prep() {
    if (img.image && host) vkDestroyImage(host->device, img.image, nullptr);
    if (img.memory && host) vkFreeMemory(host->device, img.memory, nullptr);
  }
};
bool PrepHelpOn() {   // [perf] pass 5, opt-in SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_HELP=1 (no measured gain: bursts' misses are rarely "not started")
  static const bool on = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_HELP"); return e && *e == '1'; }();
  return on;
}
// [perf] SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_IMAGE=1: the workers also create the VkImage + memory. Off by default: in two A/B pairs (pass 5) it cut
// ensureimg per burst (41-49 to 15-29 ms) but the hub burst's upload time doubled and scratch allocation slowed (allocation contention).
bool PrepImageOn() {
  static const bool on = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_IMAGE"); return e && *e == '1'; }();
  return on;
}
std::mutex g_prepMu;
std::condition_variable g_prepCv, g_prepDoneCv;
std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Prep>> g_prepQ;
std::unordered_map<const TextureImpl*, std::shared_ptr<Prep>> g_prepOf;
std::deque<std::pair<const TextureImpl*, uint64_t>> g_prepOrder;   // ready order for eviction (texture, seq)
uint64_t g_prepBytes = 0, g_prepSeq = 0;
std::vector<const Prep*> g_prepRunning;   // jobs reading guest memory right now (TexPrefetchPoolGone waits for them)
std::unordered_set<const TextureImpl*> g_prepDropped;   // [perf] evicted before their upload (pref_miss_drop)
uint64_t PrepBudget() {
  static const uint64_t b = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_UPLOAD_PREFETCH_MB"); long v = e && *e ? strtol(e, nullptr, 10) : 1536; return (uint64_t)std::clamp(v, 0L, 8192L) << 20; }();   // MB, clamped (negative wrapped); pass 6 default 1536 (384 dropped all 788 missed uploads)
  return b;
}
// Total Vulkan-side bytes and per-(layer, level) offsets, exactly as UploadStaticTexture computes them.
uint64_t PlanOffsets(const TextureBuilder& b, const FormatInfo* fi, const SurfaceLayout& lay, uint32_t layers, uint32_t levels, std::vector<uint64_t>& offs) {
  uint64_t total = 0;
  offs.clear();
  for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < layers; ly++)
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < levels; m++) {
      const LevelLayout& l = lay.levels[m];
      offs.push_back(total);
      total += ((uint64_t)((l.w + fi->bw - 1) / fi->bw) * ((l.h + fi->bh - 1) / fi->bh) * l.d * fi->bytes + 15) & ~15ull;
    }
  (void)b;
  return total;
}
bool PrepRun(Prep& pr) {   // state stays 1 (running); the worker publishes the result under g_prepMu
  const TextureBuilder& b = pr.b;
  const FormatInfo* fi = pr.fi;
  const uint32_t depth = b.target == TT_3D ? (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1) : 1, layers = TextureLayerCount(b), levels = Levels(b);
  SurfaceLayout lay = ComputeSurfaceLayout((uint32_t)b.width, (uint32_t)b.height, depth, layers, (uint32_t)std::max(b.levels, 1), fi->bytes, fi->bw, fi->bh);
  std::vector<uint64_t> offs;
  const uint64_t total = PlanOffsets(b, fi, lay, layers, levels, offs);
  pr.srcBytes = lay.total;
  const uint64_t h1 = FastHash(pr.src, pr.srcBytes);
  pr.data.resize((size_t)total);
  std::vector<uint8_t> lin;
  for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < layers; ly++)
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < levels; m++) {
      if (pr.cancel.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
      const LevelLayout& l = lay.levels[m];
      lin.resize((size_t)l.wb * l.hb * l.d * fi->bytes);
      DeswizzleLevel(pr.src + ly * lay.layerSize + l.offset, lin.data(), l, fi->bytes);
      memcpy(pr.data.data() + offs[ly * levels + m], lin.data(), lin.size());
    }
  if (FastHash(pr.src, pr.srcBytes) != h1) return false;   // written meanwhile
  pr.hash = h1;
  return true;
}
void PrepWorker() {
  SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
  for (;;) {
    std::shared_ptr<Prep> pr;
    {
      std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
      g_prepCv.wait(lk, [] { return !g_prepQ.empty(); });
      pr = g_prepQ.front(); g_prepQ.pop_front();
      if (pr->cancel.load() || pr->state.load() != 0) { if (pr->state.load() == 0) pr->state = 3; continue; }
      pr->state = 1;
      g_prepRunning.push_back(pr.get());
    }
    bool ok = PrepRun(*pr);
    if (ok && PrepImageOn() && pr->host && !pr->cancel.load() && !CreateTexImage(pr->host, pr->b, pr->fi, pr->hw, pr->hh, pr->img)) pr->img = TexImage{};
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
      g_prepRunning.erase(std::find(g_prepRunning.begin(), g_prepRunning.end(), pr.get()));
      if (ok && !pr->cancel.load()) { g_prepBytes += pr->data.size(); pr->state = 2; }
      else { pr->data.clear(); pr->data.shrink_to_fit(); pr->state = 3; }   // failed, or forgotten / evicted while running
    }
    g_prepDoneCv.notify_all();
  }
}
// Under g_prepMu: drop ready entries, oldest first, until the staged bytes fit the budget.
void PrepEvictLocked() {
  while (g_prepBytes > PrepBudget() && !g_prepOrder.empty()) {
    auto [t, seq] = g_prepOrder.front(); g_prepOrder.pop_front();
    auto it = g_prepOf.find(t);
    if (it == g_prepOf.end() || it->second->seq != seq) continue;
    if (it->second->state.load() == 1) { g_prepOrder.push_back({t, seq}); break; }   // running: keep, try later
    if (it->second->state.load() == 2) g_prepBytes -= std::min<uint64_t>(g_prepBytes, it->second->data.size());
    it->second->cancel = true;
    g_prepOf.erase(it);
    if (g_prepDropped.size() > 65536) g_prepDropped.clear();   // diagnostics only: keep it bounded
    g_prepDropped.insert(t);
  }
}
// Removes the entry of `t`; waits while its job runs. Returns it only when its data is ready.
std::shared_ptr<Prep> PrepTake(const TextureImpl* t, int* why) {   // why: 1 none queued, 2 job not usable, 3 not started, 4 dropped
  std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
  auto it = g_prepOf.find(t);
  if (it == g_prepOf.end()) { *why = g_prepDropped.erase(t) ? 4 : 1; return nullptr; }
  std::shared_ptr<Prep> pr = it->second;
  g_prepOf.erase(it);
  if (pr->state.load() == 0 && !PrepHelpOn()) { pr->cancel = true; pr->state = 3; *why = 3; return nullptr; }   // not started: synchronous path
  // [perf] pass 5: not started yet, so the replay thread works the queue too. It takes up to 8 jobs from the front (textures
  // initialized just before this one, usually drawn in the same frame), then its own. The workers keep going in parallel. Before,
  // every not-started texture of a scene-change burst was deswizzled serially here.
  for (int helped = 0; pr->state.load() == 0;) {
    std::shared_ptr<Prep> j;
    if (helped < 8 && !g_prepQ.empty()) { j = g_prepQ.front(); g_prepQ.pop_front(); }
    else { j = pr; auto q = std::find(g_prepQ.begin(), g_prepQ.end(), pr); if (q != g_prepQ.end()) g_prepQ.erase(q); }
    if (j != pr && (j->cancel.load() || j->state.load() != 0)) { if (j->state.load() == 0) j->state = 3; continue; }
    j->state = 1;
    g_prepRunning.push_back(j.get());
    lk.unlock();
    bool ok = PrepRun(*j);
    if (ok && j != pr && PrepImageOn() && j->host && !j->cancel.load() && !CreateTexImage(j->host, j->b, j->fi, j->hw, j->hh, j->img)) j->img = TexImage{};
    lk.lock();
    g_prepRunning.erase(std::find(g_prepRunning.begin(), g_prepRunning.end(), j.get()));
    if (ok && (j == pr || !j->cancel.load())) { g_prepBytes += j->data.size(); j->state = 2; }
    else { j->data.clear(); j->data.shrink_to_fit(); j->state = 3; }
    g_prepDoneCv.notify_all();
    if (j != pr) helped++;
  }
  g_prepDoneCv.wait(lk, [&] { return pr->state.load() != 1; });
  if (pr->state.load() != 2) { *why = 2; return nullptr; }
  g_prepBytes -= std::min<uint64_t>(g_prepBytes, pr->data.size());
  return pr;
}
}  // namespace

void TexPrefetch(TextureImpl* t) {
  if (!PrepBudget() || !t || !t->fi) return;
  const TextureBuilder& b = t->b;
  const FormatInfo* fi = t->fi;
  if (fi->astcW || fi->aspect != VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT || b.samples > 1 || (b.flags & TF_LINEAR) || b.width <= 0 || b.height <= 0) return;
  if (b.target != TT_2D && b.target != TT_2D_ARRAY && b.target != TT_CUBEMAP && b.target != TT_CUBEMAP_ARRAY && b.target != TT_3D) { snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_PREF_SKIP_KIND); return; }
  if (TextureStorageSize(b) > (48ull << 20)) { snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_PREF_SKIP_KIND); return; }   // render-target sized: not worth holding
  const uint8_t* src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(b.packaged);
  const void* poolKey = nullptr;
  if (b.pool) {
    if (auto* p = Impl<PoolImpl>(b.pool, MAGIC_POOL)) {
      poolKey = p;
      if (!src && !(b.flags & (TF_COMPRESSIBLE | TF_DISPLAY | TF_LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET)) && p->storage) src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p->storage) + b.poolOffset;
    }
  }
  if (!src) { snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_PREF_SKIP_NOSRC); return; }
  static std::once_flag once;
  std::call_once(once, [] {
    const unsigned n = std::max(1u, std::min(4u, std::thread::hardware_concurrency() / 8));
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) std::thread(PrepWorker).detach();
  });
  auto pr = std::make_shared<Prep>();
  pr->b = b; pr->fi = fi; pr->src = src; pr->pool = poolKey;
  pr->host = t->host; pr->hw = t->HW(); pr->hh = t->HH();
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
    PrepEvictLocked();
    if (g_prepBytes >= PrepBudget()) { snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_PREF_SKIP_BUDGET); return; }
    g_prepDropped.erase(t);
    pr->seq = ++g_prepSeq;
    auto old = g_prepOf.find(t);
    if (old != g_prepOf.end()) {
      old->second->cancel = true;
      if (old->second->state.load() == 2) g_prepBytes -= std::min<uint64_t>(g_prepBytes, old->second->data.size());
    }
    if (g_prepOrder.size() > 2 * g_prepOf.size() + 4096) {   // drop records of entries already taken or forgotten
      std::deque<std::pair<const TextureImpl*, uint64_t>> keep;
      for (auto& o : g_prepOrder) { auto it = g_prepOf.find(o.first); if (it != g_prepOf.end() && it->second->seq == o.second) keep.push_back(o); }
      g_prepOrder.swap(keep);
    }
    g_prepOf[t] = pr;
    g_prepOrder.push_back({t, pr->seq});
    g_prepQ.push_back(pr);
  }
  g_prepCv.notify_one();
}
// [perf] TextureImpl::EnsureImage: hand over the image a prefetch worker created for `t` (ready jobs only, never waits), when the
// builder and host size still match. The deswizzled data stays queued for UploadStaticTexture.
bool TexPrefetchTakeImage(TextureImpl* t) {
  if (!PrepBudget() || !PrepImageOn()) return false;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
  auto it = g_prepOf.find(t);
  if (it == g_prepOf.end()) return false;
  Prep& pr = *it->second;
  if (pr.state.load() != 2 || !pr.img.image || pr.hw != t->HW() || pr.hh != t->HH() || pr.fi != t->fi || memcmp(&pr.b, &t->b, sizeof pr.b) != 0) return false;
  t->image = pr.img.image; t->memory = pr.img.memory;
  t->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED; t->subLayout.clear();
  t->imgLevels = pr.img.levels; t->imgLayers = pr.img.layers; t->ci_flags = pr.img.flags;
  pr.img = TexImage{};   // owned by the texture now
  snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_UPLOAD_PREF_IMG);
  return true;
}

void TexPrefetchShutdown() {
  std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
  for (auto& pr : g_prepQ) pr->cancel = true;
  g_prepDoneCv.wait(lk, [] { return g_prepRunning.empty(); });
  g_prepQ.clear(); g_prepOf.clear(); g_prepOrder.clear(); g_prepBytes = 0;   // ~Prep destroys any worker image now, device still alive
}

// TextureFinalize / DestroyTexture: drop the entry and wait for a running job (it reads the guest source).
void TexPrefetchForget(const TextureImpl* t) {
  if (!PrepBudget()) return;
  std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
  auto it = g_prepOf.find(t);
  if (it == g_prepOf.end()) return;
  std::shared_ptr<Prep> pr = it->second;
  g_prepOf.erase(it);
  pr->cancel = true;
  g_prepDoneCv.wait(lk, [&] { return pr->state.load() != 1; });
  if (pr->state.load() == 2) g_prepBytes -= std::min<uint64_t>(g_prepBytes, pr->data.size());
}
// DestroyPool: cancel queued jobs that read this pool and wait for running ones.
void TexPrefetchPoolGone(const void* pool) {
  if (!PrepBudget() || !pool) return;
  std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(g_prepMu);
  for (auto& pr : g_prepQ) if (pr->pool == pool) pr->cancel = true;
  g_prepDoneCv.wait(lk, [&] {
    for (const Prep* pr : g_prepRunning) if (pr->pool == pool) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

void UploadStaticTexture(ReplayCtx& cx, TextureImpl* t) {
  if (t->uploaded) return;
  t->uploaded = true;   // one attempt only
  struct PerfUp {
    uint64_t t0; const TextureImpl* t;
    ~PerfUp() {
      if (!snap_perf::on) return;
      const uint64_t dt = snap_perf::now_ns() - t0;
      snap_perf::add(snap_perf::C_UPLOAD, dt); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_UPLOADS);
      if (dt > 2000000) { char det[96]; snprintf(det, sizeof det, "%dx%d fmt=%x levels=%d", t->b.width, t->b.height, t->b.format, t->b.levels); snap_perf::event("texupload", (double)dt / 1e6, det); }
    }
  } perfUp{snap_perf::on ? snap_perf::now_ns() : 0, t};
  const TextureBuilder& b = t->b;
  if (!t->EnsureImage()) return;   // adopts the prefetch worker's image when there is one (TexPrefetchTakeImage)
  int prepWhy = 0;
  std::shared_ptr<Prep> pre = PrepBudget() ? PrepTake(t, &prepWhy) : nullptr;   // [perf] prefetched data, checked below
  const uint8_t* src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(b.packaged);
  if (!src && b.pool && !(b.flags & (TF_COMPRESSIBLE | TF_DISPLAY | TF_LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET))) {
    if (auto* p = Impl<PoolImpl>(b.pool, MAGIC_POOL)) if (p->storage) src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p->storage) + b.poolOffset;
  }
  if (!src) return;
  if (t->fi->aspect != VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT || b.samples > 1) return;
  const FormatInfo* fi = t->fi;
  const GuestFmt g = GuestFormat(fi);
  if ((b.flags & TF_LINEAR) && !fi->astcW && b.target != TT_3D && b.target != TT_CUBEMAP) {
    // Pitch-linear texture (the game's CPU-rendered glyph atlases): rows are `stride` bytes apart, not block-linear.
    const uint32_t wb = ((uint32_t)b.width + fi->bw - 1) / fi->bw, hb = ((uint32_t)b.height + fi->bh - 1) / fi->bh;
    const uint64_t rowBytes = (uint64_t)wb * fi->bytes;
    const uint64_t stride = b.stride >= (int)rowBytes ? (uint64_t)b.stride : rowBytes;
    VkBuffer lbuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint8_t* lmap = NewScratch(cx, rowBytes * hb, &lbuf);
    if (!lmap) { LogError("linear texture upload: staging allocation failed"); return; }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < hb; y++) memcpy(lmap + (uint64_t)y * rowBytes, src + (uint64_t)y * stride, (size_t)rowBytes);
    t->srcHash = HashBytes(src, stride * hb);
    DebugDumpTexture(t, "linear", lmap, rowBytes * hb, (uint32_t)b.width, (uint32_t)b.height);
    EndRendering(cx);
    Transition(cx.cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy r{};
    r.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
    r.imageExtent = {(uint32_t)b.width, (uint32_t)b.height, 1};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cx.cb, lbuf, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &r);
    return;
  }
  const uint32_t depth = b.target == TT_3D ? (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1) : 1, layers = TextureLayerCount(b);
  const uint32_t levels = Levels(b);
  SurfaceLayout lay = ComputeSurfaceLayout((uint32_t)b.width, (uint32_t)b.height, depth, layers, (uint32_t)std::max(b.levels, 1), g.bpb, g.bw, g.bh);
  const bool astc = fi->astcW != 0 && !(fi->vk >= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK && fi->vk <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK);
  const bool toBc7 = astc && fi->bw == 4;
  // Vulkan-side bytes of one (level, layer) subresource
  auto vkSize = [&](const LevelLayout& l) -> uint64_t {
    return (uint64_t)((l.w + fi->bw - 1) / fi->bw) * ((l.h + fi->bh - 1) / fi->bh) * l.d * fi->bytes;
  };
  uint64_t total = 0;
  std::vector<uint64_t> offs;
  for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < layers; ly++) for (uint32_t m = 0; m < levels; m++) { offs.push_back(total); total += (vkSize(lay.levels[m]) + 15) & ~15ull; }

  VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  uint8_t* map = NewScratch(cx, total, &buf);
  if (!map) { LogError("texture upload: staging allocation failed (%llu bytes)", (unsigned long long)total); return; }
  snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_UPLOAD_BYTES, total);   // [perf] was never wired

  // Disk cache for the (expensive) ASTC transcode: keyed by a 128-bit hash of the guest data plus format/size.
  std::string cachePath;
  if (!astc && pre) {   // [perf] deswizzled ahead of time by TexPrefetch, valid while the guest bytes are unchanged
    if (auto& pr = pre) {
      if (pr->src == src && pr->data.size() == total && pr->srcBytes == lay.total && FastHash(src, lay.total) == pr->hash) {
        memcpy(map, pr->data.data(), (size_t)total);
        snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_UPLOAD_PREF);
        goto cached;
      }
      snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_PREF_MISS_HASH);
    }
  } else if (!astc && PrepBudget() && !(b.flags & TF_LINEAR) && b.samples <= 1) {
    snap_perf::count(prepWhy == 1 ? snap_perf::V_PREF_MISS_NONE : prepWhy == 4 ? snap_perf::V_PREF_MISS_DROP : prepWhy == 3 ? snap_perf::V_PREF_MISS_LATE : snap_perf::V_PREF_MISS_FAIL);
  }
  if (astc && !cx.h->cacheDir.empty()) {
    uint64_t h1 = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull, h2 = 0x1234567ull;
    Fnv(src, (size_t)lay.total, h1, h2);
    char name[160];
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "/astc_%x_%dx%d_%dx%d_%u_%u_%d_%016llx%016llx.bin", b.format, b.width, b.height, b.depth, b.levels,
             layers, toBc7 ? 7 : 8, (int)b.target, (unsigned long long)h1, (unsigned long long)h2);
    cachePath = cx.h->cacheDir + name;
    std::ifstream f(cachePath, std::ios::binary);
    if (f) {
      f.read((char*)map, (std::streamsize)total);
      if ((uint64_t)f.gcount() == total) goto cached;
    }
  }
  {
    std::vector<uint8_t> lin, rgba;
    for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < layers; ly++)
      for (uint32_t m = 0; m < levels; m++) {
        const LevelLayout& l = lay.levels[m];
        lin.resize((size_t)l.wb * l.hb * l.d * g.bpb);
        DeswizzleLevel(src + ly * lay.layerSize + l.offset, lin.data(), l, g.bpb);
        uint8_t* dst = map + offs[ly * levels + m];
        if (!astc) { memcpy(dst, lin.data(), lin.size()); continue; }
        // ASTC fallback (2D slices; 3D ASTC is not decoded)
        rgba.assign((size_t)l.w * l.h * 4, 0);
        AstcDecodeLdr(lin.data(), l.w, l.h, g.bw, g.bh, fi->srgb, rgba.data());
        if (toBc7) EncodeBc7(rgba.data(), l.w, l.h, dst);
        else memcpy(dst, rgba.data(), rgba.size());
      }
  }
  if (!cachePath.empty()) {
    std::ofstream f(cachePath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (f) f.write((const char*)map, (std::streamsize)total);
  }
cached:
  if (const char* dd = getenv("NVN_TEX_DUMP")) { (void)dd; DebugDumpTexture(t, "static", map + offs[0], vkSize(lay.levels[0]), lay.levels[0].w, lay.levels[0].h); }
  EndRendering(cx);
  Transition(cx.cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
  std::vector<VkBufferImageCopy> regions;
  for (uint32_t ly = 0; ly < layers; ly++)
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < levels; m++) {
      const LevelLayout& l = lay.levels[m];
      VkBufferImageCopy r{};
      r.bufferOffset = offs[ly * levels + m];
      r.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, m, ly, 1};
      r.imageExtent = {l.w, l.h, l.d};
      regions.push_back(r);
    }
  vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cx.cb, buf, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, (uint32_t)regions.size(), regions.data());
}

void RefreshDynamicTexture(ReplayCtx& cx, TextureImpl* t) {
  if (t->hashSeq == g_replaySeq) return;
  uint64_t n = 0;
  const uint8_t* src = DynamicSource(t, &n);
  if (!src || n > (32u << 20)) return;
  t->hashSeq = g_replaySeq;
  { snap_perf::Scope perfHash(snap_perf::C_HASH); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_HASH_CALLS); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_HASH_BYTES, n);
    if (HashBytes(src, n) == t->srcHash) return; }
  t->uploaded = false;
  UploadStaticTexture(cx, t);
}

}  // namespace nvn
```

```h
// Provenance legend, used in the comments below:
//   [CALL 0xADDR]  evidence from the game binary (analysis/import/v262144-main.elf, module offsets):
//                  argument setup at the call site, or an allocation size next to the call.
//   [TOTK-NVN]     value cross-checked against tools/ref/totk/runtime/nvn.h (MIT, h1k421 / TotK recomp).
//                  That file was reconstructed by the community from public DWARF of a shipped game,
//                  not from the Nintendo SDK; we read it as a reference and re-typed the values.
//   [LAS-NVN]      tools/ref/las/runtime/nvn/formats.c (MIT), format block sizes and groups.
// No Nintendo SDK header was obtained or copied.
```

```cpp
  SetBc(0x49, VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK, 8); SetBc(0x4A, VK_FORMAT_BC4_SNORM_BLOCK, 8);
  SetBc(0x4B, VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK, 16); SetBc(0x4C, VK_FORMAT_BC5_SNORM_BLOCK, 16);
  SetBc(0x4D, VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK, 16); SetBc(0x4E, VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK, 16, true);
  SetBc(0x4F, VK_FORMAT_BC6H_SFLOAT_BLOCK, 16); SetBc(0x50, VK_FORMAT_BC6H_UFLOAT_BLOCK, 16);
  // ASTC LDR 0x79..0x94: 14 block sizes, unorm then sRGB. [ASSUMPTION: order not confirmed, the game uses no ASTC.]
  for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    g_fmts[0x79 + i] = {kAstcUnorm[i], 16, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, kAstcDims[i][0], kAstcDims[i][1], kAstcDims[i][0], kAstcDims[i][1], false};
    g_fmts[0x87 + i] = {AstcSrgb(kAstcUnorm[i]), 16, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, kAstcDims[i][0], kAstcDims[i][1], kAstcDims[i][0], kAstcDims[i][1], true};
  }
  SetF(FMT_BGRX8_SRGB, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, 4); SetF(FMT_BGRA8_SRGB, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, 4);
}
const FormatInfo* LookupFormat(int f) {
  InitFormats();
  if (f <= 0 || f >= (int)(sizeof g_fmts / sizeof *g_fmts) || g_fmts[f].vk == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) return nullptr;
  return &g_fmts[f];
}
static void PatchFormatFallbacks(VkPhysicalDevice pd) {
  InitFormats();
  VkFormatProperties p{};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(pd, VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT, &p);
  if (!(p.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) {
    g_fmts[FMT_DEPTH24_STENCIL8].vk = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    g_fmts[FMT_DEPTH24_STENCIL8].bytes = 8;
    Log("D24S8 unsupported, using D32S8");
  }
  // ASTC LDR: native when the device has it, else CPU decode and transcode to BC7 (RGBA8 if BC7 is missing or
  // NVN_ASTC_FALLBACK=rgba8). The decode happens in UploadStaticTexture.
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(pd, VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK, &p);
  if (!(p.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT)) {
    VkFormatProperties pb{};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(pd, VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK, &pb);
    const char* e = getenv("NVN_ASTC_FALLBACK");
    bool bc7 = (pb.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT) && !(e && !strcmp(e, "rgba8"));
    for (int i = 0x79; i <= 0x94; i++) {
      FormatInfo& f = g_fmts[i];
      if (bc7) { f.vk = f.srgb ? VK_FORMAT_BC7_SRGB_BLOCK : VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK; f.bytes = 16; f.bw = f.bh = 4; }
      else { f.vk = f.srgb ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB : VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; f.bytes = 4; f.bw = f.bh = 1; }
    }
    Log("ASTC not supported by the device: decoding on the CPU, sampled as %s", bc7 ? "BC7 (transcoded)" : "RGBA8");
  }
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(pd, VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32, &p);
  if (!(p.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT)) {
    g_fmts[FMT_DEPTH24].vk = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;
    Log("D24 unsupported, using D32F");
  }
}

// ---- Host ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
static VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL DebugCb(VkDebugUtilsMessageSeverityFlagBitsEXT sev, VkDebugUtilsMessageTypeFlagsEXT,
                                              const VkDebugUtilsMessengerCallbackDataEXT* d, void*) {
  if (sev & VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT) {
    g_valErrors++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[vk][ERROR] %s\n", d->pMessage);
  } else if (sev & VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING_BIT_EXT) {
    g_valWarnings++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[vk][warn] %s\n", d->pMessage);
  }
  return VK_FALSE;
}

uint32_t Host::FindMemoryType(uint32_t bits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags want, VkMemoryPropertyFlags avoid) const {
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < memProps.memoryTypeCount; i++)
    if ((bits & (1u << i)) && (memProps.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want &&
        !(memProps.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & avoid))
      return i;
  return UINT32_MAX;
}

bool Host::Init(bool wantValidation) {
  uint32_t n = 0;
  bool haveLayer = false, haveValFeat = false;
  if (wantValidation) {
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkLayerProperties> lp(n);
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, lp.data());
    for (auto& l : lp) if (!strcmp(l.layerName, "VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation")) haveLayer = true;
    if (haveLayer) {
      vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties("VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation", &n, nullptr);
      std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> ep(n);
      vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties("VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation", &n, ep.data());
      for (auto& e : ep) if (!strcmp(e.extensionName, VK_EXT_VALIDATION_FEATURES_EXTENSION_NAME)) haveValFeat = true;
    }
    if (!haveLayer) LogError("validation requested but VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation not found (set VK_LAYER_PATH)");
  }
  validation = haveLayer;

  std::vector<const char*> iext = {VK_KHR_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_KHR_WIN32_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME};
  if (validation) {
    iext.push_back(VK_EXT_DEBUG_UTILS_EXTENSION_NAME);
    if (haveValFeat) iext.push_back(VK_EXT_VALIDATION_FEATURES_EXTENSION_NAME);
  }
  snap_hdr::AppendInstanceExt(iext);
  UpscaleInstanceExtensions(iext);   // [upscale]
  const char* layers[] = {"VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation"};
  VkValidationFeatureEnableEXT enables[] = {VK_VALIDATION_FEATURE_ENABLE_SYNCHRONIZATION_VALIDATION_EXT};
  VkValidationFeaturesEXT vf{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VALIDATION_FEATURES_EXT};
  vf.enabledValidationFeatureCount = 1;
  vf.pEnabledValidationFeatures = enables;
  VkApplicationInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
  ai.pApplicationName = "NVN-Vulkan layer";
  ai.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
  VkInstanceCreateInfo ici{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
  ici.pApplicationInfo = &ai;
  ici.enabledExtensionCount = (uint32_t)iext.size();
  ici.ppEnabledExtensionNames = iext.data();
  if (validation) {
    ici.enabledLayerCount = 1;
    ici.ppEnabledLayerNames = layers;
    if (haveValFeat) ici.pNext = &vf;
  }
  if (vkCreateInstance(&ici, nullptr, &instance) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateInstance failed"); return false; }

  if (validation) {
    auto fn = (PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
    VkDebugUtilsMessengerCreateInfoEXT mi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSENGER_CREATE_INFO_EXT};
    mi.messageSeverity = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING_BIT_EXT;
    mi.messageType = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_GENERAL_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_VALIDATION_BIT_EXT |
                     VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_PERFORMANCE_BIT_EXT;
    mi.pfnUserCallback = DebugCb;
    if (fn) fn(instance, &mi, nullptr, &messenger);
  }

  // Pick a physical device: Vulkan 1.3, graphics+compute queue family with Win32 presentation support.
  vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, nullptr);
  std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> pds(n);
  vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, pds.data());
  int bestScore = -1;
  for (auto pd : pds) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pr; vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd, &pr);
    if (pr.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3) continue;
    uint32_t qn = 0; vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd, &qn, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> qf(qn); vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd, &qn, qf.data());
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < qn; i++) {
      const VkQueueFlags need = VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT;
      if ((qf[i].queueFlags & need) == need && vkGetPhysicalDeviceWin32PresentationSupportKHR(pd, i)) {
        int score = pr.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU ? 2 : 1;
        if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; phys = pd; family = i; props = pr; }
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!phys) { LogError("no Vulkan 1.3 GPU with graphics+present queue"); return false; }
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(phys, &memProps);
  Log("GPU: %s", props.deviceName);

  VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(phys, &f2);
  VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES};
  f13.synchronization2 = VK_TRUE;
  f13.dynamicRendering = VK_TRUE;
  {   // translator patch 0010 (SNAP_XLATE_REV=3) turns KIL into OpDemoteToHelperInvocation; the feature is harmless when no module uses it
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features qd{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 qd2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, &qd};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(phys, &qd2);
    f13.shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation = qd.shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation;
  }
  VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
  f12.timelineSemaphore = VK_TRUE;
  f12.pNext = &f13;
  VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features f11{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES};
  f11.shaderDrawParameters = VK_TRUE;   // translated shaders use DrawParameters (base vertex / base instance builtins)
  f13.pNext = &f11;
  {
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features q12{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 q2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, &q12};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(phys, &q2);
    f12.samplerMirrorClampToEdge = q12.samplerMirrorClampToEdge;
    f12.hostQueryReset = q12.hostQueryReset;   // vkResetQueryPool in the replay (queries are reset on the host while recording)
    hostQueryReset = q12.hostQueryReset == VK_TRUE;
  }
  VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 en{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
  // Every core feature the GPU has: translated shaders declare Float64/Int64/ImageGatherExtended/ClipDistance...,
  // and cbuffers are declared as vec4[4096], so robustBufferAccess is needed for short UBO ranges.
  en.features = f2.features;
  features = f2.features;
  en.pNext = &f12;
  float prio = 1.0f;
  VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO};
  qci.queueFamilyIndex = family;
  qci.queueCount = 1;
  qci.pQueuePriorities = &prio;
  std::vector<const char*> dext = {VK_KHR_SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSION_NAME};
  snap_hdr::AppendDeviceExt(phys, dext);
  // Maxwell/NVN behaviours Vulkan lacks by default (docs/nvn-vulkan-design.md "Maxwell checks"): flat varyings come from the last vertex,
  // sampler border colors are arbitrary RGBA, and the translated shaders' subgroup ops assume 32 lanes. Each is optional and has an
  // env switch (=0) for A/B runs: SNAP_VK_PROVOKING, SNAP_VK_BORDER, SNAP_VK_SGPIN.
  VkPhysicalDeviceProvokingVertexFeaturesEXT pvf{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROVOKING_VERTEX_FEATURES_EXT};
  VkPhysicalDeviceCustomBorderColorFeaturesEXT cbf{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_FEATURES_EXT};
  {
    auto on = [](const char* n) { const char* e = getenv(n); return !(e && e[0] == '0'); };
    uint32_t ne = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(phys, nullptr, &ne, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> ep(ne);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(phys, nullptr, &ne, ep.data());
```
