    auto has = [&](const char* n) { for (auto& e : ep) if (!strcmp(e.extensionName, n)) return true; return false; };
    VkPhysicalDeviceProvokingVertexFeaturesEXT qpv{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROVOKING_VERTEX_FEATURES_EXT};
    VkPhysicalDeviceCustomBorderColorFeaturesEXT qcb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_FEATURES_EXT};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features q13{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES};
    qpv.pNext = &qcb; qcb.pNext = &q13;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 q2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, &qpv};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(phys, &q2);
    if (has(VK_EXT_PROVOKING_VERTEX_EXTENSION_NAME) && qpv.provokingVertexLast && on("SNAP_VK_PROVOKING")) {
      dext.push_back(VK_EXT_PROVOKING_VERTEX_EXTENSION_NAME); pvf.provokingVertexLast = VK_TRUE; g_provokingLast = true;
      pvf.pNext = f11.pNext; f11.pNext = &pvf;
    }
    if (has(VK_EXT_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_EXTENSION_NAME) && qcb.customBorderColors && qcb.customBorderColorWithoutFormat && on("SNAP_VK_BORDER")) {
      dext.push_back(VK_EXT_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_EXTENSION_NAME); cbf.customBorderColors = cbf.customBorderColorWithoutFormat = VK_TRUE; g_customBorder = true;
      cbf.pNext = f11.pNext; f11.pNext = &cbf;
    }
    if (q13.subgroupSizeControl && on("SNAP_VK_SGPIN")) {
      VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Properties p13{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_PROPERTIES};
      VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 pp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, &p13};
      vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(phys, &pp);
      if (p13.minSubgroupSize <= 32 && 32 <= p13.maxSubgroupSize) {
        f13.subgroupSizeControl = VK_TRUE; g_sgPinStages = p13.requiredSubgroupSizeStages;
        Log("subgroup size %u-%u, required-size stages 0x%x: pinning shaders with subgroup ops to 32", p13.minSubgroupSize, p13.maxSubgroupSize, (unsigned)g_sgPinStages);
      }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[nvn] maxwell checks: provokingVertexLast=%d customBorderColor=%d subgroupPin=0x%x\n", (int)g_provokingLast, (int)g_customBorder, (unsigned)g_sgPinStages);
  }
  snap_pace::AppendDeviceExt(phys, dext, &f11);   // [pace] VK_KHR_present_id + present_wait (queue depth cap)
  UpscaleDeviceExtensions(this, dext, &en.pNext, &f11, &f12, &f13);   // [upscale] backend extensions and features
  VkDeviceCreateInfo dci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
  dci.pNext = &en;
  dci.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
  dci.pQueueCreateInfos = &qci;
  dci.enabledExtensionCount = (uint32_t)dext.size();
  dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = dext.data();
  if (vkCreateDevice(phys, &dci, nullptr, &device) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateDevice failed"); return false; }
  vkGetDeviceQueue(device, family, 0, &queue);
  snap_hdr::LoadDeviceFuncs(device);
  snap_pace::DeviceCreated(device);   // [pace]
  UpscaleDeviceCreated(this);   // [upscale]
  VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo pci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_CACHE_CREATE_INFO};
  VKCHK(vkCreatePipelineCache(device, &pci, nullptr, &pipelineCache));
  {
    const char* e = getenv("NVN_CACHE_DIR");
    if (e && *e) cacheDir = e;
    else {
      char path[MAX_PATH] = {};
      GetModuleFileNameA(nullptr, path, MAX_PATH);
      std::string d = path;
      size_t k = d.find_last_of("\\/");
      cacheDir = (k == std::string::npos ? std::string(".") : d.substr(0, k)) + "\\nvn_cache";
    }
    if (const char* r = getenv("SNAP_XLATE_REV"); r && *r && strcmp(r, "0")) cacheDir += std::string("_r") + r;   // translator revision: separate shader cache (nvn_shader.cpp)
    CreateDirectoryA(cacheDir.c_str(), nullptr);
    LoadPipelineCache(this);
  }
  PatchFormatFallbacks(phys);
  return true;
}

void Host::Shutdown() {
  if (device) vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
  if (device) UpscaleDestroy(this);   // [upscale]
  if (device) DestroyHostExtras(this);
  if (device) GraveDrain(this);   // [nvnfix] retired textures, samplers, pools, programs (the device is idle)
  if (device) { TexPrefetchShutdown(); ScratchPoolDrain(this); }   // [perf] staged prefetch images, recycled scratch buffers
  if (pipelineCache) vkDestroyPipelineCache(device, pipelineCache, nullptr);
  if (device) vkDestroyDevice(device, nullptr);
  if (messenger) {
    auto fn = (PFN_vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkDestroyDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
    if (fn) fn(instance, messenger, nullptr);
  }
  if (instance) vkDestroyInstance(instance, nullptr);
  device = VK_NULL_HANDLE; instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE; messenger = VK_NULL_HANDLE; pipelineCache = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
}

// ---- images ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
uint32_t TextureLayerCount(const TextureBuilder& b) {
  switch (b.target) {
    case TT_1D_ARRAY: case TT_2D_ARRAY: return (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1);
    case TT_CUBEMAP: return 6;
    case TT_CUBEMAP_ARRAY: return (b.depth % 6 == 0 && b.depth > 0) ? (uint32_t)b.depth : (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1) * 6;  // [ASSUMPTION] unused by the game
    default: return 1;
  }
}
bool TextureImpl::EnsureImage() {
  if (image) return true;
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_ENSUREIMG);   // [perf] replay sub-scope
  if (!fi) fi = LookupFormat(b.format);
  if (!fi) { LogError("texture format 0x%x not mapped", b.format); return false; }
  if (TexPrefetchTakeImage(this)) return true;   // [perf] created ahead by a prefetch worker
  TexImage ti;
  if (!CreateTexImage(host, b, fi, HW(), HH(), ti)) return false;
  image = ti.image; memory = ti.memory;
  layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
  subLayout.clear();
  imgLevels = ti.levels; imgLayers = ti.layers; ci_flags = ti.flags;
  return true;
}

// [perf] The VkImage + dedicated memory of a texture, from its builder and host size alone (no TextureImpl state), so the upload
// prefetch workers can create it ahead of the replay (nvn_tex_vk.cpp TexPrefetch). Thread-safe: device-level create calls only.
bool CreateTexImage(Host* host, const TextureBuilder& b, const FormatInfo* fi, uint32_t hw, uint32_t hh, TexImage& out) {
  VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkFormatProperties fp{};
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(host->phys, fi->vk, &fp);
  const auto feat = fp.optimalTilingFeatures;
  VkImageUsageFlags usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
  if (feat & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
  if (fi->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT) {
    if (feat & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    if (feat & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_STORAGE_IMAGE_BIT) usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT;
  } else if (feat & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT) {
    usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
  }
  VkImageCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.flags = VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT;   // views may reinterpret the format (TextureView SetFormat)
  ci.format = fi->vk;
  ci.mipLevels = (uint32_t)std::max(b.levels, 1);
  ci.arrayLayers = 1;
  ci.samples = b.samples > 1 ? (VkSampleCountFlagBits)b.samples : VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
  ci.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
  ci.usage = usage;
  ci.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
  switch (b.target) {
    case TT_2D: case TT_RECTANGLE: case TT_2D_MULTISAMPLE:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ci.extent = {hw, hh, 1}; break;
    case TT_1D:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; ci.extent = {(uint32_t)b.width, 1, 1}; break;
    case TT_1D_ARRAY:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; ci.extent = {(uint32_t)b.width, 1, 1};
      ci.arrayLayers = (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1); break;
    case TT_2D_ARRAY:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ci.extent = {hw, hh, 1};
      ci.arrayLayers = (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1);
      if (ci.arrayLayers >= 6 && ci.extent.width == ci.extent.height) ci.flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT;   // a shader may declare a cube
      break;
    case TT_CUBEMAP: case TT_CUBEMAP_ARRAY:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ci.extent = {hw, hh, 1};
      ci.arrayLayers = TextureLayerCount(b); ci.flags |= VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT; break;
    case TT_3D:
      ci.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D; ci.extent = {(uint32_t)b.width, (uint32_t)b.height, (uint32_t)std::max(b.depth, 1)}; break;
    default:
      LogError("texture target %d not supported yet", b.target); return false;
  }
  // clamp mip chain to what the extent allows
  uint32_t maxDim = std::max(ci.extent.width, std::max(ci.extent.height, ci.extent.depth)), maxMips = 1;
  while (maxDim >>= 1) maxMips++;
  ci.mipLevels = std::min(ci.mipLevels, maxMips);
  if (vkCreateImage(host->device, &ci, nullptr, &image) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateImage failed"); image = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return false; }
  VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(host->device, image, &mr);
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  mai.allocationSize = mr.size;
  mai.memoryTypeIndex = host->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
  if (mai.memoryTypeIndex == UINT32_MAX || vkAllocateMemory(host->device, &mai, nullptr, &memory) != VK_SUCCESS) {
    LogError("image memory allocation failed"); vkDestroyImage(host->device, image, nullptr); image = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return false;
  }
  vkBindImageMemory(host->device, image, memory, 0);
  out.image = image; out.memory = memory;
  out.levels = ci.mipLevels; out.layers = ci.arrayLayers; out.flags = ci.flags;
  return true;
}

static VkImageViewType ViewTypeFor(int target) {
  switch (target) {
    case TT_1D: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D;
    case TT_1D_ARRAY: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY;
    case TT_3D: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D;
    case TT_2D_ARRAY: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
    case TT_CUBEMAP: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE;
    case TT_CUBEMAP_ARRAY: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY;
    default: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
  }
}

SubRange TextureImpl::RangeOf(const TexView* v) const {
  TexView z{};
  if (!v) v = &z;
  const uint32_t lvlTotal = std::max(imgLevels, 1u), layers = std::max(imgLayers, 1u);
  uint32_t lb = (v->flags & 1) ? v->lvlBase : 0, ln = (v->flags & 1) ? v->lvlNum : lvlTotal;
  if (lb >= lvlTotal) lb = lvlTotal - 1;
  ln = std::max(1u, std::min(ln, lvlTotal - lb));
  uint32_t yb = (v->flags & 2) ? v->layerBase : 0, yn = (v->flags & 2) ? v->layerNum : layers;
  if (yb >= layers) yb = layers - 1;
  yn = std::max(1u, std::min(yn, layers - yb));
  return {lb, ln, yb, yn};
}

SubRange RtRange(const TextureImpl* t, const TexView* v) {
  SubRange r = t->RangeOf(v);
  r.ln = 1;                                              // an attachment is a single mip level
  if (!v || !(v->flags & 2)) r.yn = 1;                   // no layer selection: layer 0 only (as before)
  return r;
}

// TexView flags: 1 levels, 2 layers, 4 format, 8 target, 0x10 depth/stencil mode.
// Views are cached per (type, format, aspect, level window, layer window, sampled). shaderType (the translator's SamplerType:
// low byte 1 = 1D, 3 = 2D, 4 = 3D, 5 = cube, bit 8 = array) makes the view match what the shader declares.
VkImageView TextureImpl::View(const TexView* v, bool sampled, int shaderType, const SubRange* range) {
  if (!EnsureImage()) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_VIEW);   // [perf] replay sub-scope (key build + lookup + create on a miss)
  TexView z{};
  if (!v) v = &z;
  const FormatInfo* vf = fi;
  if (v->flags & 4) { if (const FormatInfo* o = LookupFormat(v->format)) vf = o; }
  const int target = (v->flags & 8) ? v->target : b.target;
  SubRange r = range ? *range : RangeOf(v);
  VkImageViewType vt = ViewTypeFor(target);
  if (shaderType) {
    const int dim = shaderType & 0xff;
    const bool arr = (shaderType & 0x100) != 0;
    const bool img1D = b.target == TT_1D || b.target == TT_1D_ARRAY, img3D = b.target == TT_3D;
    const bool cubeOk = (ci_flags & VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT) != 0;
    if (img1D) {
      if (dim != 1) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      vt = arr ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D;
      if (!arr) r.yn = 1;
    } else if (img3D) {
      if (dim != 4) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D; r.yb = 0; r.yn = 1;
    } else {
      switch (dim) {
        case 3:   // 2D
          vt = arr ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
          if (!arr) r.yn = 1;
          break;
        case 5:   // cube
          if (!cubeOk) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
          if (!arr) {
            vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE;
            if (r.yb + 6 > imgLayers) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            r.yn = 6;
          } else {
            vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY;
            r.yn = std::max(6u, r.yn / 6 * 6);
            if (r.yb + r.yn > imgLayers) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
          }
          break;
        default: return VK_NULL_HANDLE;   // buffer textures, 1D on a 2D image, 3D on a 2D image
      }
    }
  } else if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D || vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D || vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D) {
    if (vt != VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D) r.yn = 1;
  }
  VkImageAspectFlags asp = vf->aspect;
  if (sampled && (asp & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) && (asp & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT))
    asp = ((v->flags & 0x10) && v->dsMode == 1) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
  // [perf] binary key (snprintf was most of this function's cost; called per sampled texture per draw). The 0x01 lead byte keeps it
  // apart from RenderView's text keys ("R...") in the shared map.
  // 15 bytes so it stays in the string's small buffer (no heap allocation per lookup).
  // [nvnfix] RGBX / BGRX formats map to full RGBA Vulkan formats: a sampled view reads alpha as 1, as the X channel does on the
  // hardware (bit 0x40 of kb[1]; view types are < 0x40). Storage views keep the identity swizzle (Vulkan requires it).
  const int nvnFmt = ((v->flags & 4) && vf != fi) ? v->format : b.format;
  const bool xAlpha = sampled && (nvnFmt == FMT_RGBX8_SRGB || nvnFmt == FMT_BGRX8 || nvnFmt == FMT_BGRX8_SRGB);
  char kb[15];
  kb[0] = 1; kb[1] = (char)((sampled ? 0x80 : 0) | (xAlpha ? 0x40 : 0) | ((unsigned)vt & 0x3f)); kb[2] = (char)(uint8_t)asp;
  const uint32_t vkf = (uint32_t)vf->vk; memcpy(kb + 3, &vkf, 4);
  const uint16_t lv[4] = {(uint16_t)r.lb, (uint16_t)r.ln, (uint16_t)r.yb, (uint16_t)r.yn}; memcpy(kb + 7, lv, 8);
  const std::string key(kb, sizeof kb);
  auto it = views.find(key);
  if (it != views.end()) return it->second;
  VkImageViewCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.image = image;
  ci.viewType = vt;
  ci.format = vf->vk;
  ci.subresourceRange = {asp, r.lb, r.ln, r.yb, r.yn};
  if (xAlpha) { ci.components.a = VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ONE; LifeCount(LS_X_ALPHA_VIEWS); }
  VkImageView iv = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreateImageView(host->device, &ci, nullptr, &iv) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateImageView failed"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
  views[key] = iv; viewTypes[iv] = ci.viewType;
  return iv;
}
VkImageView TextureImpl::RenderView(const TexView* v, SubRange* out) {
  if (!EnsureImage()) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_VIEW);   // [perf] replay sub-scope
  SubRange r = RtRange(this, v);
  if (out) *out = r;
  const VkImageViewType vt = r.yn > 1 ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
  char key[64];
  snprintf(key, sizeof key, "R%d.%d.%u.%u.%u.%u", (int)vt, (int)fi->vk, (unsigned)fi->aspect, r.lb, r.yb, r.yn);
  auto it = views.find(key);
  if (it != views.end()) return it->second;
  VkImageViewCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
  ci.image = image; ci.viewType = vt; ci.format = fi->vk;
  ci.subresourceRange = {fi->aspect, r.lb, 1, r.yb, r.yn};
  VkImageView iv = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreateImageView(host->device, &ci, nullptr, &iv) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateImageView (attachment) failed"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
  views[key] = iv; viewTypes[iv] = ci.viewType;
  return iv;
}

void DestroyTexture(TextureImpl* t) {
  if (!t) return;
  TexPrefetchForget(t);   // [perf] a prefetch job may be reading its guest data
  UpscaleForgetTexture(t);   // [upscale]
  AaForgetTexture(t);   // drops the AA step's cached UNORM views of this image (the graveyard calls this once the GPU is done with it)
  if (t->bcShadow) { DestroyTexture(t->bcShadow); t->bcShadow = nullptr; }
  if (t->xferShadow) { DestroyTexture(t->xferShadow); t->xferShadow = nullptr; }
  if (t->host && t->host->device) {
    for (auto& kv : t->views) vkDestroyImageView(t->host->device, kv.second, nullptr);
    if (t->image) vkDestroyImage(t->host->device, t->image, nullptr);
    if (t->memory) vkFreeMemory(t->host->device, t->memory, nullptr);
  }
  delete t;
}

// ---- memory pools --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mirrored backing: a VkBuffer over one VkDeviceMemory block. CPU-accessible pools use HOST_VISIBLE|COHERENT
// memory (preferring DEVICE_LOCAL, i.e. resizable BAR) and are updated by memcpy from the guest pointer at
// MemoryPoolFlushMappedRange. GPU-only pools use DEVICE_LOCAL. Backing is created lazily (first flush / first
// buffer bind) because the game also creates many pools that only hold texture storage.
// [nvnfix] Loader threads (MemoryPoolFlushMappedRange, BufferFlushMappedRange) and the replay thread (ResolveBuf) can get here
// together. Creation is serialized and p->buffer is published last, so a thread that sees it non-null also sees bound memory and
// p->mapped (it used to be set before the allocation: a second thread could use an unbound buffer, or both allocated).
bool EnsureBacking(PoolImpl* p) {
  if (__atomic_load_n(&p->buffer, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return true;
  static std::mutex initMu;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> initLk(initMu);
  if (p->buffer) { LifeCount(LS_BACKING_RACE); return true; }
  Host* h = p->host;
  VkBufferCreateInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
  bi.size = p->size;
  bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT |
             VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT |
             VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT;
  VkBuffer buffer = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreateBuffer(h->device, &bi, nullptr, &buffer) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(h->device, buffer, &mr);
  uint32_t type = UINT32_MAX;
  if (p->Cpu()) {
    const VkMemoryPropertyFlags hv = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT;
    type = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, hv | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    if (type == UINT32_MAX) type = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, hv);
  } else {
    type = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
  }
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  mai.allocationSize = mr.size;
  mai.memoryTypeIndex = type;
  if (type == UINT32_MAX || vkAllocateMemory(h->device, &mai, nullptr, &p->memory) != VK_SUCCESS) {
    LogError("pool backing allocation failed (%llu bytes)", (unsigned long long)p->size);
    vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, buffer, nullptr); p->memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return false;
  }
  vkBindBufferMemory(h->device, buffer, p->memory, 0);
  if (h->memProps.memoryTypes[type].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT) {
    void* m = nullptr;
    vkMapMemory(h->device, p->memory, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &m);
    p->mapped = static_cast<uint8_t*>(m);
    if (p->mapped && p->storage) memcpy(p->mapped, p->storage, (size_t)p->size);
  }
  __atomic_store_n(&p->buffer, buffer, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  return true;
}
// ---- synthetic GPU address space ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The guest only treats an NVNbufferAddress as an opaque 64-bit value (BufferGetAddress + offset arithmetic).
// Every memory pool gets a 1 MiB-aligned range so an address maps back to (pool, offset) at replay.
void Host::RegisterPool(PoolImpl* p) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(vaMutex);
  p->va = nextVa;
  nextVa += (p->size + 0xFFFFF) & ~0xFFFFFull;
  nextVa += 0x100000;   // guard gap
  vaMap[p->va] = p;
}
void Host::UnregisterPool(PoolImpl* p) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(vaMutex);
  vaMap.erase(p->va);
}
bool Host::ResolveAddress(uint64_t addr, PoolImpl** pool, uint64_t* off) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(vaMutex);
  auto it = vaMap.upper_bound(addr);
  if (it == vaMap.begin()) return false;
  --it;
  PoolImpl* p = it->second;
  if (addr - p->va >= p->size) return false;
  *pool = p; *off = addr - p->va;
  return true;
}
void SyncPoolRange(PoolImpl* p, uint64_t off, uint64_t size) {
  if (!p || !p->Cpu() || !p->storage || off >= p->size) return;
  if (!p->buffer && !EnsureBacking(p)) return;
  if (!p->mapped) return;
  size = std::min<uint64_t>(size, p->size - off);
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_POOLSYNC);
  snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_POOLSYNC_CALLS); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_POOLSYNC_BYTES, size);
  uint64_t pos = off;
  const uint64_t end = off + size;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(p->gpuMutex);
  // copy [off, end) except the ranges the GPU owns (their CPU bytes are stale: the GPU wrote the real data)
  while (pos < end) {
    uint64_t next = end;
    bool skip = false;
    for (auto& r : p->gpuRanges) {
      if (r.second <= pos || r.first >= end) continue;
      if (r.first <= pos) { pos = std::max(pos, std::min(r.second, end)); skip = true; break; }
      next = std::min(next, r.first);
    }
    if (skip) continue;
    memcpy(p->mapped + pos, static_cast<uint8_t*>(p->storage) + pos, (size_t)(next - pos));
    pos = next;
  }
}
uint64_t g_replayEpoch = 1;
std::atomic<unsigned long> g_replayTid{0};
// [perf] Dirty-page sync (perf pass 4, pass2_design.md item 3). Guest memory is reserved with MEM_WRITE_WATCH
// (runtime/os/os_memory.cpp), so GetWriteWatch(RESET) over [off, end) returns exactly the pages written since the last query
// and clears them in the same call: a write that lands after the query is reported by the next one. Only those whole pages
// (minus GPU-owned ranges) are copied into the mirror. The first use of a pool resets the whole storage and copies all of it.
// Pools whose storage is not page aligned or not in a watched reservation, and pools with fragment-shader write-backs (photo
// evaluation), keep full copies. SNAP_SYNC_FULL=1 restores full copies everywhere (also drops the reserve flag).
static bool WriteWatchOn() {
  static const bool on = [] {
    const char *a = getenv("SNAP_SYNC_FULL"), *b = getenv("SNAP_WRITE_WATCH");
    return !((a && *a == '1') || (b && *b == '0'));
  }();
  return on;
}
// Under p->gpuMutex. Copies [b, e) of the storage into the mirror, skipping GPU-owned ranges. Returns the bytes copied.
static uint64_t CopySkippingGpu(PoolImpl* p, uint64_t b, uint64_t e) {
  uint64_t pos = b, copied = 0;
  while (pos < e) {
    uint64_t next = e;
    bool skip = false;
    for (auto& r : p->gpuRanges) {
      if (r.second <= pos || r.first >= e) continue;
      if (r.first <= pos) { pos = std::max(pos, std::min(r.second, e)); skip = true; break; }
      next = std::min(next, r.first);
    }
    if (skip) continue;
    memcpy(p->mapped + pos, static_cast<uint8_t*>(p->storage) + pos, (size_t)(next - pos));
    copied += next - pos;
    pos = next;
  }
  return copied;
}
// Returns false when write watch cannot be used for this pool (the caller falls back to a full copy).
static bool SyncDirtyPages(PoolImpl* p, uint64_t off, uint64_t end) {
  if (!p->Cpu() || !p->storage) return true;
  if (!p->buffer && !EnsureBacking(p)) return true;
  if (!p->mapped) return true;
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_POOLSYNC);
  snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_POOLSYNC_CALLS);
  static thread_local std::vector<PVOID> addrs;
  const uintptr_t base = (uintptr_t)p->storage;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(p->gpuMutex);
  if (p->ww < 0) return false;
  if (p->ww == 0) {
    if ((base & 0xFFF) || (p->size & 0xFFF)) { p->ww = -1; return false; }
    ULONG_PTR n = (ULONG_PTR)(p->size >> 12); DWORD gran = 0;
    addrs.resize((size_t)std::max<ULONG_PTR>(n, 1));
    if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, p->storage, (SIZE_T)p->size, addrs.data(), &n, &gran) != 0) {
      p->ww = -1;
      static int warned = 0;
      if (warned++ < 8) Log("pool %p (0x%llx bytes): no write watch on its storage (error %lu), full copies", (void*)p, (unsigned long long)p->size, GetLastError());
      return false;
    }
    p->ww = 1;
    snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_POOLSYNC_BYTES, CopySkippingGpu(p, 0, p->size));   // mirror == storage as of the reset
    return true;
  }
  const uint64_t pb = off & ~0xFFFull, pe = std::min<uint64_t>((end + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull, p->size);
  ULONG_PTR n = (ULONG_PTR)((pe - pb) >> 12); DWORD gran = 0;
  if (!n) return true;
  // [cpuprof 2026-11-13] ~640 ranges per course frame each paid a GetWriteWatch syscall (~1.2 ms of the 4.3 ms replay). Take one
  // whole-pool snapshot without reset per replay epoch; a range none of whose pages were dirty at the snapshot needs no syscall (the
  // guest wrote it before the submit or not at all; a write after the snapshot stays dirty for the next epoch, like a write after the
  // per-range reset did). Ranges with a dirty page still use GetWriteWatch with reset below, which also returns later writes.
  static const bool kSnap = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_POOLSYNC_SNAPSHOT"); return !(e && *e == '0'); }();
  if (kSnap) {
    if (p->wwSnapEpoch != g_replayEpoch) {
      p->wwSnapEpoch = g_replayEpoch;
      ULONG_PTR m = (ULONG_PTR)(p->size >> 12); DWORD g = 0;
      addrs.resize((size_t)std::max<ULONG_PTR>(m, 1));
      p->wwBits.assign((size_t)((p->size >> 12) + 63) / 64, 0);
      if (GetWriteWatch(0, p->storage, (SIZE_T)p->size, addrs.data(), &m, &g) != 0) p->wwSnapEpoch = 0;   // per-range syscalls this epoch
      else for (ULONG_PTR i = 0; i < m; i++) { const uint64_t pg = ((uintptr_t)addrs[i] - base) >> 12; p->wwBits[pg >> 6] |= 1ull << (pg & 63); }
    }
    if (p->wwSnapEpoch == g_replayEpoch) {
      bool any = false;
      for (uint64_t pg = pb >> 12; pg < (pe >> 12) && !any; pg++) any = (p->wwBits[pg >> 6] >> (pg & 63)) & 1;
      if (!any) return true;
    }
  }
  addrs.resize((size_t)n);
  if (GetWriteWatch(WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET, (uint8_t*)p->storage + pb, (SIZE_T)(pe - pb), addrs.data(), &n, &gran) != 0) { p->ww = -1; return false; }
  if (kSnap && p->wwSnapEpoch == g_replayEpoch)   // [cpuprof] these pages are reset and copied now
    for (uint64_t pg = pb >> 12; pg < (pe >> 12); pg++) p->wwBits[pg >> 6] &= ~(1ull << (pg & 63));
  uint64_t copied = 0;
  for (ULONG_PTR i = 0; i < n;) {   // addresses come back in ascending order: coalesce runs of adjacent pages
    const uint64_t rb = (uint64_t)((uintptr_t)addrs[i] - base);
    uint64_t re = rb + 0x1000;
    ULONG_PTR j = i + 1;
    while (j < n && (uint64_t)((uintptr_t)addrs[j] - base) == re) { re += 0x1000; j++; }
    copied += CopySkippingGpu(p, rb, std::min<uint64_t>(re, p->size));
    i = j;
  }
  snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_POOLSYNC_BYTES, copied);
  return true;
}
void SyncPoolRangeOnce(PoolImpl* p, uint64_t off, uint64_t size) {
  if (!p || off >= p->size) return;
  const uint64_t end = std::min<uint64_t>(off + size, p->size);
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(p->gpuMutex);
    if (p->syncEpoch != g_replayEpoch) { p->synced.clear(); p->syncEpoch = g_replayEpoch; }
    for (auto& r : p->synced) if (r.first <= off && end <= r.second) return;
  }
  if (!(WriteWatchOn() && !p->wbPool.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && SyncDirtyPages(p, off, end))) SyncPoolRange(p, off, size);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(p->gpuMutex);
  if (p->syncEpoch != g_replayEpoch) { p->synced.clear(); p->syncEpoch = g_replayEpoch; }
  if (p->synced.size() >= 64) p->synced.clear();
  uint64_t b = off, e = end;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < p->synced.size();) {   // absorb overlapping or touching ranges
    auto& r = p->synced[i];
    if (r.first <= e && b <= r.second) { b = std::min(b, r.first); e = std::max(e, r.second); p->synced[i] = p->synced.back(); p->synced.pop_back(); }
    else i++;
  }
  p->synced.push_back({b, e});
}
void MarkGpuWritten(PoolImpl* p, uint64_t off, uint64_t size) {
  if (!p || !size || off >= p->size) return;
  const uint64_t end = std::min<uint64_t>(off + size, p->size);
  static const bool xl = getenv("NVN_XFER_LOG") != nullptr;
  if (xl && p->Cpu()) { static int n = 0; if (n++ < 400) fprintf(stderr, "[xfer] GPU writes CPU pool %p (size 0x%llx) off=0x%llx size=0x%llx\n", (void*)p, (unsigned long long)p->size, (unsigned long long)off, (unsigned long long)(end - off)); }
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(p->gpuMutex);
  p->synced.clear();
  for (auto& r : p->gpuRanges) if (r.first <= off && end <= r.second) return;   // already covered
  p->gpuRanges.push_back({off, end});
  // merge overlapping ranges so the list stays short
  std::sort(p->gpuRanges.begin(), p->gpuRanges.end());
  size_t w = 0;
  for (size_t i = 1; i < p->gpuRanges.size(); i++) {
    if (p->gpuRanges[i].first <= p->gpuRanges[w].second) p->gpuRanges[w].second = std::max(p->gpuRanges[w].second, p->gpuRanges[i].second);
    else p->gpuRanges[++w] = p->gpuRanges[i];
  }
  p->gpuRanges.resize(w + 1);
}
void DestroyPool(PoolImpl* p) {
  if (!p) return;
  TexPrefetchPoolGone(p);   // [perf] no prefetch job may read the storage after this
  if (p->host) p->host->UnregisterPool(p);
  if (p->host && p->host->device) {
    if (p->mapped) vkUnmapMemory(p->host->device, p->memory);
    if (p->buffer) vkDestroyBuffer(p->host->device, p->buffer, nullptr);
    if (p->memory) vkFreeMemory(p->host->device, p->memory, nullptr);
  }
  delete p;
}

// ---- queue ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool InitQueue(QueueImpl* q) {
  Host* h = q->host;
  VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cp{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
  cp.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
  cp.queueFamilyIndex = h->family;
  if (vkCreateCommandPool(h->device, &cp, nullptr, &q->pool) != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
  VkSemaphoreTypeCreateInfo tc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_CREATE_INFO};
  tc.semaphoreType = VK_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_TIMELINE;
  tc.initialValue = 0;
  VkSemaphoreCreateInfo sc{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
  sc.pNext = &tc;
  return vkCreateSemaphore(h->device, &sc, nullptr, &q->timeline) == VK_SUCCESS;
}
void DestroyQueue(QueueImpl* q) {
  Host* h = q->host;
  QueueFinishImpl(q);
  for (auto cb : q->freeCbs) vkFreeCommandBuffers(h->device, q->pool, 1, &cb);
  for (auto dp : q->freePools) vkDestroyDescriptorPool(h->device, dp, nullptr);
  if (q->pool) vkDestroyCommandPool(h->device, q->pool, nullptr);
  if (q->timeline) vkDestroySemaphore(h->device, q->timeline, nullptr);
  delete q;
}
VkCommandBuffer QueueImpl::AcquireCb() {
  if (!freeCbs.empty()) {
    VkCommandBuffer cb = freeCbs.back(); freeCbs.pop_back();
    vkResetCommandBuffer(cb, 0);
    return cb;
  }
  VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  ai.commandPool = pool;
  ai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
  ai.commandBufferCount = 1;
  VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(host->device, &ai, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkAllocateCommandBuffers failed (out of memory?)"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }   // [nvnfix] callers skip the work
  return cb;
}
void QueueImpl::Reap(bool wait_all) {
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_REAP);
  if (wait_all && value) {
    VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO};
    wi.semaphoreCount = 1; wi.pSemaphores = &timeline; wi.pValues = &value;
    vkWaitSemaphores(host->device, &wi, UINT64_MAX);
  }
  uint64_t done = 0;
  vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(host->device, timeline, &done);
  size_t keep = 0;
  for (auto& r : inflight) {
    if (r.value <= done) {
      freeCbs.push_back(r.cb); ListRelease(r.list);   // [nvnfix] the submit's reference (a re-submitted list lives on)
      for (auto dp : r.pools) { vkResetDescriptorPool(host->device, dp, 0); freePools.push_back(dp); }
      for (auto& sb : r.scratch) ReleaseScratch(host, sb);   // [perf] recycled (or destroyed as before)
    }
    else inflight[keep++] = r;
  }
  inflight.resize(keep);
}

// ---- replay ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
static VkAccessFlags2 AccessFor(VkImageLayout l) {
  switch (l) {
    case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED: case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR: return 0;
    case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL: return VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL: return VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    default: return VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
  }
}

// [perf] Scratch recycling (perf pass 4): a retired scratch buffer goes back to a free list by (power-of-two size class, usage)
// instead of vkDestroyBuffer + vkFreeMemory, and NewScratch takes one from there before allocating (vkAllocateMemory was about
// 0.2 ms each, 2 per course frame and one per texture in upload bursts). Classes from 64 KB to 32 MB; the free list holds at
// most SNAP_SCRATCH_POOL_MB (default 128). SNAP_SCRATCH_POOL_MB=0 restores exact-size buffers that are freed on retire.
static uint64_t ScratchPoolCap() {   // MB from the env, clamped to 0..4096 (a negative or garbage value used to wrap to "unlimited")
  static const uint64_t cap = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_SCRATCH_POOL_MB"); long v = e && *e ? strtol(e, nullptr, 10) : 128; return (uint64_t)std::clamp(v, 0L, 4096L) << 20; }();
  return cap;
}
static std::mutex g_scratchMu;
static std::vector<ScratchBuf> g_scratchFree;
static uint64_t g_scratchFreeBytes = 0;
void ScratchPoolDrain(Host* h) {   // Host::Shutdown, before vkDestroyDevice
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_scratchMu);
  for (auto& sb : g_scratchFree) { vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, sb.buf, nullptr); vkFreeMemory(h->device, sb.mem, nullptr); }
  g_scratchFree.clear(); g_scratchFreeBytes = 0;
}
void ReleaseScratch(Host* h, const ScratchBuf& sb) {
  if (sb.cap && ScratchPoolCap()) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_scratchMu);
    if (g_scratchFreeBytes + sb.cap <= ScratchPoolCap()) { g_scratchFree.push_back(sb); g_scratchFreeBytes += sb.cap; return; }
  }
  vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, sb.buf, nullptr); vkFreeMemory(h->device, sb.mem, nullptr);
}
uint8_t* NewScratch(ReplayCtx& cx, uint64_t size, VkBuffer* out, VkBufferUsageFlags extra) {
  Host* h = cx.h;
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_SCRATCH); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_SCRATCH_ALLOCS);
  VkBufferCreateInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
  bi.size = std::max<uint64_t>(size, 16); bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | extra;
  ScratchBuf sb;
  if (ScratchPoolCap() && bi.size <= (32ull << 20)) {   // [perf] recycled size class
    uint64_t cls = 64ull << 10;
    while (cls < bi.size) cls <<= 1;
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_scratchMu);
      for (size_t i = 0; i < g_scratchFree.size(); i++) {
        if (g_scratchFree[i].cap != cls || g_scratchFree[i].usage != (uint32_t)bi.usage) continue;
        sb = g_scratchFree[i]; g_scratchFree[i] = g_scratchFree.back(); g_scratchFree.pop_back(); g_scratchFreeBytes -= cls;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (sb.buf) { cx.scratch->push_back(sb); *out = sb.buf; return sb.map; }
    bi.size = cls; sb.cap = cls; sb.usage = (uint32_t)bi.usage;
  }
  if (vkCreateBuffer(h->device, &bi, nullptr, &sb.buf) != VK_SUCCESS) return nullptr;
  VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(h->device, sb.buf, &mr);
  VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
  VkMemoryAllocateFlagsInfo fl{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_FLAGS_INFO};
  mai.allocationSize = mr.size;
  mai.memoryTypeIndex = h->FindMemoryType(mr.memoryTypeBits, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
  void* map = nullptr;
  if (mai.memoryTypeIndex == UINT32_MAX || vkAllocateMemory(h->device, &mai, nullptr, &sb.mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyBuffer(h->device, sb.buf, nullptr); return nullptr; }
  (void)fl;
  vkBindBufferMemory(h->device, sb.buf, sb.mem, 0);
  vkMapMemory(h->device, sb.mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map);
  sb.map = (uint8_t*)map;
  cx.scratch->push_back(sb);
  *out = sb.buf;
  return (uint8_t*)map;
}

bool InLayout(const TextureImpl* t, VkImageLayout want, const SubRange& r) {
  if (t->subLayout.empty()) return t->layout == want;
  for (uint32_t y = r.yb; y < r.yb + r.yn && y < t->imgLayers; y++)
    for (uint32_t l = r.lb; l < r.lb + r.ln && l < t->imgLevels; l++)
      if (t->subLayout[y * t->imgLevels + l] != want) return false;
  return true;
}

// Moves the subresources of `r` to layout `to`. Layouts are tracked per (level, layer) once a transition covers part of the
// image: the game renders into one mip level while sampling the level above it. A whole-image transition from a uniform layout is
// a single barrier. Transitions to GENERAL always emit a barrier (execution + memory dependency, as before).
void TransitionRange(VkCommandBuffer cb, TextureImpl* t, VkImageLayout to, const SubRange& r0) {
  if (!t->image) return;
  const uint32_t L = std::max(t->imgLevels, 1u), Y = std::max(t->imgLayers, 1u);
  SubRange r = r0;
  r.lb = std::min(r.lb, L - 1); r.ln = std::max(1u, std::min(r.ln, L - r.lb));
  r.yb = std::min(r.yb, Y - 1); r.yn = std::max(1u, std::min(r.yn, Y - r.yb));
  std::vector<VkImageMemoryBarrier2> bars;
  auto mk = [&](VkImageLayout from, uint32_t lb, uint32_t ln, uint32_t yb, uint32_t yn) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
    b.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
    b.srcAccessMask = AccessFor(from);
    b.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
    b.dstAccessMask = AccessFor(to);
    b.oldLayout = from;
    b.newLayout = to;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = t->image;
    b.subresourceRange = {t->fi->aspect, lb, ln, yb, yn};
    bars.push_back(b);
  };
  const bool whole = r.lb == 0 && r.ln == L && r.yb == 0 && r.yn == Y;
  if (t->subLayout.empty()) {
    if (t->layout == to && to != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL) return;
    if (whole) {
      mk(t->layout, 0, L, 0, Y);
      t->layout = to;
    } else {
      t->subLayout.assign((size_t)L * Y, t->layout);
    }
  }
  if (!t->subLayout.empty()) {
    for (uint32_t y = r.yb; y < r.yb + r.yn; y++) {
      uint32_t l = r.lb;
      while (l < r.lb + r.ln) {
        const VkImageLayout from = t->subLayout[y * L + l];
        uint32_t e = l + 1;
        while (e < r.lb + r.ln && t->subLayout[y * L + e] == from) e++;
        if (from != to || to == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL) {
          if (!bars.empty() && bars.back().oldLayout == from && bars.back().subresourceRange.baseMipLevel == l &&
              bars.back().subresourceRange.levelCount == e - l &&
              bars.back().subresourceRange.baseArrayLayer + bars.back().subresourceRange.layerCount == y)
            bars.back().subresourceRange.layerCount++;   // same level run on the previous layer: one barrier for both
          else mk(from, l, e - l, y, 1);
        }
        for (uint32_t k = l; k < e; k++) t->subLayout[y * L + k] = to;
        l = e;
      }
    }
    bool uniform = true;
    for (VkImageLayout x : t->subLayout) if (x != to) { uniform = false; break; }
    if (uniform) { t->layout = to; t->subLayout.clear(); }
  }
  if (bars.empty()) return;
  VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO};
  di.imageMemoryBarrierCount = (uint32_t)bars.size();
  di.pImageMemoryBarriers = bars.data();
  vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

void Transition(VkCommandBuffer cb, TextureImpl* t, VkImageLayout to) {
  if (!t->image) return;
  TransitionRange(cb, t, to, {0, std::max(t->imgLevels, 1u), 0, std::max(t->imgLayers, 1u)});
}

// scale of the current render targets (viewport/scissor are in guest pixels)
static float RtScale(const ReplayCtx& cx) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) if (cx.rt[i]) return cx.rt[i]->scale;
  return 1.0f;
}
// Viewport / scissor in guest pixels -> Vulkan, scaled for the bound render targets (render scale, nvn_host.h)
static void EmitViewport(ReplayCtx& cx, int i) {
  const float* v = cx.vpGuest[i];
  if (v[2] <= 0 || v[3] <= 0) return;
  cx.vpScale = RtScale(cx);
  VkViewport vp = MakeNvnViewport(cx.h->originMode, v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], cx.vpScale);
  { float jx, jy; UpscaleViewportJitter(cx, &jx, &jy); vp.x += jx; vp.y += jy; }   // [upscale] sub-pixel jitter of the scene's draws
  vkCmdSetViewport(cx.cb, (uint32_t)i, 1, &vp);
}
static void EmitScissor(ReplayCtx& cx, int i) {
  int x = cx.scGuest[i][0], y = cx.scGuest[i][1], w = cx.scGuest[i][2], ht = cx.scGuest[i][3];
  if (x < 0) { w += x; x = 0; }
  if (y < 0) { ht += y; y = 0; }
  if (w < 0) w = 0;
  if (ht < 0) ht = 0;
  const float sc = cx.scScale = RtScale(cx);
  if (sc != 1.0f) { x = (int)std::floor(x * sc); y = (int)std::floor(y * sc); w = (int)std::ceil(w * sc); ht = (int)std::ceil(ht * sc); }
  VkRect2D r{{x, y}, {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)ht}};
  vkCmdSetScissor(cx.cb, (uint32_t)i, 1, &r);
}

// [nvnfix] review_nvn.md 11 (measurement): NVN clears honor the scissor, ours clear the whole subresource. Counts clears made while
// scissor 0 is set smaller than the target level (guest pixels), to see whether the game relies on scissored clears.
static void CountScissoredClear(const ReplayCtx& cx, const TextureImpl* t, const TexView* v) {
  if (!(cx.scHave & 1)) return;
  const SubRange rr = RtRange(t, v);
  const int lw = std::max(1, t->b.width >> rr.lb), lh = std::max(1, t->b.height >> rr.lb);
  const int* s = cx.scGuest[0];
  if (s[0] > 0 || s[1] > 0 || s[0] + s[2] < lw || s[1] + s[3] < lh) {
    LifeCount(LS_CLEAR_SCISSORED);
    static int logged = 0;
    if (logged++ < 6 && getenv("SNAP_NVN_STATS")) fprintf(stderr, "[nvnstats] scissored clear: target %dx%d level %u fmt 0x%x scissor %d,%d %dx%d\n", t->b.width, t->b.height, rr.lb, t->b.format, s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]);
  }
}

static void Replay(ReplayCtx& cx, const CmdList& list) {
  Host* h = cx.h;
  VkCommandBuffer cb = cx.cb;
  TextureImpl** rt = cx.rt;
  g_replaySeq++;
  ReplayBegin(cx);
  static bool warnedMask = false;
  for (const Cmd& c : list.cmds) {
    switch (c.op) {
      case Op::SetRenderTargets:
        EndRendering(cx);
        for (int k = 0; k < 9; k++) {
          rt[k] = c.tex[k];
          cx.rtHasView[k] = false; cx.rtView[k] = TexView{};
          const size_t o = (size_t)k * (1 + sizeof(TexView));
          if (rt[k] && c.blob.size() >= o + 1 + sizeof(TexView) && c.blob[o]) { memcpy(&cx.rtView[k], &c.blob[o + 1], sizeof(TexView)); cx.rtHasView[k] = true; }
        }
        RedirectCompressedTargets(cx);
        if (DebugDrawLogActive()) DebugDrawLog("SetRenderTargets rt0=%p(%dx%d f%x) depth=%p\n", (void*)rt[0], rt[0] ? rt[0]->b.width : 0, rt[0] ? rt[0]->b.height : 0, rt[0] ? rt[0]->b.format : 0, (void*)rt[8]);
        // render scale changed: viewports / scissors set for the previous targets are re-applied at the new scale
        { const bool jit = UpscaleOnSetRenderTargets(cx);   // [upscale] scene / upscale point; jitter changed: re-emit viewports
          if (jit && cx.vpHave) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (cx.vpHave & (1u << i)) EmitViewport(cx, i); }
        if (cx.vpHave && RtScale(cx) != cx.vpScale) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (cx.vpHave & (1u << i)) EmitViewport(cx, i);
        if (cx.scHave && RtScale(cx) != cx.scScale) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (cx.scHave & (1u << i)) EmitScissor(cx, i);
        break;
      case Op::ClearColor: {
        EndRendering(cx);
        TextureImpl* t = (c.i[0] >= 0 && c.i[0] < 8) ? rt[c.i[0]] : nullptr;
        if (!t || !t->EnsureImage()) { Log("ClearColor with no usable render target %d", c.i[0]); break; }
        CountScissoredClear(cx, t, cx.rtHasView[c.i[0]] ? &cx.rtView[c.i[0]] : nullptr);   // [nvnfix] SNAP_NVN_STATS
        if ((c.i[1] & 0xF) != 0xF) { if (c.i[1] & 0xF) DoMaskedClear(cx, t, cx.rtHasView[c.i[0]] ? &cx.rtView[c.i[0]] : nullptr, c.i[1] & 0xF, c.f); break; }
        t->uploaded = true;
        const SubRange rr = RtRange(t, cx.rtHasView[c.i[0]] ? &cx.rtView[c.i[0]] : nullptr);   // only the bound mip level / layers
        TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, rr);
        VkClearColorValue v{};
        if (t->fi->kind == 0) memcpy(v.float32, c.f, sizeof v.float32);
        else if (t->fi->kind == 1) memcpy(v.uint32, c.f, sizeof v.uint32);   // NVN passes raw ints for integer formats
        else memcpy(v.int32, c.f, sizeof v.int32);
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg{VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, rr.lb, 1, rr.yb, rr.yn};
        vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &v, 1, &rg);
        if (cx.bcDst[c.i[0]]) { cx.bcDirty = true; FlushCompressedTargets(cx); }   // a cleared compressed target (stand-in)
        break;
      }
      case Op::ClearDepthStencil: {
        EndRendering(cx);
        TextureImpl* t = rt[8];
        if (!t || !t->EnsureImage()) { Log("ClearDepthStencil with no depth target"); break; }
        CountScissoredClear(cx, t, cx.rtHasView[8] ? &cx.rtView[8] : nullptr);   // [nvnfix] SNAP_NVN_STATS
        VkImageAspectFlags asp = 0;
        if (c.i[0] && (t->fi->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT)) asp |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;     // depthMask
        if (c.i[2] && (t->fi->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT)) asp |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;  // stencilMask
        if (c.i[2] && (c.i[2] & 0xFF) != 0xFF) { static int pm = 0; if (pm++ < 20) Log("ClearDepthStencil with a partial stencil mask 0x%x (cleared whole; value %d)", c.i[2], c.i[1]); }
        if (!asp) break;
        t->uploaded = true;
        const SubRange rr = RtRange(t, cx.rtHasView[8] ? &cx.rtView[8] : nullptr);
        TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, rr);
        VkClearDepthStencilValue v{c.f[0], (uint32_t)c.i[1]};
        {   // debug (NVN_EVAL_DEPTH_DUMP=<dir>): the Evaluation depth (EvaluationCopyDepth's copy of the scene depth) before the first subject clear of a present, raw float32 1920x1080
          static const char* edd = getenv("NVN_EVAL_DEPTH_DUMP"); static int lastP = -1, nd = 0;
          if (edd && *edd && t->b.format == 0x36 && t->b.width == 1920 && (t->fi->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) && g_presentCount != lastP && nd < 12) {
            lastP = g_presentCount;
            const uint64_t sz = (uint64_t)t->b.width * t->b.height * 4;
            VkBuffer eb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; uint8_t* em = NewScratch(cx, sz, &eb);
            if (em) {
              TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, rr);
              VkBufferImageCopy ebc{}; ebc.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; ebc.imageExtent = {(uint32_t)t->b.width, (uint32_t)t->b.height, 1};
              vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, eb, 1, &ebc);
              VkMemoryBarrier2 emb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
              emb.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT; emb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
              emb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT; emb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT;
              VkDependencyInfo edi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; edi.memoryBarrierCount = 1; edi.pMemoryBarriers = &emb;
              vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &edi);
              TransitionRange(cb, t, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, rr);
              char en[600]; snprintf(en, sizeof en, "%s/evaldepth_p%d_%d.raw", edd, g_presentCount, nd++);
              Readback erb; erb.map = em; erb.dst = nullptr; erb.size = sz; erb.kind = 2; erb.dumpPath = en;
              erb.sb = cx.scratch->back(); cx.scratch->pop_back(); cx.readbacks->push_back(erb);
            }
          }
        }
        { static const bool el = getenv("NVN_EVAL_LOG") != nullptr; static int n = 0;
          if (el && t->b.format == 0x36 && n++ < 5000) fprintf(stderr, "[eval] p%d ClearDepthStencil depth=%d(%g) stencil=%d(%d) t=%p\n", g_presentCount, c.i[0], c.f[0], c.i[2], c.i[1], (void*)t); }
        VkImageSubresourceRange rg{asp, rr.lb, 1, rr.yb, rr.yn};
        vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &v, 1, &rg);
        break;
      }
      case Op::SetViewports: {
        cx.vpSet = true;
        if (c.i[0] > 0 && h->props.limits.maxViewports <= 1) break;
        float x = c.f[0], y = c.f[1], w = c.f[2], ht = c.f[3];
        if (DebugDrawLogActive()) DebugDrawLog("SetViewport %d: %g %g %g %g (rt0 %p)\n", c.i[0], x, y, w, ht, (void*)rt[0]);
        if (w <= 0 || ht <= 0) break;
        if (c.i[0] < 4) { memcpy(cx.vpGuest[c.i[0]], c.f, sizeof cx.vpGuest[0]); cx.vpHave |= (uint8_t)(1u << c.i[0]); EmitViewport(cx, c.i[0]); break; }
        VkViewport vp = MakeNvnViewport(h->originMode, x, y, w, ht, RtScale(cx));
        vkCmdSetViewport(cb, (uint32_t)c.i[0], 1, &vp);
        break;
      }
      case Op::SetScissors: {
        cx.scSet = true;
        if (c.i[0] > 0 && h->props.limits.maxViewports <= 1) break;
        if (c.i[0] < 4) { for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) cx.scGuest[c.i[0]][j] = c.i[1 + j]; cx.scHave |= (uint8_t)(1u << c.i[0]); EmitScissor(cx, c.i[0]); break; }
        int x = c.i[1], y = c.i[2], w = c.i[3], ht = c.i[4];
        if (x < 0) { w += x; x = 0; }
        if (y < 0) { ht += y; y = 0; }
        if (w < 0) w = 0;
        if (ht < 0) ht = 0;
        { const float sc = RtScale(cx); if (sc != 1.0f) { x = (int)std::floor(x * sc); y = (int)std::floor(y * sc); w = (int)std::ceil(w * sc); ht = (int)std::ceil(ht * sc); } }
        VkRect2D r{{x, y}, {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)ht}};
        vkCmdSetScissor(cb, (uint32_t)c.i[0], 1, &r);
        break;
      }
      case Op::Barrier: {
        EndRendering(cx);
        // Conservative: every NVN barrier bit maps to a full memory barrier (refined in phase 1).
        VkMemoryBarrier2 mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
        mb.srcStageMask = mb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
        mb.srcAccessMask = mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
        VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO};
        di.memoryBarrierCount = 1;
        di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
        break;
      }
      default:
        ReplayDrawOp(cx, c);
        break;
    }
  }
  ReplayEnd(cx);
}

void SubmitLists(QueueImpl* q, int n, CmdList* const* lists) {
  Host* h = q->host;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(h->queueMutex);
  g_replayEpoch++;
  struct TidScope { TidScope() { g_replayTid.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_relaxed); } ~TidScope() { g_replayTid.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed); } } tidScope;
  q->Reap(false);
  UpscaleBeforeSubmit(n, lists);   // [upscale] photo frames
  std::vector<VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo> infos;
  std::vector<Retired> pending;
  std::vector<Readback> readbacksOut;
  std::vector<int> perfSlots;
  for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    CmdList* l = lists[k];
    if (!l) continue;
    if (g_hooks.on_submit) g_hooks.on_submit(g_hooks.user, k, (int)l->cmds.size());
    VkCommandBuffer cb = q->AcquireCb();
    if (!cb) { ListRelease(l); continue; }   // [nvnfix] allocation failed (logged): drop this list, not the process
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
    bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
    const int perfSlot = snap_perf::on ? PerfGpuBegin(h, cb) : -1;
    perfSlots.push_back(perfSlot);
    ReplayCtx cx;
    cx.h = h; cx.cb = cb; cx.q = q;
    std::vector<VkDescriptorPool> pools;
    cx.pools = &pools;
    std::vector<ScratchBuf> scratch;
    cx.scratch = &scratch;
    std::vector<Readback> rbs;
    cx.readbacks = &rbs;
    { snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_REPLAY); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_CMDS, l->cmds.size()); Replay(cx, *l); }
    for (auto& rb : rbs) if (rb.kind == 3) {   // fragment-shader SSBO results are read by the host (FlushReadbacks) after the timeline value
      VkMemoryBarrier2 mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
      mb.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT; mb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_WRITE_BIT;
      mb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT; mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT;
      VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; di.memoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb;
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
      break;
    }
    if (perfSlot >= 0) PerfGpuEnd(h, cb, perfSlot);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkCommandBufferSubmitInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_SUBMIT_INFO};
    ci.commandBuffer = cb;
    infos.push_back(ci);
    pending.push_back({0, cb, l, std::move(pools), std::move(scratch)});
    for (auto& rb : rbs) readbacksOut.push_back(rb);
  }
  if (infos.empty()) return;
  uint64_t v = ++q->value;
  VkSemaphoreSubmitInfo sig{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO};
  sig.semaphore = q->timeline; sig.value = v; sig.stageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
  VkSubmitInfo2 si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2};
  si.commandBufferInfoCount = (uint32_t)infos.size(); si.pCommandBufferInfos = infos.data();
  si.signalSemaphoreInfoCount = 1; si.pSignalSemaphoreInfos = &sig;
  { snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_QSUBMIT); snap_perf::count(snap_perf::V_SUBMITS); VKCHK(vkQueueSubmit2(h->queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE)); }
  for (int ps : perfSlots) PerfGpuSubmitted(ps, v);
  for (auto& r : pending) { r.value = v; q->inflight.push_back(r); }
  if (!readbacksOut.empty()) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> rl(h->rbMutex);
    for (auto& rb : readbacksOut) {
      rb.sem = q->timeline; rb.value = v;
      if (rb.kind == 3) rb.pool->wbPending.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
      h->readbacks.push_back(std::move(rb));
    }
  }
}

void QueueFence(QueueImpl* q, SyncImpl* s) {
  Host* h = q->host;
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(h->queueMutex);
  uint64_t v = ++q->value;
  VkSemaphoreSubmitInfo sig{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO};
  sig.semaphore = q->timeline; sig.value = v; sig.stageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
  VkSubmitInfo2 si{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO_2};
  si.signalSemaphoreInfoCount = 1; si.pSignalSemaphoreInfos = &sig;
  VKCHK(vkQueueSubmit2(h->queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE));
  s->sem = q->timeline; s->value = v; s->armed = true;
}

void QueueFinishImpl(QueueImpl* q) {
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_FINISH);
  { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(q->host->queueMutex); q->Reap(true); }
  FlushReadbacks(q->host, false);
}

static SyncWaitResult WaitSyncRaw(const SyncImpl* s, uint64_t timeoutNs);
SyncWaitResult WaitSync(const SyncImpl* s, uint64_t timeoutNs) {
  snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_WAITSYNC);
  SyncWaitResult r = WaitSyncRaw(s, timeoutNs);
  if (s->armed) FlushReadbacks(s->host, false);
  return r;
}
static SyncWaitResult WaitSyncRaw(const SyncImpl* s, uint64_t timeoutNs) {
  if (!s->armed) return SYNC_ALREADY_SIGNALED;
  uint64_t cur = 0;
  vkGetSemaphoreCounterValue(s->host->device, s->sem, &cur);
  if (cur >= s->value) return SYNC_ALREADY_SIGNALED;
  VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO};
  wi.semaphoreCount = 1; wi.pSemaphores = &s->sem; wi.pValues = &s->value;
  VkResult r = vkWaitSemaphores(s->host->device, &wi, timeoutNs);
  if (r == VK_SUCCESS) return SYNC_CONDITION_SATISFIED;
  if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) return SYNC_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED;
  return SYNC_FAILED;
}

// ---- window / swapchain ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The NVN-visible window textures are ordinary offscreen images (scene resolution). Present acquires a real
// swapchain image and blits (scales, letterboxes) the chosen slot into it. That decouples scene resolution from
// output resolution (native 4K / DLAA / DLSS later) and makes the present blit the single composition point.
bool WindowImpl::Recreate() {
  Host* h = host;
  vkDeviceWaitIdle(h->device);
  VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR caps{};
  VKCHK(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(h->phys, surface, &caps));
  VkExtent2D ext = caps.currentExtent;
  if (ext.width == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ext = {tex.empty() ? 1280u : (uint32_t)tex[0]->b.width, tex.empty() ? 720u : (uint32_t)tex[0]->b.height};
  if (ext.width == 0 || ext.height == 0) return false;  // minimized

  uint32_t n = 0;
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(h->phys, surface, &n, nullptr);
  std::vector<VkSurfaceFormatKHR> fm(n);
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(h->phys, surface, &n, fm.data());
  const bool srgbSrc = !tex.empty() && tex[0]->fi && (tex[0]->fi->vk == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB || tex[0]->fi->vk == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB);
  const VkFormat want[2] = {srgbSrc ? VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB : VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                            srgbSrc ? VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB : VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM};
  VkSurfaceFormatKHR pick = fm.empty() ? VkSurfaceFormatKHR{} : fm[0];
  bool found = false;
  for (int k = 0; k < 2 && !found; k++)
    for (auto& f : fm)
      if (f.format == want[k] && f.colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR) { pick = f; found = true; break; }
  hdr = false;
  if (snap_hdr::Requested()) {   // SNAP_HDR=1: A2B10G10R10 + HDR10_ST2084 when the display and driver offer it, else the SDR pick above (logged)
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR hp{};
    if (snap_hdr::PickFormat(fm.data(), (uint32_t)fm.size(), &hp, hwnd)) { pick = hp; hdr = true; }
  }

  vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(h->phys, surface, &n, nullptr);
  std::vector<VkPresentModeKHR> pm(n);
  vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(h->phys, surface, &n, pm.data());
  auto has = [&](VkPresentModeKHR m) { return std::find(pm.begin(), pm.end(), m) != pm.end(); };
  VkPresentModeKHR mode = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
  if (presentInterval <= 0) mode = has(VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR) ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR
                                   : has(VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR) ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR : VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;

  if (!(caps.supportedUsageFlags & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT)) { LogError("surface lacks TRANSFER_DST"); return false; }
  uint32_t minImages = std::max(caps.minImageCount, 3u);
  if (caps.maxImageCount) minImages = std::min(minImages, caps.maxImageCount);

  VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR};
  ci.surface = surface;
  ci.minImageCount = minImages;
  ci.imageFormat = pick.format;
  ci.imageColorSpace = pick.colorSpace;
  ci.imageExtent = ext;
  ci.imageArrayLayers = 1;
  ci.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | (caps.supportedUsageFlags & (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT));   // color attachment: overlay
  ci.imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
  ci.preTransform = caps.currentTransform;
  ci.compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR;
  ci.presentMode = mode;
  ci.clipped = VK_TRUE;
  ci.oldSwapchain = swapchain;
  VkSwapchainKHR ns = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreateSwapchainKHR(h->device, &ci, nullptr, &ns) != VK_SUCCESS) { LogError("vkCreateSwapchainKHR failed"); return false; }
  for (auto s : renderDone) vkDestroySemaphore(h->device, s, nullptr);
  renderDone.clear();
  if (swapchain) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(h->device, swapchain, nullptr);
  swapchain = ns;
  scFormat = pick.format;
  scExtent = ext;
  if (hdr) snap_hdr::SetMetadata(h->device, swapchain);
  vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(h->device, swapchain, &n, nullptr);
  scImages.resize(n);
  vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(h->device, swapchain, &n, scImages.data());
  VkSemaphoreCreateInfo sci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    VkSemaphore s; vkCreateSemaphore(h->device, &sci, nullptr, &s); renderDone.push_back(s);
  }
  while (acquireSems.size() < n + 1) {
    VkSemaphore s; vkCreateSemaphore(h->device, &sci, nullptr, &s);
    acquireSems.push_back(s); acquireValue.push_back(0);
  }
  needRecreate = false;
  snap_pace::SwapchainCreated(swapchain, hwnd);   // [pace] present ids restart on the new swapchain
  Log("swapchain %ux%u images=%u fmt=%d mode=%d", ext.width, ext.height, n, (int)scFormat, (int)mode);
  if (snap_hdr::Requested()) fprintf(stderr, "hdr: swapchain %ux%u fmt=%d colorspace=%d %s (peak %.0f nits, paper white %.0f nits, mode %s)\n", ext.width, ext.height, (int)scFormat, (int)pick.colorSpace,
                                     hdr ? (snap_hdr::IsScrgb() ? "scRGB active" : "HDR10 ST2084 active") : "SDR (fallback)", snap_hdr::Peak(), snap_hdr::Paper(), snap_hdr::ModeName());
  return true;
}

void DestroyWindow(WindowImpl* w) {
  Host* h = w->host;
  if (h && h->device) {
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(h->device);
    for (auto s : w->renderDone) vkDestroySemaphore(h->device, s, nullptr);
    for (auto s : w->acquireSems) vkDestroySemaphore(h->device, s, nullptr);
    if (w->swapchain) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(h->device, w->swapchain, nullptr);
    if (w->surface) vkDestroySurfaceKHR(h->instance, w->surface, nullptr);
  }
  if (h) h->windows.erase(std::remove(h->windows.begin(), h->windows.end(), w), h->windows.end());
  delete w;
}

// Frame limiter for present intervals >= 1: absolute schedule on the steady clock, high-resolution timer for the
// bulk of the wait and a short spin for the rest. Resyncs when the game falls more than one period behind.
// [pace] SNAP_PACE=legacy only; the default model is snap_pace::Release (nvn_pace.cpp).
static void PaceLegacy(WindowImpl* w) {
  if (g_paceHz <= 0 || w->presentInterval <= 0) { w->nextPresentNs = 0; return; }
  using namespace std::chrono;
  int64_t period = (int64_t)(1e9 * w->presentInterval / g_paceHz);
  if (const int cap = snap_window_frame_cap(); cap > 0) period = std::max(period, (int64_t)(1e9 / cap));   // hook request 3
  const int64_t now = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
  // Absolute schedule. A frame that already ran more than one period late is released at once and the schedule restarts from now
  // (the old code restarted from now and then still waited a full period, so every slow frame cost work + one period).
  if (w->nextPresentNs == 0 || now - w->nextPresentNs > period) w->nextPresentNs = now;
  else w->nextPresentNs += period;
  static HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
  int64_t left = w->nextPresentNs - now;
  if (left > 2000000 && timer) {   // sleep all but ~1.5 ms
    LARGE_INTEGER due; due.QuadPart = -(left - 1500000) / 100;
    SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE);
    WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
  }
  while (duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count() < w->nextPresentNs) YieldProcessor();
}

// [pace] Frame limiter. Default: one frame clock locked to the display's vblanks when the refresh is a whole multiple of the
// rate (else a steady-clock grid), shared with the guest vsync event (nvn_pace.h). SNAP_PACE=legacy: PaceLegacy above.
static void Pace(WindowImpl* w) {
  snap_pace::PaceMark(false);   // SNAP_PACE_LOG
  if (snap_pace::Legacy()) PaceLegacy(w);
  else {
    int64_t period = 0;
    if (g_paceHz > 0 && w->presentInterval > 0) {
      period = (int64_t)(1e9 * w->presentInterval / g_paceHz);
      if (const int cap = snap_window_frame_cap(); cap > 0) period = std::max(period, (int64_t)(1e9 / cap));   // hook request 3
    }
    snap_pace::Release(w->hwnd, w->swapchain, period, g_paceHz > 0 ? (int64_t)(1e9 / g_paceHz) : 0);
  }
  snap_pace::PaceMark(true);
}

int g_fdBurst = 0;
static bool PresentWindowOnce(QueueImpl* q, WindowImpl* w, int slot) {
  Host* h = q->host;
  if (slot < 0 || slot >= (int)w->tex.size()) { LogError("present of invalid slot %d", slot); return false; }
  TextureImpl* src = w->tex[slot];   // [nvnfix] EnsureImage moved under queueMutex below: a replay may create the same image
  struct PerfFrame { QueueImpl* q; ~PerfFrame() { if (snap_perf::on) PerfFrameMark(q, (uint64_t)g_presentCount); } } perfFrame{q};   // one CSV row per present (SNAP_PERF)
  {
    // Load pass (2026-11-13): the frame limiter is a wait (vsync on the Switch), so the presenting JobWorker gives its virtual
    // core back while it sleeps; loader threads pinned to that core (ResourceUncompress p31) ran only between frames before,
    // which made loading screens CPU-starved. SNAP_PACE_RELEASE_CORE=0 keeps the core (old). SNAP_NVN_RELEASE_CORE=1 still
    // releases it around the whole present (bridge).
    static const bool kPaceRelease = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_PACE_RELEASE_CORE"); return !(e && e[0] == '0'); }();
    snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_PACE);
    if (kPaceRelease) os_host_block_begin();
    Pace(w);
    if (kPaceRelease) os_host_block_end();
  }
  // Test switch (off by default): SNAP_STRESS_PRESENT_MS=<ms>[:<from>:<to>] sleeps that long per present (only for presents from..to
  // if given), like the very slow runs (4-7 presents/s) in which crash B1 (GPU arena 7 full) happened.
  {
    static int ms = 0, from = 0, to = 0x7fffffff;
    static const bool on = [] { const char* e = getenv("SNAP_STRESS_PRESENT_MS"); if (e) sscanf(e, "%d:%d:%d", &ms, &from, &to); return ms > 0; }();
    if (on && g_presentCount >= from && g_presentCount <= to) Sleep((DWORD)ms);
  }
  std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lk(h->queueMutex);   // [pace] unique_lock: dropped around the acquire waits below
  if (!src->EnsureImage()) return false;
  q->Reap(false);
  OwnPoolReap(q);   // fallback buffer pools retired by BufferFinalize (B1 safety net)
  GraveReap(q);     // [nvnfix] finalized textures, samplers, pools, programs whose last possible use has completed
  LifeStatsTick();  // [nvnfix] SNAP_NVN_STATS=1
  g_presentCount++;
  UpscaleOnPresent();   // [upscale]
  if (g_hooks.on_present) g_hooks.on_present(g_hooks.user, slot, src->b.width, src->b.height);

  uint32_t idx = 0;
  // The acquire semaphore must have no pending wait: gate reuse on the timeline value of the submit that waited it.
  if (w->needRecreate && !w->Recreate()) return false;
  const uint32_t ak = w->acquireNext++ % (uint32_t)w->acquireSems.size();
  // [pace] The timeline wait and vkAcquireNextImageKHR block on the GPU and the display but touch no queue, so the default model
  // drops the queue lock around them (other threads keep submitting); Recreate (vkDeviceWaitIdle) retakes it. Legacy holds it.
  const bool dropLock = !snap_pace::Legacy();
  if (dropLock) lk.unlock();
  snap_pace::Stamp(snap_pace::M_ACQ_BEGIN);
  if (w->acquireValue[ak]) {
    VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO};
    wi.semaphoreCount = 1; wi.pSemaphores = &q->timeline; wi.pValues = &w->acquireValue[ak];
    snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_ACQSEM);
    vkWaitSemaphores(h->device, &wi, UINT64_MAX);
  }
  for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    if (w->needRecreate) {
      if (dropLock) lk.lock();
      const bool ok = w->Recreate();
      if (dropLock) lk.unlock();
      if (!ok) return false;
    }
    VkResult r;
    { snap_perf::Scope perfScope(snap_perf::C_ACQUIRE); r = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(h->device, w->swapchain, UINT64_MAX, w->acquireSems[ak], VK_NULL_HANDLE, &idx); }
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS || r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) { if (r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) w->needRecreate = true; break; }
    if (r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) { w->needRecreate = true; if (attempt == 2) return false; continue; }
    LogError("vkAcquireNextImageKHR failed: %d", (int)r);
    return false;
  }
  snap_pace::Stamp(snap_pace::M_ACQ_END);
  if (dropLock) lk.lock();

  VkCommandBuffer cb = q->AcquireCb();
  VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
  bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
  vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
  const int perfSlot = snap_perf::on ? PerfGpuBegin(h, cb) : -1;

  VkImage dst = w->scImages[idx];
  auto imgBarrier = [&](VkImage img, VkImageAspectFlags asp, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
    b.srcStageMask = b.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
    b.srcAccessMask = AccessFor(from); b.dstAccessMask = AccessFor(to);
    b.oldLayout = from; b.newLayout = to;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = img;
    b.subresourceRange = {asp, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS};
    VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO};
    di.imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pImageMemoryBarriers = &b;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
  };
  Transition(cb, src, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
  // Debug frame dump (NVN_FRAME_DUMP=<dir> [NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM=<sec> _TO=<sec> _EVERY=<sec> _MAX=<n>]): copies the game's window texture (no overlay) into a host buffer
  // and writes a half-size BMP after the submit. Used for screenshots when the desktop capture is unavailable (hidden desktop).
  static const char* fdDir = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP");
  static const double fdFrom = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM") ? atof(getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM")) : 0.0;
  static const double fdTo = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_TO") ? atof(getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_TO")) : 1e9;
  static const double fdEvery = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY") ? atof(getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY")) : 1.0;
  static const int fdMax = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_MAX") ? atoi(getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_MAX")) : 60;
  static const auto fdT0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  static double fdNext = 0; static int fdCount = 0;
  VkBuffer fdBuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory fdMem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; void* fdMap = nullptr; char fdName[512] = {};
  // NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FULL=1: full-size BMP (default half size, point sampled); NVN_FRAME_DUMP_POST=1: dump the swapchain image after the
  // present blit, SNAP_LOOK and the UI overlay instead of the game's window texture (comparison shots of host post effects)
  static const bool fdFull = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FULL") != nullptr, fdPost = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_POST") != nullptr;
  uint32_t fdW = src->HW(), fdH = src->HH(); bool fdBgra = src->fi && (src->fi->vk == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || src->fi->vk == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB);
  if (fdPost) { fdW = w->scExtent.width; fdH = w->scExtent.height; fdBgra = w->scFormat == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || w->scFormat == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB; }
  const bool fdBurstNow = g_fdBurst > 0 && (g_fdBurst-- % 4) == 0;   // NVN_THUMB_LOG: a photo-thumbnail draw requests a short burst of frames
  const bool fdHdr = fdPost && w->hdr;   // HDR10 swapchain: the dump is the raw A2B10G10R10 PQ image, written through snap_hdr::DumpPQ
  if (fdDir && *fdDir && fdCount < fdMax && src->fi && src->fi->bytes == 4 && src->fi->aspect == VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT) {
    const double nowS = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - fdT0).count();
    // NVN_FRAME_DUMP_AT=<p1,p2,...>: dump at those present counts instead of by time (frame-exact comparisons between runs)
    static std::vector<int> fdAt = [] { std::vector<int> v; if (const char* e = getenv("NVN_FRAME_DUMP_AT")) for (const char* c = e; *c;) { v.push_back(atoi(c)); while (*c && *c != ',') c++; if (*c == ',') c++; } return v; }();
    static size_t fdAtIdx = 0;
    bool fdAtNow = false;
    if (!fdAt.empty()) { if (fdAtIdx < fdAt.size() && g_presentCount >= fdAt[fdAtIdx]) { fdAtNow = true; fdAtIdx++; } }
    if (fdBurstNow || fdAtNow || (fdAt.empty() && nowS >= fdFrom && nowS <= fdTo && nowS >= fdNext)) {
      fdNext = nowS + fdEvery;
      if (CreateHostBuffer(h, (uint64_t)fdW * fdH * (fdHdr && snap_hdr::IsScrgb() ? 8 : 4), VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, &fdBuf, &fdMem, &fdMap)) {
        VkBufferImageCopy bc{}; bc.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; bc.imageExtent = {src->HW(), src->HH(), 1};
        if (!fdPost) vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, src->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, fdBuf, 1, &bc);
        VkMemoryBarrier2 mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
        mb.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT; mb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        mb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT; mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT;
        VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; di.memoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
        snprintf(fdName, sizeof fdName, "%s/f%04d_p%d_t%.1f.bmp", fdDir, fdCount++, g_presentCount, nowS);
      } else { fdBuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    }
  }
  bool hdrDone = false;   // HDR10 swapchain (SNAP_HDR=1): nvn_hdr.cpp draws the PQ pass instead of the clear + blit below (set after the rects are known)
  if (!w->hdr) {
  imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
  VkClearColorValue black{};
  VkImageSubresourceRange rg{VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, dst, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &black, 1, &rg);
  imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
  }

  // source rectangle: crop if set, else the whole texture
  // render scale: the window texture may be larger than the guest-visible size (crop is in guest pixels)
  const int srcW = (int)src->HW(), srcH = (int)src->HH();
  const double rsx = (double)srcW / src->b.width, rsy = (double)srcH / src->b.height;
  int sx = 0, sy = 0, sw = srcW, sh = srcH;
  if (w->crop[2] > 0 && w->crop[3] > 0) { sx = (int)(w->crop[0] * rsx + 0.5); sy = (int)(w->crop[1] * rsy + 0.5); sw = (int)(w->crop[2] * rsx + 0.5); sh = (int)(w->crop[3] * rsy + 0.5); }
  sx = std::clamp(sx, 0, srcW - 1); sy = std::clamp(sy, 0, srcH - 1);
  sw = std::clamp(sw, 1, srcW - sx); sh = std::clamp(sh, 1, srcH - sy);
  // destination rectangle: aspect-preserving fit
  const double sa = (double)sw / sh, da = (double)w->scExtent.width / w->scExtent.height;
  int dw = w->scExtent.width, dh = w->scExtent.height;
  if (sa > da) dh = std::max(1, (int)(dw / sa + 0.5)); else dw = std::max(1, (int)(dh * sa + 0.5));
  int dx = ((int)w->scExtent.width - dw) / 2, dy = ((int)w->scExtent.height - dh) / 2;
  VkImageBlit blit{};
  blit.srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
  blit.srcOffsets[0] = {sx, sy, 0}; blit.srcOffsets[1] = {sx + sw, sy + sh, 1};
  blit.dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
  blit.dstOffsets[0] = {dx, dy, 0}; blit.dstOffsets[1] = {dx + dw, dy + dh, 1};
  const bool same = (sw == dw && sh == dh);
  if (w->hdr) {
    // HDR path: the scene is blitted into an SDR scratch image so SNAP_LOOK and the F1 overlay (SDR code) keep working; the overlay draws into a
    // transparent layer. nvn_hdr.cpp then encodes scene (inverse tone map) + layer (paper white) into the HDR swapchain image.
    snap_hdr::Scratch sc{};
    if (snap_hdr::PrepScratch(cb, h->phys, h->device, w->scExtent, &sc)) {
      VkImageBlit sb = blit;
      sb.dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
      if (sc.dbg != 1) vkCmdBlitImage(cb, src->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, sc.sdr, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &sb, same ? VK_FILTER_NEAREST : VK_FILTER_LINEAR);
      imgBarrier(sc.sdr, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
      SnapUiFrame uf{h->instance, h->phys, h->device, h->queue, h->family, cb, sc.sdr, sc.sdrFmt, w->scExtent, w->swapchain, (uint32_t)w->scImages.size(), w->hwnd};
      snap_look_present(&uf);
      SnapUiFrame ul = uf; ul.image = sc.layer; ul.format = sc.layerFmt;
      snap_ui_present(&ul);
      snap_hdr::Frame hf{h->phys, h->device, cb, dst, w->scFormat, w->scExtent, w->swapchain, sc.sdr, sc.sdrFmt, w->scExtent.width, w->scExtent.height,
                         0, 0, (int)w->scExtent.width, (int)w->scExtent.height, 0, 0, (int)w->scExtent.width, (int)w->scExtent.height, sc.layer};
      hdrDone = snap_hdr::Record(hf);
    }
    if (!hdrDone) {   // setup failed: this frame blits, then the swapchain is recreated as SDR
      w->hdr = false; w->needRecreate = true;
      imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
      LogError("HDR pass failed; the next frame recreates an SDR swapchain");
    }
  }
  if (!w->hdr && !hdrDone) vkCmdBlitImage(cb, src->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, dst, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &blit,
                 same ? VK_FILTER_NEAREST : VK_FILTER_LINEAR);
  { SnapUiFrame uf{h->instance, h->phys, h->device, h->queue, h->family, cb, dst, w->scFormat, w->scExtent, w->swapchain, (uint32_t)w->scImages.size(), w->hwnd}; if (!hdrDone) { snap_look_present(&uf); snap_ui_present(&uf); } }
  if (fdBuf && fdPost) {   // NVN_FRAME_DUMP_POST: copy the finished swapchain image (TRANSFER_DST after the overlay)
    imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy bc{}; bc.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}; bc.imageExtent = {fdW, fdH, 1};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, dst, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, fdBuf, 1, &bc);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
    mb.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT; mb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    mb.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT; mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT;
    VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO}; di.memoryBarrierCount = 1; di.pMemoryBarriers = &mb;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
  }   // overlay: image stays TRANSFER_DST
  imgBarrier(dst, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR);
  if (perfSlot >= 0) PerfGpuEnd(h, cb, perfSlot);
  vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);

  uint64_t v = ++q->value;
