`runtime/os/perf.cpp`:

```cpp
// See perf.h. Output files (SNAP_PERF=<base>): <base>_frames.csv, <base>_threads.csv, <base>_events.csv.
#include "perf.h"

#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <array>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include "os.h"

namespace snap_perf {

std::atomic<uint64_t> g_ns[C_COUNT], g_calls[C_COUNT], g_val[V_COUNT];
thread_local Ledger tl_ledger;
thread_local uint8_t tl_role = R_OTHER;
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_role_ns[R_COUNT][WT_COUNT], g_fs_bytes;
uint64_t g_wait_event_ns = 8000000;
static const char* kWtName[WT_COUNT] = {"core", "lock", "cvar", "key", "multi", "sleep", "fs"};
static uint64_t g_prev_role[R_COUNT][WT_COUNT], g_prev_fs_bytes;
static std::mutex g_led_mu;
static std::map<unsigned long, Ledger*> g_ledgers;
void ledger_register() {
    tl_ledger.tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_led_mu);
    g_ledgers[tl_ledger.tid] = &tl_ledger;
    tl_ledger.reg = true;
}
Ledger::~Ledger() {
    if (!reg) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_led_mu);
    g_ledgers.erase(tid);
}
static FILE* g_waits;

static const char* kCtrName[C_COUNT] = {"replay", "qsubmit", "pace", "acquire", "acqsem", "present", "waitsync", "finish", "pipe",
                                        "shader", "poolsync", "upload", "hash", "desc", "getpipe", "readback", "scratch", "reap",
                                        "ensureimg", "view", "rendbegin"};
static const char* kValName[V_COUNT] = {"draws", "submits", "cmds", "poolsync_bytes", "poolsync_calls", "uploads", "upload_bytes",
                                        "hash_bytes", "hash_calls", "pipes_created", "scratch_allocs", "desc_sets", "barriers", "shaders",
                                        "pipes_skipped", "upload_pref", "upload_pref_img",
                                        "pref_miss_none", "pref_miss_fail", "pref_miss_hash", "pref_miss_late",
                                        "pref_miss_drop", "pref_skip_kind", "pref_skip_nosrc", "pref_skip_budget"};

static FILE *g_frames, *g_threads, *g_events;
static std::mutex g_ev_mu;
static uint64_t g_t0, g_prev_ns[C_COUNT], g_prev_val[V_COUNT], g_prev_calls[C_COUNT], g_last_mark;
static OsStats g_prev_os;
static uint64_t g_prev_cycles;
static std::once_flag g_once;

static void sampler() {
    std::map<DWORD, std::pair<HANDLE, uint64_t>> h;   // tid -> handle, last cpu time (100 ns)
    uint64_t last = now_ns();
    for (;;) {
        Sleep(1000);
        const uint64_t now = now_ns();
        const double t = (double)(now - g_t0) / 1e9, wall_ms = (double)(now - last) / 1e6;
        last = now;
        HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
        if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) continue;
        THREADENTRY32 te{sizeof te};
        std::map<DWORD, bool> seen;
        if (Thread32First(snap, &te)) {
            do {
                if (te.th32OwnerProcessID != GetCurrentProcessId()) continue;
                seen[te.th32ThreadID] = true;
                auto it = h.find(te.th32ThreadID);
                if (it == h.end()) {
                    HANDLE th = OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
                    if (!th) continue;
                    it = h.emplace(te.th32ThreadID, std::make_pair(th, (uint64_t)0)).first;
                }
                FILETIME c, e, k, u;
                if (!GetThreadTimes(it->second.first, &c, &e, &k, &u)) continue;
                const uint64_t cpu = (((uint64_t)k.dwHighDateTime << 32) | k.dwLowDateTime) + (((uint64_t)u.dwHighDateTime << 32) | u.dwLowDateTime);
                const double ms = (double)(cpu - it->second.second) / 1e4;
                it->second.second = cpu;
                if (ms < 2.0) continue;
                wchar_t* d = nullptr;
                using Fn = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PWSTR*);
                static Fn gd = (Fn)(void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "GetThreadDescription");
                char nm[64] = "";
                if (gd && SUCCEEDED(gd(it->second.first, &d)) && d) { snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%ls", d); LocalFree(d); }
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_ev_mu);
                fprintf(g_threads, "%.2f,%lu,%s,%.1f,%.1f\n", t, te.th32ThreadID, nm[0] ? nm : "-", ms, wall_ms);
            } while (Thread32Next(snap, &te));
        }
        CloseHandle(snap);
        for (auto it = h.begin(); it != h.end();) {
            if (!seen.count(it->first)) { CloseHandle(it->second.first); it = h.erase(it); } else ++it;
        }
        if (g_waits) {   // per-thread blocked time over the last second (threads that waited 1 ms or more)
            static std::map<unsigned long, std::array<uint64_t, WT_COUNT>> prev;
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_led_mu);
            for (auto& [tid, l] : g_ledgers) {
                auto& pv = prev[tid];
                uint64_t d[WT_COUNT], sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < WT_COUNT; i++) {
                    const uint64_t v = l->ns[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    d[i] = v - pv[i];
                    pv[i] = v;
                    sum += d[i];
                }
                if (sum < 1000000) continue;
                static std::map<unsigned long, std::string> names;
                auto nit = names.find(tid);
                if (nit == names.end()) {
                    char nm[64] = "-";
                    using Fn = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PWSTR*);
                    static Fn gd = (Fn)(void*)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "GetThreadDescription");
                    if (HANDLE th = OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, tid)) {
                        wchar_t* dsc = nullptr;
                        if (gd && SUCCEEDED(gd(th, &dsc)) && dsc) {
                            if (*dsc) snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%ls", dsc);
                            LocalFree(dsc);
                        }
                        CloseHandle(th);
                    }
                    for (char* c = nm; *c; c++) if (*c == ',') *c = ';';
                    nit = names.emplace(tid, nm).first;
                }
                fprintf(g_waits, "%.2f,%lu,%s", t, tid, nit->second.c_str());
                for (int i = 0; i < WT_COUNT; i++) fprintf(g_waits, ",%.1f", (double)d[i] / 1e6);
                fprintf(g_waits, "\n");
            }
            fflush(g_waits);
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_ev_mu);
        fflush(g_threads);
    }
}

static void init() {
    const char* base = std::getenv("SNAP_PERF");
    if (!base || !*base) base = std::getenv("SNAP_PERF_SHARED");   // non-exclusive A/B runs (see perf.h)
    if (!base || !*base) return;
    if (const char* w = std::getenv("SNAP_PERF_WAIT_MS")) g_wait_event_ns = (uint64_t)(atof(w) * 1e6);
    std::string b = base;
    g_frames = fopen((b + "_frames.csv").c_str(), "w");
    g_threads = fopen((b + "_threads.csv").c_str(), "w");
    g_events = fopen((b + "_events.csv").c_str(), "w");
    if (!g_frames || !g_threads || !g_events) return;
    g_t0 = g_last_mark = now_ns();
    fprintf(g_frames, "frame,t_s,dt_ms,tid,cpu_mcycles,gpu_busy_ms,gpu_span_ms,gpu_cbs");
    for (int i = 0; i < C_COUNT; i++) fprintf(g_frames, ",%s_ms,%s_n", kCtrName[i], kCtrName[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < V_COUNT; i++) fprintf(g_frames, ",%s", kValName[i]);
    fprintf(g_frames, ",os_preempt_req,os_preempt_yield,os_overflow,os_core_waits,os_spin_yields,os_lock_contended,os_cv_waits,os_fiber_sw");
    static const char* kRole[R_COUNT] = {"oth", "gt", "mt"};
    for (int r : {1, 2, 0})
        for (int i = 0; i < WT_COUNT; i++) fprintf(g_frames, ",%s_%s_ms", kRole[r], kWtName[i]);
    fprintf(g_frames, ",fs_bytes\n");
    fprintf(g_threads, "t_s,tid,name,cpu_ms,wall_ms\n");
    fprintf(g_events, "t_s,kind,ms,detail\n");
    g_waits = fopen((b + "_waits.csv").c_str(), "w");
    if (g_waits) {
        fprintf(g_waits, "t_s,tid,name");
        for (int i = 0; i < WT_COUNT; i++) fprintf(g_waits, ",%s_ms", kWtName[i]);
        fprintf(g_waits, "\n");
    }
    os_get_stats(&g_prev_os);
    std::thread(sampler).detach();
}

void frame_mark(uint64_t present_no, double gpu_busy_ms, double gpu_span_ms, int gpu_cbs) {
    if (!on) return;
    std::call_once(g_once, init);
    if (!g_frames) return;
    if (tl_role == R_OTHER) tl_role = R_PRESENT;
    const uint64_t now = now_ns();
    ULONG64 cyc = 0;
    QueryThreadCycleTime(GetCurrentThread(), &cyc);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_ev_mu);
    fprintf(g_frames, "%llu,%.4f,%.3f,%lu,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%d", (unsigned long long)present_no, (double)(now - g_t0) / 1e9, (double)(now - g_last_mark) / 1e6,
            GetCurrentThreadId(), (double)(cyc - g_prev_cycles) / 1e6, gpu_busy_ms, gpu_span_ms, gpu_cbs);
    g_prev_cycles = cyc;
    g_last_mark = now;
    for (int i = 0; i < C_COUNT; i++) {
        const uint64_t ns = g_ns[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed), n = g_calls[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        fprintf(g_frames, ",%.3f,%llu", (double)(ns - g_prev_ns[i]) / 1e6, (unsigned long long)(n - g_prev_calls[i]));
        g_prev_ns[i] = ns; g_prev_calls[i] = n;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < V_COUNT; i++) {
        const uint64_t v = g_val[i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        fprintf(g_frames, ",%llu", (unsigned long long)(v - g_prev_val[i]));
        g_prev_val[i] = v;
    }
    OsStats o;
    os_get_stats(&o);
    fprintf(g_frames, ",%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu,%llu", (unsigned long long)(o.preempt_requests - g_prev_os.preempt_requests),
            (unsigned long long)(o.preempt_yields - g_prev_os.preempt_yields), (unsigned long long)(o.overflow_grants - g_prev_os.overflow_grants),
            (unsigned long long)(o.core_waits - g_prev_os.core_waits), (unsigned long long)(o.spin_yields - g_prev_os.spin_yields),
            (unsigned long long)(o.lock_contended - g_prev_os.lock_contended), (unsigned long long)(o.cv_waits - g_prev_os.cv_waits),
            (unsigned long long)(o.fiber_switches - g_prev_os.fiber_switches));
    g_prev_os = o;
    for (int r : {1, 2, 0})
        for (int i = 0; i < WT_COUNT; i++) {
            const uint64_t v = g_role_ns[r][i].load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
            fprintf(g_frames, ",%.3f", (double)(v - g_prev_role[r][i]) / 1e6);
            g_prev_role[r][i] = v;
        }
    const uint64_t fb = g_fs_bytes.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    fprintf(g_frames, ",%llu\n", (unsigned long long)(fb - g_prev_fs_bytes));
    g_prev_fs_bytes = fb;
    if (present_no % 120 == 0) { fflush(g_frames); fflush(g_events); }
}

void event(const char* kind, double ms, const char* detail) {
    if (!on) return;
    std::call_once(g_once, init);
    if (!g_events) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_ev_mu);
    fprintf(g_events, "%.3f,%s,%.3f,%s\n", (double)(now_ns() - g_t0) / 1e9, kind, ms, detail ? detail : "");
}

}  // namespace snap_perf

```

`runtime/os/perf.h`:

```h
// Env-gated performance instrumentation (off unless SNAP_PERF=<output base path> is set; see analysis/perf/).
// Counters are process-wide atomics added to by any thread; frame_mark() (called once per presented frame) turns the deltas since
// the previous mark into one CSV row. A sampler thread writes per-thread CPU time once a second. When SNAP_PERF is unset every
// entry point is a single predictable branch.
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace snap_perf {

enum Ctr {
    C_REPLAY = 0,    // SubmitLists: replaying NVN command lists into Vulkan (game thread CPU), includes several items below
    C_QSUBMIT,       // vkQueueSubmit2 calls (draw lists and present)
    C_PACE,          // frame limiter sleep
    C_ACQUIRE,       // vkAcquireNextImageKHR (blocks on the display)
    C_ACQSEM,        // waiting for the timeline value that last used an acquire semaphore
    C_PRESENT,       // vkQueuePresentKHR
    C_WAITSYNC,      // guest nvnSyncWait (CPU waits for the GPU)
    C_FINISH,        // guest nvnQueueFinish
    C_PIPE,          // vkCreateGraphicsPipelines / compute (synchronous compile on the replaying thread)
    C_SHADER,        // program creation (cache read, vkCreateShaderModule, harness)
    C_POOLSYNC,      // SyncPoolRange: guest memory copied into the mirrored buffers
    C_UPLOAD,        // UploadStaticTexture (deswizzle, ASTC/BC7 transcode, staging copy)
    C_HASH,          // RefreshDynamicTexture hashing of CPU-written textures
    C_DESC,          // WriteDescriptors (set allocation + vkUpdateDescriptorSets)
    C_GETPIPE,       // GetPipeline lookup including key building (includes compile)
    C_READBACK,      // FlushReadbacks / GPU->guest copies
    C_SCRATCH,       // NewScratch (vkCreateBuffer + vkAllocateMemory + map)
    C_REAP,          // QueueImpl::Reap
    C_ENSUREIMG,     // TextureImpl::EnsureImage that creates an image (vkCreateImage + memory) (perf pass 4 replay sub-scope)
    C_VIEW,          // image view creation (sampled and attachment views)
    C_RENDBEGIN,     // BeginRendering (render-pass setup incl. attachment views)
    C_COUNT
};
enum Val {   // plain counters (no time)
    V_DRAWS = 0, V_SUBMITS, V_CMDS, V_POOLSYNC_BYTES, V_POOLSYNC_CALLS, V_UPLOADS, V_UPLOAD_BYTES, V_HASH_BYTES, V_HASH_CALLS,
    V_PIPES_CREATED, V_SCRATCH_ALLOCS, V_DESC_SETS, V_BARRIERS, V_SHADERS, V_PIPES_SKIPPED,
    V_UPLOAD_PREF,   // [perf] static uploads served from the prefetch (deswizzled off the replay thread)
    V_UPLOAD_PREF_IMG,   // [perf] images created by a prefetch worker and adopted by EnsureImage (pass 5)
    V_PREF_MISS_NONE, V_PREF_MISS_FAIL, V_PREF_MISS_HASH, V_PREF_MISS_LATE,   // [perf] static uploads not served by the prefetch: never queued / job failed (bytes changed during it) / bytes changed since / job not started yet
    V_PREF_MISS_DROP,                                                         // [perf] pass 6: queued but dropped from the staging budget before its upload
    V_PREF_SKIP_KIND, V_PREF_SKIP_NOSRC, V_PREF_SKIP_BUDGET,                  // [perf] pass 6: TexPrefetch calls not queued: format/target/size / no guest source yet / budget full
    V_COUNT
};

// SNAP_PERF_SHARED=<prefix> is the same output for a run on one normal (non-exclusive) slot: A/B comparisons on a shared PC.
inline const bool on = std::getenv("SNAP_PERF") != nullptr || std::getenv("SNAP_PERF_SHARED") != nullptr;

// Blocked time by cause (perf pass 3, SNAP_PERF only). Each thread adds to its own ledger (registered on first use; the
// sampler writes <base>_waits.csv once a second, per thread) and to process-wide sums by role: frame_mark writes the deltas of
// the presenting threads (gt_*: the JobWorkers that call nvnQueuePresent), of the main thread (mt_*) and of all threads (all_*).
enum Wt {
    WT_CORE = 0,  // acquire_core: ready, waiting for one of the 3 virtual cores (includes preemption hand-backs)
    WT_LOCK,      // contended nn::os mutex / critical section (svcArbitrateLock path)
    WT_CVAR,      // condition variable wait (events, semaphores, message queues, barriers, cv)
    WT_KEY,       // light events, rw locks, timers, thread join
    WT_MULTI,     // WaitAny / MultiWait
    WT_SLEEP,     // nn::os::SleepThread / svcSleepThread
    WT_FS,        // fs file read (host ReadFile)
    WT_COUNT
};
enum Role : uint8_t { R_OTHER = 0, R_PRESENT = 1, R_MAIN = 2, R_COUNT };
struct Ledger {
    std::atomic<uint64_t> ns[WT_COUNT];
    unsigned long tid = 0;
    bool reg = false;
    ~Ledger();
};
extern thread_local Ledger tl_ledger;
extern thread_local uint8_t tl_role;
extern std::atomic<uint64_t> g_role_ns[R_COUNT][WT_COUNT];
extern std::atomic<uint64_t> g_fs_bytes;
void ledger_register();
inline void wait_add(Wt w, uint64_t ns) {
    if (!tl_ledger.reg) ledger_register();
    tl_ledger.ns[w].fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_role_ns[tl_role][w].fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void set_role(Role r) { tl_role = r; }
inline bool key_thread() { return tl_role != R_OTHER; }
// Long-wait event threshold in ns (SNAP_PERF_WAIT_MS, default 8 ms) for presenting / main threads; other threads' core waits use 4x.
extern uint64_t g_wait_event_ns;

inline uint64_t now_ns() {
    return (uint64_t)std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}
extern std::atomic<uint64_t> g_ns[C_COUNT], g_calls[C_COUNT], g_val[V_COUNT];

inline void add(Ctr c, uint64_t ns) {
    g_ns[c].fetch_add(ns, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_calls[c].fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
inline void count(Val v, uint64_t n = 1) { if (on) g_val[v].fetch_add(n, std::memory_order_relaxed); }

struct Scope {
    Ctr c; uint64_t t0;
    explicit Scope(Ctr c_) : c(c_), t0(on ? now_ns() : 0) {}
    ~Scope() { if (on) add(c, now_ns() - t0); }
};

// One row per presented frame. gpu_* come from the NVN layer's timestamp queries (-1 when unavailable).
void frame_mark(uint64_t present_no, double gpu_busy_ms, double gpu_span_ms, int gpu_cbs);
// A named occurrence with a duration (pipeline compiles, shader translations, texture uploads over 2 ms ...).
void event(const char* kind, double ms, const char* detail);

}  // namespace snap_perf

```

`runtime/os/sampler.cpp`:

```cpp
// Sampling CPU profiler (off unless SNAP_SAMPLE is set; 2026-11-13, CPU profile worker).
//
//   SNAP_SAMPLE=1 | <base path>    on; output <base>.prof (default analysis\perf\sample_<pid>.prof, relative to the working dir)
//   SNAP_SAMPLE_US=<us>             sampling period (default 1000)
//   SNAP_SAMPLE_WRITE_S=<s>         rewrite the output every s seconds (default 20; a run killed by PID keeps the last copy)
//   SNAP_SAMPLE_MIN_KCYC=<k>        sample a thread only when it used at least k thousand cycles since its last sample (default 100)
//
// One host thread wakes every period, and for every thread of the process that did enough work since its last sample
// (QueryThreadCycleTime delta >= SNAP_SAMPLE_MIN_KCYC) it suspends the thread, reads its context, copies the top 16 KiB of its stack into a static buffer and resumes it.
// Nothing between SuspendThread and ResumeThread touches the heap or any user-mode lock (GetThreadContext, VirtualQuery, memcpy
// only), so a thread suspended while it holds the heap lock or an SRW lock cannot deadlock the sampler (same rule as the stall
// watchdog in host\boot.cpp). The stack copy is unwound after the resume with RtlVirtualUnwind (no heap, no dbghelp), giving up to
// kDepth host frames; lifted guest functions are host functions (f_<guest address>), so the host stack is the guest call chain.
// Stacks are counted in a fixed table (allocated once), keyed by thread, present-count bucket (presents / 500) and frames.
// The file holds raw absolute addresses plus the module list; analysis\perf\cpu_profile.py symbolizes them with the linker map
// (snap_boot.map) and the guest ELF symbols, and prints flat and caller views per thread.
#include <windows.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <psapi.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <intrin.h>

namespace {

constexpr int kDepth = 8;                  // frames kept per sample (leaf first)
constexpr int kMaxThreads = 512;
constexpr size_t kStackCopy = 16 * 1024;
constexpr uint32_t kTableBits = 19;        // 512K stacks, ~44 MB
constexpr uint32_t kTableSize = 1u << kTableBits;
constexpr int kBucketPresents = 500;

struct Entry {
    uint64_t pc[kDepth];
    uint32_t tid;
    uint16_t bucket;
    uint8_t depth, flags;   // flags bit0: leaf rip sits right after a syscall instruction (thread blocked in the kernel)
    uint64_t count;
    uint64_t cyc;           // thread cycles since its previous sample, summed (CPU-weighted view)
};
struct Thr {
    DWORD tid;
    HANDLE h;
    uint64_t last_cyc, cyc, n_samples, n_sys;
    bool alive;
    char name[64];
};

Entry *g_tab;
uint64_t g_used, g_dropped, g_ticks, g_self_cyc, g_suspend_fail;
Thr g_thr[kMaxThreads];
int g_nthr;
alignas(16) uint8_t g_stack[kStackCopy];
const int *g_frame;          // present counter (nvn::g_presentCount), may be null
char g_path[MAX_PATH];
unsigned g_period_us = 1000, g_write_s = 20;
uint64_t g_min_cyc = 100000;   // SNAP_SAMPLE_MIN_KCYC (thousands of cycles of work since the last sample; ~30 us at 3.5 GHz)
HANDLE g_flush_req, g_flush_done;
DWORD g_self_tid;
std::atomic<bool> g_on{false};

uint64_t hash_entry(const Entry &e) {
    uint64_t h = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull ^ ((uint64_t)e.tid << 20) ^ ((uint64_t)e.bucket << 8) ^ e.flags;
    for (int i = 0; i < e.depth; i++) { h ^= e.pc[i]; h *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull; h ^= h >> 29; }
    return h;
}
void add(const Entry &e, uint64_t cyc) {
    uint64_t i = hash_entry(e) & (kTableSize - 1);
    for (uint32_t probe = 0; probe < 64; probe++, i = (i + 1) & (kTableSize - 1)) {
        Entry &s = g_tab[i];
        if (s.count == 0) {
            s = e;
            s.count = 1;
            s.cyc = cyc;
            g_used++;
            return;
        }
        if (s.tid == e.tid && s.bucket == e.bucket && s.flags == e.flags && s.depth == e.depth &&
            memcmp(s.pc, e.pc, sizeof(uint64_t) * e.depth) == 0) {
            s.count++;
            s.cyc += cyc;
            return;
        }
    }
    g_dropped++;
}

// Unwind a context whose stack lo..lo+n was copied to g_stack (see raw_unwind in host\boot.cpp). Every integer register that points
// into the copied range is rebased before each step, since a function's frame register need not be rbp. Any value read outside
// the copy is from the live stack (the thread runs again) and can be garbage, hence the SEH guard in unwind().
void rebase_all(CONTEXT &ctx, uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi, uint64_t slo) {
    DWORD64 *r = &ctx.Rax;   // Rax..R15 are contiguous in CONTEXT
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (r[i] >= lo && r[i] < hi) r[i] = slo + (r[i] - lo);
}
void unwind_steps(CONTEXT &ctx, uint64_t lo, size_t n, uint64_t *pcs, int *depth) {
    const uint64_t hi = lo + n, slo = (uintptr_t)g_stack, shi = slo + n;
    rebase_all(ctx, lo, hi, slo);
    while (*depth < kDepth && ctx.Rip) {
        pcs[(*depth)++] = ctx.Rip;
        if (ctx.Rsp < slo || ctx.Rsp + 8 > shi) break;
        DWORD64 img = 0;
        PRUNTIME_FUNCTION fe = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(ctx.Rip, &img, nullptr);
        if (!fe) { ctx.Rip = *(DWORD64 *)ctx.Rsp; ctx.Rsp += 8; }
        else {
            void *hd = nullptr;
            DWORD64 est = 0;
            RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, img, ctx.Rip, fe, &ctx, &hd, &est, nullptr);
        }
        rebase_all(ctx, lo, hi, slo);
        if (ctx.Rsp < slo || ctx.Rsp > shi) break;
    }
}
uint64_t g_unwind_faults;
int unwind(CONTEXT ctx, uint64_t lo, size_t n, uint64_t *pcs) {
    int d = 0;
    __try {
        unwind_steps(ctx, lo, n, pcs, &d);
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        g_unwind_faults++;
    }
    return d;
}

// Thread list: NtGetNextThread walks this process's threads only. The first version used a Toolhelp snapshot, which copies every
// thread of the whole system; on the shared PC that took ~250 ms per refresh and most of the sampler's CPU.
using NtGetNextThreadFn = LONG(NTAPI *)(HANDLE, HANDLE, ACCESS_MASK, ULONG, ULONG, PHANDLE);
void name_thread(Thr &t) {
    using GetDesc = HRESULT(WINAPI *)(HANDLE, PWSTR *);
    static GetDesc gd = (GetDesc)(void *)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "GetThreadDescription");
    wchar_t *d = nullptr;
    if (gd && SUCCEEDED(gd(t.h, &d)) && d) {
        if (*d) {
            snprintf(t.name, sizeof t.name, "%ls", d);
            for (char *c = t.name; *c; c++) if (*c == ' ' || *c == '\t') *c = '_';
        }
        LocalFree(d);
    }
}
void refresh_threads() {
    static NtGetNextThreadFn next_thread = (NtGetNextThreadFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll"), "NtGetNextThread");
    static int pass;
    pass++;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nthr; i++) {   // exited threads keep their rows (their samples) and drop the handle
        Thr &t = g_thr[i];
        if (!t.h) continue;
        if (WaitForSingleObject(t.h, 0) == WAIT_OBJECT_0) { CloseHandle(t.h); t.h = nullptr; continue; }
        if (!t.name[0] || (pass & 7) == 0) name_thread(t);   // guest threads name themselves right after they start
    }
    if (!next_thread) return;
    const ACCESS_MASK acc = THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION | SYNCHRONIZE;
    HANDLE cur = nullptr;
    bool keep_cur = false;
    for (;;) {
        HANDLE nx = nullptr;
        const LONG st = next_thread(GetCurrentProcess(), cur, acc, 0, 0, &nx);
        if (cur && !keep_cur) CloseHandle(cur);
        if (st != 0 || !nx) break;
        cur = nx;
        keep_cur = false;
        const DWORD tid = GetThreadId(nx);
        if (tid == g_self_tid || tid == 0) continue;
        bool known = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nthr && !known; i++) known = g_thr[i].tid == tid && g_thr[i].h;
        if (known || g_nthr >= kMaxThreads) continue;
        Thr &t = g_thr[g_nthr++];
        memset(&t, 0, sizeof t);
        t.tid = tid;
        t.h = nx;
        keep_cur = true;
        QueryThreadCycleTime(nx, &t.last_cyc);
        name_thread(t);
    }
}

uint64_t g_t_qtc, g_t_susp, g_t_unwind, g_t_refresh, g_t_write, g_n_sampled;   // sampler cost by phase (rdtsc), in the header
void sample_one(Thr &t, uint16_t bucket) {
    uint64_t cyc = 0;
    const uint64_t r0 = __rdtsc();
    if (!QueryThreadCycleTime(t.h, &cyc)) return;
    const uint64_t dc = cyc - t.last_cyc;
    g_t_qtc += __rdtsc() - r0;
    // Below g_min_cyc the thread only woke briefly (or only ran our own suspend APC, which is charged to the target thread: with a
    // plain "ran since the last tick" test every blocked thread got sampled every tick and the sampler took 70% of a core).
    if (dc < g_min_cyc) return;
    g_n_sampled++;
    const uint64_t r1 = __rdtsc();
    t.last_cyc = cyc;
    t.cyc += dc;
    CONTEXT ctx;
    ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL | CONTEXT_INTEGER;
    if (SuspendThread(t.h) == (DWORD)-1) { g_suspend_fail++; return; }
    // ---- suspended: no heap, no user-mode locks below until ResumeThread
    size_t n = 0;
    const bool got = GetThreadContext(t.h, &ctx) != FALSE;
    if (got) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)ctx.Rsp, &mbi, sizeof mbi) && mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && !(mbi.Protect & PAGE_GUARD)) {
            const uint64_t end = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
            n = (size_t)(end - ctx.Rsp < kStackCopy ? end - ctx.Rsp : kStackCopy);
            memcpy(g_stack, (void *)(uintptr_t)ctx.Rsp, n);
        }
    }
    ResumeThread(t.h);
    // ---- resumed
    QueryThreadCycleTime(t.h, &t.last_cyc);   // after the resume: the suspend/resume APC cost is not counted as the thread's work
    const uint64_t r2 = __rdtsc();
    g_t_susp += r2 - r1;
    if (!got) return;
    Entry e;
    memset(&e, 0, sizeof e);
    e.tid = t.tid;
    e.bucket = bucket;
    if (n) e.depth = (uint8_t)unwind(ctx, ctx.Rsp, n, e.pc);
    else { e.pc[0] = ctx.Rip; e.depth = 1; }
    const uint8_t *ip = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)ctx.Rip;
    if (ctx.Rip > 0x10000 && !IsBadReadPtr(ip - 2, 2) && ip[-2] == 0x0f && ip[-1] == 0x05) e.flags |= 1;
    t.n_samples++;
    if (e.flags & 1) t.n_sys++;
    add(e, dc);
    g_t_unwind += __rdtsc() - r2;
}

void write_out() {
    char tmp[MAX_PATH + 8];
    snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp", g_path);
    FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "w");
    if (!f) return;
    fprintf(f, "# snap sampler v2\nmin_cycles %llu\nunwind_faults %llu\n", (unsigned long long)g_min_cyc, (unsigned long long)g_unwind_faults);
    fprintf(f, "cost_mcyc_qtc %llu\ncost_mcyc_suspend %llu\ncost_mcyc_unwind %llu\ncost_mcyc_refresh %llu\ncost_mcyc_write %llu\nsampled %llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)(g_t_qtc / 1000000), (unsigned long long)(g_t_susp / 1000000), (unsigned long long)(g_t_unwind / 1000000),
            (unsigned long long)(g_t_refresh / 1000000), (unsigned long long)(g_t_write / 1000000), (unsigned long long)g_n_sampled);
    fprintf(f, "period_us %u\nticks %llu\nstacks %llu\ndropped %llu\nsuspend_fail %llu\nself_cycles %llu\nframe %d\nbucket_presents %d\n",
            g_period_us, (unsigned long long)g_ticks, (unsigned long long)g_used, (unsigned long long)g_dropped,
            (unsigned long long)g_suspend_fail, (unsigned long long)g_self_cyc, g_frame ? *g_frame : -1, kBucketPresents);
    HMODULE mods[1024];
    DWORD need = 0;
    if (EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), mods, sizeof mods, &need)) {
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < need / sizeof(HMODULE) && i < 1024; i++) {
            MODULEINFO mi{};
            char nm[MAX_PATH] = "?";
            GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], &mi, sizeof mi);
            GetModuleBaseNameA(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], nm, sizeof nm);
            for (char *c = nm; *c; c++) if (*c == ' ') *c = '_';
            fprintf(f, "module %llx %lx %s\n", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll, (unsigned long)mi.SizeOfImage, nm);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nthr; i++) {
        const Thr &t = g_thr[i];
        if (!t.n_samples) continue;
        fprintf(f, "thread %lu %s %llu %llu %llu\n", t.tid, t.name[0] ? t.name : "-", (unsigned long long)t.cyc,
                (unsigned long long)t.n_samples, (unsigned long long)t.n_sys);
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kTableSize; i++) {
        const Entry &e = g_tab[i];
        if (!e.count) continue;
        fprintf(f, "s %lu %u %u %llu %llu", e.tid, e.bucket, e.flags, (unsigned long long)e.count, (unsigned long long)e.cyc);
        for (int k = 0; k < e.depth; k++) fprintf(f, " %llx", (unsigned long long)e.pc[k]);
        fputc('\n', f);
    }
    fclose(f);
    MoveFileExA(tmp, g_path, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING);
}

DWORD WINAPI sampler_main(void *) {
    g_self_tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST);
    using SetDesc = HRESULT(WINAPI *)(HANDLE, PCWSTR);
    if (auto sd = (SetDesc)(void *)GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription")) sd(GetCurrentThread(), L"snap:sampler");
    HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    if (!timer) timer = CreateWaitableTimerW(nullptr, FALSE, nullptr);
    LARGE_INTEGER due;
    due.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)g_period_us * 10;
    SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE);   // re-armed each tick (one-shot): a late tick does not queue more
    ULONGLONG last_refresh = 0, last_write = GetTickCount64();
    HANDLE self = GetCurrentThread();
    for (;;) {
        HANDLE hs[2] = {timer, g_flush_req};
        const DWORD w = WaitForMultipleObjects(2, hs, FALSE, 1000);
        SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE);
        const ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        if (w == WAIT_OBJECT_0 + 1 || now - last_write >= g_write_s * 1000ull) {
            const uint64_t w0 = __rdtsc();
            write_out();
            g_t_write += __rdtsc() - w0;
            last_write = now;
            if (w == WAIT_OBJECT_0 + 1) { SetEvent(g_flush_done); continue; }
        }
        uint64_t c0 = 0, c1 = 0;
        QueryThreadCycleTime(self, &c0);
        if (now - last_refresh >= 500) { const uint64_t f0 = __rdtsc(); refresh_threads(); g_t_refresh += __rdtsc() - f0; last_refresh = now; }
        const int fr = g_frame ? *(volatile const int *)g_frame : 0;
        const uint16_t bucket = (uint16_t)(fr < 0 ? 0 : (fr / kBucketPresents > 65535 ? 65535 : fr / kBucketPresents));
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nthr; i++) if (g_thr[i].h) sample_one(g_thr[i], bucket);
        g_ticks++;
        QueryThreadCycleTime(self, &c1);
        g_self_cyc += c1 - c0;
    }
}

}  // namespace

// Called once from cmd_run (host\boot.cpp). `frame` = the present counter used for the bucket key.
void snap_sampler_start(const int *frame) {
    const char *v = getenv("SNAP_SAMPLE");
    if (!v || !*v || !strcmp(v, "0")) return;
    if (!strcmp(v, "1")) snprintf(g_path, sizeof g_path, "analysis\\perf\\sample_%lu.prof", GetCurrentProcessId());
    else snprintf(g_path, sizeof g_path, "%s.prof", v);
    if (const char *p = getenv("SNAP_SAMPLE_US")) { int u = atoi(p); g_period_us = u < 100 ? 100 : (u > 100000 ? 100000 : (unsigned)u); }
    if (const char *p = getenv("SNAP_SAMPLE_WRITE_S")) { int s = atoi(p); g_write_s = s < 2 ? 2 : (unsigned)s; }
    if (const char *p = getenv("SNAP_SAMPLE_MIN_KCYC")) g_min_cyc = (uint64_t)strtoull(p, nullptr, 10) * 1000;
    g_tab = (Entry *)VirtualAlloc(nullptr, sizeof(Entry) * kTableSize, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!g_tab) return;
    g_frame = frame;
    g_flush_req = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    g_flush_done = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    if (HANDLE h = CreateThread(nullptr, 256 * 1024, sampler_main, nullptr, 0, nullptr)) { CloseHandle(h); g_on = true; }
    fprintf(stderr, "sampler: on, period %u us, output %s\n", g_period_us, g_path);
}

// Final write before the process ends (the --timeout path in host\boot.cpp calls this before TerminateProcess). Waits at most 5 s.
void snap_sampler_flush() {
    if (!g_on) return;
    SetEvent(g_flush_req);
    WaitForSingleObject(g_flush_done, 5000);
}

```

`runtime/os/svc_getinfo.md`:

```md
# svcGetInfo (SVC 0x29) in os_svc

Raw ABI at the `svc #0x29`: x1 = info type, x2 = handle, x3 = subtype; returns w0 = result, x1 = value. The sdk stub is
`sdk+0x399de8` (`str x0,[sp,-16]!`, `svc`, store x1 to the saved out pointer); the C-level call is `stub(out*, type, handle, subtype)`.
Handle `0xffff8001` is the current-process pseudo handle. Implemented in `os_svc` (`os_kernel.cpp`, case 0x29); memory
values come from `mem_get_info` in `os_memory.cpp`.

## Call sites (found by scanning sdk .text for `bl sdk+0x399de8`; main has no `svc` and no direct caller, it reaches these through sdk)

| Caller (sdk) | Site | type, handle, sub | Use of the result |
|---|---|---|---|
| nn::diag::IsDebuggerAttached | 0x1463cc | 8, 0, 0 | returns the value as bool |
| nn::os::GetIdleTickCount | 0x33ec2c | 0xa, 0, -1 | returns the tick count (overridden by `ov_GetIdleTickCount`, returns 0) |
| nn::os::SetDyingMessageRegion | 0x33ecd8 | 0x14, 0xffff8001, 0 | stores `{addr,size}` at `[ctx+0x1c0]`, so the value must be writable guest memory |
| VammManagerImplByHorizon::GetReservedRegionImpl | 0x346ca8, 0x346cc4 | 2 then 3 | alias region base and size |
| VammManager::InitializeIfEnabled (overridden) | 0x346d58 | 0x10 | nonzero and result 0 = VAMM enabled |
| VammManager::IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled | 0x346dbc | 0x10 | enabled = (result 0 and value != 0) |
| VammManager::GetVirtualAddressMemoryResourceUsage (overridden) | 0x347adc, 0x347afc | 0x10, 0x11 | total and used system resource size, usage = min(used+8 MiB, total) |
| DebugImplByHorizon::QueryMemoryInfo | 0x348234, 0x348254 | 0x16, 0x15 | used and total non-system memory |
| ThreadManagerImplByHorizon::GetThreadAvailableCoreMask (overridden) | 0x34943c | 0, 0xffff8001, 0 | core mask |
| OsResourceManager ctor | 0x34a25c, 0x34a298 | 0xc, 0xe | aslr base, stack base, handed to region managers (size 0x4000 granule) |
| AslrSpaceManagerImplByHorizon::GetAslrSpaceEndAddress | 0x34a360, 0x34a380 | 0xc then 0xd | end = base + size |
| StackGuardManagerImplByHorizon::GetStackGuardEndAddress | 0x34a3f0, 0x34a410 | 0xe then 0xf | end = base + size |
| nn::os::detail::IsApplication | 0x34a63c | 0x17 | bool |
| RngManager ctor | 0x34a6b4, 0x34a6c8 | 0xb, 0, subtypes 2 and 3 | 16 bytes seed for the TinyMt |
| InitializeRandomImpl | 0x34a720, 0x34a734 | 0xb, 0, subtypes 0 and 1 | 16 bytes seed for the TinyMt |

(Handle values are `mov w2,#-0x7fff` = 0xffff8001 everywhere except types 8, 0xa, 0xb which pass 0.)

## Implemented values

Types from the Horizon (Atmosphere/switchbrew) InfoType enum. Types 8, 10, 11 require handle 0; all others require
`0xffff8001` (else 0xe401 InvalidHandle). Subtype must be 0 except types 10 (core -1 or < cores, else 0xe001) and 11 (0..3, else 0xe001).

| Type | Name | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | CoreMask | `(1<<cores)-1`, 7 by default | GetThreadAvailableCoreMask override test expects 7 |
| 1 | PriorityMask | all ones | not requested; harmless |
| 2, 3 | AliasRegion addr, size | a real 2 GiB `MEM_RESERVE` block, created on first query | GetReservedRegionImpl; VAMM does not allocate from it (host VAMM is VirtualAlloc) |
| 4, 5 | HeapRegion addr, size | the 16 GiB reservation that `SetMemoryHeapSize` commits from, reserved on first query | same block as `GetMemoryHeapAddress`; tested |
| 6 | TotalMemorySize | 4 GiB + 1 GiB system resource | arbitrary budget |
| 7 | UsedMemorySize | type 0x16 + type 0x11 | |
| 8 | DebuggerAttached | 0 | IsDebuggerAttached caller |
| 10 | IdleTickCount | 0 | same as the override; no idle accounting |
| 11 | RandomEntropy[0..3] | 4 fixed u64 from `std::random_device`, per run | RngManager and InitializeRandomImpl |
| 12, 13 | AslrRegion addr, size | host min/max application address (`GetSystemInfo`) | AslrSpaceManager; host addresses are guest addresses |
| 14, 15 | StackRegion addr, size | a real 1 GiB `MEM_RESERVE` block, created on first query | StackGuardManager |
| 16 | SystemResourceSizeTotal | 1 GiB (must be nonzero, VAMM-enabled test at sdk+0x346dbc) | |
| 17 | SystemResourceSizeUsed | min(VAMM committed bytes, 16) | consistent with `ov_VamUsage` |
| 18 | ProgramId | 0x0100F4300BF2C000 | task; not requested by the game |
| 20 | UserExceptionContextAddress | one zeroed 4 KiB `VirtualAlloc` block | SetDyingMessageRegion writes `[ctx+0x1c0]` |
| 21 | TotalNonSystemMemorySize | 4 GiB | QueryMemoryInfo |
| 22 | UsedNonSystemMemorySize | heap size + VAMM committed bytes | QueryMemoryInfo |
| 23 | IsApplication | 1 | |

Everything else (9 ResourceLimit, 19, 24 and unknown values) returns 0x7801 (InvalidEnumValue, module 1 desc 60) and logs
`svcGetInfo: unknown type ...`. None of those is requested by sdk or main.

## Other SVCs added to os_svc
- 0x27 OutputDebugString(str, len): logs up to 1 KiB, returns 0.
- 0x26 Break(reason, info, size): logs; fatal unless bit 31 of reason is set (notification only).
- 0x1e GetSystemTick already existed. The boot logs in `analysis/boot/` show no other SVC on the backstop path besides GetInfo.

## Stopgap in host/boot.cpp
`svc_dispatch` calls `os_svc` first, so the type-20 branch is now dead. It can be removed (leave `return os_svc(c, imm);`). Not edited here.

Tests: `tests/os/os_test.cpp` `test_getinfo` (227 checks total, 0 failed).

```

`runtime/simd.h`:

// Via TotK Recomp @ 7a37fc3 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Valiantsin Dzerakh); modified for the Snap prototype where noted.
// Adapted from LAS Recomp runtime/simd.h @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
// Portable C lowering of AArch64 FP / AdvSIMD / crypto / CRC32 (tools/simd_c.py emits calls with constant
// fields; everything is always_inline so the size/lane/op switches fold at -O1).
// Semantics follow the ARM pseudocode, not the host: NaN propagation (first signalling NaN quietened, then
// first quiet NaN), FPCR.DN default NaN, FPCR.FZ flushing (inputs and pre-rounding-tiny results), FPCR.RMode
// for arithmetic / conversions / FRINTX/I, saturating FP->int conversions, fused multiply-add, ARM estimate
// tables. Not modelled: FPSR cumulative exception bits and QC, FPCR trap enables, FP16 arithmetic (ARMv8.2).
// FPCR.AHP is honoured by the half-precision conversions. Host assumptions: IEEE binary32/64, MXCSR in
// round-to-nearest outside the slow paths, with FTZ|DAZ equal to FPCR.FZ (cpu.h rt_fpcr_sync keeps it so); fma must be
// correctly rounded: -march=x86-64-v3 has the FMA instruction, and the v2 build links runtime/fma.c for it.
#pragma once
#include <fenv.h>
#include <immintrin.h>
#include <math.h>

#include "cpu.h"

typedef __uint128_t u128;
#define SI static inline __attribute__((always_inline))
#define SN static __attribute__((noinline))
#define SIMD_CAT2(a, b) a##_##b
#define SIMD_CAT(a, b) SIMD_CAT2(a, b)

#define SIMD_VT(name, T) typedef T name __attribute__((vector_size(16), may_alias));
SIMD_VT(vu8, uint8_t) SIMD_VT(vs8, int8_t) SIMD_VT(vu16, uint16_t) SIMD_VT(vs16, int16_t)
SIMD_VT(vu32, uint32_t) SIMD_VT(vs32, int32_t) SIMD_VT(vu64, uint64_t) SIMD_VT(vs64, int64_t)
SIMD_VT(vf32, float) SIMD_VT(vf64, double)
typedef uint16_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa16;
typedef uint32_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa32;
typedef uint64_t __attribute__((may_alias)) sa64;
typedef float __attribute__((may_alias)) saf32;
typedef double __attribute__((may_alias)) saf64;
typedef u128 __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) u128u;

// ---- registers: VREG = whole V register as a vector type; VQ = source with the upper half cleared when
// Q=0; VW = write, zeroing the upper half when Q=0. Scalar views of lane 0: VS8..VS64, VSF32/VSF64.
#define VREG(T, n) (*(T *)&c->v[n])
#define VQ(T, Q, n) ((T)((Q) ? c->v[n] : (u128)(uint64_t)c->v[n]))
#define VW(T, Q, d, e) do { T _w = (e); c->v[d] = (Q) ? (u128)_w : (u128)(uint64_t)(u128)_w; } while (0)
#define VS8(n) (*(uint8_t *)&c->v[n])
#define VS16(n) (*(sa16 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS32(n) (*(sa32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VS64(n) (*(sa64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF32(n) (*(saf32 *)&c->v[n])
#define VSF64(n) (*(saf64 *)&c->v[n])
#define VHI64(n) (((sa64 *)&c->v[n])[1])
#define LD128(a) (*(const u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a))
#define ST128(a, v) (*(u128u *)(uintptr_t)(a) = (u128)(v))
#define SHUF __builtin_shufflevector
#define CVT __builtin_convertvector

#define FPCR_AHP (1u << 26)
#define FPCR_DN (1u << 25)
#define FPCR_FZ (1u << 24)
#define FPCR_RM (3u << 22)

enum { FOP_ADD, FOP_SUB, FOP_MUL, FOP_MULX, FOP_NMUL, FOP_DIV, FOP_ABD, FOP_SQRT, FOP_MADD, FOP_RECPS, FOP_RSQRTS,
       FOP_MAX, FOP_MIN, FOP_MAXNM, FOP_MINNM };

SI int simd_fe_mode(uint64_t fpcr) {
    static const int m[4] = {FE_TONEAREST, FE_UPWARD, FE_DOWNWARD, FE_TOWARDZERO};
    return m[(fpcr >> 22) & 3];
}

// MXCSR rounding control (bits 13-14) without fesetround's x87 + SSE double write; ldmxcsr only on change.
#define SIMD_RC_MASK 0x6000u
SI unsigned simd_rm_set_rc(unsigned cur, unsigned rc) {
    if ((cur & SIMD_RC_MASK) != rc) _mm_setcsr((cur & ~SIMD_RC_MASK) | rc);
    return cur;
}
// Set MXCSR RC from FPCR.RMode (RN 00, RP 10, RM 01, RZ 11); returns the previous MXCSR.
SI unsigned simd_rm_enter(uint64_t fpcr) {
    static const unsigned rc[4] = {0x0000u, 0x4000u, 0x2000u, 0x6000u};
    return simd_rm_set_rc(_mm_getcsr(), rc[(fpcr >> 22) & 3]);
}
// Force toward-zero.
SI void simd_rm_rz(void) { simd_rm_set_rc(_mm_getcsr(), 0x6000u); }
// Restore the MXCSR saved by simd_rm_enter, only if it changed.
SI void simd_rm_leave(unsigned old) {
    unsigned cur = _mm_getcsr();
    if ((cur & SIMD_RC_MASK) != (old & SIMD_RC_MASK)) _mm_setcsr((cur & ~SIMD_RC_MASK) | (old & SIMD_RC_MASK));
}

// The thread's MXCSR mirrors the guest FPCR.FZ with RC = nearest whenever guest code runs (cpu.h rt_fpcr_sync), so
// plain host FP gives the ARM result unless FPCR.RMode asks for directed rounding, which the slow paths handle.
SI int simd_directed(const Cpu *c) { return __builtin_expect((c->fpcr & FPCR_RM) != 0, 0); }

#define T float
#define U uint32_t
#define NB 32
#define EB 8
#define MB 23
#define VT vf32
#define VTU vu32
#define VTS vs32
#define NL 4
#include "simd_fp.h"
#undef F
#undef T
#undef U
#undef NB
#undef EB
#undef MB
#undef VT
#undef VTU
#undef VTS
#undef NL

#define T double
#define U uint64_t
#define NB 64
#define EB 11
#define MB 52
#define VT vf64
#define VTU vu64
#define VTS vs64
#define NL 2
#include "simd_fp.h"
#undef F

#undef VTS
