```h
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                     if (num >= 3 && res[2] >= 0.0f && res[2] <= 1.0f) {
                        t = res[2], it = 1.0f - t;
                        px = it*it*x0 + 2*t*it*x1 + t*t*x2;
                        py = it*it*y0 + 2*t*it*y1 + t*t*y2;
                        dist2 = (px-sx)*(px-sx) + (py-sy)*(py-sy);
                        if (dist2 < min_dist * min_dist)
                           min_dist = (float) STBTT_sqrt(dist2);
                     }
                  }
               }
            }
            if (winding == 0)
               min_dist = -min_dist;  // if outside the shape, value is negative
            val = onedge_value + pixel_dist_scale * min_dist;
            if (val < 0)
               val = 0;
            else if (val > 255)
               val = 255;
            data[(y-iy0)*w+(x-ix0)] = (unsigned char) val;
         }
      }
      STBTT_free(precompute, info->userdata);
      STBTT_free(verts, info->userdata);
   }
   return data;
}

STBTT_DEF unsigned char * stbtt_GetCodepointSDF(const stbtt_fontinfo *info, float scale, int codepoint, int padding, unsigned char onedge_value, float pixel_dist_scale, int *width, int *height, int *xoff, int *yoff)
{
   return stbtt_GetGlyphSDF(info, scale, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint), padding, onedge_value, pixel_dist_scale, width, height, xoff, yoff);
}

STBTT_DEF void stbtt_FreeSDF(unsigned char *bitmap, void *userdata)
{
   STBTT_free(bitmap, userdata);
}

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
// font name matching -- recommended not to use this
//

// check if a utf8 string contains a prefix which is the utf16 string; if so return length of matching utf8 string
static stbtt_int32 stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(stbtt_uint8 *s1, stbtt_int32 len1, stbtt_uint8 *s2, stbtt_int32 len2)
{
   stbtt_int32 i=0;

   // convert utf16 to utf8 and compare the results while converting
   while (len2) {
      stbtt_uint16 ch = s2[0]*256 + s2[1];
      if (ch < 0x80) {
         if (i >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != ch) return -1;
      } else if (ch < 0x800) {
         if (i+1 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xc0 + (ch >> 6)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + (ch & 0x3f)) return -1;
      } else if (ch >= 0xd800 && ch < 0xdc00) {
         stbtt_uint32 c;
         stbtt_uint16 ch2 = s2[2]*256 + s2[3];
         if (i+3 >= len1) return -1;
         c = ((ch - 0xd800) << 10) + (ch2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xf0 + (c >> 18)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >>  6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c      ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         s2 += 2; // plus another 2 below
         len2 -= 2;
      } else if (ch >= 0xdc00 && ch < 0xe000) {
         return -1;
      } else {
         if (i+2 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xe0 + (ch >> 12)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch >> 6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch     ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
      }
      s2 += 2;
      len2 -= 2;
   }
   return i;
}

static int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal(char *s1, int len1, char *s2, int len2)
{
   return len1 == stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix((stbtt_uint8*) s1, len1, (stbtt_uint8*) s2, len2);
}

// returns results in whatever encoding you request... but note that 2-byte encodings
// will be BIG-ENDIAN... use stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian() to compare
STBTT_DEF const char *stbtt_GetFontNameString(const stbtt_fontinfo *font, int *length, int platformID, int encodingID, int languageID, int nameID)
{
   stbtt_int32 i,count,stringOffset;
   stbtt_uint8 *fc = font->data;
   stbtt_uint32 offset = font->fontstart;
   stbtt_uint32 nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return NULL;

   count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);
   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      if (platformID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0) && encodingID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2)
          && languageID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4) && nameID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6)) {
         *length = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
         return (const char *) (fc+stringOffset+ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10));
      }
   }
   return NULL;
}

static int stbtt__matchpair(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 nm, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 nlen, stbtt_int32 target_id, stbtt_int32 next_id)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   stbtt_int32 count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stbtt_int32 stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);

   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      stbtt_int32 id = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6);
      if (id == target_id) {
         // find the encoding
         stbtt_int32 platform = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0), encoding = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2), language = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4);

         // is this a Unicode encoding?
         if (platform == 0 || (platform == 3 && encoding == 1) || (platform == 3 && encoding == 10)) {
            stbtt_int32 slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
            stbtt_int32 off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10);

            // check if there's a prefix match
            stbtt_int32 matchlen = stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(name, nlen, fc+stringOffset+off,slen);
            if (matchlen >= 0) {
               // check for target_id+1 immediately following, with same encoding & language
               if (i+1 < count && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+6) == next_id && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12) == platform && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+2) == encoding && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+4) == language) {
                  slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+8);
                  off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+10);
                  if (slen == 0) {
                     if (matchlen == nlen)
                        return 1;
                  } else if (matchlen < nlen && name[matchlen] == ' ') {
                     ++matchlen;
                     if (stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char*) (name+matchlen), nlen-matchlen, (char*)(fc+stringOffset+off),slen))
                        return 1;
                  }
               } else {
                  // if nothing immediately following
                  if (matchlen == nlen)
                     return 1;
               }
            }
         }

         // @TODO handle other encodings
      }
   }
   return 0;
}

static int stbtt__matches(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 offset, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 nlen = (stbtt_int32) STBTT_strlen((char *) name);
   stbtt_uint32 nm,hd;
   if (!stbtt__isfont(fc+offset)) return 0;

   // check italics/bold/underline flags in macStyle...
   if (flags) {
      hd = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "head");
      if ((ttUSHORT(fc+hd+44) & 7) != (flags & 7)) return 0;
   }

   nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return 0;

   if (flags) {
      // if we checked the macStyle flags, then just check the family and ignore the subfamily
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   } else {
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, 17))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1,  2))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   }

   return 0;
}

static int stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal(unsigned char *font_collection, char *name_utf8, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   for (i=0;;++i) {
      stbtt_int32 off = stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(font_collection, i);
      if (off < 0) return off;
      if (stbtt__matches((stbtt_uint8 *) font_collection, off, (stbtt_uint8*) name_utf8, flags))
         return off;
   }
}

#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
#endif

                                float pixel_height, unsigned char *pixels, int pw, int ph,
                                int first_char, int num_chars, stbtt_bakedchar *chardata)

   return stbtt_BakeFontBitmap_internal((unsigned char *) data, offset, pixel_height, pixels, pw, ph, first_char, num_chars, chardata);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(const unsigned char *data, int index)
{
   return stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex_internal((unsigned char *) data, index);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts(const unsigned char *data)

   return stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts_internal((unsigned char *) data);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_InitFont(stbtt_fontinfo *info, const unsigned char *data, int offset)

   return stbtt_InitFont_internal(info, (unsigned char *) data, offset);
}

   return stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal((unsigned char *) fontdata, (char *) name, flags);
}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian(const char *s1, int len1, const char *s2, int len2)
{
   return stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char *) s1, len1, (char *) s2, len2);
}
```

`runtime/ui/ui_audio.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// "Audio" tab of the F1 menu: Master (continuous) and Music / Sound effects / Voice (the game's own 0-10 levels, 10% steps).
// Volumes live in the audio layer (docs/audio.md, "Volume API for UI"); it applies them live and persists audio.json itself.
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>

#include "audio/audio_out.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"

namespace snap::ui {

namespace {

struct Row {
  const char* label;
  const char* hint;
  int cat;
  bool stepped;
};
const Row kRows[] = {
    {"Master", "Overall loudness, any value from 0 to 100%.", SNAP_VOL_MASTER, false},
    {"Music", "Background music, in the game's own 10% steps.", SNAP_VOL_BGM, true},
    {"Sound effects", "Footsteps, camera, Pokemon sounds other than voices, in 10% steps.", SNAP_VOL_SE, true},
    {"Voice", "Spoken lines, in 10% steps.", SNAP_VOL_VOICE, true},
};

double now_secs() { return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count(); }

double g_last_set[SNAP_VOL_COUNT] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
float g_drag[SNAP_VOL_COUNT] = {-1, -1, -1, -1};   // value shown while the slider is held

}  // namespace

void tab_audio() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Volume changes apply at once and are saved in audio.json next to your controls file.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  for (const Row& r : kRows) {
    ImGui::PushID(r.cat);
    float cur = std::clamp(snap_audio_get_volume(r.cat), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    float shown = g_drag[r.cat] >= 0 ? g_drag[r.cat] : cur;
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(r.label);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(std::min(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.6f, ImGui::GetFontSize() * 30.0f));
    bool changed = false;
    float next = shown;
    if (r.stepped) {
      int lv = (int)std::lround(shown * 10.0f);
      char fmt[24];
      std::snprintf(fmt, sizeof fmt, "%d%%", lv * 10);
      if (ImGui::SliderInt("##v", &lv, 0, 10, "%d / 10")) { changed = true; next = lv / 10.0f; }
    } else {
      int pct = (int)std::lround(shown * 100.0f);
      if (ImGui::SliderInt("##v", &pct, 0, 100, "%d%%")) { changed = true; next = pct / 100.0f; }
    }
    const bool active = ImGui::IsItemActive();
    const bool released = ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit();
    if (changed) {
      g_drag[r.cat] = next;
      const double n = now_secs();
      if (n - g_last_set[r.cat] > 0.2) { snap_audio_set_volume(r.cat, next); g_last_set[r.cat] = n; }   // persisting writes a file: a few times per second at most
    }
    if (released) { snap_audio_set_volume(r.cat, g_drag[r.cat] >= 0 ? g_drag[r.cat] : next); g_drag[r.cat] = -1; }
    else if (!active && !changed) g_drag[r.cat] = -1;
    if (r.stepped) { ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%d%%", (int)std::lround(shown * 100.0f)); }
    ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%s", r.hint);
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::PopID();
  }
  if (ImGui::Button("Reset to original mix")) {
    for (const Row& r : kRows) { snap_audio_set_volume(r.cat, 1.0f); g_drag[r.cat] = -1; }
  }
  ImGui::SameLine();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "All four back to 100%, the way the game ships.");
  audio_output_section();
}

}  // namespace snap::ui
```

`runtime/ui/ui_controls.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The controls menu: bindings per device (keyboard, mouse, controller), mouse and controller options, accessibility, live npad readout.
// Edits go to the input hub at once (live) and are saved to input.json a moment later (atomic write). Colors and sizes come from
// ui_theme.h only.
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

#include "hle/hle.h"
#include "hle/input_core.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"
#include "ui_theme.h"

namespace snap::ui {

using namespace hle::input;

namespace {

double now_s() {
  using namespace std::chrono;
  return duration<double>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

struct Rebind {
  bool active = false;
  int action = 0;
  Device dev = kDevKeyboard;
  int slot = 0;
};

struct MenuState {
  Mapping edit;
  bool dirty = false;
  double dirty_t = 0;
  Rebind rb;
  const char* want_tab = nullptr;
  int cur_tab = 0;               // index into kTabs of the page drawn this frame
  int reset_dev = -1;            // device whose reset is awaiting confirmation
  std::string note;              // short feedback line ("Bound A to P", "Saved")
  double note_until = 0;
  uint64_t dismissed_serial = 0;
  float ui_scale_edit = 1.0f;
  double saved_flash_until = 0;
} S;

// scale a design size (pixels at font 18) with the current font size
float px(float v) { return v * ImGui::GetFontSize() / theme().font_px; }

void say(const std::string& s, double secs = 4.0) {
  S.note = s;
  S.note_until = now_s() + secs;
}

void apply() {
  hub().set_mapping(S.edit);
  S.dirty = true;
  S.dirty_t = now_s();
}

ImU32 col(const ImVec4& c) { return ImGui::GetColorU32(c); }

// ---- rebinding -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void finish_rebind() {
  S.rb.active = false;
  hub().capture_cancel();
}

void begin_rebind(int action, Device dev, int slot) {
  S.rb = Rebind{true, action, dev, slot};
  hub().capture_begin(1u << (int)dev);
}

void resolve_rebind(bool* esc_used) {
  if (!S.rb.active) return;
  Source s;
  bool cancel = false, clear = false, got = false;
  if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)) cancel = true;
  else if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Delete, false)) clear = true;
  else if (hub().capture_result(&s)) {
    got = true;
    if (s.kind == Source::KeyboardKey && s.id == key_from_name("Escape")) { cancel = true; got = false; }
    else if (s.kind == Source::KeyboardKey && s.id == key_from_name("Delete")) { clear = true; got = false; }
  } else if (hub().capture_timed_out()) {
    finish_rebind();
    say("Rebinding timed out. Nothing changed.");
    return;
  }
  if (!cancel && !clear && !got) return;
  *esc_used = true;
  auto& v = action_sources(S.edit, S.rb.action);
  if (got) {
    slot_set(v, S.rb.dev, S.rb.slot, s);
    apply();
    say(std::string(action_label(S.rb.action)) + " (" + device_name(S.rb.dev) + ") = " + source_label(s));
  } else if (clear) {
    slot_clear(v, S.rb.dev, S.rb.slot);
    apply();
    say(std::string(action_label(S.rb.action)) + " (" + device_name(S.rb.dev) + ") cleared");
  } else {
    say("Rebinding cancelled.");
  }
  finish_rebind();
}

void slot_button(int action, Device dev, int slot) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  auto& v = action_sources(S.edit, action);
  Source s = slot_get(v, dev, slot);
  const bool listening = S.rb.active && S.rb.action == action && S.rb.dev == dev && S.rb.slot == slot;
  std::vector<int> users;
  if (s.kind != Source::None) users = actions_using(S.edit, s);
  const bool conflict = users.size() > 1;
  std::string label = listening ? "Press a key..." : s.kind == Source::None ? "-" : source_label(s);
  if (dev == kDevMouse && listening) label = "Press a button...";
  if (dev == kDevController && listening) label = "Press a button...";
  if (conflict && !listening) label = "! " + label;   // a cue besides the color
  int pushed = 0;
  if (listening) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, t.slot_listening); ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 1)); pushed = 2; }
  else if (conflict) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, t.conflict); ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 1)); pushed = 2; }
  else if (s.kind == Source::None) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, t.text_dim); pushed = 1; }
  ImGui::PushID(action * 16 + (int)dev * 4 + slot);
  if (ImGui::Button(label.c_str(), ImVec2(px(t.slot_w), 0))) {
    if (listening) { finish_rebind(); say("Rebinding cancelled."); }
    else begin_rebind(action, dev, slot);
  }
  const bool hovered = ImGui::IsItemHovered();
  if (s.kind != Source::None && !listening &&
      ((hovered && ImGui::IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Right)) || (ImGui::IsItemFocused() && (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Delete, false) || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceUp, false))))) {
    slot_clear(v, dev, slot);
    apply();
    say(std::string(action_label(action)) + " (" + device_name(dev) + ") cleared");
  }
  if (hovered && ImGui::BeginTooltip()) {
    if (conflict) {
      std::string others;
      for (int a : users) if (a != action) others += std::string(others.empty() ? "" : ", ") + action_label(a);
      ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "Also bound to: %s", others.c_str());
      ImGui::TextDisabled("Allowed: both actions fire together.");
    }
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Click, then press the key, button or axis.\nEsc cancels. Delete or right-click clears.");
    ImGui::EndTooltip();
  }
  ImGui::PopID();
  if (pushed) ImGui::PopStyleColor(pushed);
}

// ---- small widgets ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void desc(const char* text) {
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme().text_dim);
  ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
  ImGui::TextUnformatted(text);
  ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
}

bool checkbox(const char* label, bool* v, const char* d) {
  bool ch = ImGui::Checkbox(label, v);
  if (d) { ImGui::Indent(px(30)); desc(d); ImGui::Unindent(px(30)); }
  ImGui::Spacing();
  return ch;
}

bool slider(const char* label, const char* id, float* v, float lo, float hi, const char* fmt, const char* d) {
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextUnformatted(label);
  ImGui::SameLine(px(250));
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(px(340));
  bool ch = ImGui::SliderFloat(id, v, lo, hi, fmt, ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
  if (d) { ImGui::Indent(px(30)); desc(d); ImGui::Unindent(px(30)); }
  ImGui::Spacing();
  return ch;
}

void stick_plot(const char* id, float x, float y, float dz, float outer) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  float sz = px(t.stick_plot);
  ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(sz, sz));
  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  ImVec2 c(p.x + sz * 0.5f, p.y + sz * 0.5f);
  float r = sz * 0.5f - 2;
  dl->AddCircleFilled(c, r, col(t.slot), 48);
  if (dz > 0) dl->AddCircle(c, r * dz, col(t.border), 32);
  if (outer < 0.995f) dl->AddCircle(c, r * outer, col(t.border), 32);
  dl->AddCircle(c, r, col(t.border), 48);
  dl->AddLine(ImVec2(c.x - r, c.y), ImVec2(c.x + r, c.y), col(t.border));
  dl->AddLine(ImVec2(c.x, c.y - r), ImVec2(c.x, c.y + r), col(t.border));
  float dx = std::clamp(x, -1.0f, 1.0f) * r, dy = -std::clamp(y, -1.0f, 1.0f) * r;
  dl->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(c.x + dx, c.y + dy), px(7), col(std::fabs(x) + std::fabs(y) > 0.01f ? t.accent_hover : t.text_dim), 16);
  (void)id;
}

void confirm_reset() {
  if (S.reset_dev >= 0) ImGui::OpenPopup("Reset to defaults?");
  ImVec2 c = ImGui::GetMainViewport()->GetCenter();
  ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(c, ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
  if (ImGui::BeginPopupModal("Reset to defaults?", nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove)) {
    Device d = (Device)std::clamp(S.reset_dev, 0, (int)kDevCount - 1);
    ImGui::Text("Reset all %s bindings and options to the defaults?", device_name(d));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Other devices keep their settings.");
    ImGui::Spacing();
    if (ImGui::Button("Reset", ImVec2(px(140), 0))) {
      reset_device(S.edit, d);
      apply();
      say(std::string(device_name(d)) + " reset to defaults");
      S.reset_dev = -1;
      ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Cancel", ImVec2(px(140), 0))) { S.reset_dev = -1; ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup(); }
    ImGui::SetItemDefaultFocus();
    ImGui::EndPopup();
  } else if (!ImGui::IsPopupOpen("Reset to defaults?")) {
    S.reset_dev = -1;
  }
}

void reset_button(Device d) {
  std::string l = std::string("Reset ") + device_name(d) + " to defaults";
  if (ImGui::Button(l.c_str())) S.reset_dev = (int)d;
}

// ---- tabs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const char* const kTabs[] = {"Bindings", "Mouse", "Controller", "Accessibility", "Audio", "Graphics", "Display", "Photos", "Mods", "Saves", "Test input"};
constexpr int kTabCount = (int)(sizeof kTabs / sizeof kTabs[0]);

bool begin_tab(const char* name) {
  ImGuiTabItemFlags fl = 0;
  if (S.want_tab && std::string(S.want_tab) == name) { fl = ImGuiTabItemFlags_SetSelected; S.want_tab = nullptr; }
  const bool open = ImGui::BeginTabItem(name, nullptr, fl);
  if (open) for (int i = 0; i < kTabCount; ++i) if (std::string(kTabs[i]) == name) S.cur_tab = i;
  return open;
}

void tab_bindings(float footer_h) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  desc("Click a slot, then press a key, mouse button, wheel notch, controller button or stick direction. Two slots per device for each Switch input. "
       "Esc cancels, Delete or right-click clears. A '!' marks a source used by more than one input (allowed).");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  reset_button(kDevKeyboard); ImGui::SameLine();
  reset_button(kDevMouse); ImGui::SameLine();
  reset_button(kDevController);
  ImGui::Spacing();
  const ImGuiTableFlags tf = ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY | ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg | ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerV | ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedFit | ImGuiTableFlags_NoSavedSettings;
  float h = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - footer_h;
  if (ImGui::BeginTable("bindings", 7, tf, ImVec2(0, std::max(h, px(120))))) {
    ImGui::TableSetupScrollFreeze(1, 1);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Switch input", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed, px(t.label_w));
    const char* heads[6] = {"Keyboard 1", "Keyboard 2", "Mouse 1", "Mouse 2", "Controller 1", "Controller 2"};
    for (const char* hname : heads) ImGui::TableSetupColumn(hname, ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed, px(t.slot_w) + px(8));
    ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
    struct Group { const char* title; int first, count; };
    static const int buttons[] = {kA, kB, kX, kY, kL, kR, kZL, kZR, kPlus, kMinus, kUp, kDown, kLeft, kRight, kStickL, kStickR};
    int conflicts = 0;
    for (int a = 0; a < kActionCount; ++a)
      for (int d = 0; d < kDevCount; ++d)
        for (int sl = 0; sl < kMaxSlotsPerDevice; ++sl) {
          Source s = slot_get(action_sources(S.edit, a), (Device)d, sl);
          if (s.kind != Source::None && actions_using(S.edit, s).size() > 1) ++conflicts;
        }
    auto section = [&](const char* title) {
      ImGui::TableNextRow();
      ImGui::TableSetColumnIndex(0);
      ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "%s", title);
    };
    auto row = [&](int action) {
      ImGui::TableNextRow();
      ImGui::TableSetColumnIndex(0);
      ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
      ImGui::TextUnformatted(action_label(action));
      int ci = 1;
      for (int d = 0; d < kDevCount; ++d)
        for (int sl = 0; sl < kMaxSlotsPerDevice; ++sl) {
          ImGui::TableSetColumnIndex(ci++);
          slot_button(action, (Device)d, sl);
        }
    };
    section("Buttons");
    for (int b : buttons) row(b);
    section("Left stick (movement)");
    for (int a = 16; a < 20; ++a) row(a);
    section("Right stick (camera aim)");
    for (int a = 20; a < 24; ++a) row(a);
    ImGui::EndTable();
    if (conflicts) ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "! %d slot%s share a source with another input.", conflicts, conflicts == 1 ? "" : "s");
    else ImGui::TextDisabled("No conflicts.");
  }
}

void tab_mouse() {
  Mapping& m = S.edit;
  desc("Mouse buttons and the wheel are bound on the Bindings tab. The left button is also the touch screen.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  reset_button(kDevMouse);
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  bool ch = false;
  ch |= checkbox("Mouse look (mouse moves the camera)", &m.mouse_look,
                 "Mouse movement drives the right stick, the camera aim. Off by default. While on, the cursor is hidden and held at the window center, and the left button no longer acts as the touch screen.");
  ImGui::BeginDisabled(!m.mouse_look);
  ch |= slider("Sensitivity", "##sens", &m.mouse_sensitivity, 0.1f, 5.0f, "%.2f",
               "How far the stick moves for a given mouse speed. 1.00 reaches full deflection at about 1500 pixels per second.");
  ch |= checkbox("Invert horizontal", &m.mouse_invert_x, "Moving the mouse right turns the camera left.");
  ch |= checkbox("Invert vertical", &m.mouse_invert_y, "Moving the mouse up aims down, like a flight stick.");
  ch |= slider("Smoothing", "##smooth", &m.mouse_smoothing, 0.0f, 1.0f, m.mouse_smoothing <= 0.001f ? "Off" : "%.2f",
               "Averages the movement over a longer window. Off is the most direct; higher values trade a little lag for steadier aim.");
  ImGui::EndDisabled();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ch |= checkbox("Left mouse button is the touch screen", &m.mouse_touch,
                 "Clicking in the window taps the Switch touch screen (used by some menus). Ignored while mouse look is on.");
  ch |= checkbox("Lock the cursor to the window while playing", &m.lock_cursor,
                 "Keeps the cursor inside the game window during play. It is released while this menu is open and whenever the window loses focus.");
  if (ch) apply();
}

void tab_controller() {
  Mapping& m = S.edit;
  desc("Controller buttons are bound on the Bindings tab. Any controller SDL3 or XInput knows works; all of them act as one Switch Pro Controller.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  reset_button(kDevController);
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  bool ch = false;
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextUnformatted("Face button layout");
  int layout = m.face_layout;
  ImGui::SameLine(px(250));
  if (ImGui::RadioButton("By position (Xbox B = Switch A)", layout == 0)) layout = 0;
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (ImGui::RadioButton("Nintendo labels (Xbox A = Switch A)", layout == 1)) layout = 1;
  if (layout != m.face_layout) { set_face_layout(m, layout); ch = true; }
  ImGui::Indent(px(30));
  desc("By position puts Switch A on the right-hand face button like a Switch. Nintendo labels match letters instead. Switching swaps the south/east and west/north bindings in place.");
  ImGui::Unindent(px(30));
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ch |= checkbox("Swap sticks", &m.swap_sticks, "The physical left stick drives the Switch right stick (camera) and the physical right stick drives the left stick (movement).");
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  struct S2 { const char* name; StickMap* sm; const char* id; };
  S2 sticks[2] = {{"Left stick (movement)", &m.left, "L"}, {"Right stick (camera)", &m.right, "R"}};
  RawInput raw = hub().raw();
  for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
    StickMap& sm = *sticks[i].sm;
    ImGui::PushID(sticks[i].id);
    ImGui::TextColored(theme().title, "%s", sticks[i].name);
    ImGui::BeginGroup();
    ch |= slider("Dead zone (inner)", "##dz", &sm.deadzone, 0.0f, 0.6f, "%.2f", "Ignores small movements near the center, which stops drift.");
    ch |= slider("Outer dead zone", "##oz", &sm.outer_deadzone, 0.5f, 1.0f, "%.2f", "Reaches full deflection before the stick hits its edge. Lower it if your stick cannot reach 100%.");
    sm.outer_deadzone = std::max(sm.outer_deadzone, sm.deadzone + 0.05f);
    ch |= checkbox("Invert Y", &sm.invert_y, "Pushing the stick up acts as down.");
    ImGui::EndGroup();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    float rx = (sm.analog == "right") ? raw.rx : raw.lx, ry = (sm.analog == "right") ? raw.ry : raw.ly;
    if (m.swap_sticks && sm.analog != "none") { rx = sm.analog == "right" ? raw.lx : raw.rx; ry = sm.analog == "right" ? raw.ly : raw.ry; }
    if (sm.analog == "none") rx = ry = 0;
    ImGui::BeginGroup();
    stick_plot("plot", rx, ry, sm.deadzone, sm.outer_deadzone);
    ImGui::TextDisabled("live input");
    ImGui::EndGroup();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::Separator();
    ImGui::Spacing();
  }
  ch |= slider("ZL trigger threshold", "##zl", &m.zl_threshold, 0.05f, 1.0f, "%.2f", "How far the left analog trigger must be pulled to count as pressed.");
  ch |= slider("ZR trigger threshold", "##zr", &m.zr_threshold, 0.05f, 1.0f, "%.2f", "The same for the right trigger.");
  ImGui::TextDisabled("Live triggers: ZL %.2f   ZR %.2f   (%s)", raw.lt, raw.rt, raw.pad_connected ? "controller connected" : "no controller detected");
  if (ch) apply();
  extras_controller();
}

void tab_access() {
  Mapping& m = S.edit;
  desc("Options that change how the controls and this menu behave. They apply at once.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  bool ch = false;
  ch |= checkbox("ZL: toggle instead of hold", &m.toggle_zl, "One press holds ZL down until the next press, for players who cannot keep a trigger held. Applies to every ZL binding.");
  ch |= checkbox("ZR: toggle instead of hold", &m.toggle_zr, "The same for ZR, the camera shutter in the game.");
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextUnformatted("Menu size (UI scale)");
  ImGui::SameLine(px(250));
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(px(340));
  ImGui::SliderFloat("##uiscale", &S.ui_scale_edit, 0.75f, 2.5f, "%.2fx", ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
  if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) { m.ui_scale = S.ui_scale_edit; ch = true; }
  ImGui::Indent(px(30));
  desc("Scales text and buttons in this menu. The change applies when you release the slider. The menu also grows with the window on larger screens.");
  ImGui::Unindent(px(30));
  if (ch) apply();
}

void tab_test() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  desc("What the game would read from npad 0 right now, after your bindings. The game itself sees no input while this menu is open.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  PadSample p = hub().preview();
  RawInput raw = hub().raw();
  ImGui::Text("Controller: %s    Keyboard focus: %s", raw.pad_connected ? "connected" : "none detected", raw.focused ? "yes" : "no");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Buttons");
  static const int order[] = {kA, kB, kX, kY, kL, kR, kZL, kZR, kPlus, kMinus, kUp, kDown, kLeft, kRight, kStickL, kStickR};
  int n = 0;
  for (int b : order) {
    bool on = (p.buttons >> b) & 1;
    std::string label = std::string(on ? "(*) " : "( ) ") + button_name(b);
    ImVec2 sz(px(110), 0);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, on ? t.accent : t.slot);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, on ? t.accent : t.slot);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, on ? t.accent : t.slot);
    ImGui::PushID(b);
    ImGui::Button(label.c_str(), sz);
    ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(3);
    if (++n % 8) ImGui::SameLine();
  }
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Sticks");
  ImGui::BeginGroup();
  stick_plot("l", p.lx / 32767.0f, p.ly / 32767.0f, 0, 1);
  ImGui::Text("L  %6d %6d", p.lx, p.ly);
  ImGui::EndGroup();
  ImGui::SameLine(0, px(40));
  ImGui::BeginGroup();
  stick_plot("r", p.rx / 32767.0f, p.ry / 32767.0f, 0, 1);
  ImGui::Text("R  %6d %6d", p.rx, p.ry);
  ImGui::EndGroup();
  ImGui::SameLine(0, px(40));
  ImGui::BeginGroup();
  ImGui::Text("Raw triggers");
  ImGui::ProgressBar(raw.lt, ImVec2(px(180), 0), "LT");
  ImGui::ProgressBar(raw.rt, ImVec2(px(180), 0), "RT");
  ImGui::Text("Raw mouse speed: %.0f, %.0f px/s", raw.mouse_vx, raw.mouse_vy);
  ImGui::EndGroup();
  ImGui::TextDisabled("Raw buttons held: %d    keys held: %d    mouse buttons: %d", (int)raw.pad.count(), (int)raw.keys.count(), (int)__builtin_popcount(raw.mouse_buttons));
}

}  // namespace

// ---- public ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void menu_opened() {
  options_menu_opened();
  S.edit = hub().mapping();
  S.ui_scale_edit = S.edit.ui_scale;
  S.rb.active = false;
  S.reset_dev = -1;
  S.note.clear();
}

void menu_closed() {
  finish_rebind();
  if (S.dirty) { hub().save(); S.dirty = false; }
}

void menu_tick_save() {
  if (S.dirty && now_s() - S.dirty_t > 0.5) {
    S.dirty = false;
    std::string err;
    if (hub().save(&err)) S.saved_flash_until = now_s() + 2.0;
  }
}

void menu_select_tab(const char* name) { S.want_tab = name; }
bool menu_rebinding() { return S.rb.active; }
bool menu_begin_rebind(int action, Device dev, int slot) {
  if (action < 0 || action >= kActionCount) return false;
  begin_rebind(action, dev, slot);
  return true;
}

void draw_menu(ImVec2 size, bool* want_close) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  bool esc_used = false;
  const bool was_rebinding = S.rb.active;
  resolve_rebind(&esc_used);
  if (!S.rb.active && !was_rebinding && !esc_used && !ImGui::IsPopupOpen(nullptr, ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId) && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, false)) *want_close = true;

  // controller: LB/RB switch pages, B closes (the same as Escape)
  if (!S.rb.active && !ImGui::IsPopupOpen(nullptr, ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId) && !ImGui::IsAnyItemActive()) {
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadL1, false)) S.want_tab = kTabs[(S.cur_tab + kTabCount - 1) % kTabCount];
    if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadR1, false)) S.want_tab = kTabs[(S.cur_tab + 1) % kTabCount];
    if (!esc_used && !was_rebinding && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, false)) *want_close = true;
  }

  ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList()->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), size, col(t.backdrop));
  const float scale = ImGui::GetFontSize() / t.font_px;
  const float w = std::min(size.x * t.panel_width, t.panel_max_w * scale);
  const float h = std::min(size.y * t.panel_height, 1100.0f * scale);
  style_shadow(ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList(), ImVec2((size.x - w) * 0.5f, (size.y - h) * 0.5f), ImVec2(w, h), t.window_round * scale);
  ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(size.x * 0.5f, size.y * 0.5f), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));
  ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, h), ImGuiCond_Always);
  const ImGuiWindowFlags wf = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse |
                              ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse;
  if (!ImGui::Begin("Controls##snapmenu", nullptr, wf)) { ImGui::End(); return; }

  // header
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Settings");
  ImGui::SameLine();
  ImGui::TextDisabled("   game input is paused while this menu is open");
  const char* closeLabel = "Close  (F1)";
  ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - ImGui::CalcTextSize(closeLabel).x - ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.x * 2 - ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.x);
  if (ImGui::Button(closeLabel)) *want_close = true;

  // notice from loading or saving the controls file
  const uint64_t serial = hub().message_serial();
  const std::string msg = hub().message();
  if (!msg.empty() && serial != S.dismissed_serial) {
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, t.toast_bg);
    float mh = ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing() * 2.6f;
    if (ImGui::BeginChild("notice", ImVec2(0, mh), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders)) {
      ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - px(110));
      ImGui::TextColored(msg.find("invalid") != std::string::npos || msg.find("Could not") != std::string::npos ? t.error : t.good, "%s", msg.c_str());
      ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
      ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - px(110));
      if (ImGui::Button("Dismiss")) S.dismissed_serial = serial;
    }
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
  }

  options_restart_bar();   // "N changes need a restart" with the Apply and restart button

  const float footer_h = ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing() * 3.4f;
  if (ImGui::BeginTabBar("tabs", ImGuiTabBarFlags_None)) {
    if (begin_tab("Bindings")) { tab_bindings(footer_h); ImGui::EndTabItem(); }
    if (begin_tab("Mouse")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_mouse();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Controller")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_controller();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Accessibility")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_access();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Audio")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_audio();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Graphics")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_graphics();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Display")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_display();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Photos")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_photos();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Mods")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_mods();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Saves")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_saves();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    if (begin_tab("Test input")) {
      if (ImGui::BeginChild("p", ImVec2(0, -footer_h))) tab_test();
      ImGui::EndChild();
      ImGui::EndTabItem();
    }
    ImGui::EndTabBar();
  }
  if (S.want_tab) S.want_tab = nullptr;

  confirm_reset();

  // footer: feedback line and file
  ImGui::Separator();
  const double now = now_s();
  if (now < S.note_until) ImGui::TextColored(t.good, "%s", S.note.c_str());
  else if (S.dirty) ImGui::TextDisabled("Saving...");
  else if (now < S.saved_flash_until) ImGui::TextColored(t.good, "Saved");
  else ImGui::TextDisabled("Saved automatically.");
  ImGui::SameLine();
  std::string path = hub().config_path();
  std::string right = "F1 or hold Back+Start (0.5 s) closes the menu     " + path;
  float tw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(right.c_str()).x;
  ImGui::SameLine(std::max(ImGui::GetCursorPosX(), ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - tw - ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.x));
  ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", right.c_str());
  style_footer_prompts(true, true);
  ImGui::End();
}

bool draw_toast(ImVec2 size, double now) {
  (void)now;
  const std::string msg = hub().message();
  if (msg.empty()) return false;
  const Theme& t = theme();
  const float scale = ImGui::GetFontSize() / t.font_px;
  const float w = std::min(size.x * 0.9f, t.toast_w * scale * 1.6f);
  ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(size.x * 0.5f, size.y - 24.0f * scale), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2(0.5f, 1.0f));
  ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0));
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, t.toast_bg);
  const ImGuiWindowFlags wf = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs |
                              ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNav;
  if (ImGui::Begin("##snaptoast", nullptr, wf)) {
    bool bad = msg.find("invalid") != std::string::npos || msg.find("Could not") != std::string::npos;
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
    ImGui::TextColored(bad ? t.error : t.good, "Controls: %s", msg.c_str());
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Press F1 to open the controls menu.");
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
  }
  ImGui::End();
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
  return true;
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// F1 menu extras backed by the per-profile settings file (hle/settings.h): gyro aim and rumble (Controller tab, live) and the photo gallery
// (inside the Photos page; opens the local gallery server in the browser). Graphics options moved to ui_options.cpp.
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "hle/input_core.h"
#include "hle/profiles.h"
#include "hle/settings.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

namespace snap::ui {

namespace {

namespace st = hle::settings;

std::atomic<int> g_gallery_state{0};   // 0 idle, 1 starting, 2 opened, 3 failed
std::atomic<unsigned> g_gallery_port{0};   // port the server we started reported (8777, or whatever the OS picked)

bool port_open(unsigned short port) {
  WSADATA wd;
  if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wd) != 0) return false;
  SOCKET s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
  bool ok = false;
  if (s != INVALID_SOCKET) {
    sockaddr_in a{};
    a.sin_family = AF_INET;
    a.sin_port = htons(port);
    inet_pton(AF_INET, "127.0.0.1", &a.sin_addr);
    ok = connect(s, (sockaddr*)&a, sizeof a) == 0;
    closesocket(s);
  }
  WSACleanup();
  return ok;
}

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
  int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
  std::wstring w((size_t)std::max(n, 1), L'\0');
  MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.c_str(), -1, &w[0], n);
  w.resize(w.size() - 1);
  return w;
}

// Project root: the folder holding tools-src\gallery (the game runs from the project root; the exe sits in build\play or build\snap).
std::filesystem::path find_project_root() {
  namespace fs = std::filesystem;
  std::error_code ec;
  std::vector<fs::path> starts = {fs::current_path(ec)};
  wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH * 2];
  if (GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH * 2)) starts.push_back(fs::path(exe).parent_path());
  if (const char* r = std::getenv("SNAP_PLAY_ROOT")) starts.insert(starts.begin(), fs::u8path(r));
  for (fs::path p : starts) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 5 && !p.empty(); ++i, p = p.parent_path())
      if (fs::exists(p / "tools-src" / "gallery" / "serve.py", ec)) return p;
  }
  return {};
}

std::string gallery_profile_id() {
  const hle::profiles::Active& a = hle::profiles::active();
  return a.on && !a.id.empty() ? a.id : "default";
}

// Starts tools-src\gallery\serve.py (extracts the photos, serves http://127.0.0.1:<port>/) unless the server this game started earlier still answers, then opens
// the browser at the port the server reports through --port-file (it tries 8777, then lets the OS pick; 8765 belongs to other software on some PCs).
void open_gallery_async() {
  if (g_gallery_state.exchange(1) == 1) return;
  std::string prof = gallery_profile_id();
  std::thread([prof] {
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    unsigned port = g_gallery_port.load();
    bool ok = port && port_open((unsigned short)port);
    if (!ok) {
      port = 0;
      fs::path root = find_project_root();
      if (root.empty()) { g_gallery_state = 3; return; }
      fs::path py = root / "tools" / "venv-recomp" / "Scripts" / "python.exe";
      std::error_code ec;
      std::wstring exe = fs::exists(py, ec) ? py.wstring() : L"python.exe";
      fs::path pf = fs::temp_directory_path(ec) / ("snap_gallery_port_" + std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId()) + ".txt");
      fs::remove(pf, ec);
      std::wstring cmd = L"\"" + exe + L"\" -E -P \"" + (root / "tools-src" / "gallery" / "serve.py").wstring() + L"\" --no-open --profile \"" + widen(prof) +
                         L"\" --port 8777 --port-file \"" + pf.wstring() + L"\"";
      STARTUPINFOW si{};
      si.cb = sizeof si;
      PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
      if (!CreateProcessW(nullptr, &cmd[0], nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW | BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS, nullptr, root.wstring().c_str(), &si, &pi)) {
        g_gallery_state = 3;
        return;
      }
      CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
      CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);   // the server outlives the game; it only listens on 127.0.0.1
      for (int i = 0; i < 240 && !ok; ++i) {   // extraction runs first, then the port file appears
        Sleep(500);
        std::ifstream f(pf);
        unsigned p = 0;
        if (f >> p && p > 0 && p < 65536 && port_open((unsigned short)p)) { port = p; ok = true; }
      }
      fs::remove(pf, ec);
    }
    if (ok) {
      g_gallery_port = port;
      std::wstring url = L"http://127.0.0.1:" + std::to_wstring(port) + L"/";
      ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", url.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
      g_gallery_state = 2;
    } else {
      g_gallery_state = 3;
    }
  }).detach();
}

}  // namespace

void extras_controller() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Gyro aim");
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Tilting a controller with a gyroscope (DualSense, Switch Pro, Joy-Con) moves the camera, added to the right stick. Off by default.");
  bool on = st::get_bool("gyro_on", false);
  if (ImGui::Checkbox("Gyro aim", &on)) st::set_bool("gyro_on", on);
  ImGui::BeginDisabled(!on);
  float sens = st::get_float("gyro_sens", 1.0f);
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 18.0f);
  if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Gyro sensitivity", &sens, 0.1f, 4.0f, "%.2f")) st::set_float("gyro_sens", sens);
  bool ix = st::get_bool("gyro_invert_x", false), iy = st::get_bool("gyro_invert_y", false);
  if (ImGui::Checkbox("Invert gyro X", &ix)) st::set_bool("gyro_invert_x", ix);
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (ImGui::Checkbox("Invert gyro Y", &iy)) st::set_bool("gyro_invert_y", iy);
  ImGui::EndDisabled();
  hle::input::RawInput r = hle::input::hub().raw();
  if (r.gyro_present) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Gyro: %.0f, %.0f deg/s", r.gyro_x, r.gyro_y);
  else ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Gyro: none reported (turn gyro aim on with a controller that has one)");
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Applies at once.");

  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Rumble");
  bool ron = st::get_bool("rumble_on", true);
  if (ImGui::Checkbox("Controller rumble", &ron)) st::set_bool("rumble_on", ron);
  ImGui::BeginDisabled(!ron);
  float rs = st::get_float("rumble_strength", 1.0f);
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 18.0f);
  if (ImGui::SliderFloat("Rumble strength", &rs, 0.0f, 1.5f, "%.2f")) st::set_float("rumble_strength", rs);
  ImGui::EndDisabled();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Rumble reaches DualSense, Xbox and Switch Pro pads. Applies at once.");
}

void gallery_section() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Photo gallery");
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Opens your saved photos for the running profile (\"%s\") in your web browser, from a small server on this PC (127.0.0.1). Nothing leaves the machine.",
                     hle::profiles::active().on ? hle::profiles::active().name.c_str() : "default");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  const int s = g_gallery_state.load();
  ImGui::BeginDisabled(s == 1);
  if (ImGui::Button("Open gallery in browser")) open_gallery_async();
  ImGui::EndDisabled();
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (s == 1) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Reading photos from the save...");
  else if (s == 2) ImGui::TextColored(t.good, "Opened. Use it again after taking new photos: it re-reads the save.");
  else if (s == 3) ImGui::TextColored(t.error, "Could not start the gallery server (needs tools-src\\gallery and Python).");
}
```

`runtime/ui/ui_font.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include "ui_font.h"

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>

#include "hle/hle_config.h"

namespace snap::ui {

namespace {

bool read_file(const std::string& p, std::vector<unsigned char>& d) {
  FILE* f = std::fopen(p.c_str(), "rb");
  if (!f) return false;
  std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
  long n = std::ftell(f);
  std::fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
  if (n < 16 || n > 64L * 1024 * 1024) { std::fclose(f); return false; }
  d.resize((size_t)n);
  bool ok = std::fread(d.data(), 1, d.size(), f) == d.size();
  std::fclose(f);
  return ok;
}

bool decode(std::vector<unsigned char>& d) {
  if (d.size() < 16) return false;
  uint32_t magic;
  std::memcpy(&magic, d.data(), 4);
  const uint32_t key = magic ^ 0x18029A7Fu;
  unsigned char k[4];
  std::memcpy(k, &key, 4);
  std::vector<unsigned char> o(d.size() - 8);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < o.size(); ++i) o[i] = d[8 + i] ^ k[i & 3];
  const bool ttf = o[0] == 0 && o[1] == 1 && o[2] == 0 && o[3] == 0;   // sfnt version 1.0
  if (ttf) d.swap(o);
  return ttf;
}

std::mutex g_mu;
bool g_tried = false, g_ok = false;
std::vector<unsigned char> g_data;

}  // namespace

bool game_font_ttf(std::vector<unsigned char>& out) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mu);
  if (!g_tried) {
    g_tried = true;
    const char* rel = "/drp-v262144/nx/Pack/Resident/master/Resident.drp/AsiaKNGD-E.bfttf";
    std::vector<std::string> cands;
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_GAME_FONT")) cands.push_back(e);
    std::string rf = hle::config().romfs_root;
    for (char& c : rf) if (c == '\\') c = '/';
    while (!rf.empty() && rf.back() == '/') rf.pop_back();
    const size_t sl = rf.find_last_of('/');
    cands.push_back((sl == std::string::npos ? std::string(".") : rf.substr(0, sl)) + rel);
    cands.push_back(std::string("extracted") + rel);
    for (const std::string& c : cands) {
      std::vector<unsigned char> d;
      if (read_file(c, d) && decode(d)) { g_data.swap(d); g_ok = true; break; }
    }
  }
  if (!g_ok) return false;
  out = g_data;
  return true;
}

const char* game_font_family() { return "AsiaKNGD-E"; }

}  // namespace snap::ui
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// F1 menu option pages: Graphics, Display, Photos and Mods, plus the output-mode row of the Audio tab. One table drives every option (label, plain-language
// help, default, whether it applies now or needs a restart). Values live in the per-profile settings file (hle/settings.h); hle/settings.cpp exports them as
// the documented SNAP_* env vars at start, so an env var set by hand still wins and the page says so. Live window options go through the window API (host/window_opts.h,
// remembered in window.json), the audio output mode through snap_audio_set_output (audio.json). "Apply and restart" uses restart_game().

// ---- quality presets. The preset is not stored: it is worked out from the eleven rows below, so changing any row by hand shows "Custom" and
// setting the rows to a preset's values shows that preset. "" in the table = the row's default (the key is erased, the game's own behavior).
// Normal is all defaults. Left out on purpose: draw distance and full-rate animation (photo scores unverified), the lighting preset and

    // readback copied a 240x200 guest region out of a 120x100 scaled image; transfers are render-scale aware since 2026-11-12 (nvn_xfer.cpp).
    // The upscaler rows stay out of the presets (they need a backend DLL and pick their own scene scale).
    {"verylow", "Very Low", {"0.50", "none", "", "0", "1", "512", "", "4", "", "off", "off"}},

    {"ultra", "Ultra", {"2.00", "smaa", "0.30", "16", "", "4096", "ultra", "", "", "", ""}},
    {"maximum", "Maximum", {"4.00", "smaa", "0.50", "16", "", "8192", "ultra", "512", "32,128", "", ""}},
};
bool preset_eq(int k, const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
  if (a == b) return true;
  if (k == 0 || k == 2) return std::fabs((float)std::atof(a.c_str()) - (float)std::atof(b.c_str())) < 1e-4f;
  return false;
}
std::string get_preset() {
  for (const PresetDef& p : kPresets) {
    bool all = true;
    for (int k = 0; k < kPresetKeyN && all; k++) {
      const std::string want = p.v[k][0] ? p.v[k] : kPresetKeys[k].def;
      all = preset_eq(k, st::get(kPresetKeys[k].key, kPresetKeys[k].def), want);
    }
    if (all) return p.id;
  }
  return "custom";
}
void set_preset(const std::string& v) {
  for (const PresetDef& p : kPresets) {
    if (v != p.id) continue;
    for (int k = 0; k < kPresetKeyN; k++) {
      if (p.v[k][0]) st::set(kPresetKeys[k].key, p.v[k]);
      else st::erase(kPresetKeys[k].key);
    }
    return;
  }
}
std::string get_audio_out() {
  const int m = snap_audio_get_output_mode();
  return m == SNAP_AUDIO_OUT_SPEAKERS ? "speakers" : m == SNAP_AUDIO_OUT_SPATIAL ? "spatial" : "stereo";
}
void set_audio_out(const std::string& v) {
  snap_audio_set_output(v == "speakers" ? SNAP_AUDIO_OUT_SPEAKERS : v == "spatial" ? SNAP_AUDIO_OUT_SPATIAL : SNAP_AUDIO_OUT_STEREO, -1, -1);
}
// The monitor list comes from EnumDisplayMonitors, which can be slow (and stalls the presenting thread) on some desktops: enumerate on a worker thread, at most
// every 10 s, and draw the last result.
Choices monitors() {
  static std::mutex mu;
  static Choices cached{{"-1", "Where the window is"}};
  static std::atomic<bool> busy{false};
  static double last = -100;
  const double now = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
  if (now - last > 10.0 && !busy.exchange(true)) {
    last = now;
    std::thread([] {
      const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      Choices c{{"-1", "Where the window is"}};
      for (int i = 0, n = snap_window_monitor_count(); i < n; ++i) {
        const char* nm = snap_window_monitor_name(i);
        c.push_back({std::to_string(i), std::string("Monitor ") + std::to_string(i + 1) + (nm ? std::string("  ") + nm : "")});
      }
      { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(mu); cached = c; }
      hle::log("ui: monitor list: %zu monitors in %lld ms", c.size() - 1, (long long)std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count());
      busy = false;
    }).detach();
  }
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(mu);
  return cached;
}

// ---- value access
std::string cur_of(const Opt& o) { return o.get ? o.get() : st::get(o.key, o.def); }

bool same_value(const Opt& o, const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
  if (a == b) return true;
  if (o.kind == kSlider) return std::fabs((float)std::atof(a.c_str()) - (float)std::atof(b.c_str())) < 1e-4f;
  return false;
}

void set_of(const Opt& o, const std::string& v) {
  if (o.set) { o.set(v); return; }
  if (same_value(o, v, o.def)) st::erase(o.key);   // the default is "not set": the env var is left alone and the game keeps its own behavior
  else st::set(o.key, v);
}

std::string fmt_float(float f) { char b[32]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%.2f", f); return b; }

bool env_set_by_hand(const Opt& o) {
  if (o.set && o.when == kLive) return false;   // changed through the API at once; the env var only matters at the next start
  if (st::env_name(o.key)) return st::env_wins(o.key);
  if (o.env) { const char* e = std::getenv(o.env); return e && *e; }
  return false;
}

// ---- restart tracking: the saved value of every restart option when the game started, compared with now
std::map<std::string, std::string> g_start;
std::string g_mods_start;
bool g_started = false;

std::string mods_state();   // below
void mods_reload();

void for_each_opt(void (*f)(const Opt&, void*), void* u) {
  for (auto* list : {&graphics_opts(), &display_opts(), &photo_opts(), &audio_opts()})
    for (const Opt& o : *list) if (o.kind != kSection) f(o, u);
}

void capture_start() {
  if (g_started) return;
  g_started = true;
  for_each_opt([](const Opt& o, void*) { g_start[o.key] = cur_of(o); }, nullptr);
  mods_reload();
  g_mods_start = mods_state();
}

struct Pend { std::vector<std::string> names; };

void pend_one(const Opt& o, void* u) {
  if (o.when != kRestart || env_set_by_hand(o)) return;
  auto it = g_start.find(o.key);
  if (it != g_start.end() && !same_value(o, it->second, cur_of(o))) ((Pend*)u)->names.push_back(o.label);
}

// look strength has no effect on a neutral look: do not count it alone
bool is_pending(const Opt& o) {
  if (o.when != kRestart || env_set_by_hand(o)) return false;
  auto it = g_start.find(o.key);
  if (it == g_start.end() || same_value(o, it->second, cur_of(o))) return false;
  if (!std::strcmp(o.key, "look_intensity") && st::get("look", "neutral") == "neutral" && g_start["look"] == "neutral") return false;
  return true;
}

// ---- row drawing
const Opt* g_help = nullptr;   // the option under the pointer or the keyboard/pad focus this frame

float g_scroll_req = -1;   // scripted test: scroll the option list to this fraction of its length
std::map<std::string, float> g_edit;   // slider value while it is held (committed on release: each commit writes a file)
std::map<std::string, std::string> g_text;

void badge(const Opt& o) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (o.when == kSoon) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "coming soon");
  else if (o.when == kLive) ImGui::TextColored(t.good, "applies now");
  else if (is_pending(o)) ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "changed: restart to apply");
  else ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "restart needed");
}

void draw_choice(const Opt& o) {
  const std::string cur = cur_of(o);
  Choices dyn;
  const Choices& list = o.dyn ? (dyn = o.dyn()) : o.choices;
  std::string label = cur.empty() && o.choices.empty() ? "" : cur;
  for (auto& c : list) if (c.first == cur) label = c.second;
  if (label == cur && !cur.empty() && !std::strcmp(o.key, "frame_cap")) label = cur + " fps (custom)";
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(px(250));
  if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##v", label.c_str())) {
    for (auto& c : list) {
      if (ImGui::Selectable(c.second.c_str(), c.first == cur)) set_of(o, c.first);
      if (ImGui::IsItemHovered() || ImGui::IsItemFocused()) g_help = &o;
    }
    ImGui::EndCombo();
  }
}

void draw_slider(const Opt& o) {
  const std::string cur = cur_of(o);
  float v = (float)std::atof(cur.c_str());
  auto it = g_edit.find(o.key);
  float tmp = it != g_edit.end() ? it->second : v;
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(px(250));
  const bool changed = ImGui::SliderFloat("##v", &tmp, o.lo, o.hi, o.fmt, ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
  if (changed) g_edit[o.key] = tmp;
  if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) {
    set_of(o, fmt_float(std::round(tmp * 100.0f) / 100.0f));
    g_edit.erase(o.key);
  } else if (!ImGui::IsItemActive() && !changed) g_edit.erase(o.key);
}

// An unchecked box is the same pale grey as the panel: give it an outline.
bool boxed_checkbox(const char* id, bool* b) {
  ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameBorderSize, std::max(1.0f, px(1.5f)));
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, theme().text_dim);
  const bool ch = ImGui::Checkbox(id, b);
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
  ImGui::PopStyleVar();
  return ch;
}

void draw_toggle(const Opt& o) {
  bool b = cur_of(o) != "0" && !cur_of(o).empty();
  if (boxed_checkbox("##v", &b)) set_of(o, b ? "1" : "0");
}

void draw_path(const Opt& o) {
  auto it = g_text.find(o.key);
  if (it == g_text.end()) it = g_text.emplace(o.key, cur_of(o)).first;
  char buf[520];
  std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", it->second.c_str());
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(px(420));
  if (ImGui::InputText("##v", buf, sizeof buf)) it->second = buf;
  if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) set_of(o, it->second);
}

void draw_row(const Opt& o, bool inline_help) {
  if (o.kind == kSection) {
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextColored(theme().title, "%s", o.label);
    ImGui::Separator();
    return;
  }
  ImGui::PushID(o.key);
  ImGui::BeginGroup();
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextUnformatted(o.label);
  ImGui::SameLine(px(275));
  ImGui::BeginDisabled(o.when == kSoon);
  switch (o.kind) {
    case kChoice: draw_choice(o); break;
    case kSlider: draw_slider(o); break;
    case kToggle: draw_toggle(o); break;
    case kPath: draw_path(o); break;
    default: break;
  }
  ImGui::EndDisabled();
  if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled) || ImGui::IsItemFocused() || ImGui::IsItemActive()) g_help = &o;
  badge(o);
  ImGui::EndGroup();
  if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled)) g_help = &o;
  if (env_set_by_hand(o)) ImGui::TextColored(theme().error, "    %s is set in the environment and wins over this choice.", st::env_name(o.key) ? st::env_name(o.key) : o.env);
  if (inline_help) {
    ImGui::Indent(px(24));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, theme().text_dim);
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(o.help);
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::Unindent(px(24));
    ImGui::Spacing();
  }
  ImGui::PopID();
}

std::string default_label(const Opt& o) {
  if (o.dyn) return "";
  for (auto& c : o.choices) if (c.first == o.def) return c.second;
  if (o.kind == kToggle) return std::string(o.def) == "0" ? "Off" : "On";
  if (o.kind == kSlider) { char b[48]; std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, o.fmt, (float)std::atof(o.def)); return b; }
  return o.def;
}

void draw_help(const std::vector<Opt>& list, const Opt** remembered) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  const Opt* o = g_help ? g_help : *remembered;
  if (!o) for (auto& x : list) if (x.kind != kSection) { o = &x; break; }
  *remembered = o;
  if (!o) return;
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "%s", o->label);
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", o->help);
  ImGui::Spacing();
  auto wrapped = [](const ImVec4& c, const char* fmt, const char* a) {
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, c);
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0.0f);
    ImGui::Text(fmt, a);
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
  };
  if (o->when == kSoon) wrapped(t.text_dim, "Coming soon: not in this build yet, so the control is off.%s", "");
  else if (o->when == kLive) wrapped(t.good, "Applies now.%s", "");
  else wrapped(t.title, "Restart needed: use \"Apply and restart\" at the top.%s", "");
  const std::string dl = default_label(*o);
  if (!dl.empty()) wrapped(t.text_dim, "Default: %s", dl.c_str());
  if (o->key && std::strcmp(o->key, "gfx_render_scale") == 0) {
    const float s = (float)std::atof(cur_of(*o).c_str());
    char b[64];
    std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%d x %d", (int)std::lround(1920 * s), (int)std::lround(1080 * s));
    wrapped(t.text_dim, "Now: scene drawn at %s", b);
  }
  const char* en = st::env_name(o->key) ? st::env_name(o->key) : o->env;
  if (en) { wrapped(t.text_dim, "%s", "Override with the environment variable:"); wrapped(t.text_dim, "%s", en); }
}

// Two-pane page: `extra` draws below the options in the left pane (the shader cache on the Graphics tab).
void two_pane(const char* id, std::vector<Opt>& list, const Opt** remembered, void (*extra)()) {
  g_help = nullptr;
  const float w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
  const float lw = w * 0.64f;
  if (ImGui::BeginChild(id, ImVec2(lw, 0))) {
    if (g_scroll_req >= 0) { ImGui::SetScrollY(g_scroll_req * ImGui::GetScrollMaxY()); g_scroll_req = -1; }
    for (const Opt& o : list) draw_row(o, false);
    if (extra) extra();
  }
  ImGui::EndChild();
  ImGui::SameLine();
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, theme().panel_alt);
  if (ImGui::BeginChild((std::string(id) + "_help").c_str(), ImVec2(0, 0), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders)) draw_help(list, remembered);
  ImGui::EndChild();
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
}

// ---- mods ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct ModRow {
  std::string id, name, version, author, description;
  bool enabled = true, has_json = true, exists = true;
};
double now_secs() { return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count(); }
std::vector<ModRow> g_mods;
double g_mods_loaded = -100;
std::string g_mods_root;
std::string g_mods_msg;
bool g_mods_err = false;

std::string read_all(const fs::path& p) {
  std::ifstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  std::ostringstream ss;
  ss << f.rdbuf();
  return ss.str();
}

void mods_reload() {
  g_mods_loaded = now_secs();
  g_mods_root = mods::default_root();
  g_mods.clear();
  std::error_code ec;
  std::vector<std::pair<std::string, bool>> order;
  bool have_file = false;
  hle::Json j;
  std::string err, txt = read_all(fs::path(g_mods_root) / "mods.json");
  if (!txt.empty() && hle::json_parse(txt, j, err)) {
    have_file = true;
    if (auto* arr = j.get("packs"))
      for (auto& e : arr->a) {
        if (e.type == hle::Json::Str) order.push_back({e.s, true});
        else if (e.type == hle::Json::Obj) {
          std::string id = e.get("id") ? e.get("id")->str() : e.get("folder") ? e.get("folder")->str() : "";
          if (!id.empty()) order.push_back({id, e.get("enabled") ? e.get("enabled")->boolean(true) : true});
        }
      }
  }
  std::vector<std::string> disk;
  if (fs::is_directory(g_mods_root, ec))
    for (auto& d : fs::directory_iterator(g_mods_root, ec)) if (d.is_directory(ec)) disk.push_back(d.path().filename().string());
  std::sort(disk.begin(), disk.end());
  auto listed = [&](const std::string& id) { for (auto& p : order) if (p.first == id) return true; return false; };
  for (auto& d : disk)   // folders the loader would pick up on its own (pack.json), after the ones in mods.json
    if (!listed(d) && fs::exists(fs::path(g_mods_root) / d / "pack.json", ec)) order.push_back({d, d == "native-options"});   // as mods::load: only the pack the game needs is on without a mods.json entry
  for (auto& [id, en] : order) {
    ModRow r;
    r.id = id;
    r.enabled = en;
    const fs::path dir = fs::path(g_mods_root) / id;
    r.exists = fs::is_directory(dir, ec);
    r.name = id;
    hle::Json pj;
    std::string perr, ptxt = read_all(dir / "pack.json");
    r.has_json = !ptxt.empty();
    if (r.has_json && hle::json_parse(ptxt, pj, perr)) {
      if (auto* v = pj.get("name")) if (!v->str().empty()) r.name = v->str();
      if (auto* v = pj.get("version")) r.version = v->str();
      if (auto* v = pj.get("author")) r.author = v->str();
      if (auto* v = pj.get("description")) r.description = v->str();
    }
    g_mods.push_back(r);
  }
}

// What the loader reads next start: ids and enabled flags in priority order.
std::string mods_state() {
  std::string s;
  for (auto& r : g_mods) if (r.exists) s += (s.empty() ? "" : ",") + r.id + (r.enabled ? ":1" : ":0");
  return s;
}

bool mods_save() {
  hle::Json j = hle::Json::object();
  hle::Json arr = hle::Json::array();
  for (auto& r : g_mods) {
    hle::Json e = hle::Json::object();
    e.set("id", hle::Json::string(r.id));
    e.set("enabled", hle::Json::boolean_(r.enabled));
    arr.a.push_back(e);
  }
  j.set("packs", arr);
  std::string out;
  hle::json_dump(j, out);
  out += "\n";
  std::error_code ec;
  fs::create_directories(g_mods_root, ec);
  const fs::path p = fs::path(g_mods_root) / "mods.json", tmp = fs::path(g_mods_root) / "mods.json.tmp";
  {
    std::ofstream f(tmp, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    f << out;
    if (!f.good()) { g_mods_msg = "Could not write mods.json in " + g_mods_root; g_mods_err = true; return false; }
  }
  fs::rename(tmp, p, ec);
  if (ec) { fs::remove(p, ec); fs::rename(tmp, p, ec); }
  if (ec) { g_mods_msg = "Could not replace mods.json: " + ec.message(); g_mods_err = true; return false; }
  g_mods_msg = "Saved mods.json. The change applies after a restart.";
  g_mods_err = false;
  return true;
}

void open_folder(const std::string& dir) {
  std::error_code ec;
  fs::create_directories(fs::u8path(dir), ec);
  ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"explore", fs::u8path(dir).wstring().c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
}

}  // namespace

// ---- pages -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void options_menu_opened() { capture_start(); }

int options_pending_restart(std::string* names) {
  capture_start();
  Pend p;
  for_each_opt(pend_one, &p);
  if (mods_state() != g_mods_start) p.names.push_back("Mods");
  if (names) {
    names->clear();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.names.size(); ++i) *names += (i ? ", " : "") + p.names[i];
  }
  return (int)p.names.size();
}

void options_restart_bar() {
  std::string names;
  const int n = options_pending_restart(&names);
  if (!n) return;
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, t.toast_bg);
  if (ImGui::BeginChild("pending", ImVec2(0, ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing() * 2.6f), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders)) {
    ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - px(250));
    std::string shown = names;
    size_t c1 = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3 && c1 != std::string::npos; ++k) c1 = names.find(", ", c1 == 0 && k == 0 ? 0 : c1 + 2);
    if (c1 != std::string::npos) shown = names.substr(0, c1) + " and " + std::to_string(n - 3) + " more";
    ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "%d change%s need%s a restart: %s", n, n == 1 ? "" : "s", n == 1 ? "s" : "", shown.c_str());
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
    ImGui::SameLine(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - px(240));
    if (ImGui::Button("Apply and restart")) restart_game();
  }
  ImGui::EndChild();
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
}
```
