```cpp
void tab_mods() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  if (now_secs() - g_mods_loaded > 3.0) mods_reload();
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Mod packs are folders in %s. A pack higher in the list wins when two packs replace the same game file. The loader reads this list when the game starts, so every change here needs a restart.",
                     g_mods_root.c_str());
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_MODS_DIR")) if (*e) ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "SNAP_MODS_DIR is set in the environment: this is the folder it points to.");
  ImGui::Spacing();
  if (ImGui::Button("Open mods folder")) open_folder(g_mods_root);
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (ImGui::Button("Rescan")) mods_reload();
  ImGui::SameLine();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "restart needed");
  if (!g_mods_msg.empty()) ImGui::TextColored(g_mods_err ? t.error : t.good, "%s", g_mods_msg.c_str());
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  if (g_mods.empty()) {
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextWrapped("No packs found. A pack is a folder with a pack.json next to its <archive>.drp\\<entry> files; see docs\\mods.md.");
    return;
  }
  int move_from = -1, move_to = -1;
  bool changed = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < (int)g_mods.size(); ++i) {
    ModRow& r = g_mods[i];
    ImGui::PushID(i);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(i == 0);
    if (ImGui::ArrowButton("up", ImGuiDir_Up)) { move_from = i; move_to = i - 1; }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(i + 1 == (int)g_mods.size());
    if (ImGui::ArrowButton("down", ImGuiDir_Down)) { move_from = i; move_to = i + 1; }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!r.exists);
    if (boxed_checkbox("##en", &r.enabled)) changed = true;
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::TextColored(r.enabled ? t.text : t.text_dim, "%d. %s", i + 1, r.name.c_str());
    if (!r.version.empty()) { ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "v%s", r.version.c_str()); }
    if (!r.author.empty()) { ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "by %s", r.author.c_str()); }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::TextColored(r.enabled ? t.good : t.text_dim, r.enabled ? "on" : "off");
    ImGui::Indent(px(70));
    if (!r.exists) ImGui::TextColored(t.error, "Listed in mods.json but the folder %s is missing.", r.id.c_str());
    else if (!r.has_json) ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "Folder \"%s\" has no pack.json (name and version unknown).", r.id.c_str());
    else if (!r.description.empty()) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%s", r.description.c_str());
    ImGui::Unindent(px(70));
    ImGui::PopID();
  }
  if (move_from >= 0 && move_to >= 0 && move_to < (int)g_mods.size()) { std::swap(g_mods[move_from], g_mods[move_to]); changed = true; }
  if (changed) mods_save();
}

// ---- scripted-test entry points (ui_test.cpp): the same code the controls run
namespace {
const Opt* find_opt(const std::string& key) {
  for (auto* list : {&graphics_opts(), &display_opts(), &photo_opts(), &audio_opts()})
    for (const Opt& o : *list) if (o.kind != kSection && key == o.key) return &o;
  return nullptr;
}
}  // namespace

bool options_test_set(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
  capture_start();
  const Opt* o = find_opt(key);
  if (!o || o->when == kSoon) return false;
  set_of(*o, value);
  return true;
}
void options_test_scroll(float fraction) { g_scroll_req = fraction; }
std::string options_test_get(const std::string& key) {
  const Opt* o = find_opt(key);
  return o ? cur_of(*o) : "<unknown option>";
}
bool options_test_option_when(const std::string& key, std::string* when) {
  const Opt* o = find_opt(key);
  if (!o) return false;
  *when = o->when == kLive ? "live" : o->when == kRestart ? "restart" : "soon";
  return true;
}
bool options_test_mods(const std::string& op, const std::string& id, int arg, std::string* state) {
  capture_start();
  mods_reload();
  if (op == "toggle" || op == "move") {
    int i = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)g_mods.size(); ++k) if (g_mods[k].id == id) i = k;
    if (i < 0) return false;
    if (op == "toggle") g_mods[i].enabled = !g_mods[i].enabled;
    else {
      int j = i + arg;
      if (j < 0 || j >= (int)g_mods.size()) return false;
      std::swap(g_mods[i], g_mods[j]);
    }
    if (!mods_save()) return false;
  }
  *state = mods_state();
  return true;
}

}  // namespace snap::ui

```

`runtime/ui/ui_overlay.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// In-game overlay core: Dear ImGui (Vulkan + Win32 backends) drawn on top of the finished scene blit at native output resolution.
//
//  - snap_ui_present() is the only entry from the NVN layer (runtime/nvn/nvn_vk.cpp, PresentWindow). It runs on the presenting
//    thread, records into the present command buffer and leaves the swapchain image in TRANSFER_DST for the caller's final barrier.
//  - The game window (a plain HWND owned by host/boot.cpp) is subclassed once: F1 toggles the menu, the wheel feeds the input hub,
//    the cursor is hidden/released per the hub's policy and the rest goes to ImGui while the menu is open.
//  - While the menu is open the input hub reports an idle pad to the game; the menu reads keyboard/mouse through ImGui's Win32
//    backend and the pad through the hub (SDL3 + XInput merged), so every controller the game accepts also drives the menu.
#include <windows.h>
#include <windowsx.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "hle/hle.h"
#include "hle/input_core.h"
#include "imgui.h"
#include "imgui_impl_vulkan.h"
#include "imgui_impl_win32.h"
#include "ui_font.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"
#include "ui_present.h"
#include "ui_theme.h"

extern IMGUI_IMPL_API LRESULT ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam);

namespace snap::ui {

Theme& theme() {
  static Theme t;
  return t;
}

namespace {

using hle::input::hub;

double now_s() {
  using namespace std::chrono;
  return duration<double>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

struct Core {
  std::recursive_mutex mu;             // ImGui context (recursive: ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame can re-enter the window procedure on the presenting thread): the window thread (messages) and the present thread (frames)
  std::atomic<bool> open{false};
  std::atomic<bool> modal{false};      // shader prompt / progress screen
  bool was_modal = false;
  std::atomic<bool> imgui_ready{false};
  HWND hwnd = nullptr;
  WNDPROC orig = nullptr;
  bool was_open = false;
  // Vulkan
  VkDevice device = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  VkFormat format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
  VkSwapchainKHR swapchain = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  std::unordered_map<VkImage, VkImageView> views;
  bool vk_ready = false, srgb = false, failed = false;
  // style
  float applied_scale = 0;
  // notice
  uint64_t seen_serial = 0;
  double toast_until = 0;
};
Core g;

// ---- window subclass ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
LRESULT ui_wndproc_impl(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
  switch (m) {
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
    case WM_SYSKEYDOWN:
      if (w == VK_F1) {
        if (!(l & (1 << 30)) && !g.modal.load()) overlay_set_open(!g.open.load());   // key-down edge only, not the auto-repeat
        return 0;
      }
      break;
    case WM_KEYUP:
    case WM_SYSKEYUP:
      if (w == VK_F1) return 0;
      break;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
      hle::input::post_wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(w));
      break;
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
    case WM_CLOSE:
    case WM_DESTROY:
      ClipCursor(nullptr);   // never leave the cursor confined to a window that is going away or inactive
      break;
    case WM_ACTIVATE:
      if (LOWORD(w) == WA_INACTIVE) ClipCursor(nullptr);
      break;
    case WM_SETCURSOR:
      if (LOWORD(l) == HTCLIENT && hub().cursor_hidden() && !g.open.load() && !g.modal.load()) { SetCursor(nullptr); return TRUE; }
      break;
    default: break;
  }
  if ((g.open.load() || g.modal.load()) && g.imgui_ready.load()) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g.mu);
    if (ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler(h, m, w, l)) return TRUE;
  }
  return CallWindowProcW(g.orig, h, m, w, l);
}

// No host exception may leave a window procedure (the OS turns it into STATUS_FATAL_USER_CALLBACK_EXCEPTION and kills the process).
LRESULT CALLBACK ui_wndproc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
  try {
    return ui_wndproc_impl(h, m, w, l);
  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    static int n = 0;
    if (n++ < 20) hle::log("ui: exception in the window procedure (msg 0x%x): %s", m, e.what());
  } catch (...) {
    static int n = 0;
    if (n++ < 20) hle::log("ui: unknown exception in the window procedure (msg 0x%x)", m);
  }
  return g.orig ? CallWindowProcW(g.orig, h, m, w, l) : DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

void ensure_window(HWND h) {
  if (!h || g.hwnd == h) return;
  g.hwnd = h;
  g.orig = reinterpret_cast<WNDPROC>(SetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_WNDPROC, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(ui_wndproc)));
  hle::log("ui: overlay hooked into the game window (F1 or hold Back+Start for 0.5 s opens the controls menu)");
}

// ---- colors: the swapchain is often an sRGB format, which would brighten straight ImGui colors; pre-convert them
float lin(float c) { return std::pow(std::clamp(c, 0.0f, 1.0f), 2.2f); }
ImVec4 fb(const ImVec4& c) { return g.srgb ? ImVec4(lin(c.x), lin(c.y), lin(c.z), c.w) : c; }

void apply_style(float scale) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGuiStyle s;
  ImGui::StyleColorsLight(&s);
  s.WindowRounding = t.window_round;
  s.ChildRounding = s.FrameRounding = s.PopupRounding = s.GrabRounding = s.TabRounding = t.rounding;
  s.ScrollbarRounding = t.rounding;
  s.WindowPadding = ImVec2(t.window_pad, t.window_pad);
  s.FramePadding = ImVec2(t.frame_pad_x, t.frame_pad_y);
  s.ItemSpacing = ImVec2(t.item_spacing, t.item_spacing);
  s.ItemInnerSpacing = ImVec2(t.item_spacing * 0.75f, t.item_spacing * 0.5f);
  s.WindowBorderSize = 2.0f;
  s.TabBarBorderSize = 0.0f;
  s.FrameBorderSize = 0.0f;
  s.FrameBorderSize = 0.0f;
  s.ScrollbarSize = 14.0f;
  s.GrabMinSize = 16.0f;
  s.CellPadding = ImVec2(6.0f, 4.0f);
  ImVec4* c = s.Colors;
  c[ImGuiCol_Text] = fb(t.text);
  c[ImGuiCol_TextDisabled] = fb(t.text_dim);
  c[ImGuiCol_WindowBg] = fb(t.panel);
  c[ImGuiCol_ChildBg] = fb(t.panel_alt);
  c[ImGuiCol_PopupBg] = fb(t.panel);

  c[ImGuiCol_FrameBg] = fb(t.slot);

  c[ImGuiCol_TableBorderStrong] = fb(t.border);

  c[ImGuiCol_ModalWindowDimBg] = ImVec4(0, 0, 0, 0.6f);

  c[ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrab] = fb(t.slot_hover);
  s.ScaleAllSizes(scale);
  s.FontSizeBase = t.font_px;
  s.FontScaleMain = scale;
  ImGui::GetStyle() = s;
  g.applied_scale = scale;
}

bool init_imgui(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  if (g.failed) return false;
  if (g.imgui_ready.load()) return g.format == f->format;   // a format change after init is not supported: no overlay then
  std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g.mu);
  IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
  ImGui::CreateContext();
  ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
  io.IniFilename = nullptr;
  io.LogFilename = nullptr;
  io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard | ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad;
  io.BackendFlags |= ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad;
  g.format = f->format;
  g.srgb = f->format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB || f->format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
  g.device = f->device;
  if (!ImGui_ImplWin32_Init(f->hwnd)) { hle::log("ui: ImGui_ImplWin32_Init failed"); g.failed = true; ImGui::DestroyContext(); return false; }
  ImGui_ImplVulkan_InitInfo ii{};
  ii.ApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
  ii.Instance = f->instance;
  ii.PhysicalDevice = f->phys;
  ii.Device = f->device;
  ii.QueueFamily = f->family;
  ii.Queue = f->queue;
  ii.DescriptorPoolSize = 16;
  ii.MinImageCount = 2;
  ii.ImageCount = std::max(4u, f->image_count + 2);   // frames the present path can keep in flight
  ii.UseDynamicRendering = true;
  ii.PipelineInfoMain.MSAASamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
  static VkFormat color_format;
  color_format = f->format;
  ii.PipelineInfoMain.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RENDERING_CREATE_INFO};
  ii.PipelineInfoMain.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
  ii.PipelineInfoMain.PipelineRenderingCreateInfo.pColorAttachmentFormats = &color_format;
  if (!ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init(&ii)) { hle::log("ui: ImGui_ImplVulkan_Init failed"); g.failed = true; ImGui_ImplWin32_Shutdown(); ImGui::DestroyContext(); return false; }
  g.vk_ready = true;
  // font: the game's own UI font decoded from the user's extracted files at run time (ui_font.h; never copied into the repo), else Segoe UI
  // from the Windows fonts folder when present (system file, not shipped), else the embedded vector font
  bool font_ok = false;
  {
    static std::vector<unsigned char> game_font;   // must outlive the atlas
    if (game_font_ttf(game_font)) {
      ImFontConfig fc;
      fc.FontDataOwnedByAtlas = false;
      font_ok = io.Fonts->AddFontFromMemoryTTF(game_font.data(), (int)game_font.size(), theme().font_px, &fc) != nullptr;
      if (font_ok) hle::log("ui: using the game's UI font (%s) decoded from the extracted files", game_font_family());
    }
  }
  if (!font_ok)
  if (const char* root = std::getenv("SystemRoot")) {
    std::string path = std::string(root) + "\\Fonts\\" + theme().font_file;
    if (GetFileAttributesA(path.c_str()) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) font_ok = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(path.c_str(), theme().font_px) != nullptr;
  }
  if (!font_ok) io.Fonts->AddFontDefaultVector();
  apply_style(1.0f);
  g.imgui_ready = true;
  hle::log("ui: ImGui %s ready, swapchain format %d%s", IMGUI_VERSION, (int)f->format, g.srgb ? " (sRGB, colors pre-converted)" : "");
  return true;
}

VkImageView view_for(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  if (g.swapchain != f->swapchain) {   // swapchain recreated (the present path waited for the device to go idle): drop old views
    for (auto& kv : g.views) vkDestroyImageView(f->device, kv.second, nullptr);
    g.views.clear();
    g.swapchain = f->swapchain;
  }
  auto it = g.views.find(f->image);
  if (it != g.views.end()) return it->second;
  VkImageViewCreateInfo vi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO};
  vi.image = f->image;
  vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
  vi.format = f->format;
  vi.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  VkImageView v = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  if (vkCreateImageView(f->device, &vi, nullptr, &v) != VK_SUCCESS) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
  g.views[f->image] = v;
  return v;
}

void barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to) {
  VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
  b.srcStageMask = b.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
  b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
  b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
  b.oldLayout = from;
  b.newLayout = to;
  b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
  b.image = img;
  b.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
  VkDependencyInfo di{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO};
  di.imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1;
  di.pImageMemoryBarriers = &b;
  vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

// Gamepad navigation from the hub's merged pad state (SDL3 + XInput), so any controller the game accepts drives the menu.
void feed_gamepad(ImGuiIO& io, bool enabled) {
  using namespace hle::input;
  RawInput r = hub().raw();
  const bool on = enabled && r.focused;
  auto btn = [&](ImGuiKey k, bool v) { io.AddKeyEvent(k, on && v); };
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown, r.pad.test(kPadSouth));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, r.pad.test(kPadEast));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceLeft, r.pad.test(kPadWest));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceUp, r.pad.test(kPadNorth));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadUp, r.pad.test(kPadDUp));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown, r.pad.test(kPadDDown));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, r.pad.test(kPadDLeft));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, r.pad.test(kPadDRight));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadL1, r.pad.test(kPadLShoulder));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadR1, r.pad.test(kPadRShoulder));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadL3, r.pad.test(kPadLStick));
  btn(ImGuiKey_GamepadR3, r.pad.test(kPadRStick));
  auto analog = [&](ImGuiKey k, float v) {
    const float dz = 0.25f;
    float a = on && v > dz ? std::min(1.0f, (v - dz) / (1.0f - dz)) : 0.0f;
    io.AddKeyAnalogEvent(k, a > 0.0f, a);
  };
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickLeft, -r.lx);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickRight, r.lx);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickUp, r.ly);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickDown, -r.ly);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadRStickLeft, -r.rx);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadRStickRight, r.rx);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadRStickUp, r.ry);
  analog(ImGuiKey_GamepadRStickDown, -r.ry);
  io.AddKeyAnalogEvent(ImGuiKey_GamepadL2, on && r.lt > 0.3f, on ? r.lt : 0.0f);
  io.AddKeyAnalogEvent(ImGuiKey_GamepadR2, on && r.rt > 0.3f, on ? r.rt : 0.0f);
}

}  // namespace

bool overlay_open() { return g.open.load(); }
void* overlay_hwnd() { return g.hwnd; }

// Window thread (F1) and present thread (chord, scripted test) both call this.
void overlay_set_open(bool open) {
  if (g.open.exchange(open) == open) return;
  hle::input::hub().set_menu_open(open || g.modal.load());
  if (open) ClipCursor(nullptr);   // the cursor must reach the menu, not stay confined by the game
  hle::log("ui: controls menu %s", open ? "opened" : "closed");
}

void overlay_set_modal(bool on) {
  if (g.modal.exchange(on) == on) return;
  hle::input::hub().set_menu_open(on || g.open.load());
  if (on) ClipCursor(nullptr);
  hle::log("ui: shader screen %s", on ? "shown" : "closed");
}

}  // namespace snap::ui

static void ui_present_impl(const SnapUiFrame* f);
// Exceptions never reach the NVN present path: log, drop the frame's overlay and keep the game running.
extern "C" void snap_ui_present(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  static int errors = 0;
  try {
    ui_present_impl(f);
  } catch (const std::exception& e) {
    if (errors++ < 20) hle::log("ui: exception in the overlay frame: %s", e.what());
  } catch (...) {
    if (errors++ < 20) hle::log("ui: unknown exception in the overlay frame");
  }
}

static void ui_present_impl(const SnapUiFrame* f) {
  using namespace snap::ui;
  auto& hubr = hle::input::hub();
  ensure_window(static_cast<HWND>(f->hwnd));
  const double now = now_s();
  test_tick(now);
  const bool shader = shader_screen_active(now);
  overlay_set_modal(shader);
  if (!shader && g.was_modal) shader_screen_closed();
  g.was_modal = shader;
  if (hubr.consume_menu_toggle() && !shader) overlay_set_open(!g.open.load());
  const bool open = g.open.load() && !shader;
  if (open && !g.was_open) menu_opened();
  if (!open && g.was_open) menu_closed();
  g.was_open = open;
  menu_tick_save();

  // a load or save problem (invalid input.json, migration) shows as a notice at the bottom for a few seconds
  const uint64_t serial = hubr.message_serial();
  if (serial != g.seen_serial) {
    g.seen_serial = serial;
    if (!hubr.message().empty()) g.toast_until = now + 12.0;
  }
  const bool toast = !open && now < g.toast_until;
  if (!open && !shader && !toast) return;
  if (!init_imgui(f)) return;
  if (open || shader) hubr.poll(8);   // keeps rebinding and the live readout fresh even when the game is not polling

  const ImVec2 size(static_cast<float>(f->extent.width), static_cast<float>(f->extent.height));
  ImDrawData* dd = nullptr;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lk(g.mu);
    const float scale = std::clamp(hubr.mapping().ui_scale, 0.5f, 3.0f) * std::max(1.0f, size.y / 1080.0f);
    if (std::fabs(scale - g.applied_scale) > 0.001f) apply_style(scale);
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame();
    ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame();
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.DisplaySize = size;
    feed_gamepad(io, (open || shader) && !hubr.capturing());
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    if (shader) {
      draw_shader_screen(size);
    } else if (open) {
      bool close = false;
      draw_menu(size, &close);
      if (close) overlay_set_open(false);
    } else if (!draw_toast(size, now)) {
      g.toast_until = 0;
    }
    ImGui::Render();
    dd = ImGui::GetDrawData();
  }
  if (!dd || dd->CmdListsCount == 0) return;
  VkImageView view = view_for(f);
  if (!view) return;
  barrier(f->cb, f->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
  VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO};
  ca.imageView = view;
  ca.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
  ca.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD;   // keep the scene
  ca.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
  VkRenderingInfo ri{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO};
  ri.renderArea = {{0, 0}, f->extent};
  ri.layerCount = 1;
  ri.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
  ri.pColorAttachments = &ca;
  vkCmdBeginRendering(f->cb, &ri);
  ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(dd, f->cb);
  vkCmdEndRendering(f->cb);
  barrier(f->cb, f->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
}

```

`runtime/ui/ui_picker.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Startup save-profile picker: a small native window shown before the save mounts (the game window and Vulkan do not exist
// for this purpose yet, so it uses plain GDI). Keyboard (Up/Down, Enter, Esc), mouse (hover, click, wheel) and controller
// (D-pad or left stick, A to choose, B to use the last played profile) all work.
// Test hooks: SNAP_PICKER_SHOT=<file.bmp> saves a picture of the window after it has drawn and then closes it;
// SNAP_PICKER_AUTO=<index> is the choice returned then (default -1: the last played profile).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "hle/profiles.h"
#include "ui_font.h"

namespace {

using hle::profiles::PickItem;

struct State {
  const PickItem* items = nullptr;
  int n = 0;           // profiles; row n is "New profile"
  int sel = 0;
  int top = 0;         // first visible row
  int result = -2;     // -2 still open
  float scale = 1.0f;
  HFONT f_title = nullptr, f_name = nullptr, f_small = nullptr;
  int shot_ticks = -1;
  std::wstring shot_path;
  int auto_choice = -1;
  WORD prev_buttons = 0;
  int pad_repeat = 0;
};
State* g = nullptr;

// game palette (measured from the game's menus, see analysis/ui/style_ref.md): cream page, white cards, yellow selection with an orange outline
constexpr COLORREF kBg = RGB(244, 242, 240), kPanel = RGB(252, 252, 252), kSel = RGB(248, 213, 71), kSelLine = RGB(248, 171, 121),
                   kText = RGB(90, 83, 80), kDim = RGB(139, 138, 139), kBorder = RGB(224, 220, 215), kTitle = RGB(218, 116, 58);

int px(int v) { return (int)(v * g->scale + 0.5f); }
constexpr int kVisible = 6;

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
  if (s.empty()) return L"";
  int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), (int)s.size(), nullptr, 0);
  std::wstring w((size_t)n, L'\0');
  MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), (int)s.size(), &w[0], n);
  return w;
}

RECT row_rect(int i, const RECT& cl) {
  int vis = i - g->top;
  int y = px(96) + vis * px(64);
  RECT r{px(28), y, cl.right - px(28), y + px(56)};
  return r;
}
int total_rows() { return g->n + 1; }

void keep_visible() {
  if (g->sel < g->top) g->top = g->sel;
  if (g->sel >= g->top + kVisible) g->top = g->sel - kVisible + 1;
  g->top = std::max(0, std::min(g->top, std::max(0, total_rows() - kVisible)));
}

void paint(HWND h, HDC dc) {
  RECT cl;
  GetClientRect(h, &cl);
  HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(dc);
  HBITMAP bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(dc, cl.right, cl.bottom);
  HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
  HBRUSH bg = CreateSolidBrush(kBg);
  FillRect(mem, &cl, bg);
  DeleteObject(bg);
  SetBkMode(mem, TRANSPARENT);
  SelectObject(mem, g->f_title);
  SetTextColor(mem, kTitle);
  TextOutW(mem, px(28), px(22), L"Choose a save profile", 21);
  SelectObject(mem, g->f_small);
  SetTextColor(mem, kDim);
  const wchar_t* sub = L"Each profile keeps its own save. You can rename, copy, clear or delete them later in the F1 menu (Saves tab).";
  TextOutW(mem, px(28), px(60), sub, (int)wcslen(sub));
  for (int i = g->top; i < total_rows() && i < g->top + kVisible; ++i) {
    RECT r = row_rect(i, cl);
    bool sel = i == g->sel;
    HBRUSH b = CreateSolidBrush(sel ? kSel : kPanel);
    HPEN pen = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, sel ? px(3) : 1, sel ? kSelLine : kBorder);
    HGDIOBJ ob = SelectObject(mem, b), op = SelectObject(mem, pen);
    RoundRect(mem, r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom, px(26), px(26));
    SelectObject(mem, ob); SelectObject(mem, op);
    DeleteObject(b); DeleteObject(pen);
    SetTextColor(mem, kText);
    SelectObject(mem, g->f_name);
    if (i < g->n) {
      std::wstring nm = widen(g->items[i].name);
      TextOutW(mem, r.left + px(18), r.top + px(8), nm.c_str(), (int)nm.size());
      SelectObject(mem, g->f_small);
      SetTextColor(mem, sel ? RGB(120, 100, 80) : kDim);
      std::wstring info = L"Last played: " + widen(hle::profiles::format_time(g->items[i].last_played)) + L"     Save size: " +
                          widen(hle::profiles::format_size(g->items[i].size));
      TextOutW(mem, r.left + px(18), r.top + px(31), info.c_str(), (int)info.size());
    } else {
      const wchar_t* t = L"+  New profile";
      TextOutW(mem, r.left + px(18), r.top + px(14), t, (int)wcslen(t));
    }
  }
  if (total_rows() > kVisible) {   // scroll hint
    SelectObject(mem, g->f_small);
    SetTextColor(mem, kDim);
    wchar_t t[64];
    std::swprintf(t, 64, L"%d-%d of %d", g->top + 1, std::min(total_rows(), g->top + kVisible), total_rows());
    TextOutW(mem, cl.right - px(130), px(60), t, (int)wcslen(t));
  }
  SelectObject(mem, g->f_small);
  SetTextColor(mem, kDim);
  {   // controller prompts: the game's orange chevron with a white disc
    auto prompt = [&](int x, const wchar_t* letter, const wchar_t* label) {
      const int y = cl.bottom - px(38), hh = px(24), ww = px(34), nose = px(10);
      POINT pts[5] = {{x, y}, {x + ww - nose, y}, {x + ww, y + hh / 2}, {x + ww - nose, y + hh}, {x, y + hh}};
      HBRUSH ob = CreateSolidBrush(kSelLine);
      HPEN op = CreatePen(PS_SOLID, 1, RGB(150, 100, 70));
      HGDIOBJ o1 = SelectObject(mem, ob), o2 = SelectObject(mem, op);
      Polygon(mem, pts, 5);
      HBRUSH wb = CreateSolidBrush(RGB(255, 250, 245));
      SelectObject(mem, wb);
      SelectObject(mem, GetStockObject(NULL_PEN));
      const int cx = x + (ww - nose) / 2 + px(3), cy = y + hh / 2, rr = px(8);
      Ellipse(mem, cx - rr, cy - rr, cx + rr, cy + rr);
      SelectObject(mem, o1); SelectObject(mem, o2);
      DeleteObject(ob); DeleteObject(op); DeleteObject(wb);
      SelectObject(mem, g->f_small);
      SetTextColor(mem, kTitle);
      SIZE ts; GetTextExtentPoint32W(mem, letter, 1, &ts);
      TextOutW(mem, cx - ts.cx / 2, cy - ts.cy / 2, letter, 1);
      SetTextColor(mem, kDim);
      TextOutW(mem, x + ww + px(8), cy - ts.cy / 2, label, (int)wcslen(label));
      GetTextExtentPoint32W(mem, label, (int)wcslen(label), &ts);
      return x + ww + px(8) + ts.cx + px(26);
    };
    int x = px(28);
    x = prompt(x, L"A", L"Choose");
    prompt(x, L"B", L"Last played profile");
    SetTextColor(mem, kDim);
    const wchar_t* hint = L"Up/Down, Enter or click also work";
    SIZE hs; GetTextExtentPoint32W(mem, hint, (int)wcslen(hint), &hs);
    TextOutW(mem, cl.right - px(28) - hs.cx, cl.bottom - px(38) + px(4), hint, (int)wcslen(hint));
  }
  BitBlt(dc, 0, 0, cl.right, cl.bottom, mem, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
  SelectObject(mem, old);
  DeleteObject(bmp);
  DeleteDC(mem);
}

void save_bmp(HWND h, const std::wstring& path) {
  RECT cl;
  GetClientRect(h, &cl);
  HDC dc = GetDC(h);
  HDC mem = CreateCompatibleDC(dc);
  BITMAPINFO bi{};
  bi.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER);
  bi.bmiHeader.biWidth = cl.right;
  bi.bmiHeader.biHeight = cl.bottom;
  bi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
  bi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 24;
  void* bits = nullptr;
  HBITMAP bmp = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
  HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(mem, bmp);
  BitBlt(mem, 0, 0, cl.right, cl.bottom, dc, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
  int stride = ((cl.right * 3 + 3) / 4) * 4;
  BITMAPFILEHEADER fh{};
  fh.bfType = 0x4d42;
  fh.bfOffBits = sizeof fh + sizeof bi.bmiHeader;
  fh.bfSize = fh.bfOffBits + (DWORD)stride * cl.bottom;
  FILE* f = _wfopen(path.c_str(), L"wb");
  if (f) {
    fwrite(&fh, sizeof fh, 1, f);
    fwrite(&bi.bmiHeader, sizeof bi.bmiHeader, 1, f);
    fwrite(bits, 1, (size_t)stride * cl.bottom, f);
    fclose(f);
  }
  SelectObject(mem, old);
  DeleteObject(bmp);
  DeleteDC(mem);
  ReleaseDC(h, dc);
}

void move_sel(int d) {
  g->sel = std::max(0, std::min(total_rows() - 1, g->sel + d));
  keep_visible();
}

int hit(HWND h, int x, int y) {
  RECT cl;
  GetClientRect(h, &cl);
  for (int i = g->top; i < total_rows() && i < g->top + kVisible; ++i) {
    RECT r = row_rect(i, cl);
    if (x >= r.left && x < r.right && y >= r.top && y < r.bottom) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

typedef DWORD(WINAPI* XGetState)(DWORD, void*);
struct XState { DWORD packet; WORD buttons; BYTE lt, rt; SHORT lx, ly, rx, ry; };

void poll_pad(HWND h) {
  static XGetState fn = nullptr;
  static bool tried = false;
  if (!tried) {
    tried = true;
    for (const wchar_t* dll : {L"xinput1_4.dll", L"xinput1_3.dll", L"xinput9_1_0.dll"}) {
      if (HMODULE m = LoadLibraryW(dll)) { fn = (XGetState)GetProcAddress(m, "XInputGetState"); if (fn) break; }
    }
  }
  if (!fn) return;
  WORD b = 0;
  int ly = 0;
  for (DWORD i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
    XState s{};
    if (fn(i, &s) == ERROR_SUCCESS) { b |= s.buttons; if (std::abs(s.ly) > std::abs(ly)) ly = s.ly; }
  }
  if (ly > 16000) b |= 0x0001;      // up
  if (ly < -16000) b |= 0x0002;     // down
  WORD pressed = b & (WORD)~g->prev_buttons;
  bool held_dir = (b & 0x0003) && (b == g->prev_buttons);
  if (held_dir) { if (++g->pad_repeat > 12 && g->pad_repeat % 4 == 0) pressed |= (b & 0x0003); }
  else g->pad_repeat = 0;
  g->prev_buttons = b;
  if (pressed & 0x0001) move_sel(-1);
  if (pressed & 0x0002) move_sel(1);
  if (pressed & 0x1000) g->result = g->sel;       // A
  if (pressed & 0x2000) g->result = -1;           // B
  if (pressed) InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, FALSE);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK wndproc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
  if (!g) return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
  switch (m) {
    case WM_PAINT: { PAINTSTRUCT ps; HDC dc = BeginPaint(h, &ps); paint(h, dc); EndPaint(h, &ps); return 0; }
    case WM_ERASEBKGND: return 1;
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
      if (w == VK_UP) move_sel(-1);
      else if (w == VK_DOWN) move_sel(1);
      else if (w == VK_HOME) { g->sel = 0; keep_visible(); }
      else if (w == VK_END) { g->sel = total_rows() - 1; keep_visible(); }
      else if (w == VK_RETURN || w == VK_SPACE) g->result = g->sel;
      else if (w == VK_ESCAPE) g->result = -1;
      InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, FALSE);
      return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
      int i = hit(h, (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l));
      if (i >= 0 && i != g->sel) { g->sel = i; InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, FALSE); }
      return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
      int i = hit(h, (short)LOWORD(l), (short)HIWORD(l));
      if (i >= 0) g->result = i;
      return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
      move_sel((short)HIWORD(w) > 0 ? -1 : 1);
      InvalidateRect(h, nullptr, FALSE);
      return 0;
    case WM_TIMER:
      poll_pad(h);
      if (g->shot_ticks >= 0 && ++g->shot_ticks == 25) {   // about 0.4 s: the window has drawn
        save_bmp(h, g->shot_path);
        g->result = g->auto_choice;
      }
      return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE: g->result = -1; return 0;
  }
  return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" int snap_ui_pick_profile(const PickItem* items, int count) {
  State st;
  st.items = items;
  st.n = count;
  g = &st;
  for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) if (items[i].last_played > items[st.sel].last_played) st.sel = i;   // start on the last played
  HDC sdc = GetDC(nullptr);
  st.scale = std::max(1.0f, GetDeviceCaps(sdc, LOGPIXELSX) / 96.0f);
  ReleaseDC(nullptr, sdc);
  // the game's own UI font, decoded from the extracted files and registered for this process only (never written to disk)
  static std::vector<unsigned char> game_font;
  const wchar_t* face = L"Segoe UI";
  if (snap::ui::game_font_ttf(game_font)) {
    DWORD nfonts = 0;
    if (AddFontMemResourceEx(game_font.data(), (DWORD)game_font.size(), nullptr, &nfonts) && nfonts > 0) face = L"AsiaKNGD-E";
  }
  auto mkfont = [&](int h, int weight) {
    return CreateFontW(-px(h), 0, 0, 0, face[0] == L'S' ? weight : FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET, OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS,
                       CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE, face);
  };
  st.f_title = mkfont(26, FW_SEMIBOLD);
  st.f_name = mkfont(18, FW_SEMIBOLD);
  st.f_small = mkfont(14, FW_NORMAL);
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_PICKER_SHOT")) { if (*e) { st.shot_ticks = 0; st.shot_path = widen(e); } }
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_PICKER_AUTO")) if (*e) st.auto_choice = std::atoi(e);

  WNDCLASSW wc{};
  wc.lpfnWndProc = wndproc;
  wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
  wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(32512));
  wc.lpszClassName = L"SnapProfilePicker";
  RegisterClassW(&wc);
  int w = px(720), hgt = px(96 + kVisible * 64 + 64);
  RECT r{0, 0, w, hgt};
  AdjustWindowRect(&r, WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU, FALSE);
  int ww = r.right - r.left, wh = r.bottom - r.top;
  int sx = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN), sy = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
  HWND h = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_TOPMOST | WS_EX_APPWINDOW, wc.lpszClassName, L"New Pokemon Snap - choose a save profile", WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU,
                           (sx - ww) / 2, (sy - wh) / 2, ww, wh, nullptr, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);
  int ret = -1;
  if (h) {
    ShowWindow(h, SW_SHOW);
    SetForegroundWindow(h);
    SetTimer(h, 1, 16, nullptr);
    MSG msg;
    while (st.result == -2) {
      if (!GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0)) break;
      TranslateMessage(&msg);
      DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    ret = st.result == -2 ? -1 : st.result;
    KillTimer(h, 1);
    DestroyWindow(h);
  }
  UnregisterClassW(wc.lpszClassName, wc.hInstance);
  DeleteObject(st.f_title); DeleteObject(st.f_name); DeleteObject(st.f_small);
  g = nullptr;
  return ret;
}
```

`runtime/ui/ui_saves.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// "Saves" tab of the F1 overlay: save profiles (hle/profiles.h). Switching profile, clearing or deleting the active one takes
// effect on restart; nothing here touches the files of the profile the running game has mounted, except copying one consistent
// generation (Duplicate). Clear and Delete move data to profiles\_trash (newest 10 kept).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <shobjidl.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "hle/hle.h"
#include "hle/profiles.h"
#include "hle/settings.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"

namespace snap::ui {

namespace {

namespace pr = hle::profiles;

struct SavesState {
  std::unique_ptr<pr::Store> store;
  std::string root;
  double loaded_at = -100;
  std::vector<int64_t> sizes;
  std::vector<pr::TrashEntry> trash;
  int sel = 0;
  char new_name[64] = "";
  char rename_buf[64] = "";
  char dup_buf[64] = "";
  char import_name[64] = "";
  std::string msg;
  bool msg_err = false;
  double msg_until = 0;
  enum Confirm { None, Clear, Delete } confirm = None;
  bool restart_needed = false;
  int last_sel = -1;
  std::vector<std::string> fixtures;
  double fixtures_at = -100;
  // folder dialog result (filled by a worker thread)
  std::mutex mu;
  std::string picked;
  std::atomic<bool> picking{false};
  std::string import_src;
};
SavesState Z;

double now_secs() { return ImGui::GetTime(); }

void say(const std::string& m, bool err) { Z.msg = m; Z.msg_err = err; Z.msg_until = now_secs() + 8; }

std::string find_root() {
  if (pr::active().on) return pr::active().root;
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_PROFILES_DIR")) if (*e) return e;
  return "";
}

void reload() {
  if (!Z.store || Z.store->root() != Z.root) Z.store.reset(new pr::Store(Z.root));
  Z.store->load();
  Z.sizes.clear();
  for (auto& p : Z.store->list()) Z.sizes.push_back(Z.store->size_bytes(p.id));
  Z.trash = Z.store->trash_list();
  Z.loaded_at = now_secs();
  if (Z.sel >= (int)Z.store->list().size()) Z.sel = std::max(0, (int)Z.store->list().size() - 1);
}

std::vector<std::string> scan_fixtures() {
  std::vector<std::string> out;
  namespace fs = std::filesystem;
  std::vector<fs::path> bases;
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_FIXTURES_DIR")) if (*e) bases.push_back(fs::u8path(e));
  std::error_code ec;
  bases.push_back(fs::current_path(ec) / "build" / "fixtures" / "saves");
  wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH];
  if (GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH)) {
    fs::path d = fs::path(exe).parent_path();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4 && d.has_parent_path(); ++i, d = d.parent_path()) bases.push_back(d / "fixtures" / "saves");
    bases.push_back(fs::path(exe).parent_path() / ".." / ".." / "build" / "fixtures" / "saves");
  }
  for (auto& b : bases) {
    if (!fs::is_directory(b, ec)) continue;
    for (fs::directory_iterator it(b, ec), end; !ec && it != end; it.increment(ec)) {
      std::error_code e2;
      if (!it->is_directory(e2)) continue;
      auto u = fs::weakly_canonical(it->path(), e2).u8string();
      std::string s(u.begin(), u.end());
      if (pr::looks_like_save(s) && std::find(out.begin(), out.end(), s) == out.end()) out.push_back(s);
    }
    if (!out.empty()) break;
  }
  return out;
}

void open_folder(const std::string& dir) {
  std::error_code ec;
  std::filesystem::create_directories(std::filesystem::u8path(dir), ec);
  std::wstring w = std::filesystem::u8path(dir).wstring();
  ShellExecuteW(nullptr, L"open", w.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
}

void pick_folder_async() {
  if (Z.picking.exchange(true)) return;
  std::thread([] {
    std::string result;
    if (SUCCEEDED(CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED))) {
      IFileOpenDialog* dlg = nullptr;
      if (SUCCEEDED(CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_ALL, IID_PPV_ARGS(&dlg)))) {
        DWORD fl = 0;
        dlg->GetOptions(&fl);
        dlg->SetOptions(fl | FOS_PICKFOLDERS | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM);
        dlg->SetTitle(L"Choose a save folder to import");
        if (SUCCEEDED(dlg->Show(nullptr))) {
          IShellItem* it = nullptr;
          if (SUCCEEDED(dlg->GetResult(&it))) {
            PWSTR p = nullptr;
            if (SUCCEEDED(it->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &p))) {
              auto u = std::filesystem::path(p).u8string();
              result.assign(u.begin(), u.end());
              CoTaskMemFree(p);
            }
            it->Release();
          }
        }
        dlg->Release();
      }
      CoUninitialize();
    }
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(Z.mu); Z.picked = result; }
    Z.picking = false;
  }).detach();
}

// Working directory at startup: host\play.ps1 and run_boot.ps1 start the game from the project root and the command line holds relative paths
// (--trace analysisoot\play_trace.log), so the relaunch uses the same directory even if something changed it since.
const std::wstring g_start_cwd = [] { wchar_t b[MAX_PATH * 2]; DWORD n = GetCurrentDirectoryW(MAX_PATH * 2, b); return n && n < MAX_PATH * 2 ? std::wstring(b, n) : std::wstring(); }();

// Relaunch the game the way host\play.ps1 starts it: same exe and arguments, same working directory, same environment with the one-shot variables
// removed (SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT: the -SkipIntro script must not replay; SNAP_PROFILE_PICKER: no picker again), SNAP_PROFILE set to the chosen profile, and
// the redirected log handles inherited. When play.ps1 launched this process (SNAP_PLAY_ROOT) the new pid is written to build\play.restart so play.ps1 keeps
// its play.lock and follows the new process. The new process waits for this one to exit.
void restart_now(const std::string& profile_name) {
  wchar_t exe[MAX_PATH * 2];
  if (!GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe, MAX_PATH * 2)) { say("Cannot find the game executable.", true); return; }
  std::wstring cmd = GetCommandLineW();
  int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, profile_name.c_str(), -1, nullptr, 0);
  std::wstring wn((size_t)std::max(n, 1), L'\0');
  MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, profile_name.c_str(), -1, &wn[0], n);
  SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"SNAP_PROFILE", wn.c_str());
  SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"SNAP_RESTART_WAIT_PID", std::to_wstring(GetCurrentProcessId()).c_str());
  SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"SNAP_PROFILE_PICKER", L"0");
  SetEnvironmentVariableW(L"SNAP_INPUT_SCRIPT", nullptr);
  hle::settings::forget_exported_env();   // SNAP_LOOK / SNAP_SSAO_QUALITY come from the profile settings; the new process reads the saved values
  if (const char* alt = std::getenv("SNAP_UI_TEST_RESTART")) if (*alt) SetEnvironmentVariableA("SNAP_UI_TEST", alt);   // the relaunched game runs the follow-up script
  STARTUPINFOW si{};
  si.cb = sizeof si;
  HANDLE hin = GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE), hout = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE), herr = GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
  BOOL inherit = FALSE;
  if (hout && hout != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && herr && herr != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {   // keep the log redirection of the parent
    SetHandleInformation(hout, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT);
    SetHandleInformation(herr, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT);
    si.dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES;
    si.hStdInput = (hin && hin != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) ? hin : nullptr;
    si.hStdOutput = hout;
    si.hStdError = herr;
    inherit = TRUE;
  }
  PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
  const wchar_t* cwd = g_start_cwd.empty() ? nullptr : g_start_cwd.c_str();
  // Break away from the launcher's job object when it allows that (hidden test runs close the job when the first process exits and would kill the new game);
  // without permission start it inside the job.
  BOOL started = CreateProcessW(exe, &cmd[0], nullptr, nullptr, inherit, CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, nullptr, cwd, &si, &pi);
  if (!started) started = CreateProcessW(exe, &cmd[0], nullptr, nullptr, inherit, 0, nullptr, cwd, &si, &pi);
  if (!started) {
    say("Could not start the game again (error " + std::to_string(GetLastError()) + ").", true);
    return;
  }
  hle::log("ui: restart: relaunched as pid %lu with profile \"%s\"", (unsigned long)pi.dwProcessId, profile_name.c_str());
  if (const char* pr = std::getenv("SNAP_PLAY_ROOT")) if (*pr) {
    std::ofstream f(std::filesystem::u8path(pr) / "build" / "play.restart", std::ios::trunc);
    f << pi.dwProcessId << '\n';
  }
  CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
  CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
  TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0);   // the save layer commits atomically; unsaved progress is lost
}

// A button that must be held; returns true once when the hold completes. Works with mouse, keyboard (Enter) and the gamepad.
bool hold_button(const char* label, float secs, const ImVec4& color) {
  static ImGuiID held = 0;
  static double since = 0;
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, color);
  ImGui::Button(label);
  ImGui::PopStyleColor();
  ImGuiID id = ImGui::GetItemID();
  if (ImGui::IsItemActive()) {
    if (held != id) { held = id; since = now_secs(); }
    float f = (float)((now_secs() - since) / secs);
    ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetItemRectMin(), b = ImGui::GetItemRectMax();
    ImGui::GetWindowDrawList()->AddRectFilled(a, ImVec2(a.x + (b.x - a.x) * std::min(1.0f, f), b.y), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 70), ImGui::GetStyle().FrameRounding);
    if (f >= 1.0f) { held = 0; return true; }
  } else if (held == id) {
    held = 0;
  }
  return false;
}

// "Import test save" button body (also used by the scripted test): imports a fixture folder as a new profile named after it.
std::string import_fixture(pr::Store& st, const std::string& f, std::string* err) {
  std::string base = std::filesystem::u8path(f).filename().string(), name = base;
  for (int i = 2; st.find(name); ++i) name = base + " " + std::to_string(i);
  if (st.import_folder(f, name, err).empty()) return "";
  return name;
}

void copy_name(char* dst, size_t n, const std::string& s) { std::snprintf(dst, n, "%s", s.c_str()); }

}  // namespace

bool hold_confirm(const char* label, float secs, const ImVec4& color) { return hold_button(label, secs, color); }
void restart_game() { const pr::Active& a = pr::active(); restart_now(a.on ? a.name : std::string()); }

// Scripted-test entry points: the same code the buttons run, without a mouse click.
bool saves_test_import(const std::string& fixture, std::string* name_out, std::string* err) {
  Z.root = find_root();
  if (Z.root.empty()) { *err = "profiles are off"; return false; }
  Z.store.reset(new pr::Store(Z.root));
  Z.store->load();
  for (auto& f : scan_fixtures()) {
    if (std::filesystem::u8path(f).filename().string() != fixture) continue;
    std::string n = import_fixture(*Z.store, f, err);
    if (n.empty()) return false;
    *name_out = n;
    return true;
  }
  *err = "fixture not found: " + fixture;
  return false;
}
void saves_test_switch(const std::string& name) { restart_now(name); }

void saves_tab_opened() { Z.loaded_at = -100; Z.confirm = SavesState::None; }

void tab_saves() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  const float lh = ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing();
  Z.root = find_root();
  if (Z.root.empty()) {
    ImGui::TextWrapped("Save profiles are off in this run (the save folder is set by SNAP_SAVE_DIR or hle.json). Start the game without that setting to use profiles.");
    return;
  }
  if (now_secs() - Z.loaded_at > 3.0 || !Z.store) reload();
  if (now_secs() - Z.fixtures_at > 5.0) { Z.fixtures = scan_fixtures(); Z.fixtures_at = now_secs(); }
  {   // results of the folder dialog
    std::string p;
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(Z.mu); p.swap(Z.picked); }
    if (!p.empty()) { Z.import_src = p; copy_name(Z.import_name, sizeof Z.import_name, Z.store->next_free_name()); }
  }
  pr::Store& st = *Z.store;
  const pr::Active& act = pr::active();

  ImGui::TextWrapped("A profile is a separate save. The game is running profile \"%s\". Switching profile, and clearing or deleting the running one, take effect after a restart.",
                     act.on ? act.name.c_str() : "?");
  if (Z.restart_needed) {
    ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "A change is waiting for a restart.");
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Restart now")) restart_now(act.on ? act.name : "");
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("(unsaved progress in the running game is lost)");
  }
  if (!act.note.empty()) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%s", act.note.c_str());
  if (ImGui::GetTime() < Z.msg_until) ImGui::TextColored(Z.msg_err ? t.error : t.good, "%s", Z.msg.c_str());
  ImGui::Spacing();

  // ---- list
  const auto& list = st.list();
  if (ImGui::BeginTable("profiles", 4, ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg | ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerV | ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY, ImVec2(0, lh * 6.4f))) {
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Profile", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 2.0f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Last played", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.4f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Save size", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.0f);
    ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Status", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch, 1.6f);
    ImGui::TableSetupScrollFreeze(0, 1);
    ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)list.size(); ++i) {
      const pr::Profile& p = list[(size_t)i];
      ImGui::TableNextRow();
      ImGui::TableNextColumn();
      ImGui::PushID(i);
      if (ImGui::Selectable(p.name.c_str(), Z.sel == i, ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAllColumns, ImVec2(0, lh * 0.9f))) { Z.sel = i; Z.confirm = SavesState::None; }
      ImGui::PopID();
      ImGui::TableNextColumn();
      ImGui::TextUnformatted(pr::format_time(p.last_played).c_str());
      ImGui::TableNextColumn();
      ImGui::TextUnformatted(pr::format_size(i < (int)Z.sizes.size() ? Z.sizes[(size_t)i] : 0).c_str());
      ImGui::TableNextColumn();
      if (act.on && p.id == act.id) {
        if (st.is_pending(p.id, "delete")) ImGui::TextColored(t.error, "Running - delete on restart");
        else if (st.is_pending(p.id, "clear")) ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "Running - clear on restart");
        else ImGui::TextColored(t.good, "Running now");
      } else {
        ImGui::TextDisabled("-");
      }
    }
    ImGui::EndTable();
  }
  if (Z.sel < 0 || Z.sel >= (int)list.size()) { ImGui::TextDisabled("No profiles yet."); }
  else {
    const pr::Profile p = list[(size_t)Z.sel];   // a copy: reload() replaces the list
    const bool is_active = act.on && p.id == act.id;
    if (Z.last_sel != Z.sel) {
      Z.last_sel = Z.sel;
      copy_name(Z.rename_buf, sizeof Z.rename_buf, p.name);
      copy_name(Z.dup_buf, sizeof Z.dup_buf, p.name + " copy");
    }
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Selected: %s", p.name.c_str());
    if (!is_active) {
      if (ImGui::Button("Switch to this profile (restarts the game)")) restart_now(p.name);
      ImGui::SameLine();
    }
    if (ImGui::Button("Open folder")) open_folder(st.save_dir(p.id));
    // rename and duplicate
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(lh * 11);
    ImGui::InputText("##rename", Z.rename_buf, sizeof Z.rename_buf);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Rename")) {
      std::string e;
      if (st.rename(p.id, Z.rename_buf, &e)) { say("Renamed.", false); reload(); } else say(e, true);
    }
    ImGui::SameLine(0, lh * 1.5f);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(lh * 11);
    ImGui::InputText("##dup", Z.dup_buf, sizeof Z.dup_buf);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Duplicate")) {
      std::string e;
      std::string id = st.duplicate(p.id, Z.dup_buf, &e);
      if (!id.empty()) { say("Copied the latest saved state into a new profile.", false); reload(); } else say(e, true);
    }
    // clear and delete, two steps: arm, then hold
    if (Z.confirm == SavesState::None) {
      if (ImGui::Button("Clear save...")) Z.confirm = SavesState::Clear;
      ImGui::SameLine();
      if (ImGui::Button("Delete profile...")) Z.confirm = SavesState::Delete;
    } else {
      const bool clr = Z.confirm == SavesState::Clear;
      ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "%s \"%s\"? The data is moved to the trash (newest 10 kept) and can be restored below.%s",
                         clr ? "Clear the save of" : "Delete the profile", p.name.c_str(),
                         is_active ? " It is running now, so this happens at the next start." : "");
      if (hold_button(clr ? "Hold to clear the save" : "Hold to delete the profile", 1.5f, t.error)) {
        std::string e;
        bool ok = true;
        if (is_active) { st.queue(clr ? "clear" : "delete", p.id); Z.restart_needed = true; say("Queued: it happens at the next start. Use Restart now to start fresh.", false); }
        else if (clr) { ok = st.clear(p.id, &e); if (ok) say("Save cleared; the old data is in the trash.", false); }
        else { ok = st.remove(p.id, &e); if (ok) say("Profile deleted; its data is in the trash.", false); }
        if (!ok) say(e, true);
        Z.confirm = SavesState::None;
        reload();
      }
      ImGui::SameLine();
      if (ImGui::Button("Cancel")) Z.confirm = SavesState::None;
    }
  }

  // ---- create and import
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(lh * 11);
  ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##new", "New profile name", Z.new_name, sizeof Z.new_name);
  ImGui::SameLine();
  if (ImGui::Button("Create profile")) {
    std::string e;
    std::string name = Z.new_name[0] ? Z.new_name : st.next_free_name();
    if (!st.create(name, &e).empty()) { say("Created \"" + name + "\".", false); Z.new_name[0] = 0; reload(); } else say(e, true);
  }
  ImGui::SameLine(0, lh * 1.5f);
  if (ImGui::Button(Z.picking ? "Choosing a folder..." : "Import save from folder...")) pick_folder_async();
  if (!Z.import_src.empty()) {
    ImGui::TextWrapped("Import %s as", Z.import_src.c_str());
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(lh * 11);
    ImGui::InputText("##impname", Z.import_name, sizeof Z.import_name);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Import")) {
      std::string e;
      if (!st.import_folder(Z.import_src, Z.import_name, &e).empty()) { say("Imported into a new profile.", false); Z.import_src.clear(); reload(); } else say(e, true);
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Cancel import")) Z.import_src.clear();
  }
  if (!Z.fixtures.empty() && ImGui::TreeNode("Import test save")) {
    ImGui::TextDisabled("Test saves found next to the build. Each one becomes a new profile.");
    for (auto& f : Z.fixtures) {
      std::string base = std::filesystem::u8path(f).filename().string();
      std::string label = "Import \"" + base + "\"";
      if (ImGui::Button(label.c_str())) {
        std::string e, name = import_fixture(st, f, &e);
        if (!name.empty()) { say("Imported \"" + name + "\" into a new profile.", false); reload(); } else say(e, true);
      }
    }
    ImGui::TreePop();
  }

  // ---- trash
  if (ImGui::TreeNode("Restore from trash")) {
    if (Z.trash.empty()) ImGui::TextDisabled("The trash is empty. Cleared and deleted saves wait here; the newest 10 are kept.");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Z.trash.size(); ++i) {
      const auto& e = Z.trash[i];
      ImGui::PushID((int)i);
      ImGui::Text("%s   %s   %s   %s", e.name.c_str(), e.kind == "delete" ? "deleted" : "cleared", pr::format_time(e.when).c_str(), pr::format_size(e.size).c_str());
      ImGui::SameLine();
      if (ImGui::SmallButton("Restore")) {
        std::string err;
        if (!st.restore(e.folder, &err).empty()) { say("Restored into a new profile.", false); reload(); } else say(err, true);
        ImGui::PopID();
        break;
      }
      ImGui::PopID();
    }
    ImGui::TreePop();
  }
}

}  // namespace snap::ui
```

`runtime/ui/ui_shaders.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Shader precompile UI over the C API in runtime/nvn/shaderprecompile.h (analysis/perf/shader_precompile_api.md):
//   - first-launch prompt (mode UNSET): compile now vs compile while playing
//   - progress screen while the game is held (mode NOW and a run in progress): percentage, ETA, Cancel / Continue in background
//   - "Graphics" tab of the F1 menu: mode, status, "Compile all known shaders now", "Rebuild shader cache"
// All three work with mouse, keyboard and controller (ImGui navigation).
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

#include "hle/hle_config.h"
#include "hle/profiles.h"
#include "nvn/shaderprecompile.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"

namespace snap::ui {

namespace {

struct ShaderUi {
  bool prompt_done = false;     // the user chose (or the prompt is off for this run)
  double first_seen = -1;
  bool was_screen = false;
  bool focus_next = true;
  std::string msg;
  bool msg_err = false;
  double msg_until = 0;
  bool confirm_rebuild = false;
  bool demo = false;            // SNAP_SHADER_UI_DEMO=1: a simulated progress screen for screenshots and controller tests (no compiling)
  double demo_start = -1;
  double demo_t = 0;            // seconds since the demo screen started (same clock as `now` in shader_screen_active)
};
ShaderUi Q;

bool env_set(const char* n) { const char* e = std::getenv(n); return e && *e; }

// Test runs must never get a modal prompt: they use SNAP_SAVE_DIR / SNAP_UI_TEST / SNAP_SHADER_PRECOMPILE.
bool prompt_enabled() {
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_SHADER_PROMPT")) if (*e) return *e != '0';
  if (env_set("SNAP_SAVE_DIR") || env_set("SNAP_UI_TEST") || env_set("SNAP_SHADER_PRECOMPILE") || hle::config().headless) return false;
  return true;
}

std::string cache_dir() {
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_SHADERCACHE_DIR")) if (*e) return e;
  if (const char* e = std::getenv("SNAP_CONFIG_DIR")) if (*e) return std::string(e) + "\\shadercache";
  return hle::default_data_root() + "\\shadercache";
}

std::string minutes_text(double sec) {
  if (sec < 0) return "estimating";
  if (sec < 45) return "under a minute";
  int m = (int)std::ceil(sec / 60.0);
  return "about " + std::to_string(m) + (m == 1 ? " minute" : " minutes");
}
std::string eta_text(double sec) {
  if (sec < 0) return "estimating the time left...";
  int s = (int)std::ceil(sec);
  char b[64];
  if (s >= 60) std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "about %d min %02d s left", s / 60, s % 60);
  else std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, "about %d s left", std::max(s, 1));
  return b;
}

void centered_window(const ImVec2& size, float w_frac, float max_w, const char* id, ImVec2* out_pos, float* out_w, float* out_h, float h_lines_hint) {
  const float w = std::min(size.x * w_frac, max_w * size.y / 1080.0f);
  const float h = ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing() * h_lines_hint;
  *out_pos = ImVec2((size.x - w) * 0.5f, (size.y - h) * 0.5f);
  *out_w = w;
  *out_h = h;
  (void)id;
}

void say(const std::string& m, bool err) { Q.msg = m; Q.msg_err = err; Q.msg_until = ImGui::GetTime() + 8; }

}  // namespace

bool shader_screen_active(double now) {
  if (Q.first_seen < 0) { Q.first_seen = now; Q.demo = env_set("SNAP_SHADER_UI_DEMO"); }
  if (Q.demo) {
    if (Q.demo_start < 0) Q.demo_start = now;
    Q.demo_t = now - Q.demo_start;
    return Q.demo_t > 1.0 && Q.demo_t < 60.0;
  }
  if (shaderprecompile_is_holding_game()) return true;   // progress screen
  if (!Q.prompt_done) {
    if (!prompt_enabled() || shaderprecompile_get_mode() != SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_UNSET) { Q.prompt_done = true; return false; }
    return now - Q.first_seen > 1.5;   // a short beat so the first frame of the game is not covered at once
  }
  return false;
}

void draw_shader_screen(ImVec2 size) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  const bool holding = Q.demo || shaderprecompile_is_holding_game() != 0;
  ImDrawList* bg = ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
  bg->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(0, 0), size, holding ? ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.957f, 0.949f, 0.941f, 0.97f)) : ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.42f)));

  ImVec2 pos;
  float w, h;
  centered_window(size, 0.62f, 980.0f, "shader", &pos, &w, &h, holding ? 15.0f : 19.0f);
  ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(pos);
  ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(w, 0));
  if (!holding) style_shadow(bg, pos, ImVec2(w, h), t.window_round * ImGui::GetFontSize() / t.font_px);
  ImGuiWindowFlags wf = ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings |
                        ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse;
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, t.panel);
  ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, t.accent_hover);
  ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(t.window_pad * 1.6f * ImGui::GetFontSize() / t.font_px, t.window_pad * 1.4f * ImGui::GetFontSize() / t.font_px));
  if (ImGui::Begin("##shaderscreen", nullptr, wf)) {
    ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x);
    const float bh = ImGui::GetTextLineHeight() * 2.3f;
    if (holding) {
      uint32_t done = 0, total = 0;
      double eta = -1;
      shaderprecompile_progress(&done, &total, &eta);
      if (Q.demo) {   // fake numbers: 800 pipelines at 25 per second
        total = 800;
        done = std::min<uint32_t>(total, (uint32_t)((Q.demo_t - 1.0) * 25.0));
        eta = (total - done) / 25.0;
      }
      const float frac = total ? std::min(1.0f, (float)done / (float)total) : 0.0f;
      ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Compiling shaders");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      ImGui::TextUnformatted("The game starts when this finishes. This makes play smoother, with fewer pauses when new effects appear.");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      char ov[96];
      std::snprintf(ov, sizeof ov, "%d%%   (%u of %u)", (int)(frac * 100.0f + 0.5f), done, total);
      ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PlotHistogram, t.accent);
      ImGui::ProgressBar(frac, ImVec2(-1, bh * 0.8f), ov);
      ImGui::PopStyleColor();
      ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%s", total ? eta_text(eta).c_str() : "starting...");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      ImGui::Spacing();
      if (Q.focus_next) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); Q.focus_next = false; }
      if (ImGui::Button("Continue in background", ImVec2(w * 0.44f, bh))) {
        if (Q.demo) Q.demo_start = -1e9; else shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING);   // releases the game; the compile goes on at low priority
        Q.prompt_done = true;
      }
      ImGui::SameLine();
      if (ImGui::Button("Cancel", ImVec2(w * 0.28f, bh))) {
        if (Q.demo) Q.demo_start = -1e9; else shaderprecompile_cancel();
        Q.prompt_done = true;
      }
      ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Continue in background starts the game now and keeps compiling while you play (this also sets the mode to \"Compile while playing\"). Cancel stops compiling; missing shaders are then built when the game first needs them.");
    } else {
      const double est = shaderprecompile_estimate_seconds();
      const bool can_now = est > 0.0;
      ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Shader compilation");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      ImGui::TextUnformatted("The game's graphics shaders are built for your graphics card the first time they are needed. Doing that in advance avoids pauses and stutter during play. Choose when to do it:");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      if (can_now) {
        ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Compile now covers the shaders this game has already used on this PC, about %s. Shaders it has not used yet are still built while you play.", minutes_text(est).c_str());
      } else {
        ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "Compile now is not available yet. This is the first run on this PC, so no shaders have been recorded and there is no list to compile in advance. The game records them as you play, and from the next launch you can compile them all at startup (F1 > Graphics).");
      }
      ImGui::Spacing();
      ImGui::Spacing();
      std::string l1 = can_now ? "Compile shaders now (" + minutes_text(est) + ", smoother play)" : "Compile shaders now (nothing recorded yet)";
      if (!can_now) ImGui::BeginDisabled();
      if (can_now && Q.focus_next) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); Q.focus_next = false; }
      if (ImGui::Button(l1.c_str(), ImVec2(-1, bh))) {
        shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW);
        Q.prompt_done = true;
      }
      if (!can_now) ImGui::EndDisabled();
      if (!can_now && Q.focus_next) { ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(); Q.focus_next = false; }
      if (ImGui::Button("Compile while playing (start now, possible brief stutter)", ImVec2(-1, bh))) {
        shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING);
        Q.prompt_done = true;
      }
      ImGui::Spacing();
      ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "You can change this later in the F1 menu, Graphics tab.");
      ImGui::Spacing();
      style_footer_prompts(false, false);
    }
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
  }
  ImGui::End();
  ImGui::PopStyleVar();
  ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
  Q.was_screen = true;
}

void shader_screen_closed() { Q.focus_next = true; Q.was_screen = false; }

// ---- Graphics tab -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
void shader_cache_section() {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Shader cache");
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Pipelines are compiled from shaders as the game needs them and saved in %s. Compiling ahead of time avoids stutter.", cache_dir().c_str());
  ImGui::Spacing();

  int mode = shaderprecompile_get_mode();
  ImGui::Text("When to compile:");
  bool now_mode = mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW;
  bool play_mode = mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING;
  if (ImGui::RadioButton("Compile at startup (the game waits, smoothest play)", now_mode)) shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW);
  if (ImGui::RadioButton("Compile while playing (starts at once, possible brief stutter)", play_mode)) shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_PLAYING);
  if (mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_UNSET) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Not chosen yet; the game behaves like \"while playing\".");
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Takes effect at the next start for \"at startup\"; \"while playing\" applies now.");
  ImGui::Spacing();

  uint32_t done = 0, total = 0;
  double eta = -1;
  shaderprecompile_progress(&done, &total, &eta);
  const int st = shaderprecompile_state();
  const char* stn = st == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING ? "compiling" : st == SHADERPRECOMPILE_DONE ? "finished" : st == SHADERPRECOMPILE_CANCELLED ? "cancelled" : "idle";
  ImGui::Text("Status: %s", stn);
  if (st == SHADERPRECOMPILE_RUNNING && total) {
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PlotHistogram, t.accent);
    ImGui::ProgressBar((float)done / (float)total, ImVec2(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.6f, 0));
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(eta_text(eta).c_str());
  } else if (total) {
    ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "Last run: %u of %u pipelines.", done, total);
  }
  const uint32_t pending = shaderprecompile_background_pending();
  if (pending) ImGui::TextColored(t.conflict, "%u shaders the game asked for are still compiling in the background.", pending);
  const double est = shaderprecompile_estimate_seconds();
  if (est > 0) ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "A full compile takes %s on this PC.", minutes_text(est).c_str());
  ImGui::Spacing();

  if (ImGui::Button("Compile all known shaders now")) {
    int n = shaderprecompile_begin();
    say(n > 0 ? "Queued " + std::to_string(n) + " pipelines." : "Nothing to compile: everything known is already built.", false);
  }
  ImGui::SameLine();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, mode == SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW ? "The game pauses on a progress screen while it runs." : "Runs in the background while you play.");

  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::Separator();
  ImGui::Spacing();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.title, "Rebuild shader cache");
  ImGui::TextWrapped("Throws away the saved graphics-driver cache and compiles every recorded shader again, for example after a driver update or when you see graphical glitches. The game restarts and shows the progress screen; unsaved progress is lost.");
  if (!Q.confirm_rebuild) {
    if (ImGui::Button("Rebuild shader cache...")) Q.confirm_rebuild = true;
  } else {
    if (hold_confirm("Hold to rebuild and restart", 1.5f, t.error)) {
      std::error_code ec;
      std::filesystem::remove(std::filesystem::u8path(cache_dir()) / "pipeline_cache.bin", ec);
      shaderprecompile_set_mode(SHADERPRECOMPILE_MODE_NOW);
      Q.confirm_rebuild = false;
      restart_game();
      say("Could not restart the game; the cache was cleared and the next start will rebuild it.", true);
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Cancel")) Q.confirm_rebuild = false;
  }
  if (ImGui::GetTime() < Q.msg_until) { ImGui::Spacing(); ImGui::TextColored(Q.msg_err ? t.error : t.good, "%s", Q.msg.c_str()); }
}

}  // namespace snap::ui
```

`runtime/ui/ui_style.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Drawing helpers for the game-style look (palette in ui_theme.h, measurements in analysis/ui/style_ref.md): a soft card shadow and the
// controller-prompt glyphs (orange chevron with a white disc for face buttons, grey pill for shoulder buttons).
#include <cstring>

#include "ui_internal.h"

namespace snap::ui {

static ImU32 col32(const ImVec4& c) { return ImGui::GetColorU32(c); }

void style_shadow(ImDrawList* dl, ImVec2 pos, ImVec2 size, float round) {
  const float s = ImGui::GetFontSize() / theme().font_px;
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {   // stacked translucent rounded rects: cheap soft shadow, offset a little downward like the game's cards
    const float g = (3.0f + i * 3.5f) * s;
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(pos.x - g, pos.y - g + 8.0f * s), ImVec2(pos.x + size.x + g, pos.y + size.y + g + 8.0f * s), IM_COL32(60, 45, 30, 9), round + g);
  }
}

float style_prompt(const char* glyph, const char* label) {
  const Theme& t = theme();
  ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
  const float fs = ImGui::GetFontSize();
  const float h = fs * 1.35f;
  const bool face = std::strlen(glyph) == 1;
  const ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
  const float y0 = p.y + (ImGui::GetTextLineHeight() - h) * 0.5f;
  float w;
  if (face) {
    w = h * 1.45f;
    const float nose = h * 0.42f;   // chevron pointing right: the game's A and B prompt shape
    ImVec2 pts[5] = {{p.x, y0}, {p.x + w - nose, y0}, {p.x + w, y0 + h * 0.5f}, {p.x + w - nose, y0 + h}, {p.x, y0 + h}};
    dl->AddConvexPolyFilled(pts, 5, col32(t.accent_hover));
    dl->AddPolyline(pts, 5, IM_COL32(150, 100, 70, 255), ImDrawFlags_Closed, 1.5f);
    const ImVec2 c(p.x + (w - nose) * 0.5f + h * 0.12f, y0 + h * 0.5f);
    dl->AddCircleFilled(c, h * 0.34f, IM_COL32(255, 250, 245, 255), 20);
    const ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(glyph);
    dl->AddText(ImVec2(c.x - ts.x * 0.5f, c.y - ts.y * 0.5f), col32(t.title), glyph);
  } else {
    const ImVec2 ts = ImGui::CalcTextSize(glyph);
    w = ts.x + h * 0.7f;
    dl->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(p.x, y0), ImVec2(p.x + w, y0 + h), col32(t.text_dim), h * 0.5f);
    dl->AddText(ImVec2(p.x + (w - ts.x) * 0.5f, y0 + (h - ts.y) * 0.5f), IM_COL32(255, 255, 255, 255), glyph);
  }
  ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(w, ImGui::GetTextLineHeight()));
  ImGui::SameLine(0, fs * 0.35f);
  ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
  ImGui::TextColored(t.text_dim, "%s", label);
  ImGui::SameLine(0, fs * 1.2f);
  return w;
}

void style_footer_prompts(bool tabs, bool back) {
  style_prompt("A", "Select");
  if (back) style_prompt("B", "Back");
  if (tabs) { style_prompt("LB", ""); style_prompt("RB", "Switch page"); }
  ImGui::NewLine();
}
```
