`runtime/ui/ui_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Scripted end-to-end test of the controls menu inside the real game window: SNAP_UI_TEST=<file>.
// One command per line, '#' starts a comment, times are seconds after the first present:
//   <t> key F1 [0|1]                post a real F1 key press to the game window (goes through the window procedure)
//   <t> tab <Bindings|Mouse|Controller|Accessibility|Test_input>
//   <t> rebind <A|B|...|Down> <kb|mouse|pad> <slot>     what a click on that slot does (starts the capture)
//   <t> press <key:P|pad:east|mouse:left|...> <seconds> hold a source down through the input hub
//   <t> expect_button <A|ZL|...> <0|1>                  the bit the game reads from npad 0
//   <t> expect_preview <A|...> <0|1>                    the mapped state while the menu hides input from the game
//   <t> expect_open <0|1> / expect_rebinding <0|1>
//   <t> expect_bind <A|...> <kb|mouse|pad> <slot> <src|none>
//   <t> shot <file.bmp>             copy the window client area from the screen (needs a visible window)
//   <t> opt <key> <value>, expect_opt, expect_when, expect_pending <n>, expect_env <NAME> <value>   option pages (ui_options.cpp); "-" = empty value
//   <t> mods <toggle|move> <id> [offset], expect_mods <id:1,id:0>, apply_restart   Mods tab and the Apply and restart button
//   <t> quit                        print the summary and exit the process
// Every check logs "ui-test: ... PASS|FAIL"; the summary line is "ui-test: SUMMARY n checks, m failed".
#include <windows.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "audio/audio_out.h"
#include "hle/hle.h"
#include "hle/input_core.h"
#include "hle/profiles.h"
#include "ui_internal.h"

namespace snap::ui {

using namespace hle::input;

namespace {

struct Cmd {
  double at;
  std::string line;
  bool done = false;
};
struct Release {
  double at;
  Source s;
};
std::vector<Cmd> g_cmds;
std::vector<Release> g_rel;
bool g_loaded = false, g_active = false;
double g_t0 = 0;
int g_checks = 0, g_failed = 0;
std::string g_last_import;

void out(const char* fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
void out(const char* fmt, ...) {
  char b[512];
  va_list ap;
  va_start(ap, fmt);
  std::vsnprintf(b, sizeof b, fmt, ap);
  va_end(ap);
  hle::log("ui-test: %s", b);
  std::fprintf(stderr, "ui-test: %s\n", b);
  std::fflush(stderr);
}

void check(bool ok, const std::string& what) {
  ++g_checks;
  if (!ok) ++g_failed;
  out("%s %s", what.c_str(), ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
}

Source parse_src(const std::string& s) {
  Source out_s;
  if (s != "none") parse_source(s, &out_s);
  return out_s;
}
bool parse_dev(const std::string& s, Device* d) {
  if (s == "kb") *d = kDevKeyboard;
  else if (s == "mouse") *d = kDevMouse;
  else if (s == "pad") *d = kDevController;
  else return false;
  return true;
}

void capture_window(std::string path) {
  HWND h = static_cast<HWND>(overlay_hwnd());
  if (!h) { out("shot: no window"); return; }
  std::thread([h, path]() {   // off the present thread: the swapchain must keep presenting while the screen is copied
    SetWindowPos(h, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
    Sleep(900);
    RECT cr;
    GetClientRect(h, &cr);
    POINT o = {0, 0};
    ClientToScreen(h, &o);
    int w = cr.right, ht = cr.bottom;
    HDC sdc = GetDC(nullptr), mdc = CreateCompatibleDC(sdc);
    HBITMAP bmp = CreateCompatibleBitmap(sdc, w, ht);
    SelectObject(mdc, bmp);
    BitBlt(mdc, 0, 0, w, ht, sdc, o.x, o.y, SRCCOPY);
    BITMAPINFOHEADER bi = {sizeof(bi), w, -ht, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
    std::vector<uint8_t> px((size_t)w * ht * 4);
    GetDIBits(mdc, bmp, 0, ht, px.data(), (BITMAPINFO*)&bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
    BITMAPFILEHEADER fh = {0x4d42, (DWORD)(sizeof(fh) + sizeof(bi) + px.size()), 0, 0, sizeof(fh) + sizeof(bi)};
    if (FILE* f = std::fopen(path.c_str(), "wb")) {
      std::fwrite(&fh, sizeof(fh), 1, f);
      std::fwrite(&bi, sizeof(bi), 1, f);
      std::fwrite(px.data(), 1, px.size(), f);
      std::fclose(f);
    }
    DeleteObject(bmp);
    DeleteDC(mdc);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, sdc);
    SetWindowPos(h, HWND_NOTOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE);
    out("shot: wrote %s (%dx%d)", path.c_str(), w, ht);
  }).detach();
}

void run(const std::string& line, double t) {
  std::istringstream is(line);
  std::string cmd;
  is >> cmd;
  if (cmd == "key") {
    std::string k;
    int want = -1;   // optional: only press when the menu is not already in the wanted state (real input may interfere)
    is >> k >> want;
    HWND h = static_cast<HWND>(overlay_hwnd());
    if (want >= 0 && overlay_open() == (want != 0)) { out("t=%.1f menu already in wanted state, F1 skipped", t); }
    else if (k == "F1" && h) {
      PostMessageW(h, WM_KEYDOWN, VK_F1, 0x003b0001);
      PostMessageW(h, WM_KEYUP, VK_F1, (LPARAM)0xC03b0001);
      out("t=%.1f posted F1 to the game window", t);
    }
  } else if (cmd == "tab") {
    static std::string name;
    is >> name;
    for (auto& c : name) if (c == '_') c = ' ';
    menu_select_tab(name.c_str());
  } else if (cmd == "rebind") {
    std::string a, d;
    int slot = 0;
    is >> a >> d >> slot;
    Device dev;
    int act = button_from_name(a);
    check(act >= 0 && act <= kDown && parse_dev(d, &dev) && menu_begin_rebind(act, dev, slot), "rebind " + a + " " + d + " " + std::to_string(slot) + " started");
  } else if (cmd == "press") {
    std::string src;
    double secs = 0.3;
    is >> src >> secs;
    Source s = parse_src(src);
    check(s.kind != Source::None, "press " + src);
    hub().inject_source(s, true);
    g_rel.push_back({t + secs, s});
  } else if (cmd == "expect_button" || cmd == "expect_preview") {
    std::string n;
    int want = 1;
    is >> n >> want;
    int b = button_from_name(n);
    hub().poll(0);
    PadSample p = cmd == "expect_button" ? hub().pad() : hub().preview();
    bool down = b >= 0 && ((p.buttons >> b) & 1);
    check(b >= 0 && down == (want != 0), cmd + " " + n + " == " + std::to_string(want) + " (buttons=" + std::to_string((unsigned long long)p.buttons) + ")");
  } else if (cmd == "vol" || cmd == "expect_vol") {   // vol <master|bgm|se|voice> <percent> ; expect_vol checks snap_audio_get_volume
    std::string c;
    float pct = 0;
    is >> c >> pct;
    int cat = c == "master" ? SNAP_VOL_MASTER : c == "bgm" ? SNAP_VOL_BGM : c == "se" ? SNAP_VOL_SE : SNAP_VOL_VOICE;
    if (cmd == "vol") { snap_audio_set_volume(cat, pct / 100.0f); out("t=%.1f set volume %s = %.0f%%", t, c.c_str(), pct); }
    else check(std::fabs(snap_audio_get_volume(cat) - pct / 100.0f) < 0.006f, "volume " + c + " == " + std::to_string((int)pct) + "% (got " + std::to_string((int)std::lround(snap_audio_get_volume(cat) * 100.0f)) + "%)");
  } else if (cmd == "opt") {   // opt <key> <value|-> : what changing the control does ("-" = empty value)
    std::string k, v;
    is >> k >> v;
    if (v == "-") v.clear();
    check(options_test_set(k, v), "set option " + k + " = '" + v + "'");
  } else if (cmd == "expect_opt") {   // expect_opt <key> <value|->
    std::string k, v;
    is >> k >> v;
    if (v == "-") v.clear();
    const std::string got = options_test_get(k);
    check(got == v, "option " + k + " == '" + v + "' (is '" + got + "')");
  } else if (cmd == "scroll") {   // scroll <0..1>: the option list of the open page
    float f = 0;
    is >> f;
    options_test_scroll(f);
  } else if (cmd == "expect_when") {   // expect_when <key> <live|restart|soon>
    std::string k, w, got;
    is >> k >> w;
    check(options_test_option_when(k, &got) && got == w, "option " + k + " is " + w + " (is '" + got + "')");
  } else if (cmd == "expect_pending") {   // expect_pending <n>: settings that wait for a restart
    int n = 0;
    is >> n;
    std::string names;
    const int got = options_pending_restart(&names);
    check(got == n, "pending restart options == " + std::to_string(n) + " (is " + std::to_string(got) + ": " + names + ")");
  } else if (cmd == "expect_env") {   // expect_env <NAME> <value|->: the env var the game reads at start
    std::string n, v;
    is >> n >> v;
    const char* e = std::getenv(n.c_str());
    if (v == "-") v.clear();
    check(std::string(e ? e : "") == v, "env " + n + " == '" + v + "' (is '" + (e ? e : "") + "')");
  } else if (cmd == "mods") {   // mods <toggle|move> <pack id> [offset]: what the Mods tab buttons do (writes mods.json)
    std::string op, id, state;
    int arg = 0;
    is >> op >> id >> arg;
    check(options_test_mods(op, id, arg, &state), "mods " + op + " " + id + " " + std::to_string(arg));
  } else if (cmd == "expect_mods") {   // expect_mods <id:1,id:0,...> : packs in priority order with enabled flags
    std::string want, state;
    is >> want;
    options_test_mods("read", "", 0, &state);
    check(state == want, "mods state == " + want + " (is " + state + ")");
  } else if (cmd == "apply_restart") {   // the "Apply and restart" button
    out("t=%.1f apply and restart (the game restarts)", t);
    std::fflush(stderr);
    restart_game();
  } else if (cmd == "expect_open") {
    int want = 1;
    is >> want;
    check(overlay_open() == (want != 0), "menu open == " + std::to_string(want));
  } else if (cmd == "expect_rebinding") {
    int want = 1;
    is >> want;
    check(menu_rebinding() == (want != 0), "rebinding == " + std::to_string(want));
  } else if (cmd == "expect_bind") {
    std::string a, d, src;
    int slot = 0;
    is >> a >> d >> slot >> src;
    Device dev;
    int act = button_from_name(a);
    bool ok = act >= 0 && parse_dev(d, &dev);
    Source got = ok ? slot_get(action_sources(hub().mapping(), act), dev, slot) : Source{};
    check(ok && got == parse_src(src), "binding " + a + " " + d + " " + std::to_string(slot) + " == " + src + " (is '" + source_to_string(got) + "')");
  } else if (cmd == "saves_import") {   // saves_import <fixture folder name>: what "Import test save" does; remembers the new profile name
    std::string fx, err;
    is >> fx;
    static std::string last_import;
    check(saves_test_import(fx, &last_import, &err), "import test save " + fx);
    if (!err.empty()) out("  (%s)", err.c_str());
    g_last_import = last_import;
  } else if (cmd == "saves_switch") {    // saves_switch: "Switch to this profile" on the profile that was just imported; relaunches the game
    out("t=%.1f switching to profile \"%s\" (the game restarts)", t, g_last_import.c_str());
    std::fflush(stderr);
    saves_test_switch(g_last_import);
  } else if (cmd == "expect_profile") {   // expect_profile <name>: the running game's profile
    std::string n;
    std::getline(is >> std::ws, n);
    check(hle::profiles::active().on && hle::profiles::active().name == n, "profile is " + n);
  } else if (cmd == "save") {
    std::string err;
    check(hub().save(&err), "save " + err);
  } else if (cmd == "shot") {
    std::string p;
    is >> p;
    capture_window(p);
  } else if (cmd == "quit") {
    out("SUMMARY %d checks, %d failed", g_checks, g_failed);
    std::fflush(stderr);
    ExitProcess(g_failed ? 1 : 0);
  } else {
    out("unknown command '%s'", line.c_str());
  }
}

void load() {
  g_loaded = true;
  const char* path = std::getenv("SNAP_UI_TEST");
  if (!path || !*path) return;
  std::ifstream f(path);
  if (!f) { std::fprintf(stderr, "ui-test: cannot open %s\n", path); return; }
  std::string line;
  while (std::getline(f, line)) {
    size_t h = line.find('#');
    if (h != std::string::npos) line.resize(h);
    std::istringstream is(line);
    double at;
    if (!(is >> at)) continue;
    std::string rest;
    std::getline(is, rest);
    g_cmds.push_back({at, rest});
  }
  g_active = !g_cmds.empty();
  std::fprintf(stderr, "ui-test: %zu commands from %s\n", g_cmds.size(), path);
}

}  // namespace

bool test_active() { return g_active; }

void test_tick(double now) {
  if (!g_loaded) { load(); g_t0 = now; }
  if (!g_active) return;
  const double t = now - g_t0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < g_rel.size();) {
    if (t >= g_rel[i].at) { hub().inject_source(g_rel[i].s, false); g_rel.erase(g_rel.begin() + (long)i); } else ++i;
  }
  for (auto& c : g_cmds) {
    if (c.done || t < c.at) continue;
    c.done = true;
    run(c.line, t);
    break;   // one command per frame: the menu and the input hub get a frame to react
  }
}

}  // namespace snap::ui
```

```py
r"""Writes the local 'surround-bus' mod pack: Init.bnk with the mixer bus (id 508372457, parent of bgm/se/voice) channel
config changed from stereo (0x3102) to 0 = same as parent, so Wwise mixes 5.1 when the host reports 6 channels.
Read-only on extracted data; the result goes to %APPDATA%\SnapRecomp\mods\surround-bus (never commit it).
Run: python -I scripts\audio_make_surround_pack.py"""
import json, os, struct
src = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', 'extracted', 'drp-v262144', 'nx', 'Sound', 'master', 'Init.drp', 'Init.bnk')
d = bytearray(open(src, 'rb').read())
k = d.find(struct.pack('<II', 508372457, 3803692087))   # bus id, parent = Master Audio Bus
assert k > 0, 'mixer bus not found'
off = k + 44                                            # id, parent, 6 props, 5 bytes, then the u32 channel config
assert d[off:off + 4] == struct.pack('<I', 0x3102), 'unexpected channel config'
d[off:off + 4] = b'\0\0\0\0'
root = os.path.join(os.environ['APPDATA'], 'SnapRecomp', 'mods', 'surround-bus')
out = os.path.join(root, 'nx', 'Sound', 'master', 'Init.drp')
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
open(os.path.join(out, 'Init.bnk'), 'wb').write(d)
json.dump({"name": "Surround master bus", "version": "1.0.0", "author": "snaprecomp",
           "description": "Init.bnk mixer bus channel config stereo -> same as parent (5.1 capable)."}, open(os.path.join(root, 'pack.json'), 'w'))
print('wrote', out)
```

`scripts/audit_revisions.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic, re-runnable audit of the five New Pokemon Snap revisions.

Run:  python -I scripts/audit_revisions.py [--keys <prod.keys>]

Inputs (read-only): the XCI and four update NSPs plus the keyset, all passed to
NSTool by path (key contents are never read or printed here).
Outputs (ignored dirs only):
  extracted/<rev>/...            tik, cnmt NCA, program/control NCA, exefs, *.uncompressed.nso
  analysis/revisions/summary.json, summary.md, romfs-<rev>.txt, symbols-<rev>.json, rtti-<rev>.txt
No game data is embedded in this script.  Pure stdlib (works under python -I).
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import statistics
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = Path(os.environ.get("SNAP_DUMPS_DIR", str(ROOT / "dumps")))  # folder with the XCI/NSP files and prod.keys
NSTOOL = ROOT / "tools" / "nstool" / "nstool.exe"
OUT = ROOT / "analysis" / "revisions"
EXT = ROOT / "extracted"
BELOW_NORMAL = 0x00004000 if os.name == "nt" else 0

REVS = [
    ("v0", "n-pokemonsnap.xci"),
    ("v65536", "n-pokemonsnap_v65536.nsp"),
    ("v131072", "n_pokemon_snap_v131072.nsp"),
    ("v196608", "n-pokemon_snap_v196608.nsp"),
    ("v262144", "n-new_pokemon_snap_v262144.nsp"),
]


def load_pfs0():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pfs0", ROOT / "scripts" / "pfs0.py")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


pfs0 = load_pfs0()


def run(args, **kw):
    r = subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args], capture_output=True, text=True,
                       encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", creationflags=BELOW_NORMAL, **kw)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        while True:
            b = f.read(8 * 1024 * 1024)
            if not b:
                break
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- acquisition

def parse_cnmt_text(text):
    info = {"contents": []}
    m = re.search(r"Version:\s+\S+ \(v(\d+)\)", text)
    info["version"] = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
    m = re.search(r"TitleId:\s+(0x[0-9a-f]+)", text)
    info["title_id"] = m.group(1) if m else None
    m = re.search(r"Type:\s+(\w+) \(\d+\)\n\s+Attributes", text)
    info["meta_type"] = m.group(1) if m else None
    for m in re.finditer(r"Type:\s+(\w+) \(\d+\)\s+Id:\s+([0-9a-f]{32})\s+Size:\s+(0x[0-9a-f]+)\s+Hash:\s+([0-9a-f]{64})", text):
        info["contents"].append({"type": m.group(1), "id": m.group(2),
                                 "size": int(m.group(3), 16), "sha256": m.group(4)})
    return info


def acquire(rev, srcname, keys):
    d = EXT / rev
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = SRC / srcname
    meta = {"rev": rev, "source": srcname, "source_size": src.stat().st_size}
    entries = {}
    if srcname.endswith(".xci"):
        sec = d / "secure"
        if not (sec.exists() and any(sec.glob("*.cnmt.nca"))):
            sec.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            rc, out = run([NSTOOL, "-k", keys, "--secure", sec, src])
            if rc:
                raise RuntimeError("xci secure extract failed: " + out[-500:])
        cnmt_nca = next(sec.glob("*.cnmt.nca"))
        store = sec
        tik = None
    else:
        entries = {e["name"]: e for e in pfs0.inventory(src)}
        names = list(entries)
        cnmt_name = next(n for n in names if n.endswith(".cnmt.nca"))
        tik_name = next(n for n in names if n.endswith(".tik"))
        for n in (cnmt_name, tik_name):
            t = d / n
            if not t.exists():
                pfs0.extract(src, entries[n], t, False)
        cnmt_nca = d / cnmt_name
        tik = d / tik_name
        store = d
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cnmt_"))
    try:
        run([NSTOOL, "-k", keys, "--part0", tmp, cnmt_nca])
        cnmt_file = next(tmp.glob("*.cnmt"))
        rc, text = run([NSTOOL, "-k", keys, "-t", "cnmt", cnmt_file])
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    (d / "cnmt.txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    cnmt = parse_cnmt_text(text)
    meta["cnmt"] = cnmt
    for c in cnmt["contents"]:
        if c["type"] in ("Program", "Control"):
            nca = store / (c["id"] + ".nca")
            if not nca.exists() and entries:
                pfs0.extract(src, entries[c["id"] + ".nca"], nca, False)
            c["path"] = str(nca)
            c["hash_matches_cnmt"] = nca.stat().st_size == c["size"] and sha256_file(nca) == c["sha256"]
    prog_path = next(c["path"] for c in cnmt["contents"] if c["type"] == "Program")
    rc, hdrtxt = run([NSTOOL, "-k", keys] + (["--tik", tik] if tik else []) + [prog_path])
    for key, label in (("sdk_addon_version", r"SdkAddon Ver\.:\s+(.*)"), ("nca_dist_type", r"Dist\. Type:\s+(.*)"),
                       ("nca_key_generation", r"Key Generation:\s+(.*)")):
        mm = re.search(label, hdrtxt)
        meta[key] = mm.group(1).strip() if mm else None
    meta["tik"] = str(tik) if tik else None
    meta["cnmt_nca"] = str(cnmt_nca)
    if entries:
        meta["nsp_members"] = [{"name": n, "size": entries[n]["size"]} for n in entries]
        meta["nsp_content_nca_sizes_total"] = sum(e["size"] for n, e in entries.items() if n.endswith(".nca"))
    return meta


def nca_args(keys, meta):
    a = ["-k", keys]
    if meta["tik"]:
        a += ["--tik", meta["tik"]]
    return a


def content(meta, typ):
    return next(c for c in meta["cnmt"]["contents"] if c["type"] == typ)


def extract_exefs(rev, meta, keys):
    d = EXT / rev / "exefs"
    prog = content(meta, "Program")["path"]
    if not (d / "main").exists():
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        rc, out = run([NSTOOL] + nca_args(keys, meta) + ["--part0", d, prog])
        if not (d / "main").exists():
            raise RuntimeError("exefs extract failed: " + out[-500:])
    return d


def extract_nacp(rev, meta, keys):
    d = EXT / rev / "control"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    nacp = d / "control.nacp"
    if not nacp.exists():
        ctl = content(meta, "Control")["path"]
        run([NSTOOL] + nca_args(keys, meta) + ["-x", "/control.nacp", nacp, ctl])
        if not nacp.exists():
            tmp = d / "part0"
            run([NSTOOL] + nca_args(keys, meta) + ["--part0", tmp, ctl])
            if (tmp / "control.nacp").exists():
                (tmp / "control.nacp").replace(nacp)
    data = nacp.read_bytes()
    ver = data[0x3060:0x3070].split(b"\0")[0].decode("ascii", "replace")
    name = data[0:0x200].split(b"\0")[0].decode("utf-8", "replace")
    return {"display_version": ver, "title_en": name, "nacp_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- RomFS listings

def romfs_listing(meta, keys, base_nca):
    """Names only; sizes are not exposed by `nstool --fstree`. Returns paths relative to the
    NCA root, e.g. '1/common/...' (partition 1 = RomFS)."""
    prog = content(meta, "Program")["path"]
    args = [NSTOOL] + nca_args(keys, meta)
    if meta["rev"] != "v0":
        args += ["--basenca", base_nca]
    rc, out = run(args + ["--fstree", prog])
    lines = out.splitlines()
    try:
        i = next(k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if "ContentArchive/Tree" in l)
    except StopIteration:
        return None, out[-300:]
    files, stack = [], []
    for l in lines[i + 1:]:
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        depth = len(l) - len(l.lstrip(" "))
        name = l.strip()
        stack = stack[:depth - 1]
        if name.endswith("/"):
            stack.append(name.rstrip("/"))
        else:
            files.append("/".join(stack[1:] + [name]))
    return files, None


def by_dir(paths):
    d = {}
    for f in paths:
        p = f.split("/")
        k = "/".join(p[:3]) if len(p) > 3 else "/".join(p[:-1])
        d[k] = d.get(k, 0) + 1
    return dict(sorted(d.items()))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NSO handling

def lz4_block(src, size):
    """Pure-Python LZ4 block decompressor (no third-party deps, works under python -I)."""
    out = bytearray()
    i, n = 0, len(src)
    while i < n:
        tok = src[i]
        i += 1
        ll = tok >> 4
        if ll == 15:
            while True:
                b = src[i]
                i += 1
                ll += b
                if b != 255:
                    break
        out += src[i:i + ll]
        i += ll
        if i >= n:
            break
        off = src[i] | (src[i + 1] << 8)
        i += 2
        ml = tok & 15
        if ml == 15:
            while True:
                b = src[i]
                i += 1
                ml += b
                if b != 255:
                    break
        ml += 4
        start = len(out) - off
        if off >= ml:
            out += out[start:start + ml]
        else:
            chunk = bytes(out[start:])
            out += (chunk * (ml // off + 1))[:ml]
    if len(out) != size:
        raise ValueError("lz4 size mismatch")
    return bytes(out)


def read_nso(path):
    b = Path(path).read_bytes()
    assert b[:4] == b"NSO0", "not an NSO"
    flags = struct.unpack_from("<I", b, 0xC)[0]
    seg = []
    for i in range(3):
        fo, mo, ds = struct.unpack_from("<III", b, 0x10 + 0x10 * i)
        seg.append({"file_off": fo, "mem_off": mo, "decomp": ds})
    bss = struct.unpack_from("<I", b, 0x3C)[0]
    mid = b[0x40:0x60]
    csz = struct.unpack_from("<III", b, 0x60)
    hashes = [b[0xA0 + 0x20 * i:0xC0 + 0x20 * i] for i in range(3)]
    api = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, 0x88)
    dynstr = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, 0x90)
    dynsym = struct.unpack_from("<II", b, 0x98)
    data = []
    for i in range(3):
        raw = b[seg[i]["file_off"]:seg[i]["file_off"] + csz[i]]
        if flags & (1 << i):
            raw = lz4_block(raw, seg[i]["decomp"])
        assert len(raw) == seg[i]["decomp"]
        if flags & (1 << (3 + i)):
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).digest() == hashes[i], "segment hash mismatch"
        data.append(raw)
    return {"hdr": b[:0x100], "flags": flags, "seg": seg, "bss": bss, "module_id": mid,
            "csz": csz, "data": data, "api": api, "dynstr": dynstr, "dynsym": dynsym,
            "file_size": len(b)}


def write_uncompressed(nso, out):
    """Header + memory image (segments at 0x100 + mem_offset, gaps zero-filled), compression flags cleared."""
    hdr = bytearray(nso["hdr"])
    struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 0xC, nso["flags"] & ~7)
    struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 0x2C, 0)  # module-name size zeroed; matches the reference v262144 file hash
    body = bytearray(max(s["mem_off"] + s["decomp"] for s in nso["seg"]))
    for i, (s, raw) in enumerate(zip(nso["seg"], nso["data"])):
        struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 0x10 + 0x10 * i, 0x100 + s["mem_off"])
        struct.pack_into("<I", hdr, 0x60 + 4 * i, len(raw))
        body[s["mem_off"]:s["mem_off"] + len(raw)] = raw
    out.write_bytes(bytes(hdr) + bytes(body))


def image_of(nso):
    end = max(s["mem_off"] + s["decomp"] for s in nso["seg"])
    img = bytearray(end)
    for s, raw in zip(nso["seg"], nso["data"]):
        img[s["mem_off"]:s["mem_off"] + len(raw)] = raw
    return img


def dec_ptr(img, off, enc, base_hdr):
    fmt = {0x03: ("<I", 4), 0x0B: ("<i", 4), 0x04: ("<Q", 8), 0x0C: ("<q", 8)}[enc & 0x0F]
    v = struct.unpack_from(fmt[0], img, off)[0]
    app = enc & 0x70
    if app == 0x10:
        v += off
    elif app == 0x30:
        v += base_hdr
    return v, off + fmt[1]


def parse_fdes(img):
    res = {"mod0": False}
    try:
        mo = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, 4)[0]
        if img[mo:mo + 4] != b"MOD0":
            return res, []
        res["mod0"] = True
        dyn, bss_s, bss_e, eh_s, eh_e, rt = struct.unpack_from("<iiiiii", img, mo + 4)
        res["mod0_offset"] = mo
        res["bss_range"] = [mo + bss_s, mo + bss_e]
        ehh = mo + eh_s
        res["eh_frame_hdr"] = [ehh, mo + eh_e]
        ver, ptr_enc, cnt_enc, tab_enc = img[ehh:ehh + 4]
        off = ehh + 4
        _, off = dec_ptr(img, off, ptr_enc, ehh)
        cnt, off = dec_ptr(img, off, cnt_enc, ehh)
        res["fde_count"] = cnt
        fdes = []
        for i in range(cnt):
            a, off = dec_ptr(img, off, tab_enc, ehh)
            f, off = dec_ptr(img, off, tab_enc, ehh)
            length = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, f)[0]
            rng = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, f + 12)[0] if length else 0
            fdes.append((a, rng))
        return res, fdes
    except Exception as e:  # noqa
        res["fde_error"] = str(e)
        return res, []


def parse_dynsym(nso):
    ro = nso["data"][1]
    so, ss = nso["dynsym"]
    to, ts = nso["dynstr"]
    strtab = ro[to:to + ts]
    syms = []
    for i in range(ss // 24):
        nm, info, other, shndx, val, size = struct.unpack_from("<IBBHQQ", ro, so + 24 * i)
        name = strtab[nm:strtab.find(b"\0", nm)].decode("latin1") if nm else ""
        syms.append({"name": name, "type": info & 15, "bind": info >> 4, "defined": shndx != 0,
                     "value": val, "size": size})
    return syms


STR_RE = re.compile(rb"[\x20-\x7e]{4,}")
BUILTIN = set("bcahstijlmxyfdvwe")
IDENT = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*")


def _body(s, i):
    """Validate Itanium nested/template body up to the matching 'E'. Returns (index_of_E, names)."""
    named = 0
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]
        if c.isdigit():
            j = i
            while j < len(s) and s[j].isdigit():
                j += 1
            n = int(s[i:j])
            if n == 0 or s[i] == '0' or j + n > len(s) or not IDENT.fullmatch(s[j:j + n]):
                return -1, 0
            i = j + n
            named += 1
        elif c == "E":
            return i, named
        elif c in "NI":
            e, nn = _body(s, i + 1)
            if e < 0:
                return -1, 0
            i = e + 1
            named += nn
        elif c == "S":
            if s[i:i + 2] in ("St", "Sa", "Ss", "Sb", "Si", "So", "Sd"):
                i += 2
            else:
                m = re.match(r"S[0-9A-Z]*_", s[i:])
                if not m:
                    return -1, 0
                i += m.end()
        elif c in BUILTIN or c in "PRK":
            i += 1
        else:
            return -1, 0
    return -1, 0


def is_rtti_name(s):
    """Itanium typeinfo-name grammar: '<len><ident>' or 'N...E' with length-validated identifiers."""
    if len(s) < 3 or len(s) > 400:
        return False
    if s[0].isdigit():
        m = re.match(r"(\d+)", s)
        n = int(m.group(1))
        body = s[m.end():]
        return n > 1 and m.group(1)[0] != '0' and len(body) == n and IDENT.fullmatch(body) is not None
    if s[0] == "N" and s[-1] == "E":
        e, named = _body(s, 1)
        return e == len(s) - 1 and named >= 1
    return False


def ns_counts(names):
    """Count RTTI names by first identifier (e.g. nn / St / game-ish), top 12."""
    c = {}
    for n in names:
        m = re.match(r"N?(?:St)?(\d+)", n)
        k = "?"
        if m:
            ln = int(m.group(1))
            k = n[m.end():m.end() + ln]
            if n.startswith("St") or n.startswith("NSt"):
                k = "std:" + k
        c[k] = c.get(k, 0) + 1
    return dict(sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:12])


def analyze_strings(ro, data):
    strs = [m.group().decode("ascii") for m in STR_RE.finditer(ro)]
    allstrs = strs + [m.group().decode("ascii") for m in STR_RE.finditer(data)]
    rtti = sorted({s for s in strs if is_rtti_name(s)})
    src_re = re.compile(r"[\w./\\\-]+\.(?:cpp|cc|cxx|c|h|hpp|inl)(?![\w])")
    src = sorted({m.group() for s in strs for m in [src_re.search(s)] if m})
    cpp = [s for s in src if s.lower().endswith((".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx", ".c"))]
    hdr = [s for s in src if s.lower().endswith((".h", ".hpp", ".inl"))]
    low = [s.lower() for s in strs]
    kw = {k: sum(1 for s in low if k in s) for k in
          ("assert", "error", "warning", "fatal", "panic", "abort", "failed", "debug", "trace")}
    sdk = sorted({m.group() for s in allstrs for m in
                  re.finditer(r"NintendoSdk_nnSdk-[\w.\-]+|NintendoSDK_\w+-[\w.\-]+", s)})
    tool = sorted({s for s in allstrs if re.search(
        r"clang version|LLVM [0-9]|Nintendo [Cc]lang|GCC: |Apple LLVM|armclang", s)})[:10]
    return {
        "ro_string_count": len(strs),
        "rtti_name_count": len(rtti),
        "rtti_namespace_counts": ns_counts(rtti),
        "rtti_ZTS_literal_count": sum(1 for s in strs if s.startswith("_ZTS")),
        "source_path_unique": len(src),
        "source_cpp_unique": len(cpp),
        "source_header_unique": len(hdr),
        "keyword_counts": kw,
        "sdk_version_strings": sdk[:20],
        "toolchain_strings": tool,
        "nvn_api_names": sum(1 for s in strs if re.fullmatch(r"nvn[A-Z]\w+", s)),
        "_rtti_set": rtti,
        "_src_set": src,
    }


def scan_text(text):
    """Cheap AArch64 pattern counts over 4-byte aligned words."""
    n = len(text) // 4
    words = struct.unpack("<%dI" % n, text[:n * 4])
    imm_mask = ~(0x7F << 15) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    c = dict.fromkeys(("stp_x29_x30_pre", "stp_x29_x30_off", "ldp_x29_x30_post", "ldp_x29_x30_off",
                       "ret", "bl", "blr", "br", "paciasp", "autiasp", "bti", "nop", "adrp", "zero_words"), 0)
    regs = (30 << 10) | (31 << 5) | 29
    pre, off = 0xA9800000 | regs, 0xA9000000 | regs
    post, ldo = 0xA8C00000 | regs, 0xA9400000 | regs
    for w in words:
        m = w & imm_mask
        if m == pre:
            c["stp_x29_x30_pre"] += 1
        elif m == off:
            c["stp_x29_x30_off"] += 1
        elif m == post:
            c["ldp_x29_x30_post"] += 1
        elif m == ldo:
            c["ldp_x29_x30_off"] += 1
        elif w == 0xD65F03C0:
            c["ret"] += 1
        elif (w >> 26) == 0x25:
            c["bl"] += 1
        elif (w & 0xFFFFFC1F) == 0xD63F0000:
            c["blr"] += 1
        elif (w & 0xFFFFFC1F) == 0xD61F0000:
            c["br"] += 1
        elif w == 0xD503233F:
            c["paciasp"] += 1
        elif w == 0xD50323BF:
            c["autiasp"] += 1
        elif (w & 0xFFFFFF3F) == 0xD503241F:
            c["bti"] += 1
        elif w == 0xD503201F:
            c["nop"] += 1
        elif (w & 0x9F000000) == 0x90000000:
            c["adrp"] += 1
        elif w == 0:
            c["zero_words"] += 1
    return c


def analyze_nso(path, name, collect=False):
    nso = read_nso(path)
    unc = Path(str(path) + ".uncompressed.nso")
    if not unc.exists():
        write_uncompressed(nso, unc)
    r = {
        "name": name,
        "build_id": nso["module_id"][:20].hex().upper(),
        "module_id_full": nso["module_id"].hex(),
        "compressed_file_size": nso["file_size"],
        "flags": nso["flags"],
        "segments": [{"name": n, "mem_offset": s["mem_off"], "size": s["decomp"], "compressed": c}
                     for n, s, c in zip((".text", ".ro", ".data"), nso["seg"], nso["csz"])],
        "bss_size": nso["bss"],
        "uncompressed_size": 0x100 + sum(s["decomp"] for s in nso["seg"]),
        "uncompressed_file_size": unc.stat().st_size,
        "uncompressed_sha256": sha256_file(unc),
        "compressed_sha256": sha256_file(path),
    }
    img = image_of(nso)
    eh, fdes = parse_fdes(img)
    r["mod0"] = eh["mod0"]
    for k in ("mod0_offset", "bss_range", "fde_count", "fde_error"):
        if k in eh:
            r[k] = eh[k]
    if "eh_frame_hdr" in eh:
        r["eh_frame_hdr_range"] = eh["eh_frame_hdr"]
    sizes = [s for _, s in fdes if s]
    if sizes:
        r["fde_func_bytes_total"] = sum(sizes)
        r["fde_func_size_median"] = int(statistics.median(sizes))
        r["fde_func_size_mean"] = round(sum(sizes) / len(sizes), 1)
        r["fde_func_size_gt_1k"] = sum(1 for s in sizes if s > 1024)
        r["fde_text_coverage_pct"] = round(100.0 * sum(sizes) / nso["seg"][0]["decomp"], 2)
    syms = parse_dynsym(nso)
    defined = [s for s in syms if s["defined"] and s["name"]]
    imported = [s for s in syms if not s["defined"] and s["name"]]
    r["dynsym_total"] = len(syms)
    r["dynsym_defined"] = len(defined)
    r["dynsym_imported"] = len(imported)
    r["dynsym_defined_func"] = sum(1 for s in defined if s["type"] == 2)
    r["dynsym_defined_object"] = sum(1 for s in defined if s["type"] == 1)
    a_off, a_sz = nso["api"]
    r["sdk_api_list"] = sorted({m.group().decode() for m in STR_RE.finditer(nso["data"][1][a_off:a_off + a_sz])})
    r["_defined_names"] = sorted(s["name"] for s in defined)
    r["_imported_names"] = sorted(s["name"] for s in imported)
    st = analyze_strings(nso["data"][1], nso["data"][2])
    r["strings"] = {k: v for k, v in st.items() if not k.startswith("_")}
    r["_rtti_set"] = st["_rtti_set"]
    r["_src_set"] = st["_src_set"]
    r["text_scan"] = scan_text(nso["data"][0])
    if collect:
        r["_text"] = nso["data"][0]
        r["_fdes"] = fdes
    return r


def normalize_words(text, lenient):
    n = len(text) // 4
    w = list(struct.unpack("<%dI" % n, text[:n * 4]))
    for i, x in enumerate(w):
        if (x >> 26) == 0x25 or (x >> 26) == 0x05:
            w[i] = x & 0xFC000000          # BL / B imm26
        elif (x & 0x1F000000) == 0x10000000:
            w[i] = x & 0x9F00001F          # ADR / ADRP
        elif (x & 0x3B000000) == 0x18000000:
            w[i] = x & 0xFF00001F          # LDR literal
        elif lenient:
            if (x & 0x7F800000) == 0x11000000:
                w[i] = x & ~(0xFFF << 10) & 0xFFFFFFFF   # ADD imm
            elif (x & 0x3B000000) == 0x39000000:
                w[i] = x & ~(0xFFF << 10) & 0xFFFFFFFF   # LDR/STR unsigned imm
    return struct.pack("<%dI" % n, *w)


def norm_hashes(x, lenient):
    t = normalize_words(x["_text"], lenient)
    return {hashlib.sha1(t[s:s + n]).digest() for s, n in x["_fdes"] if n and s + n <= len(t)}


def func_hash_overlap(a, b):
    def hs(x):
        t = x["_text"]
        return {hashlib.sha1(t[s:s + n]).digest() for s, n in x["_fdes"] if n and s + n <= len(t)}
    ha, hb = hs(a), hs(b)
    na, nb = norm_hashes(a, False), norm_hashes(b, False)
    la, lb = norm_hashes(a, True), norm_hashes(b, True)
    return {"a_unique_bodies": len(ha), "b_unique_bodies": len(hb), "byte_identical": len(ha & hb),
            "identical_masking_branch_adrp_literal": len(na & nb), "unique_a_masked": len(na), "unique_b_masked": len(nb),
            "identical_lenient_also_mask_add_ldr_imm12": len(la & lb), "unique_a_lenient": len(la), "unique_b_lenient": len(lb)}


def text_page_equal(a, b):
    ta, tb = a["_text"], b["_text"]
    n = min(len(ta), len(tb)) // 4096
    eq = sum(1 for i in range(n) if ta[i * 4096:(i + 1) * 4096] == tb[i * 4096:(i + 1) * 4096])
    return {"pages_compared": n, "identical_pages_same_offset": eq}


def npdm_info(path, keys):
    rc, out = run([NSTOOL, "-k", keys, "-t", "meta", path])
    return {"sha256": sha256_file(path), "size": Path(path).stat().st_size,
            "nstool_text": [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip() and "WARNING" not in l]}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- main

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--keys", default=str(SRC / "prod.keys"))
    keys = ap.parse_args().keys
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rc, nsv = run([NSTOOL, "--help"])
    versions = {"nstool": nsv.splitlines()[0] if nsv else "?", "python": sys.version.split()[0]}

    order = [r for r, _ in REVS]
    metas, nsos = {}, {}
    for rev, srcname in REVS:
        print("acquire", rev, flush=True)
        metas[rev] = acquire(rev, srcname, keys)
    base_nca = content(metas["v0"], "Program")["path"]
    for rev in order:
        m = metas[rev]
        print("analyze", rev, flush=True)
        exe = extract_exefs(rev, m, keys)
        m["nacp"] = extract_nacp(rev, m, keys)
        mods = {}
        for p in sorted(exe.iterdir()):
            if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith((".npdm", ".nso", ".part")):
                mods[p.name] = analyze_nso(p, p.name, collect=(p.name == "main"))
        m["exefs_files"] = sorted(p.name for p in exe.iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith(".nso"))
        m["npdm"] = npdm_info(exe / "main.npdm", keys)
        m["modules"] = mods
        nsos[rev] = mods["main"]
        (OUT / f"symbols-{rev}.json").write_text(json.dumps(
            {"defined": nsos[rev]["_defined_names"], "imported": nsos[rev]["_imported_names"]}), encoding="utf-8")
        (OUT / f"rtti-{rev}.txt").write_text("\n".join(nsos[rev]["_rtti_set"]), encoding="utf-8")
        (OUT / f"sourcepaths-{rev}.txt").write_text("\n".join(nsos[rev]["_src_set"]), encoding="utf-8")
    cmp = {}
    for a, b in zip(order, order[1:]):
        x, y = nsos[a], nsos[b]
        ra, rb = set(x["_rtti_set"]), set(y["_rtti_set"])
        da, db = set(x["_defined_names"]), set(y["_defined_names"])
        ia, ib = set(x["_imported_names"]), set(y["_imported_names"])
        sa, sb = set(x["_src_set"]), set(y["_src_set"])
        cmp[f"{a}->{b}"] = {
            "main_build_id_same": x["build_id"] == y["build_id"],
            "text_size_delta": y["segments"][0]["size"] - x["segments"][0]["size"],
            "fde_count_delta": y.get("fde_count", 0) - x.get("fde_count", 0),
            "rtti_added": len(rb - ra), "rtti_removed": len(ra - rb),
            "defined_sym_added": len(db - da), "defined_sym_removed": len(da - db),
            "imported_added_count": len(ib - ia), "imported_removed_count": len(ia - ib),
            "imported_sym_added": sorted(ib - ia)[:40], "imported_sym_removed": sorted(ia - ib)[:40],
            "source_paths_added": len(sb - sa), "source_paths_removed": len(sa - sb),
            "function_bodies": func_hash_overlap(x, y),
            "text_pages": text_page_equal(x, y),
        }
    listings = {}
    for rev in order:
        print("romfs", rev, flush=True)
        files, err = romfs_listing(metas[rev], keys, base_nca)
        listings[rev] = files
        if files is None:
            metas[rev]["romfs_listing_error"] = err
            continue
        (OUT / f"romfs-{rev}.txt").write_text("\n".join(sorted(files)), encoding="utf-8")
        metas[rev]["romfs_file_count"] = sum(1 for f in files if f.startswith("1/"))
    romfs_diff = {}
    for a, b in zip(order, order[1:]):
        if listings[a] is None or listings[b] is None:
            continue
        sa, sb = set(listings[a]), set(listings[b])
        romfs_diff[f"{a}->{b}"] = {
            "added": len(sb - sa), "removed": len(sa - sb),
            "added_by_dir": by_dir(sb - sa), "removed_by_dir": by_dir(sa - sb),
            "note": "name-level only; per-file size/hash of the patched RomFS is not exposed by nstool"}
    for rev in order:
        for r in metas[rev]["modules"].values():
            for k in [k for k in r if k.startswith("_")]:
                del r[k]
    npdm_diffs = {}
    for a, b in zip(order, order[1:]):
        import difflib
        la, lb = metas[a]["npdm"]["nstool_text"], metas[b]["npdm"]["nstool_text"]
        npdm_diffs[f"{a}->{b}"] = {"file_sha256_differs": metas[a]["npdm"]["sha256"] != metas[b]["npdm"]["sha256"],
                                   "text_diff": [l for l in difflib.unified_diff(la, lb, lineterm="", n=0)
                                                 if not l.startswith(("---", "+++", "@@"))]}
    cmp["npdm_diffs"] = npdm_diffs
    summary = {"tool_versions": versions, "revisions": metas, "comparisons": cmp, "romfs_diff": romfs_diff}
    (OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=1, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
    write_md(summary, order)
    print("done")


def write_md(s, order):
    L = ["# Revision audit (generated by scripts/audit_revisions.py)", "",
         "Tools: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in s["tool_versions"].items()), ""]
    rows = []

    def row(label, fn):
        rows.append([label] + [str(fn(s["revisions"][r])) for r in order])
    M = lambda m: m["modules"]["main"]
    row("source file size (bytes)", lambda m: m["source_size"])
    row("NACP display version", lambda m: m["nacp"]["display_version"])
    row("cnmt version", lambda m: m["cnmt"]["version"])
    row("program NCA id", lambda m: content(m, "Program")["id"])
    row("program NCA size", lambda m: content(m, "Program")["size"])
    row("program NCA SdkAddon version", lambda m: m["sdk_addon_version"])
    row("program NCA SHA-256 == CNMT", lambda m: content(m, "Program")["hash_matches_cnmt"])
    row("control NCA SHA-256 == CNMT", lambda m: content(m, "Control")["hash_matches_cnmt"])
    row("ExeFS files", lambda m: " ".join(m["exefs_files"]))
    row("main build ID", lambda m: M(m)["build_id"])
    row("main compressed size", lambda m: M(m)["compressed_file_size"])
    row("main uncompressed size", lambda m: M(m)["uncompressed_file_size"])
    row("main uncompressed SHA-256", lambda m: M(m)["uncompressed_sha256"])
    row("main .text size", lambda m: hex(M(m)["segments"][0]["size"]))
    row("main .ro size @ addr", lambda m: f'{hex(M(m)["segments"][1]["size"])} @ {hex(M(m)["segments"][1]["mem_offset"])}')
    row("main .data size @ addr", lambda m: f'{hex(M(m)["segments"][2]["size"])} @ {hex(M(m)["segments"][2]["mem_offset"])}')
    row("main .bss size", lambda m: hex(M(m)["bss_size"]))
    row("MOD0", lambda m: M(m)["mod0"])
    row("FDE count", lambda m: M(m).get("fde_count"))
    row("FDE median func size", lambda m: M(m).get("fde_func_size_median"))
    row("FDE text coverage %", lambda m: M(m).get("fde_text_coverage_pct"))
    row("dynsym defined / imported", lambda m: f'{M(m)["dynsym_defined"]} / {M(m)["dynsym_imported"]}')
    row("RTTI-style type names", lambda m: M(m)["strings"]["rtti_name_count"])
    row("source path strings .cpp / .h", lambda m: f'{M(m)["strings"]["source_cpp_unique"]} / {M(m)["strings"]["source_header_unique"]}')
    row("assert / error strings", lambda m: f'{M(m)["strings"]["keyword_counts"]["assert"]} / {M(m)["strings"]["keyword_counts"]["error"]}')
    row("SDK version strings", lambda m: "; ".join(M(m)["strings"]["sdk_version_strings"][:2]))
    row("RTTI names by namespace (top 4)", lambda m: ", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in list(M(m)["strings"]["rtti_namespace_counts"].items())[:4]))
    row("toolchain strings", lambda m: len(M(m)["strings"]["toolchain_strings"]))
    for k in ("stp_x29_x30_pre", "stp_x29_x30_off", "ret", "bl", "paciasp", "bti"):
        row("scan " + k, lambda m, k=k: M(m)["text_scan"][k])
    for mod in ("sdk", "rtld"):
        row(mod + " build ID", lambda m, mod=mod: m["modules"][mod]["build_id"])
        row(mod + " uncompressed SHA-256", lambda m, mod=mod: m["modules"][mod]["uncompressed_sha256"])
    row("main.npdm SHA-256", lambda m: m["npdm"]["sha256"])
    row("RomFS file count (name listing)", lambda m: m.get("romfs_file_count", "?"))
    L.append("| field | " + " | ".join(order) + " |")
    L.append("|" + "---|" * (len(order) + 1))
    for r in rows:
        L.append("| " + " | ".join(r) + " |")
    L += ["", "## Consecutive comparisons", "```json", json.dumps(s["comparisons"], indent=1), "```", "",
          "## RomFS name diffs", "```json", json.dumps(s["romfs_diff"], indent=1), "```", ""]
    (OUT / "summary.md").write_text("\n".join(L), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`scripts/classify_vtables.py`:

```py
"""Classify vtable candidates into probable classes -> analysis/maps/classes.tsv, class_functions.tsv"""
import sys, os, struct, collections
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from scan_vtable_writers import *


def cstr(img, a):
    if a > 0 and img[a - 1] != 0:
        return None
    e = a
    while e < len(img) and img[e] != 0 and e - a < 96:
        e += 1
    b = bytes(img[a:e])
    if len(b) < 4 or img[e] != 0:
        return None
    if not all(32 <= c < 127 for c in b):
        return None
    return b.decode()


def analyze():
    img = load_image(); funcs = load_funcs(); vts = load_vtables(); rel = load_relocs()
    fsize = {s: e - s for s, e, k in funcs}
    vtmap = {v['start']: (v['start'], 0) for v in vts}
    byv = {v['start']: v for v in vts}
    res = scan(img, funcs, vtmap, rel)

    def slotfns(v):
        return [int(x, 16) for x in v['slots'] if x and not x.startswith('@')]
    in_slot = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for v in vts:
        for i, x in enumerate(v['slots']):
            if x and not x.startswith('@'):
                in_slot[int(x, 16)].add((v['start'], i))
    dele = {0x400}
    for _ in range(3):
        for s, e, k in funcs:
            if e - s <= 0x30:
                c = res[s]['calls']
                if len(c) == 1 and c[0][2] == 'b' and c[0][1] in dele:
                    dele.add(s)

    def is_secondary(v):
        try:
            return int(v['prefix'][0], 16) >= 0xf000000000000000
        except ValueError:
            return False
    writers = {}
    for s, r in res.items():
        if not r['writes']:
            continue
        stores = [(w[0][0], w[1], w[2], w[3], w[4], w[5]) for w in r['writes']]
        prim = [x for x in stores if x[5] == 0]
        writers[s] = dict(stores=stores, prim=prim, calls=r['calls'])
    role = {}
    for s, w in writers.items():
        own_slot = any(vt == vs for (vs, i) in in_slot.get(s, ()) for x in w['stores'] for vt in [x[0]])
        anyslot = s in in_slot
        calls_del = any(c[1] in dele for c in w['calls'])
        sd = 0
        if own_slot: sd += 3
        elif anyslot: sd += 2
        if calls_del: sd += 1
        first_bl = min([c[0] for c in w['calls']] or [10 ** 9])
        if w['prim'] and w['prim'][0][4] < first_bl and w['calls']: sd += 1
        role[s] = ['dtor' if sd >= 3 else 'ctor', sd]
    for s, w in sorted(writers.items()):
        if role[s][0] == 'dtor' and s in in_slot:
            for c in w['calls']:
                t = c[1]
                if t in role and role[t][0] == 'ctor' and t not in in_slot:
                    tw = writers[t]
                    if tw['prim'] and ((not tw['calls']) or tw['prim'][0][4] < tw['calls'][0][0]):
                        role[t] = ['dtor', 3]
    primary_of_writer = {s: w['prim'][-1][0] for s, w in writers.items() if w['prim']}
    secondary = collections.defaultdict(set)
    members = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for s, w in writers.items():
        P = primary_of_writer.get(s)
        if P is None:
            continue
        for x in w['stores']:
            vt, absoff = x[0], x[5]
            if absoff is None or absoff == 0:
                continue
            if is_secondary(byv[vt]):
                secondary[P].add(vt)
            else:
                members[P].add(vt)
    prim_set = set(primary_of_writer.values())
    sec_claim = {}
    for P in sorted(secondary):
        for sv in sorted(secondary[P]):
            if sv in prim_set:
                continue
            sec_claim.setdefault(sv, P)
    bases = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    for s, w in writers.items():
        P = primary_of_writer.get(s)
        if P is None:
            continue
        seen = []
        for x in w['prim']:
            if x[0] != P and x[0] not in seen:
                seen.append(x[0])
        for b in seen:
            bases[P][(b, 'inline_overwrite')] += 1
        pidx = w['prim'][-1][4]
        for c in w['calls']:
            i, t = c[0], c[1]
            if c[3] == 0 and t in primary_of_writer and primary_of_writer[t] != P:
                if role[s][0] == role[t][0]:
                    if role[s][0] == 'ctor' and i < pidx:
                        bases[P][(primary_of_writer[t], 'ctor_chain')] += 1
                    elif role[s][0] == 'dtor' and i > pidx:
                        bases[P][(primary_of_writer[t], 'dtor_chain')] += 1

    def slot_share(a, b):
        return sum(1 for x, y in zip(byv[a]['slots'], byv[b]['slots']) if x == y)
    classes = {}
    for v in vts:
        sv = v['start']
        if sv in sec_claim:
            continue
        classes[sv] = dict(secs=sorted(x for x in secondary.get(sv, ()) if sec_claim.get(x) == sv))
    cid = lambda a: 'C%06x' % a
    ctors = collections.defaultdict(list); dtors = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for s, P in sorted(primary_of_writer.items()):
        if P in classes:
            (ctors if role[s][0] == 'ctor' else dtors)[P].append(s)
    names = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for P in classes:
        cand = set(ctors[P]) | set(dtors[P])
        for f in slotfns(byv[P])[:6]:
            if fsize.get(f, 999) <= 0x40:
                cand.add(f)
        for f in sorted(cand):
            for (i, a) in res.get(f, {'strrefs': []})['strrefs']:
                st = cstr(img, a)
                if st and st not in names[P]:
                    names[P].append(st)
    out = []
    for P in sorted(classes):
        bc = bases.get(P)
        best = None
        if bc:
            cands = collections.Counter()
            for (b, ev), n in bc.items():
                cands[b] += n
            b = sorted(cands.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[0][0]
            evs = sorted(set(ev for (bb, ev) in bc if bb == b))
            b = sec_claim.get(b, b)
            best = (b, '+'.join(evs), slot_share(P, b))
        out.append((P, byv[P], classes[P], best))
    return dict(img=img, funcs=funcs, vts=vts, byv=byv, res=res, writers=writers, role=role, in_slot=in_slot,
                primary_of_writer=primary_of_writer, sec_claim=sec_claim, ctors=ctors, dtors=dtors, names=names,
                members=members, out=out, fsize=fsize, cid=cid)


def main():
    A = analyze()
    out = A['out']; cid = A['cid']; ctors = A['ctors']; dtors = A['dtors']; names = A['names']
    h = lambda xs: ';'.join('0x%x' % x for x in xs)
    hdr = '# build_id: DDB900FF04A912ED42430508389853CFAF1ACCCE\n'
    with open(os.path.join(MAPS, 'classes.tsv'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        f.write('# file: classes.tsv\n# probable classes from vtable-writer analysis (scripts/classify_vtables.py). class_id = C + primary vtable start (module offset); vtable = first function slot (the stored object pointer value).\n')
        f.write('# ctor/dtor = writers of the primary vtable at [this+0]; dtor = sits in own vtable slot, or stores vtable before first call and calls delete. base_evidence: inline_overwrite (vtable of base stored earlier in same function), ctor_chain (base ctor called before own store), dtor_chain (base dtor called after own store); base_shared_slots = equal slots at same index\n')
        f.write(hdr)
        f.write('class_id\tvtable\tslots\tsecondary_vtables\tctors\tdtors\tbase_class\tbase_evidence\tbase_shared_slots\tname_strings\tmember_vtables\tn_writers\n')
        for P, v, c, best in out:
            f.write('\t'.join([cid(P), '0x%x' % P, str(len(v['slots'])), h(c['secs']), h(ctors[P]), h(dtors[P]),
                               cid(best[0]) if best else '', best[1] if best else '', str(best[2]) if best else '',
                               ';'.join(names[P][:6]), h(sorted(A['members'].get(P, ()))), str(len(ctors[P]) + len(dtors[P]))]) + '\n')
    with open(os.path.join(MAPS, 'class_functions.tsv'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        f.write('# file: class_functions.tsv\n# every function that stores a known vtable start; role heuristic score (dtor if >=3); stores = vtable@basereg+off\n')
        f.write(hdr)
        f.write('function\tsize\trole\tscore\tprimary_class\tin_vtable_slot\tstores\n')
        for s in sorted(A['writers']):
            w = A['writers'][s]; P = A['primary_of_writer'].get(s)
            pc = cid(A['sec_claim'].get(P, P)) if P is not None else ''
            f.write('\t'.join(['0x%x' % s, '0x%x' % A['fsize'][s], A['role'][s][0], str(A['role'][s][1]), pc,
                               ';'.join('0x%x#%d' % x for x in sorted(A['in_slot'].get(s, ()))),
                               ';'.join('0x%x@x%d+%d%s' % (x[0], x[1], x[2], '' if x[5] is None else '/this+%d' % x[5]) for x in w['stores'])]) + '\n')
    print('classes', len(out), 'writers', len(A['writers']), 'with ctors', sum(1 for o in out if ctors[o[0]]),
          'dtors', sum(1 for o in out if dtors[o[0]]), 'base', sum(1 for o in out if o[3]),
          'secondary claimed', len(A['sec_claim']), 'named', sum(1 for o in out if names[o[0]]))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/drp_unpack.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack DRP archive entries (raw + Oodle) to extracted/drp-v262144/<archive path>/<name>.<ext>.

Run (private venv, BelowNormal is set automatically):
  tools\\venv-oodle\\Scripts\\python -I scripts\\drp_unpack.py --set priority --max-minutes 25
  options: --set priority|rest|all   --archive <substring>   --ext <ext[,ext]>   --retry-failed
           --limit N (entries)   --max-minutes M   --verify-only (re-hash existing outputs)
Resumable: analysis/romfs/drp_unpacked.tsv records every entry; entries with status ok whose output
file exists with the right size are skipped.  Source only; writes game-derived bytes ONLY under
extracted/drp-v262144 (git-ignored).

Per chunk layout (confirmed): word0 = CRC32 of the decompressed data (also the crypto seed), word1 = 'resd',
word2 = total, word3 = ext crc, word4 = csize (payload bytes incl. the 4-byte 'Oodl' tag), word5 = dsize.
Oodle payload = 'Oodl' + stream; decoder call = OodleLZ_Decompress(payload+4, csize-4, dst, dsize, 1,0,0,0,...,3).
Raw entry (no 'Oodl' tag): payload[:dsize] is the data.
Encrypted archives: whole chunk (words 1..) XORed with the per-chunk xorshift stream; done by
tools/oodle_build/drp_xor.dll (built from scripts/drp_xor/drp_xor.rs).
"""
import argparse, ctypes, hashlib, os, struct, sys, time, zlib
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import romfs_census as rc          # noqa: E402
import oodle_unicorn as ou         # noqa: E402

ROOT = rc.ROOT
RFS = ROOT / "extracted" / "romfs-v262144"
OUTDIR = ROOT / "extracted" / "drp-v262144"
MANIFEST = ROOT / "analysis" / "romfs" / "drp_unpacked.tsv"
DLL = ROOT / "tools" / "oodle_build" / "drp_xor.dll"
HDR = "archive\tidx\tentry\ttype\tcsize\tsize\tsha256\tstatus\n"

PRI_EXT = {"nushdb", "luo", "courseb", "levelb", "msbt", "msbp", "allb", "mdfb", "genderb", "pdcd", "silb",
           "ecbd", "mdcd", "navb", "rtd", "path", "paramb", "pcnb", "misd", "achd", "mdrp", "nvhb", "ldtb",
           "picd", "pstb", "pfrb", "pflb", "lm", "lmb", "lme", "nufxlb", "reflectb", "shb"}


def is_priority(arch, ext):
    a = arch
    if a.startswith("common/Text/") or a.startswith("common/UI/master/Scenes/"):
        return True
    if a in ("resource/nx/resource.drp",) or a.startswith("nx/Pack/Resident/") or a.endswith("/LevelCommon.drp"):
        return True
    return ext in PRI_EXT and not a.startswith("nx/Sound/")


def load_manifest():
    done = {}
    if MANIFEST.exists():
        for ln in MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[1:]:
            p = ln.split("\t")
            if len(p) == 8:
                done[(p[0], int(p[1]))] = p
    return done


def out_path(arch, e, used):
    nm = e["name"]
    base = nm if nm.lower().endswith("." + e["ext"].lower()) else "%s.%s" % (nm, e["ext"])
    key = (arch, base.lower())
    if used.get(key):
        base = "%s__%d.%s" % (nm[:-len(e["ext"]) - 1] if nm.lower().endswith("." + e["ext"].lower()) else nm, e["idx"], e["ext"])
    used[key] = True
    return OUTDIR / arch / base


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--set", default="priority", choices=["priority", "rest", "all"])
    ap.add_argument("--archive", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--ext", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--retry-failed", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--max-minutes", type=float, default=25)
    ap.add_argument("--no-write", action="store_true", help="decode and verify only")
    ap.add_argument("--sample", type=int, default=0, help="K entries per ext spread over all archives (implies --no-write)")
    ap.add_argument("--manifest", default="")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    rc.set_belownormal()
    xor = ctypes.CDLL(str(DLL))
    xor.drp_xor.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p]
    global MANIFEST
    if a.manifest:
        MANIFEST = Path(a.manifest)
    if a.sample:
        a.no_write = True
    exts = set(x for x in a.ext.split(",") if x)
    sample_keys = None
    if a.sample:
        import collections
        byext = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for ln in (ROOT / "analysis/romfs/drp_entries.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[1:]:
            q = ln.split("	")
            byext[q[3]].append((q[0], int(q[1]), int(q[6])))
        sample_keys = set()
        for ex, lst in byext.items():
            lst = [x for x in lst if x[2] <= 40 << 20] or lst
            step = max(1, len(lst) // a.sample)
            for x in lst[::step][:a.sample]:
                sample_keys.add((x[0], x[1]))
            big = max(byext[ex], key=lambda x: x[2])   # also the largest of each ext
            if big[2] <= 110 << 20:
                sample_keys.add((big[0], big[1]))
    done = {} if a.sample else load_manifest()
    MANIFEST.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    newfile = not MANIFEST.exists() or a.sample
    mf = open(MANIFEST, "w" if a.sample else "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    if newfile:
        mf.write(HDR)
    vm = ou.OodleVM()
    t_end = time.time() + a.max_minutes * 60
    arches = sorted(p.relative_to(RFS).as_posix() for p in RFS.rglob("*.drp"))
    cnt = dict(ok=0, fail=0, skipped=0)
    bytes_out = 0
    t_dec = 0.0
    n_done = 0
    stop = False
    for arch in arches:
        if a.archive and a.archive not in arch:
            continue
        info, ents = rc.parse_drp(RFS / arch)
        if not ents:
            continue
        sel = []
        for e in ents:
            if exts and e["ext"] not in exts:
                continue
            if sample_keys is not None:
                if (arch, e["idx"]) in sample_keys:
                    sel.append(e)
                continue
            pri = is_priority(arch, e["ext"])
            if a.set == "priority" and not pri:
                continue
            if a.set == "rest" and pri:
                continue
            sel.append(e)
        todo = []
        used = {}
        for e in ents:   # path assignment must be stable over the whole archive
            e["_path"] = out_path(arch, e, used)
        for e in sel:
            m = done.get((arch, e["idx"]))
            if m and (m[7] == "ok" and e["_path"].exists() and e["_path"].stat().st_size == int(m[5])):
                cnt["skipped"] += 1
                continue
            if m and m[7].startswith("fail") and not a.retry_failed:
                cnt["skipped"] += 1
                continue
            todo.append(e)
        if not todo:
            continue
        with open(RFS / arch, "rb") as f:
            table = f.read(0x94)[0x14:0x94]
            for e in todo:
                if time.time() > t_end or (a.limit and n_done >= a.limit):
                    stop = True
                    break
                n_done += 1
                status, sha, size = "ok", "", e["dsize"]
                try:
                    f.seek(e["off"])
                    buf = bytearray(f.read(e["total"]))
                    if e["encrypted"]:
                        n4 = len(buf) // 4
                        seed = struct.unpack_from("<I", buf, 0)[0]
                        r = rc.rng_for(seed, table)
                        st = (ctypes.c_uint32 * 4)(r.x, r.y, r.z, r.w)
                        cb = (ctypes.c_char * len(buf)).from_buffer(buf)
                        xor.drp_xor(ctypes.addressof(cb), n4, ctypes.addressof(st))
                        del cb
                    crc_expect = struct.unpack_from("<I", buf, 0)[0]
                    magic, total, extcrc, csz, dsz = struct.unpack_from("<5I", buf, 4)
                    assert magic == rc.RESD and dsz == e["dsize"] and csz == e["csize"], "chunk header mismatch"
                    d0 = e["data_off"] - e["off"]
                    pay = bytes(buf[d0:d0 + csz])
                    if e["oodle"]:
                        t0 = time.perf_counter()
                        n, out = vm.decompress(pay[4:], dsz)
                        t_dec += time.perf_counter() - t0
                        if n != dsz:
                            raise RuntimeError("oodle returned %d, expected %d" % (n, dsz))
                    else:
                        out = pay[:dsz]
                        if len(out) != dsz:
                            raise RuntimeError("raw entry shorter than dsize")
                    if zlib.crc32(out) != crc_expect:
                        status = "crc_mismatch"
                    sha = hashlib.sha256(out).hexdigest()
                    if not a.no_write:
                        p = e["_path"]
                        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".part")
                        tmp.write_bytes(out)
                        os.replace(tmp, p)
                    bytes_out += len(out)
                    cnt["ok" if status == "ok" else "fail"] += 1
                except Exception as ex:   # record and continue; rebuild the VM (state may be dirty)
                    status = "fail:" + str(ex).replace("\t", " ").replace("\n", " ")[:120]
                    cnt["fail"] += 1
                    vm = ou.OodleVM()
                mf.write("%s\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\t%s\t%s\n" % (arch, e["idx"], e["name"], e["ext"], e["csize"],
                                                                 size, sha, status))
                mf.flush()
        if stop:
            break
    mf.close()
    print("ok=%d fail=%d skipped=%d  wrote=%.3f GB  decode_time=%.1fs (%.2f MB/s decoded)  stopped_early=%s" % (
        cnt["ok"], cnt["fail"], cnt["skipped"], bytes_out / 1e9, t_dec,
        (bytes_out / 1e6 / t_dec) if t_dec else 0, stop))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/drp_xor/drp_xor.rs`:

```rs
// DRP per-chunk xorshift stream decryptor (public NewSnap algorithm). Source only; build:
//   rustc -O --crate-type cdylib -o tools/oodle_build/drp_xor.dll scripts/drp_xor/drp_xor.rs
#[no_mangle]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn drp_xor(buf: *mut u32, nwords: usize, st: *const u32) {
    let (mut x, mut y, mut z, mut w) = (*st, *st.add(1), *st.add(2), *st.add(3));
    #[inline(always)]
    fn nxt(x: &mut u32, y: &mut u32, z: &mut u32, w: &mut u32) -> u32 {
        let t = *x ^ (*x << 11);
        *x = *y; *y = *z; *z = *w;
        *w = *w ^ (((*w as i32) >> 19) as u32) ^ (t ^ (((t as i32) >> 8) as u32));
        *w & 0x7FFF_FFFF
    }
    for i in 1..nwords {
        let a = nxt(&mut x, &mut y, &mut z, &mut w);
        let b = nxt(&mut x, &mut y, &mut z, &mut w) >> 30;
        *buf.add(i) ^= a | (b << 31);
    }
}

```

`scripts/elf_xref.py`:

```py
"""Light AArch64 xref finder for the main ELF (numpy only, no disassembler needed for the scan).

  python -I scripts/elf_xref.py find <bytes-literal>        # rodata hits, then code xrefs (adrp+add)
  python -I scripts/elf_xref.py func <addr> [maxinstr]      # disassemble with capstone
  python -I scripts/elf_xref.py vt <addr> [maxinstr]        # FlatBuffers vtable-offset pattern scan in a function
"""
import sys, os, struct
import numpy as np

ELF = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', 'analysis', 'import', 'v262144-main.elf')
TEXT_END = 0xa365b0


def load():
    return open(ELF, 'rb').read()


def find_literals(d, lit, lo=0xa36000, hi=0xc61000):
    out = []
    i = d.find(lit, lo)
    while i != -1 and i < hi:
        out.append(i)
        i = d.find(lit, i + 1)
    return out


def xrefs(d, targets):
    """Code addresses of adrp(+add) pairs that materialise any of the target addresses."""
    code = np.frombuffer(d[:TEXT_END], dtype='<u4')
    isadrp = (code & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000
    idx = np.nonzero(isadrp)[0]
    ins = code[idx].astype(np.int64)
    immlo = (ins >> 29) & 3
    immhi = (ins >> 5) & 0x7ffff
    imm = (immhi << 2) | immlo
    imm = np.where(imm & (1 << 20), imm - (1 << 21), imm)
    page = ((idx.astype(np.int64) * 4) & ~0xfff) + (imm << 12)
    rd = ins & 31
    res = {t: [] for t in targets}
    tset = {}
    for t in targets:
        tset.setdefault(t & ~0xfff, []).append(t)
    for k in range(len(idx)):
        pg = int(page[k])
        if pg not in tset:
            continue
        for j in range(1, 6):
            if idx[k] + j >= len(code):
                break
            nx = int(code[idx[k] + j])
            if (nx & 0xff800000) == 0x91000000 and ((nx >> 5) & 31) == int(rd[k]):
                off = (nx >> 10) & 0xfff
                for t in tset[pg]:
                    if pg + off == t:
                        res[t].append(int(idx[k]) * 4)
    return res


def func_start(d, addr):
    """Walk back to a plausible function entry (stp x29,x30 prologue or sub sp) - heuristic."""
    code = np.frombuffer(d[:TEXT_END], dtype='<u4')
    i = addr // 4
    for j in range(i, max(i - 4000, 0), -1):
        w = int(code[j])
        if (w & 0xffc003e0) == 0xa98003e0 or (w & 0xff0003ff) == 0xd10003ff:  # stp pre-index / sub sp,sp,#
            # include preceding stp sequence
            return j * 4
    return addr


def disasm(d, addr, n):
    from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM
    md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM)
    for ins in md.disasm(d[addr: addr + 4 * n], addr):
        print('%x: %s %s' % (ins.address, ins.mnemonic, ins.op_str))


def main():
    d = load()
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == 'find':
        lit = eval(sys.argv[2]) if sys.argv[2].startswith("b'") else sys.argv[2].encode()
        hits = find_literals(d, lit)
        print('rodata hits', [hex(h) for h in hits[:20]])
        r = xrefs(d, hits[:20])
        for t, l in r.items():
            print(hex(t), [hex(x) for x in l])
    elif cmd == 'func':
        disasm(d, int(sys.argv[2], 16), int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 120)
    elif cmd == 'start':
        print(hex(func_start(d, int(sys.argv[2], 16))))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

```py
            1: ('level_pack_hash', H, 'CRC32 of LC_nnn[_n]_X; 30 of 32 resolve to RomFS level packs'),
            4: ('stage_id', M, '1..105'),
            5: ('time_code', M, '27 = A, 28 = B, 29 = C variant of the pack'),
        }),
    },
    'pstb': {'R.0[]': ('PhotoStamp', {0: ('stamp_id', M, ''), })},
    'pfrb': {'R.0[]': ('PhotoFrame', {0: ('frame_id', M, ''), })},
    'pflb': {'R.0[]': ('PhotoFilter', {0: ('filter_id', M, ''), })},
}
```
