`scripts/oodle_unicorn.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run the game's own statically linked Oodle decoder (OodleLZ_Decompress, module offset 0x7240)
under the Unicorn CPU emulator.  Offline extraction tool only; not part of the port.

Needs the private venv:  tools\\venv-oodle\\Scripts\\python -I scripts\\oodle_unicorn.py --selftest
Reads  : analysis/import/v262144-main.elf  (game code; never copied anywhere)
No game bytes are embedded in this file.

Signature (confirmed from the DRP loader call site at 0x5e3b84):
  OodleLZ_Decompress(src, srcLen, dst, dstLen, fuzzSafe=1, checkCRC=0, verbosity=0, decBufBase=0,
                     [stack:] decBufSize=0, cb=0, cbUser=0, decMem=0, decMemSize=0, threadPhase=3)
  returns decompressed byte count (0 on error).  The DRP payload is the 4 bytes 'Oodl' followed by the
  stream; the loader passes src = payload+4, srcLen = csize-4.
"""
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
from unicorn import (Uc, UC_ARCH_ARM64, UC_MODE_ARM, UC_PROT_ALL, UC_HOOK_CODE, UcError)
from unicorn.arm64_const import (UC_ARM64_REG_X0, UC_ARM64_REG_X1, UC_ARM64_REG_X2, UC_ARM64_REG_X3,
                                 UC_ARM64_REG_X4, UC_ARM64_REG_X5, UC_ARM64_REG_X6, UC_ARM64_REG_X7,
                                 UC_ARM64_REG_SP, UC_ARM64_REG_LR, UC_ARM64_REG_PC,
                                 UC_ARM64_REG_TPIDR_EL0, UC_ARM64_REG_TPIDRRO_EL0, UC_ARM64_REG_CPACR_EL1)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
ELF = ROOT / "analysis" / "import" / "v262144-main.elf"
OODLE_DECOMPRESS = 0x7240

BASE = 0x100000000
IMPORT_BASE = 0x20000000       # fake import stubs: each is a 'ret'
STACK_TOP = 0x30000000
STACK_SIZE = 16 << 20
TLS_BASE = 0x31000000
RET_SENTINEL = 0x32000000
HEAP_BASE = 0x38000000
HEAP_SIZE = 256 << 20
IN_BASE = 0x50000000 + 0x40000000   # 0x90000000
OUT_BASE = IN_BASE + 0x10000000
BUF_SIZE = 0x10000000    # 256 MB each (largest entry is 104 MB)
PAGE = 0x1000
RET_INSN = 0xD65F03C0


def al(n, a=PAGE):
    return (n + a - 1) & ~(a - 1)


class OodleVM:
    def __init__(self, elf_path=ELF):
        self.uc = Uc(UC_ARCH_ARM64, UC_MODE_ARM)
        self.err = None
        self.heap_ptr = HEAP_BASE
        self.allocs = {}
        self.import_names = {}
        self.cap_in = 0
        self.cap_out = 0
        self.in_base = IN_BASE
        self.out_base = OUT_BASE
        self.calls = 0
        self._load(elf_path)
        self._setup()

    # ---------------- image ----------------
    def _load(self, path):
        data = Path(path).read_bytes()
        f = ELFFile(open(path, "rb"))
        uc = self.uc
        segs = [s for s in f.iter_segments() if s["p_type"] == "PT_LOAD"]
        top = max(al(s["p_vaddr"] + s["p_memsz"]) for s in segs)
        uc.mem_map(BASE, top, UC_PROT_ALL)
        for s in segs:
            uc.mem_write(BASE + s["p_vaddr"], data[s["p_offset"]:s["p_offset"] + s["p_filesz"]])
        self.image_top = top

        def v2o(va):
            for s in segs:
                if s["p_vaddr"] <= va < s["p_vaddr"] + s["p_filesz"]:
                    return s["p_offset"] + va - s["p_vaddr"]
            raise ValueError(hex(va))
        dyn = {}
        for t in f.get_segment_by_type if False else []:
            pass
        dseg = [s for s in f.iter_segments() if s["p_type"] == "PT_DYNAMIC"][0]
        for t in dseg.iter_tags():
            dyn.setdefault(t.entry.d_tag, t.entry.d_val)
        symtab, strtab = dyn["DT_SYMTAB"], dyn["DT_STRTAB"]

        def sym(i):
            o = v2o(symtab) + i * 24
            name_off, info, other, shndx, value, size = struct.unpack_from("<IBBHQQ", data, o)
            so = v2o(strtab) + name_off
            name = data[so:data.index(b"\0", so)].decode()
            return name, shndx, value
        stubs = {}

        def stub_for(name):
            if name not in stubs:
                stubs[name] = IMPORT_BASE + 4 * len(stubs)
            return stubs[name]
        tables = []
        if "DT_RELA" in dyn:
            tables.append((dyn["DT_RELA"], dyn["DT_RELASZ"]))
        if "DT_JMPREL" in dyn:
            tables.append((dyn["DT_JMPREL"], dyn["DT_PLTRELSZ"]))
        counts = {}
        for addr, size in tables:
            o = v2o(addr)
            for i in range(size // 24):
                r_off, r_info, r_add = struct.unpack_from("<QQq", data, o + i * 24)
                rtype, rsym = r_info & 0xFFFFFFFF, r_info >> 32
                counts[rtype] = counts.get(rtype, 0) + 1
                if rtype == 1027:    # R_AARCH64_RELATIVE
                    val = BASE + r_add
                elif rtype in (257, 1025, 1026):  # ABS64 / GLOB_DAT / JUMP_SLOT
                    name, shndx, value = sym(rsym)
                    val = BASE + value + r_add if shndx != 0 else stub_for(name) + 0
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("unhandled reloc type %d" % rtype)
                uc.mem_write(BASE + r_off, struct.pack("<Q", val))
        self.reloc_counts = counts
        self.stubs = stubs
        self.import_names = {v: k for k, v in stubs.items()}
        uc.mem_map(IMPORT_BASE, al(4 * len(stubs) + 4), UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_write(IMPORT_BASE, struct.pack("<I", RET_INSN) * (len(stubs) + 1))

    def _setup(self):
        uc = self.uc
        uc.mem_map(STACK_TOP - STACK_SIZE, STACK_SIZE, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_map(TLS_BASE, 0x10000, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_map(RET_SENTINEL, PAGE, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_map(IN_BASE, BUF_SIZE, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_map(OUT_BASE, BUF_SIZE, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.mem_write(RET_SENTINEL, struct.pack("<I", RET_INSN))
        uc.mem_map(HEAP_BASE, HEAP_SIZE, UC_PROT_ALL)
        uc.reg_write(UC_ARM64_REG_CPACR_EL1, 3 << 20)
        uc.reg_write(UC_ARM64_REG_TPIDR_EL0, TLS_BASE + 0x1000)
        uc.reg_write(UC_ARM64_REG_TPIDRRO_EL0, TLS_BASE + 0x1000)
        self.sym_to_fn = {
            "memcpy": self._memcpy, "memmove": self._memcpy, "memset": self._memset,
            "memcmp": self._memcmp, "malloc": self._malloc, "calloc": self._calloc,
            "free": self._free, "realloc": self._realloc, "memalign": self._memalign,
            "aligned_alloc": self._memalign, "posix_memalign": self._posix_memalign,
        }
        # 0x80a0 is the Oodle "free" plugin (tail-jumps to the game's TLS-heap free).  The emulated heap is a
        # bump allocator reset per call, so free is a no-op: patch it to 'ret'.
        uc.mem_write(BASE + 0x80A0, struct.pack("<I", RET_INSN))
        lo = IMPORT_BASE
        hi = IMPORT_BASE + 4 * (len(self.stubs) + 1)
        uc.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE, self._on_import, begin=lo, end=hi)

    # ---------------- libc surface ----------------
    def _a(self, n):
        return self.uc.reg_read(UC_ARM64_REG_X0 + n)

    def _ret(self, v):
        self.uc.reg_write(UC_ARM64_REG_X0, v & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)

    def _memcpy(self):
        d, s, n = self._a(0), self._a(1), self._a(2)
        if n:
            self.uc.mem_write(d, bytes(self.uc.mem_read(s, n)))
        self._ret(d)

    def _memset(self):
        d, c, n = self._a(0), self._a(1) & 0xFF, self._a(2)
        if n:
            self.uc.mem_write(d, bytes([c]) * n)
        self._ret(d)

    def _memcmp(self):
        a = bytes(self.uc.mem_read(self._a(0), self._a(2)))
        b = bytes(self.uc.mem_read(self._a(1), self._a(2)))
        self._ret((a > b) - (a < b))

    def _malloc_n(self, n, align=64):
        n = al(max(n, 1), 64)
        p = al(self.heap_ptr, max(align, 64))
        if p + n > HEAP_BASE + HEAP_SIZE:
            raise MemoryError("emulated heap exhausted")
        self.heap_ptr = p + n
        self.allocs[p] = n
        return p

    def _malloc(self):
        self._ret(self._malloc_n(self._a(0)))

    def _calloc(self):
        n = self._a(0) * self._a(1)
        p = self._malloc_n(n)
        self.uc.mem_write(p, b"\0" * n)
        self._ret(p)

    def _memalign(self):
        al_, n = self._a(0), self._a(1)
        self._ret(self._malloc_n(n, al_))

    def _posix_memalign(self):
        al_, n = self._a(1), self._a(2)
        p = self._malloc_n(n, al_)
        self.uc.mem_write(self._a(0), struct.pack("<Q", p))
        self._ret(0)

    def _free(self):
        pass

    def _realloc(self):
        p, n = self._a(0), self._a(1)
        q = self._malloc_n(n)
        if p:
            old = min(self.allocs.get(p, 0), n)
            self.uc.mem_write(q, bytes(self.uc.mem_read(p, old)))
        self._ret(q)

    def _on_import(self, uc, address, size, user):
        name = self.import_names.get(address)
        try:
            fn = self.sym_to_fn.get(name)
            if fn is None:
                raise RuntimeError("unhandled import %r called (lr=%#x)" % (
                    name, uc.reg_read(UC_ARM64_REG_LR) - BASE))
            fn()
        except Exception as e:  # fail loudly: stop emulation, re-raise from decompress()
            self.err = e
            uc.emu_stop()

    # ---------------- buffers / call ----------------
    def _ensure(self, which, n):
        """Persistent input/output buffers, mapped once (Unicorn maps lazily, so the reserve is cheap)."""
        if n + 4096 > BUF_SIZE:
            raise MemoryError("buffer too large: %d" % n)

    def decompress(self, comp, raw_len):
        """comp = the stream after the 4-byte 'Oodl' tag. Returns (n_written, bytes)."""
        uc = self.uc
        self._ensure("in", len(comp) + 64)
        self._ensure("out", raw_len)
        uc.mem_write(self.in_base, comp)
        self.heap_ptr = HEAP_BASE
        self.allocs.clear()
        sp = STACK_TOP - 0x1000
        uc.mem_write(sp, b"\0" * 0x30)
        uc.mem_write(sp + 0x28, struct.pack("<Q", 3))     # threadPhase = Unthreaded
        for r, v in ((UC_ARM64_REG_X0, self.in_base), (UC_ARM64_REG_X1, len(comp)),
                     (UC_ARM64_REG_X2, self.out_base), (UC_ARM64_REG_X3, raw_len),
                     (UC_ARM64_REG_X4, 1), (UC_ARM64_REG_X5, 0), (UC_ARM64_REG_X6, 0),
                     (UC_ARM64_REG_X7, 0), (UC_ARM64_REG_SP, sp), (UC_ARM64_REG_LR, RET_SENTINEL)):
            uc.reg_write(r, v)
        self.err = None
        try:
            uc.emu_start(BASE + OODLE_DECOMPRESS, RET_SENTINEL)
        except UcError as e:
            raise RuntimeError("unicorn fault: %s pc=%#x" % (e, uc.reg_read(UC_ARM64_REG_PC) - BASE))
        if self.err:
            raise self.err
        self.calls += 1
        n = uc.reg_read(UC_ARM64_REG_X0)
        if n == 0 or n >= 1 << 40:
            return 0, b""
        return n, bytes(uc.mem_read(self.out_base, n))


def _selftest():
    vm = OodleVM()
    print("loaded; relocs", vm.reloc_counts, "imports", len(vm.stubs))
    print("import names:", sorted(vm.stubs)[:5], "...")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if "--selftest" in sys.argv:
        _selftest()
    else:
        print(__doc__)
```

`scripts/pfs0.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct

HEADER_SIZE = 0x10
ENTRY_SIZE = 0x18


def read_string(data, offset):
    end = data.find(b"\0", offset)
    if end < 0:
        raise ValueError("unterminated PFS0 filename")
    return data[offset:end].decode("utf-8")


def inventory(path):
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        header = source.read(HEADER_SIZE)
        if len(header) != HEADER_SIZE:
            raise ValueError("truncated PFS0 header")
        magic, count, strings_size, _ = struct.unpack("<4sIII", header)
        if magic != b"PFS0":
            raise ValueError(f"expected PFS0 magic, got {magic!r}")
        entries_data = source.read(count * ENTRY_SIZE)
        strings = source.read(strings_size)
        if len(entries_data) != count * ENTRY_SIZE or len(strings) != strings_size:
            raise ValueError("truncated PFS0 metadata")
        data_offset = HEADER_SIZE + len(entries_data) + strings_size
        entries = []
        for index in range(count):
            offset, size, name_offset, _ = struct.unpack_from("<QQII", entries_data, index * ENTRY_SIZE)
            name = read_string(strings, name_offset)
            entries.append({
                "index": index,
                "name": name,
                "offset": data_offset + offset,
                "size": size,
            })
        return entries


def extract(path, entry, output, overwrite):
    if output.exists() and not overwrite:
        raise FileExistsError(f"output already exists: {output}")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = output.with_name(output.name + ".part")
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    remaining = entry["size"]
    try:
        with path.open("rb") as source, temporary.open("xb") as destination:
            source.seek(entry["offset"])
            while remaining:
                chunk = source.read(min(8 * 1024 * 1024, remaining))
                if not chunk:
                    raise ValueError("truncated PFS0 member")
                destination.write(chunk)
                digest.update(chunk)
                remaining -= len(chunk)
        if output.exists():
            if not overwrite:
                raise FileExistsError(f"output already exists: {output}")
            os.replace(temporary, output)
        else:
            temporary.replace(output)
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return {**entry, "output": str(output), "sha256": digest.hexdigest()}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="List or selectively extract an uncompressed PFS0/NSP member")
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=("list", "extract"))
    parser.add_argument("input", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("member", nargs="?")
    parser.add_argument("output", nargs="?", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    entries = inventory(args.input)
    if args.command == "list":
        print(json.dumps(entries, indent=2))
        return
    if args.member is None or args.output is None:
        parser.error("extract requires member and output")
    matches = [entry for entry in entries if entry["name"] == args.member]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"expected one member named {args.member!r}, found {len(matches)}")
    print(json.dumps(extract(args.input, matches[0], args.output, args.overwrite), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/reconcile_functions.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""reconcile_functions.py - authoritative function list for the AArch64 lifter (v262144 main).

Inputs (all local, read-only):
  extracted/v262144/exefs/main.uncompressed.nso      image bytes
  analysis/ghidra/<project>.fde.tsv                  .eh_frame FDE (start, length) list
  analysis/maps/functions.tsv, imports.tsv, relocations.tsv   Ghidra / image exports
Outputs (analysis/maps, deterministic: sorted, no timestamps):
  functions_final.tsv          one row per function and per classified gap, covering all of .text
  functions_final.md           counts, rules, coverage, risks
  functions_size_buckets.tsv   every SIZE_MISMATCH / FDE_NO_FUNCTION / FUNCTION_NO_FDE row with its cause bucket
  jump_tables.tsv              every `br xN` site classified; recovered jump tables with targets
  functions_interior_entries.tsv  call/address-taken targets that land inside a function (not at its start)

Rules (see functions_final.md): FDE range wins; non-FDE functions need positive evidence
(direct bl target, address-taken target, dynsym, init/fini array, thunk/PLT, tail-b from another function).
Run: python -I scripts/reconcile_functions.py [--root <dir>] [--project snap-v262144]
"""
import os, sys as _s
_s.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "tools", "pylib"))
import argparse, bisect, collections, hashlib, re, struct
import capstone

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--root", default=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))
ap.add_argument("--project", default="snap-v262144")
ap.add_argument("--out", default=None)
args = ap.parse_args()
R = os.path.abspath(args.root)
OUT = args.out or os.path.join(R, "analysis", "maps")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- image
nso = open(os.path.join(R, "extracted", "v262144", "exefs", "main.uncompressed.nso"), "rb").read()
SHA = hashlib.sha256(nso).hexdigest()
BUILD_ID = nso[0x40:0x54].hex().upper()
segs = []
for i in range(3):
    fo, mo, sz = struct.unpack_from("<3I", nso, 0x10 + 0x10 * i)
    segs.append((mo, nso[fo:fo + sz]))
text = segs[0][1]
TEXT_END = len(text)               # includes .plt (module offsets, base 0)
NW = TEXT_END // 4
W = struct.unpack_from("<%dI" % NW, text, 0)
md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)
H = lambda v: "0x%x" % v


def tsv(p):
    out = []
    for l in open(os.path.join(R, p), encoding="utf8"):
        if l.startswith("#") or not l.strip():
            continue
        out.append(l.rstrip("\n").split("\t"))
    return out


fde = sorted((int(a, 16), int(b, 16)) for a, b in tsv("analysis/ghidra/%s.fde.tsv" % args.project))
fdestart = dict(fde)
fde_starts = [a for a, _ in fde]
gf = {}
tags_all = {}
for r in tsv("analysis/maps/functions.tsv")[1:]:
    tags = r[8].split(",")
    tags_all[int(r[0], 16)] = tags
    if "ghidra" in tags:
        gf[int(r[0], 16)] = dict(size=int(r[2], 16), tags=tags, name=r[5])
imports = tsv("analysis/maps/imports.tsv")[1:]
plt = {}
for r in imports:
    if r[6]:
        plt[int(r[6], 16)] = r[1]
reloc_fn = set()       # RELATIVE reloc targets landing in .text
for r in tsv("analysis/maps/relocations.tsv")[1:]:
    if r[1] == "RELATIVE" and r[5] and r[6] == ".text":
        reloc_fn.add(int(r[5], 16))


def sx(v, bits):
    return v - (1 << bits) if v >> (bits - 1) else v

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- instruction scan (bit masks, fast)
bl_cnt = collections.Counter()
b_list = []                # (pc, target) unconditional b
adrp_regs = {}
adrp_add = set()           # addresses formed by adrp+add that land in .text
br_sites = []
blr_count = 0
for i, w in enumerate(W):
    pc = i * 4
    t = w >> 26
    if t == 0x25:
        bl_cnt[pc + sx(w & 0x3ffffff, 26) * 4] += 1
    elif t == 5:
        b_list.append((pc, pc + sx(w & 0x3ffffff, 26) * 4))
    elif (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000:
        imm = sx(((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2 | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21)
        adrp_regs[w & 31] = ((pc & ~0xfff) + (imm << 12), pc)
    elif (w & 0xff800000) == 0x91000000:
        rn = (w >> 5) & 31
        imm = (w >> 10) & 0xfff
        if (w >> 22) & 1:
            imm <<= 12
        if rn in adrp_regs and pc - adrp_regs[rn][1] <= 64:
            tt = adrp_regs[rn][0] + imm
            if 0 <= tt < TEXT_END:
                adrp_add.add(tt)
    elif (w & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd61f0000:
        br_sites.append(pc)
    elif (w & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd63f0000:
        blr_count += 1


def fde_of(a):
    i = bisect.bisect_right(fde_starts, a) - 1
    if i >= 0 and fde[i][0] <= a < fde[i][0] + fde[i][1]:
        return fde[i]
    return None


def words(a, b):
    return W[a // 4:b // 4]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- function set
funcs = {}     # start -> dict(end, kind, ssrc, esrc, conf, notes, tags)
for a, l in fde:
    funcs[a] = dict(end=a + l, kind="function", ssrc="fde", esrc="fde", conf="high", notes=[], tags=set())
plt_lo = min(plt)
plt_hi = max(plt) + 16
for a in sorted(plt):
    funcs[a] = dict(end=a + 16, kind="plt_stub", ssrc="plt+JUMP_SLOT", esrc="plt_stub16", conf="high",
                    notes=["import:" + plt[a]], tags={"thunk"})

fde_no_fn = [a for a, _ in fde if a not in gf]
for a in fde_no_fn:
    funcs[a]["notes"].append("ghidra_missed_function")


def evidence(a):
    ev = []
    if a in bl_cnt: ev.append("bl")
    if a in reloc_fn: ev.append("reloc_ptr")
    if a in adrp_add: ev.append("adrp_add_ptr")
    tg = tags_all.get(a, [])
    for t in ("dynsym", "init_array", "fini_array", "thunk"):
        if t in tg: ev.append(t)
    return ev


def gend(a):
    return a + max(gf[a]["size"], 4)

ghidra_external = sorted(a for a in gf if a >= TEXT_END)     # Ghidra external-import thunks (outside .text)
ghidra_only_all = sorted(a for a in gf if a not in fdestart and a not in plt and a < TEXT_END)
inside_fde = [a for a in ghidra_only_all if fde_of(a)]
ghidra_only = [a for a in ghidra_only_all if not fde_of(a)]
rejected = {}   # addr -> reason
cand = []
for a in ghidra_only:
    if all(w in (0, 0xd503201f) for w in words(a, gend(a))):
        rejected[a] = "nop_or_zero_padding_function"
    else:
        cand.append(a)
candset = set(cand)
tailb_ev = set()
for pc, t in b_list:
    if t in candset and not (t <= pc < gend(t)):
        tailb_ev.add(t)


def falls_through(pc):
    w = W[pc // 4]
    if w >> 26 == 5: return False
    if (w & 0xfffffc1f) in (0xd65f0000, 0xd61f0000): return False
    if w == 0 or w == 0xe7ffdefe: return False
    if w >> 26 == 0x25: return False   # bl: assume may be noreturn -> not a fragment
    return True

unresolved = []
for a in cand:
    e = gend(a)
    ev = evidence(a)
    strong = list(ev)
    if a in tailb_ev: ev.append("tail_b")
    if ev:
        funcs[a] = dict(end=e, kind="thunk" if "thunk" in ev else "function", ssrc="+".join(ev), esrc="ghidra_body",
                        conf="high" if strong else "medium", notes=[], tags={"nofde"})
    else:
        funcs[a] = dict(end=e, kind="unresolved", ssrc="ghidra_only_no_evidence", esrc="ghidra_body", conf="low",
                        notes=[], tags={"nofde"})
        unresolved.append(a)


def clip_overlaps():
    out = []
    st_ = sorted(funcs)
    for s_, n_ in zip(st_, st_[1:]):
        if funcs[s_]["end"] > n_:
            out.append((s_, n_))
            funcs[s_]["end"] = n_
            funcs[s_]["notes"].append("clipped_at_next_start")
    return out

def trim_pad(a, e):
    while e - 4 > a and W[(e - 4) // 4] in (0, 0xd503201f):
        e -= 4
    return e

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gaps
def classify_gap(a, b):
    ws = words(a, b)
    if a == 0: return "header", "MOD0 header, not code"
    if all(w == 0 for w in ws): return "gap_padding", "zero_udf0"
    if all(w in (0, 0xd503201f) for w in ws): return "gap_padding", "nop_or_zero"
    ins = list(md.disasm(text[a:b], a))
    if len(ins) * 4 == b - a and not any(i.mnemonic == "udf" for i in ins):
        return "gap_unknown_code", "decodes_as_code_no_function"
    return "gap_data", "undecodable_words"


def compute_gaps():
    st_ = sorted(funcs)
    g = []
    cur = 0
    for s_ in st_:
        if s_ > cur: g.append((cur, s_))
        cur = max(cur, funcs[s_]["end"])
    if cur < TEXT_END: g.append((cur, TEXT_END))
    return {x: classify_gap(*x) for x in g}

overlaps = clip_overlaps()
gapinfo = compute_gaps()
st = sorted(funcs)

def containing(a):
    i = bisect.bisect_right(st, a) - 1
    if i >= 0 and funcs[st[i]]["end"] > a:
        return st[i]
    return None

# evidence-only candidates: bl / pointer targets Ghidra has no function for, sitting in a non-padding gap
evid_only = {}
for tset, name in ((bl_cnt.keys(), "bl"), (reloc_fn, "reloc_ptr"), (adrp_add, "adrp_add_ptr")):
    for t in tset:
        if 0 < t < plt_lo and t % 4 == 0 and containing(t) is None:
            evid_only.setdefault(t, set()).add(name)
padding_targets = []
gaps_sorted = sorted(gapinfo)
for t, ev in sorted(evid_only.items()):
    j = bisect.bisect_right(gaps_sorted, (t, 1 << 60)) - 1
    if j < 0 or not (gaps_sorted[j][0] <= t < gaps_sorted[j][1]): continue
    a_, b_ = gaps_sorted[j]
    if gapinfo[(a_, b_)][0] not in ("gap_unknown_code", "gap_data"):
        padding_targets.append(t); continue
    # end = next evidence-only start in the same gap, else the gap end
    nxt = [x for x in evid_only if t < x < b_]
    e = min(nxt) if nxt else b_
    funcs[t] = dict(end=trim_pad(t, e), kind="function", ssrc="+".join(sorted(ev)), esrc="next_start_or_gap_end", conf="medium",
                    notes=["evidence_only_not_in_ghidra"], tags={"nofde"})
overlaps += clip_overlaps()
st = sorted(funcs)

# fragments: no-evidence Ghidra-only entries and orphan code gaps that belong to the predecessor
def branches_into(s_, lo, hi):
    for i in md.disasm(text[s_:funcs[s_]["end"]], s_):
        if i.mnemonic != "bl" and (i.mnemonic.startswith("b") or i.mnemonic in ("cbz", "cbnz", "tbz", "tbnz")):
            m = re.search(r"#(0x[0-9a-f]+)$", i.op_str)
            if m and lo <= int(m.group(1), 16) < hi:
                return True
    return False

absorbed = 0
for a in sorted(unresolved):
    prev = max((s_ for s_ in funcs if s_ < a and funcs[s_]["kind"] != "plt_stub"), default=None)
    if prev is not None and funcs[prev]["end"] == a and (falls_through(a - 4) or branches_into(prev, a, funcs[a]["end"])):
        funcs[prev]["end"] = funcs[a]["end"]
        funcs[prev]["esrc"] += "+merged_fragment"
        funcs[prev]["notes"].append("absorbed_ghidra_split_at_" + H(a))
        rejected[a] = "fragment_merged_into_predecessor"
        del funcs[a]
        unresolved.remove(a)
st = sorted(funcs)
gapinfo = compute_gaps()
orphan_gap_c = collections.Counter()
for (a, b), (k, n) in sorted(gapinfo.items()):
    if k != "gap_unknown_code": continue
    st = sorted(funcs)
    i = bisect.bisect_left(st, a) - 1
    prev = st[i] if i >= 0 else None
    if prev is not None and funcs[prev]["end"] == a and funcs[prev]["kind"] != "plt_stub" and (falls_through(a - 4) is True or branches_into(prev, a, b)):
        funcs[prev]["end"] = trim_pad(prev, b)
        funcs[prev]["esrc"] += "+merged_orphan_code"
        funcs[prev]["notes"].append("absorbed_orphan_code_at_" + H(a))
        orphan_gap_c["merged"] += 1
    else:
        funcs[a] = dict(end=trim_pad(a, b), kind="unresolved", ssrc="code_in_gap_no_evidence", esrc="gap_end", conf="low",
                        notes=["decodes_as_code_no_call_or_pointer_evidence"], tags={"nofde"})
        unresolved.append(a)
        orphan_gap_c["unresolved"] += 1
st = sorted(funcs)
gapinfo = compute_gaps()
overlaps += clip_overlaps()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- noreturn fixpoint
NR_NAME = re.compile(r"__throw|^__cxa_throw$|^abort$|AbortImpl|DiagAbort|^_ZSt9terminatev$|^__cxa_rethrow$|^exit$|"
                     r"^_Unwind_Resume$|^longjmp$|^__assert_fail$|^__cxa_call_unexpected$|^__cxa_pure_virtual$|"
                     r"rethrow_exception|^_exit$|^__stack_chk_fail$")
noret = {a for a, n in plt.items() if NR_NAME.search(n)}
bymap = collections.defaultdict(list)
for pc, t in b_list:
    i = bisect.bisect_right(st, pc) - 1
    if i >= 0:
        s = st[i]
        if pc < funcs[s]["end"] and not (s <= t < funcs[s]["end"]):
            bymap[s].append(t)
finfo = {}
for s in st:
    if funcs[s]["kind"] == "plt_stub": continue
    ws = words(s, funcs[s]["end"])
    finfo[s] = (any((w & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd65f0000 for w in ws), any((w & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd61f0000 for w in ws), bymap.get(s, []))
changed = True
while changed:
    changed = False
    for s, (hr, hb, tails) in finfo.items():
        if s in noret or hr or hb: continue
        if funcs[s]["kind"] == "unresolved": continue
        if all(t in noret for t in tails):
            noret.add(s); changed = True
for s in noret:
    if s in funcs: funcs[s]["tags"].add("noreturn")
fn_noret = sorted(s for s in noret if s in funcs and funcs[s]["kind"] != "plt_stub")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- jump tables
def dec(pc):
    return next(md.disasm(text[pc:pc + 4], pc), None)


def seg_read(addr, n):
    for mo, data in segs:
        if mo <= addr and addr + n <= mo + len(data):
            return data[addr - mo:addr - mo + n]
    return None

TERM = (0xd65f0000, 0xd61f0000)
NODEF = {"cbz", "cbnz", "tbz", "tbnz", "cmp", "cmn", "tst", "str", "stp", "strb", "strh", "stur", "sturb", "ccmp", "ccmn", "blr", "br", "ret"}


def writes(i, r):
    """does instruction i define register name r (x/w alias)?"""
    if i.mnemonic in NODEF or i.mnemonic.startswith("b"):
        return False
    o = [x.strip() for x in i.op_str.split(",")]
    return bool(o) and o[0][1:] == r[1:] and o[0][0] in "xw"

# Tables whose base register is set on a path the window walk cannot follow (phi of two adrp+add, or a register
# kept live across calls). Table address checked by hand against the TotK generator's path-sensitive resolver
# (2026-11-11, analysis/recomp/jump_table_resolution.md): same 17 and 86 distinct targets from the table bytes
# and the guarding cmp (cmp w9,#0x13 and cmp w8,#0x9b).
# Bound read by hand where the guard is `cmp w1,#9 ; cbz x2,L ; ... L: b.hi default` (flags survive the cbz).
MANUAL_COUNT = {0x23d7a4: 10}
MANUAL_TABLE = {0x2222c0: 0xb213a5, 0x9dc1a0: 0xb29682}


def analyze_br(s):
    if plt_lo <= s < plt_hi:
        return "plt_stub", {}
    rn = dec(s).op_str.strip()
    win = []
    p = s - 4
    while p >= 0 and len(win) < 28:
        w = W[p // 4]
        if (w & 0xfffffc1f) in TERM or w >> 26 == 5 or w == 0:
            break
        i = dec(p)
        if i is None: break
        win.append(i)
        p -= 4
    mdef = None
    for k, i in enumerate(win):
        if writes(i, rn):
            mdef = i
            win = win[k + 1:]          # only definitions before the add
            break
    if mdef is None or mdef.mnemonic in ("ldr", "mov", "ldp"):
        return ("indirect_tail_vcall" if mdef is not None else "indirect_other"), {}
    if mdef.mnemonic != "add":
        return "indirect_other", {}
    ops = [o.strip() for o in mdef.op_str.split(",")]
    if len(ops) < 3 or ops[2].startswith("#"):
        return "indirect_other", {}
    ra, rb = ops[1], ops[2]
    shift = 0
    ext = None
    if len(ops) > 3:
        m = re.match(r"(lsl|sxtw|uxtw)\s*(#(\w+))?", ops[3])
        if m:
            ext = m.group(1)
            shift = int(m.group(3), 0) if m.group(3) else 0

    def find_def(r):
        for i in win:
            if writes(i, r):
                return i
        return None
    da, db = find_def(ra), find_def(rb)
    ld = base_ins = None
    for d_, other in ((db, da), (da, db)):
        if d_ is not None and d_.mnemonic in ("ldrb", "ldrh", "ldr", "ldrsb", "ldrsh", "ldrsw"):
            ld, base_ins = d_, other
            break
    if ld is None:
        return "indirect_other", {}
    esz = {"ldrb": 1, "ldrsb": 1, "ldrh": 2, "ldrsh": 2, "ldr": 4, "ldrsw": 4}[ld.mnemonic]
    signed = ld.mnemonic in ("ldrsb", "ldrsh", "ldrsw")
    m = re.match(r"\[(\w+),\s*(\w+)", ld.op_str.split(",", 1)[1].strip())
    if not m:
        return "indirect_other", {}
    rt = m.group(1)
    add_i = adrp_i = None
    for i in win:
        o = [x.strip() for x in i.op_str.split(",")]
        if o and o[0] == rt and i.mnemonic == "add" and len(o) > 2 and o[2].startswith("#") and add_i is None:
            add_i = i
        if o and o[0] == rt and i.mnemonic == "adrp":
            adrp_i = i
            break
    if adrp_i is None:
        # table register set far above the window: walk back to its defining adrp(+add) in the same function
        fd0 = fde_of(s)
        lo0 = fd0[0] if fd0 else max(0, s - 0x2000)
        p2 = s - 4
        add_i = None
        while p2 >= lo0 and p2 > s - 0x4000:
            i = dec(p2)
            if i is not None and writes(i, rt):
                if i.mnemonic == "add" and add_i is None and i.op_str.split(",")[1].strip() == rt and i.op_str.split(",")[2].strip().startswith("#"):
                    add_i = i
                elif i.mnemonic == "adrp":
                    adrp_i = i
                    break
                else:
                    break
            p2 -= 4
    if adrp_i is None and s not in MANUAL_TABLE:
        return "jump_table_unrecovered", {"why": "no_adrp_for_table"}
    if adrp_i is None:
        tbl = MANUAL_TABLE[s]
    else:
        tbl = int(adrp_i.op_str.split("#")[1], 16) + (int(add_i.op_str.split("#")[-1], 0) if add_i else 0)
    base = None
    if base_ins is not None and base_ins.mnemonic == "adr":
        base = int(base_ins.op_str.split("#")[1], 16)
    elif base_ins is None or base_ins.op_str.split(",")[0].strip()[1:] == rt[1:]:
        base = tbl
    if base is None:
        return "jump_table_unrecovered", {"why": "base_unknown", "tbl": tbl}
    count = bsrc = None
    p = s - 4
    cnt = 0
    last_cc = None
    while p >= 0 and cnt < 40:
        i = dec(p); cnt += 1
        if i is None: break
        if i.mnemonic in ("b.hi", "b.hs", "b.cs", "b.ls", "b.lo", "b.cc") and last_cc is None:
            last_cc = i
        elif i.mnemonic == "ccmp" and "#" in i.op_str and last_cc is not None and last_cc.mnemonic in ("b.hi", "b.ls"):
            # `cmp a,#0 ; ccmp x,#K,#nzcv,ne ; b.hi default`: with nzcv C=1,Z=0 the failed-condition path also
            # takes `hi`, so the bound is the ccmp immediate (0x3f1014 used to read the `cmp a,#0` as the bound)
            ops_cc = [o.strip() for o in i.op_str.split(",")]
            nz = int(ops_cc[2].lstrip("#"), 0)
            if (nz & 2) and not (nz & 4):
                count = int(ops_cc[1].lstrip("#"), 0) + 1
                bsrc = "ccmp_bound"
            break
        elif i.mnemonic == "cmp" and "#" in i.op_str and last_cc is not None:
            k = int(i.op_str.split("#")[1], 0)
            count = k + 1 if last_cc.mnemonic in ("b.hi", "b.ls") else k
            bsrc = "cmp_bound"
            break
        if (W[p // 4] & 0xfffffc1f) in TERM: break
        p -= 4
    fd = fde_of(s)
    flo, fhi = (fd[0], fd[0] + fd[1]) if fd else (0, plt_lo)
    if not count and s in MANUAL_COUNT:
        count, bsrc = MANUAL_COUNT[s], "cmp_bound_manual"
    if not count:
        # No guard in the straight-line window: the dispatch block (from the table adrp) is entered only through a
        # `cmp rN,#K ; b.ls/b.hi` of the function. Accept exactly one such conditional edge into the block.
        q = adrp_i.address if adrp_i is not None else s
        bs = q
        while bs > flo and not (W[bs // 4 - 1] >> 26 in (5, 0x25) or (W[bs // 4 - 1] & 0xfffffc1f) in TERM
                                or (dec(bs - 4) is not None and dec(bs - 4).mnemonic.startswith(("b.", "cb", "tb")))):
            bs -= 4
        edges = []
        for a in range(flo, fhi, 4):
            i = dec(a)
            if i is None or not (i.mnemonic.startswith(("b.", "cb", "tb"))):
                continue
            if i.mnemonic.startswith("b.") and ("#" in i.op_str) and bs <= int(i.op_str.split("#")[1], 16) <= s:
                edges.append((a, i, True))
        pj = dec(bs - 4)
        if pj is not None and pj.mnemonic in ("b.hi", "b.hs", "b.ls", "b.lo"):
            edges.append((bs - 4, pj, False))   # fallthrough edge
        if len(edges) == 1:
            a, i, taken = edges[0]
            # nearest cmp before the branch (up to 3 instructions back, no flag writer between)
            for back in (4, 8, 12):
                c = dec(a - back)
                if c is not None and c.mnemonic == "cmp" and "#" in c.op_str:
                    k = int(c.op_str.split("#")[1], 0)
                    ok = ((i.mnemonic == "b.ls" and taken) or (i.mnemonic == "b.hi" and not taken))
                    ok2 = ((i.mnemonic == "b.lo" and taken) or (i.mnemonic == "b.hs" and not taken))
                    if ok or ok2:
                        count = k + 1 if ok else k
                        bsrc = "cmp_bound_pred"
                    break
                if c is not None and c.mnemonic in ("subs", "adds", "tst", "ccmp", "fcmp"):
                    break
    targets = []
    for k in range(count if count else 512):
        raw = seg_read(tbl + k * esz, esz)
        if raw is None: break
        v = int.from_bytes(raw, "little", signed=signed)
        tg = base + (v << shift)
        if not count and not (flo <= tg < fhi and tg % 4 == 0):
            break
        targets.append(tg)
    valid = len(targets) > 0 and all(flo <= t < fhi and t % 4 == 0 for t in targets)
    info = dict(tbl=tbl, base=base, esz=esz, shift=shift, signed=signed, n=len(targets), targets=targets)
    if count and valid:
        info.update(bsrc=bsrc, conf="high")
        return "jump_table", info
    if not count and valid and len(targets) >= 2:
        info.update(bsrc="scan_until_invalid", conf="low" if len(targets) >= 512 else "medium")
        return "jump_table", info
    info["why"] = "targets_invalid_or_no_bound"
    return "jump_table_unrecovered", info

br_class = collections.Counter()
jt_infos = {}
for s in br_sites:
    c, info = analyze_br(s)
    br_class[c] += 1
    jt_infos[s] = (c, info)
with open(os.path.join(OUT, "jump_tables.tsv"), "w", encoding="utf8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write("# file: jump_tables.tsv\n# every `br xN` site outside the PLT (%d PLT-stub sites excluded). class: jump_table (recovered; every target validated 4-aligned inside the containing FDE), jump_table_unrecovered, indirect_tail_vcall (target loaded from memory/register move), indirect_other\n" % br_class["plt_stub"])
    f.write("# build_id: %s\n# input_sha256: %s\n" % (BUILD_ID, SHA))
    f.write("br_site\tfunction\tclass\ttable\tbase\tentry_bytes\tshift\tsigned\tcount\tbound\tconfidence\ttargets\n")
    for s in sorted(jt_infos):
        c, info = jt_infos[s]
        if c == "plt_stub": continue
        fn = containing(s)
        fns = H(fn) if fn is not None else ""
        if c == "jump_table":
            f.write("\t".join([H(s), fns, c, H(info["tbl"]), H(info["base"]), str(info["esz"]), str(info["shift"]),
                               str(int(info["signed"])), str(info["n"]), info["bsrc"], info["conf"], ";".join(H(t) for t in info["targets"])]) + "\n")
        else:
            f.write("\t".join([H(s), fns, c, H(info["tbl"]) if "tbl" in info else "", "", "", "", "", "", "", info.get("why", ""), ""]) + "\n")
n_jt = br_class["jump_table"]
jt_targets = sum(i["n"] for c, i in jt_infos.values() if c == "jump_table")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mismatch buckets
def bucket_extra(a, L, g):
    if g > L:
        if W[(a + L) // 4] == 0 and (W[(a + L - 4) // 4] >> 26) == 0x25:
            return "ghidra_longer_trailing_udf_after_final_bl"
        return "ghidra_longer_other"
    if L == 4 and W[a // 4] == 0xe7ffdefe:
        return "trap_stub_0xe7ffdefe_ghidra_size1"
    e0 = a + g
    ws = words(e0, a + L)
    if all(w in (0, 0xd503201f) for w in ws):
        return "extra_is_padding"
    ins = list(md.disasm(text[e0:a + L], e0))
    calls = [int(i.op_str[1:], 16) for i in ins if i.mnemonic == "bl"]
    pn = [plt.get(t, "") for t in calls]
    if any(n == "_Unwind_Resume" for n in pn):
        return "landing_pads_cleanup_unwind_resume"
    if any(n in ("__cxa_end_catch", "__cxa_begin_catch") for n in pn):
        return "landing_pads_catch"
    if any(x in gf and x not in fdestart for x in range(e0 + 4, a + L, 4)):
        return "fde_spans_ghidra_function"
    if ins and all(i.mnemonic in ("bl", "udf") for i in ins) and all(t in noret for t in calls):
        return "noreturn_call_tail_only"
    if ins and ins[0].mnemonic == "bl" and calls and calls[0] in noret and ins[-1].mnemonic != "ret":
        return "noreturn_call_then_landing_pad_code"
    if ins and ins[-1].mnemonic == "bl" and calls and calls[-1] in noret:
        return "landing_pad_other_ends_noreturn_call"
    for i in md.disasm(text[a:e0], a):
        if i.mnemonic != "bl" and (i.mnemonic.startswith("b") or i.mnemonic in ("cbz", "cbnz", "tbz", "tbnz")):
            m = re.search(r"#(0x[0-9a-f]+)$", i.op_str)
            if m and e0 <= int(m.group(1), 16) < a + L:
                return "extra_branch_target_cold_or_split_block"
    return "extra_unreached_code_other"

bucket_rows = []
for a, L in fde:
    g = gf.get(a)

        bucket_rows.append(("FDE_NO_FUNCTION", a, L, 0, "ghidra_missed_function"))

    else:
        reason = "ghidra_only_dropped"

bucket_rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0]))

    f.write("# file: functions_size_buckets.tsv\n# disagreement rows (see functions_disagreements.tsv) with the cause bucket assigned by reconcile_functions.py (thunks that are PLT stubs excluded)\n")
    f.write("# build_id: %s\n# input_sha256: %s\n" % (BUILD_ID, SHA))

bcount = collections.Counter((k, b) for k, a, L, g, b in bucket_rows)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- interior entries
interior = []
for t in sorted(set(bl_cnt) | reloc_fn | adrp_add):

    f.write("# kind: function | thunk | plt_stub | unresolved | gap_padding | gap_data | gap_unknown_code | header. start_source/end_source = data that decided each boundary. confidence high|medium|low\n")
    f.write("# build_id: %s\n# input_sha256: %s\n" % (BUILD_ID, SHA))

    items = []
    for s in funcs:
```

`scripts/romfs_census.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic census of the extracted v262144 RomFS (no game data embedded).

Run:  python -I scripts/romfs_census.py [--root extracted/romfs-v262144] [--no-hash] [--shaders]

Reads  : extracted/romfs-v262144/** (read-only)
Writes : analysis/romfs/files.tsv         path, size, sha256, ext, magic4
         analysis/romfs/formats.tsv       kind/key/count/bytes tallies (ext, magic, group, drp_*)
         analysis/romfs/drp_entries.tsv   one row per DRP entry (header metadata only)
         analysis/romfs/drp_archives.tsv  one row per DRP archive
         analysis/romfs/shader_scan.tsv   (--shaders) pattern hits per file / DRP entry
DRP layout follows the public ISC-licensed kwsch/NewSnap reader (header, seed table, per-entry
xorshift crypto, CRC32 extension ids).  Only headers/names are decrypted; Oodle payloads are
never decompressed (Oodle is not available here).  Pure stdlib.
"""
import argparse, collections, hashlib, os, re, struct, sys, zlib
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / "analysis" / "romfs"
M32 = 0xFFFFFFFF

DRPF_MAGIC = 0x7F0E5359      # crc32("DRPF") as seen on disk
FHDR = 0xC65753E8            # crc32("fhdr"): unencrypted marker
RESD = 0xE0A331B4            # crc32("resd"): file block
OODL = 0xE42D98BA            # crc32("Oodl"): entry payload is Oodle-compressed

# CRC32-of-extension ids (from public kwsch/NewSnap DrpFileEntry.cs)
DRP_EXT = {
0x1C375F45:"txt",0xBE1C9ACB:"msbt",0xB9715ED2:"msbp",0xBB922BB1:"lm",0x5C156DBC:"nutexb",0x950C38A5:"bnk",
0xCD63FEC8:"lmb",0x53076B6B:"lme",0x31C91A2C:"luo",0xA9B87C9F:"rtd",0xA76EEEC0:"shb",0x8C43BD03:"skb",
0x0FB47EED:"achd",0x89E759E1:"allb",0xE42AB2FE:"cbsb",0xE165A47B:"cesb",0xB20291CC:"cutb",0x7A390130:"ecbd",
0x9B70EEC4:"facb",0xF78548DD:"ldtb",0xBAF0E4F7:"lprb",0xA3D90E1B:"mdcd",0x37CD5F6B:"mdfb",0xEADAF976:"mdrp",
0xE1C38F19:"misd",0x6971203F:"navb",0xA459AA15:"nvhb",0x0B548B0F:"path",0x58284CA4:"pcnb",0x01AA8159:"pdcd",
0x6CD5ECCD:"pflb",0xB894D312:"pfrb",0x0972120A:"picd",0xF423150F:"pstb",0xBE2D954D:"ptsb",0x753C041E:"silb",
0x97948F6D:"bfotf",0x87E7C3FC:"bfttf",0x2E9EDB6D:"efxbn",0x509961FC:"characterb",0x623D9D06:"matinstb",
0xDAB89279:"numatb",0x8E6610FB:"modelb",0x0032C3E4:"nuanmb",0x81D2341C:"nuhlpb",0x236DB83A:"numshb",
0x67E93703:"nusktb",0x3F86D270:"nusrcmdlb",0xC3157ABE:"courseb",0x9C5515DE:"nufxlb",0x2F6D9B0B:"nushdb",
0x7E309203:"reflectb",0xE57E2E01:"paramb",0x2E641827:"stfrolb",0xE9AB884F:"genderb",0xF59A44EB:"levelb",
0x62BC395A:"navmshb",
}


def sar(v, n):
    if v & 0x80000000:
        v -= 1 << 32
    return (v >> n) & M32


class XorShift:
    __slots__ = "x", "y", "z", "w"

    def __init__(self, seed):
        self.w = (0x41C64E6D * seed + 12345) & M32
        self.z = (0x41C64E6D * self.w + 12345) & M32
        self.y = (0x41C64E6D * self.z + 12345) & M32
        self.x = (0x41C64E6D * self.y + 12345) & M32

    def nxt(self):
        t = (self.x ^ (self.x << 11)) & M32
        self.x, self.y, self.z = self.y, self.z, self.w
        self.w = (self.w ^ sar(self.w, 19) ^ (t ^ sar(t, 8))) & M32
        return self.w & 0x7FFFFFFF

    def word(self):  # GetNext(0xFFFFFFFF)
        a = self.nxt()
        b = self.nxt() >> 30
        return a | (b << 31)


def rng_for(seed, table):
    key = 0
    for i in range(4):
        key |= table[(seed >> (i * 8)) & 0x7F] << (i * 8)
    return XorShift(key)


def decrypt_chunk_prefix(buf, table, nbytes):
    """Decrypt a file-block chunk's first nbytes (multiple of 4). buf starts at the chunk."""
    seed = struct.unpack_from("<I", buf, 0)[0]
    r = rng_for(seed, table)
    n = min(nbytes, len(buf)) // 4
    w = list(struct.unpack_from("<%dI" % n, buf, 0))
    w[1] ^= r.word()
    w[2] ^= r.word()
    for i in range(3, n):
        w[i] ^= r.word()
    return struct.pack("<%dI" % n, *w)


def parse_drp(path):
    """Return (archive_info dict, [entry dict]). Reads headers only."""
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    ents = []
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        hd = bytearray(f.read(0x94))
        if len(hd) < 0x94 or struct.unpack_from("<I", hd, 0)[0] != DRPF_MAGIC:
            return None, []
        table = bytes(hd[0x14:0x94])
        seed = struct.unpack_from("<I", hd, 4)[0]
        marker = struct.unpack_from("<I", hd, 8)[0]
        encrypted = marker != FHDR
        if encrypted:
            r = rng_for(seed, table)
            for off in (8, 0xC, 0x10):
                v = struct.unpack_from("<I", hd, off)[0] ^ r.word()
                struct.pack_into("<I", hd, off, v)
        crc_ok = zlib.crc32(bytes(hd[0x10:0x94])) == seed
        count = struct.unpack_from("<I", hd, 0x10)[0]
        info = dict(size=size, encrypted=int(encrypted), crc_ok=int(crc_ok), count=count)
        if not crc_ok or count > 1000000:
            return info, []
        pos = 0x94
        for i in range(count):
            f.seek(pos)
            raw = bytearray(f.read(0x200))
            if len(raw) < 0x20:
                info["error"] = "truncated"
                break
            dec = bytearray(decrypt_chunk_prefix(raw, table, len(raw) & ~3) if encrypted else raw)
            seed_e, magic, total, extcrc, csz, dsz = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIII", dec, 0)
            if magic != RESD or total < 0x20 or pos + total > size:
                info["error"] = "bad chunk %d at 0x%x" % (i, pos)
                break
            nul = dec.find(b"\0", 0x18)
            if nul < 0:
                info["error"] = "long name"
                break
            name = dec[0x18:nul].decode("ascii", "replace")
            doff = (nul + 4) & ~3
            lead = struct.unpack_from("<I", dec, doff)[0] if doff + 4 <= len(dec) else 0
            oodle = lead == OODL
            magic4 = "" if oodle else bytes(dec[doff:doff + 4]).hex()
            ents.append(dict(idx=i, off=pos, total=total, name=name, extcrc=extcrc,
                             ext=DRP_EXT.get(extcrc, "%08X" % extcrc), oodle=int(oodle),
                             csize=csz, dsize=dsz, magic4=magic4, data_off=pos + doff,
                             encrypted=int(encrypted)))
            pos += total
        info["footer"] = size - pos
    return info, ents


def set_belownormal():
    try:
        import ctypes
        k = ctypes.windll.kernel32
        k.SetPriorityClass(k.GetCurrentProcess(), 0x4000)
    except Exception:
        pass


def sha_and_magic(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        first = f.read(1 << 20)
        h.update(first)
        while True:
            b = f.read(8 << 20)
            if not b:
                break
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest(), first[:4].hex()


SHADER_PATTERNS = [
    ("NVgpuprog", re.compile(rb"!!NV[a-z]{2}\d\.\d")),
    ("glsl_version", re.compile(rb"#version [1-4]\d\d")),
    ("spirv", re.compile(rb"\x03\x02\x23\x07\x00[\x00-\x06]\x01\x00")),
    ("GFSH", re.compile(rb"GFSH")),
    ("NVN_str", re.compile(rb"NVN[a-zA-Z_ ]{3,}")),
]


def shader_scan(root, rows, ents_by_path, wr):
    """Raw scan of every non-encrypted byte: non-DRP files fully, unencrypted DRPs fully.
    Encrypted DRPs: decrypt (whole entry) only shader-ish, non-Oodle entries."""
    import mmap
    shaderish = {"shb", "nushdb", "nufxlb", "matinstb", "numatb", "efxbn", "reflectb"}
    for rel, size, _, ext, magic in rows:
        if ext == "wem" or size == 0:
            continue
        info = ents_by_path.get(rel)
        if info and info[0].get("encrypted"):
            continue
        with open(root / rel, "rb") as f, mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ) as m:
            for name, pat in SHADER_PATTERNS:
                hits = [mt.start() for mt in pat.finditer(m)]
                if hits:
                    wr.write("%s\t-\t%s\t%d\t0x%x\n" % (rel, name, len(hits), hits[0]))
    for rel, (info, ents) in ents_by_path.items():
        if not info.get("encrypted"):
            continue
        with open(root / rel, "rb") as f:
            table = f.read(0x94)[0x14:0x94]
            for e in ents:
                if e["ext"] not in shaderish or e["oodle"] or e["total"] > 64 << 20:
                    continue
                f.seek(e["off"])
                raw = bytearray(f.read(e["total"]))
                dec = decrypt_chunk_prefix(raw, table, len(raw) & ~3)
                for name, pat in SHADER_PATTERNS:
                    n = len(pat.findall(dec))
                    if n:
                        wr.write("%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t-\n" % (rel, e["name"], name, n))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=str(ROOT / "extracted" / "romfs-v262144"))
    ap.add_argument("--no-hash", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--shaders", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    set_belownormal()
    root = Path(a.root)
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths = sorted(p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    rels = [p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in paths]
    if a.no_hash:
        res = [("", open(p, "rb").read(4).hex()) for p in paths]
    else:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as ex:
            res = list(ex.map(sha_and_magic, paths))
    rows = []
    for rel, p, (sha, mg) in zip(rels, paths, res):
        ext = p.suffix.lstrip(".").lower() or "(none)"
        rows.append((rel, p.stat().st_size, sha, ext, mg))
    with open(OUT / "files.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as w:
        w.write("path\tsize\tsha256\text\tmagic4\n")
        for r in rows:
            w.write("%s\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%s\n" % r)

    tally = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])

    def add(k, key, size):
        t = tally[(k, key)]
        t[0] += 1
        t[1] += size

    for rel, size, _, ext, mg in rows:
        add("ext", ext, size)
        add("magic4", mg, size)
        add("ext+magic4", "%s:%s" % (ext, mg), size)
        parts = rel.split("/")
        add("group", "/".join(parts[:3]) if len(parts) > 3 else "/".join(parts[:-1]), size)

    ents_by_path = {}
    with open(OUT / "drp_entries.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as we, \
         open(OUT / "drp_archives.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as wa:
        we.write("archive\tidx\tname\text\toodle\tcsize\tdsize\tmagic4_if_raw\n")
        wa.write("archive\tsize\tencrypted\tcrc_ok\tentries\tfooter\terror\n")
        for (rel, size, _, ext, mg), p in zip(rows, paths):
            if mg != "59530e7f":
                continue
            info, ents = parse_drp(p)
            if info is None:
                continue
            ents_by_path[rel] = (info, ents)
            wa.write("%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%s\t%s\n" % (rel, size, info["encrypted"], info["crc_ok"],
                     len(ents), info.get("footer", ""), info.get("error", "")))
            add("drp_archive_encrypted", str(info["encrypted"]), size)
            if info.get("error") or not info["crc_ok"]:
                add("drp_archive_error", info.get("error", "crc").split(" ")[0], size)
            for e in ents:
                we.write("%s\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%s\n" % (rel, e["idx"], e["name"], e["ext"],
                         e["oodle"], e["csize"], e["dsize"], e["magic4"]))
                add("drp_entry_ext", e["ext"], e["dsize"])
                add("drp_entry_ext_oodle" if e["oodle"] else "drp_entry_ext_raw", e["ext"], e["dsize"])
                if not e["oodle"]:
                    add("drp_entry_raw_ext+magic4", "%s:%s" % (e["ext"], e["magic4"]), e["dsize"])
                add("drp_entry_compression", "oodle" if e["oodle"] else "raw", e["dsize"])
    with open(OUT / "formats.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as w:
        w.write("kind\tkey\tcount\tbytes\n")
        for (k, key), (c, b) in sorted(tally.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[0][0], -kv[1][0], kv[0][1])):
            w.write("%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\n" % (k, key, c, b))
    if a.shaders:
        with open(OUT / "shader_scan.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as w:
            w.write("file\tentry\tpattern\tcount\tfirst_offset\n")
            shader_scan(root, rows, ents_by_path, w)
    print("files", len(rows), "drp", len(ents_by_path), "bytes", sum(r[1] for r in rows))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`scripts/scan_vtable_writers.py`:

```py
"""Scan .text for vtable-pointer stores; shared by classify_vtables.py. Deterministic, no capstone.
Pure word-level decode of adrp/add/ldr/str/stp/bl/b with linear register tracking."""
import struct, sys, os
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
MAPS = os.path.join(ROOT, 'analysis', 'maps')
ELF = os.path.join(ROOT, 'analysis', 'import', 'v262144-main.elf')

def load_image():
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'pylib'))
    from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
    f = ELFFile(open(ELF, 'rb'))
    img = bytearray(0xcc7000 + 0x100000)
    for s in f.iter_segments():
        if s['p_type'] == 'PT_LOAD':
            d = s.data()
            img[s['p_vaddr']:s['p_vaddr'] + len(d)] = d
    return img

def load_tsv(name):
    rows = []; hdr = None
    for l in open(os.path.join(MAPS, name), encoding='utf-8'):
        l = l.rstrip('\n')
        if l.startswith('#') or not l: continue
        p = l.split('\t')
        if hdr is None: hdr = p; continue
        rows.append(dict(zip(hdr, p)))
    return rows

def load_funcs():
    out = []
    for r in load_tsv('functions_final.tsv'):
        if r['kind'] in ('function', 'thunk'):
            out.append((int(r['start'], 16), int(r['end'], 16), r['kind']))
    out.sort()
    return out

def load_vtables():
    vts = []
    for r in load_tsv('vtables_candidate.tsv'):
        s = int(r['start_offset'], 16)
        slots = r['slots'].split(';') if r['slots'] else []
        pw = r['prefix_words'].split(',')
        vts.append(dict(start=s, slots=slots, prefix=pw, nent=int(r['entries'])))
    vts.sort(key=lambda v: v['start'])
    return vts

def load_relocs():
    rel = {}
    for r in load_tsv('relocations.tsv'):
        if r['type'] == 'RELATIVE':
            rel[int(r['offset'], 16)] = int(r['target'], 16)
    return rel

ALLOCATORS = (0x990e70, 0x3f0)
OUT_ALLOCATORS = (0x991c30,)  # aligned allocator, result returned through [x0] out-pointer

def scan(img, funcs, vtmap, rel):
    """Per function: writes[(vt, objreg, off, bl_before, insn_idx, abs_off)], calls[(idx, target, kind, x0_off)],
    strrefs[(idx, rodata addr)].  abs_off = offset from 'this' (x0 at entry, or the fresh object returned by an
    allocator call in functions <= 0x400 bytes) when the base register is this-derived, else None.
    x0_off = same for the first argument of a call."""
    res = {}
    for (s, e, kind) in funcs:
        writes = []; calls = []; strrefs = []
        regs = {}; th = {0: 0}
        small = (e - s) <= 0x400
        sp0 = None; pending = None
        n = (e - s) // 4
        words = struct.unpack_from('<%dI' % n, img, s)
        nbl = 0
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            a = s + 4 * i
            top = w & 0xff000000
            rd = w & 31
            if (w & 0x9f000000) == 0x90000000:  # adrp
                imm = (((w >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3)
                if imm & 0x100000: imm -= 0x200000
                regs[rd] = (a & ~0xfff) + (imm << 12); th.pop(rd, None)
            elif top == 0x91000000:  # add xd, xn, #imm
                rn = (w >> 5) & 31
                imm = (w >> 10) & 0xfff
                if (w >> 22) & 1: imm <<= 12
                if rn in regs and rn != 31:
                    v = regs[rn] + imm
                    regs[rd] = v
                    if 0xa39000 <= v < 0xc61000: strrefs.append((i, v))
                else:
                    regs.pop(rd, None)
                if rn in th and rn != 31: th[rd] = th[rn] + imm
                else: th.pop(rd, None)
                if rn == 31 and rd == 0: sp0 = imm
            elif (w & 0xffe0ffe0) == 0xaa0003e0:  # mov xd, xm
                rm = (w >> 16) & 31
                if rm in th: th[rd] = th[rm]
                else: th.pop(rd, None)
                if rm in regs: regs[rd] = regs[rm]
                else: regs.pop(rd, None)
            elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0xf9400000:  # ldr x unsigned
                rn = (w >> 5) & 31
                th.pop(rd, None)
                if small and rn == 31 and pending is not None and ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 8 == pending:
                    th[rd] = 0; pending = None
                if rn in regs:
                    t = rel.get(regs[rn] + ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 8)
                    if t is not None: regs[rd] = t
                    else: regs.pop(rd, None)
                else: regs.pop(rd, None)
            elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0xf9000000:  # str x
                v = regs.get(rd)
                if v is not None and v in vtmap:
                    base = (w >> 5) & 31; off = ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 8
                    writes.append((vtmap[v], base, off, nbl, i, (th[base] + off) if base in th else None))
            elif (w & 0xffc00000) == 0xa9000000:  # stp x signed offset
                imm = (w >> 15) & 0x7f
                if imm & 0x40: imm -= 0x80
                base = (w >> 5) & 31
                for k, r in ((0, rd), (1, (w >> 10) & 31)):
                    v = regs.get(r)
                    if v is not None and v in vtmap:
                        off = imm * 8 + 8 * k
                        writes.append((vtmap[v], base, off, nbl, i, (th[base] + off) if base in th else None))
            elif (w >> 26) == 0x25:  # bl
                imm = w & 0x3ffffff
                if imm & 0x2000000: imm -= 0x4000000
                t = a + imm * 4
                calls.append((i, t, 'bl', th.get(0))); nbl += 1
                for r in range(19): regs.pop(r, None); th.pop(r, None)
                if small and t in ALLOCATORS: th[0] = 0
                if small and t in OUT_ALLOCATORS: pending = sp0
            elif (w >> 26) == 0x5:  # b
                imm = w & 0x3ffffff
                if imm & 0x2000000: imm -= 0x4000000
                t = a + imm * 4
                if not (s <= t < e): calls.append((i, t, 'b', th.get(0)))
            elif (w & 0xfffffc1f) == 0xd63f0000:  # blr
                for r in range(19): regs.pop(r, None); th.pop(r, None)
            elif top in (0x54000000, 0xb4000000, 0xb5000000, 0x34000000, 0x35000000, 0x36000000, 0x37000000, 0xb6000000, 0xb7000000, 0x14000000):
                pass
            elif ((w >> 25) & 5) == 4:  # load/store class
                if (w >> 22) & 1:
                    regs.pop(rd, None); th.pop(rd, None)
                    if (w >> 27) & 7 == 5:
                        r2 = (w >> 10) & 31; regs.pop(r2, None); th.pop(r2, None)
            else:
                regs.pop(rd, None); th.pop(rd, None)
        res[s] = dict(end=e, writes=writes, calls=calls, strrefs=strrefs)
    return res

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""scope_report.py - writes analysis/runtime/nvn_usage.{tsv,md} and imports_usage.{tsv,md} from the pickle made by scope_scan.py.
Run with: python -I scripts/scope_report.py --pkl <pkl>

import argparse, os, pickle, re, sys

from scope_scan import tsv, hx, ROOT, set_lowprio, Image, load_relocs

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- NVN grouping

def nvn_object(name):

# phase 0 = needed to bring up the device and present a cleared frame; 1 = textured mesh; 2 = rest of the used set; 9 = never referenced
```
