`scripts/sdk_boundary.py`:

```py
"""Static census of the guest `sdk` module for the runtime-boundary decision (docs/runtime-boundary.md).

Read-only. Inputs: analysis/import/v262144-{main,sdk}.elf (from scripts/nso2elf.py). Outputs (no game bytes, only
counts, module offsets and symbol names) in analysis/runtime/boundary/.
Run: tools/venv-recomp/Scripts/python.exe -I scripts/sdk_boundary.py
"""
import bisect, collections, json, os, struct, subprocess
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'analysis', 'runtime', 'boundary')
CXXFILT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tools', 'llvm', 'bin', 'llvm-cxxfilt.exe')


def sext(v, bits):
    return v - (1 << bits) if v & (1 << (bits - 1)) else v


def uleb(b, p):
    r = s = 0
    while True:
        c = b[p]; p += 1
        r |= (c & 0x7F) << s; s += 7
        if c < 0x80:
            return r, p


def sleb(b, p):
    r = s = 0
    while True:
        c = b[p]; p += 1
        r |= (c & 0x7F) << s; s += 7
        if c < 0x80:
            if c & 0x40:
                r -= 1 << s
            return r, p


class Mod:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.data = open(path, 'rb').read()
        self.f = ELFFile(open(path, 'rb'))
        self.segs = [(s['p_vaddr'], s['p_filesz'], s['p_offset']) for s in self.f.iter_segments() if s['p_type'] == 'PT_LOAD']
        self.sec = {}
        for s in self.f.iter_sections():
            self.sec.setdefault(s.name, (s['sh_addr'], s['sh_size']))
        self.syms = []   # (name, value, size, type, defined)
        dynsym = self.f.get_section_by_name('.dynsym')
        for s in dynsym.iter_symbols():
            if s.name:
                self.syms.append((s.name, s['st_value'], s['st_size'], s['st_info']['type'], s['st_shndx'] != 'SHN_UNDEF'))
        self.reloc_sym = {}
        for rs in ('.rela.plt', '.rela.dyn'):
            sec = self.f.get_section_by_name(rs)
            if sec:
                for r in sec.iter_relocations():
                    if r['r_info_sym']:
                        self.reloc_sym[r['r_offset']] = dynsym.get_symbol(r['r_info_sym']).name

    def read(self, va, n):
        for v, sz, off in self.segs:
            if v <= va and va + n <= v + sz:
                return self.data[off + va - v: off + va - v + n]
        return b'\0' * n

    def plt_map(self):
        """PLT stub address -> symbol (adrp x16 / ldr x17,[x16,#off] / add / br x17)."""
        lo, size = self.sec['.plt']
        words = struct.unpack('<%dI' % (size // 4), self.read(lo, size))
        m = {}
        for i in range(len(words) - 1):
            w, w2 = words[i], words[i + 1]
            if (w & 0x9F00001F) == 0x90000010 and (w2 & 0xFFC003FF) == 0xF9400211:
                pc = lo + 4 * i
                imm = sext((((w >> 5) & 0x7FFFF) << 2) | ((w >> 29) & 3), 21) << 12
                got = (pc & ~0xFFF) + imm + ((w2 >> 10) & 0xFFF) * 8
                if got in self.reloc_sym:
                    m[pc] = self.reloc_sym[got]
        return m

    def enc(self, buf, pos, e, base):
        if e == 0xFF:
            return None, pos
        fmt, va = e & 0x0F, base + pos
        if fmt == 0x01:
            v, pos = uleb(buf, pos)
        elif fmt == 0x09:
            v, pos = sleb(buf, pos)
        elif fmt in (0x02, 0x0A):
            v = struct.unpack_from('<h' if fmt == 0x0A else '<H', buf, pos)[0]; pos += 2
        elif fmt in (0x03, 0x0B):
            v = struct.unpack_from('<i' if fmt == 0x0B else '<I', buf, pos)[0]; pos += 4
        elif fmt in (0x00, 0x04, 0x0C):
            v = struct.unpack_from('<q' if fmt == 0x0C else '<Q', buf, pos)[0]; pos += 8
        else:
            raise ValueError('pointer encoding %#x' % e)
        if (e & 0x70) == 0x10:
            v += va
        return v, pos

    def fdes(self):
        lo, size = self.sec['.eh_frame']
        buf = self.read(lo, size)
        cies, out, pos = {}, [], 0
        while pos + 4 <= len(buf):
            ln = struct.unpack_from('<I', buf, pos)[0]
            if ln == 0:
                break
            start, body = pos, pos + 4
            cid = struct.unpack_from('<I', buf, body)[0]
            if cid == 0:
                p = body + 5
                aug = buf[p:buf.index(b'\0', p)].decode(); p += len(aug) + 1
                _, p = uleb(buf, p); _, p = sleb(buf, p); _, p = uleb(buf, p)
                info = {'aug': aug, 'R': 0, 'L': 0xFF, 'P': None}
                if aug.startswith('z'):
                    _, p = uleb(buf, p)
                    for ch in aug[1:]:
                        if ch == 'R':
                            info['R'] = buf[p]; p += 1
                        elif ch == 'L':
                            info['L'] = buf[p]; p += 1
                        elif ch == 'P':
                            pe = buf[p]; p += 1
                            v, p = self.enc(buf, p, pe, lo)
                            if pe & 0x80:
                                v = self.reloc_sym.get(v, 'got%#x' % v)
                            info['P'] = v
                cies[start] = info
            else:
                cie = cies[body - cid]
                p = body + 4
                pc, p = self.enc(buf, p, cie['R'], lo)
                rng, p = self.enc(buf, p, cie['R'] & 0x0F, lo)
                lsda = None
                if cie['aug'].startswith('z'):
                    _, p = uleb(buf, p)
                    if 'L' in cie['aug'] and cie['L'] != 0xFF:
                        v, _ = self.enc(buf, p, cie['L'] & 0x0F, lo)
                        if v:
                            lsda, _ = self.enc(buf, p, cie['L'], lo)
                out.append((pc, rng, lsda, cie['P']))
            pos = body + ln
        return out

    def lsda(self, va, fstart):
        """LSDA call-site table: list of (start, len, landing_pad or 0, action)."""
        buf = self.read(va, 8192)
        p = 0
        lpe = buf[p]; p += 1
        lpstart = fstart
        if lpe != 0xFF:
            lpstart, p = self.enc(buf, p, lpe, va)
        tte = buf[p]; p += 1
        if tte != 0xFF:
            _, p = uleb(buf, p)
        cse = buf[p]; p += 1
        cslen, p = uleb(buf, p)
        end, sites = p + cslen, []
        while p < end:
            s, p = self.enc(buf, p, cse & 0x0F, va)
            l, p = self.enc(buf, p, cse & 0x0F, va)
            lp, p = self.enc(buf, p, cse & 0x0F, va)
            act, p = uleb(buf, p)
            sites.append((fstart + s, l, lpstart + lp if lp else 0, act))
        return sites


def demangle(names):
    r = subprocess.run([CXXFILT], input='\n'.join(names), capture_output=True, text=True)
    return dict(zip(names, r.stdout.split('\n')))


def classify(name, dem):
    d = dem or name
    if name.startswith(('_Unwind_', '__unw_')) or 'libunwind' in d:
        return 'unwind'
    if name.startswith(('__cxa_', '__gxx_', '__dynamic_cast')) or '__cxxabiv1' in d:
        return 'libc++abi'
    for pre in ('vtable for ', 'typeinfo for ', 'typeinfo name for ', 'VTT for ', 'construction vtable for ',
                'guard variable for ', 'non-virtual thunk to ', 'virtual thunk to '):
        if d.startswith(pre):
            d = d[len(pre):]
    if d.startswith(('std::', 'operator new', 'operator delete')):
        return 'libc++'
    if d.startswith('nn::'):
        return 'nn::' + d.split('::')[1].split('(')[0].split('<')[0]
    if d.lower().startswith('nvn'):
        return 'nvn'
    if d.startswith('nv::') or name.startswith('nv'):
        return 'nv'
    if name.startswith('nn') or d.startswith('nn'):
        return 'nn C API'
    if name.startswith('_Z'):
        return 'other C++ (%s)' % d.split('::')[0].split('(')[0][:24]
    return 'libc'


SERVICES = ['sm:', 'fsp-srv', 'hid', 'hid:sys', 'irs', 'appletOE', 'appletAE', 'audout:u', 'audren:u', 'audin:u',
            'audctl', 'auddev', 'hwopus', 'nvdrv', 'nvdrv:a', 'nvmemp', 'vi:u', 'vi:s', 'vi:m', 'set', 'set:sys',
            'time:u', 'time:a', 'time:s', 'acc:u0', 'acc:u1', 'pctl', 'pctl:a', 'prepo:u', 'prepo:a', 'nifm:u', 'bsd:u',
            'bsd:s', 'sfdnsres', 'ssl', 'friend:u', 'caps:su', 'caps:u', 'caps:a', 'ldr:ro', 'ro:1', 'lm', 'pl:u', 'csrng',
            'mm:u', 'apm', 'psm', 'nsd:u', 'nsd:a', 'aoc:u', 'bcat:u', 'erpt:c', 'fatal:u', 'ngct:u', 'pdm:qry',
            'btm:u', 'nfp:user', 'nfc:user', 'ectx:aw', 'grc:c', 'ldn:u', 'friend:a', 'olsc:u', 'hidbus', 'mii:u',
            'pgl', 'jit:u', 'dauth:0', 'fsp-pr', 'ns:am2', 'ns:ec', 'pm:shell', 'spl:', 'ovln:snd', 'nim:eca']


def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    sdk = Mod(os.path.join(ROOT, 'analysis', 'import', 'v262144-sdk.elf'))
    mn = Mod(os.path.join(ROOT, 'analysis', 'import', 'v262144-main.elf'))
    rep = {}
    sdefs = [s for s in sdk.syms if s[4]]
    sund = [s for s in sdk.syms if not s[4]]
    dem = demangle(sorted({s[0] for s in sdk.syms} | {s[0] for s in mn.syms}))
    by_name = {s[0]: s for s in sdefs}
    cls = {s[0]: classify(s[0], dem.get(s[0])) for s in sdk.syms + mn.syms}
    tlo, tsz = sdk.sec['.text']
    rep['sdk'] = {'text_bytes': tsz, 'plt_bytes': sdk.sec['.plt'][1], 'data_bytes': sdk.sec['.data'][1],
                  'bss_bytes': sdk.sec['.bss'][1], 'defined_dynsyms': len(sdefs),
                  'defined_funcs': sum(1 for s in sdefs if s[3] == 'STT_FUNC'), 'undefined_dynsyms': len(sund),
                  'undefined_names': sorted(s[0] for s in sund)}
    c, cb = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    for s in sdefs:
        if s[3] == 'STT_FUNC':
            c[cls[s[0]]] += 1; cb[cls[s[0]]] += s[2]
    rep['sdk']['exported_funcs_by_class'] = {k: [c[k], cb[k]] for k, _ in c.most_common()}

    sf, mf = sdk.fdes(), mn.fdes()
    rep['sdk']['fdes'] = len(sf)
    rep['sdk']['fdes_with_lsda'] = sum(1 for x in sf if x[2])
    rep['sdk']['personalities'] = dict(collections.Counter(str(x[3]) for x in sf if x[2]))

    lp_rows, n_lp, n_catch = [], 0, 0
    for pc, rng, lsda, pers in mf:
        if not lsda:
            continue
        sites = mn.lsda(lsda, pc)
        withlp = [s for s in sites if s[2]]
        lps = sorted({s[2] for s in withlp})
        if lps:
            n_lp += len(lps)
            catch = any(s[3] for s in withlp)
            n_catch += catch
            lp_rows.append((pc, rng, len(withlp), len(lps), int(catch)))
    rep['main_eh'] = {'fdes': len(mf), 'fdes_with_lsda': sum(1 for x in mf if x[2]),
                      'personalities': dict(collections.Counter(str(x[3]) for x in mf if x[2])),
                      'functions_with_landing_pads': len(lp_rows), 'landing_pads_unique': n_lp,
                      'callsites_with_landing_pad': sum(r[2] for r in lp_rows),
                      'functions_with_catch_or_filter_action': n_catch}
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'main_landing_pads.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n') as fo:
        fo.write('# main functions whose LSDA has landing pads (module offsets); has_action = some pad has a catch/filter action\n')
        fo.write('function\tsize\tcallsites_with_lp\tunique_pads\thas_action\n')
        for r in lp_rows:
            fo.write('%#x\t%#x\t%d\t%d\t%d\n' % r)

    mimps = [s for s in mn.syms if not s[4]]
    res, unresolved = collections.Counter(), []
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'main_imports_in_sdk.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n', encoding='utf-8') as fo:
        fo.write('# each undefined dynsym of main resolved by name against sdk exports (sdk module offsets)\n')
        fo.write('import\tdemangled\tclass\tsdk_offset\tsdk_size\tsdk_type\n')
        for s in mimps:
            d = by_name.get(s[0])
            if d:
                res[cls[s[0]]] += 1
                fo.write('%s\t%s\t%s\t%#x\t%d\t%s\n' % (s[0], dem.get(s[0], ''), cls[s[0]], d[1], d[2], d[3]))
            else:
                unresolved.append(s[0])
                fo.write('%s\t%s\t%s\t-\t-\t-\n' % (s[0], dem.get(s[0], ''), cls[s[0]]))
    rep['main_imports'] = {'total': len(mimps), 'resolved_in_sdk': sum(res.values()),
                           'by_class': dict(res.most_common()), 'unresolved': unresolved}

    pltm = sdk.plt_map()
    rep['sdk']['plt_stubs_decoded'] = len(pltm)
    words = struct.unpack('<%dI' % (tsz // 4), sdk.read(tlo, tsz))
    starts = set(x[0] for x in sf) | {s[1] for s in sdefs if s[3] == 'STT_FUNC' and tlo <= s[1] < tlo + tsz}
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        if (w & 0xFC000000) == 0x94000000:
            t = tlo + 4 * i + sext(w & 0x3FFFFFF, 26) * 4
            if tlo <= t < tlo + tsz:
                starts.add(t)
    starts = sorted(starts)
    fname = {}
    for s in sorted(sdefs, key=lambda s: s[0]):
        if s[3] == 'STT_FUNC':
            fname.setdefault(s[1], s[0])

    def fn_of(a):
        i = bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1
        return starts[i] if i >= 0 else None

    edges, ext, fsvc = collections.defaultdict(set), collections.defaultdict(set), collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i, w in enumerate(words):
        a = tlo + 4 * i
        if (w & 0x7C000000) == 0x14000000:
            t = a + sext(w & 0x3FFFFFF, 26) * 4
            src = fn_of(a)
            if t in pltm:
                nm = pltm[t]
                if nm in by_name and by_name[nm][1]:
                    edges[src].add(by_name[nm][1])
                else:
                    ext[src].add(nm)
            elif tlo <= t < tlo + tsz:
                dst = fn_of(t)
                if dst != src or t == src:
                    edges[src].add(dst)
        elif (w & 0xFFE0001F) == 0xD4000001:
            fsvc[fn_of(a)].append((w >> 5) & 0xFFFF)
    svc_count, svc_funcs = collections.Counter(), collections.defaultdict(set)
    for f, l in fsvc.items():
        for imm in l:
            svc_count[imm] += 1
            svc_funcs[imm].add(fname.get(f, '%#x' % f))
    rep['sdk']['svc_sites'] = sum(svc_count.values())
    rep['sdk']['svc_distinct'] = len(svc_count)
    rep['sdk']['svc_by_imm'] = {('%#x' % k): v for k, v in sorted(svc_count.items())}
    rep['sdk']['functions_in_callgraph'] = len(starts)

    def closure(roots):
        seen, st = set(), list(roots)
        while st:
            f = st.pop()
            if f not in seen:
                seen.add(f); st.extend(edges.get(f, ()))
        return seen

    def summarize(seen):
        size, sv = 0, collections.Counter()
        for f in seen:
            i = bisect.bisect_left(starts, f)
            size += (starts[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(starts) else tlo + tsz) - f
            for imm in fsvc.get(f, ()):
                sv[imm] += 1
        kinds = collections.Counter(cls[fname[f]] if f in fname else 'internal (not exported)' for f in seen)
        exts = set()
        for f in seen:
            exts |= ext.get(f, set())
        return {'functions': len(seen), 'bytes': size, 'svcs': {('%#x' % k): v for k, v in sorted(sv.items())},
                'by_class': dict(kinds.most_common()), 'external_calls': sorted(exts)}

    def roots(classes=None):
        return [by_name[s[0]][1] for s in mimps if s[0] in by_name and by_name[s[0]][3] == 'STT_FUNC'
                and (classes is None or cls[s[0]] in classes)]
    rt_classes = ('libc', 'libc++', 'libc++abi', 'unwind')
    ca, cr = closure(roots()), closure(roots(rt_classes))
    rep['closure_all_imports'] = summarize(ca)
    rep['closure_runtime_imports'] = summarize(cr)
    rep['sdk_whole'] = summarize(set(starts))
    nn_reached = sorted({fname[f] for f in cr if f in fname and cls[fname[f]].startswith(('nn', 'nv'))})
    rep['closure_runtime_imports']['nn_entry_points'] = len(nn_reached)
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'runtime_closure_nn_calls.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n', encoding='utf-8') as fo:
        fo.write('# nn::/nv exported sdk functions reached by direct calls from the libc/libc++/libc++abi/unwind imports of main\n')
        fo.write('class\tfunction\n')
        for n in nn_reached:
            fo.write('%s\t%s\n' % (cls[n], dem.get(n, n)))
    # Per service imported by main: does its direct-call closure reach IPC (nn::sf / svc) or stay user-mode?
    per = {}
    ipc_svcs = {0x1F, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x43, 0x44, 0x72}
    for k in sorted({cls[s[0]] for s in mimps}):
        cl = closure(roots((k,)))
        sv = {imm for f in cl for imm in fsvc.get(f, ())}
        sf = sum(1 for f in cl if f in fname and cls[fname[f]] in ('nn::sf', 'nn::sm'))
        per[k] = {'imports': sum(1 for s in mimps if cls[s[0]] == k), 'closure_functions': len(cl),
                  'svcs': len(sv), 'ipc_svcs': len(sv & ipc_svcs), 'nn_sf_functions': sf}
    rep['per_service_closure'] = per
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'per_service_closure.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n') as fo:
        fo.write('# direct-call closure inside sdk of the imports of each class (lower bound: no indirect calls)\n')
        fo.write('class\timports\tclosure_functions\tdistinct_svcs\tipc_svcs\tnn_sf_or_sm_functions\n')
        for k, v in per.items():
            fo.write('%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%d\n' % (k, v['imports'], v['closure_functions'], v['svcs'], v['ipc_svcs'], v['nn_sf_functions']))

    # Frontier: expand the runtime closure only through non-nn functions; the first nn::/nv export reached on each path
    # is where a host override would sit if sdk's libc/libc++ are lifted and nn:: is HLE'd.
    def is_nn(f):
        return f in fname and cls[fname[f]].startswith(('nn', 'nv'))
    seen, st, frontier = set(), list(roots(rt_classes)), set()
    while st:
        f = st.pop()
        if f in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(f)
        if is_nn(f):
            frontier.add(f)
            continue
        st.extend(edges.get(f, ()))
    fsv = collections.Counter(imm for f in seen if not is_nn(f) for imm in fsvc.get(f, ()))
    main_nn = {s[0] for s in mimps if cls[s[0]].startswith(('nn', 'nv'))}
    fr_names = sorted(fname[f] for f in frontier)
    rep['runtime_frontier'] = {'lifted_functions': len(seen) - len(frontier),
                               'nn_frontier_functions': len(frontier),
                               'nn_frontier_not_imported_by_main': sum(1 for n in fr_names if n not in main_nn),
                               'by_class': dict(collections.Counter(cls[n] for n in fr_names).most_common()),
                               'svcs_without_nn': {('%#x' % k): v for k, v in sorted(fsv.items())}}
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'runtime_frontier_nn.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n', encoding='utf-8') as fo:
        fo.write('# first nn::/nv export reached from main\'s libc/libc++/libc++abi/unwind imports (direct calls only): the HLE override points if sdk runtime is lifted\n')
        fo.write('class\timported_by_main\tfunction\n')
        for n in fr_names:
            fo.write('%s\t%d\t%s\n' % (cls[n], int(n in main_nn), dem.get(n, n)))
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'sdk_svcs.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n', encoding='utf-8') as fo:
        fo.write('# svc #imm in sdk .text. in_all/in_runtime = reached by the direct-call closure of all main imports / of the libc+libc++ imports only\n')
        fo.write('svc\tsites\tin_all_closure\tin_runtime_closure\tfunctions (first 4)\n')
        for imm in sorted(svc_count):
            fs = sorted(svc_funcs[imm])
            k = '%#x' % imm
            fo.write('%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\t%s\n' % (k, svc_count[imm], int(k in rep['closure_all_imports']['svcs']),
                     int(k in rep['closure_runtime_imports']['svcs']),
                     '; '.join(dem.get(x, x) for x in fs[:4]) + (' ...' if len(fs) > 4 else '')))
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'sdk_exports_by_class.tsv'), 'w', newline='\n', encoding='utf-8') as fo:
        fo.write('class\texported_funcs\tbytes_st_size_sum\n')
        for k, v in rep['sdk']['exported_funcs_by_class'].items():
            fo.write('%s\t%d\t%d\n' % (k, v[0], v[1]))
    blob = b''.join(sdk.read(v, sz) for v, sz, _ in sdk.segs)
    rep['sdk']['ipc_service_name_strings'] = [s for s in SERVICES if (b'\0' + s.encode() + b'\0') in blob]
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, 'sdk_census.json'), 'w', newline='\n') as fo:
        json.dump(rep, fo, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    print(json.dumps(rep, indent=1, sort_keys=True)[:7000])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/shader_harness/Program.cs`:

```cs
// Offline Maxwell -> SPIR-V harness. Derived from Ryujinx.ShaderTools (MIT, Ryujinx Team and Contributors).
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader;
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader.Translation;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace ShaderHarness
{
    class Program
    {
        private class GpuAccessor : IGpuAccessor
        {
            private readonly byte[] _data;
            private int _textures, _images;
            public GpuAccessor(byte[] data) { _data = data; }
            public SetBindingPair CreateConstantBufferBinding(int index) => new SetBindingPair(0, index + 1);
            public SetBindingPair CreateImageBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _images; _images += count; return new SetBindingPair(3, b); }
            public SetBindingPair CreateStorageBufferBinding(int index) => new SetBindingPair(1, index);
            public SetBindingPair CreateTextureBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _textures; _textures += count; return new SetBindingPair(2, b); }
            public ReadOnlySpan<ulong> GetCode(ulong address, int minimumSize) => MemoryMarshal.Cast<byte, ulong>(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(_data)[(int)address..]);
            public GpuGraphicsState QueryGraphicsState() => new GpuGraphicsState(false, InputTopology.Triangles, false, TessPatchType.Triangles,
                TessSpacing.EqualSpacing, false, false, false, false, false, 1f, AlphaTestOp.Always, 0f, default, true, default, false, false, true /*originUpperLeft*/, false);
            public int QuerySamplerArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;
            public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromBuffer(int slot) => 32;
            public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;
        }


        // ---- NVN layer mode ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        // Binding spaces are per stage so one fixed VkPipelineLayout serves every pipeline (see docs/nvn-vulkan-design.md):
        //   set 0: binding 0 = Ryujinx support buffer, binding 1 + stage*16 + s = constant buffer c[s] of that stage
        //   set 1: storage buffers, binding stage*16 + ordinal
        //   set 2: combined image samplers, binding stage*32 + running counter
        //   set 3: storage images, binding stage*8 + running counter
        private class NvnAccessor : IGpuAccessor
        {
            private readonly byte[] _data; private readonly int _stage, _constOff, _codeOff;
            private int _textures, _images;
            public NvnAccessor(byte[] data, int stage, int constOff, int codeOff) { _data = data; _stage = stage; _constOff = constOff; _codeOff = codeOff; }
            public uint ConstantBuffer1Read(int offset)
            {
                int o = _constOff + offset;
                return (o >= 0 && o + 4 <= _data.Length) ? BitConverter.ToUInt32(_data, o) : 0;
            }
            public SetBindingPair CreateConstantBufferBinding(int index) => new SetBindingPair(0, 1 + _stage * 16 + index);
            public SetBindingPair CreateImageBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _images; _images += count; return new SetBindingPair(3, _stage * 8 + b); }
            public SetBindingPair CreateStorageBufferBinding(int index) => new SetBindingPair(1, _stage * 16 + index);
            public SetBindingPair CreateTextureBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _textures; _textures += count; return new SetBindingPair(2, _stage * 32 + b); }
            // address 0 = start of the SPH (graphics) or of the code (compute), i.e. data[_codeOff..]
            public ReadOnlySpan<ulong> GetCode(ulong address, int minimumSize) => MemoryMarshal.Cast<byte, ulong>(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(_data)[(_codeOff + (int)address)..(_constOff & ~7)]);
            // NVN: window origin upper-left, depth near-is-zero (DepthMode=false means no [-1,1] -> [0,1] remap)
            public GpuGraphicsState QueryGraphicsState() => new GpuGraphicsState(false, InputTopology.Triangles, false, TessPatchType.Triangles,
                TessSpacing.EqualSpacing, false, false, false, false, false, 1f, AlphaTestOp.Always, 0f, default, true, default, false, false, true /*originUpperLeft*/, false);
            public int QuerySamplerArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;
            public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromBuffer(int slot) => 32;
            public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;
            // Host profile (bump the cache salt in nvn_shader.cpp when this changes): the SPIR-V must not require
            // capabilities that the layer's device does not enable. Fragment shader interlock is the one that the
            // translator declares by default and that no consumer GPU path here provides.
            public bool QueryHostSupportsFragmentShaderInterlock() => false;
            // Translator diagnostics ("instruction X is not implemented", "Invalid ...") are dropped by default. SNAP_XLATE_LOG=<file> in
            // --nvn-batch appends them as <program>, a tab and the message (audit: docs/nvn-vulkan-design.md, analysis/core/shader_audit.md).
            public void Log(string message) { if (LogW != null) lock (LogW) LogW.WriteLine(LogName + "\t" + message.Replace('\n', ' ')); }
        }
        static StreamWriter LogW; static string LogName = "";

        static string J(string s) => "\"" + s + "\"";

        // args: data.bin out.spv out.json stage(0 VS,1 FS,2 GS,5 CS) constOff codeOff
        // The translator always declares gl_PerVertex with ClipDistance[8] + CullDistance[1]; that sums to 9 and exceeds
        // maxCombinedClipAndCullDistances (8 on common GPUs), a validation error at pipeline creation. Shrink the clip array
        // to 7 entries (a fresh OpConstant, so the shared constant 8 used by other arrays is untouched) unless clip distance 7
        // is actually written.
        static byte[] FixClipCull(byte[] spv, int clipWritten)
        {
            if ((clipWritten & 0x80) != 0) { Console.Error.WriteLine("warning: clip distance 7 written; leaving gl_PerVertex as translated"); return spv; }
            uint[] w = new uint[spv.Length / 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(spv, 0, w, 0, spv.Length);
            uint structId = 0;
            for (int i = 5; i < w.Length;)
            {
                uint op = w[i] & 0xFFFF, len = w[i] >> 16;
                if (op == 72 && w[i + 3] == 11 && w[i + 4] == 3) structId = w[i + 1];   // OpMemberDecorate ... BuiltIn ClipDistance
                i += (int)len;
            }
            if (structId == 0) return spv;
            uint arrId = 0;
            for (int i = 5; i < w.Length;)
            {
                uint op = w[i] & 0xFFFF, len = w[i] >> 16;
                if (op == 30 && w[i + 1] == structId) arrId = w[i + 4];                     // OpTypeStruct: member 2 (+2 for result id and 2 earlier members)
                i += (int)len;
            }
            if (arrId == 0) return spv;
            int arrPos = -1; uint lenId = 0;
            for (int i = 5; i < w.Length;)
            {
                uint op = w[i] & 0xFFFF, len = w[i] >> 16;
                if (op == 28 && w[i + 1] == arrId) { arrPos = i; lenId = w[i + 3]; }
                i += (int)len;
            }
            if (arrPos < 0) return spv;
            int constEnd = -1; uint constType = 0;
            for (int i = 5; i < w.Length;)
            {
                uint op = w[i] & 0xFFFF, len = w[i] >> 16;
                if (op == 43 && w[i + 2] == lenId) { constEnd = i + (int)len; constType = w[i + 1]; }
                i += (int)len;
            }
            if (constEnd < 0) return spv;
            uint newId = w[3]; w[3] = newId + 1;
            w[arrPos + 3] = newId;
            var o = new List<uint>(w.Length + 4);
            o.AddRange(w.Take(constEnd));
            o.Add((4u << 16) | 43u); o.Add(constType); o.Add(newId); o.Add(7);
            o.AddRange(w.Skip(constEnd));
            // the array type may precede the constant (it cannot: its length operand must be defined first), so positions after constEnd shifted only
            byte[] r = new byte[o.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(o.ToArray(), 0, r, 0, r.Length);
            return r;
        }

        static int Nvn(string[] a)
        {
            return NvnTranslate(File.ReadAllBytes(a[0]), a[1], a[2], int.Parse(a[3]), int.Parse(a[4]), int.Parse(a[5]));
        }

        // --nvn-batch list.tsv binsDir outDir salt: every program of the list (corpus from scripts/xlate_corpus.py) is translated in
        // this process and written as <key>.spv/.json, key = SHA-256(data section || salt|stage|codeOff), the NVN layer's cache key
        // (runtime/nvn/nvn_shader.cpp Sha256Hex). Failures are listed in outDir\failures.tsv and do not stop the run.
        // Optional 5th/6th arguments first and count translate a slice of the list (chunks under 10 minutes).
        static int NvnBatch(string[] a)
        {
            string[] lines = File.ReadAllLines(a[0]);
            string binsDir = a[1], outDir = a[2], salt = a[3];
            int first = a.Length > 4 ? int.Parse(a[4]) : 0, count = a.Length > 5 ? int.Parse(a[5]) : lines.Length;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
            using var fail = new StreamWriter(Path.Combine(outDir, "failures" + first + ".tsv"));
            int ok = 0, bad = 0;
            string logPath = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SNAP_XLATE_LOG");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(logPath)) LogW = new StreamWriter(logPath, true);
            for (int i = first; i < Math.Min(lines.Length, first + count); i++)
            {
                string[] f = lines[i].Split('	');
                byte[] data = File.ReadAllBytes(Path.Combine(binsDir, f[0] + ".bin"));
                int stage = int.Parse(f[1]), constOff = int.Parse(f[2]), codeOff = int.Parse(f[3]);
                LogName = f[4];
                byte[] extra = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(salt + "|" + stage + "|" + codeOff);
                var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create();
                sha.TransformBlock(data, 0, data.Length, null, 0);
                sha.TransformFinalBlock(extra, 0, extra.Length);
                string key = Convert.ToHexString(sha.Hash).ToLowerInvariant();
                try { NvnTranslate(data, Path.Combine(outDir, key + ".spv"), Path.Combine(outDir, key + ".json"), stage, constOff, codeOff); ok++; }
                catch (Exception e) { bad++; fail.WriteLine(f[0] + "\t" + key + "\t" + f[4] + "\t" + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message.Replace('\n', ' ')); }
            }
            LogW?.Flush();
            Console.WriteLine("ok " + ok + " failed " + bad);
            return bad == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        }

        static int NvnTranslate(byte[] data, string outSpv, string outJson, int stage, int constOff, int codeOff)
        {
            TranslationFlags flags = TranslationFlags.DebugMode;
            if (stage == 5) flags |= TranslationFlags.Compute;
            var ctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, new NvnAccessor(data, stage, constOff, codeOff), new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Spirv, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags));
            ShaderProgram p = ctx.Translate();
            File.WriteAllBytes(outSpv, FixClipCull(p.BinaryCode, (int)p.Info.ClipDistancesWritten));
            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            sb.Append("{\"stage\":" + stage + ",\"usesInstanceId\":" + (p.Info.UsesInstanceId ? 1 : 0) + ",\"usesFragCoord\":" + (p.Info.UsesFragCoord ? 1 : 0)
                + ",\"clipDistances\":" + p.Info.ClipDistancesWritten + ",\"fragmentOutputMap\":" + p.Info.FragmentOutputMap);
            sb.Append(",\"cbuffers\":[");
            bool first = true;
            foreach (var c in p.Info.CBuffers) { sb.Append((first ? "" : ",") + "{\"slot\":" + c.Slot + ",\"set\":" + c.Set + ",\"binding\":" + c.Binding + "}"); first = false; }
            sb.Append("],\"sbuffers\":[");
            first = true;
            foreach (var c in p.Info.SBuffers) { sb.Append((first ? "" : ",") + "{\"slot\":" + c.Slot + ",\"set\":" + c.Set + ",\"binding\":" + c.Binding + ",\"sbCbSlot\":" + c.SbCbSlot + ",\"sbCbOffset\":" + c.SbCbOffset + ",\"write\":" + (((int)c.Flags & 1) != 0 ? 1 : 0) + "}"); first = false; }
            sb.Append("],\"textures\":[");
            first = true;
            foreach (var t in p.Info.Textures) { sb.Append((first ? "" : ",") + "{\"set\":" + t.Set + ",\"binding\":" + t.Binding + ",\"handleIndex\":" + t.HandleIndex + ",\"cbufSlot\":" + t.CbufSlot + ",\"type\":" + (int)t.Type + ",\"array\":" + t.ArrayLength + ",\"separate\":" + (t.Separate ? 1 : 0) + "}"); first = false; }
            sb.Append("],\"images\":[");
            first = true;
            foreach (var t in p.Info.Images) { sb.Append((first ? "" : ",") + "{\"set\":" + t.Set + ",\"binding\":" + t.Binding + ",\"handleIndex\":" + t.HandleIndex + ",\"cbufSlot\":" + t.CbufSlot + ",\"type\":" + (int)t.Type + ",\"array\":" + t.ArrayLength + ",\"flags\":" + (int)t.Flags + "}"); first = false; }
            sb.Append("]}");
            File.WriteAllText(outJson, sb.ToString());
            return 0;
        }

        static int Batch(string list, string outDir)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
            using var res = new StreamWriter(Path.Combine(outDir, "results.tsv"));
            foreach (string line in File.ReadAllLines(list))
            {
                string[] f = line.Split('\t');
                string name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(f[0]);
                var sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
                try
                {
                    TranslationFlags flags = TranslationFlags.DebugMode;
                    if (f[1] == "CS") flags |= TranslationFlags.Compute;
                    var ctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, new GpuAccessor(File.ReadAllBytes(f[0])), new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Spirv, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags));
                    ShaderProgram p = ctx.Translate();
                    File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(outDir, name + ".spv"), p.BinaryCode);
                    res.WriteLine(name + "\tok\t" + p.BinaryCode.Length + "\t" + p.Info.CBuffers.Count + "\t" + p.Info.Textures.Count + "\t" + p.Info.SBuffers.Count + "\t" + sw.ElapsedMilliseconds);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    string m = e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message.Replace('\n', ' ');
                    string at = e.StackTrace == null ? "" : e.StackTrace.Split('\n')[0].Trim();
                    res.WriteLine(name + "	FAIL	" + m + " @ " + at);
                }
                res.Flush();
            }
            return 0;
        }

        static int Main(string[] args)
        {
            // args: in.bin out.spv [compute]   |   --batch list.tsv outdir  (list: path<TAB>stage; writes results.tsv)
            if (args.Length == 7 && args[0] == "--nvn") return Nvn(args[1..]);
            if (args.Length >= 5 && args[0] == "--nvn-batch") return NvnBatch(args[1..]);
            if (args.Length == 3 && args[0] == "--batch") return Batch(args[1], args[2]);
            if (args.Length < 2) { Console.Error.WriteLine("usage: in.bin out.spv [compute]"); return 2; }
            TranslationFlags flags = TranslationFlags.DebugMode;
            if (args.Length > 2 && args[2] == "compute") flags |= TranslationFlags.Compute;
            byte[] data = File.ReadAllBytes(args[0]);
            var opts = new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Spirv, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags);
            var ctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, new GpuAccessor(data), opts);
            ShaderProgram program = ctx.Translate();
            if (program.BinaryCode != null) File.WriteAllBytes(args[1], program.BinaryCode);
            else File.WriteAllText(args[1], program.Code);
            Console.WriteLine("ok stage=" + program.Info.Stage + " cb=" + program.Info.CBuffers.Count + " tex=" + program.Info.Textures.Count + " ssbo=" + program.Info.SBuffers.Count + " spv=" + (program.BinaryCode?.Length ?? 0));
            if (args.Length > 3 && args[3] == "info")
            {
                foreach (var t in program.Info.Textures) Console.WriteLine("  tex set=" + t.Set + " bind=" + t.Binding + " cbufSlot=" + t.CbufSlot + " handleIdx=" + t.HandleIndex + " type=" + t.Type + " fmt=" + t.Format + " flags=" + t.Flags);
                foreach (var c in program.Info.CBuffers) Console.WriteLine("  cbuf set=" + c.Set + " bind=" + c.Binding + " slot=" + c.Slot);
                foreach (var c in program.Info.SBuffers) Console.WriteLine("  sbuf set=" + c.Set + " bind=" + c.Binding + " slot=" + c.Slot + " sbCbSlot=" + c.SbCbSlot + " sbCbOff=" + c.SbCbOffset);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
```

`scripts/snap_save.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""snap_save.py - inspect and edit a SnapRecomp save directory (New Pokemon Snap). Code only, no game data.

Format (from kwsch/NewSnap, ISC, cloned to tools/ref/NewSnap; the constants are parsed from its SaveReader.cs at run
time so no key material lives in this repo):
  save root:  CURRENT ("SNAPSAVE1\\n<gen>\\n<check>\\n"), gens/<n>/<16 hex file names>, gens/<n>.ok
  save file:  0x30 header (AES-128-CBC, IV masked by an xorshift stream seeded 0xB519FC35 + file index), then
              <entry_count> entries of <enc_size> bytes: 16 byte masked IV + AES-CBC(0x20 meta + data).
  entry meta: adler32, crc32 (both over data[:data_size]), magic 0x9B7A0B7C, data_size, data_size again, 3 unknown words.
  A fully zero first qword marks an empty entry (left alone).

Needs the `cryptography` package: run with `python -E -P scripts/snap_save.py ...` (user-site packages).

  snap_save.py dump SRC [--entry FILE:ENTRY] [--all]
  snap_save.py unlock SRC DST [--profile unlock|unlock_routes|none] [--set FILE:ENTRY:OFFSET:SIZE=VALUE ...]
  snap_save.py patch SRC DST --set FILE:ENTRY:OFFSET:SIZE=VALUE [--set ...]
SRC is a save root (uses CURRENT), a gens/<n> dir, or a dir of save files. DST is a new save root; it must not exist
(never edits in place). Only the edited save files are rewritten; the rest are copied byte for byte.
"""
import argparse, os, re, shutil, struct, sys, zlib

M32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REF = os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'tools', 'ref', 'NewSnap', 'NewSnap.Lib', 'Saves', 'SaveReader.cs')
HDR = 0x30


def load_consts():
    try:
        src = open(REF, encoding='utf-8-sig').read()
    except OSError:
        sys.exit('missing %s: git clone https://github.com/kwsch/NewSnap tools/ref/NewSnap' % os.path.normpath(REF))
    names = re.findall(r'"([0-9a-f]{16})"', src)
    keys = [int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'0x(B519FC[0-9A-F]{2})', src)]
    hk = re.search(r'HeaderKey\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}', src, re.S).group(1)
    key = bytes(int(x, 16) for x in re.findall(r'0x([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})', hk))
    assert len(names) == 16 and len(keys) == 16 and len(key) == 16
    return names, keys, key


NAMES, KEYS, KEY = load_consts()


class XorShift:
    def __init__(s, seed):
        s.w = (0x41C64E6D * seed + 12345) & M32
        s.z = (0x41C64E6D * s.w + 12345) & M32
        s.y = (0x41C64E6D * s.z + 12345) & M32
        s.x = (0x41C64E6D * s.y + 12345) & M32

    def next(s):
        t = (s.x ^ (s.x << 11)) & M32
        sw = s.w - (1 << 32) if s.w & 0x80000000 else s.w
        st = t - (1 << 32) if t & 0x80000000 else t
        s.x, s.y, s.z = s.y, s.z, s.w
        s.w = (s.w ^ ((sw >> 19) & M32) ^ (t ^ ((st >> 8) & M32))) & M32
        return s.w & 0x7FFFFFFF

    def limit(s, lim):  # NewSnap GetNext(limit) for limit < 0x7FFFFFFF
        d = 0x80000000 // (lim + 1)
        while True:
            r = s.next() // d
            if r <= lim:
                return r


def mask_iv(raw16, seed):  # symmetric xor mask
    r = XorShift(seed)
    return bytes(raw16[i] ^ (r.limit(0xFE) + 1) for i in range(16))


def aes(iv, data, decrypt):
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes
    c = Cipher(algorithms.AES(KEY), modes.CBC(iv))
    o = c.decryptor() if decrypt else c.encryptor()
    return o.update(data) + o.finalize()


class SaveFile:
    def __init__(self, path, index):
        self.path, self.index = path, index
        self.f = open(path, 'rb')
        h = self.f.read(HDR)
        hd = aes(mask_iv(h[0x20:], KEYS[index]), h[:0x20], True)
        self.magic, self.enc_size, self.dec_size, self.count, self.size_maybe = struct.unpack('<IiiiI', hd[:20])
        self.raw_header = h

    def raw_entry(self, e):
        self.f.seek(HDR + e * self.enc_size)
        return self.f.read(self.enc_size)

    def read(self, e):
        """None for an empty entry, else (meta dict, bytearray of data_size bytes)."""
        b = self.raw_entry(e)
        if len(b) < self.enc_size or b[:8] == bytes(8):
            return None
        iv_masked = b[:16]
        d = aes(mask_iv(iv_masked, KEYS[self.index] + e), b[16:], True)
        adler, crc, magic, sz, sz2, u1, u2, u3 = struct.unpack('<IIIiiIII', d[:0x20])
        return dict(adler=adler, crc=crc, magic=magic, size=sz, size2=sz2, unk=(u1, u2, u3), iv=iv_masked,
                    pad=d[0x20 + sz:]), bytearray(d[0x20:0x20 + sz])

    @staticmethod
    def checks_ok(meta, data):
        return meta['adler'] == zlib.adler32(bytes(data)) and meta['crc'] == zlib.crc32(bytes(data))

    def build_entry(self, e, meta, data):
        body = struct.pack('<IIIiiIII', zlib.adler32(bytes(data)) & M32, zlib.crc32(bytes(data)) & M32, meta['magic'],
                           len(data), len(data), *meta['unk']) + bytes(data) + meta['pad']
        return meta['iv'] + aes(mask_iv(meta['iv'], KEYS[self.index] + e), body, False)


def resolve_gen(src):
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(src, 'CURRENT')):
        n = open(os.path.join(src, 'CURRENT')).read().split()[1]
        return os.path.join(src, 'gens', n), int(n)
    base = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(src))
    return src, int(base) if base.isdigit() else 1


def open_gen(gdir):
    out = {}
    for i, n in enumerate(NAMES):
        p = os.path.join(gdir, n)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            out[i] = SaveFile(p, i)
    return out


def words(b):
    return struct.unpack('<%dI' % (len(b) // 4), bytes(b[:len(b) // 4 * 4]))


def nonzero_bytes(b):
    return [(hex(o), b[o]) for o in range(len(b)) if b[o]]


ALBUM_INUSE = 0x14  # file 6 data byte: 1 = album slot in use, 0 = free (analysis/save/album.md)


def album_slots(sf):
    """(in-use slots, freed slots that still hold data) of the album metadata file 6."""
    inuse, freed = [], []
    for e in range(sf.count):
        r = sf.read(e)
        if r is None or not any(r[1]):
            continue
        (inuse if len(r[1]) > ALBUM_INUSE and r[1][ALBUM_INUSE] else freed).append(e)
    return inuse, freed


def cmd_dump(a):
    gdir, n = resolve_gen(a.src)
    files = open_gen(gdir)
    print('generation', n, gdir)
    for i, sf in files.items():
        scan = sf.enc_size <= 0x4000 or a.all
        used = bad = 0
        if scan:
            for e in range(sf.count):
                r = sf.read(e)
                if r is None:
                    continue
                if any(r[1]):
                    used += 1
                if not sf.checks_ok(*r):
                    bad += 1
        print('file %2d %s size=%d entries=%d enc=%#x data=%#x nonzero_entries=%s bad_checksums=%s' % (
            i, NAMES[i], os.path.getsize(sf.path), sf.count, sf.enc_size, sf.dec_size,
            used if scan else '-', bad if scan else '-'))
    if 6 in files:  # album: file 6 byte 0x14 = slot in use; Cancel Save clears it and leaves the image (a freed slot)
        inuse, freed = album_slots(files[6])
        print('album: %d photos in use (slots %s), %d freed slots with data%s' % (
            len(inuse), inuse, len(freed), ' (slots %s)' % freed if a.freed else ' (--freed lists them)' if freed else ''))
    if a.entry:
        fi, e = [int(x, 0) for x in a.entry.split(':')]
        meta, data = files[fi].read(e)
        print('entry %d:%d size=%d checksums_ok=%s' % (fi, e, len(data), files[fi].checks_ok(meta, data)))
        for o in range(0, len(data), 32):
            if any(data[o:o + 32]) or a.all:
                print('  %04x %s' % (o, bytes(data[o:o + 32]).hex(' ', 4)))
    else:
        dump_fields(files)
        for fi in (1, 12):
            if fi in files:
                meta, data = files[fi].read(0)
                print('file %d words:' % fi, {i: w for i, w in enumerate(words(data)) if w})
        if 9 in files:
            meta, data = files[9].read(0)
            print('file 9 nonzero bytes:', nonzero_bytes(data)[:40])


def load_thresholds():
    """(w1, w2, w3) per route from ResearchPoint.mdrp (read at run time; nothing embedded)."""
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    for dp, _, fs in os.walk(os.path.join(root, 'extracted')):
        if 'ResearchPoint.mdrp' in fs:
            b = open(os.path.join(dp, 'ResearchPoint.mdrp'), 'rb').read()
            out = {}
            for i in range(ROUTES):
                p = 28 + 4 * i
                t = p + struct.unpack_from('<I', b, p)[0]
                out[i + 1] = struct.unpack_from('<3I', b, t + 12)
            return out
    return None


def level_of(pts, th):
    w1, w2, w3 = th
    return 4 if pts >= w3 else 3 if pts >= w2 else 2 if pts >= w1 else 1


def dump_fields(files):
    """Pretty-print the identified unlock / level / research fields (see analysis/save/fields.md)."""
    if 9 not in files or 11 not in files:
        return
    st = files[11].read(0)[1]
    rec = files[9].read(0)[1]
    th = load_thresholds()
    print('routes (status: 0 locked, 1 unlocked, 2 entered; level 1-4 from research points):')
    for r in range(ROUTES):
        base = r * REC
        plays = struct.unpack_from('<I', rec, base)[0]
        pts = n = 0
        for k in range(40):
            o = base + ENT0 + 12 * k
            if struct.unpack_from('<H', rec, o)[0] == 0:
                break
            n += 1
            pts += sum(struct.unpack_from('<4H', rec, o + 4))
        base_pts = int.from_bytes(rec[base + 0x1f1:base + 0x1f4], 'little')
        lv = '?' if th is None else level_of(pts, th[r + 1])
        print('  route %2d status=%d plays=%d entries=%d points=%d level=%s found=%#x prev_level=%d baseline=%d%s' % (
            r + 1, st[r], plays, n, pts, lv, struct.unpack_from('<Q', rec, base + 0x1e8)[0], rec[base + 0x1f0],
            base_pts, '' if th is None else ' thresholds=%s' % (th[r + 1],)))


def parse_set(s):
    m = re.fullmatch(r'(\w+):(\w+):(\w+):(\d+)=(\w+)', s)
    if not m:
        sys.exit('bad --set %r (want FILE:ENTRY:OFFSET:SIZE=VALUE)' % s)
    fi, e, off, sz, v = m.groups()
    return int(fi, 0), int(e, 0), int(off, 0), int(sz), int(v, 0)


PROFILES = {}


def profile(name):
    def deco(f):
        PROFILES[name] = f
        return f
    return deco


@profile('none')
def _none(files):
    return []


ROUTES = 30
REC = 0x1f8        # file 9 entry 0: ROUTES route records of 0x1f8 bytes, indexed by route_id-1
ENT0 = 8           # first research entry in a record: u16 id (0 ends the list), u16 skipped, 4 x u16 scores
ENT_ID = 1         # research-entry id used by `unlock` (UNVERIFIED: valid ids were not identified statically)


def route_edits(files, scored=True, entry_id=None):
    """Course unlock (file 11 status byte) and, when `scored`, research points >= every level threshold (file 9)."""
    if 11 not in files or 9 not in files:
        sys.exit('save lacks file 9 / file 11')
    st = files[11].read(0)[1]
    rec = files[9].read(0)[1]
    ed = []
    for r in range(ROUTES):
        if st[r] == 0:
            ed.append((11, 0, r, 1, 1))      # 1 = unlocked, not yet entered; the game promotes it to 2 on first entry
        if not scored:
            continue
        base = r * REC
        if struct.unpack_from('<I', rec, base)[0] == 0:
            ed.append((9, 0, base, 4, 1))    # played / cleared count (0 means never played)
        eid = struct.unpack_from('<H', rec, base + ENT0)[0]
        if eid == 0:
            ed.append((9, 0, base + ENT0, 2, ENT_ID if entry_id is None else entry_id))
        for k in range(4):                  # 4 x 0xFFFF = 262140 >= the largest threshold (200000)
            ed.append((9, 0, base + ENT0 + 4 + 2 * k, 2, 0xFFFF))
    return ed


@profile('unlock')
def _unlock(files):
    return route_edits(files, True)


@profile('unlock_routes')
def _unlock_routes(files):
    return route_edits(files, False)


PROFILES['all'] = _unlock


def apply_edits(files, edits):
    """edits: (file, entry, offset, size, value); returns {file index: {entry: (meta, data)}}"""
    changed = {}
    for fi, e, off, sz, v in edits:
        if fi not in files:
            sys.exit('save has no file %d' % fi)
        ent = changed.setdefault(fi, {})
        if e not in ent:
            r = files[fi].read(e)
            if r is None:
                sys.exit('file %d entry %d is empty' % (fi, e))
            ent[e] = r
        meta, data = ent[e]
        if off + sz > len(data):
            sys.exit('offset %#x+%d beyond entry data (%d)' % (off, sz, len(data)))
        data[off:off + sz] = (v & ((1 << (8 * sz)) - 1)).to_bytes(sz, 'little')
    return changed


def cmd_write(a):
    if os.path.exists(a.dst):
        sys.exit('refusing: DST exists (never edits in place): ' + a.dst)
    gdir, n = resolve_gen(a.src)
    files = open_gen(gdir)
    edits = list(PROFILES[a.profile](files))
    edits += [parse_set(s) for s in (a.set or [])]
    changed = apply_edits(files, edits)
    ngdir = os.path.join(a.dst, 'gens', str(n))
    os.makedirs(ngdir)
    for i, sf in files.items():
        out = os.path.join(ngdir, NAMES[i])
        if i not in changed:
            shutil.copyfile(sf.path, out)
            continue
        with open(out, 'wb') as o:
            o.write(sf.raw_header)
            for e in range(sf.count):
                if e in changed[i]:
                    meta, data = changed[i][e]
                    o.write(sf.build_entry(e, meta, data))
                else:
                    o.write(sf.raw_entry(e))
        chk = SaveFile(out, i)  # self-check: re-read what was just written
        for e, (meta, data) in changed[i].items():
            m2, d2 = chk.read(e)
            assert d2 == data and chk.checks_ok(m2, d2), 'verify failed %d:%d' % (i, e)
    open(ngdir + '.ok', 'w').write('ok\n')
    check = ((n * 2654435761) & M32) ^ 0x534e4150  # Save::check_of in runtime/hle/fs_core.cpp
    open(os.path.join(a.dst, 'CURRENT'), 'w', newline='\n').write('SNAPSAVE1\n%d\n%d\n' % (n, check))
    print('wrote %s (generation %d); edited files: %s; %d edits' % (a.dst, n, sorted(changed), len(edits)))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    d = sub.add_parser('dump')
    d.add_argument('src'); d.add_argument('--entry'); d.add_argument('--all', action='store_true')
    d.add_argument('--freed', action='store_true', help='also list freed album slots (data left by Cancel Save)')
    u = sub.add_parser('unlock')
    u.add_argument('src'); u.add_argument('dst'); u.add_argument('--profile', default='unlock'); u.add_argument('--set', action='append')
    p = sub.add_parser('patch')
    p.add_argument('src'); p.add_argument('dst'); p.add_argument('--set', action='append', required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == 'dump':
        cmd_dump(a)
    else:
        if a.cmd == 'patch':
            a.profile = 'none'
        cmd_write(a)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/trace_render_graph.py`:

```py
"""Render-pass graph trace -> analysis/maps/render_passes_final.tsv (deterministic).
Pass nodes are created by three code paths that all call the node factory 0x97a680 (vtable 0xcc4058):
  - 0x5cd800 (CreatePass(name), 35 call sites inside 0x5bd940)
  - 0x5bd940 itself ("DynamicShadow", direct call to 0x97a680)
  - 0x4d0f50 ("StaticShadow", called from 0x5bd940)
Names are the rodata string referenced (adrp+add) between the previous graph-helper call and the call site."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from scan_vtable_writers import *

FACTORY = 0x97a680; CREATE = 0x5cd800; SHADOW_S = 0x4d0f50; BUILDER = 0x5bd940
HELPERS = {0x5cd800, 0x5cd2a0, 0x987d20, 0x4d0f50, 0x97a680, 0x9863c0, 0x5b8340, 0x5b9a70, 0x5b9390, 0x5ba450,
           0x5cdba0, 0x5ce300, 0x5cea90, 0x4ca580, 0x4caa90, 0x5b8240}
BAD = ('output', 'Input', 'rendertarget', 'RenderTarget', 'depthstencil', 'DepthStencil', 'plug', 'constantBuffer',
       'Constant', 'ConstantBuffer', 'renertarget', 'Layout')


def cstr(img, a):
    e = a
    while e < len(img) and img[e] != 0 and e - a < 96:
        e += 1
    b = bytes(img[a:e])
    if len(b) < 2 or not all(32 <= c < 127 for c in b):
        return None
    return b.decode()


def main():
    img = load_image(); funcs = [f for f in load_funcs() if f[0] in (BUILDER, SHADOW_S)]
    res = scan(img, funcs, {}, load_relocs())
    r = res[BUILDER]
    calls = sorted(r['calls'])
    rows = []
    prev = -1
    for (i, t, k, _) in calls:
        if t in HELPERS:
            if t in (CREATE, FACTORY):
                names = []
                for (j, a) in r['strrefs']:
                    if prev < j < i:
                        st = cstr(img, a)
                        if st and not any(b in st for b in BAD):
                            names.append(st)
                name = names[-1] if names else '(unresolved)'
                rows.append((name, 'CreatePass_0x5cd800' if t == CREATE else 'inline_0x5bd940', BUILDER + 4 * i))
            prev = i
    # StaticShadow from 0x4d0f50
    r2 = res[SHADOW_S]
    nm = None
    for (j, a) in r2['strrefs']:
        st = cstr(img, a)
        if st == 'StaticShadow':
            nm = st
    if nm:
        site = [BUILDER + 4 * i for (i, t, k, _) in calls if t == SHADOW_S][0]
        rows.append((nm, 'factory_0x4d0f50', site))
    # order: by call site address
    rows.sort(key=lambda x: x[2])
    cid = 'Ccc4058'
    with open(os.path.join(MAPS, 'render_passes_final.tsv'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        f.write('# file: render_passes_final.tsv\n')
        f.write('# one row per graph pass node created in the pass-graph builder 0x5bd940 (scripts/trace_render_graph.py). All nodes share one class: the generic RenderPassBase node (0xf8-byte object) built by factory 0x97a680.\n')
        f.write('# execute_slot_fn = vtable slot 5 (+0x28) = per-frame Execute called by the execute loop 0x988fe0; identical for every pass (no per-pass override found); per-pass behavior lives in plug/task objects attached to the node (see render_graph.md)\n')
        f.write('# build_id: DDB900FF04A912ED42430508389853CFAF1ACCCE\n')
        f.write('pass_name\tclass_id\tctor\tvtable\texecute_slot_fn\tcreator\tcreate_site\tbase_class_id\tconfidence\n')
        for name, creator, site in rows:
            conf = 'medium' if name != '(unresolved)' else 'low'
            f.write('\t'.join([name, cid, '0x97a680', '0xcc4058', '0x982210', creator, '0x%x' % site, 'Ccc3fe8', conf]) + '\n')
    print('pass rows', len(rows), 'unresolved', sum(1 for x in rows if x[0] == '(unresolved)'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/ui/lmb.py`:

```py
"""LMBB reader and prepend-patcher for the game's Lumen behavior files (`<scene>.lmb`, FlatBuffers, file id "LMBB").

A scene is <scene>.lm (Lumen/Flash layout: movie clips, frame labels, text fields), <scene>.lme and <scene>.lmb. The .lmb is
the screen's whole UI behavior, as data:

  Root    f0 [Macro]   named action lists        f1 [State]  screen states (pages)        f2 str  first state
  State   f0 name      f1 [Action] run on enter  f2 [Element] focusable buttons/areas
          f6 u32       f7 str (next state)       f8 [Group]  focus groups (d-pad links)   f9 str  first group
  Element f0 name (the event the game's C++ receives on decide)   f1 [Action]   f3 hit/anchor clip path
          f5 u32   f11 str group   f13/f14 i32 (25, 25 on option rows)   (other fields: see dump; kept as-is)
  Group   f0 name  f1 [Link{f0 u32 dir (1 up, 2 down; 3/4 left/right in some scenes), f1 str target group}]  f2 str
  Action  f0 u32 trigger (10 enter, 3 focus, 4 unfocus, 1 decide, 2 leave ...)   f1 u32 op (1 goto label, 7 set text,
          10 play sound, 12 wait ...)   f2 str clip path   f3 str label/text/sound   f4 str
Text and paths may hold `{Var}` (variables the C++ sets per state, e.g. {Line6Type}) or `{File.Label}` (MSBT message).

The patcher never rewrites existing objects. FlatBuffers offsets point forward, so new objects are written in front of the old
data (right after the 8-byte header) and the old bytes are shifted by a multiple of 16; offsets between old objects stay
valid, new objects point forward into the old ones, and a new root table replaces the old root (which stays as dead data).

  python -I scripts/ui/lmb.py dump <file.lmb> [state]       # readable dump (game text: keep it local)
Only code lives here; no game data.
"""
import struct, sys

def U32(b, o): return struct.unpack_from('<I', b, o)[0]
def I32(b, o): return struct.unpack_from('<i', b, o)[0]
def U16(b, o): return struct.unpack_from('<H', b, o)[0]

ACTION = {0: 'u32', 1: 'u32', 2: 'str', 3: 'str', 4: 'str'}
LINK = {0: 'u32', 1: 'str'}
GROUP = {0: 'str', 1: ('vec', LINK), 2: 'str'}
MACRO = {0: 'str', 1: ('vec', ACTION)}
ELEMENT = {0: 'str', 1: ('vec', ACTION), 2: 'str', 3: 'str', 4: 'str', 9: 'str', 10: 'u8', 11: 'str', 12: 'u8',
           13: 'i32', 14: 'i32', 15: 'u32', 17: 'u32', 18: 'u8', 19: 'u8'}
STATE = {0: 'str', 1: ('vec', ACTION), 2: ('vec', ELEMENT), 3: 'str', 6: 'u32', 7: 'str', 8: ('vec', GROUP), 9: 'str', 10: 'u8'}
ROOT = {0: ('vec', MACRO), 1: ('vec', STATE), 2: 'str'}


class Ref:
    """A pointer to an existing object of the original file (absolute offset in the original)."""
    def __init__(self, off):
        self.off = off


class Raw:
    """A field copied byte-for-byte (scalar of unknown meaning) or by reference (offset field of unknown type)."""
    def __init__(self, data=None, ref=None):
        self.data, self.ref = data, ref


class Table:
    def __init__(self, fields):
        self.fields = fields      # {slot: value}; value: int (with 'u32'/'i32'/'u8' type in .types), str, Table, list, Ref, Raw
        self.types = {}


class Lmb:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.b = bytes(data)
        if self.b[4:8] != b'LMBB':
            raise ValueError('not an LMBB file')
        self.root = U32(self.b, 0)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- reading
    def slots(self, t):
        b = self.b
        vt = t - I32(b, t)
        vs, ts = U16(b, vt), U16(b, vt + 2)
        offs = {f: U16(b, vt + 4 + 2 * f) for f in range((vs - 4) // 2)}
        offs = {f: o for f, o in offs.items() if o}
        return offs, ts

    def field_loc(self, t, f):
        offs, _ = self.slots(t)
        return t + offs[f] if f in offs else None

    def deref(self, loc):
        return loc + U32(self.b, loc)

    def string(self, s):
        n = U32(self.b, s)
        return self.b[s + 4:s + 4 + n].decode('utf-8')

    def vec(self, v):
        return [v + 4 + 4 * i for i in range(U32(self.b, v))]

    def get(self, t, f, kind):
        loc = self.field_loc(t, f)
        if loc is None:
            return None
        if kind == 'u32':
            return U32(self.b, loc)
        if kind == 'i32':
            return I32(self.b, loc)
        if kind == 'u8':
            return self.b[loc]
        if kind == 'str':
            return self.string(self.deref(loc))
        if isinstance(kind, tuple) and kind[0] == 'vec':
            return [self.deref(e) for e in self.vec(self.deref(loc))]
        if kind == 'table':
            return self.deref(loc)
        raise ValueError(kind)

    def states(self):
        return {self.get(s, 0, 'str'): s for s in self.get(self.root, 1, ROOT[1])}

    def elements(self, state):
        return {self.get(e, 0, 'str'): e for e in self.get(state, 2, STATE[2]) or []}

    def groups(self, state):
        return {self.get(g, 0, 'str'): g for g in self.get(state, 8, STATE[8]) or []}

    def action(self, a):
        return tuple(self.get(a, f, k) for f, k in sorted(ACTION.items()))

    def to_table(self, t, schema):
        """Decode a table for re-emitting: schema fields become values, children are referenced (Ref) not copied,
        unknown fields are copied raw (4-aligned 4-byte fields that point at a valid object are kept as references)."""
        offs, ts = self.slots(t)
        out = Table({})
        order = sorted(offs.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
        for i, (f, o) in enumerate(order):
            size = (order[i + 1][1] if i + 1 < len(order) else ts) - o
            loc = t + o
            k = schema.get(f)
            if k in ('u32', 'i32', 'u8'):
                out.fields[f] = self.get(t, f, k)
                out.types[f] = k
            elif k is not None:
                out.fields[f] = Ref(self.deref(loc))
                out.types[f] = 'off'
            else:
                out.fields[f] = Raw(data=self.b[loc:loc + min(size, 8)])
                out.types[f] = 'raw'
        return out

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- dump
    def dump(self, only=None, out=sys.stdout):
        w = out.write
        w(f'first state: {self.get(self.root, 2, "str")}\n')
        for m in self.get(self.root, 0, ROOT[0]) or []:
            w(f'macro {self.get(m, 0, "str")}: {len(self.get(m, 1, MACRO[1]) or [])} actions\n')
        for name, s in self.states().items():
            if only and name != only:
                continue
            w(f'\n== state {name} @{s:#x} f6={self.get(s, 6, "u32")} f7={self.get(s, 7, "str")} first_group={self.get(s, 9, "str")}\n')
            for a in self.get(s, 1, STATE[1]) or []:
                w(f'  enter {self.action(a)}\n')
            for gname, g in self.groups(s).items():
                links = [(self.get(l, 0, 'u32'), self.get(l, 1, 'str')) for l in self.get(g, 1, GROUP[1]) or []]
                w(f'  group {gname} {links} f2={self.get(g, 2, "str")}\n')
            for ename, e in self.elements(s).items():
                offs, ts = self.slots(e)
                extra = {f: self.b[e + o:e + o + 4].hex() for f, o in offs.items() if f not in (0, 1, 3, 11)}
                w(f'  element {ename} @{e:#x} anchor={self.get(e, 3, "str")} group={self.get(e, 11, "str")} other={extra}\n')
                for a in self.get(e, 1, ELEMENT[1]) or []:
                    w(f'    {self.action(a)}\n')


class Patcher:
    """Builds new tables in front of the original data. Values: int (typed via types), str, list (vector of tables or
    strings), Table, Ref (original object), Raw."""
    def __init__(self, lmb):
        self.l = lmb
        self.objs = []

    def build(self, root):
        b = self.l.b
        front = bytearray()
        fixups = []        # (pos in front, target) target = ('new', obj_id) | ('old', off)
        placed = {}        # id(obj) -> pos in front
        strings = []       # (pos of uoffset field, str) placed after all tables

        def align(n):
            while len(front) % n:
                front.append(0)

        def put_table(t):
            items = sorted(t.fields.items())
            sizes = {}
            for f, v in items:
                k = t.types.get(f)
                if k == 'u8':
                    sizes[f] = 1
                elif k == 'raw' and v.data is not None:
                    sizes[f] = len(v.data)
                else:
                    sizes[f] = 4
            nslots = (max(t.fields) + 1) if t.fields else 0
            # table body layout: soffset, then fields largest first
            layout, pos = {}, 4
            for f, _ in sorted(items, key=lambda kv: -sizes[kv[0]]):
                sz = sizes[f]
                al = 4 if sz >= 4 else 1
                pos = (pos + al - 1) // al * al
                layout[f] = pos
                pos += sz
            tsize = (pos + 3) // 4 * 4
            vt = struct.pack('<HH', 4 + 2 * nslots, tsize) + b''.join(
                struct.pack('<H', layout.get(f, 0)) for f in range(nslots))
            align(2)
            vpos = len(front)
            front.extend(vt)
            align(4)
            tpos = len(front)
            body = bytearray(tsize)
            struct.pack_into('<i', body, 0, tpos - vpos)
            front.extend(body)
            children = []
            for f, v in items:
                at = tpos + layout[f]
                k = t.types.get(f)
                if k == 'u32':
                    struct.pack_into('<I', front, at, v & 0xffffffff)
                elif k == 'i32':
                    struct.pack_into('<i', front, at, v)
                elif k == 'u8':
                    front[at] = v & 0xff
                elif isinstance(v, Raw):
                    front[at:at + len(v.data)] = v.data
                elif isinstance(v, Ref):
                    fixups.append((at, ('old', v.off)))
                elif isinstance(v, str):
                    strings.append((at, v))
                elif isinstance(v, (Table, list)):
                    fixups.append((at, ('new', id(v))))
                    children.append(v)
                else:
                    raise TypeError((f, v))
            placed[id(t)] = tpos
            return children

        def put_vec(v):
            align(4)
            pos = len(front)
            front.extend(struct.pack('<I', len(v)))
            children = []
            for i, e in enumerate(v):
                at = pos + 4 + 4 * i
                front.extend(b'\0\0\0\0')
                if isinstance(e, Ref):
                    fixups.append((at, ('old', e.off)))
                elif isinstance(e, str):
                    strings.append((at, e))
                else:
                    fixups.append((at, ('new', id(e))))
                    children.append(e)
            placed[id(v)] = pos
            return children

        # preorder: every object is written before the objects it points to (offsets must point forward)
        stack = [root]
        seen = set()
        while stack:
            o = stack.pop(0)
            if id(o) in seen:
                raise ValueError('a new object is referenced twice; build a copy instead')
            seen.add(id(o))
            kids = put_table(o) if isinstance(o, Table) else put_vec(o)
            stack = kids + stack
        for at, s in strings:
            align(4)
            pos = len(front)
            enc = s.encode('utf-8')
            front.extend(struct.pack('<I', len(enc)) + enc + b'\0')
            fixups.append((at, ('abs', pos)))
        while (len(front)) % 16:
            front.append(0)
        delta = len(front)
        base = 8                          # front region starts after [root uoffset][LMBB]
        out = bytearray(b[:8]) + front + b[8:]
        for at, (kind, tgt) in fixups:
            src = base + at
            if kind == 'old':
                dst = tgt + delta
            elif kind == 'new':
                dst = base + placed[tgt]
            else:
                dst = base + tgt
            if dst <= src:
                raise ValueError('backward offset')
            struct.pack_into('<I', out, src, dst - src)
        struct.pack_into('<I', out, 0, base + placed[id(root)])
        return bytes(out)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) >= 3 and sys.argv[1] == 'dump':
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        Lmb(open(sys.argv[2], 'rb').read()).dump(sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else None)
    else:
        print(__doc__)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`scripts/ui/make_native_options.py`:

```py
"""Build the local "native-options" mod pack: the PC settings as extra tabs of the game's own Settings screen (option.lmb).

The game's Settings screen is data driven (scripts/ui/lmb.py has the format): five tabs (states Game, Camera, Button, Sound,
Others), each with up to six row slots (selector_01..06_mc). A slot shows a two-choice row (lb_common), a pulldown row
(lb_pulldown, its popup pulldown_0N_mc lists up to 10 items) or a 0..10 dot slider (lb_number). This script adds ten PC
tabs in two sets of five, reached with R past the game's last tab ("Other"):

  Quality, Textures, Effects, Output, View  |  Display, Controller, Mouse, Audio, Photos

Every PC tab is a new state cloned from "Others" (same tab bar, arrows, Restore Default button, sounds and help bar) whose
rows are generated from TABS below; every pulldown row gets its own popup state cloned from the game's "NaviFrequency".
Nothing original is rewritten except the five game tab states, which also set the tab texts again (the PC tabs rename them),
The game's Lumen player does every state switch itself (element f2 = target state with f6 = 1, f6 = 4 back to the
previous state; L/R open the state the page's Prev/Next entries name, which the host points at the PC tabs).

The host side (host/mods/nativeopt.cpp) fills in each PC page as it opens (current values) and stores changes in the
same places the F1 overlay uses (runtime/hle/settings.cpp keys, the controls mapping, the audio layer). It reads the row
table from rows.txt, which this script writes next to the pack (our own text, no game data).

Input: the user's extracted option.lmb. Output: <out>/native-options/{pack.json, rows.txt,
common/UI/master/Scenes/option.drp/option.lmb}. The output is game-derived: it stays local (mods folder or build/), never in
git. host/play.ps1 runs this script when the pack is missing or older than this script.

  python -I scripts/ui/make_native_options.py [--src <option.lmb>] [--out <mods root>]
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import lmb as L

ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..'))
SRC = os.path.join(ROOT, 'extracted', 'drp-v262144', 'common', 'UI', 'master', 'Scenes', 'option.drp', 'option.lmb')
VERSION = '0.2.0'

R = ' Applies after restart.'
ONOFF = (('default', 'On'), ('off', 'Off'))      # render pass rows: "default" = the game's own pass
TOGGLE = (('1', 'On'), ('0', 'Off'))             # settings toggles stored as 1/0


def row(label, widget, store, key, default, choices, help):
    """widget: 'c' two choices, 'p' pulldown (3 to 10 items), 'n' 0..10 dot slider. store: 'opt' (a settings key through the
    F1 option table), 'map' (a controls-mapping field), 'vol' (an audio volume). choices: ((stored value, label), ...)."""
    assert widget != 'c' or len(choices) == 2, label
    assert widget != 'p' or 2 <= len(choices) <= 10, label
    assert len(help) <= 112, (label, len(help))
    return dict(label=label, widget=widget, store=store, key=key, default=default, choices=choices, help=help)


def nums(*vals, fmt='{}', suffix=''):
    return tuple((v, fmt.format(v) + suffix) for v in vals)


TABS = [
    ('Quality', 'Picture quality for this PC version.', [
        row('Quality preset', 'p', 'opt', 'gfx_preset', 'normal',
            (('verylow', 'Very Low'), ('low', 'Low'), ('normal', 'Normal'), ('high', 'High'), ('ultra', 'Ultra'),
             ('maximum', 'Maximum'), ('custom', 'Custom')),
            'Sets this tab and the next together. Very Low suits weak PCs, Maximum a very fast GPU.' + R),
        row('Render scale', 'p', 'opt', 'gfx_render_scale', '1.00',
            (('0.50', '0.5x'), ('0.75', '0.75x'), ('1.00', '1x (1080p)'), ('1.25', '1.25x'), ('1.50', '1.5x'),
             ('2.00', '2x (4K)'), ('2.50', '2.5x'), ('3.00', '3x'), ('4.00', '4x (8K)')),
            'How sharp the 3D picture is drawn. Higher is crisper and slower.' + R),
        # Visual extras (owner 2026-11-13): original look by default, every extra off; explicit values, so a change of the
        # runtime's own defaults cannot move them. (SNAP_AA: original = the game's FXAA.)
        row('Anti-aliasing', 'p', 'opt', 'gfx_aa', 'original',
            (('original', 'Original'), ('smaa', 'SMAA'), ('ssaa2+smaa', 'SMAA + supersampling')),
            'Smooths jagged edges. Supersampling draws at 2x size (1.5x at 4K) and costs the most.' + R),
        # (a pulldown, not the game's 0..10 slider: its knob is moved by the game's handler, which a PC page bypasses)
        row('Sharpening', 'p', 'opt', 'gfx_sharpen', '0.00',
            (('0.00', 'Off'), ('0.30', 'Low'), ('0.50', 'Medium')),
```
