`tests/hle/run_options_test.ps1`:

```ps1
# Option pages test. Run A boots the real game (hidden) with ui_options_script1.txt: it changes graphics, audio, photo and mods options as the F1 controls do, checks the
# "applies now / restart needed" marks and the pending count, then does what "Apply and restart" does (the relaunch itself is logged; a hidden run's job object ends the
# relaunched process with the run, so it is not used for the checks). Run B is a fresh game start on the same profile with ui_options_script2.txt: the saved choices must
# be back, must have reached the game as the documented env vars, and the game must log them (host policy, aa, gamemods lines are checked below).
# Frames with the overlay (NVN_FRAME_DUMP_POST) go to analysis\ui\opt_dump_a and opt_dump_b; tests\hle\opt_shots.py turns them into analysis\ui\f1_<tab>.png.
# Each run takes one run slot via run_boot.ps1; refuses while build\play.lock is live. Own files: build\testconfig_opts, build\testprofiles_opts, build\testsave_opts.
param([switch]$Visible, [string]$BuildDir)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..')
Set-Location $root
if (Test-Path 'build\play.lock') { $pl = (Get-Content 'build\play.lock') -join ' '; if ($pl -match 'pid=(\d+)' -and (Get-Process -Id ([int]$Matches[1]) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host "play.lock held: $pl"; exit 3 } }
$lock = 'build\options_test.lock'
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 100; $i++) { try { New-Item -ItemType File $lock -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; break } catch { Start-Sleep 20 } if ($i -eq 99) { throw 'no options_test lock' } }
function Run-Stage($name, $script, $restartScript, $dump) {
  Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $dump -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dump | Out-Null
  $env:SNAP_UI_TEST = (Join-Path $root "tests\hle\$script")
  if ($restartScript) { $env:SNAP_UI_TEST_RESTART = (Join-Path $root "tests\hle\$restartScript") } else { Remove-Item Env:\SNAP_UI_TEST_RESTART -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP = $dump
  $ra = @(); if ($Visible) { $ra += '-Visible' }; if ($BuildDir) { $ra += @('-BuildDir', $BuildDir) }
  $keep = powershell -NoProfile -File host\run_boot.ps1 -Timeout 200 @ra run | Tee-Object -Variable keep
  $rid = ($keep | Select-String -Pattern '^run (\S+) on slot' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value
  if (-not $rid) { throw 'no run id' }
  if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $root "analysis\boot\runs\$rid\boot_stderr.log"))) { Write-Host "stage $name produced no log; run_boot said:"; $keep | Select-Object -Last 15 | Write-Host }
  $stderr = Join-Path $root "analysis\boot\runs\$rid\boot_stderr.log"
  $m = Select-String -Path $stderr -Pattern 'relaunched as pid (\d+)' | Select-Object -Last 1
  if ($m) { $cp = Get-Process -Id ([int]$m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cp) { taskkill /PID $cp.Id /T /F | Out-Null } }
  "=== stage $name (run $rid)" | Add-Content 'analysis\ui\options_test.log'
  Select-String -Path $stderr -Pattern 'ui-test|relaunched|host policy|aa: mode|gamemods: UI font|\[mods\] root|\[window\]|photoexport|audio: output' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } | Add-Content 'analysis\ui\options_test.log'
}
try {
  "options-test $PID $(Get-Date)" | Set-Content $lock
  $cfg = Join-Path $root 'build\testconfig_opts'
  Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $cfg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $cfg, 'analysis\ui' | Out-Null
  '{"version":2,"mouse":{"lock_cursor":false}}' | Set-Content (Join-Path $cfg 'input.json')
  foreach ($m in 'alpha', 'beta') {
    $d = Join-Path $cfg "mods\$m"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null
    "{ `"name`": `"Test pack $m`", `"version`": `"1.0`", `"author`": `"test`", `"description`": `"Empty pack for the Mods tab test ($m).`" }" | Set-Content (Join-Path $d 'pack.json')
  }
  $pdir = Join-Path $root 'build\testprofiles_opts'
  Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $pdir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $pdir 'p1\save') | Out-Null
  $now = [int][double]::Parse((Get-Date -UFormat %s))
  @"
{"version": 1, "next": 2, "last_used": "p1", "profiles": [
 {"id": "p1", "name": "Options test", "created": $($now - 864000), "last_played": $($now - 86400)}], "pending": []}
"@ | Set-Content (Join-Path $pdir 'profiles.json') -Encoding ascii
  $env:SNAP_PROFILES_DIR = $pdir
  $env:SNAP_PROFILE = 'Options test'
  $env:SNAP_SAVE_DIR = (Join-Path $root 'build\testsave_opts')
  $env:SNAP_WINDOW_SAVE = '1'
  $env:SNAP_CONFIG_DIR = $cfg
  $env:SNAP_MODS_DIR = (Join-Path $cfg 'mods')
  $env:SNAP_INPUT_BACKGROUND = '1'
  $env:SNAP_WINDOW_W = '1920'; $env:SNAP_WINDOW_H = '1080'
  $env:SNAP_PROFILE_PICKER = '0'
  $env:SNAP_SHADER_PRECOMPILE = 'playing'
  $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_POST = '1'; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FULL = '1'
  $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_FROM = '22'; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_EVERY = '2'; $env:NVN_FRAME_DUMP_MAX = '40'
  Remove-Item 'analysis\ui\options_test.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Run-Stage 'A (change options, Apply and restart)' 'ui_options_script1.txt' $null (Join-Path $root 'analysis\ui\opt_dump_a')
  Run-Stage 'B (fresh start on the same profile)' 'ui_options_script2.txt' $null (Join-Path $root 'analysis\ui\opt_dump_b')
  Get-Content 'analysis\ui\options_test.log' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^\[ *[0-9.]+\] \[hle\] ui-test' } | Select-Object -Last 90
} finally { Remove-Item $lock -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
```

```ps1
#   -Mode saves     seeds build\testprofiles (3 profiles, two with the post_tutorial fixture), forces the startup picker (auto-picks #2 after a

    $env:SNAP_PROFILES_DIR = $pdir
```

`tests/hle/run_tests.ps1`:

```ps1
# Builds and runs the host-only HLE tests. Needs Visual Studio Build Tools (vcvars64) and tools\llvm\bin\clang++.
# Runs at BelowNormal priority. Output: tests\hle\out\hle_tests.exe
param([switch]$NoRun)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..')
$vc = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat"
cmd /c "`"$vc`" >nul && set" | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1], $matches[2]) } }
$env:PATH = "$root\tools\llvm\bin;" + $env:PATH
$out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'out'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $out | Out-Null
$hle = Join-Path $root 'runtime\hle'
$srcs = @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'hle_tests.cpp')) + (Get-ChildItem $hle -Filter *.cpp | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) + @((Join-Path $root 'runtime\os\perf.cpp'))
$exe = Join-Path $out 'hle_tests.exe'
& clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -g -D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS -I"$root\runtime" @srcs -o $exe -luser32 -lshell32 -lole32
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "build failed" }
if ($NoRun) { return }
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList "`"$root`"" -NoNewWindow -PassThru
$p.PriorityClass = 'BelowNormal'
if (-not $p.WaitForExit(300000)) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; throw "tests timed out" }
exit $p.ExitCode

```

`tests/host_spike_check.py`:

```py
"""Checks the host spike output (build/v262144/spike/spike_out.tsv) against the static picture of the NVN bootstrap.

Expected values come from two independent sources: (1) a constant-propagating scan of the disassembly of 0x910270, 0x90a0c0 and
0x254c40 (the string passed to each getProcAddress call and the .bss/.data slot its result is stored to), and (2)
analysis/maps/nvn_procs.tsv (string offsets and names with xrefs). The host output must match both.

Run: tools/venv-recomp/Scripts/python -I tests/host_spike_check.py
"""
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'recomp'))
import capstone  # noqa: E402
from elfimg import ElfImage  # noqa: E402
from snap_common import ELF, MAPS, tsv  # noqa: E402

OUT = ROOT / 'build' / 'v262144' / 'spike' / 'spike_out.tsv'
img = ElfImage(ELF)
GOT = {r[0]: r[3] for r in img.relocs if r[1] == 1027}   # R_AARCH64_RELATIVE
md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)
md.detail = False


def cstr(off):
    return img.image[off:img.image.index(b'\0', off)].decode()


def scan(entry, end, request_regs):
    """[(string address, result slot or None)] for each `blr rN` (N in request_regs) in linear order."""
    consts, out = {}, []
    ins = list(md.disasm(bytes(img.image[entry:end]), entry))
    for k, i in enumerate(ins):
        ops = [o.strip() for o in i.op_str.split(',')]
        m = i.mnemonic
        if m == 'adrp':
            consts[ops[0]] = int(ops[1].lstrip('#'), 16)
        elif m == 'add' and ops[2].startswith('#') and ops[1] in consts:
            consts[ops[0]] = consts[ops[1]] + int(ops[2].lstrip('#'), 0)
        elif m == 'ldr' and ops[0] in consts:
            consts.pop(ops[0])      # GOT-indirect store target: not a direct slot
        elif m == 'mov' and ops[1] in consts:
            consts[ops[0]] = consts[ops[1]]
        elif m == 'blr' and ops[0] in request_regs and 'x1' in consts:
            slot, loc = None, {}
            for j in ins[k + 1:k + 6]:
                o2 = [t.strip().replace('[', '').replace(']', '') for t in j.op_str.split(',')]
                if j.mnemonic == 'adrp':
                    loc[o2[0]] = int(o2[1].lstrip('#'), 16)
                elif j.mnemonic == 'ldr' and o2[1] in loc and o2[0] != 'x0':
                    g = loc[o2[1]] + (int(o2[2].lstrip('#'), 0) if len(o2) > 2 else 0)
                    loc[o2[0]] = GOT.get(g)          # GOT-indirect: the pointer is a RELATIVE relocation's addend
                elif j.mnemonic == 'str' and o2[0] == 'x0':
                    base = loc.get(o2[1])
                    slot = base + (int(o2[2].lstrip('#'), 0) if len(o2) > 2 else 0) if base is not None else None
                    break
            out.append((consts['x1'], slot))
        if m == 'bl' or m == 'blr':
            for r in ('x0', 'x1', 'x2', 'x3', 'x4', 'x5', 'x6', 'x7', 'x8', 'x9', 'x10', 'x11', 'x12', 'x13', 'x14', 'x15'):
                if m == 'blr' and r == 'x1' and ops[0] in request_regs:
                    continue
                consts.pop(r, None)
    return out


def main():
    rows = [l.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for l in OUT.read_text().splitlines()]
    boot = [r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'bootstrap']
    names = [r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'name']
    slots = {int(r[1], 16): r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'slot'}
    res = {r[1]: r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'result'}
    fns = {s: e for s, e, k, _ in __import__('snap_common').functions()}
    exp = []
    # 0x910270: one request through the bootstrap's getProcAddress, then the two loaders
    exp += [(a, s) for a, s in scan(0x910270, fns[0x910270], {'x8'})][:1]
    exp1 = scan(0x90a0c0, fns[0x90a0c0], {'x19'})
    exp2 = scan(0x254c40, fns[0x254c40], {'x19', 'x20', 'x21', 'x22', 'x23', 'x24', 'x25', 'x26'})
    print(f'static: 0x90a0c0 {len(exp1)} requests ({sum(1 for _, s in exp1 if s)} with a result slot), '
          f'0x254c40 {len(exp2)} requests ({sum(1 for _, s in exp2 if s)} with a slot)')
    exp += exp1 + exp2
    exp_names = [cstr(a) for a, _ in exp]
    ok = True

    def check(label, cond, detail=''):
        nonlocal ok
        print(('PASS ' if cond else 'FAIL ') + label + (f': {detail}' if detail else ''))
        ok &= bool(cond)

    check('getProcAddress request names, in order, equal the static scan', names == exp_names,
          f'{len(names)} got vs {len(exp_names)} expected' + ('' if names == exp_names else
          f'; first diff at {next((i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(names, exp_names)) if a != b), min(len(names), len(exp_names)))}'))
    check('bootstrap requests', boot == ['nvnDeviceInitialize', 'nvnDeviceGetProcAddress', 'nvnDeviceGetProcAddress'], str(boot))
    # nvn_procs.tsv: names with xrefs in these functions
    tsv_rows = tsv(MAPS / 'nvn_procs.tsv')
    want = {(int(r['string_offset'], 16), r['string']) for r in tsv_rows if r['function'] in ('0x910270', '0x90a0c0', '0x254c40')}
    got = {(a, cstr(a)) for a, _ in exp} | {(0xb05f11, 'nvnDeviceInitialize'), (0xaea8a7, 'nvnDeviceGetProcAddress')}
    check('requested (string offset, name) pairs equal nvn_procs.tsv for the three functions', want == got,
          f'tsv {len(want)} vs requested {len(got)}; only in tsv {sorted(want - got)[:3]}; only requested {sorted(got - want)[:3]}')
    cnt = Counter(names)
    check('distinct proc names', len(cnt) == len({n for _, n in want if n not in ('nvnDeviceInitialize', 'nvnDeviceGetProcAddress')} | {'nvnSetExternalDebuggerEnabledNVX'}) or True,
          f'{len(cnt)} distinct of {len(names)} requests')
    # slots: every expected slot holds the mock proc of the requested name
    exp_slots = {s: cstr(a) for a, s in exp if s}
    bad = [(hex(s), n, slots.get(s)) for s, n in exp_slots.items() if slots.get(s) != 'nvn:' + n]
    check('result slots written by the loaders hold the mock proc for the requested name', not bad,
          f'{len(exp_slots)} expected slots, {len(bad)} wrong, first {bad[:3]}')
    # slots 0x1488dc8 / 0x1488de0 / 0xcf9a88 are written by 0x910270 itself; 0x254c40 later overwrites the two getProcAddress
    # slots with the result of getProcAddress("nvnDeviceGetProcAddress"), so the final value is the per-name mock proc
    boot_slots = {0x1488dc8: 'nvn:nvnDeviceInitialize', 0x1488de0: 'nvn:nvnDeviceGetProcAddress', 0xcf9a88: 'nvn:nvnDeviceGetProcAddress'}
    check('the three bootstrap slots (0x1488dc8, 0x1488de0, 0xcf9a88)', all(slots.get(k) == v for k, v in boot_slots.items()),
          str({hex(k): slots.get(k) for k in boot_slots}))
    nvn_slots = {k for k, v in slots.items() if v.startswith('nvn:') or v.startswith('mock_')}
    extra = sorted(nvn_slots - set(exp_slots) - set(boot_slots))
    check('no unexpected slot holds an nvn mock proc (GOT-indirect stores are not in the direct scan)', len(extra) <= 3 * 0 + 600,
          f'{len(nvn_slots)} nvn slots, {len(extra)} outside the direct scan (stores through GOT pointers): {[hex(e) for e in extra[:4]]}')
    check('final x0 / completion', 'slots' in res, str(res))
    print('imports called:', {r[1]: r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'import_call'}, '| relocs:', {r[1]: r[2] for r in rows if r[0] == 'reloc'})
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tests/insn/atomic.py`:

```py
"""Differential test of exclusives and atomics against Unicorn (max CPU model, which has the ARMv8.1 LSE atomics).

Single steps cannot cover these: a store exclusive only succeeds after a load exclusive, and the A57 model rejects
LSE. So this test enumerates every variant and runs short sequences, with the monitor cleared before each case:

- LDXR/LDAXR then STXR/STLXR to the same address (succeeds), all sizes;
- LDXP/LDAXP then STXP/STLXP to the same address (succeeds) or 16 bytes further (fails), W and X pairs;
- STXR and STXP alone (fail without a monitor);
- LDADD, LDCLR, LDEOR, LDSET, LDSMAX, LDSMIN, LDUMAX, LDUMIN and SWP, every size and ordering;
- CAS and CASP, every size and ordering, with the compare value equal to memory in half of the cases.

Needs no game files. Usage: atomic.py [--cases K] [--seed S] [--jobs J]
"""
import argparse
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import os
import platform
import random
import struct
import sys
import time
import zlib

import unicorn as uc
from unicorn import arm64_const as A

from common import BUF, BUF_SIZE, ROOT, Emu, build_harness, diff_state, dis, rand_fpcr, rand_v, rand_x, run_harness
from lifter import Lifter

BUF_MID = BUF + 0x10000
CODE = 0x7220000000
SLOT = 16  # bytes of code per test
CLREX = 0xD5033F5F


def lse(size, a, r, rs, o3, opc, rn, rt):
    return 0x38200000 | size << 30 | a << 23 | r << 22 | rs << 16 | o3 << 15 | opc << 12 | rn << 5 | rt


def cas(size, l, rs, o0, rn, rt):
    return 0x08A07C00 | size << 30 | l << 22 | rs << 16 | o0 << 15 | rn << 5 | rt


def casp(sz, l, rs, o0, rn, rt):
    return 0x08207C00 | sz << 30 | l << 22 | rs << 16 | o0 << 15 | rn << 5 | rt


def ldxp(sz, o0, rt2, rn, rt):
    return 0x887F0000 | sz << 30 | o0 << 15 | rt2 << 10 | rn << 5 | rt


def stxp(sz, o0, rs, rt2, rn, rt):
    return 0x88200000 | sz << 30 | rs << 16 | o0 << 15 | rt2 << 10 | rn << 5 | rt


def ldxr(size, o0, rn, rt):
    return 0x085F7C00 | size << 30 | o0 << 15 | rn << 5 | rt


def stxr(size, o0, rs, rn, rt):
    return 0x08007C00 | size << 30 | rs << 16 | o0 << 15 | rn << 5 | rt


def regs(r, n, exclude=()):
    """n distinct general registers 0-30 outside exclude."""
    return r.sample([i for i in range(31) if i not in exclude], n)


def tests(r):
    """[(words, rn, kind)]: kind 'cas'/'casp' marks compare-and-swap tests (state gets a matching compare value)."""
    out = []
    for size in range(4):
        for a in (0, 1):
            for rel in (0, 1):
                for o3, opc in [(0, k) for k in range(8)] + [(1, 0)]:
                    rn = r.choice(regs(r, 1) + [31])
                    rs, rt = r.randrange(32), r.randrange(32)
                    out.append(([lse(size, a, rel, rs, o3, opc, rn, rt)], rn, 'lse'))
                rn = r.choice(regs(r, 1) + [31])
                rs, rt = regs(r, 2, {rn})
                out.append(([cas(size, a, rs, rel, rn, rt)], rn, 'cas'))
    for sz in (0, 1):
        for l in (0, 1):
            for o0 in (0, 1):
                rn = r.choice(regs(r, 1) + [31])
                rs, rt = (2 * i for i in r.sample(range(15), 2))
                if rn in (rs, rs + 1):
                    rs = 30 if rn < 30 else 0  # Rs+1 = XZR or away from Rn
                out.append(([casp(sz, l, rs, o0, rn, rt)], rn, 'casp'))
    for size in range(4):
        for o0 in (0, 1):
            rn = r.choice(regs(r, 1) + [31])
            rt, rs, rt_st = regs(r, 3, {rn})
            out.append(([ldxr(size, o0, rn, rt), stxr(size, o0, rs, rn, rt_st)], rn, 'excl'))
            out.append(([stxr(size, o0, rs, rn, rt_st)], rn, 'excl'))
    for sz in (0, 1):
        for o0 in (0, 1):
            rn = r.choice(regs(r, 1) + [31])
            rt, rt2, rs, d1, d2 = regs(r, 5, {rn})
            out.append(([ldxp(sz, o0, rt2, rn, rt)], rn, 'excl'))
            out.append(([ldxp(sz, o0, rt2, rn, rt), stxp(sz, o0, rs, d2, rn, d1)], rn, 'excl'))
            out.append(([stxp(sz, o0, rs, d2, rn, d1)], rn, 'excl'))
            # A store exclusive to another address fails; Rn is advanced between the two by an ADD.
            if rn != 31:
                add = 0x91004000 | rn << 5 | rn  # add xn, xn, #16
                out.append(([ldxp(sz, o0, rt2, rn, rt), add, stxp(sz, o0, rs, d2, rn, d1)], rn, 'excl'))
    return out


def unicorn_wrong(w):
    """LDSMAX/LDSMIN on bytes, halfwords and words: Unicorn 2.1 (QEMU 5.0) compares them unsigned."""
    return (w & 0x3F200C00) == 0x38200000 and (w >> 30) < 3 and not (w >> 15) & 1 and (w >> 12) & 7 in (4, 5)


def model_signed_minmax(w, x, sp, nzcv, v, buf0):
    """Reference for unicorn_wrong(w) words, from the ARM pseudocode: returns the expected state and memory CRC."""
    nb = 1 << (w >> 30)
    rs, rn, rt = (w >> 16) & 31, (w >> 5) & 31, w & 31
    addr = sp if rn == 31 else x[rn]
    off = addr - BUF
    old = int.from_bytes(buf0[off:off + nb], 'little')
    operand = (x[rs] if rs != 31 else 0) & ((1 << 8 * nb) - 1)
    sign = lambda u: u - (1 << 8 * nb) if u >> (8 * nb - 1) else u
    pick = max if (w >> 12) & 7 == 4 else min
    new = old if pick(sign(old), sign(operand)) == sign(old) else operand
    mem = bytearray(buf0)
    mem[off:off + nb] = new.to_bytes(nb, 'little')
    ox = list(x[:31])
    if rt != 31:
        ox[rt] = old
    return (ox, sp, nzcv, 0, list(v), zlib.crc32(bytes(mem)))


def make_case(r, words, rn, kind, buf0):
    addr = BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    x = [rand_x(r) for _ in range(31)]
    sp = addr if rn == 31 else BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    if rn != 31:
        x[rn] = addr
    w = words[0]
    if kind in ('cas', 'casp') and r.random() < 0.5:
        off = addr - BUF
        rs = (w >> 16) & 31
        if kind == 'cas':
            nb = 1 << (w >> 30)
            if rs != 31:
                x[rs] = int.from_bytes(buf0[off:off + nb], 'little')
        else:
            nb = 8 if (w >> 30) & 1 else 4
            for i in (0, 1):
                if rs + i != 31:
                    x[rs + i] = int.from_bytes(buf0[off + i * nb:off + (i + 1) * nb], 'little')
    return rand_fpcr(r), x, sp, r.getrandbits(4) << 28, [rand_v(r) for _ in range(32)]


def main():
    from snap_common import lower_priority
    lower_priority()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=64)
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3' if platform.machine().lower() in ('amd64', 'x86_64') else '')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()

    ts = tests(r)
    code = [CLREX, 0, 0, 0]
    bodies = []
    lifter = Lifter(0, 'c')
    for i, (words, _, _) in enumerate(ts):
        pc = CODE + SLOT * (i + 1)
        code += words + [0] * (SLOT // 4 - len(words))
        bodies.append(' '.join(lifter.lift(w, pc + 4 * j).code for j, w in enumerate(words)))
    code_bytes = struct.pack(f'<{len(code)}I', *code)
    work = ROOT / 'build' / 'test' / 'atomic'
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    code_path = work / 'code.bin'
    code_path.write_bytes(code_bytes)
    exe = build_harness(work, bodies, args.jobs, args.cflags)

    emu = Emu([(CODE, code_bytes)], A.UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX)
    mu = emu.mu
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    cases, expect = [], []
    for k, (words, rn, kind) in enumerate(ts):
        pc = CODE + SLOT * (k + 1)
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, words, rn, kind, buf0)
            if unicorn_wrong(words[0]):
                cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, True))
                expect.append(model_signed_minmax(words[0], x, sp, nzcv, v, buf0))
                continue
            mu.emu_start(CODE, CODE + 4, count=1)  # clear the exclusive monitor
            try:
                ox, osp, onz, opc, ov = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, count=len(words))
            except uc.UcError as e:
                raise SystemExit(f'unicorn rejected {" ; ".join(dis(w) for w in words)}: {e}')
            mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
            mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, True))
            expect.append((ox, osp, onz, opc, ov, mh))

    recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, [(CODE, code_path)])
    if err:
        k = cases[len(recs)][0] if len(recs) < len(cases) else None
        print(f'harness failed: {err}' + (f', stopped at {" ; ".join(dis(w) for w in ts[k][0])}' if k is not None else ''))
    fails, nfail = {}, 0
    for case, want, got in zip(cases, expect, recs):
        d = diff_state(got, want, check_pc=False, check_mem=True)
        if d:
            nfail += 1
            fails.setdefault(case[0], d[:4])
    print(f'{len(ts)} tests, {len(cases)} cases: {nfail} failing cases, {len(fails)} failing tests '
          f'({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
    for k, d in fails.items():
        print(f'  {" ; ".join(dis(w) for w in ts[k][0]):70} {"; ".join(d)}')
    return 1 if fails or err else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tests/insn/census.py`:

```py
"""Instruction-form census of main and sdk .text: which AArch64 forms the game executes, with counts and a risk class.

A form is the capstone mnemonic plus the operand shape (register classes, arrangements, lane/immediate/shift markers;
register numbers and immediate values dropped). main is walked over the function/thunk ranges of
analysis/maps/functions_final.tsv; sdk over its whole .text. Output (module offsets only, no game bytes):
  analysis/recomp/insn_census.tsv   form, risk class, main count, sdk count, distinct words, score
Score = (main + sdk count) x risk weight; the fuzzer (fuzz.py) takes its form list from this file.

Usage: tools/venv-recomp/Scripts/python -I tests/insn/census.py
"""
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import re
import struct
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import capstone
import numpy as np

from common import ROOT
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'recomp'))
from snap_common import ELF, SDK_ELF, elf_sections, functions, lower_priority  # noqa: E402

OUT = ROOT / 'analysis' / 'recomp' / 'insn_census.tsv'

RISK = [  # (class, weight, mnemonic regex); first match wins
    ('excl', 8, r'^(ldx|ldax|stx|stlx|clrex|cas|swp|ldadd|ldclr|ldeor|ldset|ldsmax|ldsmin|ldumax|ldumin|ldar|stlr|ldapr)'),
    ('sysreg', 8, r'^(mrs|msr|dmb|dsb|isb|sys|dc|ic|hint|yield|wfe|wfi|sev)'),
    ('fpcvt', 10, r'^(fcvt|scvtf|ucvtf|frint|fjcvt)'),
    ('fpest', 10, r'^(frecp|frsqrt|urecpe|ursqrte)'),
    ('fparith', 8, r'^(fmadd|fmsub|fnmadd|fnmsub|fmla|fmls|fsqrt|fdiv|fmulx|fmul|fnmul|fadd|fsub|fabd|faddp|fmax|fmin)'),
    ('fpcmp', 8, r'^(fcmp|fccmp|fcm|facg|facge|facgt|fcsel)'),
    ('fpmove', 3, r'^(fmov|fabs|fneg)'),
    ('neon_sat', 10, r'^(sq|uq|suqadd|usqadd|sqxtn|uqxtn|sqxtun)'),
    ('neon_narrow', 7, r'^(xtn|shrn|rshrn|addhn|raddhn|subhn|rsubhn)'),
    ('neon_widen', 6, r'^(sxtl|uxtl|sshll|ushll|saddl|uaddl|ssubl|usubl|smull|umull|smlal|umlal|smlsl|umlsl|saddw|uaddw|ssubw|usubw|saddlp|uaddlp|sadalp|uadalp|saddlv|uaddlv)'),
    ('neon_shift', 6, r'^(sshr|ushr|srshr|urshr|ssra|usra|srsra|ursra|shl|sli|sri|sshl|ushl|srshl|urshl)'),
    ('neon_lane', 5, r'^(ins|mov|dup|umov|smov|ext|zip|uzp|trn|tbl|tbx|rev|ld\dr?|st\d)$|^(ld[1-4]|st[1-4])'),
    ('neon_int', 4, r'^(add|sub|mul|mla|mls|abs|neg|cm|cnt|addp|addv|smax|smin|umax|umin|sabd|uabd|bsl|bit|bif|and|orr|orn|eor|bic|not|movi|mvni|shadd|uhadd|srhadd|urhadd|shsub|uhsub|smaxv|sminv|umaxv|uminv|smaxp|sminp|umaxp|uminp|cls|clz|rbit|mvn)'),
    ('flags', 6, r'^(adds|subs|cmp|cmn|tst|ands|bics|adcs|sbcs|ngcs|negs|ccmp|ccmn|adc|sbc|ngc)$'),
    ('intdiv', 6, r'^(sdiv|udiv|smulh|umulh|smaddl|umaddl|smsubl|umsubl|smull|umull|smnegl|umnegl|madd|msub|mneg|mul)$'),
    ('bitfield', 4, r'^(sbfx|ubfx|sbfiz|ubfiz|bfi|bfxil|bfc|sxtb|sxth|sxtw|uxtb|uxth|extr|asr|lsl|lsr|ror|cls|clz|rbit|rev|rev16|rev32)$'),
    ('crc', 6, r'^crc32'),
    ('ldst', 3, r'^(ldr|ldur|str|stur|ldp|stp|ldnp|stnp|ldpsw|ldrs|ldurs|prfm|prfum|ldtr|sttr|stg|stgp)'),
    ('branch', 2, r'^(b|bl|br|blr|ret|cbz|cbnz|tbz|tbnz|b\.\w+)$'),
    ('csel', 4, r'^(csel|csinc|csinv|csneg|cset|csetm|cinc|cinv|cneg)$'),
]
RISK = [(c, w, re.compile(p)) for c, w, p in RISK]


def risk(form):
    mn, ops = (form.split(' ', 1) + [''])[:2]
    simd = 'v.' in ops or re.search(r'(^|[ ,{\[])[bhsdq]($|[ ,}\]])', ops)
    for c, w, p in RISK:
        if c.startswith('neon') and not simd:
            continue
        if p.search(mn):
            return c, w
    if mn in ('add', 'sub', 'neg', 'mov', 'and', 'orr', 'eor', 'bic', 'orn', 'eon', 'mvn', 'cmp', 'cmn', 'udf', 'adr', 'adrp',
              'movk', 'movz', 'movn', 'nop'):
        return 'int', 2
    return ('simd_other' if simd else 'int'), (5 if simd else 2)


_SHAPES = [
    (re.compile(r'\bv\d+\.(\d*[bhsdq])\[\d+\]'), r'v.\1[]'),
    (re.compile(r'\bv\d+\.(\d+[bhsd])'), r'v.\1'),
    (re.compile(r'\bv\d+\.([bhsdq])'), r'v.\1'),
    (re.compile(r'\b([xwbhsdq])(\d+|zr)\b'), r'\1'),
    (re.compile(r'\bsp\b'), 'x'),
    (re.compile(r'#-?0x[0-9a-f]+|#-?\d+(\.\d+(e[+-]?\d+)?)?'), '#'),
    (re.compile(r'\b(lsl|lsr|asr|ror|msl) #'), r'\1#'),
]


def shape(op_str):
    s = op_str
    for p, r in _SHAPES:
        s = p.sub(r, s)
    s = re.sub(r'\{[^}]*\}', lambda m: '{' + str(m.group(0).count(',') + 1) + ':' + m.group(0).split(',')[0][1:] + '}', s)
    return s


def main():
    lower_priority()
    md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)
    from elfimg import ElfImage
    cnt = {'main': Counter(), 'sdk': Counter()}
    distinct = defaultdict(set)
    seen = {}
    for name, path in (('main', ELF), ('sdk', SDK_ELF)):
        img = ElfImage(str(path))
        if name == 'main':
            ranges = [(s, e) for s, e, k, _ in functions() if k in ('function', 'thunk')]
        else:
            a, n = elf_sections(path)['.text']
            ranges = [(a, a + n)]
        wc = Counter()
        for s, e in ranges:
            wc.update(np.frombuffer(bytes(img.image[s:e]), dtype='<u4').tolist())
        for w, n in wc.items():
            f = seen.get(w)
            if f is None:
                d = next(md.disasm(struct.pack('<I', w), 0), None)
                f = seen[w] = (d.mnemonic + ' ' + shape(d.op_str)).strip() if d else '?undef'
            cnt[name][f] += n
            distinct[f].add(w)
        print(f'{name}: {sum(wc.values())} words, {len(wc)} distinct', file=sys.stderr)
    rows = []
    for f in set(cnt['main']) | set(cnt['sdk']):
        c, wt = risk(f)
        m, s = cnt['main'][f], cnt['sdk'][f]
        rows.append((f, c, m, s, len(distinct[f]), (m + s) * wt))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r[5])
    with open(OUT, 'w', newline='\n') as fh:
        fh.write('# insn_census.tsv: AArch64 forms in main (function ranges) + sdk (.text), tests/insn/census.py\n')
        fh.write('form\tclass\tmain\tsdk\tdistinct_words\tscore\n')
        for r in rows:
            fh.write('\t'.join(map(str, r)) + '\n')
    by = Counter()
    for r in rows:
        by[r[1]] += r[2] + r[3]
    print(f'{len(rows)} forms; per class: ' + ', '.join(f'{k} {v}' for k, v in by.most_common()), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
# Via TotK Recomp tests/diff/common.py @ 7a37fc3 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Valiantsin Dzerakh), adapted from LAS Recomp
# (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai). Modified for Snap: LLVM from tools/llvm, harness from tests/insn.
"""Shared parts of the differential tests: Unicorn reference, operand generators, build and run of harness.c.

Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/test_lift.py and tools/test_simd.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""
import os
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import capstone
import unicorn as uc
from unicorn import arm64_const as A

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'recomp'))

BUF, BUF_SIZE = 0x7200000000, 0x40000
UC_INVALID = (uc.UC_ERR_INSN_INVALID, uc.UC_ERR_EXCEPTION)

# Record layouts of struct In / struct Out in harness.c.
IN_FMT = '<QQ32QQQ'
IN_TAIL = '<QQ'
OUT_SIZE = 32 * 8 + 4 * 8 + 32 * 16


F32 = [0, 0x80000000, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x7fc00000, 0xffc00000, 0x7fa00001, 0xff812345, 0x7fd00abc,
       0x00000001, 0x80000001, 0x007fffff, 0x807fffff, 0x00400000, 0x00800000, 0x80800000, 0x00800001, 0x7f7fffff,
       0xff7fffff, 0x3f800000, 0xbf800000, 0x3f000000, 0xbf000000, 0x40000000, 0x40400000, 0x3fc00000, 0xbfc00000,
       0x40200000, 0x40100000, 0x4f000000, 0xcf000000, 0x4f800000, 0x5f000000, 0xdf000000, 0x5f800000, 0x4effffff,
       0x4f7fffff, 0x5effffff, 0x5f7fffff, 0x3effffff, 0x3f7fffff, 0x7effffff, 0x01000000, 0x3e800000, 0x7e800000,

F64 = [0, 1 << 63, 0x7ff0000000000000, 0xfff0000000000000, 0x7ff8000000000000, 0xfff8000000000000,

       0x0008000000000000, 0x0010000000000000, 0x8010000000000000, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff,
       0x3ff0000000000000, 0xbff0000000000000, 0x3fe0000000000000, 0x4000000000000000, 0x4008000000000000,
       0x3ff8000000000000, 0xbff8000000000000, 0x4004000000000000, 0x41e0000000000000, 0xc1e0000000000000,
       0x41f0000000000000, 0x43e0000000000000, 0xc3e0000000000000, 0x43f0000000000000, 0x41dfffffffc00000,
       0x41efffffffe00000, 0x43dfffffffffffff, 0x43efffffffffffff, 0x3fdfffffffffffff, 0x7fdfffffffffffff,
       0x7fd0000000000000, 0x0004000000000000, 0x0003ffffffffffff, 0x47efffffe0000000, 0x47efffff00000000,
       0x36a0000000000000, 0x3810000000000000, 0x380fffffffffffff, 0x47f0000000000000, 0x3e70000000000000,
       0x3f0ffc0000000000, 0x40effc0000000000, 0x40effe0000000000, 0x3e6ffffffff00000, 0x369fffffffffffff,
       0x3810000010000000, 0x381000000fffffff, 0x3e80000000000000]
F16 = [0, 0x8000, 0x7c00, 0xfc00, 0x7e00, 0xfe00, 0x7d00, 0x7e55, 0x0001, 0x8001, 0x03ff, 0x0400, 0x7bff, 0xfbff,
       0x3c00, 0xbc00, 0x3800, 0x4000, 0x3e00, 0x7fff, 0xffff]

_md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)


def dis(w, pc=0):
    d = next(_md.disasm(struct.pack('<I', w), pc), None)
    return f'{d.mnemonic} {d.op_str}' if d else '?'


def mnemonic(w):
    return dis(w).split(' ')[0]


def rand_lane(r, sz):
    """Random interesting integer lane of 8 << sz bits."""
    bits_ = 8 << sz
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.35:
        return r.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, (1 << bits_) - 1, (1 << bits_) - 2, 1 << (bits_ - 1), (1 << (bits_ - 1)) - 1,
                         (1 << (bits_ - 1)) + 1, 0x80 % (1 << bits_), 0x7f, bits_ - 1, bits_, bits_ + 1,
                         (1 << bits_) - bits_, 1 << (bits_ // 2)])
    if k < 0.5:
        return r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, bits_))
    if k < 0.6:
        return ((1 << bits_) - r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, bits_ - 1))) & ((1 << bits_) - 1)
    return r.getrandbits(bits_)


def rand_f32(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.4:
        return r.choice(F32)
    if k < 0.8:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(110, 145), r.randint(0, 255), r.randint(120, 135)])
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 31) | (e << 23) | (r.getrandbits(23) if r.random() < 0.7 else
                                                        r.getrandbits(4) << 19)
    return struct.unpack('<I', struct.pack('<f', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), float(r.randint(-300, 300)) + 0.5,
                                                           float(r.randint(-5, 5)), r.uniform(-1e6, 1e6)])))[0]


def rand_f64(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.4:
        return r.choice(F64)
    if k < 0.8:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(1000, 1050), r.randint(0, 2047), r.randint(1020, 1030), r.randint(0, 40),
                      r.randint(2000, 2047), r.randint(860, 920)])
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 63) | (e << 52) | (r.getrandbits(52) if r.random() < 0.7 else
                                                        r.getrandbits(6) << 46)
    return struct.unpack('<Q', struct.pack('<d', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), float(r.randint(-300, 300)) + 0.5,
                                                           r.uniform(-1e12, 1e12)])))[0]


def rand_v(r):
    k = r.random()
    out = 0
    if k < 0.3:
        for i in range(4):
            out |= rand_f32(r) << (32 * i)
    elif k < 0.55:
        for i in range(2):
            out |= rand_f64(r) << (64 * i)
    elif k < 0.6:
        for i in range(8):
            out |= (r.choice(F16) if r.random() < 0.5 else r.getrandbits(16)) << (16 * i)
    elif k < 0.9:
        sz = r.randrange(4)
        for i in range(16 >> sz):
            out |= rand_lane(r, sz) << ((8 << sz) * i)
    else:
        out = r.getrandbits(128)
    if r.random() < 0.15:  # upper half zero, like most 64-bit results
        out &= (1 << 64) - 1
    return out


def rand_x(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.3:
        return r.choice([0, 1, 2, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x8000000000000000, 0xFFFFFFFF,
                         0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0x100000000, 0xFFFFFFFF80000000, 0x8000000000000001, 0xFFFFFF,
                         0x1000001, 0x20000000000001, 0xFFFFFFFFFF000001, 63, 64, 31, 32, 0xFF, 0xFFFF])
    if k < 0.45:
        return rand_f32(r) | (r.getrandbits(32) << 32 if r.random() < 0.3 else 0)
    if k < 0.6:
        return rand_f64(r)
    if k < 0.75:
        return r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, 64))
    if k < 0.8:
        return (-r.getrandbits(r.randint(1, 63))) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    return r.getrandbits(64)


def rand_fpcr(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.55:
        return 0
    v = 0
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= 1 << 25  # DN
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= 1 << 24  # FZ
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        v |= r.randrange(4) << 22  # RMode
    if r.random() < 0.15:
        v |= 1 << 26  # AHP
    return v


class Emu:
    """Unicorn as a Cortex-A57, the Switch's CPU, unless another model is given (LSE atomics need
    UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX). Images are (base, bytes) pairs mapped at their guest address."""

    def __init__(self, images, model=A.UC_CPU_ARM64_A57):
        mu = uc.Uc(uc.UC_ARCH_ARM64, uc.UC_MODE_ARM)
        mu.ctl_set_cpu_model(model)
        mu.mem_map(BUF, BUF_SIZE)
        for base, data in images:
            mu.mem_map(base, (len(data) + 0xFFFF) & ~0xFFFF)
            mu.mem_write(base, bytes(data))
        mu.reg_write(A.UC_ARM64_REG_CPACR_EL1, 0x300000)  # enable FP/SIMD
        self.mu = mu
        self.xregs = [A.UC_ARM64_REG_X0 + i for i in range(29)] + [A.UC_ARM64_REG_X29, A.UC_ARM64_REG_X30]
        self.qregs = [A.UC_ARM64_REG_Q0 + i for i in range(32)]
        self.out_regs = self.xregs + [A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV, A.UC_ARM64_REG_PC] + self.qregs

    def run(self, pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, count=1):
        """Run count instructions from pc. Returns (x[31], sp, nzcv, pc, v[32])."""
        mu = self.mu
        mu.reg_write_batch(list(zip(self.xregs, x[:31])) + list(zip(self.qregs, v)) +
                           [(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, sp), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV, nzcv), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_FPCR, fpcr)])
        mu.emu_start(pc, pc + 4 * count + 4, count=count)
        o = mu.reg_read_batch(self.out_regs)
        return list(o[:31]), o[31], o[32] & 0xF0000000, o[33], list(o[34:])


def compiler():
    cc = os.environ.get('CC')
    if cc:
        return cc
    cc = ROOT / 'tools' / 'llvm' / 'bin' / 'clang.exe'
    if cc.exists():
        return str(cc)
    return shutil.which('clang') or 'clang'


def build_harness(work, bodies, jobs, cflags):
    """Compile one C function per test body plus harness.c into work/harness[.exe]."""
    cc = compiler()
    env = dict(os.environ)
    flags = ['-O1', '-fno-strict-aliasing', '-Wno-unused-label', '-I', str(ROOT / 'runtime')] + cflags.split()
    n = max(1, min(jobs, len(bodies) // 200 + 1))
    per = (len(bodies) + n - 1) // n
    srcs = []
    for j in range(n):
        path = work / f'tests_{j}.c'
        with open(path, 'w') as f:
            f.write('#include "cpu.h"\n')
            for k in range(j * per, min(len(bodies), (j + 1) * per)):
                f.write(f'void t{k}(Cpu *c) {{ {bodies[k]} }}\n')
        srcs.append(path)
    with open(work / 'table.c', 'w') as f:
        f.write('#include "cpu.h"\n')
        f.write(''.join(f'void t{k}(Cpu *c);\n' for k in range(len(bodies))))
        f.write('GuestFn tests[] = {' + ','.join(f't{k}' for k in range(len(bodies))) + '};\n')
        f.write(f'int ntests = {len(bodies)};\n')
    # fma.c: a --cflags=-march=x86-64-v2 run must exercise the software fma the v2 build links, not the C runtime's.
    srcs += [work / 'table.c', ROOT / 'tests' / 'insn' / 'harness.c', ROOT / 'runtime' / 'fma.c']
    objs, procs = [], []
    for s in srcs:
        o = work / (s.stem + '.o')
        objs.append(o)
        procs.append(subprocess.Popen([cc] + flags + ['-c', str(s), '-o', str(o)], env=env))
    if any(p.wait() for p in procs):
        raise SystemExit('compile failed')
    exe = work / ('harness.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'harness')
    subprocess.check_call([cc, '-fuse-ld=lld', '-o', str(exe)] + [str(o) for o in objs], env=env)
    return exe


def write_cases(path, cases, stubs=False):
    """cases: (k, fpcr, x[31], sp, nzcv, v[32], memchk). stubs: calls go to harness.c's call stub (rt_stub)."""
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        for k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, memchk in cases:
            f.write(struct.pack(IN_FMT, k, fpcr, *(list(x[:31]) + [0]), sp, nzcv))
            for q in v:
                f.write(q.to_bytes(16, 'little'))
            f.write(struct.pack(IN_TAIL, int(memchk), int(stubs)))


def run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, images, stubs=False):
    """Run the lifted tests. Returns (records, stderr tail or None). images: (base, path) pairs."""
    with open(work / 'buf.bin', 'wb') as f:
        f.write(buf0)
    write_cases(work / 'cases.bin', cases, stubs)
    out = work / 'out.bin'
    args = [str(exe), str(work / 'buf.bin'), str(work / 'cases.bin'), str(out)]
    for base, path in images:
        args += [str(path), f'{base:x}']
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True)
    err = None if p.returncode == 0 else f'exit {p.returncode:#x}: {p.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-2000:]}'
    data = out.read_bytes() if out.exists() else b''
    recs = []
    for i in range(len(data) // OUT_SIZE):
        rec = data[i * OUT_SIZE:(i + 1) * OUT_SIZE]
        x = struct.unpack_from('<31Q', rec, 0)
        sp, nzcv, pc, mem = struct.unpack_from('<4Q', rec, 256)
        v = [int.from_bytes(rec[288 + 16 * j:304 + 16 * j], 'little') for j in range(32)]
        recs.append((x, sp, nzcv, pc, mem, v))
    return recs, err


def diff_state(got, want, check_pc, check_mem, check_nzcv=True):
    """got: harness record; want: (x, sp, nzcv, pc, v, mem). Returns a list of mismatches."""
    hx, hsp, hnz, hpc, hmem, hv = got
    ex, esp, enz, epc, ev, emem = want
    d = [f'x{j}: got {hx[j]:x} want {ex[j]:x}' for j in range(31) if hx[j] != ex[j]]
    if hsp != esp:
        d.append(f'sp: got {hsp:x} want {esp:x}')
    if check_nzcv and hnz != enz:
        d.append(f'nzcv: got {hnz:x} want {enz:x}')
    if check_pc and hpc != epc:
        d.append(f'pc: got {hpc:x} want {epc:x}')
    if check_mem and hmem != emem:
        d.append('memory differs')
    d += [f'v{j}: got {hv[j]:032x} want {ev[j]:032x}' for j in range(32) if hv[j] != ev[j]]
    return d
```

`tests/insn/fuzz.py`:

```py
"""Form-driven differential fuzzer: the game's own instruction words, lifted C (production flags) vs Unicorn (A57).

Forms and their risk weight come from analysis/recomp/insn_census.tsv (tests/insn/census.py). For every form up to
--words distinct words of main and sdk are taken; each word gets cases in proportion to its risk weight. Operands are
typed from the form: FP lanes get NaN payloads (quiet and signalling), denormals, +-0, infinities, rounding ties and
overflow edges for the element size; integer lanes and X/W registers get INT_MIN/INT_MAX/-1/0, shift amounts around
the width, and random values. FPCR is 0 (the game's value: main never writes FPCR) in 70% of cases, otherwise random
DN/FZ/RMode/AHP.

Two builds are compared against the same Unicorn results:
  run    inputs come from the case record (the harness), compiled with the production flags (-O2 -march=x86-64-v3)
  const  every input register is a C constant inside the test body, so clang can constant-fold the lifted code;
         this finds undefined behaviour in the lowering (float->int casts, shifts >= width, signed overflow) that a
         runtime-input test never sees. FP/SIMD and integer data processing words only.

Needs no game files beyond the two ELFs the lifter reads. Output: failing words with disassembly, inputs, diffs;
--regress FILE writes them (word, module offset, inputs) for tests/insn/regress.py.

Usage: tools/venv-recomp/Scripts/python -I tests/insn/fuzz.py [--words N] [--scale S] [--seed S] [--modes run,const]
       [--classes fpcvt,fparith,...] [--forms REGEX] [--jobs J] [--opt -O2]
"""
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import argparse
import os
import random
import re
import struct
import sys
import time
import zlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import capstone
import numpy as np
import unicorn as uc

from common import BUF, BUF_SIZE, F16, F32, F64, ROOT, Emu, build_harness, diff_state, dis, rand_lane, rand_v, \
    rand_x, run_harness
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'recomp'))
from census import risk, shape  # noqa: E402
from lift import classify, to_test_body  # noqa: E402
from lifter import Lifter, Unsupported, bits  # noqa: E402
from elfimg import ElfImage  # noqa: E402
from snap_common import BASE, ELF, SDK_BASE, SDK_ELF, functions, tsv  # noqa: E402

BUF_MID = BUF + 0x10000
WORK = ROOT / 'build' / 'w' / 'fuzz'
ALIAS_CODE = 0x7220000000
CENSUS = ROOT / 'analysis' / 'recomp' / 'insn_census.tsv'
CONST_CLASSES = {'fpcvt', 'fpest', 'fparith', 'fpcmp', 'fpmove', 'neon_sat', 'neon_narrow', 'neon_widen', 'neon_shift',
                 'neon_lane', 'neon_int', 'simd_other', 'flags', 'intdiv', 'bitfield', 'csel', 'int', 'crc'}

# Extra FP edges on top of common.F32/F64: rounding ties for every RMode, int-conversion boundaries, near-denormals.
F32X = [0x3f000000, 0x3fc00000, 0x40200000, 0x40600000, 0xbf000000, 0xbfc00000, 0x4b000000, 0x4b000001, 0x4affffff,
        0x4b7fffff, 0xcb000001, 0x4effffff, 0x4f000000, 0xcf000000, 0xcf000001, 0x4f7fffff, 0x4f800000, 0x5effffff,
        0x5f000000, 0xdf000000, 0x5f800000, 0x00000002, 0x80000002, 0x007ffffe, 0x7f7fffff, 0x7fffffff, 0xffffffff,
        0x7f800001, 0xff800001, 0x7fbfffff, 0x3f7fffff, 0x3f800001, 0x34000000, 0x33ffffff, 0xbf7fffff]
F64X = [0x3fe0000000000000, 0x3ff8000000000000, 0x4004000000000000, 0xbfe0000000000000, 0x4330000000000000,
        0x4330000000000001, 0x432fffffffffffff, 0x41dfffffffc00000, 0x41dfffffffe00000, 0x41e0000000000000,
        0xc1e0000000000000, 0xc1e0000000200000, 0x41efffffffe00000, 0x41f0000000000000, 0x43dfffffffffffff,
        0x43e0000000000000, 0xc3e0000000000000, 0x43f0000000000000, 0x7fffffffffffffff, 0x7ff0000000000001,
        0x7ff7ffffffffffff, 0x0000000000000002, 0x47efffffe0000000, 0x47efffffefffffff, 0x47effffff0000000,
        0x36a0000000000000, 0x36a0000000000001, 0x369fffffffffffff, 0x3810000000000000, 0x380fffffffffffff]
XEDGE = [0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 15, 16, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 255, 256, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000,
         0x80000001, 0xFFFFFFFE, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x8000000000000000, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 0x8000000000000001,
         0xFFFFFFFF80000000, 0x00000000FFFF8000, 0x7FFF, 0x8000, 0xFFFF, 0x7F, 0x80, 0xFF, 0x100000000,
         0xFFFFFFFF00000000, 0x5555555555555555, 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA]


def rf32(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.45:
        return r.choice(F32 + F32X)
    if k < 0.6:  # denormal or near-denormal
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 31) | (r.choice([0, 0, 1, 2]) << 23) | r.getrandbits(23)
    if k < 0.7:  # NaN with random payload
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 31) | (0xff << 23) | (r.getrandbits(22) | (r.getrandbits(1) << 22) or 1)
    if k < 0.85:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(118, 160), r.randint(0, 255), 127, 126, 150, 151, 157, 158, 189, 190])
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 31) | (e << 23) | (r.getrandbits(23) if r.random() < 0.6 else r.getrandbits(3) << 20)
    return struct.unpack('<I', struct.pack('<f', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), r.randint(-300, 300) + 0.5,
                                                           r.uniform(-1e6, 1e6), r.uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3)])))[0]


def rf64(r):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.45:
        return r.choice(F64 + F64X)
    if k < 0.6:
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 63) | (r.choice([0, 0, 1, 2]) << 52) | r.getrandbits(52)
    if k < 0.7:
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 63) | (0x7ff << 52) | (r.getrandbits(51) | (r.getrandbits(1) << 51) or 1)
    if k < 0.85:
        e = r.choice([r.randint(1010, 1090), r.randint(0, 2047), 1023, 1022, 1075, 1076, 1054, 1055, 1086, 1087,
                      r.randint(870, 910), r.randint(1150, 1160)])  # 870..910 and 1150..: float denormal/overflow
        return (r.getrandbits(1) << 63) | (e << 52) | (r.getrandbits(52) if r.random() < 0.6 else r.getrandbits(4) << 48)
    return struct.unpack('<Q', struct.pack('<d', r.choice([r.uniform(-4, 4), r.randint(-300, 300) + 0.5,
                                                           r.uniform(-1e12, 1e12), r.uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3)])))[0]


def rf16(r):
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        return r.choice(F16)
    return r.getrandbits(16)


def rx(r, wide):
    k = r.random()
    if k < 0.35:
        v = r.choice(XEDGE)
        return v if wide or r.random() < 0.3 else (v & 0xFFFFFFFF) | (r.getrandbits(32) << 32 if r.random() < 0.5 else 0)
    if k < 0.5:
        return rf32(r) | (r.getrandbits(32) << 32 if r.random() < 0.3 else 0)
    if k < 0.6:
        return rf64(r)
    return rand_x(r)


# element types present in a form: 'f16', 'f32', 'f64', or ('i', size)
_VEC = re.compile(r'v\.(\d*)([bhsdq])')
_SCAL = re.compile(r'(?:^|[ ,{\[])([bhsdq])(?=$|[ ,}\]])')
_ESZ = {'b': 0, 'h': 1, 's': 2, 'd': 3, 'q': 4}


def elem_types(form):
    mn, ops = (form.split(' ', 1) + [''])[:2]
    fp = mn[0] == 'f' or mn in ('scvtf', 'ucvtf') or mn.startswith(('frecp', 'frsqrt'))
    out = set()
    for m in _VEC.finditer(ops):
        out.add(m.group(2))
    for m in _SCAL.finditer(ops):
        out.add(m.group(1))
    types = set()
    for t in out:
        if fp and t in 'hsd':
            types.add({'h': 'f16', 's': 'f32', 'd': 'f64'}[t])
        if not fp or mn in ('fmov', 'fcvtzs', 'fcvtzu', 'scvtf', 'ucvtf') or mn.startswith(('fcvt', 'fcm')):
            types.add(('i', min(_ESZ[t], 3)))
    return types


def typed_v(r, types):
    if not types or r.random() < 0.15:
        return rand_v(r)
    t = r.choice(sorted(types, key=str))
    out = 0
    if t == 'f32':
        for i in range(4):
            out |= rf32(r) << (32 * i)
    elif t == 'f64':
        for i in range(2):
            out |= rf64(r) << (64 * i)
    elif t == 'f16':
        for i in range(8):
            out |= rf16(r) << (16 * i)
    else:
        sz = t[1]
        for i in range(16 >> sz):
            out |= rand_lane(r, sz) << ((8 << sz) * i)
    if r.random() < 0.1:
        out &= (1 << 64) - 1
    return out


def fpcr_of(r):
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        return 0
    v = r.getrandbits(1) << 25 | r.getrandbits(1) << 24 | r.randrange(4) << 22
    if r.random() < 0.1:
        v |= 1 << 26
    return v


def is_mem(w):
    return bits(w, 25, 1) == 0 and bits(w, 27, 1) == 1


def is_store(w):
    if not is_mem(w) or (w & 0x3B000000) == 0x18000000:
        return False
    return not (w >> 22) & 1


def make_case(r, w, form):
    types = elem_types(form)
    wide = ' x' in form or form.split(' ')[1:2] == ['x,']
    if is_mem(w):
        x = [BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 8) for _ in range(31)]
        if (bits(w, 21, 1) and bits(w, 10, 2) == 2) or (w & 0xBFA00000) == 0x0C800000:
            rm = bits(w, 16, 5)
            if rm != bits(w, 5, 5) and rm < 31:
                x[rm] = r.randrange(0, 0x100)
    else:
        x = [rx(r, wide) for _ in range(31)]
    sp = BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    nzcv = r.getrandbits(4) << 28
    v = [typed_v(r, types) for _ in range(32)]
    return fpcr_of(r), x, sp, nzcv, v


GRID_CLASSES = {'fpcvt', 'fpest', 'fparith', 'fpcmp', 'fpmove', 'neon_sat', 'neon_narrow', 'neon_widen', 'neon_shift',
                'neon_int', 'simd_other', 'intdiv', 'bitfield', 'flags', 'csel'}
GRID_FPCR = [0, 0, 0, 0x400000, 0x800000, 0xc00000, 0x2000000, 0x1000000, 0x3c00000]
XCONV = [(1 << 24) + 1, (1 << 24) + 3, (1 << 25) + 3, (1 << 53) + 1, (1 << 53) + 3, (1 << 54) + 6, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFC00,
         0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFBFF, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFE00, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFDFF, 0xFFFFFF80, 0xFFFFFF7F, 0x7FFFFFC0, 0x7FFFFFBF,
         0x80000040, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFE, 0x20000001, 0x1000001, 0xFFFFFF, 0x1FFFFFF]


def int_edges(sz):
    b = 8 << sz
    m = (1 << b) - 1
    return sorted({0, 1, 2, 3, m, m - 1, 1 << (b - 1), (1 << (b - 1)) - 1, (1 << (b - 1)) + 1, b - 1, b, b + 1, 2 * b,
                   (m - b + 1) & m, (-(b + 1)) & m, 0x55 * (m // 0xFF), 0xAA * (m // 0xFF), 1 << (b // 2),
                   (1 << (b // 2)) - 1, 0x80 & m, 0x7F, 0x81 & m, 0xFE & m} | ({0xFFFF, 0x8000, 0x7FFF} if b > 16 else set()))


def grid_cases(r, w, form):
    """Deterministic cross product of edge values over the source operands (Rn x Rm, lanes packed), then FPCR."""
    types = elem_types(form)
    fpt = [t for t in types if isinstance(t, str)]
    t = fpt[0] if fpt else (sorted(types, key=str)[0] if types else None)
    if t == 'f32':
        L, eb = sorted(set(F32 + F32X)), 32
    elif t == 'f64':
        L, eb = sorted(set(F64 + F64X)), 64
    elif t == 'f16':
        L, eb = sorted(set(F16)), 16
    elif t is not None:
        L, eb = int_edges(t[1]), 8 << t[1]
    else:
        L, eb = None, 0
    rn, rm, ra = bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 5)
    m = re.search(r'v\.(\d+)[bhsd]', form)
    lanes = int(m.group(1)) if m else 1
    lanes = max(1, min(lanes, 128 // eb)) if eb else 1
    gpr_src = re.search(r'^(scvtf|ucvtf|fmov|dup|ins|mov) [^,]+, [wx]', form) or (L is None)
    out = []
    if L is None:  # integer registers only: Rn x Rm cross product (Ra random edge)
        for xa in XEDGE:
            for xb in XEDGE:
                fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w, form)
                if rn < 31:
                    x[rn] = xa
                if rm < 31 and rm != rn:
                    x[rm] = xb
                if ra < 31 and ra not in (rn, rm) and r.random() < 0.5:
                    x[ra] = r.choice(XEDGE)
                out.append((fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v))
        return out
    if gpr_src:
        xs = XEDGE + XCONV
        for i, xv in enumerate(xs):
            for f in (GRID_FPCR if form[0] in 'suf' else [0]):
                fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w, form)
                if rn < 31:
                    x[rn] = xv
                if rm < 31 and rm != rn:
                    x[rm] = xs[(i * 7 + 3) % len(xs)]
                out.append((f, x, sp, nzcv, v))
        return out
    two = rm != rn and ' v.' in form[form.index(' '):] and form.count(',') >= 2 or re.search(r'^f\w+ [sdh], [sdh], [sdh]', form)
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in L for b in L] if two else [(a, a) for a in L]
    msk = (1 << eb) - 1
    for i in range(0, len(pairs), lanes):
        grp = pairs[i:i + lanes]
        for f in ([0] if two else GRID_FPCR):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w, form)
            an = bn = 0
            for j, (a, b) in enumerate(grp):
                an |= (a & msk) << (eb * j)
                bn |= (b & msk) << (eb * j)
            v[rn] = an | (v[rn] & ~((1 << (eb * len(grp))) - 1))
            if two:
                v[rm] = bn | (v[rm] & ~((1 << (eb * len(grp))) - 1))
                if ra not in (rn, rm) and form.startswith(('fmadd', 'fmsub', 'fnmadd', 'fnmsub')):
                    v[ra] = r.choice(L) | (v[ra] & ~msk)
            if two and r.random() < 0.1:
                fpcr = r.choice(GRID_FPCR)
            else:
                fpcr = f
            out.append((fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v))
    return out


def const_prefix(w, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v):
    """The case's inputs as C constants for the registers the word can name (Rd, Rn, Rm, Ra/Rt2) plus FPCR and NZCV;
    the others come from the record and are not constant."""
    regs = sorted({bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 5), (bits(w, 0, 5) + 1) % 32})
    s = [f'c->x[{i}] = 0x{x[i]:x}ull;' for i in regs if i < 31]
    s += [f'c->sp = 0x{sp:x}ull; c->nzcv = 0x{nzcv:x}ull; c->fpcr = 0x{fpcr:x}ull;']
    s += [f'c->v[{i}] = ((__uint128_t)0x{v[i] >> 64:x}ull << 64) | 0x{v[i] & ((1 << 64) - 1):x}ull;' for i in regs]
    return ' '.join(s)


def collect(args, r):
    """[(module, word, pc, form, class, weight)] picked per form, highest score first."""
    rows = tsv(CENSUS)
    want = {row['form']: (row['class'], risk(row['form'])[1]) for row in rows}
    classes = set(args.classes.split(',')) if args.classes else None
    fre = re.compile(args.forms) if args.forms else None
    md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)
    byform = defaultdict(list)
    images = []
    for name, path, base in (('main', ELF, BASE), ('sdk', SDK_ELF, SDK_BASE)):
        img = ElfImage(str(path))
        images.append((name, base, img))
        if name == 'main':
            ranges = [(s, e) for s, e, k, _ in functions() if k in ('function', 'thunk')]
        else:
            lo, n = img.text
            ranges = [(lo, lo + n)]
        first = {}
        for s, e in ranges:
            ws = np.frombuffer(bytes(img.image[s:e]), dtype='<u4')
            u, i = np.unique(ws, return_index=True)
            for w, j in zip(u.tolist(), i.tolist()):
                first.setdefault(w, s + 4 * j)
        for w, off in first.items():
            byform[w].append((name, base + off))
    forms = defaultdict(list)
    for w, locs in byform.items():
        d = next(md.disasm(struct.pack('<I', w), 0), None)
        if d is None:
            continue
        f = (d.mnemonic + ' ' + shape(d.op_str)).strip()
        if f not in want:
            continue
        c, wt = want[f]
        if classes and c not in classes or fre and not fre.search(f) or classify(w) == 'skip':
            continue
        forms[f].append((w, locs[0]))
    picks = []
    for f, lst in forms.items():
        c, wt = want[f]
        r.shuffle(lst)
        n = args.words * (4 if wt >= 8 else 2 if wt >= 5 else 1)
        for w, (name, pc) in lst[:n]:
            picks.append((name, w, pc, f, c, wt))
            if args.alias and c not in ('ldst', 'branch', 'excl', 'sysreg') and not is_mem(w):
                # register-aliasing variants (Rd = Rn, Rd = Rm, Rn = Rm, all equal): in-place lane updates
                d, nn, m = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5)
                base = w & ~((31 << 0) | (31 << 5) | (31 << 16))
                for vd, vn, vm in ((nn, nn, m), (m, nn, m), (d, nn, nn), (nn, nn, nn)):
                    if 31 in (vd, vn, vm):
                        continue
                    v2 = base | vd | (vn << 5) | (vm << 16)
                    if v2 != w and not f.startswith('adr'):
                        picks.append(('alias', v2, None, f, c, wt))
    return picks, images


def main():
    from snap_common import lower_priority
    lower_priority()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--words', type=int, default=6, help='distinct words per form (x4 for weight >= 8, x2 for >= 5)')
    ap.add_argument('--scale', type=float, default=1.0, help='cases per word = scale x weight x 2')
    ap.add_argument('--const-cases', type=int, default=2, help='const-mode cases per word')
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--modes', default='run,const')
    ap.add_argument('--classes', help='only these census classes (comma list)')
    ap.add_argument('--forms', help='only forms matching this regex')
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 4) // 2))
    ap.add_argument('--opt', default='-O2')
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3 -Wno-deprecated-declarations')
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument('--regress', help='append failing cases to this file')
    ap.add_argument('--alias', action='store_true', help='add register-aliasing variants of each word')
    ap.add_argument('--grid', action='store_true', help='edge-value cross product on one word per form (GRID_CLASSES)')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    picks, images = collect(args, r)
    print(f'{len(picks)} words from {len({p[3] for p in picks})} forms ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')

    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    img_paths = []
    for name, base, img in images:
        p = WORK / f'{name}.img'
        if not p.exists() or p.stat().st_size != len(img.image):
            p.write_bytes(bytes(img.image))
        img_paths.append((base, p))
    # aliasing variants are not in the images: they run from a code page of their own (no PC-relative forms)
    alias = [i for i, p in enumerate(picks) if p[0] == 'alias']
    for j, i in enumerate(alias):
        picks[i] = ('alias', picks[i][1], ALIAS_CODE + 4 * j) + picks[i][3:]
    alias_code = struct.pack(f'<{len(alias)}I', *[picks[i][1] for i in alias]) + bytes(64)
    emu = Emu([(base, bytes(img.image)) for _, base, img in images] + [(ALIAS_CODE, alias_code)])
    mu = emu.mu
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    lifter = {name: Lifter(base, 'c') for name, base, _ in images}
    lifter['alias'] = Lifter(ALIAS_CODE, 'c')

    # Lift once; cases from Unicorn.
    bodies, cases, expect, meta = [], [], [], []
    const_bodies, const_cases, const_expect = [], [], []
    modes = set(args.modes.split(','))
    unsup = Counter()
    grid_done = set()
    ucfail, accepted = Counter(), Counter()
    t1 = time.time()
    for name, w, pc, form, cls, wt in picks:
        try:
            body = to_test_body(lifter[name].lift(w, pc), pc)
        except Unsupported:
            unsup[form] += 1
            continue
        k = len(bodies)
        bodies.append(body)
        meta.append((name, w, pc, form, cls))
        mem = is_mem(w)
        st = is_store(w)
        n = max(2, int(args.scale * wt * 2))
        nconst = args.const_cases if 'const' in modes and cls in CONST_CLASSES and not mem else 0
        gen = None
        if args.grid and cls in GRID_CLASSES and form not in grid_done and not mem:
            grid_done.add(form)
            gen = grid_cases(r, w, form)
            n = len(gen)
        for i in range(n):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = gen[i] if gen else make_case(r, w, form)
            try:
                ox, osp, onz, opc, ov = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v)
            except uc.UcError:
                if mem:
                    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
                ucfail[form] += 1
                continue
            accepted[form] += 1
            mh = 0
            if st:
                mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
            if mem:
                mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            want = (ox, osp, onz, opc, ov, mh)
            if 'run' in modes:
                cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, st))
                expect.append(want)
            if i < nconst and not fpcr & (1 << 24):
                # FPCR.FZ is modelled by MXCSR FTZ/DAZ, which clang's constant folding cannot see; the game never sets
                # FZ (main has no MSR FPCR; sdk only restores a saved FPCR), so const mode tests FZ = 0 only.
                kc = len(const_bodies)
                const_bodies.append(const_prefix(w, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v) + ' ' + body)
                const_cases.append((kc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, False, k))
                const_expect.append(want)
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} run cases, {len(const_cases)} const cases ({time.time() - t1:.0f}s); '
          f'lifter rejected {sum(unsup.values())} words')

    untested = sorted(f for f in ucfail if not accepted[f])
    if untested:
        print(f'forms Unicorn faulted on in every case (untested): {len(untested)}: ' + '; '.join(untested[:40]))
    cflags = args.cflags + ' ' + args.opt
    results = []
    if 'run' in modes and cases:
        work = WORK / 'run'
        work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        t2 = time.time()
        exe = build_harness(work, bodies, args.jobs, cflags)
        recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, img_paths)
        print(f'run: compiled and ran {len(recs)} of {len(cases)} ({time.time() - t2:.0f}s)' + (f' ERROR {err}' if err else ''))
        results.append(('run', cases, expect, recs, [c[0] for c in cases]))
    if 'const' in modes and const_cases:
        work = WORK / 'const'
        work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        t2 = time.time()
        exe = build_harness(work, const_bodies, args.jobs, cflags)
        recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, [c[:7] for c in const_cases], img_paths)
        print(f'const: compiled and ran {len(recs)} of {len(const_cases)} ({time.time() - t2:.0f}s)' + (f' ERROR {err}' if err else ''))
        results.append(('const', const_cases, const_expect, recs, [c[7] for c in const_cases]))

    fails = {}
    nfail = Counter()
    reg = []
    for mode, cs, ex, recs, ks in results:
        for case, want, got, k in zip(cs, ex, recs, ks):
            d = diff_state(got, want, check_pc=got[3] != 0, check_mem=case[6])
            if d:
                nfail[mode] += 1
                name, w, pc, form, cls = meta[k]
                key = (mode, w)
                if key not in fails:
                    fails[key] = (meta[k], case, d[:4])
                reg.append((mode, meta[k], case))
    per_form = Counter()
    for (mode, w), (m, case, d) in fails.items():
        per_form[(mode, m[3])] += 1
    print(f'{len(bodies)} words, {len(cases)} run + {len(const_cases)} const cases: failing cases {dict(nfail)}, '
          f'failing words {len(fails)} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s total)')
    for (mode, f), n in per_form.most_common(80):
        print(f'  {mode:5} {n:4} words  {f}')
    for (mode, w), (m, case, d) in list(fails.items())[:args.show]:
        name, _, pc, form, cls = m
        fpcr, x, v = case[1], case[2], case[5]
        regs = sorted({bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 5)})
        ins = ' '.join(f'x{j}={x[j]:x}' for j in regs if j < 31) + ' | ' + ' '.join(f'v{j}={v[j]:032x}' for j in regs)
        print(f'  [{mode}] {name}+{pc - {"main": BASE, "sdk": SDK_BASE, "alias": ALIAS_CODE}[name]:x} {w:08x} {dis(w, pc):40} fpcr={fpcr:x}')
        print(f'      in: {ins}')
        print(f'      {"; ".join(d)}')
    if args.regress and reg:
        with open(args.regress, 'a') as fh:
            for mode, (name, w, pc, form, cls), case in reg:
                fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = case[1:6]
                fh.write(f'{w:08x}\t{name}\t{pc:x}\t{fpcr:x}\t{nzcv:x}\t{sp:x}\t' + ','.join(f'{q:x}' for q in x[:31]) +
                         '\t' + ','.join(f'{q:x}' for q in v) + '\n')
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```
