`tests/insn/harness.c`:

```c
// Runs lifted tests and writes the resulting CPU state per case.
// Shared by tests/diff/lift.py, simd.py, atomic.py and func.py; the expected state comes from Unicorn on the Python
// side.
//
// argv: buf.bin cases.bin out.bin image base [image base ...]
// Each image is mapped at its guest address (guest == host), the scratch buffer at BUF.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/mman.h>
#endif

#include "cpu.h"

extern GuestFn tests[];
extern int ntests;

#define BUF 0x7200000000ull
#define BUF_SIZE 0x40000

#define PTR_LO (BUF + 0x8000)
#define PTR_SPAN 0x20000

static int g_stubs;            // In.stubs of the running case
static uint64_t g_stub_h;      // digest of every call's state so far

static uint64_t splitmix(uint64_t z) {
    z += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}

static uint64_t mix(uint64_t h, uint64_t w) { return (h ^ w) * 0x100000001B3ull; }

// The callee of every call in a function under tests/diff/func.py; Runner.stub there is the same function on the
// Unicorn side. Folds the target, X0-X30, SP and V0-V7 into a digest, so a register the caller left unwritten at the
// call changes it, then sets X0-X18, NZCV and V0-V7 from the digest, so a caller reading a register it held across
// the call sees a value the callee could have left. X0-X7 mostly get pointers into the scratch buffer. The digest
// and the call count go to the top of the scratch buffer, which the memory check covers.
static void rt_stub(Cpu *c, uint64_t target) {
    uint64_t h = mix(g_stub_h, target);
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) h = mix(h, c->x[i]);
    h = mix(h, c->sp);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) h = mix(mix(h, (uint64_t)c->v[i]), (uint64_t)(c->v[i] >> 64));
    g_stub_h = h;
    for (int i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
        uint64_t s = splitmix(h + i);
        c->x[i] = i < 8 && (s & 3) ? PTR_LO + ((s >> 4) % (PTR_SPAN / 16)) * 16 : s;
    }
    c->nzcv = splitmix(h + 19) >> 60 << 28;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        c->v[i] = (__uint128_t)splitmix(h + 33 + 2 * i) << 64 | splitmix(h + 32 + 2 * i);
    uint64_t *slot = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(BUF + BUF_SIZE - 16);
    slot[0]++;
    slot[1] = h;
}

void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) {
    if (g_stubs) rt_stub(c, c->pc);
}
void rt_stub_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t target) { rt_stub(c, target); }
void rt_spin_gate(Cpu *c, uint64_t head) { (void)c; (void)head; }
void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; }
void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; abort(); }
void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)pc; abort(); }
uint64_t rt_ticks(void) { return 0; }
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) { (void)addr; (void)lr; (void)x0; }

static void *map_at(uint64_t addr, size_t len) {
    len = (len + 0xffff) & ~(size_t)0xffff;
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)addr, len, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
#else
    void *p = mmap((void *)addr, len, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
#endif
    if (p != (void *)addr) {
        fprintf(stderr, "map %llx (+%zx) failed\n", (unsigned long long)addr, len);
        exit(1);
    }
    return p;
}

static void *load_at(const char *path, uint64_t addr) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    size_t size = (size_t)ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    void *p = map_at(addr, size);
    if (fread(p, 1, size, f) != size) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fclose(f);
    return p;
}

static uint32_t crc_tab[256];
static uint32_t crc32_buf(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    uint32_t c = 0xffffffffu;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = crc_tab[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >> 8);
    return c ^ 0xffffffffu;
}

// Layouts match IN_FMT / OUT_FMT in tests/diff/common.py.
struct In { uint64_t k, fpcr, x[32], sp, nzcv; __uint128_t v[32]; uint64_t memchk, stubs; };
struct Out { uint64_t x[32], sp, nzcv, pc, mem; __uint128_t v[32]; };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 6 || (argc - 4) % 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s buf.bin cases.bin out.bin image base [image base ...]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint32_t c = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? (c >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320u : c >> 1;
        crc_tab[i] = c;
    }
    for (int i = 4; i < argc; i += 2) load_at(argv[i], strtoull(argv[i + 1], 0, 16));
    uint8_t *buf = map_at(BUF, BUF_SIZE);
    FILE *bf = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!bf || fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, bf) != BUF_SIZE) { perror(argv[1]); return 1; }
    fclose(bf);
    uint8_t *pristine = malloc(BUF_SIZE);
    memcpy(pristine, buf, BUF_SIZE);

    FILE *f = fopen(argv[2], "rb"), *o = fopen(argv[3], "wb");
    if (!f || !o) return 1;
    static struct In in;
    static struct Out out;
    static Cpu c;
    while (fread(&in, sizeof in, 1, f) == 1) {
        if (in.k >= (uint64_t)ntests) { fprintf(stderr, "bad test index %llu\n", (unsigned long long)in.k); return 1; }
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        memcpy(c.x, in.x, sizeof c.x);
        c.sp = in.sp;
        c.nzcv = in.nzcv;
        c.fpcr = in.fpcr;
        rt_fpcr_sync(&c);
        memcpy(c.v, in.v, sizeof c.v);
        c.excl_addr = ~0ull;
        g_stubs = (int)in.stubs;
        g_stub_h = 0;
        tests[in.k](&c);
        memcpy(out.x, c.x, sizeof out.x);
        out.sp = c.sp;
        out.nzcv = c.nzcv & 0xf0000000ull;
        out.pc = c.pc;
        out.mem = 0;
        if (in.memchk) {
            out.mem = crc32_buf(buf, BUF_SIZE);
            memcpy(buf, pristine, BUF_SIZE);
        }
        memcpy(out.v, c.v, sizeof out.v);
        fwrite(&out, sizeof out, 1, o);
        // Flushed per case so a crash leaves the completed cases readable.
        fflush(o);
    }
    fclose(o);
    return 0;
}

```

`tests/insn/lift.py`:

```py
# Via TotK Recomp tests/diff/lift.py @ 7a37fc3 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Valiantsin Dzerakh), adapted from LAS Recomp
# (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai). Modified for Snap: input is the main ELF.
"""Differential test of the lifter on the game's own instructions: lifted C against Unicorn, one instruction at a time.

Samples distinct instruction words from the .text of each ExeFS module, one per opcode signature first, lifts each
with the portable FP/SIMD lowering, runs it from random register state, and compares X0-X30, SP, NZCV, PC (for
branches), V0-V31 and the scratch buffer (for loads and stores) with Unicorn as a Cortex-A57.

Skipped: system instructions and exceptions, whose single step cannot be compared, and exclusives and ARMv8.1
atomics, which atomic.py covers. Encodings the lifter rejects are counted per module and mnemonic; --coverage lifts
every distinct word instead of testing.

Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/test_lift.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).

Usage: lift.py [--exefs DIR] [--modules main,sdk,subsdk0] [--encodings N] [--cases K] [--seed S] [--jobs J]
       lift.py --coverage
"""
import argparse
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import os
import platform
import random
import sys
import time
import zlib
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import unicorn as uc

from common import BUF, BUF_SIZE, ROOT, Emu, build_harness, diff_state, dis, mnemonic, rand_fpcr, rand_v, rand_x, \
    run_harness
from lifter import Lifter, Unsupported, bits
from elfimg import ElfImage
from snap_common import ELF

BUF_MID = BUF + 0x10000
MUST = r'(frint|fcvt|scvtf|ucvtf|crc32|frecp|frsqrt|urecpe|ursqrte|fsqrt|fmadd|fmsub|fnmadd|fnmsub)'
MUST_WORDS = set()
# Test load addresses, below 2^39 and clear of BUF.
BASES = {'main': 0x7100000000}


def is_mem(w):
    return bits(w, 25, 1) == 0 and bits(w, 27, 1) == 1


def classify(w):
    """'skip' for instructions whose single-step behaviour cannot be compared."""
    if (w & 0xFFC00000) == 0xD5000000:  # system: hints, barriers, MRS/MSR, cache maintenance
        return 'skip'
    if (w & 0x3F000000) == 0x08000000 and (bits(w, 23, 1) == 0 or bits(w, 21, 1)):
        return 'skip'  # exclusives need a paired load; CAS is ARMv8.1; both are covered by atomic.py
    if (w & 0x3F200C00) == 0x38200000:  # LSE atomics, ARMv8.1: atomic.py
        return 'skip'
    if (w & 0xFF000000) == 0xD4000000:  # SVC, BRK, HLT
        return 'skip'
    if (w & 0xFFFF0000) == 0:  # UDF
        return 'skip'
    return 'ok'


def class_keys(words):
    """Opcode signature per word: register fields (Rd, Rn, Rm) cleared."""
    return words & np.uint32(0xFFE0FC00)


def to_test_body(ins, pc):
    if ins.kind == 'op':
        return ins.code
    nxt = f'0x{pc + 4:x}ull'
    if ins.kind == 'b':
        return f'c->pc = 0x{ins.target:x}ull;'
    if ins.kind == 'bl':
        return f'c->x[30] = {nxt}; c->pc = 0x{ins.target:x}ull;'
    if ins.kind == 'bcond':
        return f'c->pc = ({ins.cond}) ? 0x{ins.target:x}ull : {nxt};'
    if ins.kind == 'br':
        return f'c->pc = {ins.target};'
    if ins.kind == 'blr':
        return f'{{ uint64_t t = {ins.target}; c->x[30] = {nxt}; c->pc = t; }}'
    if ins.kind == 'ret':
        return 'c->pc = c->x[30];'
    raise Unsupported(ins.kind)


def pick_module(name, nso, base, count, r, unsupported):
    """Distinct words of .text, one per opcode signature first, lifted. Returns [(word, pc, body)]."""
    lo, size = nso.text
    words = np.frombuffer(bytes(nso.image[lo:lo + size]), dtype='<u4')
    uniq, first = np.unique(words, return_index=True)
    keys = class_keys(uniq)
    order = list(range(len(uniq)))
    r.shuffle(order)
    seen, primary, rest = set(), [], []
    # Snap: every distinct word of the must-test mnemonics (explicit-rounding FP and friends) goes first.
    import re as _re
    must_re = _re.compile(MUST)
    must = [i for i in range(len(uniq)) if must_re.match(mnemonic(int(uniq[i])))]
    MUST_WORDS.update(int(uniq[i]) for i in must)
    print(f'{name}: {len(must)} distinct must-test words ({MUST})')
    order = must + [i for i in order if int(uniq[i]) not in MUST_WORDS]
    for i in order:
        k = int(keys[i])
        (rest if k in seen else primary).append(i)
        seen.add(k)
    lifter = Lifter(base, 'c')
    picks = []
    for i in must + [j for j in primary + rest if int(uniq[j]) not in MUST_WORDS]:
        if len(picks) >= count:
            break
        w = int(uniq[i])
        if classify(w) == 'skip':
            continue
        pc = base + lo + int(first[i]) * 4
        try:
            body = to_test_body(lifter.lift(w, pc), pc)
        except Unsupported:
            unsupported[(name, mnemonic(w))] += 1
            continue
        picks.append((w, pc, body))
    print(f'{name}: {len(words)} words, {len(uniq)} distinct, {len(seen)} signatures, {len(picks)} picked')
    return picks


def coverage(name, nso, base):
    """Lift every distinct word of .text. Returns {kind mnemonic: [distinct words, occurrences]} of words the lifter
    rejects (Unsupported) or turns into an undefined-instruction trap (rt_udf)."""
    lo, size = nso.text
    words = np.frombuffer(bytes(nso.image[lo:lo + size]), dtype='<u4')
    uniq, first, counts = np.unique(words, return_index=True, return_counts=True)
    lifter = Lifter(base, 'c')
    rejected = {}
    for w, i, n in zip(uniq.tolist(), first.tolist(), counts.tolist()):
        try:
            ins = lifter.lift(w, base + lo + i * 4)
            if ins.kind != 'trap' or not ins.code.startswith('rt_udf'):
                continue
            key = f'udf {mnemonic(w)}'
        except Unsupported:
            key = f'unsupported {mnemonic(w)}'
        e = rejected.setdefault(key, [0, 0])
        e[0] += 1
        e[1] += n
    total = sum(e[1] for e in rejected.values())
    print(f'{name}: {len(words)} words, {len(uniq)} distinct, {total} rejected '
          f'({sum(e[0] for e in rejected.values())} distinct)')
    for mn, (d, n) in sorted(rejected.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1]):
        print(f'  {mn:24} {n:8} occurrences {d:6} distinct')
    return rejected


def make_case(r, w):
    if is_mem(w):
        x = [BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 8) for _ in range(31)]
        if (bits(w, 21, 1) and bits(w, 10, 2) == 2) or (w & 0xBFA00000) == 0x0C800000:  # register offset
            rm = bits(w, 16, 5)
            if rm != bits(w, 5, 5) and rm < 31:
                x[rm] = r.randrange(0, 0x100)
    else:
        x = [rand_x(r) for _ in range(31)]
    sp = BUF_MID + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    nzcv = r.getrandbits(4) << 28
    v = [rand_v(r) for _ in range(32)]
    fpcr = rand_fpcr(r)
    return fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v


def main():
    from snap_common import lower_priority
    lower_priority()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--exefs', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'build' / 'extracted' / 'v121' / 'exefs')
    ap.add_argument('--modules', default='main')
    ap.add_argument('--encodings', type=int, default=20000, help='per module')
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=3, help='random states per encoding')
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=40)
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3 -Wno-deprecated-declarations' if platform.machine().lower() in ('amd64', 'x86_64') else '')
    ap.add_argument('--coverage', action='store_true',
                    help='only lift every distinct word and list the rejected ones (capstone "?" = undecodable data)')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    names = args.modules.split(',')
    if args.coverage:
        for name in names:
            coverage(name, ElfImage(ELF), BASES[name])
        print(f'({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
        return 0

    work = ROOT / 'build' / 'test' / 'lift'
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    images, picks, unsupported = [], [], Counter()
    for name in names:
        nso = ElfImage(ELF)
        base = BASES[name]
        img = work / f'{name}.img'
        img.write_bytes(bytes(nso.image))
        images.append((base, img, nso.image))
        picks += [(name,) + p for p in pick_module(name, nso, base, args.encodings, r, unsupported)]
    print(f'lifted {len(picks)} encodings ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')

    t1 = time.time()
    exe = build_harness(work, [p[3] for p in picks], args.jobs, args.cflags)
    print(f'compiled ({time.time() - t1:.0f}s)')

    emu = Emu([(base, data) for base, _, data in images])
    mu = emu.mu
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    cases, expect = [], []
    t2 = time.time()
    for k, (name, w, pc, _) in enumerate(picks):
        mem = is_mem(w)
        for _ in range(args.cases * (3 if w in MUST_WORDS else 1)):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w)
            try:
                ox, osp, onz, opc, ov = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v)
            except uc.UcError:
                if mem:
                    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
                continue
            mh = 0
            if mem:
                mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
                mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, mem))
            expect.append((ox, osp, onz, opc, ov, mh))
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} cases ({time.time() - t2:.0f}s)')

    t3 = time.time()
    recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, [(base, img) for base, img, _ in images])
    print(f'harness: {len(recs)} of {len(cases)} cases ({time.time() - t3:.0f}s)')
    if err:
        k = cases[len(recs)][0] if len(recs) < len(cases) else None
        where = f', stopped at {picks[k][1]:08x} {dis(picks[k][1])}' if k is not None else ''
        print(f'harness failed: {err}{where}')

    fails, nfail = {}, 0
    for case, want, got in zip(cases, expect, recs):
        k = case[0]
        name, w, pc, _ = picks[k]
        d = diff_state(got, want, check_pc=got[3] != 0, check_mem=case[6])
        if d:
            nfail += 1
            fails.setdefault(w, (name, pc, d[:4]))

    print('unsupported encodings (distinct words) by module and mnemonic:')
    for (name, mn), n in sorted(unsupported.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[0][0], -kv[1])):
        print(f'  {name:8} {mn:10} {n}')
    print(f'{len(picks)} encodings, {len(cases)} cases: {nfail} failing cases, {len(fails)} failing encodings '
          f'({time.time() - t0:.0f}s total)')
    if fails:
        print('  failing by mnemonic:', dict(Counter(mnemonic(w) for w in fails).most_common(40)))
    for w, (name, pc, d) in list(fails.items())[:args.show]:
        print(f'  {name:8} {w:08x} {dis(w, pc):40} {"; ".join(d)}')
    return 1 if fails or err else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tests/insn/simd.py`:

```py
"""Differential test of the portable FP/SIMD lowering (lifter simd='c') against Unicorn as a Cortex-A57.

Needs no game files. Enumerates every opcode bit pattern of the FP/SIMD data-processing space (bits 27..25 = 111),
the FP/SIMD load/store space and CRC32 with random register fields, and compares which encodings the lifter and
Unicorn accept. Then a stratified sample of encodings both accept is compiled and run with random interesting
operands (NaNs, infinities, denormals, +-0, saturation edges, random FPCR.DN/FZ/RMode/AHP): X0-X30, SP, NZCV, V0-V31
and, for stores, memory must match. FPSR is not compared; the lowering does not model the cumulative exception bits
or QC.

Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/test_simd.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).

Usage: simd.py [--encodings N] [--cases K] [--seed S] [--jobs J] [--no-validity] [--filter HEX/MASK]
"""
import argparse
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import functools
import os
import platform
import random
import struct
import sys
import time
import zlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import unicorn as uc
from unicorn import arm64_const as A

from common import BUF, BUF_SIZE, ROOT, UC_INVALID, Emu, build_harness, diff_state, dis, mnemonic, rand_fpcr, \
    rand_v, rand_x, run_harness
from lifter import Lifter, Unsupported

print = functools.partial(print, flush=True)
BASE_AREA = BUF + 0x8000
CODE, CODE_SIZE = 0x7210000000, 0x400000


def is_ldst(w):
    return (w >> 25) & 1 == 0 and (w >> 27) & 1 == 1


def is_store(w):
    if not is_ldst(w):
        return False
    if (w & 0x3B000000) == 0x18000000:  # literal
        return False
    return not (w >> 22) & 1  # L bit, same position for structures, pairs and single registers


def is_literal(w):
    return (w & 0x3F000000) == 0x1C000000


def class_key(w):
    """Opcode signature: register fields (Rd, Rn, Rm) cleared."""
    if is_ldst(w):
        return w & 0xFFE0FC00 if (w & 0xBE000000) == 0x0C000000 else w & 0xFFFFFC00
    return w & 0xFFE0FC00


def candidates(r):
    """Every opcode bit pattern of the FP/SIMD data-processing and load/store spaces, random registers."""
    out = []
    for p in range(1 << 19):
        hi, mid = p >> 15, p & 0x7FFF
        rr = r.getrandbits(10)
        out.append((hi << 28) | (0b111 << 25) | (mid << 10) | rr)  # data processing
        out.append((hi << 28) | (1 << 27) | (1 << 26) | (mid << 10) | rr)  # loads/stores
    for sf in (0, 1):
        for C in (0, 1):
            for sz in range(4):
                for _ in range(4):
                    out.append((sf << 31) | (0b0011010110 << 21) | (r.getrandbits(5) << 16) | (0b010 << 13) |
                               (C << 12) | (sz << 10) | r.getrandbits(10))
    return out


def validity(lifter, ws, emu):
    """Map word -> (lifter accepts, Unicorn accepts); words are placed at CODE + 4i."""
    mu = emu.mu
    res = {}
    step = CODE_SIZE // 4
    for base in range(0, len(ws), step):
        chunk = ws[base:base + step]
        mu.mem_write(CODE, struct.pack(f'<{len(chunk)}I', *chunk))
        mu.ctl_remove_cache(CODE, CODE + CODE_SIZE)
        state = list(zip(emu.xregs, [BASE_AREA] * 31)) + [(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, BASE_AREA)]
        for i, w in enumerate(chunk):
            pc = CODE + 4 * i
            try:
                lifter.lift(w, pc)
                lok = True
            except Unsupported:
                lok = False
            if i % 32 == 0:
                mu.reg_write_batch(state)
            try:
                mu.emu_start(pc, pc + 4, count=1)
                uok = True
            except uc.UcError as e:
                uok = e.errno not in UC_INVALID
            res[w] = (lok, uok)
    return res


def make_case(r, w):
    fpcr = rand_fpcr(r)
    v = [rand_v(r) for _ in range(32)]
    nzcv = r.getrandbits(4) << 28
    sp = BASE_AREA + r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    if is_ldst(w):
        x = [BASE_AREA + r.randrange(0, 0x100) for _ in range(31)]
        rm = (w >> 16) & 31
        if rm < 31 and rm != (w >> 5) & 31:
            reg_off = (w & 0x3B200C00) == 0x38200800  # register offset
            post_reg = (w & 0xBF800000) in (0x0C800000, 0x0D800000)
            if reg_off or post_reg:
                x[rm] = r.randrange(0, 0x100)
    else:
        x = [rand_x(r) for _ in range(31)]
    return fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v


def main():
    from snap_common import lower_priority
    lower_priority()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--encodings', type=int, default=20000)
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    ap.add_argument('--no-validity', action='store_true', help='skip the full validity enumeration')
    ap.add_argument('--filter', help='only encodings with (w & MASK) == VAL, as VAL/MASK in hex')
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=40)
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3' if platform.machine().lower() in ('amd64', 'x86_64') else '')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    lifter = Lifter(0, 'c')
    emu = Emu([(CODE, bytes(CODE_SIZE))])
    cands = candidates(r)
    if args.filter:
        val, mask = (int(x, 16) for x in args.filter.split('/'))
        cands = [w for w in cands if (w & mask) == val]
    if args.no_validity:
        val = validity(lifter, r.sample(cands, min(len(cands), args.encodings * 4)), emu)
    else:
        val = validity(lifter, cands, emu)
    agree = Counter()
    only = defaultdict(list)
    for w, (lok, uok) in val.items():
        agree[(lok, uok)] += 1
        if lok != uok:
            only['lifter' if lok else 'unicorn'].append(w)
    print(f'validity: {len(val)} encodings, both valid {agree[(True, True)]}, both invalid {agree[(False, False)]}, '
          f'lifter-only {agree[(True, False)]}, unicorn-only {agree[(False, True)]} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
    for kind in ('lifter', 'unicorn'):
        ws = only[kind]
        if ws:
            print(f'  {kind}-only by mnemonic: {dict(Counter(mnemonic(w) for w in ws).most_common(30))}')
            for w in ws[:args.show // 2]:
                print(f'    {w:08x} {dis(w)}')

    # Stratified sample of valid encodings: one per opcode signature first.
    valid = [w for w, (lok, uok) in val.items() if lok and uok]
    r.shuffle(valid)
    seen, pick = set(), []
    for w in valid:
        k = class_key(w)
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            pick.append(w)
    picked = set(pick)
    pick = (pick + [w for w in valid if w not in picked])[:args.encodings]
    # Placed at CODE + 4i; literal loads get an offset into the code region.
    for i, w in enumerate(pick):
        pc = CODE + 4 * i
        if is_literal(w):
            tgt = CODE + r.randrange(0, (len(pick) * 4 + 0x1000) & ~3, 4)
            pick[i] = (w & ~(0x7FFFF << 5)) | ((((tgt - pc) >> 2) & 0x7FFFF) << 5)
    code_bytes = struct.pack(f'<{len(pick)}I', *pick) + bytes(0x1000 + 64)
    bodies = [lifter.lift(w, CODE + 4 * i).code for i, w in enumerate(pick)]
    work = ROOT / 'build' / 'test' / 'simd'
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t1 = time.time()
    exe = build_harness(work, bodies, args.jobs, args.cflags)
    print(f'compiled {len(bodies)} tests ({time.time() - t1:.0f}s)')

    mu = emu.mu
    mu.mem_write(CODE, code_bytes)
    mu.ctl_remove_cache(CODE, CODE + CODE_SIZE)
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    code_path = work / 'code.bin'
    code_path.write_bytes(code_bytes)
    cases, expect = [], []
    t2 = time.time()
    for k, w in enumerate(pick):
        pc = CODE + 4 * k
        st = is_store(w)
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, w)
            try:
                ox, osp, onz, opc, ov = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v)
            except uc.UcError:
                if st:
                    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
                continue
            mh = 0
            if st:
                mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
                mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, st))
            expect.append((ox, osp, onz, opc, ov, mh))
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} cases ({time.time() - t2:.0f}s)')

    t3 = time.time()
    recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, [(CODE, code_path)])
    print(f'harness: {len(recs)} of {len(cases)} cases ({time.time() - t3:.0f}s)')
    if err:
        k = cases[len(recs)][0] if len(recs) < len(cases) else None
        print(f'harness failed: {err}' + (f', stopped at {pick[k]:08x} {dis(pick[k])}' if k is not None else ''))

    fails, nfail = {}, 0
    for case, want, got in zip(cases, expect, recs):
        k, v, st = case[0], case[5], case[6]
        d = diff_state(got, want, check_pc=False, check_mem=st)
        if d:
            nfail += 1
            w = pick[k]
            if w not in fails:
                ins = [f'v{j}={v[j]:032x}' for j in sorted({(w >> 5) & 31, (w >> 16) & 31, w & 31})]
                fails[w] = (case[1], d[:3], ins)
    print(f'{len(pick)} encodings, {len(cases)} cases: {nfail} failing cases, {len(fails)} failing encodings '
          f'({time.time() - t0:.0f}s total)')
    if fails:
        print('  failing by mnemonic:', dict(Counter(mnemonic(w) for w in fails).most_common(40)))
    for w, (fpcr, d, ins) in list(fails.items())[:args.show]:
        print(f'  {w:08x} {dis(w):40} fpcr={fpcr:x} {"; ".join(d)}')
        print(f'      {" ".join(ins)}')
    return 1 if fails or err else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tests/insn/snap_atomic.py`:

```py
"""Snap: differential test of the LL/SC exclusive sequences that `main` actually contains.

Scans .text for every load-exclusive (ldxr/ldaxr/ldxrb/h, ldxp/ldaxp) and the store-exclusive that follows it on the same
base register within 6 instructions, with only straight-line register ALU words between (no branch, memory, system or
FP/SIMD). Each distinct word tuple is lifted, run from random states against Unicorn (Cortex-MAX) and compared (X0-X30,
SP, V0-V31, memory). Also tests every distinct lone exclusive word (load alone; store alone, which must fail).
Reuses atomic.py's case generator and harness. Adapted from TotK Recomp tests/diff/atomic.py (MIT).

Usage: snap_atomic.py [--cases N] [--seed S] [--max-seqs M]
"""
import os as _os, sys as _sys
_sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import argparse
import os
import platform
import random
import struct
import sys
import time
import zlib
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import unicorn as uc
from unicorn import arm64_const as A

from common import BUF, BUF_SIZE, ROOT, Emu, build_harness, diff_state, dis, run_harness
import atomic
from atomic import CLREX, CODE, SLOT, make_case
from elfimg import ElfImage
from lifter import Lifter
from snap_common import ELF, lower_priority


def is_ldx(w):
    return (w & 0x3FC00000) == 0x08400000 and (w & 0x00208000) in (0, 0x8000) and not (w >> 21) & 1 and (w >> 22) & 1 \
        and (w & 0x3F600000) in (0x08400000,) or (w & 0xBFE08000) == 0x887F0000 and False


def kind_of(w):
    """'ldx' / 'stx' / None for exclusive pair and single-register forms (LDXR/LDAXR/LDXP/LDAXP/STXR/STLXR/STXP/STLXP)."""
    if (w & 0x3F000000) != 0x08000000:
        return None
    o2, L, o1 = (w >> 23) & 1, (w >> 22) & 1, (w >> 21) & 1
    if o2:
        return None  # LDAR/STLR/CAS family
    return 'ldx' if L else 'stx'


def rn_of(w):
    return (w >> 5) & 31


def plain_alu(w):
    """Straight-line integer register op that cannot fault or branch (data-processing immediate or register)."""
    top = (w >> 25) & 15
    return top in (0b1000, 0b1001, 0b0101, 0b1101) and (w & 0xFC000000) not in (0x14000000, 0x94000000)


def main():
    lower_priority()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=24)
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--max-seqs', type=int, default=6000)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 4)
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3 -Wno-deprecated-declarations')
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    t0 = time.time()
    img = ElfImage(ELF)
    lo, size = img.text
    W = np.frombuffer(bytes(img.image[lo:lo + size]), dtype='<u4').tolist()
    ldx = [i for i, w in enumerate(W) if kind_of(w) == 'ldx']
    stx_words = {w for w in W if kind_of(w) == 'stx'}
    ldx_words = {W[i] for i in ldx}
    seqs, shapes = set(), Counter()
    for i in ldx:
        for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 8, len(W))):
            w = W[j]
            if kind_of(w) == 'stx':
                if rn_of(w) == rn_of(W[i]) and all(plain_alu(W[k]) for k in range(i + 1, j)):
                    seqs.add(tuple(W[i:j + 1]))
                break
            if not plain_alu(w):
                break
    seqs = sorted(seqs)
    print(f'{len(ldx)} load-exclusives ({len(ldx_words)} distinct words), {len(stx_words)} distinct store-exclusive words, '
          f'{len(seqs)} distinct sequences')
    if len(seqs) > args.max_seqs:
        seqs = sorted(r.sample(seqs, args.max_seqs))
    # every distinct exclusive word alone, and every distinct (ldx, stx) mnemonic pair seen at least once is already in seqs
    tests = [([w], rn_of(w), 'excl') for w in sorted(ldx_words | stx_words)] + [(list(s), rn_of(s[0]), 'excl') for s in seqs]
    forms = Counter(dis(t[0][0]).split(' ')[0] + ('+' + dis(t[0][-1]).split(' ')[0] if len(t[0]) > 1 else '') for t in tests)
    print(f'{len(tests)} tests; forms:', dict(forms.most_common(30)))

    code = [CLREX, 0, 0, 0]
    bodies = []
    lifter = Lifter(0, 'c')
    for i, (words, _, _) in enumerate(tests):
        pc = CODE + SLOT + SLOT * 2 * i
        pad = [0] * (SLOT * 2 // 4 - len(words))
        code += words + pad
        bodies.append(' '.join(lifter.lift(w, pc + 4 * j).code for j, w in enumerate(words)))
    code_bytes = struct.pack(f'<{len(code)}I', *code)
    work = ROOT / 'build' / 'test' / 'snap_atomic'
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (work / 'code.bin').write_bytes(code_bytes)
    exe = build_harness(work, bodies, args.jobs, args.cflags)
    emu = Emu([(CODE, code_bytes)], A.UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX)
    mu = emu.mu
    buf0 = bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(4096)) * (BUF_SIZE // 4096)
    mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
    cases, expect, skipped = [], [], 0
    for k, (words, rn, kind) in enumerate(tests):
        pc = CODE + SLOT + SLOT * 2 * k
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = make_case(r, words, rn, kind, buf0)
            mu.emu_start(CODE, CODE + 4, count=1)
            try:
                ox, osp, onz, opc, ov = emu.run(pc, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, count=len(words))
            except uc.UcError as e:
                if skipped < 3: print('fault', e, [dis(w) for w in words], hex(pc))
                skipped += 1
                mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
                continue
            mh = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
            mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, True))
            expect.append((ox, osp, onz, opc, ov, mh))
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} cases ({skipped} faulted and skipped) ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
    recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, cases, [(CODE, work / 'code.bin')])
    if err:
        print('harness failed:', err)
    fails, nfail = {}, 0
    for case, want, got in zip(cases, expect, recs):
        d = diff_state(got, want, check_pc=False, check_mem=True)
        if d:
            nfail += 1
            fails.setdefault(case[0], d[:3])
    print(f'{len(tests)} tests, {len(cases)} cases: {nfail} failing cases, {len(fails)} failing tests ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)')
    for k, d in list(fails.items())[:40]:
        print('  ', ' ; '.join(dis(w) for w in tests[k][0]), '|', '; '.join(d))
    return 1 if fails or err else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

```

`tests/mods/mods_tests.cpp`:

```cpp
// Host-only tests for runtime/mods/mods_core (path mapping, index priority, replacement-chunk size override).
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>

#include "mods/mods_core.h"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
static int g_fail = 0, g_n = 0;
#define CHECK(c) do { g_n++; if (!(c)) { g_fail++; printf("FAIL %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #c); } } while (0)

static void write(const fs::path& p, const std::string& s) {
  fs::create_directories(p.parent_path());
  std::ofstream f(p, std::ios::binary);
  f << s;
}

int main() {
  using namespace mods;
  // ext ids (known values from romfs_census.DRP_EXT)
  CHECK(ext_crc("nutexb") == 0x5C156DBC);
  CHECK(ext_crc("NUTEXB") == 0x5C156DBC);
  CHECK(ext_crc("msbt") == 0xBE1C9ACB);
  CHECK(ext_crc("DC4A8177") == 0xDC4A8177);
  CHECK(crc32("123456789", 9) == 0xCBF43926u);
  CHECK(norm_archive("Common\\UI/Master\\a.drp") == "common/ui/master/a.drp");
  CHECK(norm_archive("rom:/common/Text/x.drp") == "common/text/x.drp");

  std::string a, s;
  uint32_t x = 0;
  CHECK(parse_pack_path("common/UI/master/Foo.drp/Icon_A.nutexb", &a, &s, &x));
  CHECK(a == "common/ui/master/foo.drp" && s == "icon_a" && x == 0x5C156DBC);
  CHECK(parse_pack_path("a.drp/foo.nutexb.nutexb", &a, &s, &x) && s == "foo");     // extracted name that repeats its ext
  CHECK(parse_pack_path("a.drp/foo.msbt", &a, &s, &x) && s == "foo" && x == 0xBE1C9ACB);
  CHECK(!parse_pack_path("pack.json", &a, &s, &x));
  CHECK(!parse_pack_path("common/UI/foo.nutexb", &a, &s, &x));            // no .drp component
  CHECK(!parse_pack_path("a.drp/sub/foo.msbt", &a, &s, &x));              // entry must sit directly in the archive folder
  CHECK(!parse_pack_path("a.drp/noext", &a, &s, &x));

  // Index: first (highest priority) pack wins; the game's name may carry its extension
  Index ix;
  ix.packs.resize(2);
  ix.packs[0].id = "hi";
  ix.packs[1].id = "lo";
  ix.add(0, "a.drp", "icon", ext_crc("nutexb"), "C:/hi/icon.nutexb");
  ix.add(1, "a.drp", "icon", ext_crc("nutexb"), "C:/lo/icon.nutexb");
  ix.add(1, "a.drp", "other", ext_crc("msbt"), "C:/lo/other.msbt");
  CHECK(ix.map.size() == 2 && ix.conflicts.size() == 1);
  const Override* o = ix.find("a.drp", "Icon", ext_crc("nutexb"));
  CHECK(o && o->pack == 0 && o->file == "C:/hi/icon.nutexb");
  CHECK(ix.find("a.drp", "Icon.nutexb", ext_crc("nutexb")) == o);          // stored name with extension
  CHECK(!ix.find("a.drp", "Icon", ext_crc("msbt")));                       // same name, other type
  CHECK(!ix.find("b.drp", "icon", ext_crc("nutexb")));                     // other archive
  CHECK(ix.find("a.drp", "OTHER", ext_crc("msbt")) != nullptr);

  // load(): mods.json order and enabled flags, pack.json, ignored files
  fs::path root = fs::temp_directory_path() / "snap_mods_test";
  fs::remove_all(root);
  write(root / "packA" / "pack.json", "{\"name\":\"Pack A\",\"version\":\"1.0\",\"author\":\"t\",\"description\":\"d\"}");
  write(root / "packA" / "common/UI/x.drp/icon.nutexb", "AAAA");
  write(root / "packB" / "pack.json", "{\"name\":\"Pack B\"}");
  write(root / "packB" / "common/UI/x.drp/icon.nutexb", "BBBB");
  write(root / "packB" / "common/UI/x.drp/menu.msbt", "MENU");
  write(root / "packB" / "readme.txt", "ignored");
  write(root / "packC" / "pack.json", "{}");
  write(root / "packC" / "common/UI/x.drp/off.msbt", "OFF");
  write(root / "mods.json", "{\"packs\":[{\"id\":\"packB\"},{\"id\":\"packA\",\"enabled\":true},{\"id\":\"packC\",\"enabled\":false},{\"id\":\"missing\"}]}");
  {
    Index i2;
    std::vector<std::string> w;
    load(root.string(), i2, w);
    CHECK(i2.packs.size() == 3 && i2.packs[0].name == "Pack B" && i2.packs[1].version == "1.0");
    CHECK(i2.map.size() == 2);   // icon (B wins), menu; packC disabled
    const Override* e = i2.find("common/ui/x.drp", "icon", ext_crc("nutexb"));
    CHECK(e && i2.packs[e->pack].id == "packB");
    CHECK(!i2.find("common/ui/x.drp", "off", ext_crc("msbt")));
    CHECK(w.size() == 1);        // "missing" folder
  }
  fs::remove(root / "mods.json");
  {
    Index i3;
    std::vector<std::string> w;
    load(root.string(), i3, w);   // no mods.json: name order, all with pack.json
    const Override* e = i3.find("common/ui/x.drp", "icon", ext_crc("nutexb"));
    CHECK(e && i3.packs[e->pack].id == "packA" && i3.map.size() == 3);
  }
  fs::remove_all(root);

  // Size override: the replacement chunk must pass the loader's raw-entry path (csize == dsize), its CRC check, and
  // may be larger than the original. Name "Icon" -> header 0x18 + 8 bytes.
  CHECK(chunk_header_len(4) == 0x18 + 8);
  CHECK(chunk_header_len(3) == 0x18 + 4);
  CHECK(chunk_header_len(7) == 0x18 + 8 && chunk_header_len(8) == 0x18 + 12);
  uint8_t orig[0x18 + 8 + 16] = {};
  uint32_t w0[6] = {0x1111u, 0x64736572u, 0x40u, ext_crc("nutexb"), 16u + 4u, 100u};   // an Oodle original: csize 20, dsize 100
  std::memcpy(orig, w0, sizeof w0);
  std::memcpy(orig + 0x18, "Icon", 5);
  std::vector<uint8_t> big(400);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < big.size(); i++) big[i] = (uint8_t)(i * 7 + 3);   // 4x the original's 100 bytes
  auto ch = build_chunk(orig, chunk_header_len(4), big.data(), big.size());
  uint32_t crc, magic, total, ecrc, csz, dsz;
  std::memcpy(&crc, &ch[0], 4); std::memcpy(&magic, &ch[4], 4); std::memcpy(&total, &ch[8], 4);
  std::memcpy(&ecrc, &ch[12], 4); std::memcpy(&csz, &ch[16], 4); std::memcpy(&dsz, &ch[20], 4);
  CHECK(magic == 0x64736572u && ecrc == ext_crc("nutexb"));
  CHECK(csz == 400 && dsz == 400);                               // raw path: memcpy(dst, payload, csize), dst sized dsize
  CHECK(total == ch.size() && ch.size() == 0x18 + 8 + 400);
  CHECK(crc == crc32(big.data(), big.size()));                   // the loader's check over dsize bytes
  CHECK(std::memcmp(&ch[0x18], "Icon", 5) == 0);                 // name kept
  size_t doff = 0x18 + ((std::strlen((const char*)&ch[0x18]) + 4) & ~(size_t)3);   // how the loader finds the payload
  CHECK(doff == chunk_header_len(4) && std::memcmp(&ch[doff], big.data(), big.size()) == 0);

  printf("%d checks, %d failed\n", g_n, g_fail);
  return g_fail ? 1 : 0;
}
```

```py
"""Unit tests for scripts/mods/make_override.py (path mapping). Run: python -I tests/mods/test_make_override.py"""
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "scripts" / "mods"))
import make_override as mo  # noqa: E402


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        self.ex = self.tmp / "extracted"
        (self.ex / "common/UI/master/Foo.drp").mkdir(parents=True)
        self.entry = self.ex / "common/UI/master/Foo.drp/icon_a.nutexb"
        self.entry.write_bytes(b"orig")
        self.rep = self.tmp / "new.nutexb"
        self.rep.write_bytes(b"x" * 400)

    def test_relpath(self):
        self.assertEqual(mo.mod_relpath(self.entry, self.ex), "common/UI/master/Foo.drp/icon_a.nutexb")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            mo.mod_relpath(self.ex / "common/UI/readme.txt", self.ex)

    def test_place(self):
        pack = self.tmp / "mods" / "p"
        dest, notes = mo.place(self.entry, self.rep, pack, self.ex)
        self.assertEqual(dest, pack / "common/UI/master/Foo.drp/icon_a.nutexb")
        self.assertEqual(dest.stat().st_size, 400)   # any size is accepted
        self.assertTrue((pack / "pack.json").exists())
        self.assertEqual(notes, [])

    def test_dup_and_ext_notes(self):
        e2 = self.ex / "common/UI/master/Foo.drp/icon__12.nutexb"
        e2.write_bytes(b"o")
        rep = self.tmp / "new.png"
        rep.write_bytes(b"p")
        _, notes = mo.place(e2, rep, self.tmp / "mods" / "q", self.ex, dry_run=True)
        self.assertEqual(len(notes), 2)
        self.assertFalse((self.tmp / "mods" / "q").exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/nvn/astc_compare.py`:

```py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Compares nvn_astc.cpp (ASTC LDR decode) with texture2ddecoder and measures the BC7 mode-6 transcode error.
#   python tests/nvn/astc_compare.py   (build first: tests\nvn\build_astc.bat)
import os, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
import texture2ddecoder as t2d
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..', '..'))
EXE = os.path.join(ROOT, 'build', 'nvn', 'astc_test.exe')
tmp = os.path.join(ROOT, 'build', 'nvn', 'astc_tmp'); os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
rng = np.random.default_rng(1234)
def psnr(a, b):
    mse = np.mean((a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64)) ** 2)
    return 99.0 if mse == 0 else 10 * np.log10(255.0 ** 2 / mse)
allok = True
for bw, bh in [(4, 4), (5, 5), (6, 6), (8, 8), (10, 8), (12, 12)]:
    W, H = bw * 32, bh * 32
    blocks = rng.integers(0, 256, size=(32 * 32, 16), dtype=np.uint8)
    # bias toward valid blocks: clear the void-extent/reserved patterns by forcing a plausible block mode
    
    path = os.path.join(tmp, 'b.bin'); blocks.tofile(path)
    ro = os.path.join(tmp, 'o.rgba'); bo = os.path.join(tmp, 'o.bc7')
    subprocess.run([EXE, path, str(W), str(H), str(bw), str(bh), '0', ro, bo], check=True, creationflags=0x4000)
    mine = np.fromfile(ro, np.uint8).reshape(H, W, 4)
    ref = np.frombuffer(t2d.decode_astc(blocks.tobytes(), W, H, bw, bh), np.uint8).reshape(H, W, 4)[..., [2, 1, 0, 3]]
    # nvn_astc.cpp rejects (magenta) blocks whose weight grid exceeds the block footprint, as the spec requires; texture2ddecoder
    # decodes those leniently, and HDR endpoint modes are magenta here (LDR decoder). Compare only blocks without any magenta pixel.
    mb = mine.reshape(H // bh, bh, W // bw, bw, 4).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(-1, bh * bw, 4)
    rb = ref.reshape(H // bh, bh, W // bw, bw, 4).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(-1, bh * bw, 4)
    valid = ~np.any(np.all(mb == np.array([255, 0, 255, 255]), axis=2), axis=1)   # no magenta pixel: LDR endpoints only
    d = np.abs(mb[valid].astype(int) - rb[valid].astype(int))
    exact = float((d.max(axis=2) == 0).mean()); close = float((d.max(axis=2) <= 1).mean())
    print('   valid blocks %d of %d' % (valid.sum(), len(valid)), end=' ')
    # BC7 transcode error against the decoded ASTC (independent BC7 decoder)
    bc7 = np.fromfile(bo, np.uint8).tobytes()
    dec = np.frombuffer(t2d.decode_bc7(bc7, W, H), np.uint8).reshape(H, W, 4)[..., [2, 1, 0, 3]]
    p = psnr(dec, mine)
    print('ASTC %dx%d: decode exact %.4f, within 1 level %.4f (max diff %d); BC7 mode-6 PSNR vs decoded %.1f dB' % (bw, bh, exact, close, d.max() if d.size else -1, p))
    allok &= close > 0.99
print('RESULT', 'ok' if allok else 'MISMATCH')
sys.exit(0 if allok else 1)

```

`tests/nvn/astc_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Host-only helper for tests/nvn/astc_compare.py: ASTC LDR decode (nvn_astc.cpp) and BC7 mode-6 encode (nvn_bc7.cpp) of
// raw data given on the command line. Usage: astc_test <blocks.bin> W H bw bh srgb <out_rgba.bin> <out_bc7.bin>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include "nvn_tex.h"
int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  if (argc < 9) return 2;
  FILE* f = fopen(argv[1], "rb"); if (!f) return 2;
  std::vector<unsigned char> in; unsigned char buf[4096]; size_t n;
  while ((n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) in.insert(in.end(), buf, buf + n);
  fclose(f);
  const unsigned W = atoi(argv[2]), H = atoi(argv[3]), bw = atoi(argv[4]), bh = atoi(argv[5]); const bool srgb = atoi(argv[6]) != 0;
  std::vector<unsigned char> rgba((size_t)W * H * 4), bc7(((W + 3) / 4) * ((H + 3) / 4) * 16);
  nvn::AstcDecodeLdr(in.data(), W, H, bw, bh, srgb, rgba.data());
  nvn::EncodeBc7(rgba.data(), W, H, bc7.data());
  f = fopen(argv[7], "wb"); fwrite(rgba.data(), 1, rgba.size(), f); fclose(f);
  f = fopen(argv[8], "wb"); fwrite(bc7.data(), 1, bc7.size(), f); fclose(f);
  return 0;
}
```

`tests/nvn/bmp2png.py`:

```py
"""Converts the 32-bit top-down BMP written by the NVN tests to PNG (no third-party modules).
Usage: python -I tests/nvn/bmp2png.py in.bmp out.png
"""
import struct
import sys
import zlib


def main(src, dst):
    d = open(src, "rb").read()
    off = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, 10)[0]
    w, h = struct.unpack_from("<ii", d, 18)
    bpp = struct.unpack_from("<H", d, 28)[0]
    assert bpp == 32, "expected a 32-bit BMP"
    top_down = h < 0
    h = abs(h)
    rows = []
    for y in range(h):
        sy = y if top_down else h - 1 - y
        row = d[off + sy * w * 4: off + (sy + 1) * w * 4]
        rgb = bytearray(w * 3)
        rgb[0::3] = row[2::4]
        rgb[1::3] = row[1::4]
        rgb[2::3] = row[0::4]
        rows.append(b"\x00" + bytes(rgb))
    raw = b"".join(rows)

    def chunk(t, body):
        c = struct.pack(">I", len(body)) + t + body
        return c + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t + body) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

    png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9)) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    open(dst, "wb").write(png)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
```

```cpp
static int g_missing = 0;
template <class F>
static void Load(F& dst, const char* name) {
  Proc p = nvnBootstrapLoader(name);
  if (!p) { fprintf(stderr, "MISSING NVN entry point %s\n", name); g_missing++; }
  dst = reinterpret_cast<F>(p);
}
#define LOAD(n) Load(n, "nvn" #n)

static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
  if (m == WM_CLOSE) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
  return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

static void SaveBmp(const char* path, const std::vector<unsigned char>& bgra, int w, int h) {
  BITMAPFILEHEADER fh{}; BITMAPINFOHEADER ih{};
  ih.biSize = sizeof ih; ih.biWidth = w; ih.biHeight = -h; ih.biPlanes = 1; ih.biBitCount = 32; ih.biCompression = BI_RGB;
  fh.bfType = 0x4d42; fh.bfOffBits = sizeof fh + sizeof ih; fh.bfSize = fh.bfOffBits + (DWORD)bgra.size();
  FILE* f = fopen(path, "wb");
  if (!f) return;
  fwrite(&fh, sizeof fh, 1, f); fwrite(&ih, sizeof ih, 1, f); fwrite(bgra.data(), 1, bgra.size(), f);
  fclose(f);
}

static float Srgb(float c) { return c <= 0.0031308f ? 12.92f * c : 1.055f * powf(c, 1.0f / 2.4f) - 0.055f; }

static void HsvToRgb(float h, float s, float v, float* o) {
  float c = v * s, x = c * (1 - fabsf(fmodf(h * 6.0f, 2.0f) - 1)), m = v - c, r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
  int i = (int)(h * 6.0f) % 6;
  switch (i) { case 0: r = c; g = x; break; case 1: r = x; g = c; break; case 2: g = c; b = x; break;
               case 3: g = x; b = c; break; case 4: r = x; b = c; break; default: r = c; b = x; }
  o[0] = r + m; o[1] = g + m; o[2] = b + m; o[3] = 1.0f;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  double pace = 60.0; int frames = 300; bool uncapped = false, validation = true, hidden = false; const char* shot = nullptr;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
    if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--frames") && i + 1 < argc) frames = atoi(argv[++i]);
    else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--uncapped")) uncapped = true;
    else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--no-validation")) validation = false;
    else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--pace") && i + 1 < argc) pace = atof(argv[++i]);
    else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--hidden")) hidden = true;
    else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--screenshot") && i + 1 < argc) shot = argv[++i];
  }
  SetProcessDPIAware();
  const int W = 1280, H = 720;

  // ---- window --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WNDCLASSW wc{}; wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc; wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr); wc.lpszClassName = L"NvnClearTest";
  wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
  RegisterClassW(&wc);
  RECT r{0, 0, W, H}; AdjustWindowRect(&r, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW & ~(WS_THICKFRAME | WS_MAXIMIZEBOX), FALSE);
  HWND hwnd = CreateWindowW(wc.lpszClassName, L"NVN clear test", (WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW & ~(WS_THICKFRAME | WS_MAXIMIZEBOX)) | WS_VISIBLE,
                            100, 100, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, nullptr, nullptr, wc.hInstance, nullptr);
  if (hidden) ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_HIDE);
  else SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 100, 100, 0, 0, SWP_NOSIZE);

  // ---- function table, as the lifted game would get it -----------------------------------------------------------
  if (validation) {
    nvnHostSetValidation(1);
    if (!getenv("VK_LAYER_PATH")) {
#ifdef NVN_TEST_LAYER_PATH
      _putenv("VK_LAYER_PATH=" NVN_TEST_LAYER_PATH);
#endif
    }
  }
  nvnHostSetFramePacing(pace);
  LOAD(DeviceGetProcAddress);
  Load(DeviceGetProcAddress, "nvnDeviceGetProcAddress");
  LOAD(DeviceInitialize); LOAD(DeviceBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(DeviceFinalize); LOAD(DeviceGetInteger);
  LOAD(DeviceSetWindowOriginMode); LOAD(DeviceSetDepthMode); LOAD(DeviceRegisterFastClearColor); LOAD(DeviceRegisterFastClearDepth);
  LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage);
  LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags); LOAD(MemoryPoolInitialize); LOAD(MemoryPoolSetDebugLabel); LOAD(MemoryPoolFinalize);
  LOAD(MemoryPoolMap); LOAD(MemoryPoolFlushMappedRange); LOAD(MemoryPoolGetSize);
  LOAD(QueueBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetFlags); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetCommandMemorySize);
  LOAD(QueueBuilderSetComputeMemorySize); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetControlMemorySize); LOAD(QueueInitialize); LOAD(QueueFinalize);
  LOAD(QueueSubmitCommands); LOAD(QueueFlush); LOAD(QueueFinish); LOAD(QueuePresentTexture); LOAD(QueueFenceSync);
  LOAD(SyncInitialize); LOAD(SyncFinalize); LOAD(SyncWait);
  LOAD(WindowBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(WindowBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(WindowBuilderSetNativeWindow); LOAD(WindowBuilderSetTextures);
  LOAD(WindowInitialize); LOAD(WindowFinalize); LOAD(WindowAcquireTexture); LOAD(WindowSetPresentInterval); LOAD(WindowSetCrop);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetFlags); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetTarget);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderSetSize2D); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetLevels); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetFormat); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetSamples);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderGetStorageSize); LOAD(TextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetStorage);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderGetFlags); LOAD(TextureInitialize); LOAD(TextureFinalize); LOAD(TextureGetWidth); LOAD(TextureGetHeight);
  LOAD(TextureGetFormat);
  LOAD(CommandBufferInitialize); LOAD(CommandBufferFinalize); LOAD(CommandBufferSetMemoryCallback);
  LOAD(CommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData); LOAD(CommandBufferAddCommandMemory); LOAD(CommandBufferAddControlMemory);
  LOAD(CommandBufferBeginRecording); LOAD(CommandBufferEndRecording); LOAD(CommandBufferIsRecording);
  LOAD(CommandBufferClearColor); LOAD(CommandBufferClearDepthStencil); LOAD(CommandBufferSetViewports);
  LOAD(CommandBufferSetScissors); LOAD(CommandBufferSetRenderTargets); LOAD(CommandBufferBarrier);
  if (g_missing) return 2;
  // Resolving through the device's getProcAddress must agree with the bootstrap loader.
  if (DeviceGetProcAddress(nullptr, "nvnDeviceInitialize") != (void*)DeviceInitialize) { fprintf(stderr, "getProcAddress mismatch\n"); return 2; }
  printf("registered NVN entry points: %d\n", nvnHostProcCount());

  // ---- Device (order from 0x90d590) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  static Obj device, queue, queue2, cmdbuf, window, fenceSync, acquireSync, cmdPool, dataPool, texPool[4];
  static Obj tex[3], depthTex, builderMem;
  unsigned char devBuilder[0x40]; memset(devBuilder, 0xCD, sizeof devBuilder);
  DeviceBuilderSetDefaults(devBuilder);
  if (!DeviceInitialize(&device, devBuilder)) { fprintf(stderr, "DeviceInitialize failed\n"); return 1; }
  int infos[0x60];
  for (int i = 0; i < 0x60; i++) DeviceGetInteger(&device, i, &infos[i]);   // the game dumps all 0x60 infos
  DeviceSetWindowOriginMode(&device, 1);   // upper left
  DeviceSetDepthMode(&device, 1);          // near is zero
  DeviceRegisterFastClearDepth(&device, 1.0f);
  const float fc[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
  DeviceRegisterFastClearColor(&device, fc, 0x38);
  printf("api %d.%d, cmd align %d, ctrl align %d, min ctrl %d, max viewports %d\n", infos[0], infos[1], infos[0x13], infos[0x14], infos[0x16], infos[0x26]);

  // ---- memory pools (command memory, plus a CPU-mapped data pool exercising the mirror) ------------------------------------
  unsigned char pb[0x40];
  const size_t cmdBytes = 0x200000;
  void* cmdMem = _aligned_malloc(cmdBytes, 0x1000);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0xa2); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, cmdMem, cmdBytes);
  if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&cmdPool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "cmd pool failed\n"); return 1; }
  MemoryPoolSetDebugLabel(&cmdPool, "command memory");
  const size_t dataBytes = 0x10000;
  void* dataMem = _aligned_malloc(dataBytes, 0x1000);
  memset(dataMem, 0x5A, dataBytes);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0xa2); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, dataMem, dataBytes);
  if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&dataPool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "data pool failed\n"); return 1; }
  if (MemoryPoolMap(&dataPool) != dataMem || MemoryPoolGetSize(&dataPool) != dataBytes) { fprintf(stderr, "pool map/size mismatch\n"); return 1; }
  ((unsigned char*)MemoryPoolMap(&dataPool))[0] = 0x77;
  MemoryPoolFlushMappedRange(&dataPool, 0, 256);   // creates the Vulkan mirror and uploads

  // ---- command buffer + queue (order from 0x90e47x..0x90e7xx) --------------------------------------------------------------
  if (!CommandBufferInitialize(&cmdbuf, &device)) { fprintf(stderr, "cb init failed\n"); return 1; }
  void* ctrlMem = _aligned_malloc(0x20000, 16);
  CommandBufferAddControlMemory(&cmdbuf, ctrlMem, 0x20000);
  CommandBufferAddCommandMemory(&cmdbuf, &cmdPool, 0, cmdBytes);
  CommandBufferSetMemoryCallback(&cmdbuf, [](void*, int, size_t, void*) {});
  CommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData(&cmdbuf, nullptr);
  unsigned char qb[0x40];
  QueueBuilderSetDefaults(qb); QueueBuilderSetDevice(qb, &device); QueueBuilderSetFlags(qb, 1);
  QueueBuilderSetComputeMemorySize(qb, 0x200000); QueueBuilderSetCommandMemorySize(qb, 0x200000); QueueBuilderSetControlMemorySize(qb, 0x20000);
  if (!QueueInitialize(&queue, qb)) { fprintf(stderr, "queue init failed\n"); return 1; }
  SyncInitialize(&fenceSync, &device);
  QueueBuilderSetDefaults(qb); QueueBuilderSetDevice(qb, &device); QueueBuilderSetFlags(qb, 3);
  if (!QueueInitialize(&queue2, qb)) { fprintf(stderr, "queue2 init failed\n"); return 1; }

  // ---- swapchain textures + window (order from 0x8f8510 and 0x985790) -------------------------------------------------------
  unsigned char tb[0x80];
  auto makeTex = [&](Obj& t, Obj& pool, int fmt, int flags) {
    TextureBuilderSetDefaults(tb); TextureBuilderSetFlags(tb, flags); TextureBuilderSetTarget(tb, 1);
    TextureBuilderSetFormat(tb, fmt); TextureBuilderSetSamples(tb, 0); TextureBuilderSetLevels(tb, 1);
    TextureBuilderSetDevice(tb, &device); TextureBuilderSetSize2D(tb, W, H);
    size_t sz = (TextureBuilderGetStorageSize(tb) + 0xfff) & ~(size_t)0xfff;
    (void)TextureBuilderGetStorageAlignment(tb);
    void* mem = _aligned_malloc(sz, 0x1000);
    MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
    MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0x2b /* cpu uncached | gpu no-access style flags are irrelevant here */); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, mem, sz);
    if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&pool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "tex pool failed\n"); exit(1); }
    TextureBuilderSetStorage(tb, &pool, 0);
    (void)TextureBuilderGetFlags(tb);
    if (!TextureInitialize(&t, tb)) { fprintf(stderr, "texture init failed\n"); exit(1); }
  };
  void* texPtrs[3];
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { makeTex(tex[i], texPool[i], 0x38 /*RGBA8_SRGB*/, 1 /*DISPLAY*/); texPtrs[i] = &tex[i]; }
  makeTex(depthTex, texPool[3], 0x35 /*DEPTH24_STENCIL8*/, 0);
  if (TextureGetWidth(&tex[0]) != W || TextureGetHeight(&tex[0]) != H || TextureGetFormat(&tex[0]) != 0x38) { fprintf(stderr, "texture getters wrong\n"); return 1; }

  unsigned char wb[0x40];
  WindowBuilderSetDefaults(wb); WindowBuilderSetDevice(wb, &device); WindowBuilderSetNativeWindow(wb, hwnd);
  WindowBuilderSetTextures(wb, 3, texPtrs);
  if (!WindowInitialize(&window, wb)) { fprintf(stderr, "WindowInitialize failed\n"); return 1; }
  WindowSetPresentInterval(&window, uncapped ? 0 : 1);
  WindowSetCrop(&window, 0, 0, W, H);
  SyncInitialize(&acquireSync, &device);
  int cur = 0;
  WindowAcquireTexture(&window, &acquireSync, &cur);
  SyncWait(&acquireSync, ~0ull);

  // ---- frame loop -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LARGE_INTEGER qf, t0; QueryPerformanceFrequency(&qf);
  std::vector<double> ft; ft.reserve(frames);
  Obj fences[2]; for (auto& f : fences) SyncInitialize(&f, &device);
  float lastColor[4] = {0, 0, 0, 1}; bool shotDone = false; int shotPixOk = -1; double shotErr = 0;
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
  LARGE_INTEGER prev = t0;
  bool quit = false;
  for (int f = 0; f < frames && !quit; f++) {
    MSG msg;
    while (PeekMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { if (msg.message == WM_QUIT) quit = true; TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageW(&msg); }
    float color[4];
    int hold = (f >= 150 && f < 170) ? 150 : f;            // freeze the color for the screenshot check
    HsvToRgb(fmodf(hold / 300.0f * 2.0f, 1.0f), 0.8f, 0.9f, color);
    memcpy(lastColor, color, sizeof color);

    if (CommandBufferIsRecording(&cmdbuf)) { fprintf(stderr, "cb already recording\n"); return 1; }
    CommandBufferBeginRecording(&cmdbuf);
    void* rt[1] = {&tex[cur]};
    CommandBufferSetRenderTargets(&cmdbuf, 1, rt, nullptr, &depthTex, nullptr);
    const float vp[4] = {0, 0, (float)W, (float)H}; const int sc[4] = {0, 0, W, H};
    CommandBufferSetViewports(&cmdbuf, 0, 1, vp);
    CommandBufferSetScissors(&cmdbuf, 0, 1, sc);
    CommandBufferClearColor(&cmdbuf, 0, color, 0xf);
    CommandBufferClearDepthStencil(&cmdbuf, 1.0f, 1, 0, 0xff);
    CommandBufferBarrier(&cmdbuf, 0x28);
    Handle h = CommandBufferEndRecording(&cmdbuf);
    QueueSubmitCommands(&queue, 1, &h);
    QueueFenceSync(&queue, &fences[f & 1], 0, 0);
    QueueFlush(&queue);
    QueuePresentTexture(&queue, &window, cur);
    WindowAcquireTexture(&window, &acquireSync, &cur);
    SyncWait(&acquireSync, ~0ull);
    SyncWait(&fences[(f + 1) & 1], ~0ull);   // fence of the previous frame

    if (shot && !shotDone && f == 160 && !hidden) {
      Sleep(100);   // let DWM catch up with the held color
      POINT p{0, 0}; ClientToScreen(hwnd, &p);
      HDC sdc = GetDC(nullptr), mdc = CreateCompatibleDC(sdc);
      HBITMAP bm = CreateCompatibleBitmap(sdc, W, H); SelectObject(mdc, bm);
      BitBlt(mdc, 0, 0, W, H, sdc, p.x, p.y, SRCCOPY);
      BITMAPINFO bi{}; bi.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), W, -H, 1, 32, BI_RGB};
      std::vector<unsigned char> px((size_t)W * H * 4);
      GetDIBits(mdc, bm, 0, H, px.data(), &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS);
      SaveBmp(shot, px, W, H);
      const unsigned char* c = &px[((size_t)(H / 2) * W + W / 2) * 4];   // BGRA
      float held[4]; HsvToRgb(fmodf(150 / 300.0f * 2.0f, 1.0f), 0.8f, 0.9f, held);
      double e = 0;
      for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) e = std::max(e, fabs(Srgb(held[k]) * 255.0 - (double)c[2 - k]));
      shotErr = e; shotPixOk = e <= 3.0 ? 1 : 0; shotDone = true;
      DeleteObject(bm); DeleteDC(mdc); ReleaseDC(nullptr, sdc);
    }
    LARGE_INTEGER now; QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    ft.push_back((double)(now.QuadPart - prev.QuadPart) * 1000.0 / qf.QuadPart);
    prev = now;
  }
  LARGE_INTEGER t1; QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
  QueueFinish(&queue);

  // ---- frame statistics (skip the first 10 frames) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  std::vector<double> s(ft.begin() + std::min<size_t>(10, ft.size() ? ft.size() - 1 : 0), ft.end());
  std::sort(s.begin(), s.end());
  double sum = 0; for (double v : s) sum += v;
  auto pct = [&](double p) { return s.empty() ? 0.0 : s[std::min(s.size() - 1, (size_t)(p * s.size()))]; };
  { DEVMODEW dm{}; dm.dmSize = sizeof dm; EnumDisplaySettingsW(nullptr, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm); printf("display refresh: %lu Hz\n", dm.dmDisplayFrequency); }
  printf("mode=%s frames=%zu avg=%.3f ms (%.1f fps) p50=%.3f p99=%.3f max=%.3f min=%.3f\n", uncapped ? "uncapped" : (pace > 0 ? "vsync+limiter" : "vsync(display-paced)"),
         ft.size(), sum / std::max<size_t>(1, s.size()), 1000.0 / std::max(1e-9, sum / std::max<size_t>(1, s.size())),
         pct(0.5), pct(0.99), s.empty() ? 0 : s.back(), s.empty() ? 0 : s.front());
  if (shot) printf("screenshot=%s center-pixel-check=%s (max channel error %.2f/255 vs sRGB-encoded clear color)\n", shot,
                   shotPixOk == 1 ? "PASS" : (shotPixOk == 0 ? "FAIL" : "n/a"), shotErr);

  // ---- teardown in the game's order (0x90f550) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  for (auto& f : fences) SyncFinalize(&f);
  SyncFinalize(&acquireSync); SyncFinalize(&fenceSync);
  WindowFinalize(&window);
  for (auto& t : tex) TextureFinalize(&t);
  TextureFinalize(&depthTex);
  for (auto& p : texPool) MemoryPoolFinalize(&p);
  QueueFinalize(&queue2); QueueFinalize(&queue);
  CommandBufferFinalize(&cmdbuf);
  MemoryPoolFinalize(&dataPool); MemoryPoolFinalize(&cmdPool);
  DeviceFinalize(&device);
  DestroyWindow(hwnd);
  unsigned errs = nvnHostValidationErrors(), warns = nvnHostValidationWarnings();
  printf("validation: errors=%u warnings=%u (layers %s)\n", errs, warns, validation ? "on" : "off");
  return (errs || (shotPixOk == 0)) ? 1 : 0;
}

```

`tests/nvn/linear_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Regression test for the two first-screen rendering bugs of the NVN->Vulkan layer. No game data involved.
//
//  1. Window origin: nvn::MakeNvnViewport maps NVN viewports to Vulkan. The game selects UPPER_LEFT; NVN keeps NDC +y up
//     in both origin modes (OpenGL clip control), so UPPER_LEFT must use a negative-height Vulkan viewport. Checked
//     numerically with the Vulkan viewport transform, including a render-target scale.
//  2. Pitch-linear textures (TF_LINEAR with a row stride): the game's glyph atlases are R8, linear, 512 x 2048 and
//     rewritten by the CPU after creation. The layer must (a) read them row by row with the stride, not as Maxwell
//     block-linear data, and (b) re-upload them when the guest memory changes. Checked through the NVN entry points
//     (TextureBuilderSetStride, CopyTextureToBuffer read-back), including a stride larger than the width.
//
// Usage: linear_test.exe [--no-validation]      exit code 0 = all checks passed
#define NOMINMAX
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "nvn_host.h"
#include "nvn_internal.h"

struct Obj { alignas(16) unsigned char raw[0x3000]; };
using Proc = void (*)(void);
using Boolean = unsigned char;
using Handle = unsigned long long;
using Addr = unsigned long long;
struct CopyRegion { int x, y, z, w, h, d; };

#define PROC(ret, name, args) static ret(*name) args
PROC(Boolean, DeviceInitialize, (void*, const void*));
PROC(void, DeviceBuilderSetDefaults, (void*));
PROC(void, DeviceSetWindowOriginMode, (void*, int));
PROC(void, DeviceSetDepthMode, (void*, int));
PROC(void, MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice, (void*, void*));
PROC(void, MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults, (void*));
PROC(void, MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage, (void*, void*, size_t));
PROC(void, MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags, (void*, int));
PROC(Boolean, MemoryPoolInitialize, (void*, const void*));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetDevice, (void*, void*));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetDefaults, (void*));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetFlags, (void*, int));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetCommandMemorySize, (void*, size_t));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetComputeMemorySize, (void*, size_t));
PROC(void, QueueBuilderSetControlMemorySize, (void*, size_t));
PROC(Boolean, QueueInitialize, (void*, const void*));
PROC(void, QueueSubmitCommands, (void*, int, const Handle*));
PROC(void, QueueFinish, (void*));
PROC(void, QueueFenceSync, (void*, void*, int, int));
PROC(Boolean, SyncInitialize, (void*, void*));

PROC(size_t, TextureBuilderGetStorageSize, (const void*));
PROC(void, TextureBuilderSetStorage, (void*, void*, ptrdiff_t));
PROC(Boolean, TextureInitialize, (void*, const void*));
PROC(Boolean, CommandBufferInitialize, (void*, void*));
PROC(void, CommandBufferSetMemoryCallback, (void*, void (*)(void*, int, size_t, void*)));
PROC(void, CommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData, (void*, void*));

PROC(Boolean, BufferInitialize, (void*, const void*));
PROC(void*, BufferMap, (const void*));
PROC(Addr, BufferGetAddress, (const void*));

static int g_missing = 0, g_fail = 0;
template <class F> static void Load(F& dst, const char* name) {
  Proc p = nvnBootstrapLoader(name);
  if (!p) { fprintf(stderr, "MISSING NVN entry point %s\n", name); g_missing++; }
  dst = reinterpret_cast<F>(p);
}
#define LOAD(n) Load(n, "nvn" #n)
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { g_fail++; printf("FAIL: "); printf(__VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } } while (0)

// Vulkan viewport transform of NDC y to a framebuffer row: y_f = (h/2) * y_ndc + (y + h/2)
static float RowOf(const VkViewport& v, float ndcY) { return (v.height * 0.5f) * ndcY + (v.y + v.height * 0.5f); }

static void TestViewport() {
  // UPPER_LEFT: NDC +1 is the first row of the rectangle (image top), NDC -1 the row below its last row.
  VkViewport u = nvn::MakeNvnViewport(nvn::ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT, 10, 20, 100, 50);
  CHECK(u.height < 0, "UPPER_LEFT viewport must have a negative height (NDC +y up), got %g", u.height);
  CHECK(std::fabs(RowOf(u, +1) - 20) < 1e-4f, "UPPER_LEFT: NDC +1 -> row %g, expected 20 (top of the rectangle)", RowOf(u, +1));
  CHECK(std::fabs(RowOf(u, -1) - 70) < 1e-4f, "UPPER_LEFT: NDC -1 -> row %g, expected 70 (bottom of the rectangle)", RowOf(u, -1));
  CHECK(u.x == 10 && u.width == 100, "UPPER_LEFT x/width unchanged");
  // render-target scale (nvnHostSetRenderScale) multiplies everything, the flip survives it
  VkViewport s = nvn::MakeNvnViewport(nvn::ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT, 10, 20, 100, 50, 2.0f);
  CHECK(std::fabs(RowOf(s, +1) - 40) < 1e-4f && std::fabs(RowOf(s, -1) - 140) < 1e-4f, "scaled UPPER_LEFT rows %g..%g, expected 40..140", RowOf(s, +1), RowOf(s, -1));
  // full-target default viewport (1920x1080): +1 -> row 0, -1 -> row 1080
  VkViewport f = nvn::MakeNvnViewport(nvn::ORIGIN_UPPER_LEFT, 0, 0, 1920, 1080);
  CHECK(RowOf(f, +1) == 0 && RowOf(f, -1) == 1080, "full viewport rows %g..%g", RowOf(f, +1), RowOf(f, -1));
  // LOWER_LEFT: rows count from the window origin, NDC -1 is the first row (image bottom), no flip.
  VkViewport l = nvn::MakeNvnViewport(nvn::ORIGIN_LOWER_LEFT, 10, 20, 100, 50);
  CHECK(l.height > 0 && std::fabs(RowOf(l, -1) - 20) < 1e-4f && std::fabs(RowOf(l, +1) - 70) < 1e-4f,
        "LOWER_LEFT: NDC -1 -> row %g (expected 20), +1 -> %g (expected 70)", RowOf(l, -1), RowOf(l, +1));
  printf("viewport origin mapping: %s\n", g_fail ? "FAIL" : "ok");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  bool validation = true;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--no-validation")) validation = false;
  TestViewport();

  if (validation) {
    nvnHostSetValidation(1);
    if (!getenv("VK_LAYER_PATH")) {
#ifdef NVN_TEST_LAYER_PATH
      _putenv("VK_LAYER_PATH=" NVN_TEST_LAYER_PATH);
#endif
    }
  }
  LOAD(DeviceInitialize); LOAD(DeviceBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(DeviceSetWindowOriginMode); LOAD(DeviceSetDepthMode);
  LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage); LOAD(MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags);
  LOAD(MemoryPoolInitialize);
  LOAD(QueueBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetFlags); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetCommandMemorySize);
  LOAD(QueueBuilderSetComputeMemorySize); LOAD(QueueBuilderSetControlMemorySize); LOAD(QueueInitialize); LOAD(QueueSubmitCommands);
  LOAD(QueueFinish); LOAD(QueueFenceSync); LOAD(SyncInitialize); LOAD(SyncWait);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetFlags); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetTarget);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderSetSize2D); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetLevels); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetFormat); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetSamples);
  LOAD(TextureBuilderSetStride); LOAD(TextureBuilderGetStorageSize); LOAD(TextureBuilderSetStorage); LOAD(TextureInitialize);
  LOAD(CommandBufferInitialize); LOAD(CommandBufferSetMemoryCallback); LOAD(CommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData);
  LOAD(CommandBufferAddCommandMemory); LOAD(CommandBufferAddControlMemory); LOAD(CommandBufferBeginRecording);
  LOAD(CommandBufferEndRecording); LOAD(CommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer);
  LOAD(BufferBuilderSetDevice); LOAD(BufferBuilderSetDefaults); LOAD(BufferBuilderSetStorage); LOAD(BufferInitialize);
  LOAD(BufferMap); LOAD(BufferGetAddress);
  if (g_missing) return 2;

  static Obj device, queue, cmdbuf, fence, cmdPool, rbPool, rbBuf, texPool, tex;
  unsigned char devBuilder[0x40]; memset(devBuilder, 0xCD, sizeof devBuilder);
  DeviceBuilderSetDefaults(devBuilder);
  if (!DeviceInitialize(&device, devBuilder)) { fprintf(stderr, "DeviceInitialize failed\n"); return 1; }
  DeviceSetWindowOriginMode(&device, 1); DeviceSetDepthMode(&device, 1);

  unsigned char pb[0x40];
  const size_t cmdBytes = 0x200000, rbBytes = 4u << 20;
  void* cmdMem = _aligned_malloc(cmdBytes, 0x1000);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0xa2); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, cmdMem, cmdBytes);
  if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&cmdPool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "cmd pool failed\n"); return 1; }
  void* rbMem = _aligned_malloc(rbBytes, 0x1000);
  memset(rbMem, 0xEE, rbBytes);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0xa2); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, rbMem, rbBytes);
  if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&rbPool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "readback pool failed\n"); return 1; }
  unsigned char bb[0x40];
  BufferBuilderSetDefaults(bb); BufferBuilderSetDevice(bb, &device); BufferBuilderSetStorage(bb, &rbPool, 0, rbBytes);
  if (!BufferInitialize(&rbBuf, bb)) { fprintf(stderr, "readback buffer failed\n"); return 1; }
  const Addr rbAddr = BufferGetAddress(&rbBuf);
  if (!CommandBufferInitialize(&cmdbuf, &device)) { fprintf(stderr, "cb init failed\n"); return 1; }
  void* ctrlMem = _aligned_malloc(0x20000, 16);
  CommandBufferAddControlMemory(&cmdbuf, ctrlMem, 0x20000);
  CommandBufferAddCommandMemory(&cmdbuf, &cmdPool, 0, cmdBytes);
  CommandBufferSetMemoryCallback(&cmdbuf, [](void*, int, size_t, void*) {});
  CommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData(&cmdbuf, nullptr);
  unsigned char qb[0x40];
  QueueBuilderSetDefaults(qb); QueueBuilderSetDevice(qb, &device); QueueBuilderSetFlags(qb, 1);
  QueueBuilderSetComputeMemorySize(qb, 0x200000); QueueBuilderSetCommandMemorySize(qb, 0x200000); QueueBuilderSetControlMemorySize(qb, 0x20000);
  if (!QueueInitialize(&queue, qb)) { fprintf(stderr, "queue init failed\n"); return 1; }
  SyncInitialize(&fence, &device);

  // Linear R8 texture, 40 x 24 texels, stride 64 bytes (> width), in a CPU-writable pool (flags like the game's data pools).
  const int W = 40, H = 24, STRIDE = 64, R8 = 1, TF_LINEAR = 0x10;
  const size_t poolBytes = 0x10000;
  uint8_t* mem = static_cast<uint8_t*>(_aligned_malloc(poolBytes, 0x1000));
  memset(mem, 0xAA, poolBytes);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetDefaults(pb); MemoryPoolBuilderSetDevice(pb, &device);
  MemoryPoolBuilderSetFlags(pb, 0xa2); MemoryPoolBuilderSetStorage(pb, mem, poolBytes);
  if (!MemoryPoolInitialize(&texPool, pb)) { fprintf(stderr, "texture pool failed\n"); return 1; }
  const ptrdiff_t texOff = 0x1000;
  unsigned char tb[0x80];
  TextureBuilderSetDefaults(tb); TextureBuilderSetDevice(tb, &device); TextureBuilderSetFlags(tb, TF_LINEAR); TextureBuilderSetTarget(tb, 1);
  TextureBuilderSetFormat(tb, R8); TextureBuilderSetSamples(tb, 0); TextureBuilderSetLevels(tb, 1); TextureBuilderSetSize2D(tb, W, H);
  TextureBuilderSetStride(tb, STRIDE);
  const size_t need = TextureBuilderGetStorageSize(tb);
  CHECK(need >= (size_t)STRIDE * H, "linear storage size %zu < stride * height %d", need, STRIDE * H);
  TextureBuilderSetStorage(tb, &texPool, texOff);
  if (!TextureInitialize(&tex, tb)) { fprintf(stderr, "TextureInitialize failed\n"); return 1; }

  auto fill = [&](unsigned seed) {
    for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
      for (int x = 0; x < STRIDE; x++) mem[texOff + (size_t)y * STRIDE + x] = x < W ? (uint8_t)((x * 7 + y * 13 + seed) & 0xFF) : 0xAA;
  };
  auto readback = [&](std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    memset(rbMem, 0xEE, 4096);
    CommandBufferBeginRecording(&cmdbuf);
    CopyRegion r{0, 0, 0, W, H, 1};
    CommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer(&cmdbuf, &tex, nullptr, &r, rbAddr, 0);
    Handle h = CommandBufferEndRecording(&cmdbuf);
    QueueSubmitCommands(&queue, 1, &h);
    QueueFenceSync(&queue, &fence, 0, 0);
    SyncWait(&fence, ~0ull);
    QueueFinish(&queue);
    out.assign(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(BufferMap(&rbBuf)), static_cast<const uint8_t*>(BufferMap(&rbBuf)) + (size_t)W * H);
  };
  auto verify = [&](const char* what, unsigned seed) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> got; readback(got);
    int bad = 0, first = -1;
    for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
      for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
        if (got[(size_t)y * W + x] != (uint8_t)((x * 7 + y * 13 + seed) & 0xFF)) { if (first < 0) first = y * W + x; bad++; }
    CHECK(bad == 0, "%s: %d of %d texels differ (first at %d: got %u)", what, bad, W * H, first, first >= 0 ? got[first] : 0u);
    printf("%s: %s\n", what, bad ? "FAIL" : "ok");
  };

  fill(0);
  verify("linear R8 with stride > width, first upload", 0);
  fill(77);                                   // the CPU rewrites the atlas (new glyphs) between submits
  verify("linear R8 after a CPU rewrite (re-upload)", 77);
  verify("linear R8 unchanged (no spurious change)", 77);

  const unsigned errs = nvnHostValidationErrors(), warns = nvnHostValidationWarnings();
  printf("validation: errors=%u warnings=%u%s\n", errs, warns, validation ? "" : " (layers off)");
  if (g_fail || errs) { printf("linear_test: FAIL (%d)\n", g_fail); return 1; }
  printf("linear_test: PASS\n");
  return 0;
}

```

```cpp
  dst = reinterpret_cast<F>(p);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
  if (m == WM_CLOSE) { PostQuitMessage(0); return 0; }
  return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
```
