HOT = (0x5bd940, 0x59ab20)

OUT = ROOT / 'analysis' / 'recomp'
GEN = ROOT / 'generated' / ('subset' if MODNAME == 'main' else 'subset_sdk')
BLD = ROOT / 'build' / ('subset' if MODNAME == 'main' else 'subset_sdk')
if MODNAME == 'sdk':
    OUT = OUT / 'sdk_diff'


def peak_rss_mb():
    """Peak working set of this process in MB (Windows)."""
    import ctypes
    from ctypes import wintypes as wt

    class PMC(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('cb', wt.DWORD), ('PageFaultCount', wt.DWORD), ('PeakWorkingSetSize', ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ('WorkingSetSize', ctypes.c_size_t), ('a', ctypes.c_size_t), ('b', ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ('c', ctypes.c_size_t), ('d', ctypes.c_size_t), ('PagefileUsage', ctypes.c_size_t),
                    ('PeakPagefileUsage', ctypes.c_size_t)]
    pmc = PMC()
    pmc.cb = ctypes.sizeof(pmc)
    k = ctypes.windll.kernel32
    k.GetCurrentProcess.restype = wt.HANDLE
    ps = ctypes.WinDLL('psapi')
    ps.GetProcessMemoryInfo.argtypes = [wt.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(PMC), wt.DWORD]
    ps.GetProcessMemoryInfo(k.GetCurrentProcess(), ctypes.byref(pmc), pmc.cb)
    return round(pmc.PeakWorkingSetSize / 1e6)


def splitmix(z):
    z = (z + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15) & M64
    z = ((z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9) & M64
    z = ((z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB) & M64
    return z ^ (z >> 31)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ selection

def call_mask(w):
    return ((w & 0xFC000000) == 0x94000000) | ((w & 0xFFFFFC1F) == 0xD63F0000)   # BL, BLR


def forbidden_mask(w):
    """Words a picked function must not contain: exceptions, system registers (except hints and barriers), LSE."""
    m = (w & 0xFF000000) == 0xD4000000                    # SVC, HVC, SMC, BRK, HLT, DCPS
    sysi = (w & 0xFFC00000) == 0xD5000000                 # MRS, MSR, SYS (DC ZVA), hints, barriers
    hint_or_barrier = ((w & 0xFFFFF000) == 0xD5032000) | ((w & 0xFFFFF000) == 0xD5033000)
    m |= sysi & ~hint_or_barrier
    m |= (w & 0x3F200C00) == 0x38200000                   # LSE atomics (none in main; kept for safety)
    return m


def llsc_mask(w):
    fam = (w & 0x3F000000) == 0x08000000                  # exclusives and load-acquire/store-release
    return fam & (((w >> 23) & 1) == 0)                   # o2 = 0: LDXR/LDAXR/STXR/STLXR/LDXP/STXP family


def cond_mask(w):
    return (((w & 0xFE000010) == 0x54000000) | ((w & 0x7E000000) == 0x34000000) | ((w & 0x7E000000) == 0x36000000))


def simd_mask(w):
    return ((w & 0x0E000000) == 0x0E000000) | (((w & 0x0A000000) == 0x08000000) & (((w >> 26) & 1) == 1))


def call_sites(mod, entry, end):
    return [a for a in range(entry, end, 4) if mod.lift(a).kind in ('bl', 'blr')]


def callees(emitter, entry, end):
    mod = emitter.mod
    out = {mod.lift(a).target for a in call_sites(mod, entry, end)
           if mod.lift(a).kind == 'bl' and mod.lift(a).target in emitter.starts}
    for a in range(entry, end, 4):   # tail calls: direct branches out of the function to another start
        i = mod.lift(a)
        if i.kind in ('b', 'bcond') and not entry <= i.target < end and i.target in emitter.starts:
            out.add(i.target)
    return out


def check_function(emitter, entry, end):
    """Tags of a function the test can run in isolation, or None."""
    mod = emitter.mod
    insns = [mod.lift(a) for a in range(entry, end, 4)]
    if insns[-1].kind not in gen.TERMINATORS or not any(i.kind in ('ret', 'b', 'bcond') for i in insns):
        return None
    tags = set()
    for k, ins in enumerate(insns):
        a = entry + 4 * k
        if ins.kind in ('bl', 'blr'):
            tags.add('calls')
        if ins.kind in ('b', 'bcond'):
            if not entry <= ins.target < end:
                if ins.target not in emitter.starts:
                    return None
                tags.add('tail_call')   # emitted as a musttail call of a stub; Unicorn side stubs it at the block hook
            elif ins.target <= a:
                tags.add('loop')
        if ins.kind == 'br':
            jt = gen.jumptables.resolve(mod, a, entry, end)
            if jt:
                tags.add('jump_table')
            elif gen.jumptables.is_computed(mod, a, entry):
                tags.add('all_label_fallback')
            else:
                return None
        if ins.kind == 'trap':
            tags.add('trap')
    w = mod.words[(entry - mod.lo) >> 2:(end - mod.lo) >> 2]
    if simd_mask(w).any():
        tags.add('simd')
    if llsc_mask(w).any():
        tags.add('atomic')
    return tags


# About a third of the picks cannot be run under Unicorn with random inputs (they dereference values the random state does
# not make valid), so the quotas are 1.5x the ~300 functions the test aims to run; untested picks are still lifted,
# compiled and linked, and reported as `untested`.
QUOTA = [('nvn', 12), ('hot', 2), ('atomic', 75), ('jump_table', 60), ('fp_simd', 90), ('leaf_int', 80), ('calls', 70),
         ('loops', 70)]


def pick_functions(mod, starts_abs, count, r, extra=()):
    """Deterministic subset: [(entry, end, category, tags)] in address order plus the Emitter."""
    w = mod.words
    if MODNAME == 'sdk':
        import snap_gen
        fns = [(s, e) for s, e in snap_gen.sdk_plan()[0]]
    else:
        fns = [(s, e) for s, e, k, _ in functions() if k in ('function', 'thunk')]
    theirs = sorted(starts_abs)
    emitter = gen.Emitter(mod, set(starts_abs))
    ws = lambda mask: np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(mask.astype(np.int64))])
    cs_forb, cs_cond, cs_call = ws(forbidden_mask(w)), ws(cond_mask(w)), ws(call_mask(w))
    cs_ll, cs_simd = ws(llsc_mask(w)), ws(simd_mask(w))
    cs_br = ws((w & 0xFFFFFC1F) == 0xD61F0000)

    def rng(cs, s, e):
        return int(cs[e >> 2] - cs[s >> 2])

    import bisect
    jt_rows = tsv(MAPS / 'jump_tables.tsv') if MODNAME == 'main' else []
    jt_fn = {int(x['function'], 16) for x in jt_rows if x['class'] == 'jump_table'}
    nvn_fn = ({int(x['function'], 16) for x in tsv(MAPS / 'nvn_procs.tsv') if x['function'].startswith('0x')} - set(NVN_LOADERS)) if MODNAME == 'main' else set()
    pools = {k: [] for k, _ in QUOTA}
    feats = {}
    for s, e in fns:
        n = (e - s) // 4
        # a generator start strictly inside the function (the 6 functions it splits) is skipped
        i = bisect.bisect_right(theirs, BASE + s)
        if i < len(theirs) and theirs[i] < BASE + e:
            continue
        big = s in NVN_LOADERS or s in HOT
        if rng(cs_forb, s, e) or not (MIN_INSNS <= n <= (BIG_INSNS if big else MAX_INSNS)):
            continue
        calls, ll, simd, br = rng(cs_call, s, e), rng(cs_ll, s, e), rng(cs_simd, s, e), rng(cs_br, s, e)
        feats[s] = (n, calls, ll, simd, br)
        if s in NVN_LOADERS or s in HOT or s in nvn_fn:
            pools['nvn' if s not in HOT else 'hot'].append(s)
        if ll:
            pools['atomic'].append(s)
        if s in jt_fn:
            pools['jump_table'].append(s)
        if simd and simd / n >= 0.30 and n >= 10:
            pools['fp_simd'].append(s)
        if not calls and not simd and not br and not ll:
            pools['leaf_int'].append(s)
        if calls and not simd and not ll and not br:
            pools['calls'].append(s)
        if rng(cs_cond, s, e):
            pools['loops'].append(s)
    picks, seen, out_ = [], set(), []
    end_of = dict(fns)
    for cat, quota in QUOTA:
        pool = sorted(set(pools[cat]))
        if cat == 'nvn':
            first = [s for s in NVN_LOADERS if s in pool]
            rest = [s for s in pool if s not in first]
            r.shuffle(rest)
            pool = first + rest
        elif cat == 'hot':
            pool = [s for s in HOT if s in pool]
        else:
            r.shuffle(pool)
        taken = 0
        for s in pool:
            if taken >= quota or len(picks) >= count:
                break
            if s in seen:
                continue
            entry, end = BASE + s, BASE + end_of[s]
            tags = check_function(emitter, entry, end)
            if tags is None or (cat == 'loops' and 'loop' not in tags):
                continue
            seen.add(s)
            out_.append((entry, end, cat, tags))
            picks.append(s)
            taken += 1
    out = out_
    for s_ in extra:   # forced picks (category jt_check)
        if s_ in end_of and s_ not in seen:
            tags = check_function(emitter, BASE + s_, BASE + end_of[s_])
            if tags is not None:
                seen.add(s_)
                out_.append((BASE + s_, BASE + end_of[s_], 'jt_check', tags))
    out = out_
    # drop callers of another pick (the C side would run that callee instead of the stub)
    picked = {e for e, _, _, _ in out}
    dropped = [o for o in out if callees(emitter, o[0], o[1]) & picked]
    out = sorted(o for o in out if o not in dropped)
    # callers of a picked function can run only where that function is a stub, so a function that calls itself (recursion)
    # or another deferred function cannot be tested here
    dset = {o[0] for o in dropped}
    unrunnable = [o for o in dropped if callees(emitter, o[0], o[1]) & dset]
    dropped = [o for o in dropped if o not in unrunnable]
    # callers of another pick go last, into a chunk and a harness executable of their own, where their picked callees
    # are stubs (0x910270 calls both NVN loaders)
    return out + sorted(dropped), emitter, {k: len(v) for k, v in pools.items()}, len(out)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ build

def compile_all(srcs, work, jobs, cflags):
    cc = compiler()
    flags = ['-O1', '-fno-strict-aliasing', '-Wno-return-type', '-Wno-unused-label', '-Wno-unused-value', '-w', '-I',
             str(ROOT / 'runtime')] + cflags.split()
    objs, running, fails = [], [], []
    todo = list(srcs)
    t0 = time.time()
    while todo or running:
        while todo and len(running) < jobs:
            s = todo.pop(0)
            o = work / (s.stem + '.o')
            objs.append(o)
            errf = open(work / (s.stem + '.err'), 'wb')
            running.append((s, subprocess.Popen([cc] + flags + ['-c', str(s), '-o', str(o)], stderr=errf)))
        for item in list(running):
            if item[1].poll() is not None:
                running.remove(item)
                if item[1].returncode:
                    fails.append((item[0].name, (work / (item[0].stem + '.err')).read_bytes().decode(errors='replace')[-1500:]))
        time.sleep(0.05)
    if fails:
        for n, e in fails[:3]:
            print('COMPILE FAIL', n, e)
        raise SystemExit('compile failed')
    return objs, time.time() - t0


def link(cc, exe, objs):
    subprocess.check_call([cc, '-fuse-ld=lld', '-o', str(exe)] + [str(o) for o in objs])


def plt_names():
    if MODNAME != 'main':
        return {}
    return {int(r['start'], 16): r['notes'].replace('import:', '') for r in tsv(MAPS / 'functions_final.tsv')
            if r['kind'] == 'plt_stub' and r['notes'].startswith('import:')}


def emit_subset(emitter, picks, nmain, jobs, chunk_fns):
    """Writes generated/subset/subset_NNN.c; returns (files, seconds, referenced prototypes)."""
    GEN.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in GEN.glob('*.c'):
        f.unlink()
    t0 = time.time()
    files, refs, n = [], set(), max(1, chunk_fns)
    jobs_ = [(f'subset_{j // n:03d}.c', j // n, picks[j:min(j + n, nmain)]) for j in range(0, nmain, n)]
    if len(picks) > nmain:
        jobs_.append(('subset_defer.c', 999, picks[nmain:]))
    for name, num, grp in jobs_:
        text = gen.chunk_text('subset', num, emitter, [(e, en) for e, en, _, _ in grp])
        p = GEN / name
        p.write_text(text)
        files.append(p)
        refs |= set(re.findall(r'^void (f_[0-9a-f]+)\(Cpu \*c\);$', text, re.M))
    return files, time.time() - t0, refs


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--functions', type=int, default=460)
    ap.add_argument('--cases', type=int, default=12, help='random states tried per function')
    ap.add_argument('--retry-untested', type=int, default=36, help='extra random states for a function with no accepted case')
    ap.add_argument('--steps', type=int, default=200000, help='Unicorn instruction cap per case')
    ap.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument('--chunk-fns', type=int, default=25)
    ap.add_argument('--cflags', default='-march=x86-64-v3')
    ap.add_argument('--mutate', type=int, default=0, help='self-test: corrupt one operation in N emitted functions')
    ap.add_argument('--add', default='', help='comma list of hex entry offsets to add as forced picks')
    ap.add_argument('--jt-source', choices=('map', 'generator'), default='map', help='jump table targets: the maps or the generator resolver')
    ap.add_argument('--only', default='', help='comma list of hex entry offsets to restrict the picks (debug)')
    ap.add_argument('--show', type=int, default=25)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    lower_priority()
    r = random.Random(args.seed)
    T = {}
    t0 = time.time()
    mod = load_module(use_map_jump_tables=args.jt_source == 'map', name=MODNAME)
    starts, dstats = gen.discover(mod)
    starts_abs = {mod.lo + int(a) * 4 for a in starts}
    T['discover_s'] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    t1 = time.time()
    extra = [int(x, 16) for x in args.add.split(',') if x]
    picks, emitter, pool_sizes, nmain = pick_functions(mod, starts_abs, args.functions, r, extra)
    if args.only:
        want = {BASE + int(x, 16) for x in args.only.split(',')}
        main_set = picks[:nmain]
        picks = [p for p in picks if p[0] in want]
        nmain = sum(1 for p in picks if p in main_set)
    T['select_s'] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
    cat_n = Counter(p[2] for p in picks)
    print(f'picked {len(picks)} of pools {pool_sizes} ({len(picks) - nmain} callers of another pick, run in a second harness): {dict(cat_n)}',
          flush=True)

    # ---- image (relocated, with .bss) for the harness and Unicorn
    BLD.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    img = bytearray(mod.nso.relocated(BASE)).ljust(mod.nso.mem_end, b'\0')
    # .bss starts as pointers into the scratch buffer (60%) or zero, so singletons reached through the GOT are not null;
    # both sides start from the same bytes (fixed seed).
    rng = np.random.default_rng(args.seed)
    nb = (mod.nso.mem_end - mod.nso.size) // 8
    words = rng.integers(PTR_LO // 16, PTR_HI // 16, nb, dtype=np.uint64) * np.uint64(16)
    words[rng.random(nb) >= 0.9] = 0
    img[mod.nso.size:mod.nso.size + nb * 8] = words.astype('<u8').tobytes()
    img = bytes(img)
    (BLD / 'main.img').write_bytes(img)
    text_end = (mod.nso.text[0] + mod.nso.text[1] + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFF

    # ---- emit + compile
    files, t_emit, refs = emit_subset(emitter, picks, nmain, args.jobs, args.chunk_fns)
    mutated = set()
    if args.mutate:   # self-test of the harness: corrupt the first '+' of every k-th function in the main chunks
        every = max(1, nmain // args.mutate)
        for f in files:
            if f.stem == 'subset_defer':
                continue
            txt = f.read_text()
            parts = re.split(r'(?m)^(?=void f_[0-9a-f]+[(]Cpu [*]c[)] [{])', txt)
            for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                m = re.match(r'void (f_[0-9a-f]+)[(]', part)
                if m and (len(mutated) * every <= int(m.group(1)[2:], 16) % (every * 997)) and part.count(' + ') and len(mutated) < args.mutate:
                    k = part.index(' + ', part.index('{'))
                    parts[i] = part[:k] + ' + 1 + ' + part[k + 3:]
                    mutated.add(int(m.group(1)[2:], 16))
            f.write_text(''.join(parts))
        print(f'mutated {len(mutated)} functions', flush=True)
    T['lift_emit_s'] = round(t_emit, 1)
    csize = sum(f.stat().st_size for f in files)
    for f in BLD.glob('*.o'):
        f.unlink()
    defined = {gen.fname(e) for e, _, _, _ in picks}
    undefined = sorted(refs - defined)
    names = plt_names()
    # abort-stub runtime: every callee outside the subset logs and aborts
    lines = ['// GENERATED-GAME-CODE: unresolved-callee stubs for the subset, generated by tests/snap_func.py. Do not commit.',
             '#include "cpu.h"', 'void rt_unresolved(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr, const char *what);']
    for f in undefined:
        a = int(f[2:], 16)
        what = f'import {names[a - BASE]}' if (a - BASE) in names else 'guest function not in subset'
        lines.append(f'void {f}(Cpu *c) {{ rt_unresolved(c, {a:#x}ull, "{what}"); }}')
    lines.append('GuestFn subset_fns[] = {' + ','.join(gen.fname(e) for e, _, _, _ in picks) + '};')
    lines.append(f'int subset_count = {len(picks)};')
    lines = ['void ' + f'{gen.fname(e)}(Cpu *c);' for e, _, _, _ in picks] + [''] + lines
    lines.insert(0, '#include "cpu.h"')
    (GEN / 'stubs_abort.c').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    (GEN / 'link_main.c').write_text('#include <stdio.h>\nextern int subset_count;\nint main(void){ printf("subset %d functions linked\\n", subset_count); return 0; }\n')
    rt = ROOT / 'runtime' / 'snap_rt_abort.c'
    objs, t_comp = compile_all(files, BLD, args.jobs, args.cflags)
    T['compile_s'] = round(t_comp, 1)
    cc = compiler()
    extra, _ = compile_all([GEN / 'stubs_abort.c', GEN / 'link_main.c', rt], BLD, args.jobs, args.cflags)
    link(cc, BLD / 'subset_link.exe', objs + extra)
    lk = subprocess.run([str(BLD / 'subset_link.exe')], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f'lift+emit {t_emit:.1f}s, compile {t_comp:.1f}s ({len(files)} chunks, {csize / 1e6:.2f} MB of C), '
          f'unresolved stubs {len(undefined)}; link run: {lk.stdout.strip()}', flush=True)
    T['c_bytes'] = csize
    T['chunks'] = len(files)
    T['unresolved_stubs'] = len(undefined)

    # ---- harness builds: all callees are the shared digest stub. Group A: the picks that call no other pick; group B:
    # callers of picks (their own object file, picked callees stubbed).
    harness_groups = []
    for gname, idxs, gobjs in (('A', list(range(nmain)), [o for o in objs if o.stem != 'subset_defer']),
                               ('B', list(range(nmain, len(picks))), [o for o in objs if o.stem == 'subset_defer'])):
        if not idxs:
            continue
        gp = [picks[i] for i in idxs]
        called = set()
        for e, en, _, _ in gp:
            called |= callees(emitter, e, en)
        table = GEN / f'table_harness_{gname}.c'
        table.write_text('#include "cpu.h"\n' + ''.join(f'void {gen.fname(e)}(Cpu *c);\n' for e, _, _, _ in gp) +
                         'GuestFn tests[] = {' + ','.join(gen.fname(e) for e, _, _, _ in gp) + '};\n' +
                         f'int ntests = {len(gp)};\n' + 'void rt_stub_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t target);\n' +
                         ''.join(f'void {gen.fname(t)}(Cpu *c) {{ rt_stub_call(c, {hex(t)}ull); }}\n'
                                 for t in sorted(called - {e for e, _, _, _ in gp})))
        hobjs, _ = compile_all([table], BLD, args.jobs, args.cflags)
        hrt, _ = compile_all([ROOT / 'tests' / 'snap_harness.c', ROOT / 'runtime' / 'fma.c'], BLD, args.jobs, args.cflags) if not harness_groups else ([BLD / 'snap_harness.o', BLD / 'fma.o'], 0)
        exe = BLD / f'harness_{gname}.exe'
        link(cc, exe, gobjs + hobjs + hrt)
        harness_groups.append((exe, idxs))

    # ---- Unicorn reference
    sites = {}
    for e, en, _, _ in picks:
        sites[e] = call_sites(mod, e, en)
    buf0 = make_buffer(r)
    runner = Runner(BASE, img, text_end, buf0, starts_abs)
    cases, expect, per_fn, skip_reasons = [], [], {}, {}
    t2 = time.time()
    for k, (e, en, cat, tags) in enumerate(picks):
        per_fn[k] = {'cases': 0, 'skips': Counter()}
        runner.begin(e, en, sites[e])
        for ci in range(args.cases + args.retry_untested):
            if ci >= args.cases and per_fn[k]['cases'] >= 3:
                break          # the extra states only top up a function that has fewer than 3 accepted cases
            case = make_case(r, rich=ci % 2 == 0)
            res = runner.run(case, args.steps)
            if isinstance(res, str):
                per_fn[k]['skips'][res] += 1
                continue
            state, wins, (pcase, patches) = res
            fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = pcase
            cases.append((k, fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v, True, wins, patches))
            expect.append(state)
            per_fn[k]['cases'] += 1
        runner.end()
    T['unicorn_s'] = round(time.time() - t2, 1)
    print(f'unicorn: {len(cases)} cases on {sum(1 for p in per_fn.values() if p["cases"])} functions '
          f'({T["unicorn_s"]}s)', flush=True)

    # ---- host side, resuming after a crash
    t3 = time.time()
    recs_all, crashed = [], {}
    work = BLD / 'run'
    work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for exe, idxs in harness_groups:
        local = {k: n for n, k in enumerate(idxs)}
        remaining = [i for i, c in enumerate(cases) if c[0] in local]
        while remaining:
            sub = [(local[cases[i][0]],) + tuple(cases[i][1:]) for i in remaining]
            recs, err = run_harness(exe, work, buf0, sub, [(BASE, BLD / 'main.img')], stubs=True)
            for jx, rec in enumerate(recs):
                recs_all.append((remaining[jx], rec))
            if not err:
                break
            bad = remaining[len(recs)] if len(recs) < len(remaining) else None
            if bad is None:
                break
            kf = cases[bad][0]
            crashed[kf] = err.replace('\n', ' ')[:300]
            remaining = [i for i in remaining[len(recs) + 1:] if cases[i][0] != kf]
    T['host_s'] = round(time.time() - t3, 1)
    T['python_peak_rss_mb'] = peak_rss_mb()
    T['total_s'] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)

    # ---- compare
    fails = {}
    nfail = 0
    ncmp = Counter()
    for ci, got in recs_all:
        k = cases[ci][0]
        d = diff_state(got, expect[ci], check_pc=False, check_mem=True, check_nzcv=False)
        ncmp[k] += 1
        if d:
            nfail += 1
            fails.setdefault(k, (ci, d))
    rows, status = [], Counter()
    for k, (e, en, cat, tags) in enumerate(picks):
        if k in crashed:
            st = 'crash'
        elif k in fails:
            st = 'fail'
        elif ncmp[k]:
            st = 'pass'
        else:
            st = 'untested'
        status[st] += 1
        detail = ''
        if st == 'fail':
            ci, d = fails[k]
            detail = f'case {ci}: ' + '; '.join(d[:3])
        elif st == 'crash':
            detail = crashed[k]
        elif st == 'untested':
            detail = ', '.join(f'{n}x {m}' for m, n in per_fn[k]['skips'].most_common(3))
        rows.append({'entry': f'{e - BASE:#x}', 'end': f'{en - BASE:#x}', 'insns': (en - e) // 4, 'category': cat,
                     'tags': ','.join(sorted(tags)), 'status': st, 'cases_run': ncmp[k], 'cases_unicorn_ok': per_fn[k]['cases'],
                     'detail': detail})
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cols = list(rows[0])
    with open(OUT / 'diff_results.tsv', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('\t'.join(cols) + '\n')
        for row in rows:
            f.write('\t'.join(str(row[c]) for c in cols) + '\n')
    by_cat = {c: Counter(r_['status'] for r_ in rows if r_['category'] == c) for c in cat_n}
    summary = {'seed': args.seed, 'cases_per_function': args.cases, 'picked': len(picks), 'status': dict(status),
               'by_category': {c: dict(v) for c, v in by_cat.items()}, 'cases_compared': len(recs_all),
               'failing_cases': nfail, 'timing': T, 'pools': pool_sizes, 'cflags': args.cflags}
    (OUT / 'diff_results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'summary': summary, 'rows': rows}, indent=1))
    if mutated:
        det = [r_ for r_ in rows if int(r_['entry'], 16) + BASE in mutated]
        summary['mutation_selftest'] = {'mutated': len(det), 'detected_fail': sum(r_['status'] == 'fail' for r_ in det),
                                        'not_tested': sum(r_['status'] == 'untested' for r_ in det),
                                        'missed': sum(r_['status'] == 'pass' for r_ in det)}
    print(json.dumps(summary))
    for row in rows:
        if row['status'] in ('fail', 'crash') and args.show:
            args.show -= 1
            print(f"  {row['status']:5} {row['entry']:>9} {row['insns']:5} insns {row['category']:10} {row['tags']}: {row['detail'][:230]}")
    return 0


def make_buffer(r):
    """Scratch buffer content: 85% pointers into the scratch region, 15% zero (list ends, null checks). No small integers
    and no random 64-bit values: both turn a field read into a wild or null base (the earlier mix left about 25% of the
    functions untested)."""
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range(BUF_SIZE // 8):
        v = r.randrange(PTR_LO, PTR_HI, 16) if r.random() < 0.85 else 0
        out += v.to_bytes(8, 'little')
    return bytes(out)


def make_case(r, rich=False):
    """rich: every argument register holds a pointer into the scratch buffer; otherwise 85% pointers and small integers
    0..7 in the rest. X8..X28 mostly random pointers or random values."""
    x = [rand_x(r) for _ in range(31)]
    for i in range(29):
        k = r.random()
        if i < 8:
            x[i] = r.randrange(PTR_LO, PTR_HI, 16) if (rich or k < 0.85) else r.randrange(0, 8)
        elif k < 0.5:
            x[i] = r.randrange(PTR_LO, PTR_HI, 16)
    x[30] = SENTINEL
    sp = STACK_TOP - r.randrange(0, 0x100, 16)
    return rand_fpcr(r), x, sp, r.getrandbits(4) << 28, [rand_v(r) for _ in range(32)]


class Runner:
    """Unicorn with the relocated image (text read-only, the rest writable), a block hook that stops when execution
    leaves the function, a code hook on each call site of the current function that stops before the call (for the
    stub), and write hooks outside the scratch buffer that record the windows the host side must compare."""

    MAX_CALLS = 3000

    def __init__(self, base, img, text_end, buf0, starts):
        self.emu = Emu([(base, img)])
        mu = self.emu.mu
        self.base, self.img, self.text_end = base, img, text_end
        self.starts = starts
        mu.mem_protect(base, text_end, uc.UC_PROT_READ | uc.UC_PROT_EXEC)
        mu.mem_map(SENTINEL, 0x1000)
        mu.mem_write(BUF, buf0)
        self.buf0 = buf0
        self.lo = self.hi = self.h = 0
        self.left = False
        self.at_call = None
        self.tail = None
        self.writes = []
        self.log = []
        mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_BLOCK, self._block)
        mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE, self._write, begin=0, end=BUF - 1)
        mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE, self._write, begin=BUF + BUF_SIZE, end=(1 << 64) - 1)
        self.hooks = []

    def begin(self, entry, end, sites):
        self.lo, self.hi = entry, end
        mu = self.emu.mu
        self.hooks = [mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_CODE, self._call, begin=a, end=a) for a in sorted(sites)]

    def end(self):
        for h in self.hooks:
            self.emu.mu.hook_del(h)
        self.hooks = []

    def _block(self, mu, address, size, user):
        if not self.lo <= address < self.hi and address != SENTINEL:
            if address in self.starts:
                self.tail = address     # a direct branch to another function start: a tail call, stubbed
            else:
                self.left = True
            mu.emu_stop()

    def _call(self, mu, address, size, user):
        if self.lo <= address < self.hi:
            self.at_call = address
            mu.emu_stop()

    def _write(self, mu, access, address, size, value, user):
        self.writes.append((address, size))

    def stub(self, a):
        """snap_harness.c rt_stub for the call at a, which Unicorn has not executed yet. Returns the address to resume at."""
        e, mu = self.emu, self.emu.mu
        w = int.from_bytes(mu.mem_read(a, 4), 'little')
        if (w & 0xFC000000) == 0x94000000:   # BL
            imm = w & 0x03FFFFFF
            target = (a + ((imm - (1 << 26) if imm >> 25 else imm) << 2)) & M64
        else:                                 # BLR
            target = mu.reg_read(e.xregs[(w >> 5) & 31])
        mu.reg_write(A.UC_ARM64_REG_X30, a + 4)
        self.stub_target(target)
        return a + 4

    def stub_target(self, target):
        e, mu = self.emu, self.emu.mu
        h = ((self.h ^ target) * FNV) & M64
        for val in list(mu.reg_read_batch(e.xregs)) + [mu.reg_read(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP)]:
            h = ((h ^ val) * FNV) & M64
        for val in mu.reg_read_batch(e.qregs[:8]):
            h = ((h ^ (val & M64)) * FNV) & M64
            h = ((h ^ (val >> 64)) * FNV) & M64
        self.h = h
        if os.environ.get('STUBLOG'):
            xs = mu.reg_read_batch(e.xregs)
            self.log.append(f'stub target={target:x} h={h:x} x0={xs[0]:x} x1={xs[1]:x} x2={xs[2]:x} x19={xs[19]:x} x20={xs[20]:x} x21={xs[21]:x} x30={xs[30]:x} sp={mu.reg_read(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP):x}')
        regs = []
        for i in range(19):
            s = splitmix((h + i) & M64)
            regs.append((e.xregs[i], PTR_LO + ((s >> 4) % ((PTR_HI - PTR_LO) // 16)) * 16 if i < 8 and s & 15 else s))
        regs.append((A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV, splitmix((h + 19) & M64) >> 60 << 28))
        for i in range(8):
            regs.append((e.qregs[i], splitmix((h + 33 + 2 * i) & M64) << 64 | splitmix((h + 32 + 2 * i) & M64)))
        mu.reg_write_batch(regs)
        top = BUF + BUF_SIZE - 16
        n = int.from_bytes(mu.mem_read(top, 8), 'little')
        mu.mem_write(top, ((n + 1) & M64).to_bytes(8, 'little') + h.to_bytes(8, 'little'))

    def windows(self):
        """Merged write ranges (at most MAX_WIN) inside the image, or None."""
        ws = sorted((a, a + s) for a, s in self.writes)
        for gap in (16, 256, 4096, 65536):
            merged = []
            for a, b in ws:
                if merged and a <= merged[-1][1] + gap:
                    merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], b)
                else:
                    merged.append([a, b])
            if len(merged) <= MAX_WIN:
                return [(a, b - a) for a, b in merged]
        return None

    REPAIRS = 24
    MAX_PATCH = 16

    def run(self, case, steps):
        """(state, windows, patched case) or a skip-reason string. A case that faults on an unmapped load is repaired
        and retried: the base register of the faulting access is replaced by a scratch pointer when it still holds its
        initial value, or the 8-byte scratch slot it was loaded from (unmodified so far) is patched to a pointer. The
        host applies the same patches (In.patch), so both sides run the same state."""
        fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = case
        x = list(x)
        patches = {}
        self.tried = set()
        for attempt in range(self.REPAIRS + 1):
            res = self._run1((fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v), patches, steps, False)
            if not (isinstance(res, tuple) and res[0] == 'fault'):
                break
            res = self._run1((fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v), patches, steps, True)    # same state, traced
            if not (isinstance(res, tuple) and res[0] == 'fault'):
                break
            fix = self._repair(res[1], x, patches, attempt)
            if not fix:
                res = res[2]
                break
        if isinstance(res, tuple) and res[0] == 'fault':
            res = res[2]
        if isinstance(res, str):
            return res
        state, wins = res
        return state, wins, ((fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v), sorted(patches.items()))

    def _repair(self, info, x, patches, attempt):
        """info: (pc, fault address, initial-register snapshot at fault, loaded {value: addr}, dirty addresses)."""
        pc, addr, regs, loaded, dirty = info
        w = int.from_bytes(self.emu.mu.mem_read(pc, 4), 'little')
        ins = next(_CS.disasm(w.to_bytes(4, 'little'), pc), None)
        if ins is None:
            return False
        m = re.search(r'\[(\w+)(?:,\s*(\w+))?', ins.op_str)
        if not m:
            return False
        for name in (m.group(1), m.group(2)):
            if not name or name[0] not in 'xw' or not name[1:].isdigit():
                continue
            n = int(name[1:])
            val = regs[n] if name[0] == 'x' else regs[n] & 0xFFFFFFFF
            new = PTR_LO + (splitmix((pc + 31 * attempt + n) & M64) % ((PTR_HI - PTR_LO) // 16)) * 16
            if name[0] != 'x' or n >= 31 or PTR_LO <= val < PTR_HI:
                continue
            # value provenance: an initial register holding this value (a copy of an argument) is replaced; the register the
            # access names comes first, then the lowest-numbered one not tried yet
            cands = [i for i in range(29) if x[i] == val and i not in self.tried]
            if cands:
                i = n if n in cands else cands[0]
                self.tried.add(i)
                x[i] = new
                return True
            a = loaded.get(val)
            if a is not None and a not in dirty and len(patches) < self.MAX_PATCH and BUF <= a < BUF + BUF_SIZE - 16:
                patches[a] = new
                return True
        return False

    def _run1(self, case, patches, steps, trace):
        """Raw run. Returns (state, windows), a reason string, or ('fault', info, reason) for an unmapped access."""
        fpcr, x, sp, nzcv, v = case
        e, mu = self.emu, self.emu.mu
        self.left, self.h, self.writes, self.log = False, 0, [], []
        for a_, v_ in patches.items():
            mu.mem_write(a_, v_.to_bytes(8, 'little'))
        loaded, dirty, hk = {}, set(), []
        if trace:
            def rd(mu_, access, address, size, value, user):
                if size == 8:
                    loaded[int.from_bytes(mu_.mem_read(address, 8), 'little')] = address
            def wr(mu_, access, address, size, value, user):
                for o in range(address & ~7, address + size, 8):
                    dirty.add(o)
            hk.append(mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_MEM_READ, rd, begin=BUF, end=BUF + BUF_SIZE - 1))
            hk.append(mu.hook_add(uc.UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE, wr, begin=BUF, end=BUF + BUF_SIZE - 1))
        regs_init = list(x[:31])
        fault = None
        mu.reg_write_batch(list(zip(e.xregs, x[:31])) + list(zip(e.qregs, v)) +
                           [(A.UC_ARM64_REG_SP, sp), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_NZCV, nzcv), (A.UC_ARM64_REG_FPCR, fpcr)])
        pc, reason = self.lo, None
        try:
            for _ in range(self.MAX_CALLS):
                self.at_call = self.tail = None
                mu.emu_start(pc, SENTINEL, count=steps)
                if self.tail is not None:       # tail call: stub it, then the callee returns to LR (the sentinel)
                    self.stub_target(self.tail)
                    mu.reg_write(A.UC_ARM64_REG_PC, SENTINEL)
                    break
                if self.at_call is None:
                    if self.left:
                        reason = 'left the function'
                    elif mu.reg_read(A.UC_ARM64_REG_PC) != SENTINEL:
                        reason = 'step cap'
                    break
                pc = self.stub(self.at_call)
            else:
                reason = 'call cap'
        except uc.UcError as ex:
            reason = f'unicorn {ex} @{mu.reg_read(A.UC_ARM64_REG_PC) - self.base:#x}'
            if ex.errno in (uc.UC_ERR_READ_UNMAPPED, uc.UC_ERR_WRITE_UNMAPPED) and trace:
                fault = (mu.reg_read(A.UC_ARM64_REG_PC), 0, list(mu.reg_read_batch(e.xregs)), loaded, dirty)
        for h_ in hk:
            mu.hook_del(h_)
        wins = self.windows() if reason is None else None
        if reason is None and wins is None:
            reason = 'too many write windows'
        if reason is None:
            for a, n in wins:
                if a < self.base or a + n > self.base + len(self.img):
                    reason = 'write outside the image'
        if reason is not None:
            self.restore([])
            if fault is not None or (not trace and 'UNMAPPED' in reason):
                return ('fault', fault, reason)
            return reason
        if self.log:
            print('CASE', *self.log, sep='\n', flush=True)
        o = mu.reg_read_batch(e.out_regs)
        crc = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(BUF, BUF_SIZE)))
        wcrc = 0
        for a, n in wins:
            wcrc = zlib.crc32(bytes(mu.mem_read(a, n)), wcrc)
        self.restore(wins)
        return (list(o[:31]), o[31], o[32] & 0xF0000000, o[33], list(o[34:]), (crc, wcrc if wins else 0)), wins

    def restore(self, wins):
        mu = self.emu.mu
        mu.mem_write(BUF, self.buf0)
        ws = wins or [(a, n) for a, n in self.writes]
        for a, n in ws:
            if self.base <= a and a + n <= self.base + len(self.img):
                mu.mem_write(a, self.img[a - self.base:a - self.base + n])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

`tests/snap_harness.c`:

```c
// Via TotK Recomp tests/diff/harness.c @ 7a37fc3 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Valiantsin Dzerakh), adapted from LAS Recomp
// (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai). Modified for the Snap prototype: up to 8 per-case memory windows inside the first
// image (data/.bss writes), checked by CRC and restored from a pristine copy after each case.
// Runs lifted tests and writes the resulting CPU state per case.
// Shared by tests/diff/lift.py, simd.py, atomic.py and func.py; the expected state comes from Unicorn on the Python
// side.
//
// argv: buf.bin cases.bin out.bin image base [image base ...]
// Each image is mapped at its guest address (guest == host), the scratch buffer at BUF.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/mman.h>
#endif

#include "cpu.h"
#define MAX_WIN 8

extern GuestFn tests[];
extern int ntests;

#define BUF 0x7200000000ull
#define BUF_SIZE 0x100000

#define PTR_LO (BUF + 0x40000)
#define PTR_SPAN 0x80000

static int g_stubs;            // In.stubs of the running case
static uint64_t g_stub_h;      // digest of every call's state so far

static uint64_t splitmix(uint64_t z) {
    z += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ull;
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBull;
    return z ^ (z >> 31);
}

static uint64_t mix(uint64_t h, uint64_t w) { return (h ^ w) * 0x100000001B3ull; }

// The callee of every call in a function under tests/diff/func.py; Runner.stub there is the same function on the
// Unicorn side. Folds the target, X0-X30, SP and V0-V7 into a digest, so a register the caller left unwritten at the
// call changes it, then sets X0-X18, NZCV and V0-V7 from the digest, so a caller reading a register it held across
// the call sees a value the callee could have left. X0-X7 mostly get pointers into the scratch buffer. The digest
// and the call count go to the top of the scratch buffer, which the memory check covers.
static void rt_stub(Cpu *c, uint64_t target) {
    uint64_t h = mix(g_stub_h, target);
    for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) h = mix(h, c->x[i]);
    h = mix(h, c->sp);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) h = mix(mix(h, (uint64_t)c->v[i]), (uint64_t)(c->v[i] >> 64));
    g_stub_h = h;
    if (getenv("STUBLOG")) fprintf(stderr, "stub target=%llx h=%llx x0=%llx x1=%llx x2=%llx x19=%llx x20=%llx x21=%llx x30=%llx sp=%llx\n", (unsigned long long)target, (unsigned long long)h, (unsigned long long)c->x[0], (unsigned long long)c->x[1], (unsigned long long)c->x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[19], (unsigned long long)c->x[20], (unsigned long long)c->x[21], (unsigned long long)c->x[30], (unsigned long long)c->sp);
    for (int i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
        uint64_t s = splitmix(h + i);
        c->x[i] = i < 8 && (s & 15) ? PTR_LO + ((s >> 4) % (PTR_SPAN / 16)) * 16 : s;
    }
    c->nzcv = splitmix(h + 19) >> 60 << 28;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        c->v[i] = (__uint128_t)splitmix(h + 33 + 2 * i) << 64 | splitmix(h + 32 + 2 * i);
    uint64_t *slot = (uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(BUF + BUF_SIZE - 16);
    slot[0]++;
    slot[1] = h;
}

void rt_dispatch(Cpu *c) {
    if (g_stubs) rt_stub(c, c->pc);
}
void rt_stub_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t target) { rt_stub(c, target); }
void rt_spin_gate(Cpu *c, uint64_t head) { (void)c; (void)head; }
void rt_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; }
void rt_brk(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)imm; (void)pc; abort(); }
void rt_udf(Cpu *c, uint64_t pc) { (void)c; (void)pc; abort(); }
uint64_t rt_ticks(void) { return 0; }
volatile int g_fnprof;
void fnprof_hit(uint64_t addr, uint64_t lr, uint64_t x0) { (void)addr; (void)lr; (void)x0; }

static void *map_at(uint64_t addr, size_t len) {
    len = (len + 0xffff) & ~(size_t)0xffff;
#ifdef _WIN32
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)addr, len, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
#else
    void *p = mmap((void *)addr, len, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0);
#endif
    if (p != (void *)addr) {
        fprintf(stderr, "map %llx (+%zx) failed\n", (unsigned long long)addr, len);
        exit(1);
    }
    return p;
}

static void *load_at(const char *path, uint64_t addr) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    size_t size = (size_t)ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    void *p = map_at(addr, size);
    if (fread(p, 1, size, f) != size) { perror(path); exit(1); }
    fclose(f);
    return p;
}

static uint32_t crc_tab[256];
static uint32_t crc32_buf(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint32_t seed) {
    uint32_t c = seed ^ 0xffffffffu;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) c = crc_tab[(c ^ p[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >> 8);
    return c ^ 0xffffffffu;
}

// Layouts match IN_FMT / OUT_FMT in tests/diff/common.py.
struct In { uint64_t k, fpcr, x[32], sp, nzcv; __uint128_t v[32]; uint64_t memchk, stubs; uint64_t win[2 * MAX_WIN]; uint64_t npatch, patch[33]; };
struct Out { uint64_t x[32], sp, nzcv, pc, mem, mem2, pad; __uint128_t v[32]; };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 6 || (argc - 4) % 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s buf.bin cases.bin out.bin image base [image base ...]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint32_t c = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? (c >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320u : c >> 1;
        crc_tab[i] = c;
    }
    uint8_t *img0 = 0, *img0_pristine = 0;
    uint64_t img0_base = 0, img0_len = 0;
    for (int i = 4; i < argc; i += 2) {
        uint64_t b = strtoull(argv[i + 1], 0, 16);
        void *p = load_at(argv[i], b);
        if (!img0) {
            FILE *q = fopen(argv[i], "rb"); fseek(q, 0, SEEK_END); img0_len = (uint64_t)ftell(q); fclose(q);
            img0 = p; img0_base = b; img0_pristine = malloc(img0_len); memcpy(img0_pristine, p, img0_len);
        }
    }
    uint8_t *buf = map_at(BUF, BUF_SIZE);
    FILE *bf = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!bf || fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, bf) != BUF_SIZE) { perror(argv[1]); return 1; }
    fclose(bf);
    uint8_t *pristine = malloc(BUF_SIZE);
    memcpy(pristine, buf, BUF_SIZE);

    FILE *f = fopen(argv[2], "rb"), *o = fopen(argv[3], "wb");
    if (!f || !o) return 1;
    static struct In in;
    static struct Out out;
    static Cpu c;
    while (fread(&in, sizeof in, 1, f) == 1) {
        if (in.k >= (uint64_t)ntests) { fprintf(stderr, "bad test index %llu\n", (unsigned long long)in.k); return 1; }
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        memcpy(c.x, in.x, sizeof c.x);
        c.sp = in.sp;
        c.nzcv = in.nzcv;
        c.fpcr = in.fpcr;
        rt_fpcr_sync(&c);
        memcpy(c.v, in.v, sizeof c.v);
        c.excl_addr = ~0ull;
        for (uint64_t pi = 0; pi < in.npatch && pi < 16; pi++) *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)in.patch[2 * pi] = in.patch[2 * pi + 1];
        g_stubs = (int)in.stubs;
        g_stub_h = 0;
        if (getenv("STUBLOG")) fprintf(stderr, "CASE\n");
        tests[in.k](&c);
        memcpy(out.x, c.x, sizeof out.x);
        out.sp = c.sp;
        out.nzcv = c.nzcv & 0xf0000000ull;
        out.pc = c.pc;
        out.mem = 0;
        out.mem2 = 0;
        if (in.memchk) {
            out.mem = crc32_buf(buf, BUF_SIZE, 0);
            memcpy(buf, pristine, BUF_SIZE);
            uint32_t h = 0;
            for (int w = 0; w < MAX_WIN; w++) {
                uint64_t a = in.win[2 * w], n = in.win[2 * w + 1];
                if (!n) continue;
                if (a < img0_base || a + n > img0_base + img0_len) { fprintf(stderr, "bad window\n"); return 1; }
                h = crc32_buf((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)a, n, h);
                memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)a, img0_pristine + (a - img0_base), n);
            }
            out.mem2 = h;
        }
        memcpy(out.v, c.v, sizeof out.v);
        fwrite(&out, sizeof out, 1, o);
        // Flushed per case so a crash leaves the completed cases readable.
        fflush(o);
    }
    fclose(o);
    return 0;
}

```

`tools-src/asset_viewer/README.md`:

```md
# Asset Studio: local before/after asset viewer

A static three.js (MIT, pinned 0.180.0) viewer for AI-upscaled textures and models, plus a stdlib-only
localhost server. Read-only. It shows no game branding and ships no game content.

Contract: `docs/hd-assets.md`, **cache `manifest.json` version 1** (rejected with a message if another version)
and **`alt_models.json` version 1** (optional).

## Run

```powershell
cd tools-src\asset_viewer
npm ci                      # once, needs network (three.js, plus Playwright for tests); then offline
python -E -P serve.py       # http://127.0.0.1:8765, cache = build\hd\cache
python -E -P serve.py --cache path\to\cache --external path\to\external --port 9000
```

- Binds to 127.0.0.1 only; GET/HEAD only; rejects traversal and symlinks leaving the served roots.
- `/cache/` maps to the cache dir, `/external/` to `--external` (default `<cache>/../external`, i.e. `build\hd\external`),
  `/vendor/three/` to `node_modules/three`, `GET /api/manifest` to the manifest merged with alt models.
- Empty or missing cache: the page shows the build command `python -E -P scripts\hd\build_cache.py ...`.

## Features

- Asset list with search, category filter and texture counts.
- 3D: orbit/zoom/pan, studio lighting, normal maps, alpha-tested materials, wireframe, LOD, dark/light/gray background.
- **Model A / Model B** dropdowns: `Original (game)`, each `manifest.variants` entry (swaps every texture), and alt models.
  A/B split uses one shared camera and a draggable (or arrow-key) divider with scissor rendering.
  Each side shows triangle and vertex counts.
- Alt models (`<cache>/alt_models.json`): merged per asset by `asset_id`, falling back to a case-insensitive match on
  asset name. Paths are relative to the cache dir; the files carry their own textures. Missing or invalid file is ignored.
- Textures tab: grid (role, size, format), compare slider over the same region, 1x-16x nearest-neighbor zoom,
  shared pan, RGB/R/G/B/A channels, original and upscaled size readouts. Alt models are not shown here.
- Keys: `A`/`B` swap sides, `W` wireframe, `1`-`4` pick Model B from the dropdown order.

## Tests and test data

```powershell
python -E -P generate_testdata.py   # procedural, game-free cache: testdata\cache + testdata\external
npm test                            # headless Edge, writes docs\*.png and docs\verification.json
```

## Known gaps

- Alt models are not rescaled to match the original; a model in different units looks bigger or smaller.
- Skinned and animated models show the bind pose only.
- Texture compare uses the 2D canvas; very large images (over 8k) are untested.
- No pipeline-produced real cache was available during development; only synthetic data was tested.
- Packed masks are available in the texture inspector but are not applied to 3D materials; version 1 does not define their channel packing. Alpha testing uses a preview cutoff of 0.5.

The independent core checks can also be run with `python -B -E -P tests\test_server.py` and `node tests/core-browser.mjs`. Core screenshots are `docs/core-3d-ab.png` and `docs/core-texture-slider.png`; results are in `docs/core-verification.json`.

```

`tools-src/asset_viewer/app.js`:

```js
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
import { clone as cloneSkeleton } from 'three/addons/utils/SkeletonUtils.js';

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = { manifest: { assets: [], variants: [] }, asset: null, models: [], split: .5, texSplit: .5, tab: 'model', texture: null, images: [], zoom: 1, pan: { x: 0, y: 0 }, channel: 'RGB', background: 0, modelEpoch: 0, textureEpoch: 0, modelNotes: [], textureNotes: [] };
const imageCache = new Map();
const backgrounds = [['dark', '#191d24'], ['light', '#e6e8eb'], ['gray', '#777b80']];
function option(value, label) { return new Option(label, value); }
const isAlt = id => typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('alt:');
const altModel = id => state.asset?.alt_models?.find(a => 'alt:' + a.id === id);
function modelChoices() {
  return [{ id: 'orig', label: 'Original (game)' }, ...state.manifest.variants.map(v => ({ id: v.id, label: 'HD · ' + v.label })), ...(state.asset?.alt_models || []).map(a => ({ id: 'alt:' + a.id, label: 'Alt · ' + (a.label || a.id) }))];
}
function variantLabel(id) { return modelChoices().find(v => v.id === id)?.label || id; }
function populateChoices() {
  const choices = modelChoices(), prev = [$('variantA').value, $('variantB').value], has = v => choices.some(c => c.id === v);
  for (const id of ['variantA', 'variantB']) $(id).replaceChildren(...choices.map(c => option(c.id, c.label)));
  $('variantA').value = has(prev[0]) ? prev[0] : 'orig';
  $('variantB').value = has(prev[1]) ? prev[1] : (state.manifest.variants[0]?.id || 'orig');
  updateLabels();
}
function notice() { $('notice').textContent = [...new Set([...state.modelNotes, ...state.textureNotes])].join(' · '); }
function cacheURL(path) {
  if (typeof path !== 'string' || !path || path.includes('\\') || path.includes(':') || path.startsWith('/') || path.split('/').includes('..')) throw new Error('Invalid cache path');
  return '/cache/' + path.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
}
async function imageFor(path) {
  const url = cacheURL(path);
  if (!imageCache.has(url)) imageCache.set(url, (async () => {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Missing texture: ${path}`);
    const blob = await response.blob();
    const image = new Image();
    const objectURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    try { image.src = objectURL; await image.decode(); return image; }
    finally { URL.revokeObjectURL(objectURL); }
  })());
  return imageCache.get(url);
}
async function variantImage(texture, variant, notes) {
  if (isAlt(variant)) variant = 'orig'; // alternate models carry their own textures
  const path = variant === 'orig' ? texture.orig : texture.variants?.[variant];
  if (path) {
    try { return await imageFor(path); }
    catch { notes.push(`${texture.name}: ${variantLabel(variant)} unavailable; using original`); }
  } else if (variant !== 'orig') notes.push(`${texture.name}: ${variantLabel(variant)} unavailable; using original`);
  try { return await imageFor(texture.orig); }
  catch { notes.push(`${texture.name}: original unavailable`); return null; }
}
function pixels(image) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = image.width; canvas.height = image.height;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
  return { canvas, context, data: context.getImageData(0, 0, image.width, image.height) };
}
function hasAlpha(image) { const data = pixels(image).data.data; for (let i = 3; i < data.length; i += 4) if (data[i] < 255) return true; return false; }

let renderer, scene, camera, controls;
try {
  renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)); renderer.setClearColor(backgrounds[0][1]);
  renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  $('viewport').prepend(renderer.domElement);
  scene = new THREE.Scene();
  camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(38, 1, .001, 10000);
  camera.position.set(3, 2, 4);
  controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement); controls.enableDamping = true;
  scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x636974, 2));
  const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff9ef, 3); key.position.set(4, 6, 5); scene.add(key);
  const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdceaff, 2.5); rim.position.set(-4, 3, -4); scene.add(rim);
} catch { $('modelMessage').textContent = 'WebGL is unavailable. Texture comparison is still available.'; }
function resize() {
  if (renderer && !$('modelPanel').hidden) {
    const w = $('viewport').clientWidth, h = $('viewport').clientHeight;
    if (w && h) { renderer.setSize(w, h, false); camera.aspect = w / h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix(); }
  }
  drawTexture();
}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe($('viewport'));
new ResizeObserver(drawTexture).observe($('textureViewport'));
function render() {
  requestAnimationFrame(render);
  if (!renderer || $('editor').hidden || state.tab !== 'model') return;
  controls.update();
  const w = $('viewport').clientWidth, h = $('viewport').clientHeight;
  renderer.setViewport(0, 0, w, h); renderer.setScissorTest(false); renderer.clear();
  const split = $('split').checked;
  renderer.setScissorTest(true);
  state.models.forEach((root, index) => {
    if (index === 1 && !split) return;
    state.models.forEach((model, i) => model.visible = i === index);
    const x = Math.round(w * state.split);
    renderer.setScissor(index ? x : 0, 0, split ? (index ? w - x : x) : w, h);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  });
  renderer.setScissorTest(false);
}
render();
function disposeModels(roots) {
  const resources = new Set();
  roots.forEach(root => { scene?.remove(root); root.traverse(object => {
    if (object.geometry) resources.add(object.geometry);
    for (const material of Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : [object.material]) {
      if (!material) continue;
      resources.add(material); for (const value of Object.values(material)) if (value?.isTexture) resources.add(value);
    }
  }); });
  resources.forEach(resource => resource.dispose());
}
function frameModel() {
  if (!state.models.length || !camera) return;
  const box = new THREE.Box3(); state.models.forEach(m => box.union(new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(m)));
  if (box.isEmpty()) return;
  const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  const radius = Math.max(box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length() / 2, .01);
  controls.target.copy(center);
  camera.position.copy(center).add(new THREE.Vector3(1, .55, 1.5).normalize().multiplyScalar(radius / Math.sin(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov / 2)) * 1.15));
  camera.near = radius / 1000; camera.far = radius * 1000; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  controls.minDistance = radius * .05; controls.maxDistance = radius * 100; controls.update();
}
// The cache glTF owns geometry/skin/UVs; the manifest owns all texture bindings.
function stripTextures(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return;
  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    if (key.endsWith('Texture')) delete value[key]; else stripTextures(value[key]);
  }
}
async function parseOriginal(asset) {
  const path = (asset.lods?.length ? asset.lods : [asset.model])[Number($('lod').value) || 0];
  if (!path) throw new Error('No model in this cache entry. Textures can still be previewed.');
  const url = cacheURL(path), response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Model is not available yet. Refresh the cache when the build completes.');
  const json = await response.json();
  json.images = []; json.textures = []; json.samplers = [];
  (json.materials || []).forEach(stripTextures);
  return (await new GLTFLoader(resourceManager()).parseAsync(JSON.stringify(json), url.slice(0, url.lastIndexOf('/') + 1))).scene;
}
function resourceManager() {
  const manager = new THREE.LoadingManager();
  manager.setURLModifier(resource => {
    const resolved = new URL(resource, location.origin);
    if (resolved.origin !== location.origin || !(resolved.pathname.startsWith('/cache/') || resolved.pathname.startsWith('/external/'))) throw new Error('Model resource must be inside the cache');
    return resolved.href;
  });
  return manager;
}
function countGeometry(root) {
  let verts = 0, tris = 0;
  root.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const p = o.geometry.attributes.position; if (!p) return; verts += p.count; tris += (o.geometry.index ? o.geometry.index.count : p.count) / 3; });
  return { verts, tris: Math.round(tris) };
}
async function loadModel(reframe = false) {
  const epoch = ++state.modelEpoch, asset = state.asset;
  state.modelNotes = []; notice();
  if (!renderer || !asset) return;
  $('modelMessage').textContent = 'Loading model…';
  const roots = [], notes = [], errors = [];
  let basePromise;
  const base = () => basePromise ||= parseOriginal(asset);
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      const choice = $(i ? 'variantB' : 'variantA').value;
      try {
        if (isAlt(choice)) {
          const alt = altModel(choice);
          if (!alt) throw new Error('Alternate model is not listed for this asset');
          const gltf = await new GLTFLoader(resourceManager()).loadAsync(alt.url);
          gltf.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) for (const m of Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]) m.wireframe = $('wireframe').checked; });
          roots.push(gltf.scene);
          continue;
        }
        const root = cloneSkeleton(await base());
        const materialCache = new Map();
        const materialFor = source => {
          if (!materialCache.has(source.name)) materialCache.set(source.name, (async () => {
            const binding = asset.materials?.find(m => m.name === source.name);
            const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ name: source.name, color: 0xffffff, roughness: .72, metalness: 0, wireframe: $('wireframe').checked, side: source.side });
            if (!binding) { notes.push(`No manifest texture binding for material ${source.name || '(unnamed)'}`); return material; }
            for (const [role, slot] of [['albedo', 'map'], ['normal', 'normalMap'], ['emissive', 'emissiveMap']]) {
              const texture = asset.textures?.find(t => t.name === binding[role]);
              if (!texture) continue;
              const image = await variantImage(texture, choice, notes);
              if (!image) continue;
              const map = new THREE.Texture(image); map.flipY = false; map.colorSpace = role === 'normal' ? THREE.NoColorSpace : THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
              map.wrapS = map.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; map.needsUpdate = true;
              material[slot] = map;
              if (role === 'albedo' && hasAlpha(image)) { material.alphaTest = .5; material.side = THREE.DoubleSide; }
              if (role === 'emissive') material.emissive.set(0xffffff);
            }
            return material;
          })());
          return materialCache.get(source.name);
        };
        const pending = [];
        root.traverse(object => {
          if (!object.isMesh) return;
          const materials = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : [object.material];
          pending.push(Promise.all(materials.map(materialFor)).then(m => { object.material = Array.isArray(object.material) ? m : m[0]; }));
        });
        await Promise.all(pending);
        roots.push(root);
      } catch (error) {
        errors.push(error.message); notes.push(`Side ${i ? 'B' : 'A'}: ${error.message}`);
        roots.push(new THREE.Group());
      }
    }
    if (epoch !== state.modelEpoch) { disposeModels(roots); return; }
    disposeModels(state.models); state.models = roots; roots.forEach(root => scene.add(root));
    state.counts = roots.map(countGeometry);
    updateLabels();
    state.modelNotes = notes; notice();
    if (errors.length === 2) {
      $('modelMessage').textContent = errors[0]; $('viewport').dataset.ready = 'false';
      $('status').textContent = 'Model unavailable · texture preview available';
      return;
    }
    $('modelMessage').textContent = '';
    if (reframe) frameModel();
    $('status').textContent = `${asset.id} · LOD ${$('lod').value} · ${asset.textures?.length || 0} textures`;
    $('viewport').dataset.ready = 'true'; resize();
  } catch (error) {
    disposeModels(roots);
    if (epoch !== state.modelEpoch) return;
    $('modelMessage').textContent = error.message; $('viewport').dataset.ready = 'false';
  }
}
function fmt(n) { return n.toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function updateLabels() {
  for (const [id, variant, prefix] of [['labelA','variantA','A'],['labelB','variantB','B']]) {
    const c = state.counts?.[prefix === 'A' ? 0 : 1];
    $(id).textContent = `${prefix} / ${variantLabel($(variant).value)}` + (c ? ` · ${fmt(c.tris)} tris · ${fmt(c.verts)} verts` : '');
  }
  for (const [id, variant, prefix] of [['texLabelA','variantA','A'],['texLabelB','variantB','B']]) $(id).textContent = `${prefix} / ${variantLabel($(variant).value)}`;
  $('labelB').hidden = $('modelDivider').hidden = !$('split').checked;
}
function listAssets() {
  const search = $('search').value.toLowerCase(), category = $('category').value;
  $('assetList').replaceChildren();
  const assets = state.manifest.assets.filter(asset => `${asset.name} ${asset.id}`.toLowerCase().includes(search) && (!category || (asset.category || 'other') === category));
  assets.forEach(asset => {
    const row = document.createElement('button'); row.className = 'asset-row' + (state.asset?.id === asset.id ? ' active' : '');
    const title = document.createElement('strong'); title.textContent = asset.name || asset.id;
    const detail = document.createElement('small'); detail.textContent = `${asset.category || 'other'} · ${asset.textures?.length || 0} textures`;
    row.append(title, detail); row.onclick = () => selectAsset(asset); $('assetList').append(row);
  });
  if (!assets.length) $('assetList').textContent = 'No matching assets.';
  $('assetCount').textContent = `${state.manifest.assets.length} assets`;
}
function setTab(tab) {
  state.tab = tab;
  $('modelPanel').hidden = tab !== 'model'; $('texturePanel').hidden = tab !== 'texture';
  for (const [id, active] of [['modelTab', tab === 'model'], ['textureTab', tab === 'texture']]) { $(id).classList.toggle('active', active); $(id).setAttribute('aria-selected', active); }
  for (const id of ['lod', 'wireframe', 'split', 'background', 'frame']) $(id).disabled = tab !== 'model';
  resize();
}
function textureGrid() {
  $('textureGrid').replaceChildren();
  for (const texture of state.asset.textures || []) {
    const button = document.createElement('button'); button.className = 'texture-card';
    const image = document.createElement('img'); image.alt = texture.name; image.loading = 'lazy';
    try { image.src = cacheURL(texture.orig); } catch { /* Invalid paths remain blank. */ }
    image.onerror = () => { image.removeAttribute('src'); image.alt = `${texture.name} · original not available yet`; };
    const info = document.createElement('div'), title = document.createElement('strong'), detail = document.createElement('small');
    title.textContent = texture.name; detail.textContent = `${texture.role || 'other'} · ${texture.w} × ${texture.h} · ${texture.format || 'PNG'}`;
    info.append(title, detail); button.append(image, info); button.onclick = () => openTexture(texture); $('textureGrid').append(button);
  }
  if (!state.asset.textures?.length) $('textureGrid').textContent = 'No textures have been added to this asset yet.';
}
async function selectAsset(asset) {
  ++state.textureEpoch; state.asset = asset; state.texture = null; state.images = []; state.textureNotes = []; imageCache.clear();
  $('assetName').textContent = asset.name || asset.id; $('breadcrumb').textContent = `${asset.category || 'other'} / ${asset.id}`;
  $('textureCount').textContent = asset.textures?.length || 0;
  $('lod').replaceChildren(...(asset.lods?.length ? asset.lods : [asset.model]).map((_, i) => option(i, `LOD ${i}`)));
  $('textureCompare').hidden = true; $('textureGrid').hidden = false;
  populateChoices(); listAssets(); textureGrid(); setTab('model'); await loadModel(true);
}
async function refresh() {
  $('reload').disabled = true;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/manifest'); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Could not read the manifest');
    const manifest = await response.json();
    if (manifest.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(manifest.assets) || !Array.isArray(manifest.variants)) throw new Error('Unsupported cache contract. Expected version 1.');
    state.manifest = manifest;
    $('category').replaceChildren(option('', 'All categories'), ...[...new Set(manifest.assets.map(a => a.category || 'other'))].sort().map(c => option(c, c)));
    $('empty').hidden = !!manifest.assets.length; $('editor').hidden = !manifest.assets.length;
    if (!manifest.assets.length) {
      ++state.modelEpoch; ++state.textureEpoch; disposeModels(state.models); state.models = []; state.asset = null;
      $('emptyMessage').textContent = manifest.message || 'No assets are available yet. Build the cache, then refresh.'; listAssets();
    } else await selectAsset(manifest.assets.find(a => a.id === state.asset?.id) || manifest.assets[0]);
  } catch (error) { $('empty').hidden = false; $('editor').hidden = true; $('emptyMessage').textContent = error.message; }
  finally { $('reload').disabled = false; }
}
async function openTexture(texture) {
  state.texture = texture; state.pan = { x: 0, y: 0 }; state.zoom = 1; $('zoom').value = '1';
  $('textureGrid').hidden = true; $('textureCompare').hidden = false; $('textureName').textContent = `${texture.name} / ${texture.role}`;
  await loadTextureCompare();
}
async function loadTextureCompare() {
  const epoch = ++state.textureEpoch, texture = state.texture;
  if (!texture) return;
  state.images = []; state.textureNotes = []; drawTexture();
  const notes = [], ids = [$('variantA').value, $('variantB').value];
  const images = await Promise.all(ids.map(id => variantImage(texture, id, notes)));
  if (epoch !== state.textureEpoch) return;
  state.images = images; state.textureNotes = notes; notice();
  const sizes = images.map((image, i) => `${i ? 'B' : 'A'} / ${variantLabel(ids[i])}${isAlt(ids[i]) ? ' (own textures; showing original)' : ''}: ${image ? `${image.width} × ${image.height}` : 'unavailable'}`);
  $('textureSizes').replaceChildren(...[`Original: ${texture.w} × ${texture.h} · ${texture.format || 'PNG'}`, ...sizes].map(text => { const span = document.createElement('span'); span.textContent = text; return span; }));
  channelImages(); $('textureViewport').dataset.ready = 'true';
}
function channelImages() {
  state.channelCanvases = state.images.map(image => {
    if (!image) return null;
    const { canvas, context, data } = pixels(image);
    if (state.channel !== 'RGB') {
      const channel = { R: 0, G: 1, B: 2, A: 3 }[state.channel];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.data.length; i += 4) { const value = data.data[i + channel]; data.data[i] = data.data[i+1] = data.data[i+2] = value; data.data[i+3] = 255; }
      context.putImageData(data, 0, 0);
    }
    return canvas;
  }); drawTexture();
}
function drawTexture() {
  const canvas = $('textureCanvas'); if (!canvas || $('texturePanel').hidden || $('textureCompare').hidden) return;
  const w = $('textureViewport').clientWidth, h = $('textureViewport').clientHeight, dpr = devicePixelRatio;
  if (!w || !h) return;
  canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr); canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d'); context.scale(dpr, dpr); context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 16) for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 16) { context.fillStyle = ((x+y)/16)%2 ? '#242a33' : '#303742'; context.fillRect(x,y,16,16); }
  if (!state.texture) return;
  // Both sides cover the same UV region: A defines the reference size, and B pixels map as
  // B_px = A_px * (B.w / A.w), so B draws at A's on-screen size (extra detail shows when zoomed).
  // "B at native 1:1" draws B at its own pixel size around the same UV center instead.
  const ref = state.channelCanvases?.[0] || state.channelCanvases?.[1];
  const refW = ref ? (state.channelCanvases[0] ? ref.width : state.texture.w) : state.texture.w;
  const refH = ref ? (state.channelCanvases[0] ? ref.height : state.texture.h) : state.texture.h;
  const nearest = state.zoom >= 4, native = $('nativeB')?.checked;
  context.imageSmoothingEnabled = !nearest; context.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
  const rects = [];
  (state.channelCanvases || []).forEach((image, i) => {
    if (!image || !state.images[i]) return;
    const sx = i && native ? image.width / refW : 1, sy = i && native ? image.height / refH : 1;
    const dw = refW * state.zoom * sx, dh = refH * state.zoom * sy;
    const x = (w-dw)/2 + state.pan.x, y = (h-dh)/2 + state.pan.y;
    context.save(); context.beginPath(); context.rect(i ? w*state.texSplit : 0, 0, i ? w*(1-state.texSplit) : w*state.texSplit, h); context.clip();
    context.drawImage(image, x, y, dw, dh); context.restore(); rects[i] = { x, y, w: dw, h: dh, srcW: image.width };
  });
  state.lastDraw = { rects, refW, refH, nearest, native: !!native };
}
function divider(id, key, redraw) {
  const element = $(id);
  function set(value) { state[key] = Math.max(.02, Math.min(.98, value)); element.style.left = `${state[key]*100}%`; element.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(state[key]*100)); redraw?.(); }
  element.onpointerdown = event => { event.stopPropagation(); element.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); };
  element.onpointermove = event => { if (!element.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) return; const rect = element.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(); set((event.clientX - rect.left)/rect.width); };
  element.onkeydown = event => { if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(event.key)) { event.preventDefault(); set(event.key === 'Home' ? .02 : event.key === 'End' ? .98 : state[key] + (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -.02 : .02)); } };
}
divider('modelDivider','split'); divider('textureDivider','texSplit',drawTexture);
let lastPointer;
$('textureCanvas').onpointerdown = event => { lastPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }; event.target.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); };
$('textureCanvas').onpointermove = event => {
  if (!event.target.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) return;
  state.pan.x += event.clientX-lastPointer.x; state.pan.y += event.clientY-lastPointer.y; lastPointer = { x:event.clientX,y:event.clientY }; drawTexture();
};
async function variantsChanged() { updateLabels(); await Promise.all([loadModel(), loadTextureCompare()]); }
$('variantA').onchange = $('variantB').onchange = variantsChanged;
$('swap').onclick = () => { const a=$('variantA').value; $('variantA').value=$('variantB').value; $('variantB').value=a; variantsChanged(); };
$('wireframe').onchange = () => state.models.forEach(root => root.traverse(object => { for (const material of Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : [object.material]) if (material) material.wireframe = $('wireframe').checked; }));
$('split').onchange = updateLabels;
$('lod').onchange = () => loadModel();
$('background').onclick = () => { state.background=(state.background+1)%backgrounds.length; const [name,color]=backgrounds[state.background]; renderer?.setClearColor(color); $('background').textContent=`Background: ${name}`; };
$('frame').onclick = frameModel;
$('modelTab').onclick = () => setTab('model'); $('textureTab').onclick = () => setTab('texture');

$('reload').onclick = refresh;
$('backToGrid').onclick = () => { ++state.textureEpoch; state.texture=null; $('textureCompare').hidden=true; $('textureGrid').hidden=false; };
$('nativeB').onchange = drawTexture;
$('zoom').onchange = () => { state.zoom=Number($('zoom').value); drawTexture(); };
$('resetPan').onclick = () => { state.pan={x:0,y:0}; drawTexture(); };
$('channels').onclick = event => { const channel=event.target.dataset.channel; if (!channel) return; state.channel=channel; for (const button of $('channels').children) button.classList.toggle('active',button.dataset.channel===channel); channelImages(); };
document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  if (event.repeat || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey || /INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(event.target.tagName) || !state.asset) return;
  const key=event.key.toLowerCase();

});
